Lamadoda eGibheboni athumela kuJoshua esibhedlela eGilgala, besithi: "Ungeke ususe isandla sakho kusuka kubakhonzi bakho; khawulela ufike utfume nathi, utawusisiza, ngobe lamakhosi lasemadolobheni lakwa-Amori wonke ahlanganisene natsi.
UJoshua waphuma eGilgala, yena nebantfu bakhe bonke, nalabo bonkhe bantfu lababoshwe ngemandla.
Simakadze watsi kuYoshuwa: "Ungabakhotsi, ngobe ngitawubanikela esandla sakho; akukho namunye wabo longeke akwazi ukumelana nawe."
UJoshua waphuma eGilgala, wafika kubo ngasebusuku bonke, watsi: "Ningabamangali.
Simakadze wabaphazamisa phambi kwa-Israyeli, wababulala ngemphiko enkulu eGibeoni, wabahlasela ngendlela leya eBethoroni, wababulala kuze kube seAzeka neMakedha.

Baye babaleka besuka eSirayeli, behamba ngendlela yeBeth-horon; ngobe Simakadze abewukhipha phezu kwabo umfula wemvula lomkhulu kusuka esibhakabhakeni, waya eAzeka, bafa; labafile ngalo mfula wemvula babeningi kunalabo abafile ngesikhephe samakhosikazi aseSirayeli.

Joshuwa wakhuluma kuSimakadze, ngelilanga lapho Simakadze anikela khona ema-Amori esihlalweni seSirayeli, watsi phambi kwalabo bonkhe baseSirayeli: "Ljulile, lizulu, phezu kweGibeboni, nenyanga, hlala phansi efulani la-Ajaloni!"

Lelilanga lahlala lihlala, nenyanga yahlala ihlala, kuze kufike lapho lomhlaba ubulala khona lomfishane wakhe, njengoba kubhalwe encwadini yeJashar. Lilanga lahlala lihlala phakathi kwesibhakabhaka, lelinye lilanga leliphelele, kuze lifike lihla.
Akukho lilanga lelifana nalo, ngaleso sikhathi noma ngemuva kwalo, lapho uSimakadze ekhuluma khona ngelizwi lemuntu njengelinjalo; ngobe uSimakadze wabambisana naSirayeli.
Joshuwa wabuyela ecampheni, yena nebantfu bakhe bonkhe, waya eGilgal.
Lamakhosi lamane akazange ahambe, wafika eMakedha, wafihlakela emgodini.
Bakhuluma kuJoshua, batsi: "Labankhosi lamashumi mahlanu bafunwa befihliwe emgodini eMakedha."
UJoshua watsi: "Gcwalisa emacwecwe amakhulu emlonyeni wegwadi, nibeke khona abantu kutsi bagcine.

ngobe Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, wabeka ema-Amori ngaphansi kwesandla senu; kodvwa ningeke nihlale lapha; landzelani labasolwa benu, nibitse emuva kwabo; ningabavumele bafike emizini yabo; ngobe uSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, wabanikela esandlani.
Bebabulala buhlungu kakhulu, uJoshua kanye nemadvodzana akhe, kuze kufike baphelelwa livi; nalabo abazange bahambe baphuma befika emizini yabo eyakhelwe ngetindlu.
Baye babuyela kuJoshua esiteji, eMakedheni, bonke labaholi bomhlaba; kwatsi angeke kubekho namunye lokhuluma nalabaSirayeli ngemuva kwalo.
UJoshua watsi: "Vula umlomo wegwadi, nifikeni nami lamakhosi lawa mahlanu."
Bafike bakhipha kulo mfula labankhosi labesihlanu, iJerusalema, neHebroni, neJarmuthi, neLakishi, neEgloni.

Babakhipha kubo kuJoshua, uJoshua wababiza bonke lamadodana eSirayeli, watsi kubaholi bebantfu labahamba naye: "Thintwani, nibeke tinyawo tenu phezu kwengcezu yalabankhosi." Bafike babeka tinyawo zabo ngaphansi kwengcezu yabo.
UJoshua wabaphendvula watsi: "Hambani, ningabi nenkinga; khululekeni ninetfu, ngobe Simakadze utawukwenza njalo kubo bonkhe lababuphikisi bakho labayawuphazamisa.
Joshuwa wababulala labankhosi, wababulala, wabeka emahlombe lasihlanu; babeka emahlombe abo kuze kube sebusuku.
Batsi: "Kungekucasha kwelanga, uYoshuwa watsi kubo: 'Nibakhuphe emajikijolo, niwafake emgodini lapho bekubophelela khona; babeka ematshe amakhulu emnyango wemgwaqo, kuze kube manje.'

UJoshua wehla eMakedha ngalolusuku, wabulala ukumkani wayo ngesandla sakhe, nalabo bonke labakhona kulomhlaba, wababulala nguNkulunkulu; akazange ashiye noma ngubani lophilayo. Wayewenza ukumkani weMakedha njengobe abeyawukwenza kumkani weJerikho.
Joshuwa wadlula eMakedha, yena kanye nabo bonkhe labaSirayeli, waya eLibna, wabahlasela.

USimakadze wabanikela ngesandla saSirayeli na-Libna, nenkhosi yayo; uJoshua wabulala bonke labakhona ngasekufeni kwesihlalo sebukhosi; akazange ashiye namunye lophilayo. Wakwenza ukumkani wayo njengobe abewenza ukumkani weJerikho.
Joshuwa wadlula eLibna, yena kanye nabo bonkhe bantfu base-Israyeli, waya eLakishi, bamisa emasitela kuwo, bahlasela.
USimakadze wehlisele Lakishi esandla saSirayeli, watsi uYoshuwa uyithathe lilanga lesibili, wabulala wonke lawo akhona ngesandla sakhe, njengobe abeyenze kuLibna.
Ngako Horam, ukumkani wa-Gezeri, waya eLakishi kutsi ayawusiza; kodvwa Joshua wambulala yena nebantfu bakhe, ngobe akazange amshiye lophilayo.
Joshuwa wadlula eLakishi, yena nalabaSirayeli bonkhe, waya eEgloni, bamisa emasitela kuwo, bahlasela.
Bayawuyikhipha ngalolusuku, babulala bonke labakhona ngasekufeni kweso; Joshua wayisaphazamisa njengobe abeyenze eLakishi.
Joshuwa waphuma eGeloni waya eHebroni, yena kanye nabo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli, bahlasela.
Bayihlasela, babulala ukumkani wayo, nalabo bonke labakhona kuyo, kanye nemindeni yabo ngesandla sekhephu; akazange ashiye nalowo lophilayo; wayisaphazamisa kahle-kahle, njengaseEgloni.
Joshuwa wabuyela, yena kanye nabo bonkhe bantfu base-Israyeli, bahlasela iDebiri.
Bayihlasela, bayawubulala wonke lakubo ngesandla sekhephu; akazange ashiye namunye lophilayo. UJoshua waba neDebiri kanye nobukhosi bayo, njengobe abeyenze eHebroni, neLibna kanye noMbuso wayo.

UJoshua wahlasela lelizwe lonke, idolobha langasentshonalanga, nedolobha langaseNtshonalanga, nedolobha langasempumalanga, nedolobha elingephansi, nalabo bonkhe bantfu babo; akazange ashiye nalowo lophilayo, wabulala wonke lowo uphefumulayo, njengobe Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, abewisela umthetho.
Joshuwa wabahlasela kusukela eKadeshe-barnea kuya eGaza, kanye nemhlaba wonke weGosheni kuze kufike eGibeoni.
Joshuwa wahlasela bonkhe lababukhosi kanye nemhlaba wabo ngaso sikhatsi lesidze, ngobe Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, wabambisana na-Israyeli.
Joshuwa wabuyela ecampheni, yena nebantfu bakhe bonkhe, waya eGilgal.
Yaba, unkhosi yaseHazori, yakubona lokhu, yathumela ku-Jobabi, ukumkani waseMadoni, nakubo bonkhe bantfu baseShimroni nabaseAkshafi, yatsi:
kanye namakhosi asemhlabatsini wasentshonalanga, eGibhithe laseJordane, enyakatho yelwandle lweGaliliya, nasemhlabatsini lwasenyakatho-mpumalanga, nasemhlabatsini waDori ngasempumalanga.
Wathumela nakwa-Kanana enyakatho nentshonalanga, nakwa-Amori, nakwa-Hethi, nakwa-Perizi, nakwa-Jebusi emhlabatsini, nakwa-Hivi ngaphansi komfula i-Hermon, emaphandleni aseMizpa.
Baphuma nabo onkhe emabutfo abo, likhulu kakhulu inani lamaphoyisa, lifana netinhlayiya temanti elwandle ngenani labo, kanye nemahhashi namadivaysi ekulwa amakhulu.
Lamadodana lawa onkhe ahlangana, wahlala elwandle laseMeromi, wahlasela bantfu baka-Israyeli.

USimakadze watsi kuYoshuwa: "Ungabakhombisi, ngobe kusasa ngaleso sikhathi ngitawubanikela bonke bafile ebusweni beSirayeli; emabhubesi abo uyawuwacobisa, nemiyalelo yabo yekulwa uyawuyibulala ngemlilo."
UJoshua wafika kubo, yena nebantfu bakhe bonke, ngasemanzini laMeromu, wabahlasela.
USimakadze wabanikela esandlani laSirayeli, lababulala, babashiya bafika eSidonu elikhulu, neMisrephothi-mayim, nalapho kuvela khona ifula leMizpa; bayabahlasela, kuze bangabi namunye lohlala phansi.
UJoshua wabasebentisa njengobe Simakadze abemphendvula watsi: "Emahhashini abo wamisa imilenze yawo, nemikhumbi yabo wayayibulala ngemlilo."
Nalapho Joshua ebuyela khona, wahlasela iHazori, wabulala ukumkani wayo ngesandla; Hazori ube yinhloko yato tonkhe tibukhosi.
Babulala bonke labakhona ngesandla sekhephu, babulawe ngokuphelele; akazange ashiye noma yini ephilayo; Joshua wakhipha neHazori.
Nawo wonke lamadolobha enkhosini, kanye namakhosi abo, ayawuwahlasela uJoshua, wababulala ngesandla sekhephu, wayabaphazamisa njengobe Mosesi, umkhonzi kaSimakadze, abewisela umthetho.
Lamadolobha lakhiwa ema-altare abo, iSirayeli akayibulala yinye, ngaphandle kweHazori, lapho uYoshuwa wayawubulala khona.
Lamandla lawo onkhe emadolobha, nempahla yawo kanye nesilwane sayo, bayawuhlala nabo; kodvwa bonke abantu babulala ngesandla sekhephu, kuze baphelelwe livi; bangasishiya nasinye isive.
USimakadze wabawisela umkhonzi wakhe uMosi, uMosesi wabeka kuwo uYoshuwa; uJoshuwa wabalalela; akazange anikeze lutho kunoma yini leyo Simakadze abem Tiphati.

Ngako-ke uJoshua wathatha lelizwe lonke, idolobha langasentshonalanga, nemhlaba wonke waseNtshonalanga, nemhlaba wonke weGosheni, nemhlaba wema-Arabha, nemhlaba womfula iJordane, nedolobha langasentshonalanga laseSirayeli, nemhlaba wema-Arabha,
kusukela emfuleni iHalaka, lowela eSeiri, kuya eBaal-Gadi, ensimini yeLibanoni, ngaphansi komfula iHermon; wakhipha bonkhe bantfu babo, wabahlasela, wababulala.
UJoshua wahlasela bonkhe labankhosi, iminyaka leminingi.
Akukho mdolobha leyawumisa ukuthula nalabaSirayeli, ngaphandle kwalabaHivi labahlala eGibeoni; bonkhe labaSirayeli bababuyisa ngekulwa.
USimakadze wabanika umphefumulo wabo ubuhlungu, bahlasela bantfu bakaSirayeli, kutsi babulawe ngokuphelele, bangabi nekuthula, njengobe Simakadze abewisela umthetho Mose.

Ngeleso sikhathi uJoshua waya, wabulala lamadodana eEnaki emadolobheni lasogwini, eHebron, neDebiri, naAnabi, kanye naleyo ndawo isogwini laseYuda naseSirayeli; uJoshua wabaphazamisa nabo bonkhe bantfu basemaphandleni abo.
Akazange ashiye lamadodana la-Enaki ezweni laseSirayeli; kuphela eGaza, neGati, na-Ashdodi, kwahlala.
Ngako-ke uJoshua wathatha lelizwe lonke, njengobe Simakadze abekhuluma kuMosese; Joshua wawanikelasa lamakhosikazi aseSirayeli njengelifa labo, ngemifelokati yabo. Lelizwe laphumula emkhosini.
Nalaba baholi belizwe labo lababiswe nguSirayeli ngaseJordane, enyakatho yelanga, labahlala khona kusukela emfuleni i-Arnon kuya emfuleni i-Hermon, nabo bonke labasemaphandleni aseJordane enyakatho:

Sihoni, ukumkani wema-Amori, lohlala eHeshboni, walawula kusukela eAroeri, lapho kubekwe khona umfula i-Arnon, naphakathi komfula, nengxenye yeGiliyadi, kuya emfuleni iJabhok, lomkhawulo wemadvodzana a-Ammon.
Wayelawula nemhlaba waseJordani, kusuka elwandle lwaseGaliliya kuya elwandle lokudlwengulayo, kuze kufike eBethe-Jeshimothi, nakwesobunxele eningizimu yePisga.
Bayawukhipha naleyo ndawo yaOg, ukumkani wase-Bashan, lowaseRephayi, lowo ahlala eAshtarothi neEdrei.
walawula eningizimu yemhlabatsi we-Hermon, neSalekha, naleyo yonke iBashan, kuze kufike emgwaqeni weGeshuru neMaaka, naphesheya kweGileyadi, kuze kufike emgwaqeni waSihoni, ukumkani waseHeshboni.
Musa, umkhonzi waSimakadze, kanye nalabaSirayeli babebabulala; kodvwa Mose, umkhonzi waSimakadze, wabanika itfu labo baseRubeni, nelabo baseGadi, kanye nengxenye yetfu labeseManase.

Nalaba bakunguJoshuwa kanye nemadvodzana akhe, labawabulala ngaseJordani eningizimu, kusuka eBaal-Gadi ensimini yaseLibanoni kuya emfuleni iHalaka, losuka eSeiri; Joshuwa wabanikela ngemhlaba wabo kumaSibiyali, abe yindawo yabo, yabahlukanise.

Emhlabatsini, nemhlabatsini lophansi, nemhlabatsini lweJordane, nemhlabatsini lomile, nemhlabatsini wetfu, nemhlabatsini waseNtshonalanga, indzawo yebantfu be-Heti, nabase-Amori, nabase-Kananani, nabase-Perizi, nabase-Hivi, nabase-Jebusi.
uMbuso waseJerikho, owodwa; ubukhosi beAi, eBetheleli, owodwa;
ukumkani weJerusalema, umnye; ukumkani weHebroni, umnye;
ukumkani weJarmuthi, omunye; ukumkani weLakishi, omnye;
ubukhosi be-Egloni, bunye; uMbuso we-Gezeri, bunye;
ubukhosi beDebiri, bunye; uMbuso weGeder, bunye;
ukumkani weHorma, omunye; ukumkani weArad, omnye;
ukumkani weLibna, omunye; ukumkani weAdulamu, omnye;
uMbuso waseMakedha, owodwa; uMbuso weBheteli, owodwa;
ubukhosi beTaphuya, bunye; uMbuso weHefer, bunye;
ubukhosi be-Afeki, bunye; uMbuso weLasaroni, bunye;
ubukhosi beMadoni, bunye; uMbuso weHazori, bunye;
unkhosi yaShimroni, Meron, yinye; unkhosi yaAkshaphi, linye;
ubukhosi beTaanakhi, olunye; uMbuso weMegido, lunye;
uMbuso waseKedeshi, omunye; uMbuso weJokneam eKarmeli, owodwa;
ubukhosi beDori, emahhashini laDori, bunye; uMbuso weTigoyimi eGilgal, bunye;
uMbuso waseTirsha, owodwa; kwabakho bukhosi lamashumi lasitfupha nelinye.
UJoshua waba mkhulu, wahlala iminyaka emikhulu; Simakadze watsi kuye: "Wena sewungumtfubi kakhulu, futhi ilizwe lelisasele lincane kakhulu lokulihlasela.
Lolu yilizwe lelisesele, lonke mhlabatsi lwabaFilisti nalabaGeshuri,

kusukela emfuleni i-Shihori, umkhawulo weMisri enyakatho, kuze kufike kumsindvo lesasingemagremu lamakhulu lamabili nemashumi mahlanu (ngobe likhulu elinamaphesenti ayisishiyagalombili), kuya emabhishi aseGhazi, naseAshdodi, naseAshkeloni, naseGathi, naseEkroni, kanye nalabo baseAvhi.
nasenyakatho, kanye nemhlaba wema-Kananani wonke, kusukela eAraha, leyayibekiwe labaSidoni, kuze kufike eAfeki, umkhawulo wesive sema-Amoreti;
kanye nemhlaba wema-Gebali, nemhlaba wonke weLibanoni enyakatho, kusuka eBaal-Gadi ngaphansi komfula iHermon, kuze kufike eHamati.

Nabo bonke labahlala kulomhlabatsini, kusuka eLibanoni kuya eMisrephothi-mayim, nalaba baseSidoni, ngitawubakhipha phambi kwamakhosikazi aseSirayeli; qiniseka kutsi ngiyawubanika lamazwe lakwaSirayeli njengelifa labo, njengobe sengikhuluma kuwe.
Ngako-ke, hlukanise lelilizwe libe ngumnikelo wesono ema-Israyeli lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa kanye nesihlanu sema-Israyeli waManase.

NaseRhubeni nawaseGadi, kanye nengxenye yemadvodzana aManase, babenemhlaba lowawuwanikela kubo uMosese ngaleso sifundazweni saseJordane, lapho kuphuma khona ilanga; uMosi, mkhonzi waSimakadze, wabanikela wona.
Kusuka e-Aroeri, enhliziyweni yemfula i-Arnon, kanye nedolobha leliphakathi kwemfula, naleyo ndawo yonke yaseMediba, kuya eDiboni;
naletinye tinhloko-dolobha taSihoni, ukumkani wema-Amori, lowabe eHeshboni, kuze kufike emgwaqeni wabana-Ammon.
Gileyadi, nemhlaba wema-Geshuri nalama-Maaka, kanye nalomhlaba wema-Hermon, nemhlaba wonke weBashan kuze kufike eSaleka;
inkhosi yase-Ogi eBashan, loyawuhlala eAshtarothi neEdreyi; yena waba ngumunye walabo labashiywa nguRefayi, ngobe Musa wababulala, wabakhipha.
Ba-Israyeli baphindze bakhipha Geshuri naMaaka; ngobe Geshuri neMaaka behlala phakathi kwa-Israyeli kuze kuleso sikhathi.
Kusesukuni laLevi-ke uMosese akazange amnike umhlaba; iminikelo yekushiswa yaSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, ngumnikelo wabo, njengobe watsi kubo.
Lokho kwakungumnikelo wesono loMosese wawunikela emndenini waRubeni, ngemindeni yabo.
Lemhlaba wabo wawusuka e-Aroeri, enhliziyweni yegwadi le-Arnon, nedolobha leliphakathi kwegwadi, naleyo ndawo yonke yaseGibhithe ifike ku-Medaba;
Heshboni, naletinye tinhloko-dolobha letingaphansi kwayo eGibhithe: Diboni, neBamoti-Baali, neBet-Baali-Meoni,
neJahazi, neKedemothi, neMefaati,
neKiritayim, neSibma, neZerethi-Shahari, emhlabatsini efulethini,
Bethe-Peori, netintaba tePisga, neBethesi-Jeshimoti.

nawo wonke lamadolobha e-Arabha, nemhlaba jikelele waSihoni, ukumkani wema-Amori, lowawuhlala eHeshboni, lapho Mosi abewuhlasela khona yena nabaholi beMidyani: uEvi, noRekem, noTsur, noHuri, noReba, bantfu baleyolizwe labasebenza kuSihoni.
Na Balaamu, unyana kaBeori, lokhuluma ngemanti, bayawuwubulala nabo bantfu labafileyo ngesikhephe.
Lemikhawulo yakwa-Rhubheni enyakatho yayiyiJordane; lamadolobha lawa, nemindeni yawo, abe ngumnikelo wesono kutsi ahlukaniswe kumadvodzana a-Rhubheni.
Lowo ngumnikelo wesono loMosese wawunikela esukundeni seGadi, ngemindeni yawo.
Nalemhlaba wabo waba yiJazeri, naletinye tinhloko-dolobha teGileyadi, nengxenye yemhlaba wemadvodzana a-Ammon, kuze kufike e-Aroeri, eliseduze neRabha.
Kusuka eHeshboni kuya eRamathi-Mizpa, neBethonimi, naseMahanayini kuya emgwaqeni weDebiri.

Nasefulani kwakunguBet-harama, neBet-nimra, neSukhothi, neZafoni, lelinye lamadolobha aSihoni, ukumkani waseHeshboni; umkhawulo wabo ube yiJordane enyakatho, kuze kufike esiphelweni selwandle laseGaliliya, ngasentshonalanga yeJordane.
Lolu mhlabatsini lwakwa-Gadi, ngemindeni yawo, lamadolobha lawa kanye netimfula tawo.
Lokho kwakungulo loMosese abewanikela ngaleso semfuleni i-Euphrates, emphilweni yemadvodzana aManase.
Lemhlaba wabo wawusuka eMahanayim, waya kuwo wonke Bashan, lonke ubukhosi beOg, ukumkani waseBashan, naletinye tinhloko-dolobha taYairi, letikhona eBashan, imidzi lemashumi lamane.
Nalengxenye yeGileyadi, neAshtarothi na-Edrei, emadolobha enkhosini ya-Ogi eBashan, wayala lamadvodzana aMakhiri, umsa waManase, lelikhulu lamadvodzakati aMakhiri, ngemndeni wabo.
Lolu mhlaba uMosese wawuhlukanisela emahlathini eMoabi, ngaseJodhani laseJerikho, enyakatho-mpumalanga.
Kusesukuni laLevi-ke, uMosi akazange amnike umhlaba; Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, ungumfelokati wabo, njengobe wabatshele.
Lolu mhlaba wahlukaniswa kwabaSirayeli, ezweni laseKanana; Eleazari umLevi, neJoshua unyana ka-Nun, nabaholi bemindeni yabo bayawuhlukanisela lamazwe lakwa-Israyeli.
Lamakhosi lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa namakhulu mahlanu, aphindze ahlukanise iNingizimu Afrika ngesandla sakhe, njengobe Simakadze abewisela umthetho ngaMosi.
Mosi wabanike lamakhosikazi abo ema-Amori, kanye nalabaLevi; ngobe Mosese wabanike lamadolobha abo ema-Amori, kanye nalabaLevi, ngasenyakatho yeJordane.

BaLevi baphindze batfunywa ema-Israyeli, laba yimindeni lemibili: uManase neEframu; kodvwa labaLevi babengenawo lomnikelo wesono emhlabatsini, ngaphandle kwemijikelo yamadolobha abehlala kuwo, kanye nemihlambi yetimbuti neyempahla.
Lamadvodza ase-Israyeli ahlukanise ilizwe, njengobe Simakadze abewisela Mose.
BaLevi bafika kuJoshua eGilgal, watsi kubo Kalebe, unyana kaJefune, umKenisi: "Uyazi kutsi yini leyo Simakadze abekhuluma ngayo kuMosese, indodana yaNkulunkulu, ngemi, nawe, eKadeshe-barnea.

Ngabe sengineminyaka lemashumi lamane lobudala, lapho Mosese, umkhonzi waSimakadze, engangithumela khona kusuka eKadeshe-barnea kutsi ngiyihlolisise lelizwe; ngabuyela ngakhuluma ngeqiniso, njengobe kwakungumoya wami.
Bami, labahamba nami, batfusa intliziyo yalaba bantu; kodvwa mina ngalandela uSimakadze Nkulunkulu wami ngentliziyo yami yonke.
Wathi ke uMosi, ngalolusuku lwalo: 'Lemhlaba lowudlulanga kuwo, kufanele ube wakho wena nabantwana bakho kuze kube sekupheleni; ngobe walandela uSimakadze Nkulunkulu wami ngenhliziyo yakho yonke.'

"Namuhla, bona, Simakadze ungigcine ephila iminyaka lemashumi mane nesihlanu, njengobe washo, kusukela kuleso sikhathi lapho akhuluma khona kuMosesi, lapho laSirayeli behamba khona entaba-mlilo; ngineminyaka lemashumi lamakhulu asibhozo nesihlanu.
Ngase nginemandla njengaleso sikhathi lapho Mosesi amemetela khona; ngase ngiphuma ngekulwa, njengobe ngabe sengikhona nalapho.

Namuhla, nikela ngalendawo yasemgwaqweni loSimakadze wakhuluma nami ngalolusuku. Utakubona khona kutsi bakhona ema-Enaki, namadolobha amakhulu anemigodi; kepha ngiyawuwakhipha ngesandla saNkulunkulu, njengoba ashoyo.
UJoshua wabambisa Kalebe, unyana waJefune, watsi: "Sitawukunika Hebroni njengemhlaba wakhe.
Ngako-ke uKhalebe, umsa kaJefune, umKenisi, wahlala eHebroni kuze kube namuhla, ngobe wayesewulandela Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, ngenhliziyo yakhe yonke.
Igama leHebroni kwakunguKirihati-Arba, ngegama laArba, lomkhulu kulabo baka-Enaki; khona lelilizwe lahlala likhululeke.
Lakwa-Edomu, kuze kufike emfuleni iSini, enyakatho-ntshonalanga, kwaba ngumhlaba wema-Amori, kanye nemhlaba wema-Amoni, enyakatho.
Umkhawulo wabo wasentshonalanga waqala ekugcineni kwesokudla kweMfula Lomnyama, kugwaca lokubheke eningizimu.
wadlula enyakatho-ntshonalanga kwendlela yeSkorpion, waya eZini, wehla enyakatho yeKadeshe-Barnea, wadlula eHezroni, wafika eAdari, wajika waya eKarka.
wadlula e-Azmoni, wafika eMfuleni weMisri, waphuma elwandle. Lowube umkhawulo wabo wasempumalanga.
Umkhawulo wasenyakatho ube yilwandle lelibomvu, kuze kube kufike emfuleni iJordane; umkhawulo wentshonalanga waba ngumhlabatsi welwandle, lapho liJodhani liphuma khona.
wafika eBet-hogla, wadlula eBet-arabha ngasenyakatho, waya eStone of Bohan son of Reuben.
wahamba waya eDebiri kusuka emfuleni i-Akor, wabuyela ngasenyakatho eGilgal, lobhekene nendlela ledlula e-Adummim, enhliziyweni yemhlabatsini; waya emawotini la-En-shemeshi, waphuma e-En-rogeli.

wahamba waya emfuleni waseBenhinom, wafika enyakatho-ntshonalanga yedolobha laseJebusi, leliyiJerusalema; waphuma khona wafika esiphelweni somfula weHinom, lobekwe ngasentshonalanga yentaba yaseRephayimi.
Kusuka esiphelweni semhlabatsini, umkhawulo wawuhamba waya emfuleni weNeftoha, wadlula emadolobhaneni aseMfula i-Efron, wehla waya eBaala (leyo yiKiriyati-yearim).
wasuka eBahala, wajika waya emgwaqeni waseSeiri, wadlula emaphandleni lasentshonalanga eMfula iJearim (leyo nguKeshaloni), waphuma eBethe-Shemeshi, wehla eTimna.
wahamba waya e-Ekroni ngasenyakatho, wajika waya eSikeroni, wadlula emfuleni iBaala, wafika eJabneel, waphuma elwandle.
Lemikhawulo yasenyakatho ifike kulwandle olukhulu. Lolu mhlabatsi lwabe luphakathi kwendzawo yekugcina tindzaba temadvodzana aJuda, ngemindeni yabo.
Simakadze watsi kuJoshua: "Utawunikela ngemnikelo wekushiswa eKiretha-Arba, lokunguHebroni, utata wa-Anaka, kutsi kube ngumnikelo wesono kubo bonkhe bantfu bakaJuda.
Kalebe wakhipha eHebroni lamadodana la-Enaki lasitfupha: Sheshai, neAhimam, naTalmai, bantfu labazalwa ngu-Anaki.
Kusuka khona wahamba waya ema-Amori labahlala eDebiri (kwaba kuthiwa yiKiriyati-Seferi).
Kalebe watsi: "Lomuntfu lobulala iKiriyati-seferi, nome uyawuyihlasela, ngitawumunika intombi yami, Aksha, kutsi abe ngumkakhe."
Wayihlasela Otniyeli, umsa waKenazi, lomkhuluwa kaKalebi; kodvwa Kalebe wamnika Aksa, intombi yakhe, kutsi abe ngumfazi wakhe.
Yafika ku-Othniyeli, yatsi kuye kutsi afune mhlaba wababa wakhe. Waye waphuma ejele, Kalebe watsi kuyo: "Ufuna yini?"

Wayiphendvula yatsi: "Nceda ungisinike sipho sakho; ngobe usanginikela ngemhlaba waseNtshonalanga, uyawuminika namanzi lasogwini." Kalebu watsi kuye: "Ninikeze amanzi esogwini lasephakeme kanye nesogwini lasephansi."
Lomhlaba utawuniketwa kutsi ube ngumhlaba wema-Amori, kanye nemindeni yabo.
Lemijikelo yabo enyakatho-ntshonalanga, kuya emgwaqeni weEdomu, yayiKabseeli, neEderi, neJaguri,
Kinaha, neDimona, neAdada,

na-Ekroni, nemadolobha ayo, nemindeni yayo;
kanye nebantfu labasenyakatho yeEkroni, eAshdodi, nabo bonkhe bantfu basemaphandleni.
kanye neAshdodi, namadolobha ayo, nemindeni yayo; kanye neGaza, namadolobha ayo, nemindeni yayo, kuze kufike emfuleni weMisri, elwandle olukhulu.

kanye neArabha, neDuma, neEshan,

Humtha, neKirihati-Arba (leyo yiHebron), neTsior; lamadolobha lasikhombisa nalabasemaphandleni awo.

neHalul, neBeth-Tsur, neGedori,
neMaarathi, neBetha-anoti, neEltekoni; lamadolobha lasitfupha kanye netibondza tabo.
neKiriyati-baali (leyo yiKiriyati-yearimi), neRabha; lamadolobha lawa mabini namadolobheni ayo.
Emhlabatsini kwakunguBetha-Arabha, neMiddine, neSekakah,
Nibshani, nedolobhana lefulawa, na-Engedi; lamadolobha ayisishiyagalombili kanye nemindeni yabo.
NaseJebusi, labahlala eJerusalema, Yuda akazange awakhuphule; ngobe iJebusi yahlala nemadvodzana akhe eJerusalema kuze kube ngalolusuku.
Lomhlaba waba nguwemadvodzana aYosefu, waphuma eJordane ngaphesheya kweJerikho, ngasentshonalanga yeJerikho; waya phezulu kusuka eJerikho, waya entaba-mlilo, waya eBheteli.
Kusuka eBetheleli (leyo nguLuzi), waya ezweni lalabaArki, ku-Ataroti.
wahamba waya emhlabatsini lwabaJaflethi, kuze kufike eBet-horon laphansi, wadlula eGezeri, wafika emaphandleni aselwandle.
Ngako-ke Manase neEfrayim, bantfu bakaJosefa, batfunywa mhlaba wabo.
Lomhlaba wemadvodzana aEfraim, ngemindeni yabo, ube: umkhawulo wabo enyakatho wawusuka eAtaroti-Adari waya eBeth-horoni lasentshonalanga;
waya elwandle, wasuka eMikmetathi ngasenyakatho, wehla eTaanathi-Shilo, waya eJanoa ngasentshonalanga.
waphuma eJanoa waya eAtaroti neNaara, wafika eJerikho, wehla waya eJordane.
Kusuka eTaphuya, umkhawulo wawuhamba ufike emgwaqeni weKana, wafika elwandle. Lowuwo ngumhlaba waseSibiya-Ephrayi, ngemindeni yawo.
Lamadolobha laphindze ahlukaniswe ema-Efrayim, kanye nemindeni yabo, emhlabatsini waManase.
Abengeke nabo bakhuphe la-Kananani labahlala eGezeri; kodvwa la-Kananani abahlala phakathi kwaEfremu kuze kungakapheli lomnyaka, wafike waba ngumkhonzi.
Lelilizwe latfolwa nguMahakhi, umsa waManase, lomkhulu kuJosefa; Makhakhi, lomkhulu kuJosefa, waba ngumzali waGileyadi; ngobe bebengabanyenti babaholi bokulwa, babe neGileyadi naBashani.

Lomhlaba waba nguwelabo labashiywa lamakhosikazi eManase, ngemindeni yabo: imindeni yaAbiezeri, nemindeni yeHeleki, nemindeni ye-Asriyeli, nemindeni yeShekemi, nemindeni ye-Heferi, nemindeni ye-Shemida; labo bamadodana kaManase, unyana waJosefa, ngemindeni yabo.

Ase-Celofehadi, umsa waHeferi, umsa waGileyadi, umsa waMakhiri, umsa waManase, akazange abe nemadvodzana, kepha waba nemadvodzakati; lamagama lamadodana akhe lakunguMahla, naNoha, naHogla, naMilka, naTirsa.

Bafike ku-Eleazari, umLevi, naJoshua, unyana wa-Nun, nebaholi, batsi: "Simakadze watsi kuMosesi ukuthi atinike umhlaba phakathi kwemadvodzana ethu." UJoshua wabanikela ngemhlaba phakathi kwemadvodzana abo, njengoba Simakadze abewisela umthetho.
Ngako-ke uManase wathola imifelonyo lelishumi, ngaphandle kweGileyadi neBashani, ngaleyo ndawo yeJordane enyakatho.
ngobe madvodzana a-Manase abenemhlaba kanye nalabomadvodzakati akhe; kepha ilizwe leGiliyadi labe likhona kubo bonkhe bantfu ba-Manase.
Lamandla laManase asuka e-Aseri waya eMikmetathi, enyakatho yeShekhemi, wafika emaphandleni labahlala eEntappuah.
Lemhlaba waseTaphua waba nguwaseManase; kepha idolobha laseTaphua, lelinemikhawulo yamakhosi eManase, waba nguweEfremu.

Lapha umkhawulo wehla waya emfuleni iKana; ngasempumalanga yemhlabatsine kwakunguEphrayi, nalapho kwaba khona imifula yaManase. Umkhawulo waManase wawusuka emphemeni wasenyakatho wemhlabatsine, wafika elwandle.
Ephrayim wahlala enyakatho, Manase enyakatho; bese ilwandle liyimikhawulo yasemantshonalanga yaManase; lafika ku-Asere enyakatho, lafika ku-Issakharemu emgwaqeni.
Nase-Issakhareni nawase-Aseri, kwaba nguManase: Bethe-Shani, ne-Ibleam, nalabo baseDori, nalabo baseEndori, nalabo baseTaanakhi, nalabo baseMegido, nalaba baseNaphothi, kanye nemindeni yabo.
Nase-Manase akazange akhuphule lamadolobha lawo, ngobe labaKanani bafuna kuhlala kulolu mhlaba.
Bafika baphindze bakhululwa, batsi: "Ase-Kananani abe ngumnikelo wesono, kodvwa akazange aboshwe nguNkulunkulu."
Lamadvodza laYosefu akhuluma kuJoshua, watsi: "Ngubani na lotawuninika ingxenye eyodwa kuphela yemhlaba, natsi sesingabantu abaningi, ngobe Simakadze usiberekile kakhulu?"
UJoshua watsi kubo: "Uma niningi kakhulu, nemhlabatsine wa-Ephrayi uncane kuwe; phumani efulethini, nize nibuyele ensimini yenu, niwucwebezele phansi umhlaba wePerizite nawaseRefayi."

Baphendvula batsi: "Lemhlabatsi ungeke ufike siwufinyelele; nabo bonkhe bantfu base-Kanana labahlala eGibhithe banesibhakabhaka banemikhumbi yensimbi, nalabo base-Bethe-Shani kanye nemindeni yayo, nalabo base-Jezreyeli.
UJoshua wakhuluma kubomadvodzana aJosefe, eEfraim neManase, watsi: "Wena nibantfu abaningi, ninamandla kakhulu; ningaba nemfelokati lomunye.
Lemhlabatsi nalowo mhlabatsi utawuba wakho; uyawuwususa, utawuba wako wonke. Utawukhipha laSikanani, ngobe nabo banesibhakabhaka sensimbi, naphezu kwekunge banamandla.
Bahlangana bonkhe bantfu base-Israyeli eSilo, bamisa khona itente lekuhlangana; nemhlaba waba ngaphansi kwabo.
Lakwa-Israyeli lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu emindeni yabo akazange abe nendlu yakhe.
UJoshua watsi kuboSirayeli: "Kungakaze kube yini kutsi nihambe niyithathe lelizwe loSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, wakulethela?
"Thiphani lamadoda lasitfupha emndenini ngamunye, ngobe ngitawubathumela bahambe behamba ngemhlaba, babhalela kutsi bangawuhlukanisela kanjani, bese babuyela kimi.
Bayawuyihlukanisela ibe ingxenye lesitsatfu; Yuda uhlala ezweni lakhe lasenyakatho, nemadvodzana aJosefu lihlala emhlabatsini lwawo.
Nibhalela lamacala lasikhombisa, niyifikele lapha kimi; ngitawutfusa lokuhlukumeza kwenu lapha phambi kwaSimakadze Nkulunkulu wethu.

švini kutsi labaLevi bangeke babe nengxenye phakathi kwenu, ngobe umnikelo waSimakadze ngumnikelo wabo; kodvwa Gadi na-Rubhene naphesheya kwelwandle kweJordane, kanye nesigamu semndeni wakwaManase, batfumele mhlaba wabo, loMosi, mkhonzi waNkulunkulu, wabanikela kuwo.
Baye baphuma, uJoshua watsi kubo: "Hambani nihambe ngemhlaba, niyibhale, bese nibuya nami, ngitawutfusa lokuhlukunyezwa kwenu lapha eShilo phambi kweSimakadze."
Lamadoda layawuhamba adlula ezweni, wabhala libhuku, wabhalela inhloko-dolobha ngenhloko-dolobha, ngamacala lasikhombisa; babuyela kuJoshua emkhosini eShilo.
Joshuwa wabeka sihlabani kubo eSilo phambi kuSimakadze, watsi: "Lomhlaba utawuhlukaniswa phakathi kwalabaSirayeli ngemindeni yabo.
Lesihlabani sekucala saphuma lesihlanganiso semadvodzana aBenjamini, ngemindeni yabo; nemabutfo abo abephakathi kwemhlaba waJuda nemhlaba waJosefa.
Lemikhawulo yabo yasenyakatho yasuka eJordane, yadlula eningizimu yeJerikho, yafika emadolobheni lasentshonalanga, yaphuma entaba-mlilo yaseBe rato-Aweni.
Kusuka khona umkhawulo udlula emphemeni weLuz (leyo nguBetheleli), wafika eAtaroti-Adari, emfuleni waseBethoroni lophansi, emaphandleni.
Kusuka emfuleni lobhekene neBeth-Horon, enyakatho, umkhawulo wajika enyakatho, waya eKirihati-Baali (leyo yiKirihati-Yearim), enhloko-dolobha yabanaJuda; lelinye icala bekungukwentshonalanga.
Icala lasekudla lisuka eKirihati-Jearim, lisenyakatho-mpumalanga, lifike emfuleni waseNeftoha.
wahamba waya emadolobheni lakwa-Efrayim, wafika eGileyadi; bese udlula emgwaqeni waseRephayimi ngaseNtshonalanga, wehla kuze afike enhliziyweni yedolobha laseJebhusi elinomfula weHinnom.
wabuyela ngasenyakatho, waya eEn-shemesi, wadlula eGili-lothi, elinamaphesheya kwendlela lesuka eAdummim, wehla waya eStone of Bohan son of Reuben.
wafika esigabeni sasenyakatho lesibheke egwadini leJordane, wehla waya egwadini.
wahamba waya ayo Jas Rayon phandleni yase-Efrayim, waya eGileyadi ápayeni lase-Amori neprini yeGileadi, waya eBet-hogala, waya eGileadi, waya eGileadi, waya eGileadi, waya eGileadi, waya eGileadi.
Lomhlabatsi ufike kuJordane, ngasenyakatho-mpumalanga; lomhlabatsi waba ngumhlabatsi wemindeni yemadvodzana aBenjamini.
Lamadolobha lamakhosikazi aBenjamini, ngemindeni yabo, lakunguJerikho, neBethogla, neEmek-kezisi,
Bet-araba, neZemarayim, neBetheleli,
Avvim, nePara, neOfra,
Kefari-Ammoni, neHofeni, neGeba; lamadolobha lalishumi elinhlanu nalabasemaphandleni abo.
neGibeoni, neRama, neBeerothi,
Mispa, neKefira, neMoza,
Rekem, ne-Irpayeli, neTara,
Sela, neHalephe, nedolobha laseJebusi (leyo liyiJerusalema), neGibeha, neKiriyati; lamadolobha alishumi elinesihlanu namadolobha abo. Lolu Tiphati, ne-Eshboni, ne-Eshboni, ne-Eshboni.
Isoti lesitsatfu saphuma sesuku lemadvodzana aSimeoni, ngemindeni yawo; lemhlaba wabo wawusemhlaba waJuda.
Lemhlaba wabo waba nguBeer-Sheba, kanye neMolada,
Hasar-Shuali, neBala, neEzem,
Eltoladi, neBethuli, neHorma,
Ziklagi, neBet-markabothi, neHazari-Susa,
Bethe-libaothi, neSaruheni: tidolobhana letilishumi linamithathu namadolobha abo.
Ayin, neRimon, neEter, neAshan; lamadolobha lasitfupha namadolobheni abo.
kanye naletinye tinhloko-dolobha letiseceleni kwalaba madolobha, kuze kufike eBaalathi-Beeri (leyiRama yasentshonalanga); lomhlaba waba nguwaseSimeoni ngemindeni yawo.
Simeoni wathola inhloko-dolobha yakhe emhlabatsini lwaYuda, ngobe uJuda ube nenhloko-dolobha enkulu kunaye. Ngako-ke Simeoni waba nenhloko-dolobha yakhe emhlabatsini lwaYuda.
Lomnikelo wesono wesithathu waphuma kuZabuloni, ngemindeni yawo; umkhawulo wabo wawufika eSaridi.
wahamba waya eMarala, wafika eDabheshethi, wafika eJokneam-gadi.
Kusuka eSarid, ibuyela emaphandleni lapho lilanga liphuma khona, ifike ezweni leKisloth-Tabor, yadlula eDaberat, yafika eJaphia.
kusuka khona waya eGathi-Heferi, neEth-Kazini, waphuma eRimoni, wajika waya eNeha.
Kusenyakatho, umkhawulo wawuhamba waya eHanaton, wafika emfuleni weYifta-eli.
neKathathi, neNahalali, neShimroni, neJidala, naBethelehemu: imijingwane lelishumi nembili nemadolobha ayo.
Lamadolobha lawa nemindeni yawo, lakungumhlaba wema-Zabuloni ngemindeni yawo.
Lokuhlukumezeka lokutsatfu kwaphuma ku-Issakhar, ngemindeni yawo.
Lemhlaba wabo ube yiJezreyeli, neKesulothi, neSunem,
Haparayim, neSiyoni, neAnaharathi,
Rabithi, neKishoni, ne-Ebezi,
Remethi, neEn-ganimi, neEn-hada, naBeth-pazez.
Lemikhawulo yafika eTabori, neShahazuma, neBethe-shemeshi, yaphela eJordane; lamadolobha lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu nalabasemaphandleni abo.
Lamadolobha lawa nemindeni yawo, lakungumhlabatsi wemndeni wakwa-Issakhar, ngemindeni yawo.
Lokuhlukunyezwa kwesihlanu kwaphuma kutsi kube ngumnikelo wesono wesifazane wase-Aseri, ngemindeni yawo.
Lemhlaba wabo ube yiHelekathi, neHali, neBetheni, neAkshaphi,
Ema-Alammeleki, nama-Amad ne-Mishali; bese umkhawulo ufike eKarmeli naseShihori-Libnathi.
wabuyela emaphandleni eBet-dagoni, wafika eZabuloni nefula leYifta-eli, wadlula eBethe-emek naseNeyeli, waya eKabuli ngasekhohlo.
wafika e-Abdon, neRehobho, neHamon, neKana, waya eSidoni elikhulu.
wajika waya eRama, wafika eTire, lasemaphandleni, wajika waya eHosa, waphela elwandle, ezweni lase-Akzib.
kanye ne-Umma, ne-Afeki, ne-Rehobothi; lamadolobha lamashumi lasitfupha namakhulu mahlanu kanye netibondza tabo.
Lamadolobha lawa nemindeni yawo, lakungumhlabatsi wemndeni wakwa-Aseri, ngemindeni yawo.
Lomnikelo wekushiswa wesishiyagalolunye waphuma ku-Naphtali, ngemindeni yawo.
Umkhawulo wabo wawusuka eHelephi, ne-Ashera eZaananim, waya eAdami-Nekeb, neYabneel, wafika eLakumi, waphela eJordane.
bese umkhawulo udlula eAznothi-Tabhori ngasenyakatho, uye waya eHukok; wafika kuZebuloni emaphandleni lasentshonalanga neAshere emaceleni asemantshonalanga naJuda kwaJordane eningizimu.
Lamadolobha lasemasitezi akunguSidimu, neZeri, neHamathi, neRakati, neKinnerethi,
Adama, neRama, neHazori,
Kedesh, neEdrei, neEnhazori,
Iron, Migdal-e-el, neHorem, neBet-anathi, neBet-shemeshi; lamadolobha lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa nalabasemaphandleni abo.
Lamadolobha lawa nemindeni yawo, lakungumhlabatsi wemndeni wakwaNeftali, ngemindeni yawo.
Lokuhlukunyezwa lokusikhombisa kwaphuma kutsi kube ngumnikelo wesono wesifazane waseDani, ngemindeni yawo.
Lemhlaba wabo waba nguSora, neEshtaoli, neIr-Shemeshi,
Shalabini, neAyaloni, neItla,
Eloni, neThimna, neEkroni,
Elteke, neGibethoni, neBalathi,
Jehudi, neBene-Beraka, neGath-Rimoni,
Me Jarkon neRakkon, kanye nendzawo lebhekene neJoppa.
Bafike bahlasela iLeshemi, bayawuthatha, bawubulala ngesandla, bahlala khona; bashintsha igama leLeshemi libe nguDani, ngegama laDani, lomkhulu wabo.
Lolu mhlabatsini lwalemindeni yemadvodzana aDani, kanye nemadolobhana ayo, bekungumhlabatsini lwalemindeni yabo.
Bafike baphela bahlukanisela iNingizimu Afrika ngemifelokati yayo, bantfu baseSirayeli batsi kuJoshua, unyana waNuni: "Nceda usinike imifelokati phakathi kwenu.
Bamnike, njengobe uSimakadze wabawisela umthetho, lomhlaba awuncela wona, iTimnathi-se-Sera, emhlabatsini waseEfraim; wawukwakha lomhlaba, wahlala kuwo.

Lolu mhlaba nguwo lomnikelo wesono lapho u-Eleazari, umLevi, noJoshua, umsa waNun, kanye nabaholi bemindeni yemakhosikazi lakwaSirayeli, banikela khona ngesipho eShilo phambi kwaSimakadze, emgwaqeni wetente lekuhlangana. Baphelelwe ekuhlukaniseni ilizwe.
Simakadze watsi kuJoshua:
Utsi kuboSirayeli, kutsi bakhethe lamadolobha ekubuyiselweni labo, labengingabe ngikhuluma nabo ngesandla saMosi.
Wonke lowo lobulala umuntu ngengozi, ngaphandle kokufuna kwakhe, angeke afike esinye semadolobha lalawo; khona-ke angeke abe nenkinga yemndeni wakhe lofuna ukubulala.

"Lomuntfu kumele afike esinye sezidolobha letinjalo, abe khona emgwaqeni womgwaqo wesive sakhe, akhulume nabaholi baleso sinhloko-dolobha kutsi yini lekwenzekile kubo; bese labaphathi besikhulu salelo situkulwane bangaba nelungelo lokungena esikhumulweni semathempelini laSimakadze.
Uma umshayeli lofuna kubuyisana nabo ephazamisa, labaholi kumele bangawudlulisa lowo muntu, ngoba babulala umshayeli wabo ngesimo sengozi kanye nalapho bebengabakhonta khona.
Angeke ahlale kulo mji, kuze afike enkundleni yesive, kuze kube sekufa umnikelo wesono lomkhulu, loyawuhlala ngalowo mnyaka; bese uyabuyela endlwini yakhe, emzini wakhe lapho abesuka khona.' "
Baye bahlukanisa iKedeshi eGalileya, emhlabatsini waNaphtali, neShekem, emhlabatsini waEfraim, neKiriyati-arba (leyo yiHebroni), emhlabatsini waYuda.
Nase-Jordane, ngasentshonalanga yeJerikho, bakhethe iBeseri emhlabatsini, esuka kumndeni waRubeni, neRamoti eGileyadi, esuka kumndeni waGadi, naGolani eBashani, esuka kumndeni waManase.

Lamadolobha lawa ahlukaniswe kuwo wonke lamakhosikazi aseSirayeli, kanye nalabo bangaphandle labahlala phakathi kwabo, kutsi lowo lobulala umuntu ngengozi afike khona, aze agwenywe ngulowo lobulalayo, ngaphambi kokuba afike enkantolo phambi kwebandla.
Bafike khona bomkhuluwa bemindeni yalabaLevi ku-Eleazari, umLevi, naJoshua, umsa waNuni, nabomkhuluwa bemindeni yalabaSirayeli.

bakhuluma nabo eSilo, ezweni leKanani, batsi: "Simakadze waletsa ngesandla saMosesi kutsi nisinike imijikelo yemadolobha sihlale kuwo, kanye nezindawo letingaphansi kwemijikelo yalemijikelo yalemihlambi yethu."
Batsi lamadvodza ase-Israyeli atawunikela ngemhlaba wabo kumaLevi, ngalemijikelo yabo, kanye nemadolobha abo.
Nalesoka lokuqala laphuma kumadvodzana a-Aron, umLevi, emndenini wa-Kehati, kwafika livi lelikhulu nemashumi lamane lamakhosikazi la-Juda, naSimeoni, naBenjamini.
Nabo-ke labaseKehati, labasele kubo, babe nemadolobha lamashumi lamabili emindenini yakwa-Efraim, nawaseDani, nasesiphelweni semndeni waManase.

Lamadvodza laGershoni abe nemadolobha lamashumi lamabili namakhulu mahlanu, asuka emindenini yase-Issakhar, naseAseri, naseNaphtali, kanye nemsindvo lesasingemagremu ayisishiyagalombili wenkhosi Manase eBashan.
Lamadvodza la-Merariya, ngemindeni yawo, abe nemadolobha lalishumi elinambili eRhubeni naGadi naZebuloni.
Lamadolobha lalawo kanye nemindeni yawo, bantfu baseSirayeli bayawuwanikela ngesandla labaLevi, njengobe Simakadze abewisela umthetho ngaMosesi.
Bebanikela ngaleso sihlanganiso se-Juda neSimeoni, ngemadolobha lawa abhalwe ngezansi.
Bafike kubo bonkhe bantfu labaseLevi, lamakhosikazi eKehati, lamadvodzana a-Aron; ngobe lokuhlukunyezwa kwakubo.
Babanikela ngeKirihati-Arba, loyise wa-Enaki, (leyinkhosi yaseHebroni), kanye nemadolobha ayo asogwini lwayo, emhlabatsini waseYuda.
Lemifula lemincane kanye nemadolobha ayo, atawuwanikela kuKalebu unyana waJefune, abe yindawo yakhe.
Lamadvodza la-Aron, umsa wa-Aroni, umLevi, atawuniketwa eHebroni, esigodlweni salowo lobulalayo, kanye neLibna.
Jatiri, neEshtemoa,
Holon, neDebiri,
neAyin, neJuta, neBethe-shemeshi; ngayinye yato nemhlaba wayo; lamadolobha lamashumi lamabili namakhulu.
Kusuka emndenini waBenjamini babebanikela ngeGibeoni, neGeba,
neAnathothi kanye nemhlaba wayo, na-Almon kanye nemhlaba wakhe; lamadolobha lamane.
Lamadolobha laSimakadze atawuwanikela kubo-Aron nemadvodzana akhe, kanye nemindeni yabo.
Labo baLevi labaseKehati, labo labahlala emindenini yalabaLevi, babe nemadolobha, ngesandla sabo, kusuka kusihlanganisi se-Ephrayim.
Waba neShekhemi, umjikelo wemuntfu lobulalayo, emhlabatsini wa-Efraim, naGezeri,
neKibzayim, neBeth-horon, ngayinye nayo inemhlaba wayo; lamadolobha lamane.
Kusuku lweDani: Elteke, neGibethoni,
neAyaloni kanye neGati-Rimoni, ngayinye nayo ibe nemhlaba wayo; lamadolobha lasitfupha.
Beba nenhloko-dolobha yayo eTaanakhi, neGati-Rimoni, kanye nemadolobha ayo: emabhishi lamakhulu lasitfupha.
Nabo bonkhe bantfu labaseKehati babe nemadolobha lamashumi lamabili namakhulu lasitfupha kanye nemhlaba wabo.
LakwaGershoni, ngemindeni yalabaLevi, kwaba nguGolan, eBashan, inhloko-dolobha yesiphepho selowo lobulalayo, kanye neBe-Eshtara; ngayinye yalezi madolobha lamashumi lamabili.
Ngaleso sihlanganisi sa-Issakhar: Kishoni, neDaberathi,
neJarmuthi kanye neEn-ganimi, ngasinye sato nesihlabatsi saso; lamadolobha lamane.
Ngaleso suku la-Aseri: Mishaleli, naAbdon,
neHelekathi kanye nemhlaba wayo, neRehobohi kanye nemhlaba wakhe; lamadolobha lamane.
NaseSizini yaNeftali: iKedesh eGalilileya, ledolobha lokugibela lombulalayo, neHamothi-Dori kanye nemhlaba wayo, naKarthani kanye nemhlaba wakhe; lamadolobha lasitfupha.
Nabo bonkhe bantfu bakaGershoni babe nemadolobha lamashumi lamabili namakhulu mathathu, kanye nemhlaba wabo.
Lakwa-Merariya, lamadodana eLevi, aphindze athole kusuka kumndeni waZabuloni: Jokneam, neKartha,
kanye neDimna, neNahalali, ngasinye sato sinemhlabatsine saso; lamadolobha lalishumi.
Kusuku lweRhubeni: Beser, neJahazi,
neKedemothi kanye nemhlaba wayo, neMefaathi kanye nemhlaba wayo; lamadolobha lamane.
Kusuka kumndeni waGadi, batfunywa Ramothi eGileyadi, dolobha lelihleli kulo lombulalayo, neMahanayim;
neHeshboni kanye nemhlaba wayo, neYazeri kanye nemhlaba wakhe: madolobha lamane.
Nabo bonkhe bantfu bemindeni yeLevi, kanye nemadvodzana aMerariya, babenemadolobha lalishumi elinambili.
Lamandla lalabaLevi, emhlabatsini lwabaSirayeli, waba madolobha lamashumi mane namakhulu lamabili nesikhombisa, kanye nezindawo taso.
Lamadolobha lawa, ngalinye lalaba nendzawo lekahle yekudla emhlabatsini lwawo; kube njalo kubo bonke.
Ngako-ke uSimakadze wabanikela kuSirayeli yonke lemhlaba, lapho abeshiwo kutsi uyabanikela khona kubabusi babo; bayawuyisa, bahlala kuwo.

Simakadze wabanikela ngenhlanhla ngaso sonke isikhathi, njengobe akazange aphikisane nababuphikisi babo. Angeke kube khona linye lalabo labaphazamisayo labo elalihlala libhekene nabo; Nkulunkulu wabanikela bonke abaphazamisi babo esandla sabo.
Akukho linye lamazwi aSimakadze, lawo ayekhuluma kuboSirayeli, echiphekile; onkhe emazwi awo afike.
UJoshua watsi kubo: "Lase-Rubeni, nase-Gadi, kanye nengxenye yemndeni wakwaManase.
wabaphendvula watsi: "Nikwenze konke loMosese, umkhonzi waSimakadze, akwenta kuwe; nimitfwala imvumi yami kuwo wonke lamazwi ami.
Lakho kuphele iminyaka leminingi, ngobe ningawashiya lamadodana enu eSirayeli kuze kube ngalolusuku; nigcineni lokushiwo nguSimakadze longuSomandla wenu, Nkulunkulu wenu, kutsi nikwenze.

Ngako-ke Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, utawunikela ngenhlanhla bazalwane benu, njengobe waphendvula watsi: "Niye nibuyeni ezweni lenu, eliyinikele nguMosese, umkhonzi kaSimakadze, ngaleso sifundazweni saseJordani, lapho liphuma khona ilanga.

Kusekho nje kutsi ugcine kakhulu lomthetho kanye nemtsetfo loMosese abekuwisela wona, ukuthi uphile Simakadze Nkulunkulu wakho, uhambe ngendlela yakhe, ugcine imiyalo yakhe, uyene naye, ube ngumkhonzi wakhe ngentliziyo yakho yonke nemoya yakho yonke.
UJoshua wabambisana nabo, wabaletsa, batsi: "Thumelani!" Baye babuyela endlwini yabo.
Nakho-ke Mosesi wabanikela ngemhlaba eBashan, kodvwa Joshua wabanikela ngemhlaba emabutfo abo ngaleso sinye semfula iJordane, ngasekunxwemeni kwelwandle. Nalapho Joshua abewaletsa khona, wababambisa,

watsi: "Buyela ekhaya lakho ngemandla akho amakhulu, nemfuyo yakho leminingi, nesiliva, negolide, nensimbi, nentsimbi, nemigqomo emikhulu; uhlukanise nalabo bazalwane bakho lokudla lokudlwengulwa kulabo labehlukumezayo.
Baye babuyela eGileyadi, emhlabatsini lwabo, lapho babehlala khona, besuka eSilo, emhlabatsini waseKanana, besuka kubo bonkhe bantfu baka-Israyeli, njengobe Simakadze abewisela umthetho ngaMosesi.
Bafika eGili-lothi, eJordane, lekhona emhlabatsini waseKanana, basungula khona ithempeli eduze kwelwandle, likhulu kakhulu.

Lamadvodza ase-Israyeli akhuluma, watsi: "Bonani, lamadodana eRubeni neGadi nalesiphenyane semndeni waManase abuye abe ne altare emgwaqeni wemhlaba waseKanana, eJordane, ngakwesokudla kwebantfu be-Israyeli."
Batsi bakubona, bonkhe bantfu beSirayeli bahlangana eShilo, batsi: "Siya kuhlasela nabo."
Batsi bathumela Phinehasi, umsa wa-Eleazari, umLevi, kubo-Rubheni, nabo-Gadi, naphesheya kwezilwandle, ezweni leGileyadi.
Bayawumisa naye bomkhuluwa labalishumi, lomunye kubo bonkhe bantfu beSirayeli; bonke babenetinhloko temindeni yabo.
Bafike bahlangana nemadvodzana aRubhene, nemadvodzakati eGadi, nendvodzakati yaManase eGileyadi, bakhuluma nabo batsi:
Libandla lonke leSimakadze likhuluma, litsi: Ngabe nguNkulunkulu weSirayeli niyawuphazamisa, ningase niyibeke phansi namuhla, nize nibuyeni kuSimakadze, nibuyeni ethempelini lakhe?
Akusho yini kutsi kuncane kuyena lokungekuhle kwePeori, lapho singesabi ngaso kuze kufike ngalolusuku, nakuba lobhubho lwafika kubo bonkhe bantfu bakaSimakadze?
Namuhla-ke niyawubuyela emuva kutsi ningasekho kuSimakadze, ngobe uma namuhla niyiphula isandla saNkulunkulu, ngekusasa utawugwema lonke ibandla laSirayeli.

Uma ilizwe lenu lingcolile, vuka nifike ezweni laSimakadze, lapho tindlu taNkulunkulu zihlala khona, niyihlukanise netfu; kodwa ningabi nakuphikisa kuSimakadze, noma nani, ngekwakha isibingelelo esisha ngaphandle kwesibingelelo saNkulunkulu wethu.
Kutsi na-Akani, umsa waZera; ngobe waba necala ekudlaleni kulelo livi, kwafika indlala phezu kwalo lonke ibandla laSirayeli; naye akazange abe nguwo kuphela lofa ngenxa yesive sakhe.
Lakwa-Rubeni, neGadi, naphesheya kwemphi yaManase, baphendula labaholi bemindeni yaseSirayeli, batsi:

USimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, yena uwazi, naSirayeli nabo bakwazi; uma sesikubekezelelani, noma sekusikhohlisa kukaNkulunkulu, sikwenze lokhu, ungasigwebi namuhla.
Uma sibuye sakha le altare kutsi siyeke kulandzela uSimakadze, noma ukuba senze khona mnikelo wekushiswa, neminikelo yesondlo kanye naleyo yenhlanhla; Simakadze atawutsi.
Sibe nenkinga, sacabanga kutsi bangatsi baphikisani nabo, bethi: Nini naSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, nine yini nalowo?

Simakadze umisele umkhawulo phakathi kwethu nenu, nimadvodzana aRubhen namadvodzakati eGadi, ngeJordane; ningaba nemsindvo lesasingemagremu lamakhulu lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa. Ningeke nibe nengxenye yini kuSimakadze?"
Ngako-ke satsi, Sibuye sibuyele ethempelini lelihle, hhayi ngemnikelo wekushiswa noma ngemnikelo wesono,

Kuye kube ngubufakazi phakathi kwethu nenu, kanye naleso sizukulwane ngasinye ngemuva kweso, kutsi siyawukhonza uSimakadze phambi kwakhe ngeminikelo yethu yokushiswa, nemfuyo lethu, nenhlanhla yesive sethu; ukuze bantfu benu bangatsi kulabo bami: Ningenayo inhlanganiso kuNkulunkulu.

Natsi sathi, Uma bekhuluma nathi noma kumadvodzana ethu njalo kusasa, sitawuti kutsi: "Njenani lomfanekiso wethempelini leSimakadze, labababa bethu layawuyenza; angeke ibe ngumnikelo wekushiswa, noma yisondlo, kodwa kumele ibe ngumshayeli phakathi kwethu nenu.

Kungeke kube lula kuwe kutsi sigweme uSimakadze, siye kumshiya ngalolusuku, sibuye senze ithempeli lelinye lomnikelo wekushiswa, nemnikelo wesono, nesondlo, ngaphandle kwethempeli laSimakadze Nkulunkulu wethu, elibekwe phambi kwendlu yakhe.
Phinehasi, umLevi, kanye nebaholi bebandla, baholi bamakhosi emadvodzana a-Isirayeli, bakhuluma lamazwi laLarubani naGadi naManase, bayawu ratona.

Phinehasi, umsa wa-Eleazarhi, umLevi, wabaphendvula watsi: "Namuhla sibone ukuthi uSimakadze unesibopho nathi, ngobe ningabi nenkinga naNkulunkulu ngalolu daba; namuhla niyawuvikela bantfu baseSirayeli ekufeni kwenkhosi."
Phinehasi, umsa wa-Eleazari, umLevi, kanye nebaholi babuyela kubo bonkhe bantfu baseRhubheni nabaseGadi eGileyadi, bafike kumadvodza aseSirayeli ahlala emhlabatsini waseKanana, batsi:
Lamadvodza ase-Israyeli ajabulile lapho akubona khona, wabonga uNkulunkulu, akazange aphinde akhulume ngekubuyela kubo emkhosini, kutsi abophe ilizwe labahlala kulo laRubeni naGadi.
Lamadvodza la-Rubeni neGadi aphindze abizwa ngegama le altare, "Ubufakazi," watsi: "Iwubufakazi phakathi kwethu kutsi uSimakadze nguNkulunkulu."
Kutsi sekudlule iminyaka leminingi, Simakadze wanikela ngesivi kuSirayeli kusuka kubo bonkhe lababubi babo lababhekene nabo ngaso sonke simo.
Wakhuluma kubo, watsi: "Namuhla ngikhulu kakhulu kunaleso sikhatsi sengibeneso; ngobe Simakadze Nkulunkulu wenu ungisungulile.
Nikubona konke lokuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, akwenta kubo bonkhe bantfu labani; ngobe Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, uyawukulwa nabo.
Bona, ngikuleta kuwe lelizwe laleyo mataifa asele, kanye nalawo masiko labengisawabulala, kutsi libe ngumnikelo wesono ngemindeni yenu, kusuka eJordane kuya emfuleni omkhulu, ngasekupheleni kwelanga.
Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, utawuzikhipha emehlweni enu, utawuzibulala; niyawuhlala ezweni labo, njengobe Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, akusho kuwe.
Kutsi-ke, ube nekuthula kakhulu, ugcine ukwenze konke lokubhalwe encwadini yemtsetfo waMosesi; ungase usihambe ngaso ngesandla sasekudla noma ngesandla sasekhohlo.
Ungeke uhlangane nebantfu labashiywe phakathi kwenu, ungakhulumanga ngegama lamasiko abo, ungeke ube nevoti ngawo, ungeke ubambisene nabo, ungeke ubabuke.
ngobe Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, niyawuwulandzela, njengobe nakwenta kuze kube manje.
ngobe Simakadze wakhipha emabutfo amakhulu namandla phambi kwenu; angeke kube khona lowo angahlala ebusweni benu kuze kungakapheli losuku.
Lomunye wenu uyawuhlasela lamakhulu, ngobe Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, yena lokulwa nabo, njengobe watsi.
Hlala ugcine, uphile Simakadze Nkulunkulu wakho.
Ngako-ke, uma nibuyela emuva, nihlangane nebantfu balelo lizwe elalisele phakathi kwenu, nibe nemindeni yabo, nihamba nabo,

khumbulani kahle kutsi uSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, angeke aphinde aphumele ebusweni bakho lamazwe lawa; bayawuba ngumbukiso kuwe, netinsika kuwe, nemphiko enhliziyweni yakho, namathumbu emilonyeni yakho, kuze niphele kulelizwe lelihle loNkulunkulu, Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, awakulethela.

Namuhla ngiyahamba ngendlela yalabo bonke labaphila emhlabeni. Uyazi ngentliziyo yakho yonke nemoya wakho wonke, kutsi akukho linye lamazwi aSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, akushoyo kuwe, elihle, elaliphazanyiswa; lifike lonke, akukho linye lelifazwa.

Ngako-ke Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, utawukuleta kuwe naleyo ncwadzi legocotwako yekuthula, lapho wakhuluma ngayo ngenu; kanjalo-ke uSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, utawukuleta kuwe naleyo ndvodza lebi, lapho akhuluma ngayo ngenu, kuze akukhulule lapha ezweni lelihle lakhe lalikunike lona.

Uma nidlula emthethweni waSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, lowo awisenzile kutsi niwugcine, niye nihambe nisebenzele bonkulunkulu babanye, nibabulawe kubo; khona-ke ubuhlungu benkhosi buyawudlidliza phezu kwenu, nizophela ngokushesha ezweni lelihle lakhe lalikunike.
UJoshua wahlanganisa tonkhe tive taSirayeli eShekem, wababiza bomkhuluwa baSirayeli, nebaholi babo, nalabavikeli babo, nalabaphathi babo. Bafike behlala phambi kwaSimakadze.

Joshuwa wakhuluma kubo bonkhe bantfu, watsi: "Simakadze Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli usho kutsi: 'Labo babi bakho babehlala ngaphesheya komfula ezikhathini zakudala; naTera, umsa kaAbrahama nenkhosi yaNahori, nabo bakhonza bokhokho babo.
"Nami ngakhipha lobaba wenu Abrahami ecaleni lelinye leMfula i-Euphrates, nami ngahamba naye kuwo wonke lamadolobha lakwaKanana, nami ngiyawutfumisa umzabalazo wakhe, nami ngangimnika uIsake.
Ase-Isake ngayawunikela ngeYakobi neEsau; na-Esau ngayawunikela ngentaba teSeyiri, kutsi ibe yitfu lakhe; kodvwa Jakobo nemndeni wakhe baphuma beya eMijiphu.
Kwatsi ngathumela Musa na-Aron, ngabulala iMijiphu ngetibondza labengingabikho kuwo; emva kwalokho ngiyawutfusa.
Nalapho ngibakhipha khona lababa wenu ema-Egypt, nifike elwandle; kodvwa laba-Egypti bayawuphazamisa nabo ngemikhumbi nelabahamba ngenqanawa kuya eMfuleni Lomnyama.

Baye bathandaza kuSimakadze, yena wabeka umthunzi phakathi kwenu neMijiphu, wabeka lwandle phezu kwabo, lwabafihla. Lamehlo enu akubona lokudla kwami eMijiphu; nihlala esigabeni setfu iminyaka leminingi.
Nami ngakulethela ezweni lama-Amori, abehlala kwelinye icala leJordane; bahlasela nine, ngobe ngibanikela emilenzeni yenu, nami ngawabulala phambi kwenu, natsi niyithathe ilizwe labo.
Balaki, umsa waSiporhi, ukumkani weMoabi, wehla ekulwa neSirayeli, watsi: "Thintela Balaamu, umsa waBeori, kutsi akulaleliseni.
kodvwa ngatsi ngingeke ngiwuvumeli uBhilihamu, watsi: "Uyawubambisana nami; ngobe ngiyakukhulula esandlani saBalaka."
Nifike nidlula eJordane, nafika eJerikho. Labahlali baseJerikho, ne-Amori, ne-Perizi, ne-Kananani, ne-Heti, ne-Girgasi, ne-Hivi, ne-Jebushi, baphikisana nabo; kodvwa ngiwanikela emandleni enu.
Nami ngathumela imphini phambi kwenu, yabakhipha, namakhosi lamakhulu mahlanu e-Amori; awuzange uhambe ngekhefu lakho, noma ngegobo lakho.
Nami ngabanikela ngemhlaba longeke niwusebenzele, nemadolobha langingawakhanga, nalapho nihlala khona; nidla emavini kanye nama-olive asingawotsi.
Manje-ke, lombani uSimakadze, nimukhonze ngentliziyo yenu yonke neqiniso; khiphani bokhokho benu lababakhonzayo ngaphesheya komfula kanye naseMisri, nisebenzele Simakadze.

švini, uma kubuhlungu emehlo enu ukuba nisebenzele uSimakadze, khetheni namhlanje lowo niyawukhonza, ngabe nguwo bokhokho benu labasenyakatho yeMfula i-Euphrates, noma nguwe-Amori, lomhlaba lapho nihlala khona; kepha mina nendlu yami yomndeni sitawukhonza Simakadze.
Baphendvula batsi: "Kungeke kube lula kutsi siyawushiya uSimakadze, sifike sikhonze ema-gods lamanye.

Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wethu, uyawutfumisa nathi kanye nababa bethu ezweni leMijiphu, endlwini yebugebengu, wakwenza lamandla amakhulu enhliziyweni yethu, wagcina siphila kulo lonke uhambo lwethu, nalapho sahamba khona phakathi kwebantfu.
ngobe uSimakadze wakhipha ema-Amori, labahlala kulolu mhlaba, phambi kwethu; natsi nethu sitawukhonza Simakadze, ngobe yena nguNkulunkulu wethu.
UYoshuwa watsi kubo: "Ningeke nikwazi kukhonza uSimakadze, ngobe yena uNkulunkulu longcwele, uThixo lomkhulu; ngeke asuse ukungcola kwenu nebubi benu.
Uma niyawushiya uSimakadze, bese nikhonza ema-gods langaphandle, yena utawubuyela kuwe, nawe utawukwenza kube buhlungu, nawe uyakufishana, nakuba akazange akwenze kahle kuwe.
Batsi bantfu kuYoshuwa: "Kungeke kube njalo; siyawukhonza Simakadze."
UJoshua watsi kubo: "Niye niyibufakazi labani, kutsi ningawukhetheli Simakadze kutsi nisebenzele yena." Baphendvula batsi: "Siyibufakazi.
Ngako-ke, khiphani bonkulunkulu bengaphandle labakhona phakathi kwenu, nibeke intliziyo yenu kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli.
Labantfu batsi kuJoshua: "Sitawukhonza Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wethu, siyawulalela."
UJoshua wabambisana nebantfu ngalolusuku, wabeka kubo umyalo kanye nemtsetfo eShekem.
UJoshua wababhalela la mazwi encwadini yemtsetfo waSimakadze, watsi: "Thina-ke sithathe itafula elikhulu, salisa phansi ngaphansi kwetafule lelikhulu laseGibhithe, lapho kungcwele khona Simakadze.

watsi kubo bonke bantfu: "Bonani, lelitji liyawuba ngubufakazi labani; ngobe leli litji lalalela yonke imiyalo yaSimakadze lokhuluma nathi; nalo litawuba ngubufakazi bani, uma ningenakuhlonipha Nkulunkulu wenu."
Joshuwa watsi kubo: "Niya, nibuye emhlabatsini lenu."
Ngemuva kwalolu daba, uJoshua, umsa wa-Nun, umkhonzi kaSimakadze, wafa, eneminyaka engumakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamane.
Wafunwa nguSimakadze, watsi: "Thina-ke sifike eTimnathi-Sera, emhlabatsini waEfremu, ngasenyakatho yenduli yaGaash.
LaSirayeli bakhonza uSimakadze zonke iintsuku zokuphila kukaJoshua, kanye nezinsuku zokuphila kwabakhulu labaphila ngemuva kwakhe, labo babebona konke lokuyenzile Simakadze kuboSirayeli.

švini taJosefe, labelabaSirayeli babezikhipha eYiputa, bazifaka eShechem, kuleyo ndawo yemhlaba lapho uYakobi abeyithengela khona labantwana bakaHamori, loyise waShechem, ngesiliva lamawaka; lendawo yafika ibe yindlu kaJosefa.
Wafa na-Eleazari, unyana wa-Aron, wabanjwa eGibeha, emfuleni lowawuniketwe Phinehasi, unyana wakhe, emhlabatsini waseEfraim.
Judg: Ase kuphelile sikhatsi seJoshua, bantfu beSirayeli babuza uSimakadze batsi: "Ngubani na loya phambili kutsi ahlasele lamakhosi e-Kanana?"
Simakadze watsi: "Juda kumele afike; bona, senginikela lelizwe emlenzeni wabo."

Lamadvodza laJuda akhuluma lamakhosikazi eSimeoni, labazalwane babo, watsi: "Thinda nathi kuleyo mhlaba lotiwayo, sife nalabaKanani, bese sihamba nawe kuleyo mhlaba wakho." Lamadodana aSimeoni afike nabo.
Yuda waphuma, watsi: "Simakadze utawubanikela ngesandla sawo ema-Kananani nalama-Perizi; babulala eBezeki amadoda lamakhulu lamabili.
Bahlangana khona na-Adoni-Bezeki, bakulwa naye, babulala bo-Kananani ne-Perizi.
Adoni-bezekhe wabaleka, ngobe beyawumlandela, baphindze bamphikisa, bacubhuta imilenze yakhe kanye nemilenze yesandla sakhe.

Wathi uAdoni-Bezeka: "Kunenkhosi letimashumi lamakhulu lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu, ticutshwe imilenze yazo kanye nemilenze yesandla sazo, latingcolisa emacwecwe ngaphansi kwetafula lami; Simakadze ungibuyisele emuva lomsebenzi labengingawubenzile kubo." Bayawufaka eYerusalem, wafa khona.
Lamadvodza laJuda ahlasele iJerusalema, wayawuyihlasela, wababulala ngesandla sekhephu, wabeka ledolobha emlilo.
Bafike bahlasela ema-Amori, labahlala eGibhithe, kanye nalababahlala eGibhithe laseNtshonalanga, nelabahlala eGibhithe laseMfula iJordani.
Bahlasela nalaba-Kananani labahlala eHebroni (kwaba igama leHebroni bekunguKirihati-Arba); babulala Sheshai, neAhimani, neTalmai.
Basuka khona bahlasela labahlala eDebiri (kwaba ligama lakhe ngaleso sikhathi iKiriyati-seferi).
Kalebe watsi: "Lomuntfu lobulala iKiriyati-seferi, nome uyawuyihlasela, ngitawumunika intombi yami, Aksha, kutsi abe ngumkakhe."
Wayihlasela Otniyeli, umsa waKenazi, lomkhuluwa ka-Kalebi; yena Kalebe wamnika Aksa, intombi yakhe, abe ngumfazi wakhe.
Yafika ku-Othniyeli, yatsi kuye: "Sicela utata wakho mhlaba!" Yaphuma isuka ejele, Kalebe watsi kuyo: "Ufuna yini?"

Wayiphendvula yatsi: "Nceda ungisinike sipho sakho; ngobe usanginikela ngemhlaba waseNtshonalanga, uyawuminika namanzi lasogwini." Kalebu watsi kuye: "Ninikeze amanzi esogwini lasephakeme kanye nesogwini lasephansi."

Nabo bonkhe bantfu base-Israyeli, kanye nemadvodzana aMosesi, labaKeni, baphuma edolobhani lelinetimbali, besuka nabomadvodzakati aYuda, befika eGibhithe lasentshonalanga ye-Arad, befika emhlabatsini waseJuda, behlala khona phakathi kwalabo bantu.
Wahamba uYuda nabazalwane bakhe, labasuka eSimeoni, bahlasela bo-Kananani labahlala eSefati, babulala bonke labahlala khona; ngobe lomhlaba wabizwa ngokuthi ngu-Horma.
Yuda wahlasela neGaza, na-Askeloni, na-Ekroni, ngaso sonke sikhatsi, kanye nemhlaba wayo jikelele.
USimakadze waba neYuda, wabeka phansi imifula, kodvwa akazange akhuphule lamakhosi aseGibhithe, ngobe abenamabhokisi emlilo ensimbi.
Baye banikela eHebroni kuKalebe, njengobe Mosi abesho; wakhipha khona lamadvodzana a-Enaki lasitfupha.
LaJebusi, lahlala eJerusalema, bantfu bakaBhenjamini bangawakhiphanga; kodvwa labaJebusi bahlala nabobantfu bakaBhenjamini eJerusalema kuze kufike losuku.
Lamadvodza laJosefa afike eBheteli, Simakadze abe nabo.
Bathumela kutsi bahlolisise iBheteli, lelinye lamagama ayo bekunguLuza.
Batsi babone umfana ephuma emigwaqeni, batsi kuye: "Sibonise indlela yekungena emgwaqeni, bese sikwenza wena ube nekuthula."
Wabakhombisa, batsi: "Labo bantu basemzini wabo babulawa ngesandla, kepha lomuntu kanye nemndeni wakhe wonke bayawushiya.
Wafika ezweni lalabaHeti, wabambisa umjikelo, wabiza igama lakhe ngokuthi Luzi; leli ligama lakhe kuze kuleso sikhatsi.
Bantfu bakaManase baphindze bakhipha labahlala eBeth-Shani, naseTaanakhi, naseDori, naseJibleamu, naseMegido nemadolobha ayo; kodvwa bo-Kananani bahlala kulomhlaba lowo.
Kwatsi lapho isiSirayeli sikhululiwe, babeka bo-Kananani kutsi babe ngumnikelo wesono; kodvwa bebengabakhuphula lilanga.
Na-Efrayim akazange akhuphule bantfu baseKanana labahlala eGezeri; kodvwa bantfu baseKanana bahlala phakathi kwabo.
NaZebuloni akazange akhuphule bantfu labahlala eKitroni, nalabahlala eNahaloli; kodvwa lamakhosi aseKanana abehlala phakathi kwabo, wabeka nabo emkhondweni.
Na-Asere akazange akhuphule labahlala e-Akko, nase-Sidon, nase-Ahlab, nase-Akzib, nase-Helba, nase-Afek, nase-Rehoboth.
Ngako-ke labase-Aseri bahlala phakathi kwalabaKanani baselezweni leli, ngobe abengabakhiphanga.

Nabhati-naphtali akazange akhuphule labahlala eBeth-shemeshi, noma eBeth-anathi; wahlala phakathi kwalabahlali baseKanani bepaphetse lelilizwe; kodvwa labahlala eBeth-shemeshi naBeth-anathi bafike babe ngumnikelo wesono.
Nase-Amori wakhipha bantfu baDani emhlabatsini, watsi: "Laba-Amori bangawavumelenga labase-Arabha kutsi bafike.
Nase-Amori wahlala eMfula iHeres, nase-Ajaloni, nase-Shaalbimu; kodvwa bantfu bemndeni ka-Yusufu baphindze basebentisa ema-Amori kutsi abe ngumsebenzi wabo.
Umfula we-Amori wawusuka ePase-Skorpion, waya eSela, wadlula khona.

USimakadze watsi kuMosi: "Ufike ufike eGileyadi, ufike eBokim, watsi: 'Nginikhuphule kusuka eMisri, futhi nginingenise kulelizwe labengingabe sengikhuluma ngaso ngesandla kubabusi benu; ngobe ngitsi: Angeke ngiphule umnqophiso wami nani kuze kube sekupheleni.
Ningeke nibe nesivumelwano nalabo baselezweni leli, kodvwa niyawuphula ema-altari abo; ngobe ningamivumeli kutsi ngikukhulume. Yini lokudla loku?
Ngako-ke ngitsi: Angeke ngibakhuphe phambi kwenu; bayawube tingulube ebusweni benu, naNkulunkulu wabo utawuba ntfo yenu."
Batsi, lapho angelu laSimakadze ekhuluma ngalowo mazwi kubo bonkhe bantfu beSirayeli, laba bantu bahlaba umxhwele.
Batsi: "Bokim" ligama lelikhona, banikela khona ngeminikelo yekushiswa kuSimakadze.
Joshuwa waletsa labantfu, baphuma bonkhe bantfu beSirayeli, bobabili labancane nalabakhulu, kutsi bathathe itfu lelikhetwe kubo.
Labantfu bakhonza uSimakadze zonke iintsuku zokuphila kukaJoshua, nezinsuku zokuphila kwabakhulu labaphila ngemuva kwakhe, labo babebona yonke lento enkulu kaYehova abeyenze kuboSirayeli.
UJoshua, umsa wa-Nun, umkhonzi kaSimakadze, wafa eneminyaka engumakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamane.
Wafunwa nguSimakadze, watsi: "Thina-ke sifike eTimnathi-heresi, emgwaqeni waEfraim, ngasenyakatho yemhlabatsi weGaash.
Nalapho lomnyaka waleso sizukulwane sewuphela khona, kwavuka lomnyaka welinye sizukulwane, asizange sibone uSimakadze, noma yini leyawuyenza kuSirayeli.
Lamadvodza ase-Israyeli ayawukwenza lokudla lokubi emehloni kaSimakadze, wanikela kuBaali.
Bayawushiya uSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, lowo wabakhipha ezweni la-Ejipta, balandela ema-Israyeli, bathandaza kuma-Amoni kanye nalabo baseGibhithe, nabo bonkhe bantfu labaseMfuleni iJordane.
Bayawushiya uSimakadze, bakhonza uBaali neAstoreti.

Ngako-ke, ngenxa yendlala yakhe kuSirayeli, uSimakadze wabanikela esihlalweni salabo labaphazamisayo, babebaphuca; wabathengisa kubo bonkhe lababuphikisi babo basekuhlaleni, bangeke bakwazi ukumelana nabo.
Kuphela lapho laSirayeli bephuma khona bahlasela, isandla saSimakadze sabe sikhona kubo, sababulala, njengobe abekhuluma nabo, njengobe akazange abonise; babe nenkinga enkulu.
USimakadze wehlisa labaholi, labahluleli, lababavikela kulabo lababulalayo.

Baye bahamba ngendlela yabo, behlala emigwaqweni yabo; bangabi nenhlonipho kuSimakadze. 11Lakho-ke abengaba hluli emajaji abo; babengakholwa kuNkulunkulu wabanye, bebakhonza imikhosi yemihlaba yamanye amazwe, bababopha kubo. Basuka ngokushesha ekuhambeni kwendlela labababa babo bebeyihamba ngayo, indlela yokulalela imiyalelo kaYehova.

Nalapho uSimakadze abewukhipha khona ummeli kubo, wabe nguNkulunkulu lowo mmeli, wabasindisa emgodini wabo nsuku zonke zokuphila kommeli wakhe; ngobe uSimakadze wayebakhathaza, lapho bephuca khona ngaphansi kwalabo lababacindezela kanye nalabo lababaphazamisa.

Kube, lapho ummeli efa khona, babuyela emuva, behamba ngendlela lebi kakhulu kunabo-baba babo, belandela emagodvo labanye, bepaphekela abo, nekubopha labo; bengeke bayeke imikhuba yabo emibi, nendlela yabo yetfu.
Ngako-ke uSimakadze wehluleke kakhulu ngeSirayeli, watsi: "Lenhlanga leli liphule isivumelwano sami, lapho ngibembise khona lababa babo, bangami hluli.
Nami-ke ngeke ngiphinde ngiphumele ngaso sinye sema-Israyeli, lawaseSirayeli, ayawushiya lapho uJoshua efa khona.
ngobe ngabo ngitawutihlola labaSirayeli, kutsi bangagcina yini indlela yaSimakadze, behamba ngayo, njengobe babehamba nabobaba babo.
Ngako-ke Simakadze washiya lamazwe lawa; akazange abonise kubo, walabanikela ngesandla saJoshuwa.
Lolu hlanga uSimakadze lwalishiya kulelizwe, kutsi abuye abone labaSirayeli, labo abazange bahambe nabo emkhosini waseKanana.
Wakwenza lokhu kuphela kutsi afundise ukulwa emashumini lamasha labantfu base-Isirayeli, labazange bahlaselwe emkhosini ngaphambili.
Laba bami base-Amori, neSidoni, nalaba Hivi, labahlala entabeni yaseLibanoni, kusukela emfuleni waBaale-Hermon, kuze kufike eHamati.
Wabashiya nabo, kutsi atawuwahlola lamadvodza aseSirayeli, aze abone ukuthi bangawuphula yini umyalo waSimakadze, lowawuye wabawisela uMosesi.
Bahlala emaKanana, nama-Hethi, nama-Amori, nama-Perizi, nama-Hivi, nama-Jebusi.
Bazala izingane tabo, banikela ngezingane zabo kubo bonkhe bantfu, bakhonza bonkulunkulu babo.
Lamadvodza ase-Israyeli akazange akwenze lokubi emehloni kaSimakadze, watsi: "Siyilibala iNkosi, Nkulunkulu wabo; bakhonza labaBaali nalaba-Ashera."
USimakadze wehluleke ngeSirayeli, wabanikela ku-Kushan-rishathaim, ukumkani wase Arame yaseNaharayim, eMesopotamiya; bantfu beSirayeli bayawukhonza iminyaka lemine.
Baye bathandaza kuSimakadze, watsi: "UNkulunkulu utawubasindisa, uOthniyeli, umsa kaKenazi, lomkhuluwa kaKalebi."
Wafika kuye umoya waSimakadze, waba ngummeli waseSirayeli, waphuma waya emkhosini; ngobe Simakadze abemnikela esandlani sakhe Kushan-rishathayi, ukumkani waseAram, watsi: "Othniel uyawubulala."
Lelizwe lahlala likhululeke iminyaka lengema-40, kuze kufe Othniyeli umsa waKenazi.
Lamadvodza ase-Israyeli abuyela ekwenzeni lokubi emlonyeni waSimakadze; ngobe abewenza lokubi, Simakadze wabanika amandla Egloni, ukumkani weMoabi, ngase-Israyeli.
Egloni wahlanganisa nabo bonkhe bantfu base-Ammon nabase-Amaleki, wafika wahlasela iSirayeli, waba nenhloko yedolobha lelinetimbali.
Lamadvodza ase-Israyeli ahlala eGeloni, ukumkani weMoabi, iminyaka lelishumi nesihlanu.

Baye bathandaza kuSimakadze, watsi kubo umsindisi, Ehudi, umsa kaGera, waseBenjamini, longeke asebenzise isandla sakhe sokudla; ngobe bantfu beSirayeli babemuthumela kutsi abe nesibopho ku-Egloni, ukumkani weMoabi.
Ehud wayalela isandla lesimbili, samamitha lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu, wamisa embhedeni wakhe wesobunxele ngaphansi kwemigqomo yakhe.
Wanikela ngemnikelo ku-Egloni, ukumkani waMoabi, lobe ngumuntfu lomkhulu kakhulu.
Ehud wakhipha leminikelo yakhe, wabasusa lamadoda abagculile imnikelo wakhe.
wabuyela eGalgali, lapho kwabekhona ema-Aserethi, watsi: "Nginekukhuluma nawe ngesifihla-buso, nkosi yami." Unkhosi yatsi: "Thintela!" Baphuma bonke labakhonzi bakhe.
Ehud waphuma waya kuye, watsi: "Nginekukhuluma nawe ngamazwi kaNkulunkulu," ngobe wayehlala emnyango wendlu yakhe. Lonkhosi yavuka yesuka esibhedlela sayo, ifike kwa-Ehudi, yatsi:
Ehud wehlisa isandla sakhe sasekhohlo, wakhipha isikhephe emphinjeni yakhe yesobunxele, wamisa emlonyeni wakhe.
Nase-Ehud akazange asuse isandla sakhe, kodvwa saphuma emuva kwakhe; ngobe isandla sakhe safika ngasemlenzeni wakhe, nemilenze yakhe nayo yafika.
Ehud waphuma waya emgwaqeni, wavala iminyango yendlu yakhe yasephansi ngemuva kwakhe, wavala ngetintambo.
Afike lapho, bafika labangani bakhe, bathola iminyango yendlu yasentshonalanga ihlanganisiwe, batsi: "Kungeke ahlale embhedeni wakhe, ephumula."
Bahlala khona kuze baphazamiseka, kodvwa yena akazange avule iminyango. Bafike bakhipha umcibisholo, bavula iminyango, babona kutsi unkhosi yabo ilele emhlabatsini ifile.
Bekungakaze bafike, Ehud waphuma, wadlula ema-Asera, wafika eSeira.
Wafika, waphuca ibhutsi emhlabatsini waseEfraim; baphuma nabo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli emhlabatsini, na-Ehud abe nguMengameli wabo.

Wabaphendvula watsi: "Thumelani ngemuva kwami, ngobe Simakadze utawunikela emandleni enu umfowabo uMowabi." Baphuma behamba emuva kwakhe, babamba imifula leJordane esuka eMoabi, bangavumeleki namunye umuntu ukuba ahambe.
Babulala leso sikhatsi ema-Moabi amashumi lamakhulu lalishumi, bonke laba ngumadoda amakhulu nalaba ngemandla; akazange ahambe namunye.
Ngaleso sikhathi Moabu wabekwa ngaphansi kwaSirayeli; lelizwe lahlala likhululeke iminyaka emashumi lamakhulu lasitfupha.
Emva kwa-Ehudi kwaba nguShamgari, umsa waAnathi, lowo wababulala bantfu baseFilisti bamakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamane ngesandla sengulube; naye wavikela Israele.
Lamadvodza aseSirayeli abuyela ekwenzeni lokubi emehloni kaSimakadze, ngemuva kwekufa kwe-Ehud.
Simakadze wabanikela esandla seJabini, ukumkani waseKanana, lohlala eHazori; umkhosi wakhe ube nguSisera, owayehlala eHaroshethi-ha-Goyim.
USisera ubenama-carriages ensimbi amakhulu lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa, waphazamisa bantfu bakaSirayeli ngebuhlungu iminyaka lelishumi nambili. Baye bathandaza kuSimakadze.
Kuleso sikhathi, uDebora, umprofeti, indodana kaLapidothi, waba ngummeli waSirayeli.
Wahlala ngaphansi kwesihlahla seDebora, phakathi kweRama neBheteli, emhlabatsini wa-Efraim; ngobe bantfu baseSirayeli befika kuye kutsi bakhulume naye.

Wathumela waya kuBaraka, unyana wa-Abinoamu, waseKedeshi eNaphtali, watsi kuye: "Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, uthi: 'Thiba lamashumi lamakhulu lamadoda lasuka eNaphtali naZebuloni, uyawuwafaka emfuleni iTabori.
ngobe ngitakwelula kuMfula iKishon uSisera, umphathi wemphi kaJabini, kanye nemilenze yakhe nebantfu bakhe, ngitawuwunikela esandla sakho.'"
Baraki watsi kuye: "Uma uhamba nami, ngitahamba; kepha uma ungeke uhambe nami, ngeke ngite.
UDebora watsi kuye: "Kulungile, ngizohamba nawe, kepha ungeke ube nekuthula kulolu hambo; ngobe uSimakadze utawunikela uSisera kumkhwenyana." UDebora waya naye Baraki eKedesh.
Baraki wahlangana neZabuloni naNeftali eKedeshi; lamadoda lamakhulu lamabili ahamba ngemuva kwakhe, naDebora waya naye.
Héberi, umKenisi, washiya lamadodana la-Hobab, lomkhuluwa kaMosese, asuka eKenisi, wamisa itente lakhe ku-Eden eZaananim, enkabeni yeKedeshi.
Bakhuluma kuSisera batsi: "Baraka, umsa wa-Abinoamu, ufike emfuleni iTabori."
USisera watsi: "Lawo makhulu lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu emacarriles akhe ensimbi, kanye nalabo bonkhe bantfu bakhe, kumele bahlangane kusuka eHaroshethe-Haggoyim kuya emfuleni iKishon."

UDebora watsi kuBaraka: "Hamba, ngobe namuhla nguwo usuku lapho Simakadze atawunikela khona uSisera ngesandla sakho; Nkulunkulu uyahamba phambi kwakho." Waphuma ke Baraki waya emfuleni iTabhori, namadoda lamakhulu lamabili alandelana naye.
Bafike bafika eBaraki, ngobe Simakadze abewuphazamisa uSisera, naletinye tithunywa takhe, nebantfu bakhe, ngesandla saBaraki; watsi: "Sisera waphuma etithunjini zakhe, wabaleka ngenyawo lakhe."
Baraki watsatsa imoto yekulwa nemphi yakhe waya eHaroshethi-Haggoyim, wababulala bonke bantfu baSisera ngesandla sekhephu; akazange ashiye namunye.
Sisera wabaleka ngenyawo waya etentini laJayeli, indodana ka-Hebere, loKenithi; ngobe kwakunekuthula phakathi kweYabin, ukumkani waseHazori, nendlu ya-Héberi.
Jayeli yaphuma yahlangana naSisera, yatsi kuye: "Ngena, nkosi yami, ngena, ungabi nenkinga." Wafika etentini lakhe, wamisa umlenze wakhe phezu kwakhe.
Watsi: "Nceda, nikela ngamanzi, ngobe nginomkhuhlane." Wayivula ibhokisi lekudla, wayinika lokudla, wamisa phansi.
Watsi kuye: "Thinda emgwaqeni wetenti, bese uma umuntu efika ekubuza kutsi: 'Kukhona yini umuntu lapha?', utawuti: 'Akukho.'"

Jayeli, indodana ka-Héberi, yakhipha umkhonto wetenti, yathatha ibhomu, yafika kuye ngasenyameni; yena ke wahlala embhedeni wakhe, ahluphekile kakhulu, yabeka umkhonto ekhanda lakhe, waya entanyeni yakhe, wafa.
Jayeli yaphuma yatsi kuye: "Thiba, ngitakukhombisa lowo muntu lofunayo." Ufike waya kuyo, wabona kutsi uSisera ubelele ekufaneni naye; intambo yetenti beyimile emlonyeni wakhe.
Ngako-ke uSimakadze wehlalela ngalomhla lowo Jabini, ukumkani waseKanana, phambi kwaSirayeli.
Lamadvodza aseSirayeli ahlala enamandla kakhulu kuJabini, ukumkani waseKanana, kuze kube babulala uJabini.
UDebora neBaraka, umsa wa-Abinoamu, bakhuluma ngalengoma ngalolusuku, batsi:
Batsi: "Labo baseSirayeli bahamba phambili, nalaba bantu banikela ngesandla sabo, bangakubonga uSimakadze!
Lingisani, nimakhosi; lalelani, nibaholi! Ngizovuya kuSimakadze, ngizovuya kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli.
Simakadze, lapho uphuma khona eSeyiri, lapho usuka khona ezweni leEdomu, imhlaba wawudlidliza, imimoya yagwadza, nemanti agwadza amanzi.
Lemifula yatsi: "Lakho uSimakadze, lowo weSinayi, wena Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli."
Ngelilanga leShamgari, unyana waAnathi, ngelilanga leJayeli, lamadolobha angeke abe khona; labahamba ngezinyawo bayawuhamba ngesivinini.
Ukuphila esiteshini sakubo kwamiswa eSirayeli; kwamiswa kuze ngifike, mina Deborah, kuze ngifike ngibe ngumama eSirayeli.
Baye bakhetha bokhokho babo, kwafika umkhosi emnyango wedolobha; kungakabonakali intambo noma intshebe ema-Israyeli lamakhulu lamane.
Intliziyo yami ihamba nabaholi beSirayeli, labo banikela ngesandla sabo ebantwini. Lombisani Simakadze!
Bakho labahamba ngetingulube letimhlophe, bakho labahlala ematjani amnandi, nalabo labahamba ngendlela, khumbulani lokhu!

Kusuka emphilweni yalabo labashaya ngesandla, bakhuluma emabhishi lamanzi, bekhuluma ngekukhululwa nguSimakadze, nekukhululwa kwabahlali bakhe baseSirayeli; khona-ke abantu bakaNkulunkulu baphuma befika emigwaqweni.
Thintela, tintela, Deborah! Thintela, tintela, ubhale ingoma! Thintela, Baraki! Tsuse lababoshwa bakho, umsa waAbinoamu!
Labambalwa labashiywe baphuma kulabo abakhulu; labantu bakaSimakadze baphuma kumtfubi, baphuma kumtfubi.
Kusuka eEfrayini kwafika labase-Amaleki; kuBenjamini kwafika nabo bonkhe bantfu bakho, balandela wena. KuMakiri kwafika bomkhuluwa, nakwaZebuloni labanesibhakabhaka.
Labaholi be-Issakhar babe neDebora, na-Issachar abe neBaraki, wahamba ngemuva kwakhe efulethini. Emndenini wakwa-Rubeni kwakukhona lokukhulu lokucabanga kanye nokuphenya kwenhliziyo.
Nakho-ke nihlala nini emigwaqeni yengulube, ningavami kutsi labahlengikazi baphikisa ngemphini yabo? LakwaRubhene kwakukhona ubuhlungu benhliziyo.
Gileadi wahlala enyakatho yeJordane; naDani, kungani uhlala ensimini? Aseri wahlala emfuleni, wahlala emigwaqeni yakhe.
NaseZebuloni wabeka engozini impilo yakhe, naNaphtali waya emadolobheni aphakeme.
Bafika bantfu, bahlasela; bahlasela bantfu base-Kanana eTaanakhi, emabhishi laMegido; ngobe bengenakuba nesiliva.
Kusuka emkhathini, tinyenyezi tahlasela, Kusuka emigwaqeni yabo yasemhlabatsini, tahlasela Sisera.
Umfula weKishoni wabasusa, lolwandle lwakudala, umfula weKishoni. Yite, tfu, ube nekuthula!
Lakho, tinyawo temahhashi latingcolisa njengehhashi lakhe lelihle lihamba nekuhamba.
Wathi angamkani waSimakadze, "Lala uMeroshe, lalama abantu bakhe, ngoba bangafika basiza Simakadze, bangasisiza kulowo lonamandla."
Ube ungcwele kunabanye amadoda, Jayeli, indodana ka-Hebere waseKeni; ube ungcwele kunabanye amadoda ahlala ematenteni.
Wayecela amanzi, yena watsi: "Nceda unywe," yena watsi: "Nceda uphuze," yena watsi: "Nceda udle."
Wayibeka ngesandla sayo emgodini wetente, nesandla sayo sokudla sayo embhedeni, wayibulala iSisera, yamisa phansi inhlavu yakhe, yashaya icala lenhloko yakhe, yayivula.
Watsi: "Uya, ufike emphilweni yakhe; wafika lapho, wehla khona; wafika lapho, wehla khona; lapho wehla khona, wehla khona.
Udzimate waSisera wehla emnyango, watsi: "Ngubani na lowo lahamba ngemoto yakhe? Ngubani na lowo lohamba ngemoto yakhe?"
Lomunye wamadodana akhe, lomkhulu kakhulu, wamphendula, watsi:

Baye bathola, bahlukanise impahla yabo; lowesifazane ngamunye abe nentombazane eyodwa noma ezimbili, nempahla emhlophe yeSisera, neingubo zegolide, nempahla yesiliva, nempahla yegolide leyimisiwe, nempahla leyimisiwe leyimiswe ngesandla sami.

Lakho, Simakadze, kuyawuphela kubo bonkhe labasolwa bakho; kepha labo labakuthandela bangeke babe njengelanga lapho liphuma khona ngemandla ayo. Lelizwe lahlala likhululeke iminyaka lemine namashumi mane.
Lamadvodza aseSirayeli akazange akwenze kahle emehlo kaSimakadze, ngobe wabanikela ngesandla sema-Midyani iminyaka lesikhombisa.
Bami baseSirayeli bakha emadolobheni, emagcekeni kanye netingcweti, lapho bangafihlisi khona. Bami baseMidiyani babenamandla kakhulu.
Ba-Israyeli baphuma besuka eMidiyani, nakuma-Amalikhi, nebantfu labavela emaphandleni, bafika bahlasela lamakhosi aseSirayeli.
Baye bamisa esiteji kulomhlaba, babulala yonke imfuyo kuze kufike eGaza; bangashiya nalutho lokuphilako eSirayeli lokudla, ngisho nengulube, noma inkomo, noma ibhokhwe, noma umdlwane.
Bafika nabo, nemindeni yabo, netente labo, bafike belikhulu elinamaphesenti lamashumi lamabili namakhulu lasitfupha, njengama-angus; angeke kube khona lokubalwa kubo, nasengumkhwenyana wabo.
Bamidiyani babulala bantfu bakaSirayeli; ngobe bonkhe bantfu bakaSirayeli becala kuSimakadze.
Lamadvodza ase-Israyeli aphuma eMidiyani, wafika eGibhithe.
wathumela kubo umprofeti, watsi kubo: "Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, utsi: 'Ngikukhuphule kusuka eMisri, kusuka endlwini yemsebenti.
Nami ngatsi: "Ngiye kutfusa ema-Amori, nalabo labaphazamisayo; ngiwakhipha emphinjeni yenu, ngayinikela kuwe lemhlaba wabo.
Nami ngatsi kuni: 'Ngiye Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu; ningababusi bonkulunkulu be-Amori, lapho nihlala khona ezweni labo.' Kodwa-ke, ningaliphulali lizwi lami.

Wafika umkhonzi waSimakadze, wahlala phansi ngaphansi kwesihlahla se-oyile esise-Ofra, esibe seYoashi, lowase-Abiezeri; ngobe uGideoni, umsa wakhe, abesewubhaka imbewu emgodini wewayini, kutsi ayifihla kuma-Midyani.
USimakadze ufike wabonakala kuGideoni, watsi kuye: "Nkulunkulu ukhona nawe, wena umshayeli lonamandla!"

UGideoni watsi: "Ngikucela, nkosi yami, uma uSimakadze ekhona nathi, yini leyetfu lesihleli sethu? Kuphi zonke lezi zinto ezimangalisayo labababutsi bethu bakhuluma ngazo, besithi: 'UNkulunkulu akazange atikhuphele ema-Egypt'? Kodwa manje Simakadze usishiye, wasisinikela kuma-Midyani.'
USimakadze wehlele kuye, watsi: "Hamba ngemandla akho lakhona, uyawusindisa bantfu bakaSirayeli esandla se-Midiyani; ngiyakuthumela.
UGideoni watsi: "Ngikucela, Nkosi yami! Ngingeke ngisindise kanjani iSirayeli, ngobe umndeni wami ungumncane kakhulu eManase, nami sengincane kakhulu emndenini wami."
Simakadze watsi kuye: "Ngiya kuba nawe, wena utawubulala bonkhe bantfu baseMidiyani njengamuntu lomunye."
Wayemphendvula watsi: "Uma ubona nginekuthula emilonyeni yakho, nikela ngephawu kutsi wena ukhuluma nami.
Ngiyakucela, ungase uhambe, kuze ngibuyele, ngifike nemnikelo wami, ngiwubeke phambi kwakho.' Simakadze watsi: 'Ngitahlala kuze ubuye.'

Waphuma, wafika endlwini yakhe, wehlisa ingulube lencane yemvu kanye neminqumo lengema-250 grams yamafutha omnqumo asengcupheni; webeka inyama emgodini, nalesiphuzo esiswini saso, wayikhipha waya kumlingisi ngaphansi kwesihlahla se-oak, wabanikela.
Watsi kuye angelu laNkulunkulu: "Thiba inyama nekudla, ukubeka kulolu mlilo, bese ukhipha lokudla lokudliwayo." UGideoni wakwenza njalo.
Watsi angeluSimakadze, ngesokudla sesandla sakhe, washaya inyama nenyama yenkukhu; khona-ke kwaphuma umlilo emfuleni, wadla inyama nenyama yenkukhu; ngobe angeluNkulunkulu akazange abuye.
UGideoni, lapho ebona khona ukuthi ngumuntfu longcwele kaSimakadze, watsi: "Hayi, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, ngiyakubona nguNkulunkulu longcwele waNkulunkulu, buso nebuso."
Simakadze watsi kuye: "Kunekuthula, ungabi nebuhlungu; ngeke ufe."
UGideoni wakwakha khona ithempeli kuSimakadze, watsi: "Simakadze ngukuthula," likhona kuze kufike ngalolusuku, eOfra, lalabaAbiezeri.

Ngelobusuku uSimakadze watsi kuye: "Thiba inkunzi yengulube yobaba wakho, inkunzi yesitsatfu, leneminyaka eyisishiyagalombili ubudala; phula ithempeli laBahali, elibe likhona lobaba bakho, uyeke i-Ashera enikeziwe.
bese ukwakha ithempeli kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, phezulu kulendawo ephakeme; uthathe inkunzi yengulube yesibili, uyinikeze njengemnikelo wekushiswa, ngesihlahla se-Ashera lesiwucophele.

UGideoni waba nemadvodza lamashumi lalishumi emindenini yakhe, wakwenza njengobe Simakadze abemphendvula watsi: "Lokho akwenze ngebusuku, kodvwa angeke akwenze lilanga; ngobe wayekhathazekile ngemndeni wakhe kanye namadodana edolobha.
Bafike baphuma emaviki lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu, bebona kutsi ithempeli leBhaali liphucukile, ne-ashera ebekwe kuyo icwecwe, nengulube yesibili ibe yimnikelo wesono esithendeni.
Baphendvula batsi: "Ubani lowenza lokhu?" Baye babheka, babuza, kwatsi: "Gideoni, umsa wa-Yoashi, uyawukwenza loku."
Batsi lamadodana edolobha kuYoashi: "Thumela ngaphandle lomuntfu wakho, aphelelwe ngukuphila; ngobe waphula ithempeli leBhaali, wabulala nesihlahla se-Ashera esiseceleni kwalo."

Joashi watsi kubo bonkhe bantfu labahlala naye: "Niyakulwa naBahali yini? Nifuna kutsi niwusindise yini? Wonke lowo lokhuluma ngaye, utawufa kuze kube ngumandlo; uma uBahali angeke abe nguNkulunkulu, angeke abe ngummeli wakhe, ngobe lidini lakhe lelitshiswa.
