Wayibiza ngalolo busuku igama leGideoni ngeYerub-bhaali, kusho kutsi: "Baale ahlangane naye," ngobe waphula ithempeli laBaale.
Bahlangana bonke baMidiyani, ne-Amaleki, nalaba basempumalanga, badlula eJordane, bamisa emasitezi eGileyadi yeJizreyeli.
Wafika umoya waSimakadze kuGideoni, watsi: "Fuma ingoma yemphimbo, ubambe abe-Abiezeri emuva kwakhe.
Wathumela emakhosa akhe kuwo onkhe emadolobha laManase, akhuluma nabo kutsi bahambe ngemuva kwakhe; nakwa-Asere, nakwa-Zabuloni, nakwa-Naphtali, naye waphuma waya kuye.
UGideoni watsi kuNkulunkulu: "Wena, uma ufuna kutsi usindise iSirayeli ngesandla sami, njengobe watsi,

bona, ngitawubeka lengulube yinye emhlabatsini; uma kuyawuba khona umfula kuphela elunguleni linye, nemhlaba wonke uhlala umnyama, khona-ke ngitazi kutsi wena utawusindisa Israele ngesandla sami, njengobe washo.
UGideoni wavuka ekuseni kakhulu, watsi: "Namuhla ngitatfusa umlenze lomnyama, ngiwutfusa ubisi, ngiwutfusa ibhodlela leligcwele.

Gideoni watsi kuNkulunkulu: "Ase ungeke ube nebuhlungu ngami; ngikucele nje sinye simo, ngikuvumele ukuthi ngiyibuke lengulube ngelinye ililanga, ngikuvumele kutsi lengulube likhutshwe, kanye nemhlaba utfole umfula.
Simakadze wakwenza njalo ngaleyo busuku; itfu lelingene laligedze kuphela, kodvwa kuyo yonke imhlaba kwakukhona umfula.

Baphuma bavuka ngekusasa, Yerubahaleli, lokunguGideoni, naye wonke lamadodana akhe, wamisa itente lakhe e-Enni-Harodi; netenti leMidiyani lisenyakatho yabo, elunxwemeni, ngasempumalanga yemlilo weMore.
USimakadze watsi kuGideyon: "Unebantfu abaningi kakhulu, ngingeke ngibanike iMidiyani emlenzeni wabo; ngobe isiSirayeli singeke sijabulise ngami, sitsi: 'Njengoba sesivulele ngemandla ethu'.

Watsi Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, watsi kuSawula: "Thumela umyalezo kubo bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu yeGileyadi, utsi: 'Lowo lolibalayo nalowo okhatshulwa ngumlilo kumele abuye eMfula iGiliyadi.'"

USimakadze watsi kuGideyon: "Asekhona lamadoda amaningi kakhulu; uyawuwafaka emanzini, khona ngitawubahlukanisela kuwe. Nalapho ngiyokusho kutsi: 'Lowo kumele ahambe nawe', lowo uyahamba; kodwa lapho ngingasho ukuthi: 'Lowe ngeke ahambe nawe', yena akayeki."
UGideoni wabakhipha laba bantu emawotini, Simakadze watsi kuye: "Sihlukanise labo labadla amanzi ngelimlomo lwabo, njengesilwane, nalabo labagubha kutsi baphuze."
Lamadoda lamakhulu mathathu aphuma emphilweni, afike ngesandla sakhe emlonyeni wakhe; kodvwa labo labashiywe bonke babuyela phansi bedla.

USimakadze watsi kuGideyon: "Ngalabamadoda lamakhulu mathathu alilepha, ngiyawukusindisa wena nemindeni yabo, ngitawubanikela ema-Midiyani esandla sakho; bonke labo abasele nabo bahambe bafike ekhaya labo."
Washiya lamadoda aseSirayeli, wagcina labamakhulu mathathu, wabanikela ngekudla kwabo kanye nemibhoshongo yabo. LaseMidiyani abesesihlalweni sakhe esingaphansi kwakhe efulethini.
Ngelobusuku uSimakadze watsi kuGideoni: "Thiba, zula ekamelweni; ngobe ngitakulethela ngesandla sakho.
Uma ulokoteka, phuma nawe naPurha, umkhonzi wakho, ufike esiteshini.

Batsi: "Sifike ekungeneni kwabanye, bese sikhuluma nabo; ngobe baphikisile ngemilomo yabo. Bathi kubo: 'Laba basekufeni!'" 18Abese ahamba naye na-Purha, umkhonto wakhe, kuya esiphelweni semabhishi, lapho kwaba khona labasebuncwabeni.

Bamidiyani, ne-Amaleki, nalabo bonke labasemaphandleni, babekwe efulethini, bangaba makhulu kakhulu njengamacici; nangetingulube zabo kwapaphulwa linani labo, ngaso sonke isikhathi bebengaba makhulu kakhulu njengesihlabathi esiseceleni kwelwandle.

Gideoni wafika, kwatsi kube kukhona umuntu ekhuluma nemphupho yakhe kumngane wakhe, watsi: "Ngibe nephupho, ngobe ngibona inkomishi yekudla kwesibindi sihamba ifike emgwaqeni waseMidiyani, yabetha itente, letenti lalibanjwa, liyawufa.
Waphendvula watsi: "Kungeke kube khona lutho ngaphandle kwesandla seGideoni, unyana ka-Yoashi, umSirayeli; Simakadze utawunikela ngaso iMidyani kanye nesitezi sonke."
Bekungenjalo, lapho Gideoni elalela khona lephupho nelombhalo walo, wehla, wathandaza, wabuyela emakhazeni laSirayeli, watsi: "Thintwa; Simakadze utawunikela emakhazeni laMidiyani emandleni enu."
Wabahlukanisa labamadoda lamakhulu mathathu abemijondolo lemithathu, wanikela kuwo onkhe emagodlo emabhubesi, netinhlamvu temhlabatsi letingenalutho, namatindlela aphumayo.
Wabaphendvula watsi: "Ningibone, nikwenze lokudla kwami; bese ngifika esiphelweni sesiteji, niyenze njalo-ke.
Nami, nalabo bonke labahamba nami, uma siphuca tiphotfo, niphuce netibophotfolo zenu ngaso sonke isigungu, nitsi: UNkulunkulu kanye noGideoni!

UGideyoni, nalabo amadoda lamakhulu abe nawo, wafika esiphelweni sekhampasi ngasekuqaleni kwebusuku, ngemuva kwekushintshwa kwamaphoyisa; baphuca tibhutsi, baphula emabhodlela ewayini lamancane lakubo.
Baphuca emabhubesi abo, batfusa tigodzi tabo, babamba tigodzi tabo ngesandla sabo sasekhohlo, nemibhoshongo ngesandla sabo sasekudla, betsi: "Isikhephe kuSimakadze kanye noGideoni!"
Bahlala khona, lomunye nalomnye endaweni yakhe, ngaso sonke isibhedlela; kodvwa sibhedlela sema-Midiyani sajika, sagwaca, sagwaca.
Batsi baphuza tindlebe letimakhulu lamane, Simakadze wabeka emacwecwe emphini labo kuwo wonke umuntu; lemphi yabaleka yafika eBet-shitha, ifike eZerera, yafika emgwaqeni weAbeli-Mehola, eTabhathi.
Lamadoda aseSirayeli asuka eNaphtali, ne-Aseri, nawaseManase, lahlangana, watsatsa uMidiyani.

UGideyoni wathumela labangani kuwo wonke umfula i-Ephrayi, watsi: "Nisele nibhekene neMidiyani, nibambe amanzi eJordane phambi kwabo kuze kube ngu-Beth-bara." Baphuma bonke amadoda a-Efrayim, babambe amanzi eJordane kuze kube ngu-Beth-bara.

Babulala naOreb neZeeb, lamadodana eMidiyani; bahlasela Oreb ngasemfuleni i-Oreb, babulala Zeeb emgodini wewayini waseZib. 21Behamba bephazamisa bantfu baseMidiyani, batsi: "Sifike kuGideyone enhliziyweni yaOreb kanye noZeeb."
Batsi lamadoda eEframu kuGideoni: "Ngubani na lowakwenza nathi, lapho uphuma ukulwa neMidiyani, ungenasibiza yini?" Baze bakhuluma naye ngebuhlungu.
Wabaphendvula watsi: "Ngubani na longiyenzile ngenani lenu? Lokudla lokushiwo nguEfremu akusho yini kutsi kungcono kunekudla lokushiwo libandla lami, abe-Abiezeri?
Simakadze wanikela esandlani sam, Orebe naZebe, baholi ba-Midyani; yini lengingayenza ngifana nani?'" Nalapho akhuluma khona, babuyela emlonyeni wakhe.
UGideoni wafika eJordane, wadlula, yena nemadodana lamakhulu mathathu ahamba naye; bafile, kodvwa baphindze balandela.
Wathi kubo bonkhe bantfu baseSukoti: "Ninise, sicelani, inhlama kulabo bami, ngobe sebavumile; nami sengihamba ngiphazamisa uZebha naSalmuna, bobukhosi beMidyani."
Batsi labaholi beSukhothi: "Ube uthathe Zebahha naSalmuna, ngobe sitawunikela yini ngekudla emkhosini wakho?"
UGideyon watsi: "Ngaleso sikhathi, lapho uSimakadze enikela ngasesandla sami kuZebha neSalmuna, ngiyawudlidliza inyama yenu ngemiphimbo yemhlabatsi kanye netinsika."
Waphuma khona waya ePhenuyeli, wababuza kanjalo-ke; baphendvula batsi: "Sisho kutsi lamadoda aseSukoti akazange aphendule njalo.
Watsi kubo bonkhe bantfu basePhenuyeli: "Lokoku, lapho ngibuyela khona ngekuthula, ngizowuvala lodonga.

Zebha naSalmuna babe eKarkori, nabo nemphi yabo, yaba ngumakhulu lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu; labo bonke labashiyelwe emikhosini yalabo basempumalanga; ngobe kwabulawa ema-Amori lamakhulu lamakhulu mahlanu namakhulu lamashumi lasitfupha lalabakhipheko.
UGideoni wehla ngendlela yabo labahlala etentweni, besuka emaphandleni eNobha neYogbeha, wahlasela lamaphoyisa, ayawuwabulala, ngobe abecabanga kutsi aphephile.
NaZebha naSalmuna, bantfu lababini baseMidiyani, babaleka; kodvwa yena wabaphazamisa, wababulala, wahlasela lonke libutfo lakhe.
UGideoni, umsa wa-Yoashi, wehla emphini, waya emfuleni waseHeres.
Wathatha umfana waseSukothi, wambuza imibuzo; wabhala kuye amagama labaholi beSukothi nalabakhulu bayo, labamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa nesihlanu.

UGideoni wafika kubo bonkhe bantfu baseSukoti, watsi: "Bonani, uZebha neSalmuna, ngobe nimiphicelele ngabo, nitsi: 'Sewuba neZebha naSalmuna? Ngabe sitawunikela yini ngekudla kulabo bantu bakho labafile?'"
Wathatha lamadoda amakhulu edolobha, watsatsa lamakhosi aseSukothi, wababulala ngetinsika temhlabatsi netingcumbu.
Naletindlu tePenuyeli atawutiphula, wabulala nabo bonkhe bantfu bedolobha.
Wakhuluma kuZebha naSalmuna, watsi: "Baphi laba bantu nibabulalayo eTabori?" Baphendvula batsi: "Bebefana nani; bonke babefana nemadvodzana ankhosi."
UGideyoni watsi: "Bebengabazalwane bami, bonyana bemama yami; nguNkulunkulu lophilayo, uma nibagcina niphila, ngingeke ningakubulalani."
Wabuyela kuYetheri, lomkhulu wakhe, watsi kuye: "Bopha labo!" kepha Yetheri akazange asuse isikhephe sakhe, ngobe wayengumfana, walokotha.
Watsi Zebha naSalmuna: "Thina sitawukwenza, ngobe umuntu uphindze ahlukaniswe ngemandla akhe." UGideoni wafika, wababulala, wakhipha emacwecwe emilenze yetinkemba tabo.
Batsi lamadoda aseSirayeli kuGideoni: "Lala phezu kwethu, wena, nonyana wakho, nalowo mntwana wakho; ngobe usisindisile ema-Midyani."
Gideoni wabaphendvula watsi: "Ngingeke ngibe ngunkhosi yenu, nandzami angeke abe ngunkhosi yenu; Simakadze utawuba nguMbuso wenu."
Watsi: "Nginesicelo esisodwa: Ninikele lomunye nalowo umlenze wakhe wegolide, lowusuka emphilweni yenu." (Bekube yisitayela sema-Ismaili kutsi bagqoke umlenze wegolide.)
Baphendvula batsi: "Siyawubanikela."Bafaka ingubo, ngobe bonke babeka emacwecwe emilenzeni yabo, ngaleso sikhatsi.

Wacela nemilenze yegolide, isisindo sayo safika kuma-shekeli lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu; ngaphandle kwemihlobiso, nemacwecwe, namahembe amhlophe, abewagqoka bantfu baseMidiyani, kanye nezingcezu ezigcongweni tetingcele zabo.
UGideoni wayenza i-ephod, ingubo yekutsi, yagolide, wayibeka eOfrani, emzini wakhe; ngobe labaSirayeli bonke bayawuphazamisa khona. Waba yitfu kuGideoni kanye nendlu yakhe.
Amakhosi aseMidiyani ahlaselwa ngaseSirayeli, akazange aphinde akhuleke; lelizwe lahlala likhululeke iminyaka emashumi mane ngemihla kaGideoni.
Wabuyela endlwini yakhe, wahlala lapho.
UGideyoni waba nemadvodzana amashumi lamane, labaphuma emilenzeni yakhe; ngobe abebenemadvodzakati amaningi.
Nalenkosikazi yakhe, leyayihlala eShekhemi, nayo yazala unyana, wayita igama lakhe kutsi nguAbimeleki.
UGideyoni, umsa wa-Yoashi, wafa emshadweni wakhe lokuhle, wabanjwa ethempelini layise, uYoashi, eOfra yeAbiezeri.
Batsi lapho Gideoni eshona khona, lamadvodza ase-Israyeli abuyela ekukhanyeni kwakhe, wahlala emaBhaali, wabeka Baale-berithi njengengcwele yabo.
Bakhohlwa kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wabo, lowawubasindisele kusuka kubo bonkhe lababubi babo lababehlele.
Batsi: "Akekho nalowo loyawuhlala emndenini waJerubhayeli, lowo nguGideoni, ngenxa yezinto zonke ezinhle azenzako kuSirayeli.
Abebhimeleki, umsa wa-Yerubahali, waya eShekem kuboyise wakhe, wabakhuluma nabo kanye nemindeni yabo, watsi:

"Nibuze bonke bantfu baseShekem, nitsi: 'Kulungile yini kuwe, kutsi lamadvodzana aJerubhayeli lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa abe ngumphathi wenu, nome lomuntfu lonyenti?' Kutsi-ke, ngiyakukhumbula; mina sengumtfubi wenu."
Batsi labazalwane bemama lakhe bakhuluma kubo bonkhe bantfu baseShekhemi, batsi: "Uyawulandela uAbhimeleki," ngobe batsi: "Uyindodana yethu"
Bangamnikela ngesiliva lama-70 endlwini yaBaale-berithi; ngaleyo golide uAbhimeleki wakhokhela abantu lababi, nalabaphazamisayo, balandela yena.

Wafika endlwini yababa bakhe e-Ofra, wabulala labazalwane bakhe labamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa, bantfu baYerubabhali, ngalinye itshe; kodvwa Jothamu, unyana omncane waYerubabhali, waphuma wafihlakela.
Bahlangana bonkhe bantfu baseShekhemi, neBet-Milo, besuka eSikheme, befika ku-Ashera, lapho kuhlala khona uAbhimeleki, bakwenza abe ngunkhosi.
Bakhuluma kuJothamu, watsi kuye: "Thini lamakhosi eShekhemi, ningikhulumela; Nkulunkulu utawubalalela."
Kwafika usuku lapho tihlahla taphuma khona kutsi zikhethe ubukhosi kubo, zatsi kuletimbali te-olive: "Ube nguMbuso wethu."
Lesihlahla se-olive satsi kuye: Ngaye ngiyawushiya yini mafutha ami, ahlonishwa nguNkulunkulu kanye nalabo bantu, ngihambe ngihamba ngaphesheya kwezihlahla?
Batsi emajikijolo esihlahla sesigasi: 'Thiba, ube ngunkhosi yethu.'
Lesihlahla semfiko satsi kuye: Ngawushiya yini lokudla kwami lokumnandi nelokuhle, ngihambe ngihamba ngaphesheya kwemihlahla?
Batsi emajikijolo esihlahla setiye, Yiva, ube ngunkhosi yethu.
Lesihlahla satsi kuye: 'Ngayishiya yini lewayini yami, eligcolisa Nkulunkulu kanye nalabo bantu, ngihambe ngihamba ngasemhlabatsini?'
Batsi emajikijolo onke emphinjeni: 'Thiba, ube ngunkhosi yethu.'

Watsi umnqumo emajikijolo, 'Uma nifuna ngaye kutsi ngibe ngunkhosi yenu, fike niphumule ngaphansi kwesomiso sami; kepha uma ninganifuni, khona-ke umlilo ungaphuma kumnqumo wemajikijolo, ube yimoto yesedari yaseLibanoni.'
Ngako-ke, ngabe sewukwenze ngekuthula nasenhlonipho, ukwenta uAbhimeleki ukumkani? Bheka, ngabe ubeke ecaleni leJerubhayeli kanye nendlu yakhe? Bheka, ngabe wakwenza kuye kutsi abe ngunkhosi?
Khumbula kutsi ubaba wami wahlasela ngesandla sakhe, watsi: 'Ngitakusibulala.'

Niye-ke namuhla nibuyela emndenini wababami, nibulala bantfu bakhe labamashumi lamabili nesihlanu ematshe lalinye, nakwenta uAbhimeleki, umsa wenkosikazi yakhe, ukumkani wabahlali baseShekhemi, ngobe ungumfana wenu.
Ngako-ke, uma namuhla nitsenzile ngeqiniso nekuthula kuYerubabhali kanye nendlu yakhe, khona-ke nikhululeke ku-Abhimeleki, naye akhululeke kuni.
"Lakho-ke, Simakadze utsi: 'Kungenjalo, mlilo uphume kuAbhimeleki, utfule bantfu baShekhemi nabaseBet-Milo; mlilo uphume kubo bonkhe bantfu baShekhemi nabaseBet-Milo, utfule Abimeleki.'"
Jothamu waphuma, wabaleka waya eBeeri, wahlala khona; ngobe akazange agweme u-Abhimeleki, lomkhulu wakhe.
Abimeleke waba ngunkhosi yaseSirayeli iminyaka lemibili.
Simakadze wathumela umphefumulo lobi, waba nenkinga phakathi kwa-Abhimeleki nabaholi beSikheme; batsi: "Abebekamele uAbimeleki."

ANkulunkulu wakwenza njalo, kutsi igazi leliboshwa lalibanjwa bantfu labalishumi elinamashumi lamabili nesihlanu ba-Yerubahaleli libuye libe ngumnikelo wesono ku-Abimeleki, loyise wabo, lowo wababulalayo, kanye nalabahlali baseShekem, labo labebasekela.
Batsi: "Kungekuhle kutsi sifike eSikheme, ngobe labahlali baseSikheme babeka emaphiko emadlelo abo; nabo bonkhe labo labahamba ngawo, babebabulala."
Gaali, umsa wa-Ebedi, waya eShekhemi naye nabazalwane bakhe; bonkhe bantfu beShekhemi bayawukholwa kuye.
Baphuma emhlabatsini, bavuna imbewu yabo, beyicindezela, beyenza ibe yinhlanhla, bafike endlwini yaNkulunkulu wabo, badla, baphuza, babulala Abimeleke.

Gaali, umsa wa-Ebedi, watsi: "Ubani uAbhimeleki? Ubani uShekhemi, kutsi siyawukhonza kuye? Angeke yini abe nguyise weJerubhayeli, naZebulu ube ngumphathi wakhe? Basebenzela indlu yaHamori, umntakwabo waseShekemi! Ngubani lotawutinikela kuAbimeleki?"
Watsi: "Ngabe lebantfu bangaba ngaphansi kwami, ngitawuwasusa!" Wathi ku-Abhimeleki: "Thintela livi lakho lonke, uphume."
Zebuli, umphathi wema-Israyeli, watsi kuGaali, umsa wa-Ebedi: "Kutsi Simakadze akazange akuvumele ufike eGileyadi.
Wathumela labaholi ku-Abhimeleki, watsi: "Gaali, unyana ka-Ebedi, nabangane bakhe bafike eShekhemi; bona bakhulisa umjikelo wedolobha labani.
Ngako-ke, wena namadodana akho nifike nifihle emhlabatsini ngalobusuku.
Watsi Simakadze watsi kuSawula: "Thintela umsebenti wakho, bese ufika emgwaqeni wenkhosi yakho, wena nebantfu bakho, bese uhlasela ledolobha.
Abe Abimeleke waphuma ngebusuku, waya eShekhemi, yena nebantfu bakhe bonkhe, behlukaniswe abemikhulu lemine.
Gaali, umsa ka-Ebedi, waphuma wahlala emgwaqeni wenhloko yedolobha; kodvwa Abimeleke nebantfu bakhe baphuma besuka emphilweni yabo.
Wababona Gaali, watsi kuZebuloni: "Bona, abantu bephuma emadolobheni!"AseZebuloni aphendvula watsi: "Wena uma ubona umthunzi wemadolobheni, ucabanga kutsi bangabe ngubantfu."
Gaali waphendula watsi: "Ngibona abantu bephuma emaphakathi kwelizwe, neqembu elinye livela emgwaqeni we-Eden."
UZebuloni watsi kuye: "Kuphi namanje kukhuluma kwakho lokukhulu, lapho utsi khona, 'Ngubani na Abimeleke, kutsi siyawumukhonza?' Nalaba bangabaphi lamadoda lowaphazamisa; phuma ube nekulwa nabo!"
Waphuma Gaali, wakhipha bantfu ba-Shekem, wabambisana na-Abimeleki.
Abimeleki wehla ngemuva kwakhe, kodvwa Gaali wabaleka; kwaba nebantfu abaningi labafa, kuze kufike emnyango.
Abimeleke wahlala e-Aruma; Zebuli wehlisa uGaali nabazalwane bakhe, kutsi bangase bahlale eShechem.
Kutsi kube sekuphele usuku, labahlali baseSikheme baphuma bephuma emhlabatsini, bakhuluma ku-Abimeleki.
Wathatha lamadodana akhe, wabahlukanisa abemijondolo emithathu, wafihla emhlabatsini; kodvwa lapho ebona abantu bephuma edolobhaneni, wavuka, wabahlasela.
Abimeleki naleyo mindeni yakhe yafika, yahlala emnyango wedolobha; lemindeni lemibili nayo yafika kulabo labasemhlabatsini, yabahlasela.
Abebhimeleki wahlasela lomhlaba lowo mhlakani wonke, wawuthatha, wababulala bonke labahlala kuwo; wehlisa lomhlaba, wawufafaza ngefulawa.
Batsi bakubona bonke bantfu baseSikheme, labahlala ethempelini la-El-berithi, baphuma befika emnyango wendlu yaSimakadze.
Abimeleki wakhuluma kutsi bahlangana khona.

Waphuma wafika emfuleni iSalmon, yena nebantfu bakhe bonke; watsi: "Nifikeni, nikwenze lokho lokumibona ngikwenza;" wakhipha sandla sakhe, wamisa emajikijolo, wababeka emphinjeni yakhe, watsi kubo bonkhe bantfu labahamba naye: "Nihambe, nikwenze lokho lokumibona ngikwenza."

Batsi bonke labaseSikheme bacubhukela emajikijolo, balandela uAbhimeleki, babeka emajikijolo emgodini, bawubulala ngemlilo umgodi kanye nalabaseSikheme. Bafa nabo bonkhe bantfu basemgodini weSikheme, labamalunga nelikhulu, amadoda nabesifazane.
Abimeleke wahamba waya eTebesi, waba nemphi yakhe kuyo, wayawuyisa.
Kube khona inhloko-dolobha leqinile ngaphakathi komgwaqo, baphuma kuyo bonke labasemgwaqweni, amadoda nabesifazane, bavala icala labo, bafike esitezi senhloko-dolobha.
Abimeleke wafika enhloko-dolobha, wahlasela inhloko-dolobha, wafike emnyango wenhloko-dolobha kutsi avule mlilo.
lomunye umfazi wakhipha isiliva lelikhulu enhloko yakhe, wabulala inhlavu yakhe.

Wayitsatsa isandla sakhe, watsi kulowo wesifazane loyawutingela imfuyo yakhe: "Susa isikhephe sakho, bulala ngami, kutsi bangatsi bati, 'Uwesifazane wambulala.'" Lomuntfu waSimakadze wehlisa isandla sakhe kuye, wabulala.
Bekubona bantfu beSirayeli kutsi uAbhimeleki ufile, batsi: "Lowo muntfu weSirayeli ufile!"
Ngako-ke uSimakadze wehlisa ku-Abhimeleki lokubi labekwenzele ubaba wakhe, lapho abulala khona bazalwane bakhe labamashumi lamane nesihlanu.
Awo-ke Nkulunkulu wababuyisela kubo bonkhe labahlali baseSikheme lokubi kwabo; kwafika kubo lalama laJothamu, umsa waYerubahali.
Kusuka lapho kwavuka, ngemuva kwezinsuku ta-Abimeleki, uTola, umsa waPua, umsa waDodo, wase-Issakhareni, waba ngumsindisi weSirayeli; wahlala eShamiri, ensimini yaseGibhithe.
Waba ngummeli waseSirayeli iminyaka lemashumi lamane nasitfupha nesikhombisa; wafa, wabanjwa eShamiri.
Emva kwakhe kwaphuma Yairi waseGileyadi, waba ngummeli waSirayeli iminyaka lemashumi lamane nambili.
Wabe nemadvodzana amashumi lamane, behamba emabhubesi lamashumi lamane; babenemadolobha lamashumi lamane eGileyadi, labizwa ngeHavoti-Yairi kuze kube namuhla.
UYahiri wafa, wabanjwa eKamoni.
Baphinde bakwenza lokudla lokubi emehloni kaSimakadze, bakhonza emaBaali, ne-Astoreti, namasiko aseAram, neSidon, neMoab, namakhosikazi e-Ammon, namaFilisti; bashiya Simakadze, bangawusebenzisi.
Ngako-ke uSimakadze wagwema bantfu beSirayeli, wabanikela emaFilistithi nemadvodzana aAmmon.
Ngaleso sikhathi, lamazwe lawa abulala bonkhe bantfu base-Israyeli labahlala kwelinye icala leJordane eGileyadi, ilizwe lama-Amori, iminyaka lengemashumi lamabili nesihlanu.
Lamadvodza ase-Ammon adlula eJordane, wahlasela Juda, naBenjamini, naEframu; ngobe lamakhosi ase-Isirayeli abe nenkinga enkulu.
Lamadvodza ase-Israyeli afike ekhuluma kuSimakadze, watsi: "Siwudlwengula wena; siyawushiya uNkulunkulu wethu, sitawukhonza labaBaali."
Simakadze watsi kuye: "LemiSirayeli, ne-Amori, ne-Ammon, neFilisti,
Ba-Sidoni, ne-Amaleki, ne-Maoni batfusa nine, ngobe nitsi: 'Ngikusindise.' Nami ngikukhululele kubo.
kodvwa nimi niyawushiya, niyawukhonza bantfu lababanye; ngobe ngitsi: Ngatsi: Angeke ngikusindise.
Niye, nitsi kulabo bonkulunkulu nibakhethile; bangakusindisa emhlabeni wenkinga yenu.
Lamadvodza aseSirayeli akhuluma kuSimakadze, watsi: "Sifile; yenza nathi kutsi kube kahle emehlo akho; kepha manje, sicela, sisindise."
Basuka bakhipha ema-Israyeli imihlambi yabo, banikela kuSimakadze; ngobe akazange afune kuze abone livi leSirayeli.
Lamadvodza ase-Ammon ahlangane, wahlala eGileyadi; lamadoda aseSirayeli ahlangana, wahlala eMizwa.
Batsi bomkhuluwa bamakhosi eGileyadi, lomunye kulowo: "Lomuntfu lotawuqala ukulwa nemadvodzana a-Ammon, kumele abe nguMengameli walabo bonke labahlala eGileyadi."
Jeftha waseGileyadi, waba ngumuntfu lonamandla lokuhlasela; ubaba wakhe waba nguGileyadi, kodvwa umkakhe wayengumfana wesilisa.
Nalendodana yeGileyadi yazala naye labantwana, bakhula, babulala Jeftha, batsi kuye: "Ungeke ube nengxenye emndenini wethu, ngobe uyise wasinye sentombi."
Jephthah watsi: "Ngubani loyawuhamba naye?" Jeftha waphuma emndenini wakhe, wahlala emazweni la-Tob; bahlangana kuye bantfu lababi kakhulu, baphuma nabo behlasela.
Kwatsi sekudlule sikhatsi, bantfu be-Ammon bahlasela bonkhe labaSirayeli.
Baye babuyela eGileyadi, batsi: "Siyawufika sifike kuJephthah, kutsi siwubuyisele ezweni leTob."
Batsi kuye: "Khangela, ube ngumholi wethu, siyawuhlasela bantfu be-Ammon."
Jeftha wabaphendvula watsi: "Ningekeni nami ningikhondze, ningamitsi endlwini yababami? Ngubani na loyawufika lapha kum, ngobe nine nkinga?"
Lamadoda amakhulu eGileyadi aphendvula, watsi: "Ngeleso sizathu sabuyela kuwe manje; fike nathi, uhlasele bantfu be-Ammon, nawe ube nguMengameli walabahlali bonke baseGileyadi."
Jeftha watsi kuye: "Kungenjalo, uma ngibuyela ukulwa nemadvodzana a-Ammon, ngobe Simakadze abeminikela phambi kwami, ngingaba nguMengameli wenu?"
Lamadoda amakhulu eGileyadi aphendvula, watsi: "Simakadze utawube ngubufakazi phakathi kwethu, uma sikhuluma njalo.
UJephthah wahamba nalabakhulu baseGileyadi, labantfu bakwenza abe nguMengameli wabo kanye nesikhulu sabo; wakhuluma amazwi akhe onke phambi kwaSimakadze eMizpa.
UJephthah wathumela labaholi kunkhosi yabana-Ammon, watsi: "Iyini inkinga yakho nami, kutsi ufike uhlasela ilizwe lami?"

Unkhosi yabana-Ammon yabaphendula labathunywa bakaJephtha, yatsi: LaSirayeli bathathe ilizwe lami, lapho bephuma eMijiphu, kusukela eArnon kuya eJabhoki, kanye neJordane; kodvwa manje uyawuyibuyisela ngekuthula.
UJephthah wehla wathumela labaholi kunkhosi yabana-Ammon, watsi:
watsi: Lokho kusho Jeftha: LaSirayeli akazange athathe ilizwe laMoabi, noma ilizwe lemadvodzana a-Ammon.
Baphuma baphuma eMijiphu, bahamba ngetfu, bafika emfuleni waseSume, bafike eKadeshi.

Baye bathumela kunkhosi yase-Edomu, besithi: Sivumele sihambe ngalelizwe lakho; kodvwa inkhosi ya-Edomu akazange ayivumeli. Bayawutsalela nakubo ukumkani waseMoabhi ngesimo salokho; naye akafuni kutsi abe khona eKadeshi.

Basuka khona bahamba bedlula esigabeni sesidlangalaleni, bajikeleza imifula yeEdomu neyeMowabi; baya ngasenyakatho-ntshonalanga yaMamobhi, bazame emaphandleni aseArnoni. Bebengafika emifuleni yaseMoabi, ngobe iArnoni iyimikhawulo yabo.
Israyeli yathumela labaholi kuSihoni, ukumkani wema-Amori, lohlala eHeshboni, yatsi kuye: 'Nceda usivumele sihambe ngemhlaba wakho siye endaweni yethu.'
Sihoni akazange avumele laSirayeli kutsi bahambe ngemhlaba wakhe, kodvwa wahlanganisa lonke luhlanga lwakhe, waba yisikhulu eJahazi, wahlasela laSirayeli.

Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, wabanikela ngesandla saSihoni kanye nebantfu bakhe bonke esihlalweni sakwa-Israyeli, batsi: "Bababulala; na-Israyeli wahlala ezweni lonke lama-Amori, abahlala kulolu mhlaba.
Bayikhipha yonke, kusukela eArnon kuya eJabhoki, kanye nemhlabatsini kuya eJordane.
ngobe Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, wakhipha la-Amori phambi kwa-Israyeli, bonkhe bantfu bakhe; nawe ke unelungelo yini lokuyawuhlala khona?
Natsi-ke, uma uthatha lokudla lokuniketwa nguKemoshi, Nkulunkulu wakho, natsi natsi sitawuthatha lokudla lokuniketwa nguSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wethu.
Ulungile yini wena kunaBalaka, umsa waSiporu, ukumkani weMoabi? Akazange ahlangane naSirayeli, noma abe nekulwa nabo?

Kusukela lapho laSirayeli behlala khona eHeshboni, nase-Aroeri nemindeni yayo, kanye naletinye tidolobhana letiseceleni kwe-Arnon, iminyaka lengemakhulu lamane; yini-ke lobusuku bonke ningeke niyithole?
Ngingeke ngikubusise wena, kepha wena uyawubutisa ngami; Simakadze, ummeli, agweme namuhla phakathi kwamakhosi aseSirayeli nemadvodzana a-Ammon."
Ngako-ke ukumkani wema-Ammon akazange acabange kutsi uJephthah abewuthumela kuye.
Wafika umoya waSimakadze kuJephthah, waya eGileyadi naManase, waya eMizpa eGileyadi, waya ema-Ammoniti.
UJephthah wehlalela uSimakadze, watsi: "Laba-Ammon, uma ngibanikela ngesandla sami,
lowo lophuma emgwaqeni wendlu yami kutsi amhlangabeze, lapho ngibuyela khona ngekuthula emphilweni nalabaLevi ba-Ammon, uyawuba nguSimakadze, ngaye ngitawunikela njengemnikelo wekushiswa.
UJephthah wehla wahlasela bantfu be-Ammon, Simakadze wabanikela esandlani sakhe.
Wabulala lamadolobha lamashumi lamane, kusukela eAroeri kuya eMinnithi, kuze kufike eAbeli-Keramimi, ngemphiko enkulu; wabeka ema-Amoni ngaphansi kwesandla saSirayeli.

UJephthah wafika ekhaya lakhe eMizpa, kwaphuma ngubani kutsi amhlangabeze, ngaphandle kwendvodzakati yakhe leyayidlalela ngemibhoshongo? Waye ngumntwana wakhe kuphela; akazange abe nemunye unyana noma indodana.
Wayibona, watsi: "Kungeke kube njalo, nkosikazi yami; wena ungisibeka ebuhlungu nasenhliziyweni yami, ngobe ngibembise kuSimakadze mnikelo wesono longingawuphulanga."
Wathi yena, "Baba wami, wena ubulale livi kuSimakadze; ngenza kimi njengoba ubulalele, ngobe Simakadze ubeke phansi umkhosi wakho ema-Ammoniti, lalabo abamelwane bakho."
Watsi: "Nceda ungisinike sipho esisodwa, ngibe nenyanga lemibili kutsi ngihambe ngasemadolobheni nabangani bami ngilingisa, ngobe angeke ngikwati."
Wathi kuye: "Thina-ke, ungaya." Wayishiya ihambe iminyaka lemibili. Waye waya emadolobheni nabangani bakhe, wakhala kutsi angeke abe nendodana.
Watsi kudlula iminyaka lemibili, yabuyela kuboyise; watsi kuye kutsi: "Asekho muntfu longeke ahambe naye"; wakwenza kube ngumthetho eSirayeli.
kutsi iminyaka ngemnyaka, tisebenti taSirayeli tiyawuphuma lilanga lesihlanu, titawukhumbula intombi yaJephthah waseGileyadi.

Lamadoda la-Ephrayi ahlangana, adlula eZafoni, waphendvula Jeftha, watsi: "Ngubani na lowaphuma ekulwa nemadvodzana a-Ammon, utsi ungasikhombisi kutsi sihambe nawe? Sizowubulala indlu yakho kanye nawe!"
UJephthah watsi kuye: "Mina nebantfu bami sasinemphiko lekhulu nalabo base-Ammon; ngakubiza wena, kodvwa awuzange ungisindise ebusweni babo.
Nalapho ngibona khona kutsi ningangisindisi, ngabeka kuphila kwami enhliziyweni yami, ngadlula ngihlasela bantfu baka-Ammon, Simakadze wangisasindisa; yini-ke lemi nafikani namhlanje ningibulala?

UJephthah wahlanganisa bonke bantfu baseGileyadi, wabahlasela ema-Ephrayim; kodvwa lamadoda aseGileyadi awabulala, ngobe lamakhosi e-Ephrayim abethi: "Niyibo bonkhe labaphuma ku-Ephrayim nakuma-Manase eGileyadi."
Lamadoda eGileyadi athathe emabhishi aseJordane, laphuma kuEfraim. Nalapho lomunye wemadvodzana aGileyadi abethi: "Laba, ngipaphule," lamadodana eGileyadi ayembuza watsi: "Uyi-Ephrayim yini wena?"

Batsi: "Kulungile, khuluma uSibholeti." Ngako-ke lapho esho khona uSibholeti, ngobe angeke abe nekhono lokulichaza kahle, baphuma bewubulala emgwaqeni weJordane. Nalapho kwabulawa emaphesenti lamashumi mane namakhulu mahlanu namabini kuEfraim.
UJephthah waba ngummeli waSirayeli iminyaka lemine; watsi: "Wafa Jeftha, umGileyadi, wafunwa emzini wakhe eGileadi.
Emva kwakhe, u-Ibzani waseBethlehem waba ngunkhosi yaseSirayeli.

Waba nemadvodza lamashumi lamakhulu lasitfupha, namadvodzana alishumi elinamahlanu, wanikela bantfu labangaphandle kwemndeni wakhe ngemadvodzana akhe, wakhipha emabhinqa lamashumi lamakhulu lalishumi elinesihlanu laphuma ngaphandle kwemndeni wakhe abemakhosikazi lamadodana akhe. U-Ibsani waba nguMengameli waseSirayeli iminyaka leyisithupha.
Wafa u-Ibsani, wabanjwa eBethlehem.
Emva kwakhe, uElon, wase-Zabuloni, waba ngummeli wakaJuda iminyaka lelishumi.
Wafa uElon, wabanjwa eAyaloni, ezweni laZebuloni.
Emva kwakhe, u-Abdon, umsa waHileli, wasePirathoni, waba ngunkhosi yase-Israyeli.
Wabe nemadvodzana amashumi mane, nemadvodzakati lamakhulu mathathu, abehamba emabhubesi lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa; waba ngummeli waSirayeli iminyaka lemine.
Wafa naAbdon, unyana waHileli, wabanjwa ePirathoni, eEfrayim, emhlabatsini lwaba-Amaleki.
Lamadvodza ase-Israyeli abuyela ekwenzeni lokubi emlonyeni waSimakadze, ngobe Simakadze abewanikela ngesandla semaFilistimi iminyaka lemashumi mane.
Kubekhona umuntu, igama lakhe lakunguManoha, waseZora, emndenini waDani; indodana yakhe yayingakazali, akazange abe nendodana.
Wabonakala kuye umlingisi waSimakadze, watsi kuye: "Beka, ungeke ube nendvodzakati, kepha utawukhulelwa, utawuzala muntfu lomnyama.
Hlala, ungadli wayini nanoma yini engcolileyo, futhi ungadla noma yini engangeni kahle.

"Yebo, utawukhulelwa, utawuzala unyana; intambo yekudla ngeke ifike ekhanda lakhe, ngobe lomuntfu ungeke abe nguNaziri waNkulunkulu kusukela emlenzeni wemama wakhe; naye uzoqala ukusindisa bantfu baka-Israyeli emaFilisti.

Waphuma lowesifazane, wafika emndenini wakhe, wamtshela watsi: "Umuntfu waNkulunkulu ufike kwami, kubonakala kuye sengathi ngumbingeleli waNkulunkulu, wamangalisa kakhulu; ngamubuza kutsi uyaphi, naye angisitshela igama lakhe.

Watsi kuye: "Lamuhla, ungeke uphuze iwayini nanoma yini engcolileyo, futhi ungeke udle noma yini enobubi; ngobe lomuntfu kumele abe nguNazirisi waNkulunkulu kusukela emlenzeni wakhe kuya kusuku lwakhe lokufa."
U-Manuwa wathandaza kuSimakadze, watsi: "Aye, Nkosi yami, sicela lomuntfu waNkulunkulu lowutfumele ufike kuthi, afundise kutsi singadla kanjani umfana loyawuzalwa."
Simakadze watsi ku-Amoni: "Thumela umnikelo wakho kulendlu yaNkulunkulu, bese unquma kutsi yini lengingayenza kuwe; ngobe Simakadze Nkulunkulu wako wakhuluma nawe.
Waphuma wabaleka, watsi kumfazi wakhe: "Yebo, lomuntu lowo labesuka kwami ngalolusuku, uvela lapha!"
Manowa wavuka, walandela indodana yakhe, waya kuye, watsi: "Uye lokhuluma nendodana yami?" Waphendvula watsi: "Ngimi."
UManoe watsi kuye: "Uma kuhamba kutsi kube njalo, yini lekufanele siyenze ngelowo mntwana?"
Angelu waSimakadze watsi kuye: "Lendvodzakati yakho kumele ikwenze konkhe labengingakuphendvula kuyo.
Angeke adle noma yini lephuma etinsini, angadla wayini nanoma yini encibilikisayo, angadla noma yini lengcolile; kumele agcine yonke imiyalo yami.' "
U-Manuwa watsi kumuntfu waNkulunkulu: "Nceda, phumula, kuze silungiselele kuwe ingulube."
Watsi yena, "Nase ngihlala khona, ngingadla inyama yakho; kepha uma uhlela iminikelo yekushiswa, uyilungiselele kuSimakadze." Ngako-ke Manowa akazange abone ukuthi yayiyinkhosi yaSimakadze.
U-Manuwa watsi kumuntfu waNkulunkulu: "Itsini igama lakho, kutsi singakuhlonipha uma lisho lakho lifike liphume?
Waphendvula watsi: "Ngubani na lowucela igama lami, ngobe kunzima kakhulu kutsi lifundwe?"
U-Manuwa watsi: "Manao uthathe inkunzi yengulube kanye nemnikelo wesono, wawunikela kuSimakadze emadolobheni; ngobe Simakadze abewenza lomsebenzi omkhulu emehlweni kaManoe nankhosi yakhe.
Batsi kuyawuphuma umphunga ethempelini, ufike esibhakabhakeni, wafika naSimakadze emliloni; ngobe bekubona Manowa nendvodzakati yakhe, bahlabana ngebuso babo phansi.
Umprofeti waSimakadze akazange aphinde abonakaliswe ku-Manuwa nendvodzakati yakhe; khona-ke uManuwa waqonda kutsi ube ngumprofeti waNkulunkulu.
Watsi uAbrahama kundvodzakati yakhe: "Sitawufa, ngobe sabona Nkulunkulu!"

Wayiphendula indodana yakhe, watsi: "Ngabe uSimakadze wafuna kutsi atfule, akazange athathe mnikelo wethu wokudla kanye nesondlo sethu, akazange atibonise zonke lezi zinto, akazange atitshele zonke lezi zinto ngalolusuku."
Lowesifazane wazala umfana, watsi kuye igama litsi: Samsone. Wakhula, ngobe Simakadze abembambise.
UMoya waSimakadze wawuqale ufike kuye eMahanayi-Dan, phakathi kweZora neEshtaoli.
Samsone waphuma waya eTimna, wabona khona umkhwenyana waseFilisti.
Wabuyela, watshela ubaba wakhe namama wakhe, watsi: "Ngibone eTimna umFilisti, indodakazi yenkhosi; namuhla niyifune kutsi ibe ngumkakhe."

Ubaba wakhe nendvodzakati yakhe batsi kuye: "Asekho yini indodana yakho, noma yinye yebantfu bakho bonke, kutsi uhambe ufike kulabaFilisti labangeke bacutjulwe, uthathe indodana?" Samsoni watsi kuyise: "Nceda uyinike, ngobe ilungile kimi."
Abazali bakhe babengazi kutsi lokhu kwakusuka kuSimakadze, watsi: "Uyafuna lilanga lokuhlasela labaFilisti;" ngobe ngaleso sikhathi labaFilisti bebengaba ngubaholi baSirayeli.
Samsoni waya eTimna nababa wakhe namama wakhe; bafika emavini eTimna, kwatsi lilanga lelincane lelibomvu lifike limuhlasela, lishaya.

Wafika umoya waSimakadze ku-Shamshoni, watsi: "Lakho nguNkulunkulu wakho!" Akazange atshele ubaba wakhe namama lakhe kutsi lakwenze yini, kodvwa wakhuluma kubo ngesandla sakhe sakhe, watsi: "Akufanele nikhulume nalo mkhwenyana.
Waphuma, wakhuluma naleyo ndoda, wamthanda kakhulu, watsi: "Ngubani lowo muntfu?
Kusukela lapho, lapho ebuyela khona kutsi abe ngumfazi wakhe, wajika waya kubona lenyama yengulube, yatsi: "Kule nyama ikhona umjovo wemakhowe kanye nemvubelo.
Waphuma, wakhipha ummbila ngesandla sakhe, wehla waya kuladla. Wafika emndenini wakhe, wabanikela nabo, bayawudla; kodvwa akazange abonise kubo kutsi umnikelo wekudla ubewusuka emlonyeni wema-leoni.
Ubaba wakhe wehla waya kubona lowesifazane, Samsone wahlela khona umcimbi, njengobe kwaba ngumthetho kubo bonkhe labancane.
Bafike bakubona, bakhetha lamadodana lamashumi lasitfupha kutsi abe ngumsebenti wakhe.
Wathi kubo Samsoni: "Ngitakusitshela incazelo yenkinga; uma ningicacisa ngalo lilanga lesitsatfu lekudla, ngitakunikela ngemigqomo etshumi lamashumi mathathu nempahla etshumi lamakhulu.

"Nase ningangicacisi, niyawuminikela ngetinsindza letimashumi lamakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamakhulu mahlanu, naletigqoko letimashumi lamakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamakhulu mane." Batsi: "Nceda usitshele incazelo yakho, siyikhulume.
Waphendvula watsi: "Ekudlani kwaphuma lokudliwayo, emandlani kwaphuma okumnandi." Bekungaba khona lilanga lesithathu labazange baphendule.

Kuye kube ngelilanga lesisikhombisa, batsi kundvodzakati ka-Samsoni: "Ncancisa umkakhe, angeke aticacise impendulo yenkinga; noma sitawukubulala wena nendlu yobaba wakho ngemlilo; ngabe utfumele nathi lapha kutsi usidlale?"

Watsi indodana ya-Samsoni ikhala phambi kwakhe, yatsi: "Wena ungeke ungithande; wena awufuni kutsi ngibe nawe. Ufike wanikela ngenkinga ebantwaneni bami, ngobe akazange anicacise." 13Aye watsi: "Ngisho nababa wami nemama yami angizange ndibatshele; yini lengingakusho kuwe?"
Wathi yena: "Ngitakhuluma yini naSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli?" Wayitsatsa imihla lesikhombisa yekudla lokunyenti, yatsi: "Ngitakhuluma yini naSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli?"

Kwatsi ngelilanga lesisikhombisa, lapho lilanga lelingene khona, lamadoda enhlokodolobha akhuluma kuye, watsi: "Ngubani lomnandi kunamakhowe? Ngubani lonamandla kunalelinyoni?" Samsoni watsi kubo: "Ngabe ningeke nihambe nengulube yami, ningazange nicacise incazelo yami."

UMoya waSimakadze wehla phezu kwakhe, waya e-Ashkeloni, wababulala lamadodana akhe lamashumi lasitfupha, wakhipha impahla yabo, wanikela ngemigqomo yabo kubo labavele bachaza incazelo yenkinga. Wabuyela ekhaya lakhe lobaba wakhe, waphuma ebuhlungu.
Umkakhe uSamsoni wafakwa kulowo owayengumfana wakhe, lowo abewube ngumfana wakhe.

Kwatsi, lapho kuhlanganiswa khona imbewu, Samsone wathatha umkhwenyana wengulube, waphuma waya endlwini yenkosi yakhe, watsi: "Ngiya kungena embhedeni wami," kodvwa ubaba wakhe akazange amvumele afike.
Wathi kuye: "Ngibe ngikholwa kutsi uyawuyifuna, ngobe ngayinikela kumfana wakho. Ngatsi: 'Inkosikazi yakhe lencane angeke ibe lihle kakhulu? Nceda uyithathe!'
Samsoni watsi kubo: "Ngaleso sikhathi ngingeke ngibe necala, uma ngibabulala labaFilisti."
Waphuma, wabulala tingulube lamakhulu lamabili nemashumi matatu; wawabopha emaphiko ngamaphiko, wababeka mlilo emphikweni lelinye nelinye.
Wamisa imikhaza, wakhipha tingulube emasimini lasemaFilisti, wabulala imithi yekudla kanye nemhlabatsi wembewu lehlala phansi, namahhashi e-olive.
Baphendvula batsi: "Shamshoni, umngane womfana waseTimna; ngobe wanikela indodana yakhe kumshado wakhe." Baphuma khona labaFilisti, babulala yena nobaba wakhe ngemlilo, kuze bafa.
Samsoni watsi kubo: "Ngekube nikwenze lokhu, ngingeke ngikhululeke kuze ngiye kumkhonta nine."
Wabahlasela, wabulala labaningi kubo, wehla waya ekungeneni kwesango lelise-Ethame, wahlala khona.
Bafike bamisa tindlu tabo eJudha, batsi: "Siyawufika eLehi."
Baphendvula batsi: "Ngubani na loyawufika emphilweni lethu?" Baphendvula batsi: "Siye saphuma kutsi sikhonze uSamsoni, kutsi sikwenze kuye njengobe yena akwentela nathi."

Batsi baphuma bantfu labamashumi lamane emadvodzana aJuda, bafika emgodini wemlilo waseEtam, batsi kuSamsoni: "Awazi yini kutsi labaFilisti balawula phezu kwethu? Uthini lokwenta nathi?" Waphendula watsi: "Ngibembisene nabo njengababenze kimi."
Batsi kuye: "Sifikile lapha kutsi sikukhonze, ukuze sikunike esandla salabaFilisti." Samsoni watsi: "Nceda ukhulume nami, ngobe ningamibulala nine."
Baphendvula batsi: "Siyavuma; siyawukubopha nje, sitawukunikela kubo, kepha asikubulalanga." Bawubopha ngemikhono lemibili emisha, bawukhipha emfuleni.

Wafika eLehi, wabona labaFilisti bephuma kuye beshaya ngamandla; khona-ke umphefumulo waSimakadze wehla phezu kwakhe, wabeka tintambo ezimilenzeni yakhe njengetinwele letibomvu, zaphuma emilenzeni yakhe.
Wathola imilenze yedoli, wayayikhipha, wabulala ngeyo amadoda lamakhulu lamabili.
Samsoni watsi: "Ngesifuba sema-asla, ngababeka njengema-asla; ngesifuba sema-asla, ngabulala amadoda lamakhulu lasitfupha."
Waphela lokukhuluma, wakhipha imilenze yakhe; ngobe kwatsi kubizwa igama lelinyenti laleso sikhala, Ramat-leki.
Watsi: "UNkulunkulu, wena lowunikela umkhonzi wakho ngalolukhulu lokusindisa; yini namanje ngizofa ngendlala, ngifike ngasesandlani sema-Israyeli angeke acweliswe?"
Simakadze wavula umfula waseLehi, amanzi aphuma kuwo. Samsone wadla, wabuyela emandlani akhe, waphila; ngobe kwashiwo igama lelifulegi: "En-Hakhore," likhona kuLehi kuze kufike manje.
USamsoni waba ngummeli waseSirayeli iminyaka lengema-20, ngelilanga leFilisti.
Wafika eGaza, wabona khona indodana yenkhosi, waphuma waya kuyo, wahlala naye.

Bakhuluma kubo bonkhe bantfu baseGaza, batsi: "Samsoni ukhona!" Bemcophelela khona, baphuma bewuhlala emnyango wenhloko-dolobha yonke lebusuku bonke, bakhala ekuseni nakusihlwa, besithi: "Lamuhla sitawumubulala."

Samsone wahlala khona kuze kube ngubusuku bemini. Waphuma, wabamba iminyango yemnyango wedolobha, nemiganga lemibili, wayisusa kanye nembhobho wayo, wababeka emilenzeni yakhe, wababeka phezulu emfuleni lobhekene neHebroni, watsi:
Watsi sekudlula sikhatsi lesidze, wathandana nenkhosi yaseSorekhi; igama lakhe lakunguDelila.

Bafike kuye labaholi beFilisti, batsi kuye: "Thina-ke, uma ungeke umkhonze kutsi akutshele ukuthi yini leyenza abe nemandla akhe amakhulu, nokuthi singeke siwukhulule kanjani, sithi: 'Sitawumubopha', ngobe angeke sikwazi ukumvikela; sitawukupa wena lomunye wethu ishekeli yesiliva elilodwa nelikhulu."
UDelila watsi ku-Samsoni: "Nceda, khuluma kimi kutsi yini leyenza kube nemandla akho amakhulu, nokuthi ubandlululwe kanjani, ukuze ukhululeke."
Samsone watsi kuye: "Uma umuntu engingatibopha ngetinsinyane letimhlophe lesithupha, tingeke zisicwe, khona-ke ngizoba nebuhlungu njengemuntu lomunye."
Bafike banikela kuyo lamadodana eFilisti ngemikhono lemincane leyisishiyagalombili, engakhuli, wayibopha yena ngayo.

Batsi laba bantu bafihla embhedeni, wakhuluma kuye watsi: "Samsoni, labaFilisti baya kuwe!" Wayisusa intambo yemphini yakhe, njengento lephuma emgodini uma ifika kumlilo. Ngako-ke umsebenti wakhe wemandla akazange ajasniwe.
Delila watsi ku-Samsoni: "Ungikhohlisa, ungisitsa; namuhla, ngiyakucela, khuluma kimi ngendlela longeke ubandlululwe ngayo."
Wati kuye: "Kungenjalo, uma umuntu engcolisa ngentambo lentsha, engasebenziswanga nhlobo, ngingeke ngikhululeke njengemuntfu lomunye."
UDelila watsi: "Samsoni, labaFilisti bafika kuwe!" Akazange asuse tintambo emlenzeni wakhe njengetinsindza. 20Watsi uSawula wathi ku-Abhisalomu: "Ngubani na lowo longeke abe ngunkhosi yakho?"

UDelila watsi kuSamsoni: "Namuhla ungeke ubandlulule ngami, ungeke ungikhohlise; khuluma-ke kutsi ungabandlululwa kanjani." Waphendvula watsi: "Uma ubeka tingulube takho letisikhombisa emlonyeni wakho, uyewubopha embhedeni wakho, uyawuwucindezela ngentambo, khona-ke ngizoba nebuhlungu njengemuntu ngamunye."
Watsi lapho ehlala khona, yamisa imilenze yakhe emlonyeni wakhe, yayibeka ngentambo, yatsi: "Samsoni, labaFilisti baya kuwe!" Wavuka waphuma embhedeni wakhe, wakhipha intambo kanye nemilenze yakhe.

Waye watsi kuye: "Ngubani lokusho kutsi, 'Ngikuthandela', lapho ungeke ukholwa kimi? Lolu busuku butawube ngumnyaka wesithathu lapho ungikhohlisa khona, ngobe awuzange ungicacisele indlela yemandla akho amakhulu."
Wahlala emangalisa ekuseni nakusihlwa, kuze kube wahlupheka kakhulu.

Wathi kuye: "Isibhakabhaka asizange sifike etindlebeni tami, ngobe sengumNaziri waNkulunkulu kusukela emhlabeni wami; uma sibhakabhaka tindlebe zami, mandla ami ayawuphuma kimi, ngibe ngumuntfu lomncane njengawo wonkejasni."

Dalilaya, lapho ebona khona ukuthi wakhuluma naye, wathumela kubo bonkhe bantfu labakhulu baseFilisti, watsi: "Nifike lapha lilanga lesibili, ngobe utshele ngako konke loku." Bafika khona labakhulu baseFilisti, babe nemali emhlane wabo.
Wamvusa, wamisa inhloko yakhe emlenzeni wakhe, wamshaya, watsi: "Cinga lomuntfu, ucwelise tingulube takhe letisikhombisa." Waqala ke kutsi ahambe naye, kodvwa amandla akhe ayawushiya.
Wathi kuye: "Samsoni, labaFilisti baya kuwe!" Waye wavuka embhedeni wakhe, watsi: "Ngizophuma ngasekuqaleni, ngize ngisasindise"; ngobe akazange aqonde ukuthi uSimakadze ubemshiya.
Bafike baphuma eGhazi, babeka emavi akhe emgodini wegolide, bakhipha emavi akhe emgodini wesiliva, babeka emavi akhe emgodini wegolide, babeka emavi akhe emgodini wensimbi.
Lakho inwele yakhe yenhloko yaqala kutsi ikhule kabusha, ngemuva kwekudlwengula.

Bahlangana khona labaphathi beFilisti, banikela ngemnikelo omkhulu ku-Dagon, loNkulunkulu wabo, nekudla lokumnandi; ngobe batsi: "Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wethu, utawunikela nguSamsoni, umfowabo, esandla sethu.
Bafike bakubona, babonga lonkulunkulu babo, batsi: "LoNkulunkulu wethu utawunikela esandla sethu umfowabo, lowo wabulala ilizwe lethu kanye nabo bonkhe labaholi bethu.
Batsi bafike bevumile, batsi: "Thwebulani uSamsoni kutsi ajabulise kubo." Bamukhipha emgodini wamaphoyisa, wadlala nabo; bambeka phakathi kwemiganga.
USamsoni watsi kulowo mfana loyawumphatha ngesandla: "Nceda, khiphani kutsi ngifike ngizibone tikhontsi letisebentisa indlu, ngize ngiyibambe."
Lendlu yabe igcwele amadoda nabesifazane, nabo bonke bobukhosi beFilisti babekhona; kwabekho nalabasesitezi, labafana nemakhulu amathathu lamadoda namakhosikazi, bebona Samsoni edlala.

Samsone wathandaza kuSimakadze, watsi: "Nkulunkulu, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, khumbulani ngami; ngiyakucela, uThixo, nginike amandla lomnyaka munye kuphela, ukuze ngibuyele emaFilisti ngemehlo ami lasitfupha.
USamsoni wehlisa isandla sakhe sakwesokudla, wabeka ngesandla sakhe sokudla esinye semfuleni, nesandla sakhe sokudla esinye emfuleni, watsi: "Ngubani na lowo muntfu?

Watsi Samsoni: "Lapha ngizofa kanye nalabaFilisti." Waye washaya ngemandla akhe, wahlasela indlu yaSimakadze, yawela phezu kwabaholi nebantfu bonke labakhona. Wabulala abantu abaningi emshadweni wakhe kunalabo abewabulala ephilayo.

Baphuma bazalwane bakhe, nendlu yonke yababa wakhe, bayawukhipha, bawufaka emgodini waManawoyi, ubaba wakhe, phakathi kweSora ne-Eshtaoli; Samsoni waba ngummeli waseSirayeli iminyaka lemashumi lamabili.
Kubekhona umfana, wahlala emhlabatsini waseEfrayim, lokuthiwa nguMika.

Watsi emama akhe: "Umntu uthathe kusuka kuwe isiliva lama-1, nami ngakulalela utibhalele lowo mkhweli; ngiyabona legolide likhona, ngiyitfumele." Emama wakhe waphendvula watsi: "UNkulunkulu akubumbise wena, umngane wami!"

Wayibuyisela emashekeli esiliva lamakhulu lamabili nemashumi lasitfupha emnene wakhe. Umnu wakhe watsi: "Lemali ngiyinikela kuSimakadze, umngane wami, kutsi abe ngumnikelo wekushiswa, umnikelo wesilivere; namuhla ngiyakuyisa kuwe."

Wayibuyisela ema-shekeli lamakhulu mahlanu emnu wakhe, wabeka ema-shekeli lamakhulu lamashumi lamabili egolide kulowo lokhipha isiliva, watsi: "Njengomfana lowo, ngenza ngeleyo golide inhlamvu yegolide," yafakwa endlini kaMika.
UMika waba nethempeli lelikhulu, wakhipha i-ephod neterebhisi, wamisa lomunye wemadvodzana akhe kutsi abe ngumLevi.
Ngaleso sikhathi angeke kubekho inkhosi ku-Israyeli; wonke umuntu wakwenza lokuhle emehlo akhe.
Kube khona umfana waseLevi lohlala khona eBethlehem-ye-Juda, emndenini wa-Juda.
Waphuma eBethlehem-eJuda, wafuna kutsi ahlale khona; wafika endlini kaMikha, emhlabatsini waseEfremu, lapho abehamba khona.
UMika watsi kuye: "Uvelaphi?" Waphendvula watsi: "Ngiye eLevi, ngasuka eBethlehem yaseYuda, ngifuna kutsi ngihlale khona."
Watsi kuye Mika: "Dla nami, ube ngubaba wami, ube ngumLevi; ngitakunikela ngeshekeli letilishumi tesiliva lomnyaka munye, nempahla yakho kanye nekudla kwakho." LoLevi wafika.
LoLevi wavuma kutsi ahlale naye; lomuntfu loncane waba njengemunye wemadvodza lakhe.
UMika wehlisele loLevi, wabeka lowo mshado abe ngumnikelo wakhe wesono, wahlala ekhaya lakhe.
UMika watsi: "Ngokumanje ngiyazi kutsi uSimakadze uzongilungisa, ngobe loLevi ungumnikelo wami wesono."

Ngaleso sikhathi kwabe sekungabakho ukumkani eSirayeli; ngaleso sikhathi isizwe sakwaDani safuna indawo lapho singahlala khona, ngobe asingazange sithole inhlanganiso yaso phakathi nemindeni yeSirayeli.

Lamadodana eDani athumela lamadodana abo, amadoda lamakhulu lamabili nesihlanu, anamandla amakhulu, kusuka eSora nase-Eshtaoli, ukuba ahlolisise lelizwe, nakulo; batsi kubo: "Niya nihlolisise leli lizwe." Bafika emadolobheni asogwini lwa-Efraim, bahlala endlini kaMika.
Bafike bafika endlwini kaMika, bahlangana nendlebe yemuntfu lomncane waseLevi, bafike bambuza bati, "Ubani lowutfumele lapha? Uyini umsebenzi wakho kulo mhlaba? Yini leyawukwenza lapha?"
Wakhuluma kubo kutsi yini leMikaya abeyenze kuye, watsi: "Ungikhokhele, ngibe ngumnikelo wakhe."
Batsi kuye: "Nceda usibuze kuNkulunkulu kutsi ngabe uhambo lwethu luyawuphumelela yini."
Umnikelo wekushiswa wabaphendvula watsi: "Hambani nikhululeke; Simakadze ubheke indlela yenu."

Lamadoda lamane asuka, wafika eLayishi, wababona labaseLayishi behlala bephephile, ngendlela yalabaSidoni, bekhululeke, bekhululekile, benezinto zabo zonke, bengenaso nasinye sifo; bahlala eduze kwalabaSidoni, bangeke babe nebudlelwane nanoma ngubani.
Bafike babuyela eSora ne-Eshtaoli, labazalwane babo bababuza batsi: "Nifuna yini?"
Baphendvula batsi: "Thumelani, siyawuhlasela; sesikubone lelilizwe, nalo lihle kakhulu. Yini natsi nihlala khona? Ungabi nenkinga, phuma niyithathe lelizwe.
Uma ufike khona, utawuthola bantfu labangeke bacabange lutho; nemhlaba ubanzi, ngobe Nkulunkulu wawunikela ngesandla sakho, umhlaba wezinto tonkhe letifunako.
Baphuma basuka eSora ne-Eshtaoli, lamadoda langamakhulu lamabili namane asesukuni leDani, alungiselelwe kulwa.
Bahamba besuka eKirihati-Yearim, lakubo Yuda, bamisa tindlu tabo; ngobe ligama lelinye lelisemaphandleni eKirihati-Yearim litsi Mahane-Dan, kuze kube manje.
Besuka khona bahamba befika emhlabatsini waseEfraim, bafike endlwini kaMika.

Batsi lamadoda lasihlanu abehlele ilizwe leLayishi, bakhuluma kulabo bazalwane babo, batsi: "Niyazi kutsi esinye sezindlu letinjalo sine-ephod, neterebhisi, nesitayela lesicwebezelayo segolide; cabangani kutsi ningeke nikwenze yini?
Basuka khona, bafika endlwini yemuntfu lomncane weLevi, lapho behlala khona Mika, bamphatsa.
Lamadoda langamakhulu lamane eDani, alungiselelwe kulwa, ahlala emgwaqeni wemnyango.

Lamadoda lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu ayawufika, awona lemhlaba, wabeka khona i-idoli, ne-ephod, namatitshala; kodvwa umnikelo wesono wahlala ekungeneni kwesango kanye nalabalishumi elinamakhulu lamane abenesibhakabhaka.
Bafike bafika endlwini ka-Mika, batsi: "Nini niyawukwenza?" 23Batsi: "Sitawukhipha igolide, nesiliva, negolide lelihlanganisiwe, negolide lelihlanganiswe negolide."

Baphendvula batsi: "Cinga, ungasho lutho; hlangana nathi, ube ngubaba wethu kanye nomnikelo wesono. Akunakuhle yini kuwe ukuba umnikelo wesono emndenini nemindenini yaseSirayeli, kunokuba ube ngumnikelo wesono emndenini womntu oyedwa?"
Umnikelo wekushiswa wawucebile kakhulu, waba ne-ephod, nama-teraphim, naleyo mifanekiso leyimfihlakalo, waphuma waya ebantwini.
Babuyela, basuka, babeka bantfwana babo, nemfuyo yabo kanye nempahla yabo phambi kwabo.
Bafike badlula emnyango wendlu ka-Mika, bahlangana lamadoda ahlala eduze kwendlu ka-Mika, wafika waya kulabo bantfu bakaDani.
Batsi batsi: "Kuphi naloko lokungekuhle lokwentako, kutsi ufike ube ngumuntfu waSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli?"
Waphendvula watsi: "Lama-Israyeli, niyawuthatha lamandla ami, nakubabusi bam, niyahamba; yini lemihlala khona? Ngabe ukhuluma kutsi, 'Kunikwe yini kuwe?'"
Batsi kubo lamadodana eDani: "Ungabi nenkinga nathi, ungase uhlaselwe ngalabo bantu labacoshayo, wena kanye nendlu yakho niphele."
Lamadoda eDani ahamba ngendlela yabo; kodvwa Mika, lapho ebona kutsi lamakhulu kunaye, wabuyela waya ekhaya lakhe.

Bathi, "Lento leMikaya ayenze nayo, kanye nomnikelo wakhe wesono, bafike eLayishi, kulabo bantu labakhululeke kakhulu, abazange bacinge lutho; bababulala ngesandla sekhephu, bamisa ledolobha limlilo."
Akukho lowo loyawubasiza, ngobe bebengaseSidoni, bahlala emadolobheni lasentshonalanga yeBet-Rehobothi; kodvwa labaDani bawubambisa, bahlala khona.
Batsi: "Dani" ngegama laDani, loyise wabo, lomnyaka wa-Isirayeli; kodvwa ngaphambilini igama ledolobha lakunguLayish.

Bafike babeka khona igolide, nesiliva, negolide lelihlanganisiwe, kanye negolide elihlanganiswe negolide, laba ngu-Yonathani, umsa kaGershoni, unyana kaMosi, naye kanye nabobana bakhe babe ngabaLevi baseDani, kuze kube yilapho lelilizwe liboshwa khona.
Bahamba nabo, behlala ethempelini lelihlelwe nguMikaya, liseSilo, lilanga lonke lapho indlu yaSimakadze ikhona khona.
Ngaleso sikhathi, lapho kungakabikho ubukhosi eSirayeli, kwafika umLevi lohlala emadolobheni lasentshonalanga yemhlabatsini waEfremu, waba nenkosikazi yesibili yaseBethelehemu yeYuda.
Yaye yaphuma kuye, yabuyela ekhaya lababa bakhe eBethlehem-eJuda. Yahlala khona iminyaka lemine.

Waye waya kuyo umkakhe, wakhuluma naye ngekuthula, watsi: "Thina-ke siyawubuyela kuwe." Wathatha nalowo mkhonzi wakhe kanye nedlovukazi lembili, wayifaka endlwini yobaba wakhe; lapho ubaba wakhe ekubona khona, wabamukela.
Ubaba wakhe-ke, loyise wesifazane, watsi kuye kutsi ahlale naye. Wahlala naye iminyaka lemithathu, edla nekudla, edla nekudla, wahlala khona.
Ngelilanga lesine bavuka ekuseni, waphuma ehamba; kodvwa utata wendvodzakati yalowo watsi kumyeni wakhe: "Thintsi udle, bese ukhululeka; emva kwalokho uyahamba."
Bahlala bedla nekudla kanye, baphuza nabo; watsi ubaba wendvodzakati yakhe: "Nceda, phumula ngalobusuku, bese ukhululeka."
Lomuntfu waphuma kutsi ahambe, kodvwa umyeni wakhe wamletsa kutsi ahlale khona; ngobe waba khona naleyo busuku.
Kulelo langa lisihlanu, wavuka emini ahambe; kodvwa uyise wendvodzakati yakhe watsi kuye: "Thintela ukudla, bese uhlala khona kuze kube sebusuku." Badla nabo bobabili kanye.

Waphuma lomuntfu, naye umkhwenyana wakhe, nalowo mkhonzi wakhe, kutsi ahambe. Loyise-ke, ubaba wendvodzakati yakhe, watsi kuye: "Bonani, kungakapheli busuku; hlala lapha, ngiyakucela, phumula, ngobe usuku luphelelwe lixesha; hlala ukhululeke, bese uvuka uhambe ekhaya lakho."
Lomuntu akazange avumeleke ukuba ahlale ekuseni, waphuma, waya eJebhusi (leyo yiJerusalema), naye nalowo mkhwenyana wakhe, kanye nalabo bobabili bamasinyane akhe.
Bafike bafika eJebuse, lilanga lafika liphelile. Watsi umkhonzi kunkhosi yakhe: "Thiba, sihlale lapha emzini wema-Jebusi, siphumule ebusuku."
Wati kuye umphathi wakhe: "Kungeke kube njalo, ngobe siyawufika emzini webantfu labangaphandle, lapho bangabakho bantfu baseSirayeli; sitawuhamba siye eGibeha."
Watsi: "Thinga, sifike eGibeha noma eRama, sihlale khona ekuseni."
Bahamba, bafika eGibeha, eBenjamini, lapho lilanga lalisa khona.
Bahlala khona eGibeha; bafike behlala emgwaqeni wedolobha, ngobe angeke kubekho umuntu loyawubamukela ekhaya kutsi bahlale khona.
Kwafika ebusuku, waphuma emsebenzini wakhe emhlabatsini, umfana omdala waseGibeha; waba ngumuntfu lovela ezweni lelingu-Efrayim, lahlala eGibeha; bantfu baleyo ndawo bebengabe nguBenjamini.
Watsi lapho ebheka khona, wabona umkhwenyana enhliziyweni yedolobha. Waphendvula watsi: "Uyaphi? Uvela phi?"

Wathi kuye: "Sihamba sisuka eBethlehem-eJuda, safika emaphandleni asentshonalanga emhlabatsini waseEfraim; ngihlala khona; ngaya eBethlehem-eJudha, kodwa manje sengiya endlini kaSimakadze. Akukho mntu loyawungikhipha ekhaya lakhe.
Sinesidvondza kanye nekudla emabhubesi ethu, sinekudla kanye newayini nathi, nami, nalowo mkhonzi wakho, nalowo mntwana lohamba nathi; asifuni lutho.
"Uyakwamukela ekhaya lami," watsi umtfubi. "Laba ngikulungiselele noma yini lekufanele uyenze, kepha ungahlala busuku bonke esiteji."
Wayemfaka endlwini yakhe, wanikela ngekudla ema-asli akhe; bahlamba tinyawo tabo, badla nekudla, baphuza namanzi.

Baye baphumula, kwafika lamadoda asenta lokubi enhlokodolobha, abambe indlu, ahlasele imnyango, waphendvula lowesifazane, umnikazi wendlu, watsi: "Thumela ngaphandle lowo mfana lofike ekhaya lakho, kutsi sihambe naye."
Waphuma umnikazi wendlu, wabatshela kutsi: "Kungeke kube njalo, bazalwane bami; ningabi nalutho lokubi, ngobe lomuntu uhlala nami; ungase ukwenze lento ebuhlungu.
"Lamuhla ngitawubakhipha lapha kuwe; uphindze ubandlulule kubo, wenze nabo kutsi kukuhle emehlo akho; kepha lomuntu angeke abe nenkinga lenjalo."
Lamadoda akazange amkhonze, ngobe loLevi abewuthatha umkhwenyana wakhe, waphuma waya kubo; bayawudlalwa naye, bayawudlalwa naye yonke lebusuku, kuze kube ekuseni, bayawuyisa.
Wafika lowesifazane endluni lapho umnikazi wakhe abehlala khona, waphuma ekuseni, wehla emnyango, wahlala khona kuze kube lilanga.
Waphuma umnikazi wayo emini, wavula imnyango wendlu kutsi ahambe ngendlela yakhe, watsi: "Asekho lowesifazane wakhe, ufile emgwaqeni, nesandla sakhe esiphelweni semgwaqeni.
Wathi kuye: "Thinda, sihambe." Akazange aphendule; wamisa yena phezu kwedoli lakhe, waphuma waya ekhaya.
Wafika ekhaya lakhe, wathatha isandla sakhe, wehlisa inhloko yakhe ibe ingxenye lelishumi nembili, ayisalela kuwo wonke lamadolobha ase-Isirayeli.
Bathi bonke labakubonayo, lomunye kulowo: "Kungeke kube kubonakala noma kwenzeke lokhu kusukela ngelilanga labaSirayeli bephuma eMfuleni we-Egipta; sifike senze yini? Sikhulume!"
Baphuma bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli, besuka eDani kuya eBeer-sheba, kanye nelizwe leGileyadi, bahlangana nabo bonke bahlala ndawonye, njengendlu eyodwa, kuSimakadze eMizpa.
Batsi bafike bomkhuluwa babo, bonke labaholi bemindeni yemadvodzana a-Israyeli, engqungqutheleni lelikhulu nemakhulu lamane, labahamba ngenyawo, labakhipha isandla.
Lamadvodza laBenjamini akubona kutsi bantfu beSirayeli bafike eMizpa, watsi kubo: "Nceda usitshele ukuthi kwenzeke yini lesi simo esibi.
LoLevi, umfazi walendvodza leyawufa, waphendula watsi: "Ngifike eGibeha leBenjamini, nginenkosikazi yami, kutsi sihlale khona.
Bami baseGibeha baphuma bemile ngemuva kwami ngasebusuku, babambe indlu ngesandla sabo, bengibulala; nenkosikazi yami yasemaphandleni bayidlwengula, wafa.
Nakho-ke, ngayikhipha, ngayicubha, ngayithumela kuwo wonke lamadolobha aseSirayeli; ngobe bakwenze lokudla lokubi nelokungalungile eSirayeli.
Namuhla, khuluma nitsi, bonkhe bantfu beSirayeli, ningati kutsi yini lokutsile.
Batsi: "Akukho mntu laphuma endlwini yakhe, noma ubuyela ekhaya lakhe, ngobe Simakadze Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli utawutsi: 'Lakho likhaya lami.'
Lokho singeke sikwenze kuGibeha; sitawuya kuyo, njengobe kutsiwe ngusondza.

Sizothatha amadoda lamakhulu lamashumi lalishumi kuwo wonke lamakhosi aseSirayeli, namakhulu lamakhulu kumakhulu lamakhulu, namakhulu kumakhulu lamakhulu lamakhulu, kutsi abe ngumnikelo wesono ema-Israyeli; bese befika ema-Israyeli eGibeha eBenjamini, bafike babuyele kuyo yonke inkohliso leyenziwe eSirayeli.
Bahlangana bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli, bahlanganisana behlasela ledolobha, bahlangene njengemuntfu lomunye.
LaseSirayeli lathumela amadoda kuwo wonke lomndeni waBenjamini, besithi: "Ngubani na lowo monakalo omkhulu lowenziwe phakathi kwenu?
Namuhla, nikelani nalaba bantu lababi baseGibeha, sitawubabulala, sisuse lokubi eSirayeli.' Kodwa lamadodana aBhenjamini akazange abone umnikelo wabo wesono ema-Israyeli.
Baphuma emabhishi abo, bahlangana eGibeha, bahlasela bantfu baka-Israyeli.

Lamadoda eBhenjamini ahlangana ngalolo lilanga lasuka emizini yabo, abesilisa labamashumi lamabili nesihlanu lamaholidi, labo basabela ngesandla, kanye nalabahlali baseGibeha, amadoda angamakhulu ayisithupha.
Kulabo bonkhe labahlaseli kwabekhona amadoda lamakhulu lamabili nesikhombisa, abekwa sandla sasekhohlo; kuwo wonke lomunye walaba angeke abe nenkinga uma eshaya ngetinti.
Bekungaba nguBenjamini kuphela, labaSirayeli bahlanganisa lamashumi lamakhulu mane lamawaka ema-Amori abengenasibhakabhaka; labo bonke bebengabatshaba.
Bafike eBheteli, babuza Simakadze, batsi: "Nguwuphi loyawuhamba kuqala phakathi kwethu kutsi ahlasele lamadodana kaBenjamini?" Nkulunkulu watsi: "UJuda utawuhamba kuqala."
Baphuma ekuseni, bantfu beSirayeli bamisa tindlu tabo eGibeha.
Lamadoda eSirayeli aphuma ekulwa nemadvodzana aBenjamini, wabeka sikhundla sokulwa nabo eGibeha.
Lamadvodza laBenjamini aphuma eGibeha, wabulala naleso sikhatsi ema-Israyeli lamaphesenti angamashumi lamabili nesihlanu emgwaqeni.
Lamadoda eSirayeli, aphindze aphinde abe khona lapho ayehlala khona lilanga lokuqala, layawutsi: "Kunemsebenti lomkhulu kakhulu lokumele siwusebenze.
Baye baphuma, bathandaza phambi kwaSimakadze kuze kube sebusuku, babuza Simakadze, batsi: "Sizobuyela yini emphilweni namakhosikazi aBenjamini, labangane bami?" Nkulunkulu watsi kubo: "Niya nabo."
Befika bantfu beSirayeli ngelilanga lesibili, bahlasela Benjamini.
Lamadoda eBhenjamini aphuma eGibeha, ahlangana nabo, wabulala ema-Isirayeli lamakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamane, labo bonke babenesicwebezela.

Bafike bonke bantfu baseSirayeli, imindeni yabo yonke, bafika eBetheleli, bahlala khona bekhala phambi kuSimakadze, baphumula ngalolusuku kuze kube sebusuku, banikela ngenhlanhla ngeminikelo yekushiswa neyekuthula kuSimakadze.
Lamadvodza aseSirayeli akhuluma kuSimakadze, watsi: "Ngubani loyawukwenza?" Ngaleso sikhathi ibhokisi lesivumelwane saNkulunkulu lakungulapho.

Phinehasi, umsa wa-Eleazari, unyana wa-Aron, abehlala phambi kwayo. Batsi: "Sizobuyela yini kutsi sihlangabeze nabangane bami, bantfu bakaBenjamini, noma siyawushiya?" USimakadze watsi: "Suka; ngobe ngekusasa ngitawubanikela esandla sakho."
Amakhosi ase-Israyeli aphindze abeka bantfu baseGibeha, kutsi baphike.
Bafike bahlasela bantfu be-Benjamini ngelilanga lesithathu, bamisa emphinjeni yeGibeha, njengobe babeyenze ngaphambili.

Lamadoda eBhenjamini aphuma abophelela kubo, latiwa emgwaqeni; baqalisa kubulala emaSirayeli, njengaleso sikhathi sangaphambilini, emhlabatsini kanye neendlela, isinye sihamba eBetheleli, nesinye sihamba eGibeha, amadoda angabamashumi amathathu.
Lamadoda aBenjamini athi: "Siyawubabulala njengaleso sikhathi sangaphambilini." Lamadoda eSirayeli ati: "Thintsi sihambe, sitawuwasusa emigwaqeni lemikhulu.
Baphuma bonke bantfu baseSirayeli emaphandleni abo, bahlala eBaali-Tamari; kodvwa lamadoda aseSirayeli afike aphuma emaphandleni abo eGibheya.
Bafika eGibeha lamakhulu lamabili ema-Israyeli akhethiwe; kulwa kwabe kunzima kakhulu, kodvwa amadoda eBenjamini akazange aqaphele kutsi indlala yafike.

USimakadze wehlisa uBhenjamini phambi kwa-Israyeli, ngobe lamadodana e-Israyeli abulala kuBenjamini ngalolusuku lamawaka lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu namakhulu lalishumi; labo bonke babengenaso isigwebo.
Lamadoda eBhenjamini akubona kutsi aboshwa, ngobe lamakhosi aseSirayeli abewushiya umkhosi weBhenjamini; ngobe lamakhosi aseSirayeli abewanikela kubo bonkhe bantfu labebafihla eGiba.
Bafike bafika eGibeha, baphikisa, babulala bonke labaseGibeha ngesandla sekhephu, nabo bonkhe labaseGibeha.
Lamadoda eSirayeli afike abe nesivumelwano nalabo labafile, kutsi bafake umphunga lomkhulu wemlilo emzini wabo njengephawu.
Lamadoda eSirayeli abuyela emuva emkhosini, lamakhosi aseBhenjamini abeqala kuhlasela lamadoda eSirayeli amalunga namakhulu lamashumi lasitfupha; ngobe besithi: "Siyawuwabulala njengalempi yokuqala."
Batsi baphuma eBhetani, babuyela emuva, batsi: "Lemijikelo yemlilo lesuka kulo mjikelo ihamba iye entabeni."
Lamadoda eSirayeli abuyela kubo; lamadoda eBhenjamini ahlaselwa ngumlilo, ngobe babone kutsi indlala yafika kubo.
Baphuma babaleka phambi kwaSirayeli, besuka eGibhithe, bafika eGibhithe; kodvwa labaphuma emizini yabo, babulawa khona nguSirayeli.
Bewabamba lamadodana eBenjamini, bayawuphazamisa, babulala emabhishobhi abo emgwaqeni waseGibeha.
Baphuma eBhenjamini labalishumi linamihlanu lamakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamane, bonkhe bantfu labakhulu.

Labanye babuyela, babaleka besuka eGibhithe, befika emfuleni iRimoni; kodvwa labaSirayeli babulala ema-Israyeli lamakhulu mahlanu emigwaqeni, bayawuwalandela kuze kuGidomi, babulala ema-Israyeli lamakhulu lamabili.
Ngako-ke bonkhe bantfu beBenjamini labafa ngalolusuku bangamaphesenti lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu abengenasikhephu; labo bonke babemadoda amakhulu.
Lamadoda langamakhulu lamane abuye, wabaleka waya efulethini lelikude, wafika entaba ta-Rimoni, wahlala khona emaviki amane.
Baye babuyela ezweni laBenjamini, babulala yonke lemishado ngesandla saso, nalabo bantu kanye nenyama, nabo bonke labo babekhona; nabo bonkhe bantfu lababa khona, babeka phansi ngemlilo.
Lamadoda eSirayeli abeke mnikelo wekushiswa eMizpa, watsi: "Akukho mntu latawunikela ngendvodzakati yakhe kuBenjamini."
Baye bafika eBheteli, bahlala khona phambi kwaNkulunkulu kuze kube sebusuku, belingisa ngelizwi elikhulu nelimfishane.
Batsi: "Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, yini lekwentako ema-Israyeli? Kungani kutsi lihlanga linye liphele e-Israyeli namuhla?"
Basuka baphuma ekuseni, basungula khona ithempeli, banikela khona ngemnikelo wekushiswa nemnikelo wesono.

Batsi: "Nguwuphi longakafika engqungqutheleni lengcwele phambi kuSimakadze, kusuka kuwo wonke lamakhosikazi aseSirayeli?" Bebebeke isinqumo sokuba lowo longeke afike phambi kuSimakadze eMizpa, abulawa.
Lamadvodza ase-Israyeli ahlupheka kakhulu ngemadvodzana akhe, lamakhosikazi eBenjamini, watsi: "Namuhla lihlanga lelinye liphelelwe ngu-Israyeli."
Ngabe sitawubanikela kanjani bobabili labashiwo, kutsi bafike babe nemakhosikazi? Ngako-ke sesivumile kuSimakadze kutsi asitawubanika amadodana ethu abesifazane."
Baphendvula batsi: "Nguwuphi lomunye wemindeni yeSirayeli longeke afike kuSimakadze eMizpa?" Bebona kutsi akukho mntu waseJabheshi-gileyadi abengafika emgwaqeni ukuhlangana.
Babala bantfu, babona kutsi angeke kube khona namunye webantfu baseJabheshi-gileyadi.
Batsi: "Thina-ke siyawufika eJabhesi-Gileyadi, sitawubulala ngesandla sawo wonke lahlala khona, kanye nebesifazane nalabancane."
Batsi: "Lena yindlela loyawuyenza ngayo, ubulala wonke umfana kanye nendvodza leyayidla nemuntu."
Bathola emaJabhesi eGileyadi, emabhishobhi lamakhulu mane, angeke abe nendodana, bayawubeka emgwaqeni eShilo, emhlaba waseKanana.
Lamadvodza layawufika eRimoni, akhuluma nabo, watsi kubo: "Lamadodana aBenjamini, hlalani lapha eRimoni.
Lamadoda eBenjamini ayawubuyela ngaleso sikhathi, wabanika lamakhosikazi aseJabhesi-Gileyadi, labo labashiwo; kodvwa akazange abonise kubo bonke.
Labantfu bahlupheka kakhulu ngenxa yaBenjamini, ngobe Simakadze abewushiya umgodzi emindenini yeSirayeli.
Batsi bomkhuluwa bebandla: "Lamadodana laBenjamini abulawe; bangaba yini nabesifazane labashiwo, kutsi bafike babe nemakhosikazi?
Batsi: "Labo abaseBenjamini kumele babe nenkhosi, kutsi kungeke kuphele imindeni yeSirayeli esinye.
Singeke sitawubanikela ngemadvodzana ethu abemakhosikazi, ngobe lamadodana eSirayeli amemetele kutsi: "Kulahleke lowo lonika indodana yakhe uBenjamini."
Kutsi, bona, kuyawube nemnyaka lomusha waSimakadze eSilo, enyakatho yeBheteli, ngasentshonalanga yendlela lesuka eBetheli ifike eShekhemi, nasenshonalanga yeLebona.
Batsi kubo-Benjamini: "Niya, nifihlele emavinini.
Nifike nibone, bese kubona kutsi lamadodakazi eShilo aphuma ekudlaleni, nisuka emivini, nithatheni nalowo nalowo indodana yenkhosi yaseShilo, niye ezweni laseBhenjamini.

""""""""""""""""""""""""""""""""""""""""""""""""""""""""jasni babo, noma labazalwane babo, bafike bekhuluma nathi, sitawutsi: 'Nceda, niyawubambisana nabo ngenxa yethu; ngobe asizange sesivulele kubo amadoda emkhosini, futhi ningawanikela kubo izingane zenu.
Lamadodana eBenjamini akazange akwenze njalo, kodvwa wakhipha lamakhosikazi ema-Amori, nalowo waseBhenjamini waba nenkosi yakhe. Baye babuyela ezweni labo, basungula imijikelo yabo, bahlala kuyo.
BaLevi basuka khona, batsi: "Siyawubuyela ezweni lelihlelwe nguSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli nawase-Israyeli."
Ngaleso sikhathi angeke kubekho inkhosi ku-Israyeli; wonke umuntu wakwenza lokuhle emehlo akhe.
Ruth: Ezikhathini lapho labaholi beSirayeli behlala khona, kwaba nendlala ezweni. Wahamba lowo muntu waseBethlehem-ye-Juda, wasuka waya emaphandleni eMoabi, wahlala khona naye nemkakhe nabantwana bakhe bobabili.

Igama lomuntfu bekungu-Elimeleki, negama lendvodzakati yakhe belinguNaomi, namagama labantwana bakhe bobabili bekunguMahloni naKilioni; babeyiEfrathi baseBethlehem yaseYuda; bafike ezweni laseMowabi, bahlala khona.
Elimeleki, lowesifazane wa-Naomi, wafa, wayishiya yena nemadvodzana akhe lamabili.
Bahlala khona iminyaka lengema-10. 24Bafike bahlangana nemadvodzana aMowabi, lababizwa ngeOrfa naRuthi; lamadodana abo ayefana nabo.
Bobabili, Mahloni naKilioni, bafa; Naomi wahlala ngaphandle kwemadvodzana akhe lamibili kanye nomkakhe.
Naomi waphuma, waya eMoabi, watsi: "Simakadze ufike wabasindise bantfu bakhe ngekudla;" ngobe wayehlala ema-Moabhi. Waye abuyela ekhaya lakhe yena nemadvodzana akhe.
Waphuma khona lapho abehlala khona, yena nemadvodzana akhe lamibili kanye naye, wabuyela ezweni laseYuda.
Naomi waphendvula watsi: "Niya, nibuye niye ekhaya lenkosi yenu; Simakadze akwenzeni kube lulala, njengobe nililela lamadodana enu lamafile kanye nami.
Simakadze utawukunikani lokuphumula, lomunye nalowo emndenini wakhe.' Wabaphola, wabashiya, baphuma bekhala ngemandla.
watsi kuye: "Siyawubuyela nawe kubo bonkhe bantfu bakho."
Naomi watsi: "Thumelani, izingane zami; kungani niyawuhamba nami? Ingabe ngitawuba nemfana wesibili longeke abe ngumfazi wenu?
Niya, bantfwana bami, ngobe sengikhulu kakhulu kutsi ngibe ngumkakhe. Nakuba sengicabanga kutsi nginethemba, nakuba sengibe nomkakhe ngalolusuku, nakuba ngazala lamadvodza,
yini na? Ungeke uhlale uhamba nabo, kuze bakhule? Ngabe ungeke uhambe nawe kubo? Hayi, izingane zami! Injabulo yami ikhulu kakhulu kunenu, ngobe isandla saSimakadze sifike kum."
Baphinde batsatsa imvubelo yabo, Orpa wamisa umkakhe-ke, watsi: "Ndzakushiya; kodvwa Ruthe uhlala naye."
Naomi yatsi: "Bona, inkosi yakho ibuyela kubo bonkhe bantfu bayo kanye naNkulunkulu wayo; buye ulandele inkosi yakho."

Ruthi waphendula watsi: "Ungabe ungisitshela ukuthi ngikushiye, ngibuye ngakho; ngobe lapho uhamba khona ngiya khona, nalapho uhlala khona ngihlala khona; abantu bakho bangaba bantu bami, Nkulunkulu wakho uNkulunkulu wami.
Nalapho ufa khona, ngitafa khona, nalapho ngingafunwa khona; Simakadze akwenze njalo-ke, anikwe kanye, noma yini leyawumisa mina nawe ngaphandle kwekufa.
Naomi, lapho ebona kutsi uRute uzimisele kuyawuhamba naye, wayeka ukumtsatsa.
Bahamba bafike eBethlehem. Befika lapho, lomhlaba wonke wawudlwengula ngenxa yabo; labesifazane batsi: "Ngabe lo nguNaomi lowo?"
Yatsi kubo: "Ungaba ngitsi na Naomi, kepha ngitsi Mara; ngobe lowo Mtfubi ungibeke ebuhlungu kakhulu.
Ngaphuma ngigcwele, kodvwa Simakadze ungibuyisele sengamtfubi; yini lemibiza ngokuthi nguNaomi? ngobe Simakadze ukhuluma ngami, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli unenkinga nami.
Ngako Naomi wabuyela eMoabi, naye naRuthi inkhosi yakhe yaseMoabi; bafike eBethlehem ekuqalekeni kwemnyaka walesihlwatsi sejubane.
Naomi yabe inemuntfu lofana nenkosikazi yakhe, lokuthiwa nguBowazi; lomuntfu waNkulunkulu waba ngummeli wemndeni wakwa-Elimeleki.
Watsi Ruthi, iMoabitha, kuNaomi: "Nceda uvumele ngihambe etentini, ngifike ngisakhulise emajikijolo ngemuva komfana loyawungihlonipha." Naomi watsi kuye: "Hamba, mntwana wami!"
Waye, waphuma emhlabatsini, waphuma emhlabatsini ngemuva kwalabo labavuna; wafika emhlabatsini leliboshwe nguBowazi, lowasemndenini ka-Elimeleki.
Batsi uBhoazi wafika eBethlehem, watsi kulabo labavuna: "UNkulunkulu abe nani!" Baphendvula batsi: "Nkulunkulu ubambisene nabo!"
Boazi watsi kumphathi wakhe, watsi: "Ngubani lowesifazane lowo?"
Lomuntfu watsi kuye: "Iyindvodzakati yaMoabi, leyawubuyela neNaomi kusuka eMoabi.

watsi: 'Nceda, vumelani kutsi ngibambe lokudla lokushiywe phakathi kwemigodzi ngemuva kwalabo labasebenza.' Wafika etindlini, wahlala esebenzela kusukela ngekusasa kuze kube manje, ngaphandle kwekuphumula emaminithi lambalwa efulethini.
UBowazi watsi kuRuthi: "Lala, intombi yami; ungayeki ufike esiteji sesinye, ungasekho lapha; hlala nalabo labasebenza nami.
Hlala lapho lamadoda evuna khona, bese ulandela emabhishobi. Labesifazane ngibatshele kutsi bangakucoci; kepha uma ungenawo umphefumulo, ungaya uphuze emgodini wamanzi labo amadoda abewugcwele."
Watsi yena, wabuyela phansi ngebuso bakhe emhlabatsini, watsi kuye: "Ngubani na lowo uyawuhamba naye, wena longenakho?

Boazi watsi kuye: "Kungetiwe kutsi kube kukhunjulwe kimi zonke izinto letiwenzile ngenkosikazi yakho ngemuva kwekufa komshado wakho, nokuthi washiya ubaba bakho nomama wakho nelizwe lakho lokuzalwa, uye waya kulabo bantu lobengabawazi.
USimakadze utawukukhokhela lokudla kwakho, umnikelo wakho wesono uyawukhululwa nguSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, lowo wasewufike uhlale ngaphansi kwemilenze yakhe.
Watsi yena: "Lakho, ngiyakucela, ngithole inhlonipho emilonyeni yakho, nkosi yami; ngobe ungithetse, wakhuluma ngesandla sakho semkhondweni wakho, nakuba anginguye umkhondweni wakho."
Watsi lapho kuphekwa khona, Boasi watsi kuye: "Thinda lapha, uphuze inhlama, uze uyifake emhluzi." Waye wahlala nalabo labavuna; yena wabanikela ngekudla lokucwebezelayo, wayidla kuze kube yaphela.
Watsi ifike iphuma kutsi ithole, uBowashi watsi kubo bonkhe bantfu bakhe: "Lalela ukuba ithole naphakathi kwemihlambi, ungamkhonzi.
Nase uphindze utfume kuye timbali letincane kusuka ebunzini, ushiye aze azicule; ungamtsi kutsi ahambe.
URuthi watsi: "Kutsi, uRuthhi wavuna emhlabatsini kuze kube sebusuku; wabalisa ijusi labewavuna, lafika kumashumi lamabili nesihlanu ema-epha.
Wayifaka enhlokodolobha, wabona umkakhe-ke kutsi yahlanganisa yini; wakhipha naRuthi, wanikela kuyo lokudla lokushiwo nguRuthhi, lapho aphelelwe khona kudla.

Wathi kuye umkakhe: "Kuphi nalapho usebenzela khona ngalolusuku? Kuphi nalapho wasebenza khona? Ungcwele lowo muntu lokubona wena!" Watsi yena akhuluma kumkakhe ngelowo, watsi: "Igama lakhe nguBowashi; nome ngabe ngihlala naye yini kulolusuku?"

Naomi watsi kunina wakhe: "Simakadze abembisene naye, ngobe akazange asuse ubuhlobo bakhe nalabo abaphilayo nalabo abafileyo." Yatsi yena: "Lomuntu ungumlingani wethu, umunye wabomndeni wethu, loyawusibuyisela."
Watsi Ruthi, iMoabitha: "Wathi nami: 'Thinala nebantfu bami, kuze baphele lokuvuna kwami.' "
UNaomi watsi kuRuthi, indodana yakhe: "Kulungile kuwe, ndodakazi yami, ukuba uhambe nebesifazane bakhe, ukuze ungabi nenkinga emhlabatsini lokunye."
Wahlala khona namakhosikazi ka-Bowazi, eqoqa, kuze kube sekuphele kulima kwejubane nekulima kwegcotjo; wahlala naye nomkakhe wesilisa.
UNaomi, umkakhe waRuthi, watsi kuye: "Nja yami, ngitakulethela indlu, lapho uhlale khona kahle."
UBowazi, lowase-Efrayim, lowo ubenemadvodzana a-Bowazi, uyise wethu; yena utawuhlukanisa ngelilanga lelilandelayo ijusi nenyama embhedeni.
Hlala, hlamba, ukhiphe iphunga, ugqoke ingubo yakho ehlelekile; bese uphuma ufike emgwaqeni. Angeke akwazi kutsi ukhona, kuze aphele ekudleni nasekudlaneni.
Nalapho ehlala khona, qaphela indawo lapho ehlala khona; bese uya, uvule imilenze yakhe, uphumule; yena utakutshela kutsi yini lokufanele uyenze.
Ruthi watsi: "Lokudla lokutsi wena, ngitawukwenza."
Waye, wenyuka waya esiteji, wakwenza njengobe umkakhe-mkhulu abemtshele.
Bowazi, lapho ephelile ekudleni kwakhe nekudla kwakhe, waphuma, waya embhedeni wakhe, wesuka ekugcineni kwegobho lelibomvu; Ruthhi wafika ngekuthula, wehlisa tinyawo zakhe, wehla embhedeni wakhe.
Emveni kwebusuku, lomuntfu waNkulunkulu waba nenkinga; wabuyela emuva, wabona indodana yakhe ihlala emehlweni akhe.
Wathi kuye: "Ubani?" Waye watsi: "Ngiye Ruthi, umkhonzi wakho; khipha ngesandla sakho imilenze yakho phezu kwami, ngobe wena ungummeli wemndeni wami, ungeke ungisuse."
Wathi kuye: "UNkulunkulu akubhalele wena, nkosikazi yami! Loluthando lukhulu kakhulu kunalelo langaphambilini, ngoba awuzange uhambe ulandela labancane, nalabo abakhulu nalabo abancane.
Namuhla, ndvodzakati yami, ungabi nebuhlungu; konke lokutsi wena ngikukwenzela; ngobe bonke labasendlulweni sami bayazi kutsi umuntfu lolungile.
Kulungile kutsi sengummeli wemndeni longeke angakukhulula, kepha kukhona omunye umuntu lowo umncane kuwe kunami.

Hamba uhlale lapha ekuseni, bese emini, uma efuna kutsi abe ngummeli wakho wendlu yakho, kulungile, abuye akubuyisele; kepha uma engeke avumeleke, ngiphila Simakadze, ngitakwenza; hlala lapha kuze kube ngumantsi.
Wayihlala emadolo akhe kuze kube ekuseni, waphuma ngaphambi kokuba kube khona umuntu lowaziyo; ngobe watsi: "Kungeke kucace muntu kutsi indodana yafika esiteji."
Watsi: "Nceda unciphise umlenze wakho, ubeke phansi." Wayewenza njalo, wabeka kuwo timiso lesishiyagalombili teshubhu, wayigqoka, wabuyela edolobhaneni.
URuthi wafika kwa-Naomi, uyise wenkosikazi yakhe, watsi kuye: "Kungekuhle yini, mntwana wami?" Waye wayikhuluma yonke lemisebenzi leBowashi abeyenze kuye.
watsi: "Wamnikela ngalemiti sishiyane se-oatmeal, watsi nami: 'Ungaya kunkosikazi yakho ungabi nalutho.'
Naomi watsi kuye: "Thintela, nkosikazi yami, kuze ubone kutsi kuzoba yini; ngobe lomuntu angeke akhululeke kuze kube sekuphele lesi simo ngalolusuku."
Boazi wafika emnyango wedolobha, wahlala khona. Nalapho kwafika umphathi wendlu yakhe, lowo akazange akhulume naye; watsi kuye: "Thina, fike uhlale lapha." Waphuma, wahlala phansi.
Bowashi watsatsa lamashumi lamabili emabhishobhi edolobha, watsi kubo: "Nihlale lapha." Bafike bahlala khona.
Watsi ke kulowo labenendlu yakhe: "Naomi, lebuyele kusuka eMoabi, ifuna kutsi ithengise inhlanganiso yemhlabatsi leyayiba ngu-Elimeleki, umngane wethu.

Ngitsi: "Ngitakusho kuwe, ngikutshele ukuthi uyithenge phambi kwalabo labahlala lapha, kanye nebaholi bebantfu bami. Uma ufuna ukuyidlulisa, yenza; kepha uma awufuni kuyidlulisa, khuluma nami, ukuze ngikwazi; ngobe akukho muntu lofanele ukudlulisa ngaphandle kwakho, futhi mina sengihamba phambili." Wathi: "Ngiyawudlulisa."
Boazi watsi: "Lemini lapho uthenga khona lemhlaba ngesandla saNaomi, kufanele uthathe naRuthi, iMoabi, indodana yomuntfu lofileyo, ukuze ugcine igama lomuntfu lofileyo likhona empahla yakhe."
Kuloko, umphathi wemndeni watsi: "Ngingeke ngiyibuyisele, ngobe ngingeke ngibeke impahla yami emtsetfweni. Uyibuyisele wena; angizange ngiyenze."
Bekunjalo naleso simiso sakubo eSirayeli, lapho bebuyela khona noma beshintshana khona ngempahla, kutsi lomunye aphuce isandla sakhe, amnike lowo wesifazane. Lokho kwakuye kwaba ngumthetho eSirayeli.
Watsi lowo umphathi wendlu, watsi kuBowazi: "Yithengise wena." Aphindze atfusa isiketi sakhe.
Bowazi watsi kubomakhulu kanye nabo bonkhe bantfu: "Niye niyi Witnesi namuhla, kutsi sengithengise ku-Naomi konke lokubekiwe nguElimeleki, neKilyone naMahloni.

Nase ngithole naRuthi, iMoabitha, indodana kaMahloni, ibe ngumkakhe, ukuze livi lelowo lafile lihlale likhona emndenini wakhe, kutsi livi lakhe lingacishiswe emzini wakhe. Niye niyibufakazi ngalolusuku."

Batsi bomkhuluwa nabo bonkhe bantfu besango: "Sisho kutsi uSimakadze ungeze lowesifazane lophuma endlwini yakho, abe njengeRakeli naLeya, laba babini abasungule indlu yaSirayeli; ube nempumelelo eEfrata, ube negama eBetheleyimu.
Lakho mndeni wakho ube njengemndeni waPerezi, loTamari abewuzala kuYuda, ngemadvodzana aSimakadze lokutawukunikela kuwe ngaleso sifazane.
UBowashi waba neRuthi, waba ngumkakhe; wahlangana naye; Simakadze wamnika ithuba lokukhulelwa, wazala uyise unyana.
Batsi labesifazane kuNaomi: "Ungcwele Simakadze, lowo angeke akushiye wena namuhla ungabi nendodana; nome kube khona igama lakhe eSirayeli.
Uya kutfumisa umphefumulo wakho, nawe utawukulekelela ekukhululeni kwakho; ngobe indvodzakati yakho, leyo uyithandayo, leyilungile kuwe kunemadvodzana asikhombisa, iyibulale.
UNaomi watsi: "Uyawuhlala lapha, ngobe ngitakulethela umntwana wami."
Batsi: "Naomi ukhulela umfana!" Batsi: "Obedi"; yena waba nguyise ka-Isai, waba nguyise kaDavide.
Lolu hlelo lwemindeni ye-Perezi: uPerezi waba ngumzali waHeshroni,
Hezroni waba ngumzali wa-Ram, Ram waba ngumzali wa-Aminadab,
uAminadabi waba ngumzali waNashoni, naNashoni waba ngumzali waSalmoni,
Salmoni waba nguyise waBohazi, Bohazi waba nguyise waObedi,
Obedi waba ngumzali waJese, neJese waba nguyise kaDavide.
1Sam: Kwabe kukhona umuntu, igama lakhe lakunguElkana, waseRamathaim-Zophim, ezweni lasephakeme leEfraim, unyana kaYeroham, unyana kaElihu, unyana kaTohu, unyana kaZuph, wesive seEfraim.
Wabe namakhosikazi lamibili, uHanna nePeninna; uPeninna ube nemadvodzana, kodvwa Hana akazange abe nemadvodzakati.

UElkana waphuma edolobhaneni lakhe ngonyaka ngamunye, waya eSilo, kutsi abe ngumnikelo wekushiswa kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli; khona lapho kwabekhona lamadodana laEli lababili, Hofni naPhinehasi, laba yinkhosi yaSimakadze.
Nalapho Elkanah anikela khona ngemnikelo wakhe, wabanika uPeninna indodana yakhe kanye nabo bonkhe labantwana bakhe nemadvodzana akhe, imisindvo lesasing scritto.
KwaHanna ke wabanika ingxenye lemibili, ngobe abemthanda; kodvwa Simakadze ubewuvulele umlomo wakhe kutsi angazali.
Naphena, umkhonzi wakhe, waphuma emphilweni yakhe, watsi: "UNkulunkulu akazange amvumele kutsi abe nemntwana."
Kwaba njalo ngonyaka, lapho aphuma khona endlwini yaSimakadze, yena uPeninna wayakhela kuye, kuze kufike kulapho iHanna ikhala khona, ingadlanga.
UElkana, lowesifazane wakhe, watsi kuye: "Hanna, kungani ulele? Kungani ungadla kudla? Yini lekwenza ube nebuhlungu emehlo akho? Angeke ngibe ngcono kuwe kunemadvodzana lalishumi?"
UHanna wavuka, lapho baphelelwe khona ekudleni nasekudlaneni eSilo; Eli, umpristi, wayehlala esihlalweni sakhe esisemnyango wendlu yaSimakadze.
UHanna wahlupheka kakhulu, wathandaza kuSimakadze, watsi:

Waye wanikela ngemnikelo, watsi: "Simakadze Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, uma ubona buhlungu bomkhonzi wakho, ungikhumbula, ungamlibali umkhonzi wakho, kodwa umnike indodana yomkhonzi wakho; khona-ke ngiya kumnikela kuYehova iminyaka yakhe yonke, isandla sakhe singeke sifike ekhanda lakhe.
Watsi lapho ihlala ithandaza kuSimakadze, Eli wabheka umlomo wakhe.
Ase-Ana wathandaza emphefumulweni wakhe; imilenze yakhe yahamba, kepha umsindo wayo wawungeke uhlangatshezwane. Ngako-ke Eli watsi: "Ube sewudle."
Watsi kuye: "Kungakapheli yini kutsi uhlale uphuza? Sula iwayini lakho!"
UHanna waphendula watsi: "Kungeke kube njalo, nkosi yami; ngiyabe ngumkakhe lohluphekile kakhulu; ngingadlanga iwayini nalesiphuzo lesibulala umphefumulo, kodwa ngawukhipha umoya wami kuSimakadze.
