"Ungeke ucabange ukuthi umkhonto wakho ungumkakhe, ngobe ngihlala lapha ngebuhlungu nendlala yami enkulu.
Eli waphendula watsi: "Hamba ukhululeke; Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, angakunikela ngesicelo sakho lesiwucela kuye."
Waye watsi: "Lakho, uvumele umkhonzi wakho athole inhlonipho emilonyeni yakho." Waye wabuyela endlela yakhe, wadla kudla, kodvwa ibuso bakhe abuzange bubi.
Bafike bavuka ngekusasa, bathandaza phambi kwaSimakadze, babuyela ekhaya labo eRama. Elkana wathandana naHanna, indodana yakhe; ngobe Simakadze wabakhumbula.
UHanna wakhulelwa, wazala unyana, watsi: "NguSamuweli," ngobe kusho kutsi: "Ngaye ngiwufuna kuSimakadze."
UElkana, lowesifazane wakhe, waphuma naye kanye nendlu yakhe yonke, waya ekunikela kuSimakadze ngemnikelo wekushiswa nsuku zonke, naleyo nandza yakhe.
Aye-ke uHanna akazange afike, watsi kumfazi wakhe: "Kungekucace kutsi umfana abe sewukhululiwe; khona-ke ngitafika ngimubeke phambi kweSimakadze, aze ahlale khona kuze kube sekupheleni."

UElkana, lowesifazane wakhe, watsi kuye: "Yenza kutsi kukuhle emehlo akho; hlala lapha kuze ugweme ukumnyatisa; ngobe Simakadze angeke agcine amazwi akhe." Wayehlala khona, wayinyatisa intombi yakhe kuze ayigweme.
Wathi, "Ngisho naleso sigubhu segolide lesingaba ngu-1/3 semalitha lamafutha omnqumo kanye nengilazi yewayini elibomvu ngasinye," wakhipha umnikelo wakhe wesono kuSimakadze, watsi:
Banikela ngenkunzi yengulube, bafike bamletha lomuntfu kuEli.
Wathi yena uHanna kuye, "Nceda, nkosi yami! Njengokuphila kwenhliziyo yakho, ngiwo lowesifazane lohlala lapha ecaleni lakho scrittola kuSimakadze.
Ngibe sengithandaza ngelowo mntwana, ngobe Simakadze wangisinika lomnikelo wami wesono.
Ngako-ke namuhla ngiwunikela kuSimakadze; kuze kube sekuphele iminyaka yakhe, utawunikela kuSimakadze. Bayawuthandaza khona kuNkulunkulu.
UHanna wathandaza, watsi: "Inhliziyo yami ijabulise kuSimakadze, ngobe Simakadze ungisindisele; ngiyawukhala ngalabo baholi bami, ngoba sengivumile kutsi ungisindise.
Akukho longcwele njengeSimakadze, akukho ngaphandle kwakho; Akukho mlilo njengaNkulunkulu wethu.
Lala magama akho, angeke aphume emlonyeni wakho; ngobe uSimakadze nguNkulunkulu lowaziyo yonke into, naye ubala imicabango yamadoda.
Tigodzi tabaholi bekulwa tilahleka, kepha labo labaphazamiseka batfunywa ngemandla.
Labanyenti basebenzela ukudla, kepha labakhulule abagcwaliswanga; lengakazala wazala lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa, kodwa lomkhulule uhlupheka kakhulu.
Simakadze ubulala, uphilasa; ubeka phansi emgodini, ubeka phezulu kuwo.
USimakadze uyawukhipha umtfubi, nawe utawuwunika umtfubi; uyawukhuphula umtfubi, naye uyawuphakamisa.

Uyawuphakamisa umtfubi emhlabatsini, utawukhuphula lomnyama emgodini wokudla; uyababeka behlala kanye nalabo abakhulu, wabanika isikhundla esiphakeme. Isisekelo sehlabathi sisoSimakadze, wamisa phezu kwayo umhlaba wonke.
Uyawugcoba imilenze yalabo abangcwele bakhe, kepha lababi bangacishiselwa emthunzini; ngeke kubekho umuntu lophumelela ngemandla akhe.

Labaphikisayo kuSimakadze, bangabi nalutho; utawutsiza mlilo phezu kwabo kusuka esibhakabhakeni. UNkulunkulu uyawugwema umhlaba wonke, utawunika umlingiswa wakhe amandla, nelowo akhethelwe yena utawuwuqinisa.
UElkana wabuyela ekhaya lakhe eRama; umfana ke wahlala esebenza kuSimakadze ngaphansi kwesandla saEli, kutsi kube ngumnikelo wesono.
Bakhona bantfu lababi, bahlala enkhosini yabo; bahlala endlwini yaSimakadze.
Lendlela labaphatsimandla bekhuluma ngayo ngebantfu yayile: lapho umuntu enikela khona ngemnikelo, wafika umkhonzi wephatsimandla, ngelidlalwa inyama, ephethe i-fork enemikhono mithathu.
Wayibeka emgodini, noma ebhodleni, noma ensimini; nome yini leyaphuma kuleyo mgodzi, umnikelo wekushiswa waba neso kuye. Bayawukwenza njalo kubo bonkhe labaSirayeli labafika eShilo.
Kube, ngaphambi kokuba batfume lemafutha, wafika umkhonzi wenkhosi, watsi kulowo lonikelayo: "Ninise inyama kutsi icwecwe ngunkhosi; ngobe angeke athathe kusuka kuwe inyama ebilisiwe, kepha imnyama."

"Wena-ke, uma umkhonzi wakho akusho kuye: 'Kungeke kuqhume kuqala lokudla lokushisayo, bese uthatha lokho lofunako', yena waphendula watsi: 'Akho, ngikunike manje; kepha uma unganiniki, ngikuthathe ngemandla.'
Waba mkhulu kakhulu umonakalo walo mshado emehloni kaSimakadze, ngobe bewuphazamisa lomnikelo waNkulunkulu.
Samuelu ke wasebenza phambi kwaSimakadze, eneminyaka lelishumi nambili ubudala, egqoke i-ephod yesiliva negolide, nebukhazikhazi.
Umnandza wakhe wayawuyalela kutsi agqoke ingubo lencane, wayisa kuye ngaleso sikhatsi lesinyenti, lapho ephuma khona nalowo wesifazane wakhe umnikelo wesono.
UEli uyawubhalisela uElkanana nomkakhe, watsi: "Simakadze akulethe kuwe umzabalazo lophuma kulowo mkhwenyana, endaweni yelowo abewufuna, lowo ayewunikela kuNkulunkulu." Baye babuyela ekhaya labo.

USimakadze wabonga uHana, waba nesibeletho, wazala lamadodana lasitfupha namakhosikazi lasitfupha. Umfana uSamuweli wakhula ebusweni boNkulunkulu, wahlala eBhetelehema, lapho ahlala khona kuze kube ngumnyaka wesihlanu.
Eli waba mkhulu kakhulu, wava konkhe loko lokudlalwa ngubana bakhe kubo bonkhe labaSirayeli, nalapho behlala khona nebesifazane labasebenza emgwaqeni wetenti lekuhlangana.
Wabaphendvula watsi: "Ngubani na lowenza lezinto, ngobe ngikhuluma kubo bonkhe bantfu ngezinto letibi nizenza.
Akunjalo, izingane zami! Lokushiwo ngikuva phakathi kwebantfu bakaSimakadze akulungile; niyawubabeka emthethweni.

Uma umuntu ephazamisa umfana wakhe, uNkulunkulu unokuwulungisa; kepha uma umuntu ephazamisa Simakadze, ngubani longeke akhulume kuye?'" Ngako-ke labantwana bakhe batsi: "Asikuvumeleni kutsi nivune," ngobe Nkulunkulu wayefuna kubondza.
USamuele, lowo mncane, waba mkhulu kakhulu, wahlala ethandekayo kuSimakadze, nakubo bantfu.
Wafika umntu waNkulunkulu ku-Eli, watsi kuye: "Simakadze utsi: 'Ngingaba sengibonakalisile yini endluni yababa bakho, lapho behlala khona eMijiphu emkhondweni kaFarao?

Nami ngakhetha ubaba wakho kutsi abe ngumnikelo wami wesono, kusuka kuwo wonke lamakhosikazi aseSirayeli, afike enhliziyweni yami, afake uvumba, agqoke i-ephod phambi kwami; nami nganikela endluni yababa bakho zonke iminikelo yekushiswa yabaSirayeli.

Ngubani na wena loyawuhlaza mnikelo wami wesono, kanye neminikelo yami yekushiswa, lapho ngitsi ngayo ngendlu yami? Ngubani na loyawuhlomisa labantwana bakho kunami, kutsi niphuze lokudla lokuhle kakhulu kuleyo mihlambi yesive sami saseSirayeli?

Ngako-ke uSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, uthi: Ngibe ngitsi: Umndeni wakho uyawuba ngumnikelo wami wesono kuze kube sekupheleni; kepha manje uSimakadze uthe: Angeke kwenzeke njalo; ngobe labo labangihloniphisa ngitawubahlonipha, kodvwa labo labangisami bayawubiwa.
Beka, kuyawufika lilanga lapho ngitawucindza khona amandla akho kanye nemandla emndeni wakho, kutsi angeke kubekho muntu emndenini wakho lophila kuze kube seminyaka lemile.
Utawubona buhlungu emndenini wami, nalapho kusetjentelwe khona lokubi eSirayeli; ngobe angeke kubekho muntu emndenini wakho lohlala iminyaka leminingi.

Nabo bonke labami, labo ngitawubasusa kubo kutsi bangabi nendlu yami yekudla, baya kuba nemilenze yakho inemilenze, namehlo akho anemilenze, nenhliziyo yakho inenhliziyo; nabo bonkhe labantfu bakho bayawufa bephila.
Lakho kuyawukuba nguphawu kuwe, lokuya kuba khona kubo bonkhe bantfu lababini, uHofeni naPhinehasi; bangafa lilanga elinye.

"Nami ngitawumisa kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, umLevi lothembekile, lowo uyawukwenza konke lokusemandleni ami; ngaye ngitawunikela ngendlu lehlala isikhathi eside, aze abe ngumkhonzi wami kuze kube sekupheleni.
Nabo bonke labashiyelwe emndenini wakho, bayawufika, batsi: Lakho mnikelo wegolide, naloko mnikelo wekudla; batawutsi: Sicela, sinike umsebenti wekushumayela, kutsi ngidle inyama.
USamuweli, lowo mncane, wasebenza kuSimakadze ngaphansi kwesandla sa-Eli. Kube khona lilanga lelincane lapho likhuluma khona iNkhosi Simakadze, itsi: "Kungeke kube nembono leningi."
Watsi ngelilanga elinye Eli abelele embhedeni wakhe, ngobe amehlo akhe abengabonanga; ngobe amehlo akhe angeke abone.
Lesibane saNkulunkulu asikuphelile, Samuelu walala endlwini yaSimakadze, lapho ibhokisi lesivumelwano saNkulunkulu lakubo.
Simakadze watsi kuSamuele: "Samuweli," waphendvula watsi: "Ngikhona.
Wahamba waya kuEli, watsi: "Ngikhona, ngobe ungisibiza." Eli watsi: "Angingakusibiza; buyela emuva uphumule!" Waphuma wahlala.
USimakadze wehla watsi: "Samuele!" Samuele wavuka, waya kuEli, watsi: "Ngikhona, ngobe ungisibiza." Eli watsi: "Ngisikubicele, mntwana wami; buyela uphumule."
Waye-ke uSamuweli akazange akhulume naSimakadze, ngobe ilizwi laNkulunkulu alizange livele kuye.
USimakadze watsi kuSamuweli kathathu. USamuele wehla waya ku-Eli, watsi: "Ngikhona; ngobe ungisibiza." Eli waqonda kutsi nguNkulunkulu lokhuluma nomfana.
UEli watsi kuSamuweli: "Hamba uphumule; bese uma ekhuluma kuwe, utsi: 'Chaza, Simakadze, ngobe umkhonzi wakho ulalela.'" Samuweli waphuma wahlala endaweni yakhe.
USimakadze wehla, wahlala khona, watsi: "Samuele, Samuele!" Samuele watsi: "Chaza, ngobe umkhonzi wakho ukhuluma."
Simakadze watsi kuSamuweli: "Lamuhla ngiyakwenza e-Israyeli sinqumo, lapho wonke lowo lokhuluma ngalo angeke abe nendlebe yekutsi liphumile.
Ngeleso sikhathi ngitawukhipha ku-Eli tonkhe tincwadzi tekucala titsi "tetfu" letikhuluma ngendlu yakhe, ngiziqale nangeziphele.
Nami ngatsi kuye kutsi ngitawubulala mndeni wakhe kuze kube sekupheleni, ngenxa yesono sakhe, ngobe wayesazi; kodvwa yena akazange abophe.
Ngako-ke ngitsi: Labo basemndenini wa-Eli, kungeke kube khona mnikelo wekushiswa noma umnikelo wesono, kutsi kubuyiselwe kubo imphilo yabo.'"
USamuele wahlala khona kuze kube ekuseni, watsi uvule iminyango yendlu yaSimakadze; Samuele walokota kutsi atshele Eli lokubona.
Eli watsi kuye: "Samuele, mntwana wami!" Samuele watsi: "Ngikhona."
Eli watsi kuye: "Utsi yini lakusho kuwe?" Eli watsi: "Ungangifihla, ngobe Nkulunkulu ungeke akwenze kube njalo, nome akwenze kube kanye, uma ungifihla noma yini lekhuluma nawe.
USamuweli watsi kuye konkhe loko, angeke amfihla lutho. Eli watsi: "UNkulunkulu ukhona; kumele akwenze lokuhle ekubonakalweni kwakhe."
USimakadze waba neSamuele, wakhula, watsi: "UNkulunkulu uyakwenza kutsi kube njalo konkhe lokusho nguSamuele."
Bobabili bantfu baseSirayeli, kusukela eDani kuya eBher-shebha, bayazi ukuthi uSamuweli ube ngumprofeti waSimakadze.
Simakadze abehlala eSilo, wabonakala khona kuSamuele ngelizwi lakhe.
Lamazwi laSamuweli afika kuwo wonke laSirayeli. Baphuma bahlasela labaFilisti, batsi: "Sirayeli sihlala e-Eben-ezeri, nalabaFilisti sihlala e-Afek."
BaFilisti bamisa umhlangano wekulwa naboSirayeli, bahlaselwa nguSirayeli phambi kwalabaFilisti, babulala emaphesenti lamakhulu mane labaseSirayeli emgwaqeni.

Bafike esiteji, labakhulu baseSirayeli batsi: "Ngubani na loyawutfusa uSimakadze namuhla phambi kwalabaFilisti? Lapha sitawukhipha ibhokisi lesivumelwano seNkulunkulu kusuka eShilo, lihambe nathi, lisisindise ekuhlaseleni kwababi bethu."

Labantfu bathumela eShilo, bakhipha ibhokisi lesivumelwano seSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, lohlala emehlweni akhe, phakathi kwee-kerubi; kwabekhona nabana bakhe bobabili, uHofeni noPhinehasi, nebhokisi lesivumelwano saNkulunkulu.
Nalapho ibhokisi lesivumelwane saSimakadze lifike esitejini, bonkhe bantfu beSirayeli bakhipha umsindo lomkhulu kakhulu, kuze umhlaba ukhatsa.
Bafike bakhuluma, batsi: "Ngubani na lowo msindo kanye nalo kuthula ekamelweni labaHebhere?" Beva kutsi ibhokisi laSimakadze lifike ekamelweni labo.
BaFilisti bakhathazekile, batsi: "UNkulunkulu ufike emgwaqeni wabo. Akunjalo! Kube sekungaba khona lutho lokufana nalo.
Ngubani na lotawusivikela emandlani lalowo nkulunkulu lomkhulu, lowo wabulala iMijiphu ngaso sonke sifo sayo enyangeni lemnyama?
Bakhombiseni ukuthula, nibe madodana, nibe madodana, ngobe ningaba bamsebenti weSihebheri, njengobe nabo babe basebenti zenu. Bakhombiseni mandla, nibe madodana, nife!

Baphilisithi bahlasela, base-Israyeli bahlaselwa, wabaleka wonke lomunye waya etenteni lakhe; kwabekho kuhlukunyezeka okukhulu, kwaba nekufa kwebantfu labahamba ngenyawo lamakhulu lamashumi mathathu ase-Israyeli.
Lebhokisi laNkulunkulu lathathwa, bafa nabo bonkhe bantfu lababini boEli, uHofeni naPhinehasi.
Waphuma emphini lokulwa, wafika eShilo ngalolusuku lomfana weBenjamini, abe nemigqomo yakhe ihlanganisiwe, nemhlabatsi phezu kwehlavu lakhe.

Wafika, wabona Eli ehlala esihlalweni sakhe ngaphesheya kwendlela abheke phansi; ngobe umphefumulo wakhe waba nebuhlungu ngenxa yebhokisi laNkulunkulu. Waphuma waya emgwaqeni, watsi kulowo mhlali: "Kutsi kube sekube sekwenzeke."
Eli wakhuluma, watsi: "Ngubani lokushayela loku?" Lomuntu wehla waya ku-Eli.
waba neminyaka lemashumi lamane namakhulu lamabili nesikhombisa, emehlo akhe angeke abone.
Wakhuluma kuEli, watsi: "Ngisuka emgwaqeni, ngobe namuhla ngiphuma emgwaqeni." Eli watsi: "Kube yini, unyana wami?"

Waphendula lowo umfundisi, watsi: "ISirayeli yabaleka ngaphambili kweFilisti, kwabekho nekufa okukhulu emphakathini; kanye nabantwana bakho bobabili, uHofeni noPhinehasi, bafile, futhi ibhokisi laNkulunkulu lithathelwe."

Watsi lapho ekhuluma ngebhokisi laNkulunkulu, Eli wehla ngasemgwaqeni wesiganeko sakhe esingeceleni kwesango lemnyango, wabulala umlenze wakhe; ngobe wayeneminyaka lengema-40 aphindze abe ngummeli waseSirayeli.

Indvodzakati yakhe, indodana ka-Phinehasi, yayikhulelwe, yafika kumnyaka wamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa. Yatsi lapho ikhuluma ngezindaba kutsi ibhokisi laNkulunkulu lithathwe, nakuba uyise wesifazane wakhe kanye nomkakhe bafile, waphuma ebuhlungu bakhe, wazala.
Yatsi, lapho iphuma ekufaneni, labesifazane labahamba nabo batsi kuye: "Ungabi nebuhlungu, ngobe ubulale umfana." Kodwa yena akazange aphendule, walala.
Wayibiza igama lakhe ngeIkabhodi, watsi: "Ubuhle busuka eSirayeli," ngobe ibhokisi laNkulunkulu lifike lithathwe, kanye nababa wakhe wenkosikazi kanye nomfazi wakhe.
Watsi: "Ubuhle buphuma eSirayeli, ngobe ibhokisi laNkulunkulu lithathelwe."
Bafilisti bakhipha ibhokisi laNkulunkulu, balisa lisuka e-Eben-ezeri baya eAshdodi.
Bafaka ibhokisi laSimakadze endlwini ya-Dagon, loNkulunkulu wabo, bamisa eduze kwesithombe sa-Dagon.
Batsi baphuma labase-Ashdodi ngelilanga lesitsatfu, bebona uDagon eshonile ngebuso bakhe emhlabatsini phambi kwebhokisi leSimakadze; batsi: "Thiba uDagon, uyibeke endaweni yakhe.

Bafike bavuka ngasebusuku, babona uDagon eshonile ngebuso bakhe phansi emhlabatsini phambi kwebhokisi laSimakadze, nenhloko yakhe kanye nesandla sakhe sicutshungulwe, sibekwe emgwaqeni wemnyango; wahlala khona kuphela.
Ngako-ke labangcwele bakaDagon, nalowo wonke longena endlwini kaDagon eAshdodi, bangase babeke tinyawo tabo emgwaqeni wakhe, kuze kube namuhla.
Isandla saSimakadze sihlekelele ema-Ashdodi kanye nemindeni yawo, wabeka kubo umonakalo omkhulu, wababulala ngetinhlayiya letibuhlungu.
Bekubona labase-Ashdodi kutsi kube njalo, batsi: "Ibhokisi leNkulunkulu waseSirayeli akufanele lihlale lapha nathi; ngobe isandla sakhe sinzima kuthi, kanye naDagon, Nkulunkulu wethu."

Baye bahlangana nabo bonkhe labaholi beFilisti, batsi kubo: "Siyawuyenza yini ibhokisi leNkulunkulu waseSirayeli?" Baphendvula batsi: "Niyisuse ibhokisi leNkulunkulu weSirayeli lifike eGathi." Beyikhipha khona ibhokisi leNkulunkulu waSirayeli.
Baye bamisa, bese isandla saSimakadze sifike kulo mji, sawuphazamisa kakhulu; wabulala bantfu balo mji, labancane nalabakhulu, wababeka emahlanjeni aphumayo.
Baye bathumela ibhokisi laSimakadze e-Ekroni. Lebhokisi lifike e-Ekroni, bantfu base-Ekroni batsi: "Belikhipha ibhokisi leNkulunkulu waseSirayeli lapha nathi, kutsi litfule mina nebantfu bethu."

Baye bahlangana nabo bonkhe labaholi beFilisti, batsi: "Thumela phansi ibhokisi leNkulunkulu waseSirayeli, liphinde libuye endaweni yayo, ukuze lingasibulala singesinye sabantu bethu." Umjikelo wokufa wawugcwele lomhlaba; isandla sikaNkulunkulu sabe sinzima kakhulu kuwo.
Nalabo abazange bafe, bahlaselwa ticubu, ngobe imvubelo yedolobha yafike ifika emhlabatsini.
Lebhokisi laSimakadze lahlala emhlabatsini weFilisti iminyaka lesikhombisa.
Batsi baFilisti bakhipha labaphatsimandla babo nebahleli-mlilo, batsi kubo: "Ngubani lokumele siyenze ngebhokisi laSimakadze? Sitshele indlela lesingayibuyisela ngayo endaweni yayo."

Baphendvula batsi: "Uma nithumela emuva ibhokisi leNkulunkulu waseSirayeli, ningayibuyiseli yinye; ngobe kumele nifikeni nemnikelo wesono kuye; khona-ke nizophiliswa, nibone kutsi kungani lisandla sakhe singakushiyani.

Batsi: "Siyawumunikela yini ngesondlo sesono?" Baphendvula batsi: "Izinhlayiya tagolide letisihlanu, nezinhlanzi tegolide tihlanu, ngayinye yazo ibe yinkosi yeFilisti; ngoba lobhubho lifana nawe kanye namakhosi akho.

Nifake emacwecwe emifanekiso yetinhlayiya, nemifanekiso yetingulube letibulala iNingizimu Afrika, ninike ukuthula kuNkulunkulu waseSirayeli; kungase kutsi asuse isandla sakhe phezu kwenu, kanye noNkulunkulu wenu, nemhlaba wenu.
Nakho-ke, yini naleyo imiphefumulo yenu leyimfishane, njengabaMijipi kanye neFaro, lapho Nkulunkulu abengazange abonise khona isandla sakhe esibi kubo, bavumele bantfu bakaSirayeli bahambe?
Manje-ke, lungiselela imoto entsha, nengulube letimbili letifileko, letingeke tikhonjwe ngejubane; hlanganisa lengulube nemoto, bese uthatha tinkukhu tazo, ubenze kube ngutindlu.
Nithathe ibhokisi laSimakadze, nilibeke ebhasini, naletinduku letinezinto tegolide, letitsi: "Lesibopho sekubuyisana" lesinithumela kuye, nilibeke eduze kwayo; bese niyikhipha.

Nize nibheke: uma ihamba ngendlela yayo, ifike eBet-shemeshi, khona-ke uSimakadze utawutfumisa phezu kwethu lesi simo esibi; kepha uma ingekho, khona-ke sitawuzi kutsi isandla sakhe asizange sitsisile. Kube kungakabi naloko.
Baye bakwenza njalo, batsi: "Thintsi tingulube ezimbili letikhulelwe, bese bezibeka ebhasini, bese bemisa tingulube tazo.
Babeka ibhokisi laSimakadze phezulu kwemoto, kanye nebhokisi lelinetingulube tegolide, kanye nemifanekiso yetibopho.

Lenkukhu yahamba ifike eBethe-shemesi, yahlala kuyo yonke lendlela yaso; yahlala iphuma nemilenze yayo; akazange ahambe ngasekunene noma ngasekhohlo. Lamakhosi aseFilisti ayewalandela kuze kufike emgwaqeni weBethe-shemesi.
Bakhona bantfu baseBethe-shemeshi bekulahla imbewu yabo emfuleni, baphakamisa imehlo abo, babona ibhokisi, baphumula kakhulu.
Lemoto yafika emhlabatsini laJoshua wase-Bethe-shemesi, yahlala khona eduze kwemlilo omkhulu; ngobe baphindze bacubhuta umthi wemoto, banikela ngenkomo ibe ngumnikelo wekushiswa kuSimakadze.

LaLevi bakhuphula ibhokisi laSimakadze, kanye nebhokisi lezinto zegolide, bamise emadolobheni amakhulu; nalabo baseBethe-shemeshi banikela ngeminikelo yekushiswa, banikela ngenhlanhla kuSimakadze ngalolusuku.
Batsi babona, labaphathi beFilisti labahlanu babuyela eEkroni ngalolusuku lwesibili.
Lemisipha yegolide, labaFilisti bayisa kuSimakadze kutsi ibe ngumnikelo wesono: Ashdodi, neGaza, neAshkeloni, neGati, neEkroni, yinye ngayinye.

Linani lezinhlanzi zegolide lalingana nenani lamadolobhana eFilisti, lalabaphathi besihlanu, kusukela emathempelini kuya emabhishi asemaphandleni. Lomlilo omkhulu lapho babeka khona ibhokisi laSimakadze ukhona kuze kufike ngalolusuku, emhlabatsini waJoshua waseBethe-shemeshi.

Ngako-ke Simakadze wabulala lamadodana eBethe-shemeshi, ngobe babebona ebhokisini leSimakadze, wababulala lamakhulu lamashumi mahlanu namakhulu lasikhombisa. Lamadodana aSawula ahlupheke kakhulu, ngobe Simakadze abewabulala.
Batsi: "Ngubani longeke ahlale phambi kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wemaSirayeli, kutsi lebhokisi lifike kuphi?"
Bathumela labaseKirihati-yearimi, besithi: "LaseFilisti libuyisele emuva ibhokisi leSimakadze; phuma niyifake enhloko yedolobha yenu."
Bafika khona labaseKirathi-yearimi, bafaka ibhokisi leSimakadze endluni ya-Abinabadi, emfuleni, bamisa uEleazaru, umsa wakhe, kutsi agcine ibhokisi lenkhosi.
Lebhokisi lahlala eKiriyati-yearimi iminyaka emikhulu, iminyaka lelishumi nambili; bonkhe bantfu beSirayeli babuyela kuSimakadze.

USamuweli wathi kubo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli, watsi: "Uma niyawubuyela kuSimakadze ngentliziyo yenu yonke, khiphani ema-Astorethi kanye namasiko langaphandle akhona phakathi kwenu; nikelani ngokuphelele kuSimakadze, niwukhonze yena kuphela, naye utawukusindisa esandla seFilisti."
Lamadvodza ase-Israyeli akhipha emaBaali kanye neAshtorethi, wahlala enkhosini.
Samuweli watsi: "Thintela bonkhe labaSirayeli eMizpa, ngobe ngitathandaza kuSimakadze kutsi anivikele."
Bahlangana eMizpa, bakhipha amanzi, bamisa phambi kuSimakadze, baphumula ngalolusuku, batsi: "Sibe nesono kuSimakadze." Samuelu waba ngummeli waseSirayeli eMizpa.
Beva iFilisti kutsi bantfu baseSirayeli bahlangane eMizpa, besuka bomkhuluwa babo baphuma bahlasela; bese beva lokudla kwabo, bakhathazeka kakhulu ngenxa yalabaFilisti.
Batsi kuSamuweli: "Ungavumeli kutsi ugweme ukukhuluma nathi kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wethu, ukuze ativikele emaFilisti.
USamuele watsi: "Ngubani na lowo muntfu lophuma eSirayeli?" Wayikhipha ingulube yakhe, wayinikela kuSimakadze njengemnikelo wekushiswa; wathandaza kuye Simakadze ngesandla sa-Israyeli.

Samuweli ke wanikela ngesondlo somlilo, baFilisti bafika bahlasela laSirayeli; kodvwa uSimakadze wehlisa umfudlana lomkhulu ngaleso sikhathi phezu kwalabaFilisti, wabaphazamisa kakhulu, bahlaselwa phambi kwaSirayeli.
Lamadoda aseSirayeli aphuma eMizpa, walandela laFilisti, wababulala kuze kube kufike ngaphansi kweBet-kar.
Samuweli wathatha itiye, wayibeka phakathi kweMiphaya neShen; watsi: "Ebene-Eben-ezeri," ngobe watsi: "Kude nalapho Simakadze abesisebentisa khona."
Babulawa labaFilisti, bangafikanga emgwaqeni waSirayeli; isandla sikaSimakadze sabe sikhona phezu kwalabaFilisti yonke imihla kaSamuweli.

Lamadolobha lalabaFilisti babewakhipha eSirayeli abuyiselwe kuSirayeli, kusukela e-Ekroni kuya eGathi; nemhlaba wabo waseSirayeli wabuyiselwa emaFilisti; kwabe khona ukuthula phakathi kweSirayeli ne-Amori.
USamuele waba ngummeli waseSirayeli iminyaka yakhe yonke.
Wahamba iminyaka ngeminyaka, wasuka eBheteli waya eGilgal, waya eMizpa, waba ngummeli waseSirayeli kuwo wonke lamadolobha.
Wabuyela eRama, ngobe lapho kwakuyindlu yakhe, waphuma khona waya eSirayeli, wakwakha khona ithempeli kuSimakadze.
Samuweli akhulela, wabeka bantfu bakhe kutsi babe ngabaholi bakaJuda.
Igama lomkhulu lwakhe lakunguJoyele, nelinye linguAbiha; laba babe ngumtsetfo eBeer-sheba.
Base-Amori, ngobe babengenako kutsi bahambe ngalendlela yakhe, bafike behlala eGibhithe; kodvwa bantfu bakhe bahamba ngendlela yakhe.
Bahlangana bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli, bafika kuSamuele eRama.
Batsi kuye: "Uye sewukhulumile, nabantwana bakho bangabi nempilo yakho; namuhla sinike ukumkani kutsi akhulume nathi, njengobe kuyawuba khona kuwo wonke lamazwe."
Batsi: "Nceda usinike ukumkani kutsi akhulume nathi." Samuweli wakhathazeka, wathandaza kuSimakadze.
USimakadze watsi kuye: "Thina, lalela amazwi lalaba bantu akhuluma kuwe kuwo wonke lamazwi abo; bangakucingeli wena, kodwa bacingisile mina kutsi ngibe ngunkhosi yabo.
Naloluhlobo lwezinto labazenzayo kusukela kuleso sikhatsi lapho ngabakhipha khona ema-Egypti, kuze kube manje, bayakwenza nawe; bamishiya, bakhonza bonkulunkulu babo.
Ngiyabalalela, kepha utawubatjela ngesandla sakho, utawubakhombisa kutsi yini loyawuyenza ukumkani loyawulawula phezu kwawo.
USamuele wakhuluma konkhe lokushiwo nguSimakadze kubo bonkhe bantfu labacela kutsi abe ngunkhosi kubo.
Wathi, Lokho kuyawukwenza ukumkani loyawulawula phezu kwenu; utawuthatha labantwana benu, wabeka emakhazeni akhe, nakwabahhashi bakhe, bahambe phambi kwamakhazani akhe.

Wababeka ngabanye njengebaholi bamakhulu kanye nabemakhulu lamashumi mahlanu; wabeka abanye njengebaholi bemifula yakhe, nabo baya kuvuna impahla yakhe; wabeka abanye njengebaholi bemikhumbi yakhe, nabo baya kuyilungisa.
Aphindze athathe tindvuna takho, aze azifake emakhandlela, aze azicwebeze, aze azicwebezele.
Uyawuthatha lokudla lokuhle kakhulu emhlabatsini wenu, netingcumbu zenu, netingcumbu te-olive yenu, aze awanike labakhonzi bakhe.
Lawo ema-decimes ekudla kwenu kanye newayini lakho, atawuwakhipha, aze awanike labaphathi bakhe nalabaphatsimandla bakhe.
Utawutsatsa labangani bakho, nemadvodzakati akho, nalabo besifazane bakho, nalabo madodakazi akho angcono, kanye nedoli lakho, aze awasebenzise emisebenzini yakhe.
Utawuthatha ingxenye yeshumi lemihlambi yenu, niyawuba ngabakhonzi bakhe.
Ngeleso sikhathi nizokhala, ngenxa yenkhosi yenu leyo niyikhethile; ngobe Simakadze angeke aniphendule ngalolusuku.
Batsi: "Kungeke kube nguSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, lowo utawuba ngunkhosi yethu."
Siyawuba sifana nebantfu bonke, sibe noMbuso wase uphuma ebusweni bethu, waphuma phambi kwethu, wahlasela emabhinqa ethu.
USamuele wehla wakhuluma kuSimakadze, watsi: "UNkulunkulu utsi: 'Ngubani lowo longeke ahambe ngesandla sami?'
USimakadze watsi: "Thintela imithandazo yabo, utawubanika ukumkani." Samuweli wathi kubo bonkhe bantfu beSirayeli: "Nihambe niya edolobhaneni lenu.
Kubekhona umuntu waseBhenjamini, igama lakhe lakunguKishi, umsa waAbiyeli, umsa waZerori, umsa waBekorathi, umsa waAfiya; lomuntu waba ngumuntfu lomkhulu kakhulu.
UKishi wayenendvodzakati, igama layo bekunguSawuleli, indodana lehle kakhulu; kwakukhona eSirayeli muntfu lohle kakhulu kunaye, waphakama ngenhloko kunebantfu bonke.
UKishi, uyise wa-Sauli, waba nesidlovukazi lesifile; watsi Kishi ku-Sauli, unyana wakhe: "Thiba nawe omunye webantfu labancane, uye ufune sidlovukazi."

USawula wahamba ngemhlaba wema-Ephrayi, nemhlaba weShalisa, kodvwa awazitholanga. Baye bafika ezweni leShaalimi, ngobe emabhubesi angeke abe khona lapho; wabahamba ngemhlaba weBenjamini, kodvwa awazitholakali.
Bafika ezweni leSuphi, uSawula watsi kulowo mshayeli lobe naye: "Thiba, sihambe, ngobe ubaba wami angeke abe nenkinga ngedlovukazi, kodwa abe nenkinga nathi."
Wati kuye: "Bonani, kulo mji ukhona umuntu waNkulunkulu, mkhulu kakhulu; konke lokushiwo nguye kulungile. Sihambe sifike khona; kungase akhulume nathi indlela esiya kuyo."
USawula watsi kulowo mkhonzi wakhe: "Kube siye, yini lesiya kumnika lowo muntu? Kuphela nekudla etinhlamvuni zethu; asikho nesondlo lesiyawuletha lomuntfu waNkulunkulu. Sikhona yini?"
Waphendvula watsi: "Bona, nginesihlanu seshekeli yegolide; ngiyawuyinikela kulowo muntu waNkulunkulu, aze atitshele indlela lesingahamba ngayo."
Ngaleso sikhathi eSirayeli, lapho umuntu ehamba ebuza uNkulunkulu, wakhuluma watsi: "Thiba, sifike kulowo obona," ngobe lomuntfu waNkulunkulu wasekuhlaleni wabizwa ngokuthi ubona.
USawula watsi kulowo mkhonzi wakhe: "Kulungile; phuma, sihambe." Bahamba bafike emzini lapho umntu waNkulunkulu abehlala khona.
Bafike bafika enhlokodolobha, bahlangana nemadvodza laphuma ekudlaleni amanzi, batsi kubo: "Ukhona yini lokubonayo?"
Baphendvula batsi: "Yebo, wafika ngaphambili kwakho; khawulela, ngobe afike edolobhaneni lethu namuhla, ngoba labantfu banemnikelo wesono ethempelini, emfuleni.

Batsi: "Lowo uyawufika ngelilanga lesikhombisa, bese ningena enhloko-dolobha, ningamuthola ngaphambi kokuba afike enhliziyweni kutsi abe nekudla; ngobe batawudla kuze afike, kodvwa yena kumele abulete lokushiswayo. Ngemuva kwaleso sidlo labamenywe baya kulala. Niyeni namhlanje; ngalesikhathi senu niyakumuthola."
Bafike bafika enhloko-dolobha; bese befika, kwafika uSamuweli, wahlangana nabo, waya phezulu ethempelini.
ngobe Simakadze abevele watsi kuSamuweli, ekuseni ngaphambi kokuba afike uSawula:

"Namuhla, ngaleso sikhathi, ngitakusithumela umuntu ezweni leBenjamini; utawumupha abe nguMengameli webantfu bami base-Israyeli. Uyawubavikela abantu bami emaFilisti; ngobe ngibabone laba bantu bami, ngobe kufike kuye lokushiwo kwabo."
Kwatsi lapho Samuelu ebona khona uSawula, Simakadze watsi kuye: "Lowo ngumuntfu labengingakutshele ngawo; lowo utawulawula abantu bami."
USawula wafika kuSamuele emnyango, watsi: "Nceda, khuluma kimi kutsi yini lendlu yomuntfu lobonako."
Samuweli watsi kuye: "Ngiye lokubonayo; phuma ufike phambi kwami ethempelini, ngobe utawudla nekudla nami ngalolusuku, bese ngikuvumele uhambe ekuseni, bese ngikutshela konkhe lokunengqondo kuwe.
"Nasetingulube letiwulahlekile, letiwulahlekile ngalolusuku lwesihlanu, ungaze ukhathazeke ngazo, ngobe zifunyelwe. Nabo bonke bantfu baseSirayeli bafuna yini wena kanye nendlu yababa bakho bonke?"
USawula waphendula watsi: "Nami senguma-Benjamini, yinye yebantfu labancane eSirayeli, nemndeni wami ungumncane kunawo wonke lamadodana aBenjamini; kungani ukhuluma nami ngalolu daba?
USamuele wabeka uSawula kanye nemkhonzi wakhe embhedeni, wababeka phezulu kulabo abamenywe, labamalunga namakhulu lamashumi lamane.
USamuele watsi kulowo lokudlalela: "Thiba lengxenye yenyama labengingakunikela ngayo, lapho ngikutshele khona kutsi uyigcine phansi."

Watsi umpheki athabathe isifuba, naleso sakubo, wamisa phambi kwa-Sauli. Samuelu watsi: "Bonani lelihlanganisiwe kuwe; udle, ngobe lihlelelwe wena ngalolu daba kusukela kulelo langa lapho ngitsi khona: 'Ngincamisile labangane'." USawula waba nekudla kanye noSamueli lomhla lowo.
Baphuma ethempelini babuyela edolobhaneni, Samuelu wakhuluma naSawula phezu kwetafula lelinetindlu.
Baphuma bafika emini, Samuelu watsi kuSawula phezu kwendlu: "Thintela bese ngikushiya uhambe." Kwatsi lapho Sauli etihlelile khona, waphuma naye naSamuele nabo.

Baphuma bafika emgwaqeni wedolobha, Samuelu watsi kuSawula: "Thipha umkhonzi wakho ukuba ahambe phambi kwethu." Wakwenza njalo; kodvwa Samuelu wathi: "Njengobe uhlala lapha, ngitakulethela impendulo yaSimakadze."
USamuele watsi: "USimakadze utfume wena kutsi ube nguMengameli webantfu bakhe, ngobe nguNkulunkulu loyawukususa esivumelwaneni sakhe nenkhosi yakho.

Uyawuphuma nami ngalolusuku, utawuhlangana namadoda lasitfupha eGileyadi, eZelatha, enhliziyweni yaBenjamini; bayakuphendvula batsi: "Lamagquma afike wawafuna, atholakale, ngobe ubaba wakho akazange acabange ngawo, kodwa wakhathazeka ngenu, watsi: 'Ngingeke ngikwenze yini lomuntfu?'"
Utahamba khona, ufike eTabori, kulapho utawuhlangana khona namadodana lasitfupha aphuma eBheteli, lomunye anesifazane lesithathu, nomnye anesidlo sekudla lesithathu, nomnye anesibhakabhaka sewayini.
Bakubuletela, bakulethela inyama lemibili, wena uyawuyimukela kubo.

"Nalapho ufike eGibeha kaNkulunkulu, lapho kukhona isikhulu seSirayeli; bese uma ufika emgwaqeni, utawuhlangana nebandla lalamaprofeti liphuma emadolobheni, lidlalela ngemibhoshongo, lidlalela ngemibhoshongo, lidlalela ngemibhoshongo, lidlalela ngemibhoshongo, lidlalela ngemibhoshongo, lidlalela ngemibhoshongo, lidlalela, lidlalela, lidlalela.
UMoya waSimakadze utawufika kuwe, nawe uzoba ngumprofeti nabo; wena uyawushintshwa ube ngumuntu lohlukile.
Naleso sikhathi, lapho lemiqondiso iphuma khona, yini nayinye ekufanele uyenze, yenza; ngobe Nkulunkulu uya kuwe.

Lala phambi kwami eGilgala, ngitafika kuwe nginikela ngeminikelo yekushiswa nemnikelo wesondlo sekuthula; ngobe utawuhlala lilanga lesitsatfu, kuze ngifike kuwe, ngikutshele kutsi yini lokufanele uyenze.
Kwatsi lapho uSawula ebuyela esuka kuSamuweli, Simakadze washintsha umphefumulo wakhe; naleso sibonakaliso sonke safika ngalolusuku.
Bafika eGibeha, bafike naSawula kanye nemkhonto wakhe; kodvwa ngaleso sikhathi kwafika ibandla lamaprofeti lahlangana naye. Lomoya waNkulunkulu waba phezu kwakhe, watsi: "Ube sewuprofeta nabo."
Batsi bonke labazange bakubona ngaleso sikhathi, batsi: "Ngubani na lowo mntwana waKishi? USauli naye ungumunye wabaprofeti?"
Waphendula lowo muntu, watsi: "Ubani ubaba wabo?" Ngako kwafika kutsi kube sithiwa: "Ngabe na-Sauli ungumunye wabaprofeta?"
USauli, lapho ephelela khona ekuprofeti, wafika ethempelini.
Watsi umyeni waSawula kuye, naye nalowo mkhonzi wakhe: "Nibe nihamba phi?" Waphendvula watsi: "Siye sifuna izinja; kodvwa sabona sekungaba khona, safika kuSamuweli."
Watsi umkhwenyana waSawula: "Nceda, ukhulume nami kutsi yini leSamuele abekusho kuwe."
USawula watsi kuye: "Wasitshela kutsi izidlovukazi sezafunwa." Kodwa uSawula akazange akhulume naSamueli, watsi: "Uyawube ngunkhosi."
USamuele wahlanganisa bonkhe bantfu beSirayeli kuSimakadze eMizpa.

Wabaphendvula watsi: "Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, utsi: 'Ngiwakhuphule ema-Israyeli eMisrayeli, ngawukhipha ngaphansi kwesandla sema-Israyeli, nangaphansi kwesandla sema-Israyeli, kanye nemandla lawo onke ebukhosini abekucindezela.'

Namuhla-ke niyawushiya loNkulunkulu wenu, lowo utawukusindisa kuwo wonke umonakalo wenu naleyo nkinga yenu, nithi kuye: 'Sibeke ukumkani phezu kwethu.' Ngako-ke manje nifikeni phambi kuSimakadze ngemindeni yenu netikhwele zenu.
USamuele wabeka tonkhe tive taSirayeli tifike, kutsi litfu lelinguBenjamini litfolwe ngeso.
Wafaka kutsi lihlanga laBenjamini lifike, lihlabe ngalihlabe, lihlabe laMatri lahlolwa; lahlolwe nguSawula, unyana kaKishi. Baye bamfuna, kodvwa akazange atholakala.
Baye babuza uSimakadze, batsi: "Uyawufika yini lapha lomuntu?" UNkulunkulu watsi: "Yebo, uyafika; ufihlakele phakathi kwezinto tekudla.
Baphuma, bafike bamkhipha; wahlala emphakathini, waphakama ngenhloko kunebanye bonke.
USamuele watsi kubo bonkhe bantfu: "Nibona yini lomuntfu labewukhethile Simakadze? Akunamunye njengaye kubo bonke bantfu." Batsi nabo bonkhe bantfu, "Kube kuphila ukumkani!"

Samuele wakhuluma kubo, watsi: "Imtsetfo webukhosi kanye nendlela yokuphila kwenkhosi ibhalwe encwadini; Samuele wayibeka phambi kwaSimakadze." Ngako-ke uSamuweli wabasusa bonke abantu, ngamunye waya ekhaya lakhe.
Na-Sauli wabuyela ekhaya lakhe eGibeha, naye abe nebantfu labakhulu, loNkulunkulu abewucebile umphefumulo wabo.
Batsi: "Uyawusivikela kanjani lomuntu?" Bangamhlomula, bangeke bamnike sipho; kepha uSawula akazange akhulume.
Nahashi, umAmoni, waya eJabhesi-Gileyadi, watsi kuye bonkhe bantfu baseJabhesi: "Yenza sivumelwano nathi, nome sitawukukhonza."
Waphendvula watsi: "Ngalesinye simo kuphela lapho ngizokwenza khona umhlanganiso nani, kutsi niphuze mehlo enu lasentshonalanga, ngobe ngaloko ngitawubeka inhlonipho kubo bonkhe bantfu ba-Israyeli."
Batsi kuye bomkhuluwa ba-Yabheshi: "Sinike lilanga lesitsatfu, sitawuthumela lamaphoyisa kuwo onkhe emadolobha ase-Isirayeli; uma kungekho namunye loyawusivikela, sizophuma siye kuwe."
Bafika eGibeha, lapho kwahlala khona uSawula, bakhuluma kubo bonkhe bantfu lamagama lawa; kodvwa bonke labahlali baphuma bekhala.
Bafike bakhuluma kuSawula, batsi: "Kunjani nalaba bantu? Bangani laba licala labo?" Baphendvula batsi: "Laba baseJabheshi batsi: 'Kulungile.'
USawula, lapho akubona amazwi abo, wafika kuye umoya waNkulunkulu, waphuma ebuhlungu kakhulu.

Wathatha ingulube lemibili, wayibopha ingxenye ngayinye, wayisa kuwo wonke lamakhosikazi aseSirayeli, watsi: "Lowo longeke alandele uSawula naSamuweli, kumele abe naloluhlobo lwengulube." Ukuthula kuSimakadze kwafika kubo bonkhe bantfu, baphuma nabo bonke njengendoda eyodwa.
USauli wababala eBezeki, kwafika lamadoda aSirayeli emawaka lamakhulu mathathu, namadoda eJuda emawaka lamashumi amathathu.

Batsi kulabo basendleleni labafikayo, batsi: "Nikhuluma kubo bonkhe bantfu baseJabhesi-Gileyadi nithi: 'Ngokuhlwa, lapho lilanga liphuma lifudumele, nizosindiswa.'" Befike labo basendleleni bekhuluma nabo bonkhe bantfu baseJabhesi, bajabulise kakhulu.
Batsi kubo bonkhe bantfu ba-Ammon: "Namuhla siyawuphuma siye kuwe, utawukwenza nathi konke lokukuhle emehlo akho."

Kutsi kube sekuphele usuku, uSawula wahlukanisa lamadoda akhe abemijondolo emithathu; bafika emgwaqeni wemadvodzana a-Ammon ngaphambi kwelilanga, bababulala kuze kube lilanga lelikhulu. Nalabo labashiyelwe bahlukaniswa, ngobe kungakabi namunye wabo lababini abehlala ndawonye.
Batsi bantfu kuSamuweli: "Ngubani lowawuti, 'USauli kumele abe ngunkhosi yethu?' Thumele kubo lapha, sitawubabulala."
USawula watsi: "Namuhla angeke kube nemuntu lobulawa, ngobe namuhla uSimakadze usewusindise Israele."
Samuweli watsi kubantfu: "Nifike niye eGilgala, siphinde sibeke uSawula kutsi abe ngunkhosi khona."

Batsi bonke bantfu bafike eGilgal, bakhipha uSawula waba ngunkhosi phambi kwaSimakadze, banikela khona ngeminikelo yekuthula phambi kwaSimakadze. NaSauli kanye nabo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli baphumula kakhulu.
USamuele wathi kubo bonkhe bantfu base-Israyeli, "Lawo macebo onke lamicelayo ngiwavumile; ngiyabanika ukumkani.

"Nakho-ke, nine ukumkani loyawuhamba nani; nami sengimtfubi, ngibe nemilenze emnyama, nabona kutsi labantwana bam bakhona phakathi kwenu. Nami ngibe ngumholi wenu kusukela ngemnyaka wami wesifazane kuze kube manje.

Lakho ngikhona; khuluma ngami phambi kuSimakadze, kanye nenkhosi yakhe lekhethiwe: Ngubani lowuthathele ingulube? nani lawunquma ukuthatha isihlalo salowo? yini naye labengudlwengula? yini nayenqaba? yini nayencabalalisa? yini nayencophelela umkhontofo? uma sengikwenza noma yini yalezinto, ngiyayibuyisela.'
Baphendvula batsi: "Wena angeke utfume, noma utfumele, nome uthathe lutho kulowo muntu."
USamuweli wabaphendvula watsi: "Simakadze ubufakazi bakho, kanye noMbuso wakhe lokhethiwe ubufakazi bakho ngalolusuku, kutsi ningathola lutho enhliziyweni yami."Batsi: "Ubufakazi bakhe!"
USamuweli watsi kubo: "Kuye Simakadze lobeka uMosesi na-Aron, kanye nalowakhipha lababa benu ezweni laseMijiphu.
Namuhla, hlalani lapha; ngobe ngizokhuluma nani phambi kwaSimakadze, ngezinto zonke ezilungile letibekiwe nguNkulunkulu kuwe kanye nababa bakho.
"Nalapho labababuleki bakho befika eMijiphu, lapho bathandaza kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, wathumela uMosi na-Aron, wabakhipha emaSirayeli eMijiphu, wababeka lapha endaweni lenye.
Baye balibala uSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wabo; ngobe wabanikela ku-Sisera, umphathi wemphi yaseHazori, nesandla seFilisti, nesandla sebukhosi beMoabi; nabo bahlasela.
Baye bathandaza kuSimakadze, batsi: Sifile; siyawushiya Simakadze, sisebenzele laba-Baali nalaba-Ashtorethi; kepha manje sisindise kusuka kuma-Amoni ne-Astarte; thina siyakukhonza.
Wathumela uYerubahali, naBedani, naJephthah, naSamuweli, wayawukukhulula ebusweni bakho bobubi benu, nihlala niphephile ngaso sonke sikhatsi.
Nalapho nikubonako ukuthi uNahasi, ukumkani wema-Amoni, ephuma ekusihlaselani kwenu, nitsi kimi: Akunjalo, ngobe sifuna kutsi kube ngukumkakhe; ngobe Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, ungumkani wenu.
Namuhla-ke, lapha unkhosi yenu leyo niyikhethile, lona niyawufuna; bona, Simakadze wamisa ukumkani phezu kwenu.

Uma niyethemba uSimakadze, niwukhonze, niwulalela, ningeke nigweme umyalo wakhe; niwe kanye nenkhosi yenu elawula phezu kwenu, uma nilandela uSimakadze Nkulunkulu wenu, nguNkulunkulu wenu, khona-ke kuyoba lula.
Ngako-ke, uma nitsi: 'Asikho isandla sami,' bese ningawuphula lomthetho wakhe, sandla sakhe siyawuba nawe, kanye nesandla sakhe sebabuphikisi bakho.
Ngako-ke hlalani, nibone lesi sigameko esikhulu lesiyawusenza Simakadze phambi kwamehlo enu.
Ngiyakhuluma kuSimakadze, aze atfume imvula nemlilo; khona-ke niyakubona kutsi lokudla lokubi lokwenta emehloni kaSimakadze, lapho nicela khona ukumkani.' "
USamuweli watsi kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli; Simakadze wanikela ngemlilo nemvula ngalolusuku lwakhe. Labantfu bonke bakhathazekile ngaNkulunkulu kanye naSamuele.
Batsi bonke bantfu kuSamuweli: "Lula uSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, ngebantfu bakho, ukuze singafa; ngobe sesivumile lokubi lokucela ukumkani kubo bonkhe labasolwa bethu."
Samuweli watsi kuye: "Ungabi nenkinga; ungenabo lobubi loku, kepha ungase uhambe usuka kuSimakadze, kodwa usebenzele Simakadze ngentliziyo yenu yonke.
Nami, ngiyakucela, ungase uhambe kulandelana kwabo: bangakutfumi nani nakunakusindisa.
Simakadze angeke asuse labantfu bakhe, ngenxa yegama lakhe elikhulu; ngobe uSimakadze wathanda kutsi abe nenu.
Nami, ngingeke ngibe nebubi kuSimakadze, ngatsi ngingavumeli lokuthandaza kwenu; ngobe ngitakusifundisa indlela engcono neyekuhle.
Kuye kutsi nigweme uSimakadze, nimukhonze ngekuthula ngentliziyo yenu yonke; ngobe nicabanga zonke izinto letikhulu azenzayo kwenu.
kodvwa uma nihlala nikwenza lokubi, niyawususwa niye naSimakadze Nkulunkulu wenu.
USawula ubeneminyaka engama-30 ubudala lapho aphuma ebukhosini, waba ngunkhosi yaseSirayeli iminyaka lengema-42.

USauli wakhetha amadoda lamakhulu mathathu eSirayeli; amashumi lamabili abekhona naye eMikmasi nasenhliziyweni yaseBheteli, nelikhulu laba khona noYonatan unyana wakhe eGibeha-Benjamini. Amanye lamadoda waya emakhaya abo.
UJonathani wahlasela isikhulu semaFilisti eGibeha. Lamakhosi aseFilisti akubona, watsi uSawula: "LabaHebhere bakhulume!"
Batsi bonke bantfu baseSirayeli beva kutsi, "Sawule wahlasela umkhosi wema-Filisti, kanye nalabaSirayeli bafike babe nebugebengu ema-Filisti," khona-ke lamaphoyisa ahlangana eGilgala abe nguSaule.

Baphilisithi bahlangana bahlasela Israele, babe nemilenze lemibili yekulwa emashumi mathathu lamakhulu, namadoda angamakhulu lalishumi elinhlanu ahamba ngemoto, namakhosikazi lamakhulu lasitfupha, kanye nebantfu abaningi njengentaba-mlilo ensimini yaselwandle.
Lamadoda aseSirayeli, akubona kutsi abesengozini, ngobe lamakhosi eSirayeli abeseduze kakhulu nabo, wafihla lamadodana akhe emagwaduleni, netingcotweni, netintaba-mlilo, nasemfuleni, nasensimini.
Batsi nalabaHebheru badlula eJordane befika ezweni leGadi neGileyadi; kodvwa uSawula wahlala eGilgal, nabo bonkhe bantfu labahamba naye batfunywa.
Wahlala iminyaka lesikhombisa, kuze kube yilapho Samuelu abememetele khona; kodvwa Samuelu akazange afike eGilgala, ngobe lamadodana ka-Sauli abephuma kuye.
USawula watsi: "Nifikeni nami nemnikelo wekushiswa kanye neminikelo yekuthula." Wanikela ngemnikelo wesono.
Bekungakapheli kutsi afike Samuelu, uSawula waphuma waya kumsindzisa.
USamuweli watsi: "Ukwenze kuphi? "Sawule wathi, "Ngibe ngibona kutsi laba bantu baphuma ngami, nawe ungafikanga ngesikhathi sishoiwe; naphezu kwekunge-ke bantfu baseFilisti behlangana eMikmasi;
ngobe ngitsi: Lapha bayawuphuma labaFilisti ngiyo eGilgala, nami sengingeke ngibuze uSimakadze; ngobe ngacabanga kutsi kufanele nginikeze iminikelo yekushiswa.

Samuweli watsi kuye: "Ukwenzele kahle; awuzange ugcine imiyalo yaSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, lowawukuwisela yona. Ngaleso sikhathi wangeke aqinise ukumkani wako phezu kweSirayeli kuze kube sekupheleni.
Ngaleso sikhathi ubukhosi bakho abungeke buhlale; Simakadze wafuna umuntu ngenhliziyo yakhe, wakubona abe nguMengameli webantfu bakhe, ngobe wena awugcinenga lomthetho waSimakadze.
Samuelu waphuma eGilgala, waya eGibeha yeBenjamini. USawula wababala lamadoda abekhona naye, amalunga namakhulu lamabili nesihlanu.
Sawule naJonathani unyana wakhe, nabo bonkhe bantfu labakhona, bahlala eGibeha-Benjamini; kodvwa labaFilisti bahlala eMikmasi.
Baphuma ema-Amori emphini lalabaFilisti, bahlukaniswa abemaqembu lasitfupha; elinye lalamaqembu lifike eOfra, emhlabatsini waseShuali.
yinye ifike eBethoroni, nesinye sifike emfuleni weSeboyimu, lobhekene nemhlabatsi.
Akukho mkhonzi lofunwa kulo lonke elase-Israyeli; ngobe labaFilisti batsi: "LabaHebhere bangakheti isandla noma inkunzi!"
Ngako-ke bonke laSirayeli babehamba baya kuFilistithi, kutsi baphuze imithi yabo yekulima, nemishado yabo, namahhashi abo, namazinyane abo.

Lentengo yalaba ngumashumi lasitfupha nesihlanu eshekeli, kutsi bacwebeze tingulube kanye nemakhoyi, namashumi lasikhombisa nesihlanu eshekeli, kutsi bacwebeze iforki kanye ne-axis, kanye nekubekwa kwemikhono yengulube.
Kwaba njalo, ngelilanga lemphiko, kutsi angeke kube khona isandla sema-Israyeli, kanye naSawuleli na-Yonatani, esinakwesokudla noma esinakwesobunxele, ngaphandle kwaSawuleli ne-Yonatani unyana wakhe.
Baphilisathi baphuma emphini, befika emgwaqeni wase Mikmasi.
UJonathani, umsa waSawula, watsi kulowo mshayeli wemikhosi yakhe: "Thiba, sihambe siye emgwaqeni wemaFilisti elapho kwesobunxele," kodvwa akazange akhulume nababa wakhe.
USawula wahlala ekungeneni kweGibeha, ngaphansi kwesihlahla se-granate esiseMigron; kwabekhona naye lamadoda angaba ngumakhulu mane.

Kubo kwabekhona naAhiya, umsa wa-Ahitubi, umshado wa-Ikabhodi, umsa wa-Phinehasi, umshado wa-Eli, ukumkani wakwaSimakadze eShilo; naye waba nesigqoko se-ephod. Akukho muntu lowaziyo ukuthi uJonadabu ubesele.

Kubekhona tindzawo letiphakeme, lelinye libizwa ngokuthi i-Bozezi, nelinye libizwa ngokuthi i-Sene, ngalelinye icala nelinye lalelisango, lapho Jonathani abefuna kutsi afike khona emkhosini wemaFilisti.
Lomunye usuka enyakatho kuya eMikmasi, lomunye usuka emgwaqeni waya eGeba.

UYonathani watsi kulowo mshayeli wakhe: "Thiba, sihambe sifike emgwaqeni walemihlambi yebantfu labangenakucircumcithwa; kungase kube nguSimakadze loyawukwenza kutsi siphile, ngobe akukho lokungeke kuvumeleke kuSimakadze, kutsi asindise ngemakhulu noma ngemakhulu lambalwa."
"Yenza konkhe lokunengqondo," watsi umkhwenyana wakhe, "hamba phambili. Ngikhona nawe ngenhliziyo nemoya."
UJonathani watsi: "Thina-ke, fike sihambe sifike kulabo bantu, siboneke kubo.
Batsi-ke kuye: "Thintela khona kuze sifike kuwe," sitawuhlala lapho sikhona, asiye kubo.
Batsi: 'Thintwa nathi,' sitawutinyuka; ngobe lokhu kuyawuba nguphawu lwethu, kutsi Simakadze utawutiwa esandlani sethu.'
Bobabili babonakaliswa emphini yalabaFilisti. Batsi labaFilisti: "Bona, labaHebhere bephuma emigodini yabo lapho befihlekile khona."

Batsi lamadoda asesiteji akhuluma kuYonathani nalowo wabeka isandla sakhe, watsi: "Nifike lapha nathi, sitawukwenta nibone." UYonatan watsi kulowo wabeka isandla sakhe: "Thinda ngemuva kwami, ngobe Simakadze utawubanikela esandlani saSirayeli.
UJonathani wehla ngesandla sakhe kanye nenyawo lakhe, naye lowo umtfubi wakhe waphuma ngemuva kwakhe; kodvwa labaFilisti bahlaselwa nguJonathani, nalowo umtfubi wakhe wababulala emuva kwakhe.
Kulelo hlaselo lokuqala, Jonathani kanye nelabo labasebentisa isandla sakhe babulala bantfu labalishumi nalabamashumi lamane emhlabatsini lobukhulu bawo bufana nephesenti lelinye letfu.

Watsi kwafika umfutho omkhulu kuwo wonke umkhosi wemaFilisti, emgwaqeni nasemhlabatsini; nabo bonkhe bantfu labakhona emgwaqeni kanye nebantfu labaphuma emgwaqeni batfutfuka; nalapho khona umhlaba utfutfuke; kwaba ngumfutho lovela kuNkulunkulu.
Batsi nalabo labahlala eGibeha, eBenjamini, bebona kutsi livi lihamba ngaso sonke sikhatsi.

USawula watsi kubo bonkhe bantfu lababe naye: "Linganisani ibandla, nibone kutsi ngubani loyawusuka nathi." Belikwenta lelinani, babona ukuthi uYonatan kanye nelowo wabeka sibhakabhaka sakhe bebengakho.
USawula watsi ku-Ahiya: "Thingisa lapha ibhokisi laNkulunkulu." Kulelo lilanga libe liseSirayeli,
Wayekhuluma naSawula nenkhosi, wabona kutsi umfutho emphini yalabaFilisti uhamba usakhula; watsi Simakadze kuSawula: "Susa lokho lokwenzayo."
USawula nawo wonke lamadoda akhe ahlangana, wafika emphilweni, wabona kutsi labaFilisti baphazanyiswa kakhulu, nabo bonke bahlaselana ngesandla.
Batsi nalabaHebhere lababe behlala neFilisti ngaphambilini, labengase bafike nabo emgwaqeni, babuyela kwaSirayeli, babe nguSawuweli no-Yonadabu.
Nabo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli labafihle emhlabatsini wa-Efraim, beva kutsi laFilistayi baphuma, bafike nabo emkhosini, bahlasela nalabo.
USimakadze wehlisa iSirayeli ngalolusuku, nemphi yafika eBethe-Aveni.

Lamadoda eSirayeli akazange akhululeke ngalolusuku, ngobe uSawula abewuphazamisa umhlaba, watsi: "Lahlelwe lowo muntfu lodla inyama ngaphambi kwebusuku, kuze kube ngibuyele ngababulalana nabo bonkhe labaholi bami!"
Loluhlanga lonke lwafika emhlabatsini, khona kwakukhona jusi emhlabathini.
Befika emgwaqeni, babona jusi iphuma, kodvwa akukho muntu loyawuyibeka emlonyeni wakhe, ngobe babengeke bakhathazeke ngaleso sifungo.

UYonathani ke akazange akhulume lapho ubaba wakhe ememezela khona ibandla; watsi: "Ngisho nesokudla sesandla sakhe, wamisa kulolu mhlabatsi lwamakhowe. Wabeka umlomo wakhe emlonyeni wakhe, namehlo akhe lakhanya."
Wakhuluma kuye omunye webantfu, watsi: "Ubaba wakho wabeka livi lelinyenti, watsi: 'Lalakeni lowo muntfu lodla ukudla ngalolusuku.' Ngako-ke laba bantu bahlupheka kakhulu."
UJonathani watsi: "Ubaba wami ubeke lelizwe engozini; ningabona kutsi mehlo ami ajabulile, ngobe ngadla umhluzi loncane.
Kungeke kube ngcono yini kutsi laba bantu baphuze lilanga lenu lokudla kwabo lokudliwe kulabo labehlukumezako; khona-ke sitawubulala labaFilisti labaningi kakhulu!
Lamadvodza ase-Israyeli abulala labaFilisti leso sikhatsi kusuka eMikmasi kuya eAyaloni; lamadoda ase-Israyeli abengeke ahambe.
Bafike bahlasela lokudla lokudliwe, babulala emakhowe, nengulube, nenyama yengulube, bayibulala phansi, badla inyama negazi lalelo.
Batsi: "Bona, laba bantu baphazamisa uSimakadze, bedla inyama negazi kulo." USawula watsi kubo: "Ube sewukhohliwe; dlulisa lapha licwengwa elikhulu!"

Watsi: "Thina-ke, phuma kulabo bantu, ukhulume nabo, utsi: 'Nifikeni lapha ninike wonke umuntu inkomo yakhe kanye nengulube yakhe, niyikhwele lapha, niyidle; kodvwa ningabi nesono kuSimakadze ngekudla inyama negazi layo.'" Bafika khona bonkhe bantfu ngaleyo ntambama, banikela khona ngenkomo yabo.
USauli watsi: "Namuhla ngusuku lwakhe lokukhulu, ngobe nguNkulunkulu loyawutfumisa emhlabatsini lwawo."

Watsi uSawula: "Thinge sihambe ngemuva kwalabaFilisti ngalebusuku, sibahlasele kuze kube ekuseni, asishiyenga namunye kubo." Baphendvula batsi: "Nikwenze lokuhle emehlo enu." Lomnikelo wesono watsi: "Siye sibuze Nkulunkulu lapha."
USawula wabuza uNkulunkulu, watsi: "Ngaba kufanele ngihambe ngasePhalisti? Ingabe utawubanikela esandlani saSirayeli?" Kodwa uThixo akazange amphendule ngalolusuku.
USawula watsi: "Nifike lapha, nibaholi bonke bebantfu, kutsi sibone ukuthi yini leyenteke namuhla.
Ngako-ke uSawula watsi kuye: "Ngiphila Simakadze, Lowusindisa iSirayeli, nakuba nguYonathani, mntwana wami, kufanele aphelelwe!" Akukho mntu walaba bantu lokhuluma.
USawula watsi kubo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli: "Nihlale lapha, nami naYonatan unyana wami siyawuhlala lapha." Baphendvula batsi: "Nceda nikwenze lokuhle emehlo enu."
USawula wathandaza kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, watsi: "Nceda utfumise impendulo ecacile." UJonathani naSauli babekwa ngesandla; laba bantu bakhululwa.
Simakadze watsi kuSawula: "Thipha sandla phakathi kwami naJonathani unyana wami." NaJonathan wabekwa sandla.
USawula watsi kuJonathani: "Sichaze kutsi ukwenzeni yini."UJonathani watsi kuye: "Ngiye ngadla ummbila omncane ngesokudla setintfwalo tami; namuhla ngiyafa!"
USawula watsi: "Nkulunkulu aninike lokhu kanye nekunye, uma ungafa, Jonathane."

Bathi kubo uSawula: "Uyafa yini uYonathani, lowenza lokukhulu lokukhulu kuSirayeli? Kungeke kube njalo; njengoba Nkulunkulu ephilayo, akusho kutsi yinye inwele yenhloko yakhe iphele phansi, ngobe wakwenza lokhu namuhla ngesandla saNkulunkulu." Ngako laba bantu bakhipha uYonathani, watsi: "Ase afile.
USauli wabuyela emuva, washiya labaFilisti; bonkhe babuyela emhlabatsini labo.
USawula waba ngunkhosi yase-Israyeli, wehla ekulwa nabo bonkhe lababuphikisi bakhe: neMowabi, nemadvodzana a-Ammon, neEdomu, nebukhosi be-Zoba, nalabaFilisti; lapho abuyela khona, wahlasela.
Waba nemandla ekulwa, wahlasela ema-Amaleki, wabavikela laSirayeli emlonyeni wabo labababulala.
Labantwana baka-Sauli: uJonathani, ne-Ishivi, ne-Malkhi-Shua; igama lelikhulu nguMerabi, nelincane liyiMikha.
Umkakhe waba nguAhinoamu, indodana ka-Ahimahazi; umkhosi waSawula ube nguAbner, unyana kaNeri, lomkhuluwa wakhe.
Kishi, ubaba waSawula, neNeri, ubaba waAbner, babenemadvodzana aAbiyeli.
Kube khona kulwa lokukhulu nalabaFilistimi iminyaka yonke yaSawula; lapho abona khona umuntu lonamandla, noma umshayeli, wabeka kuwo.
USamuweli watsi kuSawula: "Simakadze ungithumela kutsi ngikukhonze ube nguMengameli webantfu bakhe base-Israyeli; ngobe namuhla ulalele ilizwi laSimakadze.
Simakadze Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli utsi: "Ngitakwenta kutsi kube khona lokubi ku-Amaleki, ngenxa yalento ayenze kuboSirayeli, lapho bebahlasela khona lapho bephuma eMijiphu.
Hamba, bese uhlasela lamadodana e-Amaleki, uyeke lutho lobe nalo; ungawakhathaleli; bulala amadoda nabesifazane, nezingane nalabo labakhulelwe, nengulube naleyo minja, negremu nalowo mkhwenyana.
USawula wahlangana nabo bonkhe bantfu eTelayini, wababala labahamba ngenyawo lamakhulu mahlanu lamawaka, kanye nemadvodzana aYuda lamawaka lamabili.
USawula wafika enhloko-dolobha ya-Amaleki, wabeka umkhosi wekulwa efuleni.

Wathi kubo-ke uMosi: "Thumelani, phumani ku-Amaleki, ngobe ngitawukubulala nani kanye nabo; ngobe niwenzile lokuhle kubo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli, lapho besuka eMisri." Ngako bo-Kenisi baphuma phakathi kwa-Amaleki.
USawula wababulala laba-Amaleki kusuka eHavila kuya eShure, lapho befika khona ema-Egipti.
Wathatha uAgagi, ukumkani we-Amaleki, ephilayo, wabulala wonke lamakhosi akhe ngesandla sakhebhe.

Ngako-ke uSawula nebantfu baletsa Agagi, naleyo mihlambi yengulube lengcono, neleyo mihlambi yemvu, neleyo mihlambi yetimbuti, neleyo mihlambi yembumbulu, neleyo mihlambi yekulandza, nabo bonke labalungile; bengeke bayeke kuyawubulala kuwo wonke, kodvwa nabo bonkhe labo lababi nelabafile bayawubulala.
Kuye kwafika kuSamuele lizwi laSimakadze, watsi:
Watsi: "Nginesifiso sokwenza uSawula waba ngunkhosi, ngobe wabuyela emuva ngami, akazange aphumeze amazwi ami." Samuweli wahlupheka kakhulu, wathandaza kuSimakadze ngalobusuku bonke.
Samuweli wavuka ekuseni, waya kuhlangana naSauli. Bakhuluma kuSamuweli batsi: "Sauli ufike eKarmeli, uye wamisa inhloko yakhe, waphuma waya eGilgali."
USamuele wafika kuye, uSawula watsi: "UNkulunkulu ubambisene nawe; ngiwuphumelele umyalo wakhe."
Samuelu watsi: "Ngubani na lowo msindo wema-orenji lofika emandlebeni ami, nokuthi yini lemvumi yengulube engiyibona?"

USawula watsi: "Kusuka ku-Amaleki bayawubanikela kubo, ngobe labahamba phambili emihlambini yengulube neyengulube bebaligcina, kutsi babe ngumnikelo wekushiswa kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho; kepha lokunye sitawukuphelisa.
Samuweli watsi kuSawula: "Kulungile, hlala ngikutshele kutsi yini leSimakadze abekhuluma nami ngelilanga lelidlule." USawula watsi: "Ungikhulumela."
Wathi uSamuweli: "Kube wena, nakuba ubencane emehlo akho, awusekho sewuye waba yinhloko yemakhosikazi aseSirayeli? USimakadze wehlisele ukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli.
USimakadze wehlule wena, watsi: Yiya, ugweme lamadodana la-Amalekhi, labo ababusi; kulwa nabo kuze ubasuse.
Ngubani na lokwenta kutsi ungeke ulalele lizwi laSimakadze? Ngubani na lokwenza kutsi uhambe ufike kulelo ligugu, ukwenze lokubi emehloni kaSimakadze?"
USawula watsi: "Ngiye ngalalela ilizwi laSimakadze, ngahamba ngendlela leyo Simakadze abemimise kuyo, ngabulala bo-Amaleki, ngabuyisela uAgagi ukumkani wabo.
Amaphoyisa athathe emabhubesi nengulube kuleyo ndlala, lokudla lokuhle kunawo wonke, kutsi abe ngumnikelo wekushiswa kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho eGilgali.
Samuweli watsi: "UNkulunkulu uthanda yini mnikelo wekushiswa kanye neminikelo yekushiswa, njengakulalela kuSimakadze? Kulalela kungcono kunalemihlambi yengulube, nokulalela kungcono kunalesisu semvu.
Ukuphambukela kufana nebugebengu bendlela, futhi ubuhlungu benhliziyo bufana nobubi bendlela; ngobe usabekele amazwi kaSimakadze, naye usabekele wena kutsi ungaba ngunkhosi.
USawula watsi kuSamuweli: "Ngifile, ngobe ngaphula mthetho waSimakadze kanye nemithetho yakho; ngobe ngiyesaba laba bantu, ngabavumela.
Manje-ke, ngiyakucela, lungisa isono sami, ubuye nami, kutsi ngibe nekuthula kuSimakadze.
USamuweli watsi kuye: "Ngingeke ngibuye nawe, ngobe utawuphelelwa lizwi nguSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, naSimakadze utawupheliswa wena, ukuze ungaba ngumphathi waSirayeli."
Ngako-ke, lapho Samuelu ebuyelela khona kutsi ahambe, uSawula wancenga umlenze wemicaba yakhe, wayicoca.
USamuweli watsi kuye: "USimakadze uvule namuhla ukumkani kwaSirayeli kuwe, wawunikela kumfana wakho longcono kunawe.
LoNkulunkulu, lowo mkhulu kuSirayeli, angeke akhohlwe noma ashintshe ingqondo yakhe, ngobe yena angeke abe ngumuntu loshintsha ingqondo yakhe.
USawula watsi kuye: "Ngifile; kepha, ngiyakucela, ungihloniphe phambi kwabakhulu bebantfu bami kanye nenkhosi yase-Israyeli, ubuye nami, ngobe ngifuna kuthandaza kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho."
USamuele wabuyela walandela uSawula, watsi uSauli: "Ngubani na lowo lokhuluma nami?
Samuweli watsi: "Nifikeni nami kuAgagi, ukumkani wema-Amaleki." UAgagi wafika kuye ekhululeke kakhulu, watsi: "Ngabe buhlungu bekufa buphelile?"
Samuweli watsi: "Ngendlela isandla sakho senze khona labesifazane banganeni, kanjalo namama wakho angeke abe nentsana phakathi kwabesifazane." USamuweli wabulala uAgagi phambi kuSimakadze eGilgala.
Samuweli waphuma waya eRama, kodvwa uSawula waya endlini yakhe eGibeha yaSawula.
USamuweli akazange aphinde abone uSawula kuze kube ngusuku lwakhe lokufa, ngobe wathandaza kuSawula; kodvwa Simakadze waba necala lokwenza uSauli ukumkani phezu kweSirayeli.

USimakadze watsi kuSamuweli: "Utahlala nini uhlupheka ngenxa ya-Sauli, ngobe ngiyawumisa kutsi angeke abe ngunkhosi yaseSirayeli? Dlulisa indlebe yakho ngemafutha, uyeke; ngiyakuthumela kuYese waseBethlehem, ngoba ngiyenzile lomunye wemadvodzana akhe ukuba abe ngubukhosi.
Samuweli watsi: "Ngingeke ngihambe kanjani? Uma uSauli ekhuluma ngalo, uyangibulala." USimakadze watsi: "Thiba nengulube nawe, utsi: 'Ngafika nginikela ngesondlo kuSimakadze.'
Lalela uIsayi kutsi afike ekudlaleni, bese ngikukhombisa lokho lokufanele ukwenze; wena utawumbukisa lowo ngiyawukusho kuwe.
Samuelu wakwenza kutsi Simakadze abekhuluma kuye. Wayefika eBethlehem, baphuma bomkhuluwa balo mji bemuhlangana nabo, batsi: "Ufika kanjani ngekuthula?"
Samuweli watsi: "Kunekuthula; ngifike ngiyonikela ngesondlo kuSimakadze; ngcweleni, nive nami esondleni." Wangcwelena naJese nemadvodzana akhe, wabamemelela esondleni.
Bafika, Samuelu wabona uEliabu, watsi: "Lewo ngulowo Simakadze abewukhethele, lohlala lapha phambi kwaSimakadze."

USimakadze watsi kuSamuweli: "Ungeke ubheke buhle bakhe, noma ubude bakhe; ngobe sengiwubeke phansi. Simakadze angeke abhekane nemehlo lamuntu; ngoba umuntu ubheka lobuso bakhe, kodwa Nkulunkulu ubhekana nemphefumulo wakhe."
UJese watsi ku-Abinabadi, wamshiya ahambe phambi kwaSamuele; kodvwa Samuele watsi: "Simakadze akawukhethi nalowo."
UJese watsi ku-Shama: "Thina-ke sitawuhamba; kodvwa Samuelu watsi, "Simakadze akazange akhethe nalo."
UJese watsi kuyise: "Njengomfana wakhe wesishiyagalolunye lohamba phambi kukaSamuweli, uSamuele watsi kuye: 'Simakadze akazange awakhethe labo.'

UJese watsi kuye: "Aba nabo bonke labangani bakho?" UJese watsi: "Kusekhona lowo mncane, ngobe uhlala egcina tingulube." USamuweli wathi: "Thumela ufike umfune, ngoba asikuhlale sidla ukudla kuze afike."
UJese wathumela, watsi: "Thintela ufike," wafika naye. Amehlo akhe abemhlophe, akhanya kakhulu, nebuso bakhe buhle kakhulu. Simakadze watsi kuye: "Suka, umhlobise; ngobe lo nguye."
USamuele watsi: "Ngubani na lowo muntfu?" Samuele watsi: "NguSimakadze." Samuweli wehla eRama, wathatha inhloko yemafutha, wamphilisa phambi kwabazalwane bakhe.
Lomoya waSimakadze wabasuka kuSawula, ngobe lomoya lombi losuka kuSimakadze ubewumupha.
Baphendvula batsi: "Ngibona, umphefumulo lobi losuka kuNkulunkulu utfusa wena.
Nkosi yethu ivumele labakhonzi bayo bafune umuntu lodlala kahle, kutsi lapho umphefumulo lombi kusuka kuNkulunkulu efika kuwe, abe nguwo lodlala, nawe ukhululeke.
USawula watsi kubo bonkhe bantfu bakhe: "Thiphani muntfu lodlala kahle, nifikeni kum."
Waphendvula watsi: "Ngibone unyana ka-Isai waseBethlehem, lowazi kutsi udlala kanjani, naye ungumshayeli lonamandla, umshayeli wemphi, ukhuluma kahle, ubukeka kahle; Simakadze ukhona naye."
USawula watsi kuJesha: "Thumela kumntwana wakho uDavide, lohlala netinkomo."
UJese watsi: "Njengomkhwenyana, uphindze unciphise inhlama, nebhodlela lewayini, nalowo mntwana wengulube, uyewuthumela kuSawula ngesandla saDavide, umsa wakhe.
UDavide wafika ku-Sauli, waba ngumkhonzi wakhe; u-Sauli wamthanda kakhulu, watsi: "UDavidhi abe ngumunye welabo labanesibhakabhaka sakhe.
USawula watsi ku-Isayi: "Lala uDavide ahlale endlulweni yami, ngobe ngiyamthanda kakhulu."
Nalapho umoya weNkulunkulu ufika khona kuSawula, Davide wakhipha icwecwe lakhe, wadlala; watsi: "Sauli uyakhululeka, uhlala kahle, umphefumulo lobi uphuma kuye."
BaFilisti bahlanganisa imikhosi yabo kutsi bahlasele, bahlangana eSokho, lasesiJudani, bamisa tindlu tabo phakathi kweSokho neAzeka, e-Efesu-Dammim.
USawula namadoda aseSirayeli ahlangana, bamisa tindlu tabo emfuleni i-Elaha, balungiselela ukulwa nabaFilisti.
BaFilisti bahlala emadolobheni lasentshonalanga, neSirayeli behlala emadolobheni lasentshonalanga; kwabekhona lomfula phakathi kwabo.
Waphuma emphini yalabaFilisti umshayeli, igama lakhe bekunguGoliyathi, waseGati; wamamitha lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu ngebude.
Wagqoka i-helmet ye Bronze kanye ne-armor eyenziwe nge-bronze scales, eyisisindo lesilinganiselwa kumashumi lamabili nesikhombisa emakilogramu.
Wabe nemilenze yegolide, naye wabeka lilanga lesiliva emphinjeni yakhe, wabeka nesilenge segolide emuva kwakhe.
Isandla sakhe semphini sabe siqinile njengetintambo tembukeli, nenhloko yakhe yensimbi yafika kumashumi lamane esiliva namakhulu lasitfupha egolide; lowo umkhweli wemiyalelo wahamba phambi kwakhe.
UGoliathi wahlala, watsi kubo-Israyeli: "Ngubani na lowo lohamba esigabeni sokulwa? Lami ngiye umFilisti, nibo abakhonzi bakaSawule; khetheni lomunye lamadodana enu, mnikeze kutsi afike kum.
Uma angaba nemandla ekulwa nami, bese embulala, khona-ke sitawuba baholi benu; kepha uma ngiwuphumelela, bese umbulala, khona-ke niyawuba baholi bethu, nitawusisebentisa.
LoFilisti watsi: "Namuhla sengiphazamisa imiyalelo yaSirayeli; nikela nami ngumfana, sihlangane naye."
USawula kanye nabo bonkhe bantfu base-Israyeli bakhuluma amazwi lalowo Mfilisti, bakhatsazeka kakhulu, balahlekelwa ngumoya wabo.
UDavide waba ngunyana kaJese, umEfrati waseBethelehemu eYuda; uJese wayenemadvodzana amashumi lamane; kuleso sikhathi saSawula wayeneminyaka emikhulu.
Lamadodana laJese lamakhulu layawuhamba naSawula emphini; lomkhulu waba nguEliyaba, wesibili waba nguAbinabadi, wesihlanu waba nguShama.
Davide angeke abe mkhulu kunabo, ngobe labakhulu batawulandela uSawula.
Davide waphuma waya eBetheleyimu, wabuyela kwaSauli kutsi agcine tingulube tayise.
LoFilisti wafika ekuseni nakusihlwa, wehla ebusweni bakhe, iminyaka lemashumi mane.
UJese watsi kuDavide, mntwana wakhe: "Thiba lebhodlela lelinjalo nekudla lokucwebezelayo kanye nalemifino lengema-10, uhambe uyinike labangani bakho emakhazeni.
Lawa ma-cheese lamashumi lamane afike kumphathi weqembu labo, ubone kutsi bazalwane bakho baphila kanjani, bese ubuyela kubo ngezindaba.
Bakhona naSawula, nabo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli eGiliyadi, bekulwa neFilistayi.

UDavide wavuka ekuseni kakhulu, watsi: "Lama-Israyeli ayawuphuma emphilweni yakhe" ngobe uYese abemtshele. Wafika esibhedlela lapho livi lelikhulu nemashumi lamane nelisihlanu sebantfu beluvela khona, batsatsa tindlu takubo kanye nalabo labahamba nabo.
LaSirayeli nalabaFilisti balungiselela ukulwa, lomunye nenye.
UDavide washiya impahla yakhe kumphathi wezinto, wabaleka waya emkhosini, wabuza labangane bakhe kutsi baphila kanjani.
Wayekhuluma nabo, khona-ke loGoliathi, umFilisti lowo waseGathi, waphuma emphini yakhe, watsi: "Ngubani na lowo muntfu?" Davide wakubona.
Lamadoda aseSirayeli, lapho akubona lomuntfu, laphuma emphilweni yakhe, aloba kakhulu.

Lamadvodza ase-Isirayeli abethi, "Ubona yini lomuntfu lophumayo? Uphuma kutsi abusise lamakhosikazi e-Isirayeli. Lowo loyawumubulala, unkhosi itawumnikela ngemandla amakhulu, nayo itawumnika intombi yakhe njengenkosikazi, nemndeni wakhe ungeke ukhokhe tinhlawulo e-Isirayeli."

UDavide wababuza lamadoda ahlala emphilweni yakhe, watsi: "Ngubani lowo muntu loyawubulala loFilisti, aze asuse lokubi eSirayeli? Ngubani loFilisti longakacutshungulwa, kutsi abekulahlekela imiyalelo yeNkulunkulu ophilayo?"
Batsi kuye kutsi yini lekumele ikwenzelwe lowo loyawumubulala.

UElibha, lomkhulu kuDavide, wava kutsi ukhuluma nalaba bantu; watsi kuye: "Ngubani wena lowo wehla lapha? Natsi yini lemihlambi emincane labewushiyela kulomhlabatsini? Ngiyazi buhlungu bakho kanye nebubi benhliziyo yakho. Waphuma nje ukubukela umkhosi."
UDavide watsi: "Ngubani na longingayenzile? Ingabe ngingeke ngikhulume?"
Wabuyela kumunye, wabuza lombuzo lowo; baphendvula batsi: "Sekube sekuphele iminyaka lengemashumi lamane.
Lamazwi laDavide afunwa, wabhalwa kuSawula; watsi uSauli: "Thina-ke siyawumubiza."
UDavide watsi kuSawula: "Kungeke kube khona muntfu lotsi: Lakho isandla sakho siyawuphazamiseka ngenxa yalo mFilisti; umkhonzi wakho utawuhamba, uyawukulwa naye."
USawula watsi kuye: "Ungeke ube nekhono lokuya kulowo Mfilisti ukulwa naye, ngobe wena ungumfana, yena ke ungumuntu wekulwa kusukela ekukhuleni kwakhe."
UDavide watsi kuSawula: "Lomuntfu wakho wagcina tingulube tababa wakhe, lapho kwafika khona linyoni, noma umkhwenyana, wathatha ingulube emndenini.
Nami ngaya emva kwayo, ngayibulala, ngayikhulula inkomo emlonyeni wayo; kodvwa lapho ibuyela kum, ngayibamba ngemilenze yayo, ngayibulala.
Lomuntfu wakho wabulala ingulube kanye nemvu; loFilisti, lowo angeke acwecwe, uzoba njengelinye lalawo, ngobe waphazamisa imikhosi yeNkulunkulu lophilayo.
Simakadze, lowo longithetse esandlani sengulube nesandlani sema-Amori, naye utatitfusa emandleni lalowo Mfilisti.'" 19Sawule watsi kuDavide: "Hamba; Nkulunkulu abe nawe!"
USauli wehlisa Davide ngemigqomo yakhe, wamisa ingubo yekulwa kuye, wabeka inhlavu yesiliva enhloko yakhe.

UDavide wagqoka isandla saSawula phezu kwempahla yakhe, watsi: "Ngingeke ngihambe ngalento," ngobe akazange ayisebenzise. Wathi kuSawula: "Ngingeke ngihambe ngalento, ngobe angiyisebenzisi." Wayisusa.
Wathatha isandla sakhe, wakhetha ematshe lamile lalishumi elinesihlanu emfuleni, wawabeka ebhokisini lakhe lekudlalela, wabeka nentambo yakhe ngesandla sakhe, wafika kulowo mFilisti.
LoFilisti wafika waya eDavideni, nalowo umkhweli wesikhongo wayehamba phambi kwakhe.
Wabona uDavide, wakubona kutsi ungumfana, umtfubi kakhulu, nemehlo akhe abukeka kahle; watsi: "Ngubani lowo?
Watsi uFilisti kuDavide: "Ngabe ngiyinja, kutsi uya kumya nami ngetinti?" UFilisti wehlalela uDavide ngamandla akhe.
Watsi kuye: "Thinda lapha, ngitakunikela ngenyama yakho emaphiko emhlaba kanye nebantfu bemhlaba."

UDavide watsi kulowo Mfilisti: "Uya kumkela ngesandla, nesihlalo, nesibhakabhaka; kodwa mina ngiya kuwe ngegama laSimakadze Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, loNkulunkulu wama-Israyeli, lowo utawuwuphazamisa.

Simakadze utawukunikela ngesandla sami ngalolusuku, ngikubulala, ngikucishe inhloko yakho; futhi ngitabeka emacwecwe emphi yeSirayeli kulolusuku kulabo bafileyo, kumaphiko emhlaba kanye nenyama lephilayo, ukuze umhlaba wonke ubone ukuthi kukhona Nkulunkulu eSirayeli.
Nabo bonke laba bahlangane lapha, bangasazi kutsi uSimakadze awusindisi ngekhefu nasengcindezi; lokulwa nguNkulunkulu, naye uyakunikela esandla sethu.
Ngako-ke, lapho loFilisti efika emphilweni yakhe, Davide wajika waya emgwaqeni wakhe kutsi amhlangane.
Wafika ebhokisini lakhe, waphuma khona nelitfuba, wehlisa, wabulala loFilisti emlonyeni wakhe; lelitfuba lafika emlonyeni wakhe, wagwadla buso bakhe phansi.
Ngako-ke uDavide wahlasela loFilisti ngesandla sakhe, ngobe angeke abe nesikhephe emlenzeni wakhe; wabulala lowo Philistimi, watsi: "Uyawufa."

UDavide wabaleka, wehla phezu kwakhe, wakhipha isandla seFilisti, wambulala, wamisa inhloko yakhe ngesandla sakhe, watsi: "Uphi nalowo muntfu lophilayo, uyawufa." Bekubona bantfu baseFilisti kutsi umlingisi wabo ufile, babuyela emuva, baphuma.

Lamadoda ase-Israyeli nawaseJuda aphuma, wakhipha umsindo, wababulala labaFilisti kuya eGathi kanye nezingcingo ta-Akroni; lamakhosikazi ase-Israyeli nase-Akroni aboshwa phandle kwendlela yaseShaaraim.
Batsi babuyela bantfu beSirayeli, balandzela labaFilistimi, babulala emakhaya abo.
UDavide wathatha inhlavu yalo Mfilisti, waya nayo eJerusalema; lemikhosi yakhe yayiyibeka entanyeni yakhe.
USawula, lapho ebona uDavide ephuma emveni komFilisti, watsi ku-Abner, umphathi wesive: "Abner, lomunye walowo mntwana nguwuphi?"U-Abner watsi: "Ngekuphila kwakho, Nkulunkulu wakho, angiwazi."
Unkhosi yatsi: "Khangela kutsi lomuntfu lomncane ngumnyaka wabani."
Ngako-ke uDavide, lapho ebuyela khona ngemuva kwekudlwengula loFilisti, Abneri wamthatha, wayawubeka phambi kwaSawula; Davide wagcina inhloko yeloFilisti.
USawula watsi kuye: "Wenani lomuntfu, wena umshado?" UDavide waphendvula watsi: "Ngiye umnikelo wa-Isayi waseBethlehem,"
Watsi lapho Davide ephelela khona kukhuluma naSawula, uJonadabu wahlangana naye ngemoya wakhe, watsi: "Uyawumthanda njengobe uyamthanda yena."
Ngaleso sikhathi uSawula wagcina Davide, watsi: "Angeke amvumele abuye ekhaya lakhe lobaba."
UJonathani wakwenza umhlangano naDavide, ngobe wamthanda njengetfu lakhe.
UJonathani wehlisa ingubo yakhe, wayinikela kuDavide, kanye nempahla yakhe, nasengcindezi yakhe, nasetindzaweni zakhe, nasemqoka wakhe.
Nalapho uSawuleli abemthumela khona, Davide waphumelela kakhulu; ngobe uSawuleli wambeka phezu kwalabo labahamba naye; kwaba lula kubo bonkhe bantfu, nalabaphathi beSawuleli.

Bafika besuka kuDavide, lapho abewubulala khona loFilisti. Baphuma emabhishi lamakhosikazi aseSirayeli, bahlangana noSawula, ukumkani, benemiculo, nemimkhosi, nemsindo, nasendleleni, nabo bonke labafileyo.
Bakhuluma, batsi: "Sawule wabulala lamakhulu akhe, kodvwa Davide lamashumi lamakhulu akhe."
USawula wehla ebuhlungu kakhulu, watsi: "Bemnike Davide emaphesenti lamakhulu lamashumi lamabili, nami ngibanike lamaphesenti lamakhulu lasitfupha; yini angeke abe nayo, ngaphandle kwebukhosi?
Ngaleso sikhathi, uSawula wabuka Davide ngemehlo akhe aphikisayo.

Kwatsi ekuseni kwafika umoya lobi kusuka kuSimakadze, wahlasela Saulo, watsi: "Ube sewuhamba endlwini yakhe; Davide ke ubedlala i-harpa, njengobe wayehlala abedlala njalo; ngobe Sauli abenesibhakabhaka emlenzeni wakhe.
Wayikhipha, watsi: "Ngitamisa uDavide embhedeni." UDavidhi waphuma kuye emaphiko lasitfupha.
USawula walibala Davide, ngobe Simakadze abe nguDavide, kodvwa uSauli ubesuka kuye.
Ngako-ke uSawula wamshiya Davide, wamisa enhloko yamakhulu lamakhulu; watsi: "UDavide uyaphuma abe nguMengameli webantfu emkhosini."
Kuso sonke kutsi akwenze, waphumelela kakhulu; ngobe Simakadze abe naye.
USauli, lapho ebona khona kutsi uDavide uhamba kahle kakhulu, waphindze wamlibala.
Ngako-ke bonkhe labaSirayeli nalabaYuda babemthanda Davide, ngobe wabahamba nabo emidlalweni.

Watsi uSawula kuDavide: "Hlela, ngitakulethela umkakhe lomkhulu, uMerabhi, kutsi abe ngumfazi wakho; hlala nje usebenza kimi ngemandla akho kanye nekulwa kwakho naSimakadze." USawula watsi: "Ngingeke ngiwufake umunwe wami kuye; baFilisti bangakwenza kanjalo!"
UDavide watsi kuSawula: "Ngubani nami, yini lemndeni wami, yini lendlu yababa bami eSirayeli, kutsi ngibe ngumkakhe wenkhosi?"
Kwafika sikhatsi saMerabhi, intombi yaSawula, sekuyitfunywa kuDavide; watsi: "U-Adriyeli waseMehola utawuyinika yena indodana yakhe."
Mehola, intondza ka-Sauli, wathandana naDavide; bakhuluma kubo u-Sauli, watsi kulungile.
Watsi: "Ngiyawumnikela kuye, ukuze abe yintambo yakhe, kutsi baFilisti bambulala." USawula watsi kuDavide: "Namuhla utawube ngumyeni wami ngelinye ilanga."
USawula wabaletsa labakhonzi bakhe, watsi: "Nikhulume naDavide ngemfihlo, nitsi: 'Namuhla utawube ngumngane wakhe; ngobe ukumkani uthanda wena, nabo bonke labakhonzi bakhe bakuthanda nawe.'"
Bakhuluma kubo Simakadze, watsi kubo: "Kungekuhle yini kuwe kutsi ube ngumelwane wenkhosi? Nami sengumtfubi, ngingeke ngibe mkhulu kakhulu."
Bafike bakhuluma kuSawula, batsi: "UDavide utsi:

USawula watsi, "Nitsi kuDavide: 'Ubukhosi abufunanga mnikelo wesono, ngaphandle kwesikhumba semaFilisti lamashumi lamakhulu, ukuze ugweme ema-Amoni.'" USawula wacabanga kutsi abulala Davide ngesandla salabaFilisti.
Bakhuluma kuDavide, watsi: "Kulungile kuwe kutsi ube ngumunye wemadvodzakati enkhosini." Kube sekungakapheli sikhatsi lesidze,

UDavide waba nebantfu bakhe naye, waphuma, wabulala labaFilisti lamakhulu mahlanu; watsi uDavidhi afike abe nemilenze yabo lemincane, wayalela ukumkani ukuba abe ngumngane wakhe. Ngako-ke uSawula wamnika intombi yakhe, iMikhaleli, kutsi ibe ngumfazi.
USauli wabona kutsi uSimakadze ube neDavide, naMikhayeli into yakhe yayawumuthanda.
Waye wahlala esaba Davide kakhulu, waba ngumfoti wakhe kuze kube sekuphele iminyaka yakhe.

Baphuma khona abaphathi beFilisti, baphuma nabo emkhosini; ngaso sonke isikhathi lapho bephuma khona, uDavide waphumelela kakhulu kunabo bonke labakhonzi baka-Sauli, ngobe igama lakhe lafika libe lihle kakhulu.
USawula wakhuluma kuJonathani unyana wakhe, nakubo bonke labakhonzi bakhe, kutsi babulala Davide; kodvwa Jonathani unyana waSawula wabathanda kakhulu Davide.
Watsi uDavide: "Sawule, ubaba wami, ufuna kukubulala; qaphela ngekusasa, uye kulapho uhlala khona, bese uhlala khona.
Ngitaphuma, ngifike kubaba wami emhlabatsini lapho ukhona khona, ngingakhuluma naye ngawe; nome yini lengisayibona, ngiyakutshela.
UJonathani wakhuluma kahle ngeDavide kuSawula, ubaba wakhe, watsi kuye: "Ubukhosi bungeke buphikelele kumkhonzi bawo uDavide; ngobe akakuphikelelani nawe, kodvwa lokudla kwakhe kukusize kakhulu.

Wabeka sandla sakhe emphilweni yakhe, wabulala loFilisti; ngobe uSimakadze wehlisele lokukhulu kubo bonkhe labaSirayeli, nawe wakubona, waphumula; yini-ke kutsi ube necala kuDavide, lowo mntu ongenacala, ukumbulala ngaphandle kwecala?
USawula walalela uJonathani, watsi: "Ngiphila Simakadze, uDavide ngeke abulawa."
UJonathani watsi kuDavide, wakhuluma kuye konkhe loko, watsi: "UYonatani ufike kumSauli; Davide wahlala enkhosini yaSawula njengaleso sikhatsi.
Baphinde bahlasela, Davide waphuma, waba nekulwa nalabaFilistimi, wababulala ngemphiko enkulu, kodvwa labaFilistimi babuyela emuva scrittola.
Wafika umphefumulo lobi kusuka kuSimakadze wafika kuSawula, lapho ehlala khona ekhaya lakhe, enesibhakabhaka sakhe esandlani sakhe; Davide ke wayedlalela.
USauli wafuna kutsi umkhonze ngesandla sakhe emnyango, kodvwa uDavide wehlulekile, ngobe isandla sakhe safika esigangeni. UDavidi watsi: "Ngaleyo busuku ngitahamba, ngiyawuphuma."

USawula wathumela lamaphoyisa endlu kaDavide, kutsi abheke kuyo, aze ambulala ekuseni; kodvwa Mikali, indodana kaDavide, yakhuluma kuye, yatsi: "Uma ungayigcina kanjani impilo yakho ngalobusuku, kusasa utawufa."
UMikhayeli watsi: "Lala Davide ngasefasiteleni, yena wabaleka waphuma.
UMikhaleli wathatha i-teraphim, wayibeka embhedeni, wayayigqoka ngetindlovukazi, wafaka nemilenze yengulube emlonyeni.
Ngako-ke Saulo watsi kulabo labathumelayo kutsi babambe Davide, kodvwa Mikali watsi: "Unesifo."
USawula wabathumela labaphatsimandla kutsi babone uDavide, watsi: "Ninikele kuye embhedeni wakhe, ngitawubulala."
Bafike bafika, babona kutsi i-idoli ikhona embhedeni, ibe nemilenze yengulube etinhloko.
USawula watsi ku-Mikhali: "Ngubani na lowawungikhohlisa ngalendlela lenjalo, wamisa umkhonzi wami kutsi ahambe? "U-Mikhali wathi kuye: "Wathi kunini: 'Lawulahla; ngingakubulala yini?'"
UDavide wehla, waphuma, waya kuSamuweli eRama, watsi kuye konkhe lokwentako uSawula kuye; wahamba naye naSamuele bahlala khona eNayothi.
Bakhuluma kuSawula batsi: "Davide ukhona eNayothi, eRama."

Wathumela lamaphoyisa kutsi afike amthathe, babone ibandla lamaprofeti lihlala lishumayela, naSamuele ehlala nguNkulunkulu wabo; khona-ke umoya waNkulunkulu waba phezu kwamadodana kaSawula, nabo baphuma bekhuluma.
Bakhuluma kubo uSauli, watsi wathumela abanye labaholi, kodvwa nabo bafika bephazamisa. USauli wehla wabathumela bobabili, bafika nabo bephazamisa.
Waphuma wafika eRama, waya ecebeni elikhulu leliseSeku, watsi: "Kuphi uSamuweli naDavide?" Baphendvula batsi: "ENayothi, eRama."
USawula waya eNayothi, eRama; kodvwa umoya waNkulunkulu waba phezu kwakhe, watsi: "Uyahamba usengaprofeti kuze kube sewufike eNayothi."
Wayisusa imilenze yakhe, waphuma ephupheni naye phambi kwa-Samuele, wahlala ephupheni lonke lolusuku nelobusuku. Ngaleso sizathu besithi: "Asekho naSawula phakathi kwabaprofeta?"
UDavide waphuma eNayothi eRama, waya kuJonathani, watsi kuye: "Ngikwenzeni yini? Yini lemibi engiyenze? Ngubani na lowo longeke afune kumbulala ubaba wakho?"
UYonatan watsi kuye: "Kungeke kube njalo; wena awutafa; bona, utata wami angeke akwenze lutho, likhulu noma lincane, ngaphandle kwekungitshela; yini leyawungifihla ngayo? Akunakuhle!

UDavide wehla, watsi: "Ubaba wakho uwazi kahle kutsi ungithanda kakhulu; ngobe wacabanga enhliziyweni yakhe kutsi: 'Akufanele uJonathane akwazi lokhu, ngeke ahlupheke.' Kodwa-ke, njengaloNkulunkulu lophilayo kanye nawe, ngisencane nje umzuzwana wokufa.
UJonathani watsi kuDavide: "Nasiphi sifiso sakho kutsi ngisikwenze, ngiyakusifeza."

UDavide watsi: "Bonani, ngoLwesihlanu ekuseni kuyawufika umhla wenyanga entsha, lapho ngingeke ngidla khona nenkhosi; kepha ngivumele ngihambe ngifihle emhlabatsini kuze kube sekupheleni kwelilanga lesibili.
Uma ubaba wakho engifuna, utawutsi kuye: UDavide wangisicela ngesandla kutsi ahambe aze eBethlehem, emzini wakhe; ngobe khonako kuyawube nemnikelo wesono lomnyaka wesitsatfu kuwo wonke umhlanga.
Uma esho kutsi, Kulungile, khona-ke ngiphephile; kepha uma ephuma emlonyeni wakhe, khona-ke ungeke ukhathazeke, ngobe wacabanga kutsi angifihle.
Nakho-ke wena, ngicela, uncede kimi, ngobe ungene nami emthethweni phambi kwaSimakadze; kepha uma ngingabi necala, bulala wena; kungani nanginikela kubotsi bakho?
UJonathani watsi: "Kungeke kube njalo; ngobe uma ngibe ngisazi kutsi ubaba wami unesinqumo sokwenza nawe lokubi, ngabe sengingeke ngikutshele?"
UDavide watsi kuye: "Ngubani na longeke amtshele, uma ubaba wakho ekhuluma nawe ngesibi?"
UJonathani watsi: "Thiba, siphume emhlabatsini." Bahamba khona bobabili kanye.

UJonathani watsi kuDavide: "Ngikhuluma nguSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, kutsi ngesokudla noma ngesokudla ngaleso sikhathi ngizokwazi ukuthi ubaba wami ucabangani; bese uma ekubona sekuhle kuwe, ngiyakuthumela ngikutshele.

Nkulunkulu amnike lokudla kanye nekudla lokuningi, uma ubaba wami efuna kukubisela wena; Simakadze anike kutsi akwenze njalo-ke nakunye, uma sengingeke ngikutshele, ngikuvumele uhambe ngekuthula; Simakadze abe nawe, njengobe waba nobaba wami.
Nami, ngaso sonke isikhathi lapho ngiphila khona, bonisani nami inhlonipho lengcwele kaSimakadze, ngobe sengingeke ngifa.
Ungeke ubeke phansi isandla sakho ngalendlu yami kuze kube ngubusuku bonke, ngisho nalapho Simakadze abewususa khona wonke umkhosi waDavide ebusweni bemhlaba.
UJonathani waba nesivumelwano nendlu kaDavide, watsi: "Simakadze abeke icala kulabo lababi kaDavide."
UJonathani waletsa uDavide kutsi akhulume ngaleso simo, ngobe wayemthanda Davide njengaye.
UJonathani watsi kuDavide: "NgoLwesihlanu ngusuku lwemnyaka lomusha, wena ungeke ube khona, ngobe isikhundla sakho sitawuba sinye.
Ngelilanga lesitsatfu, ekuseni kakhulu, uye emsebentini wakho, ufike endaweni lapho wafihla khona ngaleso sikhathi, bese uhlala lapha, eduze kwemlilo we-Ezel.
Ngitawutfusa tingulube tatithathu ecaleni laso, njengobe ngitatfusa kulelo litsi.

Ngitathumela umfana, ngithi kuye: Yiya ufune imilenze. Uma ngitsi kulowo mntwana: Bheka, imilenze iyilapho ngaphambili kwakho; yifike uyinike lapha; khona-ke uyafika; ngobe, njengoba Nkulunkulu ephilayo akusho ukuthi ungabi necala.
Uma ngithi kulowo mntwana, Gcwalisa, imiyalelo ikhona ngaphesheya kwakho; khona-ke kufanele uhambe, ngobe Simakadze utfumele.
Nalapho sikhuluma khona, khumbula kutsi uSimakadze uyabe ngumshayeli phakathi kwami nawe kuze kube sekupheleni.
UDavide wafihlakela emhlabatsini. Kwafika lilanga lemnyaka lomusha, ukumkani wahlala ekudla.
Wahlala embhedeni wakhe, ngaseceleni kwedonga, ngaseJonathani; Abneri wahlala eduze kwa-Sauli; kepha indlu kaDavide yayingenalutho.
USauli akazange akhulume nalutho ngalolusuku, ngobe wacabanga kutsi: "Kunesinye isizathu lesivele sihlelekile kuDavide, ukuze abe nenkinga naye; yena ungeke abe nenkinga.

Kuze kwafika lilanga lesibili lenyanga, lapho indawo kaDavide ingekho khona, uSawula watsi kuJonathani, umsa wakhe: "Ngubani na lomuntfu waJese longeke afike ekudlaleni, noma ngekusasa noma namhlanje?"
UJonathani watsi: "Davide wangisicela kutsi afike eBethlehem.

watsi: "Nceda, vumelani kutsi ngihambe; ngobe siphila nemindeni lemincane emgwaqeni, nalowo mkhuluwa wami umemekile; uma ungumhlobo wami, vumelani kutsi ngiye ngibone labo mkhuluwa wami." Ngako-ke akazange afike ekudlaleni kwenkhosi.
