USawule wehla emlonyeni wakhe ku-Jonathani, watsi kuye: "Woyise wesifazane lobi, lowo umkhonzi, angingawazi yini ukuthi ufike wahlangana nonyana ka-Isaye, ukuze ube necala lakho, nalelo lelikubelethile?
"Nase uhlala emhlabani, wena kanye nebukhosi bakho, angeke nihlale niphephile; ngobe lomuntfu wa-Isayi kumele aphelelwe litfu."
Jonathani watsi kubaba wakhe: "Ngubani na loyawufa? Yini labeyenze?"
USawula wehlisa isandla sakhe kuye kutsi ambulala; khona-ke uJonathani waqonda kutsi ubaba wakhe ubengeke agweme ukumbulala Davide.
UJonathani wehla embhedeni, waphuma enhliziyweni yakhe ibuhlungu kakhulu, watsi: "Angeke ngidle kudla ngalolusuku lwesithathu lwemikhosi," ngobe waba nendlala, ngobe ubaba wakhe abemkhaza Davide.
Kwafika ekuseni, waphuma Jonathane emhlabatsini, waya kuhlangana naDavide, ngesikhathi sakubo, abe nemuntfu loncane naye.
Watsi kulowo mfana: "Lala, thola tigodzi letingeke ngizikhwele." Lomntwana wabaleka, kodvwa uJonathani wehlisa tigodzi kutsi zihambe kuye.
Wafika umfana lapho isandla sa-Yonatan sifike khona, watsi: "Isandla asikho phandle kwakho?"
Watsi yena: "Thintela, phuma uhambe, ungabi necala!" Lomuntfu waSimakadze watsi: "Thintela, phuma uhambe!"
Lomuntfu loncane awazi lutho ngaleso simo, kodvwa Jonathane naDavide kuphela labawazi.
UJonathani watsi: "Thina-ke sitawubeka sandla sethu emlonyeni wakhe, bese ubuyela edolobhaneni."

UDavide waphuma ngasenyakatho-ntshonalanga yemlilo, wehlisa isandla sakhe emhlabatsini, waba nguJonathani lilanga lesithathu ngebuso bakhe phansi; bahlabane nabo bese belila bobabili, kodvwa uDavidhi lalili kakhulu.

UJonathani watsi kuDavide: "Hamba ukhululeke, njengoba sesivulelena ngegama laSimakadze, sitsi: 'UNkulunkulu abe ngumshayeli phakathi kwami nakho, kanye nembewu yakho nembewu yami kuze kube sekupheleni.'" UDavide waphuma, uJonathani wabuyela enhlokodolobha.
UDavide waya eNobi kuye ku-Ahimeleki, umLevi. Akhemeleki wahlangana naye, watsi: "Ngubani na wena, ngobe angeke kube nemuntu nawe?"

Davide watsi ku-Akhimeleki, umLevi: "Unkhosi yami yamithumela, yatsi kuye: 'Kungeke kube nemuntu lowazi lutho ngento lengingakuthumela ngayo, noma ngento engikhuluma ngayo.' Nalabo bantu bami, ngibatshele kutsi bafike kumhlanganise lapho ngikhona.
Namuhla, yini lesingako lapha? Nceda ungisinike tingulube letisihlanu, noma lokudla lokuwufunayo."
Umnikelo wekushiswa watsi kuDavide: "Akukho kudla lokujwayelekile lapha, kepha kukhona kudla lokungcwele, uma nje lamadoda angeke ahlangane nabesifazane."
UDavide watsi: "Asekho muntfu longeke afike endlwini yami, njengaleso sikhathi lapho ngiphuma khona; ngobe isikhumba semuntu singcwele, nalapho ngihamba khona; yini namanje?

Umnikelo wekushiswa wawumnikela ngekudla lokungcwele, ngobe kwakungaba khona nakuphi nakudla ngaphandle kwekudla lokusetshenzisiwe, lapho kwasuswa khona phambi kuSimakadze, kutsi kube nekudla okusha ngalolusuku lapho kwasuswa khona.
Wayekhona khona lomunye wabakhonzi baka-Sauli lowo busuku, ehlala khona phambi kwaSimakadze, uDoegisi waseEdomu, umphathi walabo abafuyi ba-Sauli.
UDavide watsi ku-Akhimeleki: "Unakho lapha isandla, noma umcibisholo? Ngatsi sengingeke ngithathe umcibisholo wami, noma siphi nasinye isithembiso, ngobe umsebenti wenkhosi ubemfisha."

Umnikelo wekushiswa watsi: "Lesibhakabhaka seGoliathi, lomFilisti, lowuyawubulala emfuleni i-Elah, siyakhona, sifakwe ebhokisini ngaseceleni kwe-ephod; uma ufuna kuthatha lesibhakabhaka, thola, ngoba asikho sibhakabhaka esisha lapha." UDavide watsi: "Akukho sibhakabhaka lesifana nalo; nikela kimi!"
UDavide watsi: "Namuhla ngiya ku-Akishi, inkhosi yaseGathi."

Batsi kuye labakhonzi baka-Akishi: "UDavide, lomkhuluwa walelizwe, angeke abe nguye lobakhuluma ngaye emdlalweni wabo, besithi: 'Sawule wabulala lamakhulu akhe, kodvwa Davide wababulala lamashumi lamakhulu akhe'?"
Davide wabeka la mazwi enhliziyweni yakhe, watsi: "Uyawubiwa kakhulu nguAkishi, inkhosi yaseGati."

Wathi ke yena, watsi: "Ngibe ngumuntfu lokhohlakeleyo; ngaleso sikhathi, lapho ehlala khona nabo, wabonakala sengathi ungumuntu lokhohlakeleyo, wabhala ngesandla emiganganeni yemnyango, washiya umlomo wakhe uphuma.
Akishi watsi kubo bonkhe bantfu bakhe: "Bonani lomuntu, angeke abe nengqondo; yini leyawumuletha lapha kimi?
Ngabe sengingeke ngibe nebantfu lababi kakhulu, kutsi nifikeni nalowo kutsi abe ngumholi wami? Lomuntu uyawufika yini endlwini yami?"
UDavide waphuma eGathi, wabaleka waya emfuleni we-Adulam; bakubona labazalwane bakhe nendlu yababa wakhe, babuyela kuye khona.
Bahlangana naye bonke labasengozini, nalabo babe nemali, nalabo babe nenkinga; waba nguMengameli wabo; kwaba nabo amadoda angamakhulu lamane.
Waphuma khona wafika eMizpa yaseMoabi, watsi kunkhosi yakwaMoabi: "Nceda uvumele ubaba wami nemama yami bahlale nani, kuze ngibone kutsi uNkulunkulu ungiphikisa yini."
Wabathumela kunkhosi yeMoabi; bahlala naye yonke imihla leDavide abekhona esitezi lesiphakeme.
UGadi, umprofeti, watsi kuDavide: "Ungase uhlale kulendlunkulu; buyela ezweni laYuda." UDavide waphuma, waya emfuleni waseHerethi.
USawula wava kutsi uDavide nebantfu bakhe bafunwa. Waye ehlala phansi ngaphansi kwesihlahla se-tamari, eGibeha; induku yakhe yayisesandlani sakhe, nalabo bonke labakhonzi bakhe babengomunye wakhe.
USawula wabaphendvula watsi: "Thingisani, nibenjamini! Ingabe unyana ka-Isayi utawukunikani imifula netingcotjo? Ingabe uyawukwenza nibaphathi bamakhulu kanye nabakhulu lamakhulu?

Nake-ke, yini naleyo lenetfuba lenu lokungcolisa ngami? Akunamuntu lokhuluma nami lapho unyana wami ehlangana khona nomntwana waJese? Nakho angeke kube nemuntfu lokhuluma nami lapho unyana wami ephakamisa umkhonzi wami, kutsi afike amcaphune kimi, njengobe kubonisiwe namuhla."
Waphendula Doegi, umEdomu, lobe ehlala nalabakhonzi baka-Sauli, watsi: "Ngiyawubona unyana waJese efika eNobi ku-Ahileleki, umsa wa-Ahitubi.
Akhemeleki wabuza uSimakadze kutsi angakwenza yini Davide, watsi: "Namuhla ngikunikela ngekudla kanye nesandla seGoliati, loFilisti."
Unkhosi yathumela yabiza u-Akhimeleki, umsa wa-Ahitubi, umLevi, nemndeni wakhe wonke, laba ngalabaLevi baseNobe; nabo bonke bafike kunkhosi.
USawula watsi: "Hlaza, unyana wa-Ahitubhe." Waphendula watsi: "Kulungile, nkosi yami!"

USawula watsi kuye: "Ngubani na wena kanye nonyana ka-Isayi lokhetele icala labani, lapho utawumunikela khona ngekudla nesondza, wathandaza kuNkulunkulu kutsi ahambe, abe ngumkhonzi wami, njengobe unjalo ngalolusuku?
U-Akhimeleki waphendula ukumkani, watsi: "Kubo bonke labakhonzi bakho, ngubani lothembekile njengaDavide, umngane wenkosi, kanye nomphathi walemikhosi yakho, nalowo ohlonishwa ekhaya lakho?

"Ngabe ngibe sengikhuluma kuNkulunkulu ngento lenjalo? Kulungile, angeke kube njalo; ngiyakucela, ungabi nenkinga nalowo mkhonzi wakho, noma nanoma ngubani emndenini wami; ngobe lowo mkhonzi wakho akawazi lutho ngalolu daba lonke.
Unkhosi yatsi: "Uyawufa, Ahimeleki, wena nemndeni wonke wababa bakho."

Unkhosi yatsi kulabo abahlala ecaleni lakhe: "Thumelani, bulala labapristi bakaSimakadze; ngobe nabo bafike besekela uDavide, nakuba bawazi kutsi uyaphuma, bangeke bamtshele." Kodwa labaholi benkhosi bakazange bafake isandla sabo ekuhlaseleni labapristi bakaSimakadze.

Unkhosi yatsi kuDoge: "Cinga wena, bulala labaLevi." UDoge, lo-Edomu, wabuyela watsi: "Cinga wena, bulala labaLevi!" Wabulala ngalolusuku lamadodana lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu agqoka i-ephod yelinen.
Na-Nob, dolobha lalabapristi, wababulala ngesandla saso, wabulala amadoda nabesifazane, nezingane kanye nalabo abadlile ukudla, nengulube, negusha, nemvu.
Ebiyathari, umsa wa-Akhimeleki, umsa wa-Ahitubi, wehla waya eDavideni.
Wakhuluma kuDavide watsi: "Saule wabulala bantfu bakaSimakadze."
UDavide watsi ku-Abhiyathari: "Ngeleso sikhathi, lapho Doegisi we-Edomu ekhona khona, ngazi kahle kutsi utawukhuluma naSawula; nginesibopho sendlala yemndeni wakwababa wakho.
Hamba uhlale nami, ungalokoti; ngobe lowo lofuna kukubulala, ufuna nangemfishane; nawe uyawuhlala nami.'
Bakhuluma kuDavide bati, "Bonani, labaFilisti bahlasela iKehila, bese begwaza ummbila emahhashini."
UDavide wabuza uSimakadze, watsi: "Ngaya kulwa nalabaFilisti?" Simakadze wamphendvula watsi: "Yala, hlasela labaFilisti, usindise iKehila."
Lamadodana aDavide waya kuye, watsi: "Sinebuhlungu lapha eYuda; kuphi nalapho siyawufika khona eKeyila kutsi sihlangabeze emaFilisti?
UDavide wabuza uSimakadze, Simakadze watsi kuye: "Hamba uye eKeyila; ngobe ngitawubanikela labaFilisti emandleni akho."
UDavide wahamba naye namadoda akhe waya eKehila, wahlasela laFilisti, wakhipha tilwane tabo, wababulala buhlungu kakhulu. Ngako uDavide wabavikela bantfu baseKehila.
UAbihathara, umsa wa-Ahimeleki, wehla waya kuDavide eKehila, wafaka i-ephod emlenzeni wakhe.

Bakhuluma kuSawula batsi: "Davide ufike eKeyila." USawula watsi: "Nkulunkulu utawumunikela enhliziyweni yami, ngobe uDavide wabeka isandla sakhe emlonyeni wakhe, wafika emzini oneminyango nemingcingo.
USawula wahlangana nabo bonkhe bantfu bakhe, waya emkhosini, kutsi afike eKehila, abambe Davide nebantfu bakhe.
UDavide, lapho akubona kutsi uSawula efuna ukumbulala, watsi kuAbhiyathari, umLevi: "Thindisa le-ephod."
UDavide watsi: "Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, umkhonzi wakho ukholwa kutsi uSauli ufuna kufika eKeyila, abulala lomhlaba ngenxa yami.

Ingabe lamakhosi eKehila angeke amnike kuye? Ngabe uSauli utawuphuma, njengobe umkhonzi wakho akubona? Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, khuluma, ngiyakucela, kumkhonzi wakho."USimakadze watsi: "Uyaphuma."
UDavide waphendvula watsi: "Bonkhe labahlala eKehila bangaminikela-ke kuSawula, mina nebantfu bami?" Simakadze watsi: "Baya kumnikela."
UDavide waphuma eKeyila, yena namadodana akhe, abelikhulu elinamakhulu lamane; bahamba besuka kwelinye lizwe beya kwelinye. Batsi bakhuluma kuSawula batsi: "UDavide uphume eKeyila."
UDavide wahlala ezindaweni letiphephile esidlangalaleni, emadolobheni asesidlangalaleni saZefu; ngobe uSawula abemfuna nsuku zonke; kodvwa Nkulunkulu akazange amnike Davide emlenzeni wakhe.
UDavide wafunda kutsi uSawula ubesele eHoreshi, emfuleni iZipho, waphuma waya kumbulala.
UJonathani, umsa waSawula, waya kuDavide e-Horeshe, watsi: "UNkulunkulu utawukusekela."
Wathi kuye: "Ungabi nebuhlungu; uSawula, ubaba wami, angeke afake isandla sakhe kuwe; wena utawuba ngunkhosi yaseSirayeli, nami ngiyawube ngumunye wakho; naSawula, ubaba wami, naye uyakubona.
Baphikisana bobabili phambi kwaSimakadze; watsi Jonathani: "Ngiya ekhaya lami," Davide ke wahlala eHoresh.
Bafike bafika kuSawula eGibeha, batsi: "UDavide akasekho lapha nathi, enhliziyweni yaseHoreshe, emgwaqeni waseHakila, osentshonalanga yeJeshimoni?
Manje-ke, Nkosi yakho, zulazula lapho uthanda khona, sitawuba nesibopho sokumnikela kubukhosi."
USawula watsi kuye: "UNkulunkulu akubekezelele wena, ngobe utfumele nguNkulunkulu.
Yiya ufike ubone kuphi lapho Davide ehlala khona, nome yini leyawumubona khona. Ngitsiwe kutsi ungumtfubi kakhulu.
Nifike nibone kuphi nalapho ahlala khona, nifike nami ninebufakazi bokuthi ukhona yini, ngitahamba nani; bese-ke, uma ekhona kulomhlaba, ngiya kumfuna kuwo wonke lamadolobha aseYuda.
Baphuma, bafike eZifi phambi kwaSauli; Davide namadodana akhe bebengasekusihlwa seMaoni, e-Arabha, enyakatho yeJeshimoni.

Sawule namadodana akhe baphuma befuna Davide. Bakhuluma kubo, watsi: "UDavidhi ufike efulethini lelingenamlilo, wahlala emfulani weMaon." 11Kwatsi lapho Sawule akubona khona, wehla waya emfudlaneni weMmaoni lolandzelaDavide.

USawula wahamba ngecala lelinye lemhlabatsi, kodvwa Davide namadodana akhe babehamba ngecala lelinye lemhlabatsi; bahamba bephazamiseka kutsi bangabi nguSauli. Ngako-ke uSawula nebantfu bakhe bafika bahlasela uDavide namadodana akhe, batsi: "Siyawuwabulala."
Kwafika umthunywa ku-Sauli, watsi: "Khangela ufike, ngobe labaFilisti bahlasele lelizwe."
USauli wabuyela emuva, watsi: "Ngatsi-ke, ngiyawuhlasela labaFilisti!" Ngako-ke kwabizwa linye lamadolobha lawo ngegama lelitsi: "Sela-Hammahlekoti."
UDavide wehla waya khona, wahlala emadolobhaneni aEngedi.
Sawule wabuyela lapho ehlasela khona labaFilisti, bakhuluma kuye batsi: "Ngibona uDavide ensimini yeEngedi."
USauli wathatha lamakhulu mathathu ema-Israyeli akhethiwe, waya efuna Davide namadodana akhe kulabo mlilo bemihlambi yetingulube.
Wafika emabhodleni engulube endzingweni yendlela, lapho kwakukhona khona intaba-mlilo. USawula waya kuwo kutsi aphumule; kodvwa Davide namadodana akhe babeseceleni kwetintaba-mlilo.

Batsi: "Lewo ngumhla loSimakadze abekhuluma ngawo kuwe, watsi: 'Ngitawunikela umshayeli wakho ngesandla sakho, nawe utawukwenza njengobe kukuhle emehlo akho.'" UDavide waphuma ngaso sonke isikhathi, wehlisa imilenze ka-Sauli.
Ngako-ke uDavide wacabanga kutsi ube necala, ngobe abewucota umlenze wemanti laSawula.

Watsi kubo bonkhe bantfu bakhe: "UNkulunkulu angeke anivumele ngikwenze lokhu kumphathi wami, ukumkani lowo lokhethiwe nguSimakadze, kutsi ngimise isandla sami phezu kwakhe; ngobe ungumkhonzi waSimakadze."
Ngako-ke Davide waletsa lamadodana akhe, watsi: "Laba baholi bami, ningawavumeli ahlasele uSawula." USauli waphuma egwadini, wahamba ngendlela yakhe.
UDavide waphuma emgodini, waya kuSawula, watsi: "Mholi wami, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli!" Kwatsi lapho uSauli ebheka emuva kwakhe, uDavide wehla ngebuso bakhe phansi.
UDavide watsi kuSawula: "Ngubani na lokhuluma, utsi: 'Davidhi ufuna kukubulala?'

Lamehlo akho akubona namuhla, ukuthi uSimakadze wakunika esandla sami kulo mfula; kwatsi bengingakubulala, kodvwa ngakuhlonipha, ngitsi: Ngingeke ngifake isandla sami kumphathi wami, ngobe ungumkhilimu waNkulunkulu.

"Namuhla, ngitsi kuwe, utata wami, ngabona lemikhono yakho enhliziyweni yami; ngobe sengicwebezele umlenze wemilenze yakho, ngingakubulala wena. Namuhla, qaphela, bese ubona kutsi angeke kube khona lokubi, noma lokuphazamisa emiphefumulweni yami. Ngingeke ngikubisele wena, kodvwa wena ungifuna ngesandla sakho.
Simakadze abe ngummeli phakathi kwami nakho; Nkulunkulu akulethele wena lokubi lokwenta kimi, kepha isandla sami ngeke sikuhlasele.
Ngako-ke sandla sami singeke sikucoce, njengobe kusho umbhalo wasendulo: "Kubo labaphikisayo baphuma bobi."
Nguwuphi lowo lophuma ekungeneni kwenkhosi yaseSirayeli? Nguwuphi lowo uyawulandzela? Ingabe isilwane lesifile, yini?
Simakadze abe ngummeli wethu, abe ngumtsetfo phakathi kwethu; abheke icala lami, anike imvume yami, amvikele esandla sakho.
UDavide waphela kutsi akhulume la mazwi, uSawula watsi: "Izwi lakho likhona yini, Davide, mntwana wami?"
Wati kuye: "Wena ulungile kunami; wena ungisebentise kahle, kepha ngiwusebenzisile nguNkulunkulu.
Namuhla ukhuluma kimi ngekudla lokulungile lokwenta kuye; ngobe Simakadze abeminikela esandla sakho, kodvwa wena ungamibulala.
UNkulunkulu utawukukhokhela kahle, njengobe wakwenza nami ngalolusuku, ngobe nguNkulunkulu loyawutfumisa umkhonzi wakhe, abe nguSimakadze longuSomandla, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli.
Namuhla sengikholwa kutsi utawube ngunkhosi, nebukhosi beSirayeli buyawutsi bukhona ngesandla sakho.
Lapha-ke, khuluma nami ngeNkulunkulu, kutsi ungeke unqume umzabalazo wami, nome ugcine igama lami emndenini wababami.
UDavide watsi kuSawula, wabuyela ekhaya lakhe; kodvwa Davide namadodana akhe bafike esitezi lesiphakeme.
Samuweli wafa, bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli bahlangana, bamlingisa, bamphilisa endlwini yakhe eRama; Davide waphuma waya esifuleni saseFaran.
Kwabe kukhona umuntu eMaoni, lomkhulu kakhulu, labenempahla yakhe eKarmeli; wabenetingulube tamakhulu mahlanu, netibondza lamakhulu matatu; waba sewumisa tingulube zakhe eKarmeli.
Igama lakhe lakunguNabali, igama lendvodzakati yakhe nguAbhigayeli; yabe iyindodana yemuntfu lohlakaniphile, neyawubukeka kahle, kodwa umkakhe waba mnyama kakhulu, waphuma emndenini kaKalebi.
UDavide waba khona emhlabatsini, watsi kuDavide: "Nabali ushiya tingulube zakhe."
Wathumela bantfu labalishumi, watsi kubo: "Niya kuNabali eKarmeli, nimubule ngesandla sami.
Nitsi kuye: Uhlale uphila; kuthula nempilo kuwe, nakubo bonkhe bantfu basekhaya lakho, nabo bonke labakho.
Namuhla ngitsi: Lisekhona lixesha lokudlidliza tingulube zakho; ngobe labahlengikazi bakho babe nathi, asikubi nalutho kubo, lilanga lonke laba behlala eKarmeli.

Ufike ubuze labangani bakho, bangakutshela. Namuhla-ke, ngiyakucela, sebentisa ubuhlakani bakho kulabo bancane, ngobe sifike ngelilanga lekudla lokunekuthula; ngikucele, kunika labangani bakho kanye naDavide, umntwana wakho, noma yini lesingako.
Befika labangani bakaDavide, bakhuluma kuNabali ngaleso simo ngegama likaDavide, bahlala khona.
UNabali waphendula watsi kulabo labasebenzela Davide: "Ngubani loDavide? Ngubani loyise we-Isayi? Kube khona labangani abaningi namuhla, labahamba besuka kumakhosi abo.
Ngubani na longeke ngiwuthathe umnikelo wami wekudla, nemanti ami, nenyama yami engifilele labo labamisa tingulube zami, ngiyinike lamadoda asuka kuphi angazange awazi?
Lamadodana aDavide abuye abuyela, wafika wakhuluma naye ngaleso sinye simo.

UDavide wabatshela lamadodana akhe, watsi: "Lomunye nalowo agqoke isandla sakhe." Baye bakwenza njalo, uDavide naye wagqoka isandla sakhe. Kube kukhona amadoda angaba ngumakhulu mane afike nawo uDavide, kepha lamakhulu mahlanu ahlala nempahla yabo.
Wathi omunye walabo labancane akhuluma ku-Abigayeli, indodana kaNabali, watsi: "Davide wathumela labaselwandle kutsi babulele umphathi wethu, kodvwa yena wabaphuca.
Natsi laba bantu bebengaba kahle kakhulu kuyena, bangasibi nasiphi na simo; lilanga lonke lapho sahlala khona emhlabatsini kanye nabo, asikupheli nasinye isive.
Babe njengedonga lelingcolisayo, busuku nebusuku, sonke isikhathi lapho sihlala khona tingulube zethu.
Namuhla cabanga, ubone kutsi ungakwenza yini; ngobe lokubi kuyawufika kumphathi wethu kanye nendlu yakhe yonke; naye-ke ngumuntfu lobi kakhulu, angeke kube khona lowo angakhuluma naye.

U-Abhigayeli wakhawulela, watsi: "Yiba nekudla lokungemakhulu lamibili, namabhodlela lamabini ewayini, nemfuyo lelishumi elinambili enconywe ngaphambilini, kanye nasendleleni yengulube elicwebile, nemajikijolo emancane akhulu, nemifino emibimbi engama-100, nangemiphiko yemafigo langama-200."
Waye watsi kubantfu bakhe: "Nihambe ngaphambili, ngiya kuwe." Ngako-ke akazange akhulume naNabali, umkakhe.
Wayihamba iphuma efuleni lelinetinyawo letincane, yabona Davide namadodana akhe bephuma baya kuyo; wabahlangana nabo.
UDavide wakhuluma watsi: "Kungekuhle kakhulu kutsi sengigcina lempahla yakhe emfuleni, ngingabi nento elahlekile kuleyo ndlu yakhe; ngobe ungangikhokhela lokudla lokubi ngekudla okuhle.
UNkulunkulu ungeke angaba nenkinga nami, uma ekuseni ngishiya umfana lophilayo kulabo bonke labakhona kuye!
Ngako-ke, lapho Abigaili ebona uDavide, wahamba wehlisa ijusi lakhe, watsi kuDavide: "Ngubani na lowo muntfu?"
Waye wagwadla emadolo akhe, watsi: "Nceda uvumele umkhonzi wakho, nkosi yami, akhulume nawe; lalela amazwi omkhonzi wakho; ngimi kuphela longeke ngibe necala.

"Ngikucela, nkosi yami, ungeke ubeke engqondweni yakho lomuntfu lomfishane, uNabali; njengoba litsi igama lakhe, njalo-ke likhona igama lakhe, kanye nenyama yakhe. Nami, umkhonzi wakho, sengizange ngibabone labo labathunyelwe ngunkhosi yami.

Manje, nkosi yami, njengobe Simakadze Nkulunkulu wakho ephilayo, kanye netfu liphilayo, ngobe uSimakadze usandisele wena kutsi ungabi nembulala-mlilo, nakuba ungena ngesandla sakho, bangaba njengeNabali bobubi bakho, nabo bonke labafuna ukubulala nkosi yami.
Lomnikelo lowushiwo umkhonzi wakho, lowo ngiwutsatsele lomphathi wami, utfolwe kubo bonkhe bantfu labalandela.

Ngiyakucela, uvumele umkhonzi wakho agweme lokubi; ngobe Simakadze utawunikela kumphathi wami ngendlu yebukhosi lehlala isikhathi eside, ngoba wena wahlasela imibhikisho yaSimakadze; ngeke kube khona inkohliso kuwe yonke imihla yakho.
Nakuba umuntu efuna ukubulala wena, itfu lakho liyawugcinwa kulowo lophilayo nguSimakadze longuSomandla wakho, Nkulunkulu wakho; kepha litfu lalabo bakhondzayo, litawulisusa njengelitfuba elifihliwe.
Ngako-ke, lapho uSimakadze ekwenzela umphathi wami konke lokubi akushoyo kuye, ekwenta wena ube nguMengameli weSirayeli,
ungeke ube nenkinga emphefumulweni wakho, uma ubulala ngaphandle kwecala, noma uma ungenelela wena ngokwakho; bese-ke, lapho Nkulunkulu enika umphathi wami kuthula, uyakhumbula mkhonzi wakho.
UDavide watsi ku-Abhigayeli: "Ungcwele Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, lowo wetfulele wena namuhla kutsi ungihlangane.
Ngiyakubonga ngembono wakho lolungile, ngobe ungithetse ngalolusuku loku kutsi ngitsi: 'Ngiyawufa', kodvwa ngangiphindze ngatsi: 'Ngitabuya'.
Ngako-ke, nguNkulunkulu lophilayo waseSirayeli, lowo labemivimbele ekubeni ngikwenze wena kubi, uma ungeke wakhawulela ukungihlangana, ngaleso sikhathi angeke abe nendoda yakhe iNabali.
UDavide wamukela esandlani sakhe lokho abekuleta kuye, watsi: "Yiya ekhaya lakho ngekuthula; ngiyakulalela, ngikuvumele."

UAbihayeli wafika kuNabali, watsi: "Ngibona, uNabali unekudla endlwini yakhe, njengekudla kwenkhosi; umphefumulo wakhe ucebile kakhulu, futhi usele kakhulu; ngobe akazange akhulume naye lutho kuze kube ngekusasa.
Kwatsi kwafika ekuseni, lapho uNabali ephumile khona, indodana yakhe yakhuluma kuye ngaleso simo; waphuma emoyeni wakhe, waba sengathi licwebe.
Kuphela ngemuva kwezinsuku letilishumi, Simakadze wabulala uNabali, watsi: "Wafa."

UDavide, lapho ekubona ukuthi uNabali ufile, watsi: "Ungcwele Simakadze, lowo wahlulela icala lami kuNabali, loyawuncuma ngami, waletsa umkhonzi wakhe kutsi akwenze lokubi, wabuyisela indlala kaNabali phezu kwehlavu lakhe." UDavide wathumela ku-Abhigayeli, wamcela ukuba abe ngumkakhe.
Befika labangani bakhe eKarmeli, bakhuluma ku-Abhigayeli batsi: "Davide usithumela kuwe kutsi akuthathe ube ngumfazi wakhe."
Wayinikela ngebuso bakhe emhlabatsini, yatsi: "Heh, ngikhona ndodana yakho, kutsi isebenze kuwe, ibe ngumkhonzi wakho, ukuze ihlanze amehlo labangani benkosi yami.
U-Abihayeli wehla, waphuma, wafika ejele, walandela labaseDavideni, yena nebantfu bakhe labahlanu, waba ngumkakhe.
UDavide waba nenkosikazi yakhe, Ahinoamu yaseJezreyeli; nabo bonkhe babeyimadvodzakati akhe.
Sawule wanikela indvuna yakhe, iMikhayeli, indodana kaDavide, kuPaltiyele, umsa waLayisi, waseGalli.
Bafika labaZifithi kuSawula eGibeha, batsi: "Davide akase afihlakali emfuleni weHakila, lobheke eJeshimoni?"
USauli waphuma, naye namakhulu lasitfupha emakhosikazi aseSirayeli akhethiwe, waya emfuleni Zife, wafuna Davide.
USawula wamisa itente lakhe ecaleni lendlela, enhliziyweni yeHakila, ebhekene neJeshimoni; Davide ke waba khona emfuleni lomnyama. Wayebona kutsi uSauli usemfuna.
Wathumela labaphenyi, wafunda kutsi uSawula ufike ngeqiniso.

UDavide waphuma, wafika endaweni lapho uSawuleli abehlala khona, wabona khona lapho uSawuleli ne-Abneri, umsa kaNeri, umkhosi wakhe, belala khona. USawuleli ubelele embhedeni wemphi, nalabo bakhona behlala naye.

UDavide watsi ku-Akhimeleki, umHeti, kanye na-Abishai, umsa waSeruya, mkhuluwa kaYowabe, watsi: "Nguwuphi lowo lofuna kutsi ahambe nami esiteji kuSawula?" Akazange aphendule, watsi: "Ngizohamba nawe."

UDavide na-Abhishai bafika emphakathini ngebusuku, bebona uSawula ehlala embhedeni wemphi, nenduku yakhe ihlanganisiwe emhlabatsini eduze kwenhloko yakhe; Abneri kanye nabo bonkhe bantfu babelala ngaye.
UAbhishai watsi kuDavide: "Simakadze utawunikela lilanga lenu lomfishane wakho ngesandla sakho; namuhla ngiyawumshaya phansi ngesandla esisodwa, ngobe angeke angambulala kabili."
UDavide watsi ku-Abishai: "Ungambulala, ngobe ngubani longeke afake isandla sakhe emkhonzeni waSimakadze, engeke abe necala?
Waye watsi: "Ngiphila Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, Nkulunkulu wakhe utawumubulala; noma ifike lilanga lakhe, aze afile, noma ahambe emphini, aze abulawa.
Simakadze angeke anivumele kutsi ngimise isandla sami kulowo lophakiwe nguSimakadze; hlala lapha, uthathe isibhakabhaka kanye nebhodlela lamanzi elikhona embhedeni wakhe, sihambe.

UDavide wathatha intambo nebhodlela lamanzi, wababeka embhedeni ka-Sauli, baphuma. Akukho mntu lokubona, noma lokwazi, noma lovuka; bonke babehlala bephumula, ngobe uSimakadze abebafake ekuphumuleni okukhulu.
UDavide wehla waya kwelinye icala, wahlala ecaleni lelingene lomfula, ngaphesheya; kwabe sekude kakhulu phakathi kwabo.
Watsi uSawula: "Ngubani wena, Abneri, umsa waNeri?" Watsi: "Ngubani wena, Abneri, umsa waNeri?" UAbnerwa watsi: "Ngubani wena, lokhuluma kunkhosi?"
UDavide watsi: "Wena ungumuntu, akunjalo? Nguwubani lofana nawe eSirayeli? Ngubani na longeke ugcine umkwetsi wakho, ukumkani? Kuye kwafika umuntu lofuna kubulala umkwetsi wakho, ukumkani.

Lokudla lokuwenzile akukuhle; ngobe uphila Simakadze, wena namadodana akho niyawufa, ngobe angeke nigweme umphathi wenu, lokwetfweswe nguSimakadze. Sebenzisa mehlo enu kutsi nibone: Kuphi isibhamu senkhosi, nebhodlela lemanti, laba bekhona embhedeni wakhe?
USawula waqonda lizwi laDavide, watsi: "Izwi lakho likhona yini, Davide, mntwana wami?"UDavidi wathi: "Kulungile, lomkhuluwa wam, ukumkani."
Watsi: "Ngubani na lowo nkhosi yami, lohamba ngemuva komkhonzi wakhe? Ngikwenzeni yini, yini lengiyenzile? Uthini umonakalo wami?"

Lakho, nkosi yami, umkwehluleli, kumele alalele amazwi womkhonzi wakhe. Uma nguSimakadze lokwenza ukhululeke ngami, khona-ke avumele kutsi kube nemnikelo wesono; kepha uma abantu bakwenza lokhu, bangabi nalutho phambi kwaSimakadze; ngobe bamikhipha namuhla engxenyeni yami yemhlaba waSimakadze, besithi: Yiya, usebenzela bokhokho bakho.
Ngako-ke, gazi lami lingeke lifike emhlabatsini kude naSimakadze; ngobe ukumkani waseSirayeli uphuma efuna ingulube eyodwa, njengobe umuntu efuna inkomo emadolobheni.
Watsi uSawula: "Ngifile; buyela, Davide, mntwana wami! Ngako-ke, ngobe lilanga lenu lihle kakhulu kuwe, ngingeke ngikuholele lutho lokubi; ngobe sengivele ngakwenza kabi, ngibe nenkinga enkulu.
Davide watsi: "Bonani, lilanga lenkhosi likhona; lomunye walabo labancane kumele afike ayise.
Simakadze utawubalalisa wonke umuntu ngendlela yakhe, kanye neqiniso lakhe; ngobe Simakadze abekunikela ngesandla sami namuhla, kepha angizange ngimise isandla sami kulowo aphelelwe nguNkulunkulu.
Ngako-ke, njengobe lilanga lenu libe ngumnikelo wekushiswa ngami ngalolusuku, njalo Simakadze abe ngumnikelo wokushiswa ngesandla sami, andise ngisuse tinhlekelele tonkhe.
USawula watsi kuDavide: "Ubambisene nawe, uDavide, mntwana wami; utawukwenza izinto ezinkulu, uyawuphumelela." UDavide wahamba ngendlela yakhe, uSauli wabuyela ekhaya lakhe.

UDavide watsi enhliziyoni kwakhe: "Kunelilanga lelinye ngiyawufa nguSawuleli; kungcono kutsi ngihambe ngifike ezweni laFilisti, ngobe uSawuleli uya kushiya ukungifuna ngaso sonke iSirayeli, bese ngiphuma enhliziyweni yakhe."
UDavide wabuyela, yena namadoda angamakhulu lamane abe naye, waya ku-Akishi, umsa kaMahoki, ukumkani waseGathi.
UDavide wahlala na-Akishi eGathi, yena namadodana akhe; lomunye nemndeni wakhe naye; uDavide namakhosikazi akhe lababili, Ahinoamu waseJezreyeli, naAbigayili, indodana kaNabali waseKarmeli.
Bakhuluma kuSawula batsi: "Davide ufike eGathi," ngobe akazange amfune.

UDavide watsi ku-Akishi: "Uma sengithole kuthula emilonyeni yakho, nginiketwe indawo esinye semadolobha lasemaphandleni, ngihlale khona; ngobe yini na kutsi umkhonzi wakho ahlale nawe emzini wenkhosi?"
Ngako-ke Akishi watsi kuye ngalolo lilanga leSiklagi, ibe yinkhosi yakaJuda kuze kube manje.
UDavide wahlala emaFilisti iminyaka lelikhulu nemashumi lamane nesihlanu.
UDavide namadodana akhe babehamba, behlasela la Geshuri, neGherizi, ne-Amaleki; laba babahlala kulolu mhlaba kusukela ngeminyaka lengemuva, kuze kufike eShure, kuze kufike emfuleni weMijiphu.
Nalapho uDavide efika khona, akazange ashiye umfana noma indoda; wathatha ingulube, nebhokhwe, nedoli, nasenguma, naletigqoko, wabuyela ku-Akishi.
Akishi abekhuluma kubo, watsi: "Uye phi namuhla?"Davide waphendvula watsi: "ENtshonalanga yeYuda," nome: "ENtshonalanga yama-Yerahmeelithi," noma: "ENtshonalanga yama-Kenisi."

UDavide akazange ashiye muntfu lophilayo, indoda noma indodakazi, aze afike eGathi; ngobe watsi: "Kungeke bakhulume nathi bethi: 'UDavidhi wakwenza njalo.'" Lolu hlobo lwabe luhlala kulo lonke ixesha lakhe abehlala emaFilisti.
Akishi wakholwa kuDavide, watsi: "Uye sewuyawudlalwa ngubantfu bakhe base-Israyeli; ngobe utawuba ngumkhonzi wami kuze kube sekupheleni."
Kuye kwaba ngaleso sikhathi kutsi labaFilisti bahlanganisana, batsi: "Sidlane neSirayeli!" Akishi watsi kuDavide: "Usazi kahle-ke ukuthi utawuphuma nami, wena namadodana akho, emphini."
UDavide watsi: "Uyawubona ngemehlo akho kutsi lomuntfu wakho angakwenza yini." Akishi watsi: "Kulungile, ngitakwenza ube ngumfoti wami kuze kube sekuphele kuphila kwami."
Samuweli wafa, bonkhe labaSirayeli babemlingisa, bamfihla emzini wakhe, eRama; kodvwa uSawula wabasusa ezweni labo labengamaphuphi nalabo abakhuluma ngemehlo.
BaFilisti bahlangana, bafika bamisa tindlu tabo eSuneni; naSawula wahlanganisa bonkhe labaSirayeli, wabamisa tindlu zabo eGilboa.
USauli, lapho ebona khona umkhosi wemaFilista, wakhathazeka kakhulu, wakhatsazeka emilenzeni yakhe.
Wabuza uSimakadze, kodvwa Simakadze akazange amphendule ngemiphupho, noma nge-Urim, noma ngabemaprofeti.
USawula watsi kulabo abasebenza naye: "Fumanini nami indodana lekhuluma ngemanti, ngiye ngiyibuze." Baphendvula batsi: "E-Endori kukhona.
USawula washintsha ingubo yakhe, wagqoka ingubo lenye, waya kuye lowesifazane ngebusuku, yena namadodana akhe lababili, watsi: "Thintela umphefumulo wami, ufike unciphise lowo ngiwuchaze."
Lowesifazane watsi kuye: "Uyazi kutsi yini leSaule ayenze, kutsi wasusa ezweni labo labakhuluma ngemanti nelabo lababona lilanga; kungani ke wena umisa umgodzi lowufuna kumbulala?
USauli watsi kuye ngesandla saSimakadze, watsi: "Kube uphila Simakadze, ngeke ube necala ngalolu daba."
Lowesifazane watsi: "Ngubani longeke ngiwukhuphule kuwe?" Waphendvula watsi: "Ukhuphule uSamuweli."
Lowesifazane, lapho ebona khona uSamuweli, watsatsa umsindo wakhe, watsi kuSawula: "Ngubani na lowuyawungikhohlisa?
Watsi kuye ukumkani: "Ungabi nenkinga; yini lokubona?" Waphendvula, watsi: "Ngibona umphefumulo uphuma emhlaba."
Wabuza watsi: "Ubukeka kanjani?" Yati, "Kuphuma umuntu omdala, egqoke ingubo." USawula waqonda kutsi nguSamuweli, wehlisa ubuso bakhe phansi emhlabani.

USamuweli watsi kuSawula: "Ngubani na lowungeke ungangiphazamisa, ungenza ngifike lapha?" USawula watsi: "Nginenkinga enkulu kakhulu; labaFilisti baphikisana nami, ngobe Nkulunkulu usesuka kum, akazange aniphendule ngaso sonke isikhathi, noma ngemoya wephupho, noma ngenhlanhla. Ngako-ke ngingakubiza, ukuze ufundise kutsi kufanele ngikwenzeni."
USamuele watsi: "Ngubani na lowukhuluma nami, uma uSimakadze esuka kuwe, waba ngumfowabo wakho?
Simakadze wakwenza lokusho kwakhe ngesandla sami, watsi: "UNkulunkulu usewucishe ukhiphe lolu bukhosi esandla sakho, wawunike umfana wakho Davide.
Ngako-ke Simakadze utawukwenza lokhu kuwe namuhla, ngobe wena awuzange ulalele ilizwi laSimakadze, kutsi uphumelele ku-Amaleki inhlonipho yakhe.
Simakadze utawukunikela wena neSirayeli esandlani salabaFilisti; nangekusasa, wena nabantwana bakho niyawuba nami; Nkulunkulu utawunikela kanye nemkhosi waSirayeli esandlani salabaFilisti.
USauli wehla emhlabatsini, wesaba kakhulu kulelo lizwi laSamuweli; angeke abe nemandla, ngobe akazange afune ukudla ngalolusuku lonke nalolobusuku bonke.
Wafika lowesifazane kuSawula, wabona kutsi ukhatshulwa kakhulu, watsi kuye: "Bonani, umkhonzi wakho walalela amazwi akho; ngabeka impilo yami enhliziyweni yami, ngakwenza njengobe wakhuluma nami.
Namuhla, ngiyakucela, lalela umkhonzi wakho; ngitakunikela nawe ngekudla lokuncane, udle, bese uphindze ube nemandla ekuhambeni kwakho.
Akazange avumele, watsi: "Angeke ngidle." Bafike nabo labakhonjiswe nguwo umfazi, bakhuluma naye. Wabalalela, waphuma emhlaba, wahlala embhedeni.
Lowesifazane wayenengulube emndenini wakhe, wayawuyibulala; watsi: "Thintela umnikelo wesono, uyihlanganise, uyeke imiphiko yekudla lesinamafutha aningi."
Wayibeka phambi kwa-Sauli nebantfu bakhe, badla, bavuka baphuma ngaleyo busuku.
BaFilisti bahlangana nabo bonkhe bantfu babo e-Afeki, kodvwa laSirayeli bamisa tindlu tabo eduze kwempucuko yaseJizreeli.
Lamakhosi eFilisti aphuma, ngamakhulu nemakhulu lamakhulu; Davide namadodana akhe abehamba emaceleni kanye no-Akishi.

Akishi watsi: "Asekho yini loDavide, umkhonzi waSawula, ukumkani waseSirayeli, lohlala nami iminyaka lelishumi nesihlanu; kusukela kuleso sikhathi lapho asuka khona eSauli kuze kube manje, angizange ngimubone nalutho lokubi kuye."

Batsi bomkhuluwa beFilisti baphazamisa yena, batsi: Lalela lowo muntu abuye kulapho utawumunikela khona; ngobe angeke afike nathi emkhosini, angase anikeze isandla sakhe emphilweni. Ngabe angeke abe nelungelo lokubuyisa inhlonipho yakhe phambi kwaSimakadze, ngaphandle kwekuti athathe izinhlavu zabaholi bethu?
Lowo-ke angeke abe nguDavide lobakhuluma ngawo emcimbini wabo, bethi: "Sawule wabulala emaphesenti akhe, kodvwa Davide wababulala lamakhulu akhe"?

Akishi wababiza uDavide, watsi kuye: "Ngiphila Simakadze, wena ungumuntu lothembekile, futhi ngikuthandela kakhulu ukuba ube nami emkhosini; kusukela kulelo lilanga lapho wafika khona kimi kuze kube ngalolusuku, angizange ngikubone lutho olubi kuwe; kepha kubaholi awufanelekanga.
Ngako-ke buyela, uye ngekuthula, ungeke ube nenkinga kubaholi beFilisti.

UDavide watsi kuye: "Ngikwenze kuphi? Uthole yini kumkhonzi wakho kusukela kuleso sikhathi lapho ngafika khona kuwe kuze kube manje, kutsi ngingeke ngiye ngihlangabeze nalababi benkosi yami umkwetsi?"
Akishi watsi kuye: "Ngiyazi kutsi ulungile emehlo ami, sewufana nemuntfu waNkulunkulu; kepha labaholi beFilisti bathi: 'Akufanele afike nathi emdlalweni.'
Hamba uhambe, wena nabangani bakho labahamba nawe, bese uphuma ngasebusuku, lapho lilanga lifika khona.
UDavide namadodana akhe baphuma ekuseni kakhulu, bebuyela ezweni laFilisti; kodvwa labaFilisti bafike eJizreyeli.
UDavide nebantfu bakhe bafika eSiklagi ngelilanga lesithathu. Bekungakabi khona Amaleki afike eNtshonalanga kanye neSiklagi, wahlasela iSiklagi, wayibulala ngemlilo.
babambe labesifazane, nalabo bonke labakhona kuyo, kanye nebantfu labancane nalabakhulu; bebengawabulala, ngobe babehamba nabo ngendlela yabo.
Bafike bafika eSiklagi, Davide namadodana akhe, batsi: "Isikelagi icwebile; nemakhosikazi abo, nemadvodzana abo, nemadvodzakati abo athathwe njengengcebo.
UDavide namadodana akhe balala ngamandla, kuze kungabikho kubo amandla lokulala.
Lamadodana laDavide ababili, Ahinoamu wase-Izreyeli, neAbigayili lowesifazane waNabali waseKarmeli, babesekuboshwe.
UDavide wahlupheka kakhulu, ngobe laba bantu bekhuluma kutsi batawumbulala ngemlilo; kodvwa uDavide waba nebuhlungu bomoya wakhe, wonke umuntu ngenxa yemadvodzana akhe kanye nemadvodzakati akhe.
UDavide watsi kuAbhiyathari, umsa wa-Ahimeleki, umLevi: "Thintsi le-ephod." UAbhiyathari wamnikela kuyo.
UDavide wabuza uSimakadze, watsi: "Ngaba ngiyawuphazamisa lolu daba? Ngitawuwafika yini?" Waphendvula watsi: "Uyaphazamisa; utawuwafika, nawe utawuwukhulula umhlaba wonke.
Waye eGileyadi, yena namadoda langamakhulu lamane abe naye, waya emfuleni iBesoro; khona kwatsi kwabakhona labahlala phansi.
Bami balishumi elinambili bebengazange bafike efulethini, kodvwa Davide nalabamashumi lamane nesihlanu babehamba nabo.
Bafike bathola emhlabatsini umSirayeli, waphuma waya kuDavide, bamnika amanzi kutsi aphuze, naye wamnikela ngekudla.
wadla, waphila; ngobe angeke abe nekudla, noma angeke abe nesiphuzo samanzi, iminyaka lemithathu, ekuseni nakusihlwa.
UDavide watsi kuye: "Uwuphi wena, usuka kuphi?" Waphendvula watsi: "NgingumSirayeli, umkhonzi waSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Aamaleki; ngobe lomkhuluwa wami wangena emphilweni ngaleso sikhathi.
Siye safika eNtshonalanga yalabaKherethi, kanye nendzawo yebukhosi yaseYuda, naseNtshonalanga yaKalebe, sabulala naSiklagi.

UDavide watsi kuye: "Ungeke ungikhuphule yini kulelo qembu?" Waphendvula watsi: "Nceda ungisiphe ngeNkulunkulu, kutsi awuzange ungibhubhise, noma ungenise emkhondweni womphathi wami; khona-ke ngitawukukhuphula kubo."

Wahamba naye Davide, waya eGibhithe, wafika eGibhithe, watsi: "UDavide ufike eGibhithe, waphuma eGibhithe, wafika eGibhithe, wafika eGibhithe, wafika eGibhithe, wafika eGibhithe, wafika eGibhithe, wafika eGibhithi."
UDavide wababulala kusukela emini kuya emveni, watsi: "Asekho namunye wabo loyawuphuma, ngaphandle kwalabo madodana lamakhulu lamane, labo abebehamba ngetingcweti, babaleka."
UDavide wabuyiselwa tonkhe tive takhe, kanye nemadvodzana akhe lamibili, naletinye tindzawo letiphakeme.
Akukho nasinye isive, sincane noma sikhulu, sidvuna noma sidzimate, noma siphi nesiphi lesitfunywa, nome siphi nesiphi nesinye isive salabo labasele besivalile; Davide wababuyisela.
Wathatha tonkhe tingulube netibondza, bahamba ngazo phambi kwetilwane, besithi: "Leli yitfu laDavide."

UDavide wafika kulabo amadoda langamakhulu lasitfupha, abengeke ahambe naDavide, ngobe abekhathele kakhulu, abewashiya efulani leBesoro; laba baphuma behlangana noDavide nebantfu bakhe. UDavide nebaholina bafike, watsi kubo: "Unjani umphefumulo wabo?"

Batsi bonke lababi, nalabaphazamisayo emndenini kaDavide, batsi: "Ngenakho abengaphuma nathi, asitawuba nesibopho salowo mnikelo wesono siyawuwunikela kubo; kepha lomuntu ngamunye kumele athathe indodana yakhe kanye nomntwana wakhe, aze aye."
UDavide watsi kubo: "Akufanele nikwenze njalo, bazalwane bami, ngezinto loSimakadze asewusinikezile; ngobe yena asisigcinele, wanikela esihlalweni sethu iqembu labahlaseli labafika labani.
Ngubani longeke akhulume nawe? Nalowo lahlala nempahla yakhe, kumele abe nengxenye yakhe kanye naleyo yalowo laphuma emphini; bonke baphindze babe nengxenye yabo.
UDavide wabeka lesi sinqumo semtsetfo eSirayeli, kusukela ngalolusuku kuya kulolusuku.
UDavide wafika eSiklagi, watsi kulabo bakhulu baseYuda lababahlobo bakhe: "Lamuhla nine sipho sekudla lokudlwengulwa ema-Amoni." 20Watsi uSawula afike eSiklag, waya kubo bonkhe bantfu benkhosi.
Wayithumela kubo base-Betheleli, nase-Ramoti eNtshonalanga, kanye nabobase-Yatiri;
kulabo base-Aroeri, eSifmothi, neEshtemoa,
kanye neRakali, nalabo labasemadolobhaneni laJerahmeelithi nalabaseKenisi;
kulabo eHormah, Bor Ashan, Athak
ne-Hebroni, nakwalabo labakhona kuwo wonke lamadolobha lapho uDavide abehamba khona naye nabantu bakhe.
BaFilisti bahlangana naboSirayeli, batsi: "BaSirayeli baphuma emphinjeni yeGilboya, bahlaselwa, babulawa.
Bafike babulala uSawula nemadvodzana akhe, babulala naJonathani, naAbinabadi, naMalkishi-shuha, lamadvodzakati akhe.
Lempi laliba nebuhlungu kakhulu kuSawula, kodvwa labahlabani bafike bamfika, bamphikisa ngesandla.

USawula watsi kulowo owayemthabatha isibhamu: "Susa isibhamu sakho, uyeme ngaso, ungase ufike labesifazane labangenakucircumcithekiswa bami ngesandla sabo, bami ngesandla sabo, bami ngesandla sabo." Kodwa lowo owayemthwalwa sibhamu wakhe wakhathazeka, akazange akwenze. Ngako uSawula wathatha isibhamu sakhe, wehla kuso.
Wayibona isandla sakhe, watsi: "Sawule ufile!" Watsi naye washaya ngesandla sakhe, wafa naye.
Ngako-ke uSawula, nemadvodzana akhe lasitfupha, nalowo lokhipha isandla sakhe, nabo bonkhe bantfu bakhe bafile ngalolusuku.

Batsi: "Kungekubi, ngobe lamadodana eSirayeli ahlala emaphandleni kanye nalabo abasuka ngaphesheya kweJordane, lapho bebona khona ukuthi labahlaseli baseSirayeli babuyela emuva, nabo-ke labaFilisti baphuma nabo, bahlasela.
Kwaba njalo ngelilanga lesibili, lapho bafika khona labaFilisti labaya kubangela labasolwa, batsi: "Bafumene uSawula nemadvodzana akhe lafile emfuleni weGilboa."

Batsi: "Ube uDavide waphuma eGibhithe, waya emaFilisti; babeka phansi inhloko yakhe kanye nempahla yakhe yekulwa. Bathumela ngaso sonke sase-Egipta, bekhuluma kulabo labengaba khona emgodini wabo, nakubo bonke abantu."
Babeka sibhakabhaka sakhe ethempelini la-Ashtorethi, babeka lilanga lakhe emgodini waBeth-Shani.
Batsi labahlali baseJabhesi-Gileyadi bafundile konkhe labekubonise uSawula labaFilisti.
bahamba nabo bonke labaholi babo ngebusuku, bafika eBeth-Shani, bakhuphula ticubu taSawula netibondza lakhe kusuka emgodini, bafike eJabheshi, babacubha khona.
Bathabathela emathambo abo, bawafihla ngaphansi kwesihlahla se-tamari eJabheshi, bafunga lilanga lesitsatfu.
2Sam: Batsi: "Ekupheleni kwekuphila kwa-Sauli, lapho uDavide ebuyela khona ngemuva kwekuhlasela kwa-Amaleki, wahlala iminyaka lemibili eSiklagi.
Kwatsi kube ngelilanga lesithathu, kwafika umuntu esiteji saSawula, enesigqoko sakhe sicutshulwe, nemhlaba emlonyeni wakhe; wafika kuDavide, wehla emhlabatsini, waba ngumnikelo wesono.
UDavide watsi kuye: "Uvela phi?" Waphendvula watsi: "Ngisuka esiteji sakwa-Israyeli."
UDavide watsi: "Kube yini? Nceda ukhulume nami." Waphendvula watsi: "Labantfu baphuma emgwaqeni, kwatsi nalabaningi labasemndenini wakhe babulawa; neSawula kanye noJonathane umsa wakhe nabo bafa."
UDavide watsi kulowo mshayeli: "Ungazi kanjani kutsi uSawula kanye noYonatan, umsa wakhe, bafile?"
Waphendvula watsi: "Ngibe sengihlala eMfula iGilboa, ngatsi ngibona uSawula ekhonjiswe emgodini wakhe, nemoto yakhe kanye nabangani bakhe behamba ngenqanawa bengena kuye.
Wabheka emuva kwakhe, wambona, wamemetela; ngobe ngitsi: 'Ngikhona.'
Watsi: 'Ubani?' Nami ngati kuye: 'Ngiye ngu-Amaleki.'
Watsi kuye: "Nceda, hlala ngimi, uyawubulala; ngobe sengihluphekile kakhulu, kepha sengiphila."
Ngiye ngangena kuye, ngawubulala; ngobe ngawazi kutsi angeke aphile ngemuva kwekudlidliza kwakhe; ngathatha inhloko yakhe kanye nentambo yesandla sakhe, ngazifaka lapha kumphathi wami."
UDavide watsi: "Awu, Simakadze, ngobe ngitsi kuwe: 'Ngitakususa kulo mhlaba.' "
Baye baphazamisa, balilingisa, bengenakudla kuze kube sebusuku, ngenxa ka-Sauli noJonathani unyana wakhe, nebantfu bakaSimakadze, namakhosikazi aseSirayeli; ngobe babefa ngesandla.
UDavide watsi kulowo mshayeli: "Uvelaphi?" Waphendula watsi: "Ngiye unyana womhlali, umFilisti, wase-Amaleki."
UDavide watsi kuye: "Ngubani na lokungalokothi uphakamise isandla sakho ukubulala ukumkani, lowo Simakadze abewukhethile?"
UDavide watsi kusinye sesive sakhe, watsi: "Thinda umphile." Wamphilela, washona.
UDavide watsi kuye: "Dla lakho libe ngenhlavu yakho; umlomo wakho wakhuluma kuwe, watsi: 'Ngiyawubulala ukumkani lokhethiwe nguSimakadze.'"
UDavide wabhala ingoma lenjalo yekumsola uSawula naJonathani, umsa wakhe.
Waletsa kutsi bafundiswe lingoma leli, lelibizwa ngeLingoma Lekuboshwa Kwesibhakabhaka; libhalwe encwadini yeJashar.
Ubukhosi bakho, Israele, bufile emadolobheni akho; bangakaphi labo labakhulu!
Ungawukhulumanga lomsebenzi eGathi, ungawushumayeli emigwaqweni yase-Ashkeloni, ukuze zingavumi izingane zamakhosikazi laFilisti, nezingane zalabo abaphumayo, bangavumi.

Lamadolobha eGilboya, ungabi nemvula, ungabi namanzi, mhlaba ungeke ukhule ube ngumnikelo wesono; ngobe khona lapho igolide lelabo abakhulu lihleliwe, lithunyelwe; igolide laSawula aligcotshwanga ngemafutha.
Isandla seJonathani asizange sibuyiselwe emuva kusuka emphinjeni yalabo abafileyo, kanye nesikhumba salabakhulu; nesikhephe saSawula asizange sibuyiselwe emuva sinye.
Sawule naJonathani, labathandekayo nelabathandekayo ekuphila kwabo, bahlukaniswe nasekufaneni kwabo; behamba ngejubane lelikhulu kunetingulube, babenamandla kunaleliona.
Lamakhosikazi aseSirayeli, lingisani ngeSawula, lowo webeka nine ingubo yesiliva negolide, wabeka emacwecwe egolide emigqomo yenu.
Ngiyabona kutsi labakhulu batfunywa emgwaqeni; Jonathane ulele emhlabatsini lakho, washona.
"Nginenhliziyo ebuhlungu kuwe, Jonathane, mzalwana wami! Ube umnandi kakhulu kum; lothando lwakho lwami lube luhle kakhulu kunalo lomfana.
Ngabe baholi labakhulu baphucukile, nemikhumbi yabo yekulwa ilahlekile!
Ngako-ke Davide wabuza uSimakadze, watsi: "Ngaya esinye semadolobha laYuda?" Simakadze watsi: "Thina siyawuhamba." UDavide wathi: "Ngaya phi?" Nkulunkulu watsi: "EHebroni."
Waya khona Davide, naye namakhosikazi akhe lababili, Ahinoamu waseJezreyeli, ne-Abigayili, umsa waNabali waseKarmeli.
Nabo-Davide wabakhipha nabo, nalabo labengabe naye, ngalowo nemindeni yakhe; bahlala emigwaqweni yaseHebroni.
Batsi bafika lamadodana eYuda, wabapha Davide kutsi abe ngukumkani phezu kwabantfu beJuda; bakhuluma kuDavide batsi: "Laba baseJabhesi-Gileyadi bangabo lababulale uSawula."
UDavide wathumela labaseJabhesi-Gileyadi, watsi kubo: "UNkulunkulu awubambisene nabo, ngobe niyenzile lothando lolu kuSawula, umphathi wenu, kutsi niyawubulala.
Ngako-ke, Simakadze akusibonele ubuhlobo bakhe kanye neqiniso lakhe; nami ngikubonise kahle, ngobe sewukwenze lokhu.
Ngako-ke, nikhululeke, nibe nemandla; ngobe unkhosi yenu iSawula ifile, nalabo baseYuda bangisipha kutsi ngibe nguMbuso wabo.
Ngako Abneri, umsa waNeri, umlingiswa wemphi yaSawula, waya eMahanayini na-Ishboshethi, unyana waSawula.
Lakhona wamkhipha waba nguMbuso waseGileyadi, nawaseAshuri, nawaseJezreeli, nawaseEfraim, nawaseBenjamini, kanye nabo bonkhe labaSirayeli.
U-Ishboshethi, unyana waSawula, ubeneminyaka lemashumi lamane ebudala lapho waba ngunkhosi yaseSirayeli; waba ngubukhosi beminyaka lemibili.
Iminyaka lesikhombisa nemashumi lamane Davide abengunkhosi yase-Hebron, emadvodzana nemadvodzakati aJuda.
Waphuma Abneri, umsa waNeri, kanye nebantfu ba-Ishboshethi, umsa waSawula, besuka eMahanayini baya eGibeoni.
Waphuma naYowabhi, umsa waZeruya, naye kanye nebantfu bakaDavide, bahlangana nabo eGibeboni; ibandla elinye lihlala kwelinye icala lelwandle, nelinye lihlala kwelinye.
Watsi Abneri kuYowabha: "Bafike labancane, bahlangane nathi!" UYowabha watsi: "Bafike."
Baphuma, babalwa, labalishumi elinambili beBenjamini na-Ishboshethi, unyana waSawula, nemadvodza laDavide alishumi elinambili.
Batsi: "Kule ndawo, eGibeboni, babeka igama elithi Helkathi-Hasurimi; ngobe laba baseGibeboni baphindze bahlaba umkhosi ngesandla sabo, babulala labaseGibeboni kanye.
Lemphi yahlasela kakhulu ngalolusuku, Abneri namadodana eSirayeli ahlaselwa ngalabo baholi bakaDavide.
Bakhona khona bonkhe bantfu labathathu ba-Zeruya: Joabhu, naAbishai, naAsaheli; Asaheli waba ngumuntfu losheshayo, wahamba ngaso sonke sikhatsi.
Asaheli walandzela Abneri, watsi: "Ase angeke ahambe ngakwesokudla noma ngakwesobunxele, ngobe ngiye naye."
Abneri wabheka emuva, watsi: "Ukho yini wena, Asaheli?" Waphendula watsi: "Yebo!"
Watsi kuye Abneri: "Thinda ngakwesokudla kwakho noma ngakwesobunxele lwakho, ubambe lomunye walabo bancane, uthathe impahla yakhe yekulwa." Kodwa Asaheli akazange amyeke.
UAbneri watsi ku-Asaheli: "Lala ngami; yini lengingakubulala wena? Ngabe ngingeke ngiyobhekana naJowab, lomngane wakho?"

Asaheli akazange ahambe, kodvwa Abneri wamshaya ngesandla sakhe esincane emphinjeni lakhe, waphuma umcibisholo emilenzeni yakhe; wehla wayafa khona. Wonke lowo wangena endaweni lapho Asaheli abewela khona, wahlala khona.

UYowabhi na-Abishai balandzela uAbner, bafika lapho lilanga liphuma khona, befike efulethini laMama, elinamakhilomitha lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa ukusuka eGiya, eduze kwendlela yesigabeni saseGibheboni.
Lamadoda eBhenjamini ahlangana ngemuva kwa-Abner, abe yiqembu elinye, wahlala phezulu komfula lomunye.

Watsi Abneri watsi kuYowabe: "Kungeke kube yini kutsi isandla sibulala kuze kufike ekupheleni? Awusazi yini kutsi lesi siphele ngebuhlungu? Kungakapheli nini lapho utawuletsa khona labangane bakho ukuba bayeke lokudlwengulana nabo?"
UYowabhi watsi: "NguNkulunkulu lophilayo, uma ungazange ukhulume, khona-ke labangani bami bebengabi nekuthula kuze kube ngubusuku.
UYowabhi watsi: "Nceda uvule isibhakabhaka, bese bahlala bonke abantu bakhe; bangabi nakunye neSirayeli, babuyela emphini."
Abheri nebantfu bakhe bahamba ngendawo yase-Arabha yonke lebusuku, badlula eJordane, bahamba ngaso sonke saseBithroni, bafika eMahanayini.
UYowabhi wabuyela, watsi: "Ngatsi-ke uJowabe ufike wahlangana nabo bonkhe bantfu labakhona; kwaba sekuphele lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu emabutfo aDavide kanye naAsaheli."
Lamadvodza laDavide ayawubulala lamadodana ka-Abner eBenjamini, lamakhulu lamabili namashumi lamane nesihlanu.
Bafike bakhipha Asaheli, bamfihla emgodini wababa wakhe eBethlehem; kodvwa Joabhi namadodana akhe bahamba yonke lebusuku, bafika eHebroni lapho kuvuka khona umlilo.
Kube khona umkhosi phakathi kwendlu ka-Sauli nendlu kaDavide iminyaka leminingi; kodvwa uDavidi wahlala enamandla kakhulu, kepha indlu ka-Sauli yahlala iphansi.
Wazalwa nguDavide bantfu eHebroni: lomkhulu wakhe waba nguAmnhoni, wa-Ahinoamu waseJezreeli.
Lomunye waba nguKilehabi, waAbigayeli, umkaNabali waseKarmeli; lowesibili waba nguAbsalomu, unyana kaMahaka, indodana kaTalmai, ukumkani waseGeshuri.
lokwesihlanu waba nguShefatiya, unyana wa-Abitale; lokwesikhombisa waba nguJoshuwa, unyana wa-Abhiya.
Lomnyaka wasikhombisa waba nguYitreyami, wa-Egla, indodana kaDavide; laba bazalwa nguDavide eHebroni.
Kube khona umkhosi phakathi kwendlu yaSawula nendlu kaDavide; Abneri ke wahlala ekhula, waba mkhulu kakhulu emndenini waSauli.
USawula ubenenkosikazi yakhe, indvodzakati yaRispa, indodana ka-Ahiya; watsi Ishboshethi kuAbner: "Ngubani na lowudlale nenkhosikati yami?"

UAbneri wehluleke kakhulu ngaleso sinqumo sa-Ishboshethi, waphendula watsi: "Ngabe sengumkhwenyana losebenza kuYuda? Ngiye ngisebenzela indlu kaSawula ubaba wakho, nabangane bakhe, nabangani bakhe, kuze kube namuhla; ngiyakunikela esandlani sikaDavide, kodvwa namuhla ungisola ngento engeyiyo ngalowo mfana.
Nkulunkulu amnike njalo-ke, anike kanjalo-ke, uma sengingeke ngikwenzela Davide njengobe uSimakadze wehlule kuye:
kutsi ngisuse ubukhosi emndenini wa-Sauli, ngibeke inhloko yaDavide phezu kweSirayeli neYuda, kusuka eDani kuya eBherishebha.
U-Ishboshethi akazange aphinde akhulume naAbner, ngobe wayemkhohlela.
U-Abneri watsi kuDavide: "Ngubani lemhlaba? Sebenzisa sivumelwano nami, ngitakusiza kutsi ubambe lamakhosikazi aseSirayeli wonke afike kuwe."
UDavide watsi: "Kulungile, ngizokwenza sivumelwano nawe; kepha ngicela kuwe into eyodwa, kutsi ungeke ufike ubone ibuso bami, ngaphandle kokuthi ufike ube neMekholi, indodana kaShawule."
UDavide wathumela labaholi ku-Ishboshethi, unyana kaSawula, watsi: "Nceda unciphise indodana yami, iMikhaleli; ngiyikhokhele ngesikhumba semaFilisti lamakhulu lasitfupha."
U-Ishboshethi wathumela, watsi: "Thintela umkakhe, uPaltiyeli, umsa kaLayisi."
Umfazi wakhe wahamba naye, waphuma waya eBahurim, ekhala. Watsi-ke Abneri watsi kuye: "Buyela ekhaya lakho!" Wabuyela endlini yakhe.
Abnere wakhuluma nabaholi beSirayeli, watsi: "Namuhla naleso sikhathi nifuna kutsi uDavide abe ngunkhosi yenu.
Namuhla nikwenze; ngobe Simakadze ukhuluma ngeDavide, watsi: Ngesandla semkhonzi wami Davide, ngiyawusindisa bantfu bamSirayeli kusuka kumaFilisti nakubo bonkhe lababubi babo.
UAbheri wakhuluma namadodana eBhenjamini, waya eHebroni kutsi akhulume naDavide ngaso sonke sive seSirayeli nesonke sihlanganiso seBenjamini.
Wafika Abneri kuDavide eHebroni, naye namadoda lamashumi lamabili. UDavidi wabambise Abneri nebantfu bakhe bokudla.

Watsi Abneri kuDavide: "Ngaye ngiya, ngikuhlangabeze bonke laSirayeli kuwe, nkosi yami ukumkani, ukuze bakwenzele umhlangano nawe, wena ube ngunkhosi yakho ngaso sonke sifiso senhliziyo yakho." UDavide waletsa Abneri, waya ekuthula.
Batsi bafike labakhonzi bakaDavide naYowabha, besuka ekungeneni kwabo, bezinikela ngezinto letinene eziningi; Abneri akazange ahlale naye kuDavide eHebroni, ngobe uDavidi abemshiya, waphuma ekuthula.
Wafika uYowabha nebantfu bakhe bonke, bakhuluma kuYowabha bati, "Abner, umsa ka-Neri, wafika ekungeneni kwenkhosi, watsi: 'Ngimvumele ahambe ngekuthula.'
UYowabhi wafika kunkhosi, watsi: "Ngubani lowenza lokhu? Ab'neri ufike kuwe; kungani ungamuvumela ahambe? Namuhla uyaphuma.
Uyazi Abneri, umsa wa-Neri. Wafika kutsi akukhohlise, kutsi abone kuhamba kwakho, nekungena kwakho, nekuphuma kwakho, nakwenta konke lokwenzayo."
UYowabhi waphuma eDavideni, wathumela lamaphoyisa emuva kwaAbner, wababuyisela emfuleni i-Sira; Davide akazange awazi.

Wabuyela Abneri e-Hebron, Joabhi wehla waya emgwaqeni wesango kutsi akhulume naye ngesikhashana; watsi: "Lakho kungenxa yekufa kwaAsaheli, lomkhuluwa wakho." UJowabe watsatsa uAbner ngesandla sakhe sakwesobunxele, wambulala.
UDavide, lapho akubona khona ngemuva kwalokho, watsi: "Nginecala, mina nebukhosi bami, phambi kuSimakadze kuze kube sekupheleni ngekufa kukaAbner, unyana kaNeri.

Kufike kuYowabha, nakubo bonke labahlala emndenini wakhe ubaba; kube khona lomunye wemadvodzana aJowabha enhliziyweni yakhe, kanye nenkosikazi yakhe lephila ngesifo sesikhumba, nalomunye lohlala emgodini, nabo bonkhe labafa ngesikhephe, nabo tonkhe tifo letibulalayo.
UYowabhi na-Abhishai, lomzalwana wakhe, babulala uAbner, ngobe abewubulala umhlobo wabo, uAsaheli, emkhosini eGibeboni.
UDavide watsi kuYowabhi, nakubo bonke bantfu labakhona naye: "Lahlani ingubo yenu, nigqoke ingcotjo, nanikeleni phambi kwa-Abriyamu." Umkhosi uDavide wahamba ngemuva kwendlu, ethatha livi lakhe.
Bemfihla Abneri eHebroni; ngobe unkhosi yaliba nelizwi likhulu emphilweni kaAbner, nabo bonke bantfu baliba.
Unkhosi yakhuluma ingoma lenjalo nge-Abner, yatsi: "Bekufanele yini kutsi u-Abner aphelelwe njengobe umtfubi aphele?
Amehlo akho angeke abandlululwe, nemilenze yakho ingeke ibekwe emgodini; wena utawufa njengemuntfu lowela phambi kwalabo lababi. Lakho bonke bantfu baphinde bavuma kuye.

Befika bonke bantfu becela Davide kutsi aphuze kudla kuze kube limini; kodvwa Davide watsi: "Nkulunkulu aninike lokhu kanye nalokunye, uma ngidla inhlanzi noma yini nayinye ngaphambi kokuba lilanga liphele."
Labantfu bonkhe bakubona lokhu, kwaba kuhle kubo; kanjalo nanoma yini lekungenwa ngukumkani yabe iyilungile kubo.
Lawo mhla bonke bantfu kanye nabo bonkhe base-Israyeli babone kutsi kwakungeke kube ngumnyaka waSimakadze lapho Abnere, umsa waNeri, abulawa khona.
Unkhosi yatsi kubo bonkhe bantfu bakhe: "Awazi yini kutsi namuhla umholi omkhulu weSirayeli ubulawa?
Nakuba ngiyinkhosi lekhethiwe, namuhla sengincane kakhulu; nabo bonkhe bantfu baseSeruya banzima kunemi. Simakadze abuye akhokhele lowo lokwenza lokubi, njengobe abewenza lokubi.
Ishboshethi, unyana waSawula, lapho ekubona ukuthi uAbner ubefile eHebroni, akazange akhululeke kakhulu; nabo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli bakhathaza.

USawula wayenemadodana lasitfupha, abaholi bemikhosi; igama lelinye lalaba nguBahana, nelinye lalaba nguRekabu; laba babe yimadvodzana aRimoni waseBeerothi, waseBhenjamini. (Beerothi yabekwa eBenjamini;
ngobe bantfu be-Beerothi bafike eGitayini, bahlala khona njengebahlali kuze kube nguleso sikhatsi.

UYonatan, unyana wa-Sauli, wayenemnyaka lositfupha lapho kufike khona indaba ya-Sauli na-Jonathan eJezreyeli. Lomzali wakhe wamphakamisa, wabaleka; kodvwa ngesikhathi ehamba, wagwaca, waba ngumfoti; igama lakhe lakunguMephiboshethi.
Rekabu naBaana, bantfu baseRimoni waseBeerothi, baphuma befika endlwini ya-Ishboshethi, lapho kubanda khona lilanga; yena wahlala embhedeni ngekusasa.
Bafika endlwini, becabanga kutsi bafuna umnikelo wesono, batsi: "U-Rekabu na-Baana, umzalwana wakhe, bayaphuma."
Bafike endlwini yakhe, lapho ehlala khona embhedeni wakhe egumbini lakhe lokuphumula, bamphatsa, bambulala, bamisa inhlavu yakhe, bathatha inhlavu yakhe, bahamba ngendlela yase-Arabha yonke lebusuku.

Bafike bakhipha inhloko ya-Ishboshethi, bayisa kuDavide eHebroni, batsi kunkhosi: "Bona, inhloko ya-Ishboshethi, unyana wa-Sauli, umfowabo, loye wafuna kuphila kwakho; Simakadze utawukubuyisela namuhla uSawula kanye nendlu yakhe kumphathi wami, ukumkani."
UDavide waphendula watsi kuRekabu naBahana, lomkhuluwa wakhe, bantfu ba-Rimoni waseBeerothi: "Ngiphila Simakadze, lowo lamikhipha kuwo wonke umonakalo,
Watsi lapho lomuntfu ekhuluma nami, watsi: 'Sawule ufile.' Wacabanga kutsi ufika ngezindaba letinene; kodvwa ngawukhipha, ngawubulala eSikelagi; leyisibopho sakhe, ngobe wakhuluma nami.
Ngubani na longeke ngiwugweme umphefumulo webantfu lababi, lababulala umuntu ongenacala embhedeni wakhe, endlwini yakhe? Akufanele yini kutsi lilanga lakhe lifike kuwe, nami ngikucishe ngemhlaba!"

UDavide waletsa labangani bakhe, babulala labo madodana, bacubhukisa isandla sabo nenyawo labo, bamkhonta emfuleni wase-Hebron. Bathathe inhlavu ya-Ishboshethi, bayifihla ethempelini la-Abner eHebroni.
Bafike bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli kuDavide eHebroni, bakhuluma batsi: "Thina sihlobo lwakho kanye nenyama yakho.
Nasekuqaleni, lapho uSawuleli abe ngukumkani wethu, wena ubewuphuma ubewubuyela eSirayeli; Simakadze watsi kuwe: 'Uya kuba ngumhlambi webantfu bami baseSirayeli, nawe uzoba nguMengameli wabo.'"
Bafike bonke bantfu baseSirayeli kunkhosi eHebroni, ngobe inkhosi Davide yabambisene nabo khona lapho phambi kwaSimakadze; batsi: UDavide ube nguMbuso waseSirayeli.
UDavide ubeneminyaka lemashumi lamane eminyaka ubudala lapho afika ebukhosini, waba ngunkhosi iminyaka lemashumi mane.
EHebroni waba ngunkhosi yaseYuda iminyaka lesikhombisa namashumi lamabili nesihlanu; eJerusalema waba ngunkhosi yakaJuda nawaseJuda iminyaka lemashumi lamakhulu mathathu namane.

Wayikhipha iSiyone, leyayibe yidolobha laDavide.
