UHiramu, ukumkani weTire, wathumela labaholi kuDavide, nasetindzaweni tesedari, nabangani bokhuni, nabangani bomkhonto; nabo bakwakha indlu kuDavide.
UDavide wakhumbula kutsi uSimakadze ubewumisa waba ngunkhosi yaseSirayeli, ngobe ubukhosi bakhe bebuphakeme kakhulu ngenxa yalabahlali bakhe baseSirayeli.
UDavide wahlala eJerusalema iminyaka lelishumi nambili, watsi: "Namuhla ngifike eJerusalema, ngobe nguNkulunkulu wendlu yami, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli.
Lemi magama abo labazalwa kuye eJerusalema: Shamua, naShobab, naNatan, naSolomoni,
Ibhaari, neElishuwa, naNefegi, naJaphia,
Elishama, neEliyada, neElifeleti.
Batsi bafundile labaFilisti kutsi uDavide ubephucukile waba ngunkhosi yase-Israyeli, baphuma bonke labaFilisti befuna uDavide. Bafundile khona Davide, waphuma waya endlunkulu.
Bafika nabo labaFilisti, baphikelela eGiliyadi yeRefayi.
UDavide wabuza uSimakadze, watsi: "Ngaya kulwa nalabaFilistimi? Utawubanikela emandleni ami?" UNkulunkulu watsi kuDavide: "Hamba, ngobe ngiyawubeka labaFilistimi emandla akho."
UDavide wafika eBaale-Perazimu, wababulala khona, watsi: "Simakadze uvule umgodzi phakathi kwababi bami phambi kwami, njengobe amanzi avule umgodzi wakhe." Ngako lomhlaba wabizwa ngeBaale-Perazimu.
Bashiya khona imihlobiso yabo, Davide namadodana akhe ayawuyikhipha.
Baphinde baphuma labaFilisti, basakazeka efulethini laRefayim.
UDavide wabuza uSimakadze, watsi: "Ungabahlaseli ngaphesheya kwesokudla; buyela emuva kwabo, ubahlasele ngaphesheya kwezintaba-mlilo.
Uma ukhuluma, bese ubona umsindo lophuma ematsheni esihlahla se-mull, khona-ke uyawuhamba; ngobe Simakadze utawuphuma phambi kwakho kutsi ahlasele imphi yalabaFilisti.
UDavide wakwenza njengobe Simakadze abemwisele kutsi akwenze, wababulala labaFilistiti kusuka eGibeha kuya eGezeri.
UDavide wahlangana nabo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli labakhethiwe, lamakhulu lamashumi lamane.

UDavide wasuka eBaale-Juda, yena nalabo bonke labanye bakhe, besuka khona bakhipha ibhokisi leNkulunkulu, elalibizwa ngegama lakhe, ibhokisi leSimakadze longuSomandla, lohlala ebukhosini bakhe phezu kwalabo abaphila ngamehlo.
Babeka ibhokisi laNkulunkulu ebhasini elisha, balisa lisuka endlwini ka-Abinabadi, leyayise entabeni; Uza naAhio, bantfu baka-Abinabadi, babehamba nebhasi.
Beyikhipha endlwini ka-Abinabadi, eGileyadi; ibhokisi laNkulunkulu libe nalo, naAhio wahamba phambi kwebhokisi.
UDavide kanye nabo bonkhe bantfu base-Israyeli babedlala phambi kwaSimakadze, bekhuluma ngemiculo yesihlahla se-cypress, nezinhlamvu, nema-harps, nama-tamburins, nama-rattles, nama-cimbalo.
Bafike bafika emgwaqeni waNakhone, emagilebhisi ahlaba umxhwele. U-Uza wehlisa isandla sakhe, waba nebhokisi laNkulunkulu.
Watsi umlilo wendlala yaSimakadze wehla phezu kwa-Uza, Nkulunkulu wambulala khona ngenxa yesono sakhe; wafa khona ecaleni lebhokisi laNkulunkulu.
UDavide wahlupheka kakhulu, ngobe uSimakadze abewuphazamisa u-Uza; watsi kuleyo ndawo: "Perezi-Uza," kuze kube namuhla.
UDavide wakhathazeka kuSimakadze ngalolusuku, watsi: "Ngabe ibhokisi laNkulunkulu liyawufika kimi?"
Ngako-ke uDavide akazange afake ibhokisi laSimakadze kuye edolobhani laDavide, kutsi lihlale naye; wayisa endlwini kaObedi-Edomu waseGathi.
Ibhokisi laSimakadze lahlala endlwini ka-Obede-Edomu waseGathi iminyaka emithathu; Simakadze wabambisana na-Obede-Edomu nendlu yakhe yonke.

Bakhuluma kuDavide, batsi: "UNkulunkulu ubulele indlu ka-Obedi-Edomu kanye naleyo yonke into yakhe ngenxa yebhokisi laSimakadze." UDavidi waya wafaka ibhokisi lebukhosi emnyango wendlu ka-Obedi-Edomu waya emzini wakwaDavide ngekuthula.
Nalapho labo labahambisa ibhokisi laSimakadze bebehlele ngenyawo lesixhenxe, uDavide wanikela ngenkomo kanye nengulube leyimisiwe.
UDavide wadansa phambi kwaSimakadze ngemandla akhe wonke, egqoke i-ephod yelineni, ingubo yenkhosi.
Ngako-ke uDavide kanye nabo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli baphakamisa ibhokisi lenkhosi, bekhuluma ngekuphumula, nebucwebe.
Kube sekufike ibhokisi laSimakadze eMzini waDavide, uMikhayeli, intombi ka-Sauli, wabheka ngetefuleni, wabona ukumkani uDavide enqoba, edansa phambi kwaSimakadze; watsi ngubi kuye emlonyeni wakhe.
Bafike bafaka ibhokisi laSimakadze, bayibeka endaweni yayo emidlweni yetenti leDavide abeyilungiselele; Davide wanikela ngenhlanhla ngeminikelo yekushiswa neyekuthula phambi kwaSimakadze.
UDavide, lapho aphelelwe khona ekunikela ngeminikelo yekushiswa neminikelo yekuthula, wabambisana nabo bonkhe bantfu ngegama laSimakadze Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli.
Wanikela ngekudla kuwo wonke lamakhosikazi aseSirayeli, madoda nabesifazane; wanikela kulowo nalowo ngemnikelo wesono, nemnikelo wesonka, nemnikelo wesinaphi. Lamadvodza asuka endlwini yawo.

Wafika Davide emndenini wakhe kutsi abembisane nabo, waphuma uMikhayeli intombi ka-Sauli waya kuDavide watsi: "Kuhle kakhulu lobukhosi beSirayeli bosuku lwenu; sewuboshwa ngamehlo labangane bakhe labakhonjiwe, njengemuntu ongeke ahlobene nanoma yini.

UDavide watsi ku-Mikhali: "Ngase phambi kwaSimakadze, lowo wangisikhethela ngaphezu kukababa wakho, kanye nendlu yakhe yonke, kutsi ngibe nguMengameli webantfu bakaNkulunkulu baseSirayeli; ngiyakubonga ngase phambi kwaSimakadze.
Lakho ngitakwenza kube buhlungu kakhulu kunaloko, ngase ngibe mkhulu emehlo ami; kodvwa lamadodakazi lawa akhuluma ngawo utawungihlonipha.
NaMikhayeli, intombi ka-Sauli, akazange abe nendvodzakati yonke iminyaka yakhe.
Unkhosi yahlala endlwini yakhe, ngobe Simakadze abeyawumnika kuthula kutsi akhululeke kubo bonkhe lababubi bakhe labangaphandle.
Watsi ukumkani kuNathani umprofeti: "Bona, ngihlala endlwini yesedari, kepha ibhokisi laNkulunkulu lihlala etintenteni."
Nathani watsi kunkhosi: "Thina-ke sihambe, senze konkhe lokunenhliziyo yakho; ngobe Simakadze ukhona nawe.
Ngebusuku balo, kwafika kutsi kuNathani lizwi laSimakadze, watsi:
"Hamba ufike utsi umkhonzi wami Davide: Simakadze utsite kutsi, 'Uyawungikwakha yini indlu ngihlale kuyo?
Ngingeke ngihlale endlwini kusukela kuleso sikhathi lapho ngakhipha khona bantfu baseSirayeli emaGibhithe, kuze kube ngalolusuku lwamanje; kepha ngibe sengihamba ngetembu, nendlu yasengcwele.

Nakweyiphi na indawo lapho ngihamba khona nami bonkhe bantfu beSirayeli, ngabe ngakhuluma yini nanoma yimuphi webantfu bami baseSirayeli, ngobe ngitawubaletsa kutsi babe ngumhlambi walabo bantu bami beSirayeli, ngitsi: 'Ngubani longeke angenise indlu yesedari?'
Ngako-ke manje ukhuluma kulowo mkhonzi wami, uDavide, utsi: Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli utsi: Ngikuthathele emgwaqeni, ngemuva kwemihlambi, ngikwenza ube ngumholi phezu kwalabo bantu bami baseSirayeli.
Ngibe nawe ngaso sonke isikhathi lapho uphuma khona, ngiwubulala wonke umfo wakho phambi kwakho; ngiyakwenza igama lakho libe likhulu, njengegama lalabakhulu emhlaba.
Nami ngitawubeka khona bantfu bami base-Israyeli, nami ngiyawubamisa, bangahlala emhlabatsini sawo, bangabi nenkinga nhlobo; nalabo lababi bangabaphazamisi lutho njengaleso sikhatsi,

Nasekufeni kwami, kusukela kuleso sikhathi lapho ngabeka khona labaviwa kutsi baphambukele bantfu bangesiSirayeli; nami ngitakulethela ukuthula kusuka kubo bonkhe lababuphikisi bakho. NaSimakadze uyakusho kuwe, utsi: UNkulunkulu wakho utawukwakha wena indlu, kanye nendlu yebukhosi.
"Nalapho iminyaka yakho iphele khona, ufike uphumule nababa bakho, ngitawukhipha lomunye wemadvodzana akho kutsi abe ngunkhosi ngemuva kwakho, nebukhosi bakhe ngiyawubuqinisa.
Lowo uyawukwakha indlu ngegama lami, ngobe ngitawubeka phansi isikhundla sebukhosi bakhe kuze kube sekupheleni.
Ngiyawuba ngubaba wakhe, yena utawuba ngumntwana wami; uma ekwenza lokubi, ngiyawumuletsa ngesandla sakhe, njengendlela umfana lomusha akhulisa ngayo umntwana wakhe, ngesandla somuntu.
kepha inhlonipho yami ngeke isuseke kuye, njengobe ngiyisuse ku-Sauli, lowo ngawususa kutsi ugcine indlela yakho.
Lendlu yakho nebukhosi bakho buyawuhlala bukhona phambi kwami kuze kube sekupheleni; isikhundla sakho sitawutsi siqinile kuze kube sekupheleni.
Nathani wakhuluma kuDavide ngaleso sibonakaliso kanye nemazwi laSimakadze.
Wafika ukumkani Davide, wahlala phambi kwaSimakadze, watsi: "Ngubani nami, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, nokuthi yini lendlu yami, kutsi ugcine ngifike lapha?
Ngako-ke, Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, uma lokhu kungakuncane kuwe, wena utawukhuluma ngendlu yomkhonzi wakho kuze kube kuphele iminyaka lemikhulu; yini na, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli?
Ngingeke ngikutshele yini wena, Davide? Uyazi mkhonzi wakho, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli.
Ngako-ke, ngenxa yesive sakho, kanye nenhliziyo yakho, wakwenza lomhlaba wonke lomkhulu, uyawukhombisa umkhonzi wakho.
Ngako-ke wena umkhulu, Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu; akukho muntfu lofana nawe, naNkulunkulu awukho ngaphandle kwakho; sikubona ngemehlo ethu.

Naye yini lelizwe emhlaba lelifana nebantfu bakho, naboSirayeli? Wena, Nkulunkulu, waphuma utawubanikela kubo kutsi babe bantu bakho; wabanika igama lakho. Wakwenza lokudla lokukhulu kanye nalawo magugu amangalisayo ngenxa yeNingizimu yakho phambi kwalabo abantu bakho labewakhulula ema-Egipta, kusuka kumazwe lakwamanye amazwe nakumikhosi yabo.
Wabeka bantfu bakho, iSirayeli, laba bantu bakho kuze kube sekupheleni; nawe, Simakadze, waba nguNkulunkulu wabo.
Manje-ke, Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, gcina kulowo mkhonzi wakho kanye nendlu yakhe, kuze kube sekupheleni, kutsi ugcine amazwi akho, wenze njengoba wakhuluma.
Lakho kutsi likhululwe igama lakho kuze kube sekupheleni, batsi: USimakadze longuSomandla, uNkulunkulu waseSirayeli; nendlu yomkhonzi wakho Davide ihlale iqinile phambi kwakho.

"Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, unguNkulunkulu weSirayeli, wena lowo wabonisa umlomo wakho kumkhonzi wakho, watsi: 'Ngitakwakha indlu kuwe.' Ngako-ke umkhonzi wakho wathola umoya wakhe ukuba akubulele lomthandazo.
Ngako-ke, Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, wena uNkulunkulu, namazwi akho nguNkulunkulu weqiniso; nawe wakhuluma lokudla lokubi kumkhonzi wakho.

Namuhla, ngiyakucela, ubambise indlu yomkhonzi wakho, ukuze ihlale phambi kwakho kuze kube sekupheleni; ngobe wena, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, wakhuluma, watsi: Ngekubambisana kwakho, indlu yomkhonzi wakho izobanjwa kuze kube sekupheleni.
Naleso sikhatsi Davide wababulala labaFilisti, wabeka isandla sakhe phezu kwabo, wakhipha eMethegi-amma, inhloko yabo, emandleni laFilisti.

Wahlasela naMowabi, wabeka lababoshwa embhedeni emhlabeni, wabamisa ngentambo; labulala ingxenye lemibili yentambo, wagcina iyunithi elinye liphila. Amakhosi aseMoabhi afike abe ngumkhonzi kaDavide, anikela ngenhlawulo yakhe kuye.
UDavide wahlasela naHadarezere, umsa kaRehobohi, ukumkani waseZoba, lapho asuka khona ekubuyiseleni isandla sakhe emfuleni i-Ephrathi.

UDavide wabulala ema-Amori lamakhulu lamabili nemashumi ayisithupha, nalabahamba ngenyawo labalishumi elinesihlanu; uDavidi wehlisa imilenze yaso sonke isibhakabhaka sayo, ngobe akazange ashiye sibhakabhaka lesilikhulu.
Befika baArami baseDamasko, besiza kuHadarezere, ukumkani waseZoba; kodvwa Davide wababulala laba Arame baseDamasko lamakhulu matsatfu namashumi lamabili nembili.
UDavide wabeka emabutfo ebukhosini base-Aram, eDamaskus. Bafike babe ngabakhonzi bakhe, bekhokha mnikelo wakhe; Simakadze wabavikela Davide lapho waya khona.
UDavide wathatha tibhande tegolide, letibekiwe nguHadadarezere, wazisa eJerusalema.
KuBetha, neBerothai, tidolobha ta-Hadarezere, ukumkani Davide wathatha isiliva elikhulu kakhulu.
Towi, inkhosi yaseHamati, wakhuluma kutsi Davide wababulala bonke bantfu ba-Adarezere.

U-Toyi wathumela uJoram, mntwana wakhe, kunkhosi Davide, kutsi amhlelele, abuletele, watsi: "Uyawuhlasela naHadarezere; ngobe uHadarezere ube nekulwa no-Toyi." U-Joram wanikela ngesiliva, negolide, nensimbi.
Unkhosi Davide yanikela ngayo kuSimakadze, kanye negolide nesilivere laye abeneso lakubondza ema-Israyeli lapho abewuhlasela khona:
wakhipha ema-Arami, namaMoabi, nemadvodzana a-Ammon, neFilisti, ne-Amaleki; wabuyisela naleso sitfunywa sakhe, lapho abewuthathe khona kuHadarezere, umsa waRehobohi, ukumkani weZoba.
UDavide wabekwa igama, lapho ebuyela khona ngemuva kwekuhlasela kwa-Aram emaphesenti lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa emfuleni weSila.
Wabeka emabhuleki kuwo wonke lamadolobha eEdomu, nalabo bonke base-Edomu babuye babe ngumkhonzi waDavide; Simakadze wabavikela Davide lapho waya khona.
UDavide waba ngumtsetfo waSimakadze kuwo wonke lamakhosi aseSirayeli, watsi: "Lawo mandla ayawuhlala enkhosini yami.
Joabhu, umsa waZeruya, waba nguMengameli webantfu; naJosaphat, umsa waAhilodi, waba ngumbhali.
Sadoki, umsa wa-Ahitubi, ne-Akhimeleki, umsa wa-Abiathari, babe baLevi; Seraya waba ngumbhali wenkhosi.
Benaya, umsa ka-Jehoyada, waba nguMengameli webaKherethi nalabaPhelethi, labagcina umbuso waSimakadze; nemadvodzana aDavide bekubo abaphathi bakhe.
UDavide watsi: "Asekho namunye loshiwo emndenini wa-Sauli, kutsi ngiwubonele uthando ngenxa ya-Jonathani?"
Kwabekhona umkhonzi wendlu yaSawula, igama lakhe lakunguSiba; wafunwa nguDavide, watsi kuye ukumkani: "Utsi yini wena, uSiba?" Waphendula watsi: "Ngingumkhonzi wakho."
Unkhosi yatsi: "Asekho namunye lophilayo emndenini wa-Sauli, kutsi ngibe nekuthula naye kuNkulunkulu?" Siba watsi kunkhosi: "Kukhona unyana wa-Jonathani, lowo mkhulule emilenzeni yakhe.
Unkhosi yatsi: "Ukhona phi?" Siba watsi: "Yebo, endlwini yaMakiri, umsa wa-Amiyeli, eLodebari."
Wayemthumela kutsi afike, waphuma endlwini yaMakiri, umsa wa-Amiyeli, eLo-Debari.
UMephiboshethi, unyana ka-Jonathani, lomkhuluwa waSawula, waya kuDavide, wehlisa isandla sakhe emhlabatsini. UDavide watsi: "Mephiboshethi!" Waphendula watsi: "Ngiye mkhonzi wakho."

UDavide watsi kuye: "Ungaze ukhathazeke, ngobe ngitakusinikela kuwe ngenhlonipho ngenxa ya-Yonathani loyise wakho; ngiyakubuyisela yonke itfu leyayibe nguSawula umntakwabo, nawe uzodla ukudla embhedeni wami nsuku zonke.
UMephiboshethi wehla, watsi: "Ngubani na mina, umkhonzi wakho, kutsi utsalele mehlo akho esilwane lesifile njengemi?"
Unkhosi yabiza uSiba, umkhonzi waSawula, yatsi kuye: Lonke lokube nguSawula nendlu yakhe, ngikunike lomnyaka mncane wenkosi yakho.

Uyawuyibulala, wena nemadvodzana akho kanye nalabakhonzi bakho; nawe utawuyisa lamahlombe akhe, kutsi kube ngumnikelo wekudla kumntwana waSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho. Mephiboshethi-ke uyadla embhedeni wami ngaso sonke isikhathi." USiba ubenemadvodza labelishumi elinhlanu nemakhosikazi amashumi mabili.
USiba watsi kunkhosi: "Lowo mkhonzi wakho uyakwenza konke lokushiwo nguSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, kutsi akwenze." UMephiboshethi wadla embhedeni kaDavide, njengemunye wemadvodzana ankhosi.
UMephiboshethi wayenemuntfu loncane, igama lakhe lakunguMika; bonke labahlala endluni yaSiba babe basebenti taMephibosethi.
UMephiboshethi wahlala eJerusalema, ngobe wayedla njalo embhedeni wenkhosi; yena ke waba nemilenze emibi.
Kutsi kube sekuphele iminyaka leminingi, wafa ubukhosi bemadvodzana a-Ammon; Hanun, umsa wakhe, waba nguMbuso.

UDavide watsi: "Ngiyawukhombisa inhlonipho kuHanuni, unyana kaNahashi, njengoba ubaba wakhe abengibonisa inhlonipho kimi." UDavide wathumela labakhonzi bakhe kutsi bamphilise Hanuni ngenhlonipho yakhe kuyise. Bafika ezweni lamakhosikazi e-Ammon.

Batsi bomkhuluwa ba-Ammon kuHanuni, lomphathi wabo: "Ucabanga kutsi uDavide u honora ubaba wakho ngekutsi athumela labangani bakho kutsi bakukhulise? Akunjalo; ngobe uDavide wabathumela kutsi abheke umjikelo wedolobha, abe ngumhloli walo, aze awubulala."
UHanuni wabathatha labakhonzi bakaDavide, wabasabalalisa ingxenye yemilenze yabo, washiya ingubo yabo ngaphesheya komlenze wabo, wabasusa.
UDavide wathumela labangani kutsi bafike kubo, ngobe laba madoda akazange abonwe kahle; watsi kubo: "Bukelani eJericho kuze kukhule imilenze yenu, bese nibuyela ekhaya."

Bebonase bo-Ammon ukuthi försöke Davide kutsi abe ngumfoti wabo, bathumela batsi: "Sicela sikhokhise eArami baseBethe-Rehobothi amadoda lamakhulu mahlanu ahamba ngenyawo, kanye noMbuso waseZoba waseMahaka namadoda lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu, naseTobi abantu labalishumi elinambini lamawaka.
UDavide, lapho akubona khona, wathumela uYowabha kanye nebantfu bakhe bonke, labanyenti kakhulu.
Baphuma bantfu ba-Ammon, balungiselela ukulwa emgwaqeni wenhloko yedolobha; kodvwa laSirayeli baseZobha neRehobothi, nalabo baseTobi naMaaki, bahlala phandle emhlabatsini.
UYowabha, lapho ebona khona kutsi umkhosi ubekwe phambi kwakhe nasemva kwakhe, wakhetha labaseSirayeli abakhethiwe, wababeka emgcekeni lokubhekana ne-Aram.
Labanye labeka ngaphansi kwesandla senkosi yakhe, uAbishai, watsi: "Nifike nihlangane nabo-Ammonini."
UYowabhi watsi: "Ngase-Asiriya bebanamandla kunami, wena uyawufika ungangisiza; kodvwa ngasemadvodzana a-Ammon bebanamandla kunakho, khona-ke mina ngitakusiza.
Uhlale uqinile, sibuye sesivune ngebantfu bethu nemadolobha kaNkulunkulu wethu; Simakadze akwenze lokuhle emehlo akhe.
UYowabhi namadoda akhe afike ekulwa ne-Aram; kodvwa la-Aram wabaleka phambi kwakhe.
Bekubona bantfu be-Ammon kutsi labaSirayeli baphuma, nabo baphuma phambi kuka-Abishai, babuyela enhlokodolobha yabo; watsi uYowabha: "Ngibuyela ema-Ammon, ngiye eJerusalema."
Bekubona la-Arami kutsi bahlaselwe nguSirayeli, baphinde bahlangana nabo.
Hadarezere wathumela akutsela laSirayeli labahlala ngaphesheya komfula i-Euphrates, bafika eHelamu; naye Shobhaki, umkhosi wakwaHadarezere, waba phambi kwabo.
Bathi kubo Davide, watsi: "UDavide ufike eHelamu, wahlangana nabo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli, wadlula eJordane, wafika eHelamu; laSirayeli balungiselela ukulwa noDavide.

LaSirayeli babaleka phambi kweSirayeli; Davide wabulala laSirayeli ema-carriages amakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamane, nalabahamba ngemoto lamawaka lamashumi mane; wabulala naShobhaki, umkhosi wakhe, wayafa khona.
Babona bonke bantfu ba-Hadarezere ukuthi bahlaselwe nguSirayeli, bamisa ukuthula naSirayeli, bahlala besebenza nabo. Amakhosi ase-Aram akazange aphinde abe ngumkhonzi wabantfu baka-Ammon.

Kwafika lapho, ngemnyaka wamashumi lamane nesihlanu wekubusa kwaDavide, ngesikhathi lamabutfo enkhosini aphuma emkhosini, watsi Davide wamthumela uYowabhi kanye nabo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli; babulala onkhe ema-Ammonita, bahlasela iRabha.

Kube kube sebusuku, Davide wavuka embhedeni wakhe, watsi: "Ngihamba ngendlu yangasemgwaqeni." 11Kwatsi lapho ahambe ngasemphumalanga yendlu yakhe yasemaphandleni, wababona lowesifazane enhliziyweni yakhe.
UDavide wathumela lomuntfu kutsi abuze yena, watsi: "Akho-ke iBathesheba, intombi kaEliyam, indodana kaUriya waseHeti?"
UDavide wathumela labaholi, wabakhipha, waya kuye, wahlala naye. Waye sewuphelile ukugeza kwakhe, wabuyela ekhaya lakhe, watsi: "Kulungile, ngiyakucela, ngingakushiya ngihambe.
Lowesifazane wakhulelwa, watsi kuDavide: "Mine sengikhulelwe."
UDavide wathumela kuYowabhi, watsi: "Thumela kumUriya, umHeti." UYowabhi wathumela uUriya kuDavide.
UUriya wafika, Davide wambuza watsi: "UJowabe uphila kanjani, nebantfu bangani, nakulwa luhamba njani?"
UDavide watsi ku-Uriya: "Yala ekhaya lakho, hlamba inyawo lakho, uphumule." UUriya waphuma endlwini yenkhosi, ngobe ukumkani abewuthumela umklomelo ngemuva kwakhe.
Kodwa-ke, Uriya akazange afike ekhaya lakhe, wahlala emnyango wendlu yasebukhosini nalabo bonke labakhonjiswe ngunkhosi yakhe.
Batsi kuDavide: "Uriya akazange afike ekhaya lakhe." UDavide watsi kuUriya: "Wena wabuyela ehambo; kungani ungazange uhambe ekhaya lakho?"

Uriya watsi kuDavide: "Ibhokisi, nemindeni yaSirayeli naYuda ihlala emakhazeni; unkhosi yami, uYowabhi, kanye nabo bonkhe labakhonzi bakho bahlala emhlabatsini. Ngabe ngiyawubuyela ekhaya ngidle, ngiphuze, ngiphumule nemkakhe? Ngiphila nguNkulunkulu wakho, ngeke ngikwenze lokhu!"
UDavide watsi ku-Uriya: "Khangela lapha ekuseni, bese ngikususa kusasa." UUriya wahlala eJerusalema ngalolusuku kanye nelilanga lesibili.

UDavide wamcela kutsi asele naye, abe nekudla kanye newayini, watsi: "Uya kuphuma uphumule embhedeni wakhe nalabo labasebenza kunkosi yakhe." Kwafika ekuseni, waphuma wahlala embhedeni wakhe nalabo labasebenza kunkhosi yakhe, kodvwa akazange afike ekhaya lakhe.
UDavide wabhala incwadi kuYowabhi, wayithumela ngesandla sa-Uriya.
Wabhalela kulo mbhalo, watsi: "Nibeke uUriya ngaphambili, lapho kunzima khona ukulwa, bese nibuyela emuva kuye, aze ahlaselwe abe sewufa."
UYowabhi, lapho ebhekene nenhloko-dolobha, wabeka uUriya endaweni lapho awazi khona kutsi bakhona lamadoda amakhulu.
Baphuma bantfu bedolobha, bahlasela uYowabha, babulala labanye bamakhosikazi kaDavide, wabulawa na-Uriya, umHeti.
UYowabhi watsi kuDavide: "Ngubani na lowo lokhuluma ngalolu phiko?
Watsi kulowo umthunywa: "Lakho, uma uphele ukhuluma kunkhosi yonke indaba yemphi,
Kube ukumkani ekhala, wakhuluma kuwe, watsi: 'Ngubani na lowufike umjikelo wedolobha kutsi uhlangane nalo? Awazi yini ukuthi batawutibulala emagwebu emgwaqeni?

Ubani lowabulala Abimeleke, umsa wa-Yerubheshethi? Ngabe angeke kube ngumkhwenyana lowutfusa emnyango umkhonto omkhulu wengilazi kuye, watsi: "Wafa" eTebez? Ngubani na lowo uyawufika eduze kwedonga? Nakuba ukhuluma njalo, utawutsi kuye: 'UUriya, mkhonto wakho, umHeti, naye wafa.'"
Wafika lowo umthunywa, wakhuluma kuDavide ngako konkhe loko loBenjamini abemthumela kuye.
Watsi lowo mholi kuDavide: "Labo bahlaseli babenamandla kunethu, baphuma behlasela emhlabatsini, kodvwa sitawubabulala kuze kube kufike emgwaqeni wesango.
Bathi labo labashaya ngesandla baphuca emakhonsatini abo kusuka edonga, babulala abanye labaholi benkhosi; nalowo mkhonzi wakho, uUriya, umHeti, washona.

UDavide watsi kulowo lophumayo, "Uyawutsi kubo uYowabha: 'Ungabi nenkinga ngalolu daba, ngobe isandla sibulala linye nalinye; cindezela umjikelo wakho emadolobheni bese usibulala.' Lala mazwi atawukuqinisa umoya uYowabha.
Lendvodzakati ka-Uriya yakhuluma kutsi u-Uriya, lowesifazane wayo, ufile, wathandaza kuSimakadze.
Kuphela lapho kuphelile khona ukuthula, Davide wathumela afike amtfumele endlwini yakhe; waba ngumkakhe, wazala naye umntwana. Lokudla kwakhe kwabe kungalungile ekuboneni kweSimakadze.
USimakadze wehlisa Nathani kuDavide. Wafika kuye, watsi kuye: "Bekukhona amadoda lababili enhlokodolobha, elinye linemali, elinye linenkinga.
Lomuntfu lomtfubi wayenebantfu labancane nelabakhulu kakhulu.

La Septimius, försöka kutsi agweme ukulimala kwakhe, watsi: "Ngubani na lowo mkhwenyana loncane labewuthengele wena?" 21Lomtfubi wayengenalutho ngaphandle kwengulube yakhe lencane eyayithengile. Wayikhula naye kanye nezingane zakhe; wadla kusuka emgodini wakhe, wayinywa ngebhotela lakhe, walala emilenzeni yakhe; waba nguyise njengenkosikazi.

Kuye kwafika umkhwenyana, wahamba waya kulowo muntu lomkhulu. Lomuntu lowo ungeke athathe inkomo yakhe noma ingulube yakhe kutsi abe nekudla lokulungiselela lomkhonto wakhe; kodvwa uyathatha lenyama yomtfubi welowo mncane, wehlisa kumkhonto wakhe.
UDavide waba nendlala kakhulu kuye, watsi kuNathani: "Ngiphila Simakadze, lowo muntu lowenza lokhu kumele abe ngumuntu wekufa.
Ake abuyisele emakhowe lamane ngelowo, ngobe wakwenza lomsebenzi, watsi: "Angeke ngikukhulule!"
Watsi Nathani kuDavide: "Uwo lomuntu; Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, usho kutsi: 'Ngikuphekile ube ngunkhosi yase-Israyeli, ngikukhulule esandla saSawula.
Ngikunike indlu yaSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho, nemakhosikazi enkhosini yakho emlenzeni wakho; ngikunike lamadodana aseSirayeli nawaseYuda; noma ngabe lokhu bekuncane kuwe, ngingakunikela nawe.

Ngabe, yini na, wena uyawukhohlisa amazwi kaSimakadze, ukwenze lokudla lokubi emlonyeni wakhe? Wabulala ngesandla Uriya, umHeti, wathatha indodana yakhe ube ngumfazi wakho; naye wewubulala ngesandla sama-Ammonhi.
Ngako-ke lilanga lingeke lihambe lisuka emndenini wakho, kuze kube sonke isikhathi, ngobe ungikhohlisile, uthathe indodana kaUriya, umHeti, ibe ngumfazi wakho.
Simakadze utsi: "Ngitakulethela umonakalo kusuka emndenini wakho, ngitawukhipha lamadodana akho phambi kwamehlo akho, ngiyawubanikela kumfana wakho, aze afike abe nemakhosikazi akho emthunzini.
Lakho nguNkulunkulu wakho, wena wakwenza lokubi kwakho ngekufihla-buso; kodvwa mina ngitakwenzela lokhu ngasenhliziyweni yaSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli.
UDavide watsi kuNathani: "Ngibe nesono kuSimakadze."UNathani watsi kuDavide, "Simakadze uyawususa nesono sakho; wena awutafa.
Kodwa-ke, ngobe wabeka icala emagugu enkhosini yakhe ngekudla kwakho, lowo mwana lozalwa kuwe utawufa.
UNathani wabuyela ekhaya lakhe, watsi: "UNkulunkulu ubulala lomuntfu lomshado we-Uriya abewuzala kuDavide; lowo mntwana waba buhlungu kakhulu.
UDavide wathandaza kuSimakadze ngelowo mntwana, watsi: "UNkulunkulu, hlala uphumule!" Waphuma, waya embhedeni wakhe, walala phansi.
Bafike bahlangana naye labakhulu emndenini wakhe, befuna kutsi akhuleke phansi; kodvwa yena akazange avumeleke, watsi: "Angeke ngidle nekudla nabo."

Kwafika usuku lwesine, wafa lomuntfu. Labasebenzi bakaDavide bakhathazekile kutsi bamutshele kutsi lomuntfu ufile; ngobe batsi: "Lamuhla, lapho lomuntfu ehlala khona, sakhuluma naDavide, kodvwa akazange akhulume nathi. Ngabe sitawumutshela kutsi lomuntfu ufile? Ungeke abe nenkinga."
UDavide wabona kutsi labakhonzi bakhe bekhuluma ngendlebe ngayinye, waqonda ukuthi lomuntfu ufile; watsi kulabo abakhonzi bakhe: "Lomuntfu ufile yini?" Baphendvula batsi: "Yebo, wafa."
UDavide wehla emhlabatsini, wahlamba, wamisa isikhumba sakhe, washintsha ingubo yakhe, waphuma waya endlwini yaSimakadze, wathandaza, wabuyela ekhaya lakhe, wacela ukudla, bafike bamnikela, wadla.
Baphendvula batsi: "Ngubani na lokwenta lokhu? Kungakapheli sikhatsi lesidze kutsi umntwana abephila, wena ufike wafunga uyewulingisa; kepha manje lapho umntwana eshonile, uyaphuma udla!"
UDavide watsi: "Lamuhla, lapho umfana ehlala khona, ngifile, ngalingisa; ngobe ngitsi: 'Ngubani na lowaziyo? Ngabe uSimakadze ungibekezelela, kutsi umfana aphile?'
"Nasekube sewufa, yini nangeke ngihambe ngekudla? Ingabe ngitawumubuyisela emuva? Ngitahamba kuye, kodvwa yena angeke ambuyisele emuva."
UDavide wehlisa Batsheba, indodana yakhe, wahlala naye, wazala unyana, watsi nguSolomoni. USimakadze wabathandela lomuntfu, watsi:
wathumela umlayezo ngesandla saNathani lomprofeti, watsi: "Thita lomnyaka munye kutsi uJedidiya," kusho ukuthi: "Lomthandekayo kuSimakadze," ngobe Simakadze abemthanda.
UYowabhi wahlasela iRabha, inhloko-dolobha yabana-Ammon, waba nendlunkulu yenkhosi.
UYowabhi watsi kuDavide: "Ngiye kulwa ne-Rabha, ngiyawukhipha namanzi ayo.
Hlala namuhla, uhlanganise lokunye lomkhosi, ubambe umjikelo walo mtfubi, uwuthathe; noma ngabe ngiwuthathe, khona-ke liyawubizwa ngegama lami rejime.
UDavide wahlangana nabo bonkhe bantfu, waya eRabha, wabahlasela, wayawuyibulala.

Wakhipha inhloko yenkhosi yabo, wayayibeka phezu kwehlavu lakhe; bekuyigolide elingenamamitha lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu lesisindo sayo, kwabe kukhona ematshe asezingeni eliphezulu kulo. UDavide wathatha kanye naleyo mihlambi emikhulu yasemgwaqweni.

Wabakhipha nabo, wababeka emabhutsini, nasemabhotsini ensimbi, nasemabhotsini ensimbi, wabeka nabo emgodini; ngaleyo ndlela akwenze kuwo wonke lamadolobha lamadvodza ase-Ammon. UDavide wabuyela eJerusalema, yena nebantfu bakhe bonke.
Kutsi kube sekwenzeke kutsi Amnoni, umsa kaDavide, wathandana neThamari, indvodzakati ye-Absalome, lomunye wemadvodzana aDavide.
U-Amnoni wehla ebuhlungu kakhulu ngenxa yakhe, watsi: "Ngidlwengulwe nguTamari," ngobe yena udadewabo; kodvwa yena wayengumkakhe, wacabanga kutsi kungeke kube lula ku-Amnoni ukuba ayenze yini.
U-Amnoni wayenenkosikazi, igama lakhe lakunguJonadabu, unyana kaShimeha, umngane waDavide; lo Jonadabu waba ngumntu ohlakaniphile kakhulu, kanye nemuntfu lomhle.

Wathi ku-Amnoni: "Wena umntwana wenkhosi, yini lekwenza ubona mehlo akho emnyama ngaso sonke sikhatsi? Ingabe awufuni kunditshela?" Amnoni watsi kuye: "Ngiyithanda Tamari, inkosikazi kaAbsalome, lomkhulu wami."

UJonadabu watsi kuye: "Lala embhedeni wakho, ufake sewufile; bese lapho utata wakho efika ekuboneni wena, utsi kuye: 'Nceda uvumele uyisekazi wami, uThamari, afike amnike ukudla, alungiselele lokudla phambi kwami, ukuze ngikubone, ngikudla ngesandla sakhe.'"

Amnoni wehla, wacabanga kutsi ufile; ngobe lapho ukumkani efika ekubona khona, Amnoni watsi kuye: "Nceda, fike inkosikazi yami, Tamari, ilungiselele emakhofi lamakhulu lasitfupha phambi kwami, ngidle ngesandla sakhe."
UDavide wathumela kuThamari endlwini yakhe, watsi: "Thiba ufike endlini ka-Amnoni lomkhuluwa wakho uyewulungiselele ukudla."
Thamari waphuma waya endlwini ka-Amnoni, lomkhuluwa wakhe, lapho abehlala khona; wathatha umnikelo wesono, wawumisa, wakwenza emabhisa emlonyeni wakhe, wabaphe.
Yathatha i-pan, yamisa kuye, kodvwa yena akazange adle. Watsi khona Amnoni: "Bonisele bonke baphume lapha." Baphuma bonkhe.
U-Amnoni watsi kuThamari: "Thinda lekudla embhedeni wami, kutsi ngidle ngesandla sakho." Thamari wathatha ticubu letincane azenzayo, wazisa kumkakhe u-Amnon embhedeni wakhe.
Wathi, "Namuhla ngikunikela kutsi udle," watsi kuye: "Thiba nami, nyana yami!"
Waye watsi kuye: "Kungeke kube njalo, nkosikazi wami! Mna-ke ungeke ungibusise; ngoba lokhu akufanele kwenzeke eSirayeli. Ungeke wenze lokudla lokubi.
Ngiyaphi ngiye ngelukhuni lwami? Nawe ungeke ube njengelinye lalabo lababi kakhulu eSirayeli; khuluma, ngiyakucela, ukumkani, ngobe angeke akuvimbele ekubeni nenkosi yami.
Lomfana akazange avumele kutsi akhulume naye, ngobe wayenamandla kunaye; watsi: "Lawo ma-Israyeli angeke abe nekuthula nami.
Apho-ke Amnoni wamcutha kakhulu, wamcutha kakhulu kunaleso sikhatsi lapho abemthanda khona; watsi kuye Amnoni: "Suka uhambe!"
Watsi kuye: "Akekho! Kube kube buhlungu kakhulu kutsi ungeke ungivumele ngihambe, kunalokho lokwenta kimi." Kodwa yena akazange alalele.
Wakhuluma kulowo mkhonzi wakhe, watsi: "Susa lowesifazane ebusweni bami, uvule umvalo ngemuva kwakhe."
Waye egqoke ingubo leyindilinga, nemilenze emide; ngobe lokunjalo begqoka bokhokho bakhe. Lomuntfu wakhe waphuma waya ngaphandle, wavala umvalo emuva kwakhe.
Thamari watsi: "Ngubani na lowo muntfu?" Thamari wabeka umfulati phezu kwehlavu lakhe, wajika inhloko yakhe, wabeka isandla sakhe phansi ekhanda lakhe, waphuma, waphuma ekhuluma ngamandla.

UAbsalome, lomkhulu wakhe, watsi kuye: "Ube u-Amnon, lomyeni wakho, nawe? Namuhla, nkosikazi yami, usala; yena nguyise wakho. Lawo mazwi angeke abe nebuhlungu emilenzeni yakho." Thamari yahlala endlwini ka-Absalome, umngane wayo, ihlupheka kakhulu.
Ubukhosi benkhosi Davide babuva ngaleso simo, bukhatshulwa kakhulu.
Absalomu akazange akhulume na-Amnoni, buhlungu noma buhle; ngobe Abshalomu abemkhonta Amnoni, ngobe abewuphazamisa uTamari, indodana yakhe.
Kwatsi sekuphelile iminyaka lemibili, kwabe sekuphele lokudlidliza ingulube ta-Absalomu eBaal-hazori, lapho lise-Efrayim; wabiza uAbsalomu bonkhe bantfu labafileyo benkhosi.
UAbsalome waya kunkhosi, watsi: "Nginebantfu labashiya tingulube zami; ngabe unkhosi nebaholi bayo bangafika nami?"
Unkhosi yatsi ku-Absalomu: "Kungeke kube njalo, unyana wami; asihambeni sonke, ngobe sitawukuba ngumthwalo kuwe." Nakuba u-Absalomu ekhuluma naye kakhulu, uMbuso akazange ahambe. Wabambise uAbsalomu.
UAbsalomu watsi kuye: "Lakho, uma ungeke ungenele, ngikucela uvumele umngane wami, Amnoni, afike nathi." Unkhosi yatsi kuye: "Ngubani na loya nawe?"
Absalomu watsi kuye: "Lakho, ngitsi kuwe: Lakho, lakho, ngobe uSawula akazange ahambe naAbsalomu.

U-Absalome wabaletsa labangani bakhe, watsi kubo: "Thintela u-Amnon; uma ethanda wayini, ngitsi kuwe: 'Lawulala u-Amnon', bese umbulala; ungakhathazeki, ngobe ngiyakuphendvula, nihlale ninemandla, ningabi nebubi."
Lamadvodza la-Absalome ayawukwenza ku-Amnoni kutsi abekhuluma kuye; kodvwa bonkhe bantfu labasebukhosini baphuma, babuyele emamulweni abo, babafa.
Bebengase behamba ngendlela, kwafika kuDavide umlayezo watsi: "Absalomu wabulala bonke labantwana bakankhosi, akazange ashiye namunye kubo."
Waphuma khona ukumkani, washiya ingubo yakhe, wehla phansi emhlabatsini; nabo bonke labakhonzi bakhe babekhona, bashiya ingubo yabo.

UJonadabu, unyana kaShimeha, umngane waDavide, watsi: "Ngikutshele, nkosi yami, kutsi babulala bonke labangane bokumkani; nguAmnoni kuphela lokufa. Lolu daba lwabe lukhona kuAbsalomo kusukela ngalobusuku lapho Amnoni abulawe khona Tamara, inkosikazi yakhe.
Lakho-ke, nkosi yami ukumkani, angeke ucinge kutsi bonke bantfu bakho bafile; ngobe Amnoni kuphela lofa.
U-Absalomu wabaleka, ngobe umshado wakhe abehlala ecaleni lakhe. Waphakamisa amehlo akhe, watsi: "Ngibona abantu abaningi bephuma emgwaqeni lomile ngemuva kwakhe.
Watsi uJonadabu kunkhosi: "Bona, lamadvodza asebukhosini afika; sekube sekunjalo njengobe umkhonzi wakho washo."
Bafika nabo bonkhe bantfu bendlu yakhe, bakhuluma ngaso sonke sikhatsi; kodvwa uSawula nalabakhonzi bakhe bonke babelile kakhulu.
Abebhesalomu wabaleka waya kuTalmai, unyana ka-Amihudi, ukumkani waseGeshuri; kodvwa Davide waba nebuhlungu bomnyaka wakhe wonke.
UAbsalomu wehla waya eGeshuri, wahlala khona iminyaka lemibili.
Ubukhosi benkhosi Davide buye bufike ku-Absalomu, ngobe bebulele ngekufa kwa-Amnoni.
UYowabhi, umsa waZeruya, wababona kutsi umphefumulo wenkhosi ungeke uhambe ngeAbsalomu.

UYowabhi wathumela eTeprhiya, watsi: "Thina-ke sifike eTekhoya, sithole khona indodana yemuntfu lohlakaniphile, sathi kuye: 'Nceda, uhambe ube ngumfati wesono, ugqoke ingubo yesono, ungeke usebenzise umlotha, kodwa uhlale ungumfazi lofile iminyaka leminingi.
Watsi yena: "Ngitakhuluma nawe, bese uphuma ufike kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, bese ukhuluma kuye ngale mazwi."
Lowesifazane waseTekoa wafika kunkhosi, wehla ngebuso bakhe emhlabatsini, watsi: "Nceda, inkhosi yami!"
Unkhosi yatsi kuye: "Ngubani na?" Wayiphendvula yatsi: "Ngibe nguwesifazane, umkakhe ufile.
Nginemadvodzakati lamibili, ngibe ngumkhonzi wakho; bahlaselana emhlabatsini, ngobe angeke kube khona lowo loyawubahlukanisa nabo, watsi: "Lomunye wabulala lomnye."

Batsi: "Namuhla, lomndeni wonke ubuyela kumkhonzi wakho. Bathi: 'Sinike umfowabo lowo wabulala lomfowabo; sitawumufalela ngekuphila komfowabo, bese sawususa nalowo oyawuhlala naye.' 20Befuna kutsi baphule ithemba lami lelingukuphela kwalo, beshiya mntwana wami ngaphandle kwegama lakhe kanye nendlu yakhe emhlabani."
Unkhosi yatsi kulowo mfazi: "Yiya ekhaya lakho, ngitakunika umyalo kutsi ugweme."
Lowesifazane waseTekoa watsi kunkhosi: "Mkhosi, nkosi yami, inhlonipho ibe nami kanye nendlu yababami; kodvwa ukumkani kanye nesikhulu sakhe bangabi necala."
Watsi ukumkani: "Lomuntfu lokhuluma nawe, uyawufikela lapha kimi, ngobe ngeke aphinde akubise lutho."

Wathi yena: "Nceda, umkwetsi afike abembisane naSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho, ukuze lomuntfu lofuna ukubulala angeke aphinde abulala umntwana wami." Watsi ukumkani: "Ngiphila Simakadze, ngisho nemilenze yenhloko yomntwana wakho ngeke iphele phansi."
Watsi lowesifazane: "Nceda, ngivumele umkhonzi wakho akhulume linye linyenti kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wami, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli."
Wathi lowesifazane, "Ngubani na lowo ofuna ukwenza lokhu ebantwini bakaNkulunkulu? Ukhuluma njalo, utsi: 'Ngikubulale.' Ngako-ke, ungenawo umfana wakho lowawuwukhipha ekhaya.

Sifanele sife, ngobe sifana namanzi atfolwa emhlabatsini, angeke ahlukaniswe. Ngako-ke uNkulunkulu akawususanga umphefumulo wakhe kuphela, kepha wabeka nendlela kutsi lowo lotfunyelwe angeke ahlale ehlukaniswe naye.
Ngifike ngikhulume naSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, ngobe labantfu batfumisa; kodvwa ngatsi: 'Ngitakhuluma kunkhosi, kungase kwenzeke kutsi igcine lomthetho wami.'
Ngiyakholwa kutsi ubukhosi buyawulalela, buyawusindisa ebusweni bemuntfu lofuna kutsi asuse mina nemwana wami kulemhlaba Nkulunkulu abesiwutfumele.

Nami ngatsi: Lilo laSimakadze Nkulunkulu wami, lonkhosi yami ukumkani, lingeke libe lihle; ngobe Simakadze Nkulunkulu wami ufana nendvodzakati yaNkulunkulu, ikhuluma lokubi nakuhle; Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, abe nawe.
Unkhosi yatsi kudzimate: "Ungangifihla lutho kutsi ngikubuze ngalo." Umkhwenyana watsi: "Nase ukhulume, umsa wami umkwenu!"

Unkhosi yatsi: "UYowabhi akazange akuvumele ukwenze lokhu konke?" Lowesifazane waphendula watsi: "Ngiphila wena, nkosi yami umkwehluleli, ngeke kube khona lowo angahamba ngasekunene noma ngasekhohlo kunoma yini lokhuluma ngayo; ngobe umkhonzi wakho uYowabhi nguye lowawumi kutsi ngiyenze le nto, wababeka amazwi lawo onke emlonyeni wami.
Umkhonzi wakho, uYowabe, wakwenza lokhu kutsi ashintshe icala; kodvwa umkhonzi wami unekhono lelikhulu kakhulu kunaye Nkulunkulu; wena uwazi zonke izinto letiba khona emhlabeni.
Unkhosi yatsi kuYowabha: "Kulungile, ngiyakwenza; hlala uhambe, uyeke lomuntfu lomncane abe nguAbsalome."
UYowabhi wehla ngebuso bakhe emhlaba, wehlisa imilenze yakhe, wabambisana nonkhosi, watsi: "Namuhla ngiyazi kutsi unguNkulunkulu lowuthandana nami, nkosi yami, ngobe wakwenza lokudla kwami.
UYowabha waphuma, waya eGeshuru, wabuyisela Abesalomu eJerusalema.
Watsi ukumkani: "Ase ahambe endlwini yakhe, ngobe angangibona." Ngako-ke Abesalomu waphuma waya ekhaya lakhe, watsi: "Ngingeke ngibone unkhosi."
Ngaso sonke iSirayeli kwakunguAbsalome, lowo muntfu lobukekayo, loyawuhlolwa; kusuka emphinjeni yakhe kuya emlonyeni wakhe, kwakungeke kube nento lebi kuye.

Waye wamisa izinwele zakhe ngonyaka wekucala, lapho kuphelelwa khona lomnyaka; ngobe kwaba nzima kakhulu kuye. Nalapho akwenta kutsi alinganise izinwele zakhe, wathola kutishekeli tamakhulu mahlanu, ngesiliva lelikhulu nemashumi lamane, ngegolide lelikhulu.
U-Absalomu wayenemadvodzana lamabili nendvodzakati eyodwa; igama lendodana yakhe bekunguThamari, waba nguwesifazane lobuhle.
UAbsalomu wahlala eJerusalema iminyaka lemibili, ngobe akazange abone ukumkani.
U-Absalomu wathumela waya kuYowabhi, kutsi afike kuye ukumkani; kodvwa uYowabhi akazange afike kuye. U-Absalomu wehlisa umlayezo wakhe wesibili, watsi: "Asekho lofika."
U-Absalomu watsi kulabo labasebenza naye: "Bonani, insimu kaYowabhi ingaphansi kwengubo yami, nalapho ekhula khona umnqumo; phuma niyifake emlilweni." Labasebenzi baka-Absalomu basibeka emlilweni.
UYowabha waya endlwini ka-Absalomu, watsi kuye: "Ngubani na lokwenta kutsi labakhonzi bakho bafake mlilo etindlini tami?"

Abesalomu watsi kuYowabha: "Ngikuthumela ngikutshele ukuthi ufike lapha, kutsi ngikuvumele ufike kunkhosi, ngithi kuye: 'Ngubani na loyawubuyela eGeshuru? Kulungile kimi ukuba ngihlale khona. Manje vumelani ukuthi ngibone ukumkani; uma kukhona yini lokubi engikwenzayo, angeke ambulala.'
UYowabha waya kunkhosi, wakhuluma kuye. Hezekiya watsi kuAbsalomu: "Thina-ke sifike, satsi: 'USimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, utsi: Lakho livi lami, naloko livi lami.'"
Naleso sikhathi Abesalomu wakha imoto yekulwa, nemahhashi, namadoda lamashumi mahlanu ahamba phambili kwakhe.

Waphuma emini, wahlala eduze kwendlela yemnyango wedolobha. Nalowo nalowo lofika kunkhosi abe nenkinga, Abesalomu waya kuye, watsi: "Usukaphi lenhloko-dolobha?" Akazange aphendule, "Ngisesinye semindeni yaseSirayeli."
UAbsalome watsi kuye: "Bonani, icala lakho lilungile futhi lifanele, kepha unkhosi angeke ibe nemuntfu lokusilalela."
UAbsalome wakhuluma watsi: "Ngabe ngingeke ngibe ngummeli kulelizwe, kutsi wonke umuntu lonecala nenkinga afike kimi, ngobe ngitawumulungisa."
Nalapho kube khona umuntu lofika emphilweni yakhe, abengena ngesandla sakhe, wamphuca, watsi: "Ngubani na lowo?"
U-Absalome wakwenza njalo kubo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli labafika kuSimakadze kutsi bagweme, ngobe u-Absalome waba nenhliziyo yesive seSirayeli.
Kuphela iminyaka lemine nemashumi mahlanu, uAbsalomu watsi kunkhosi: "Ngiye eHebroni, ngigcine nandza yami loyawuyinikela kuSimakadze.
Ngibe sengihlala eGeshuru, eAram, ngibulale nalowo mkhonzi wakho, ngitsi: Uma Simakadze angamibuyisela eJerusalema, khona-ke ngiyawunikela kuSimakadze.
Unkhosi yatsi kuye: "Hamba ukhululeke." Waphuma, wafika eHebroni.
U-Absalomu wathumela lamaphoyisa kuwo onkhe emadolobha aseSirayeli, watsi: "Lokoku kutsi nitsi: 'U-Absalomu ube ngunkhosi eHebroni!'"
Na-Absalomu kwaphuma amadoda lamakhulu mahlanu eJerusalema, abevalelwe kutsi ahambe nabo; babehamba ngebulungisa babo, bangawazi lutho.

U-Absalome wathumela afike eGilo, waya ku-Ahitofeli waseGilo, umcebisi waDavide, waya emzini wakhe eGilo, lapho abenikela khona inhlanhla. Nale ngqungquthela yahlala ikhula, abantu baphinde bakhula besuka ku-Absalome.
Kwafika umshayeli kuDavide, watsi: "Umphefumulo wema-Israyeli udlulile ku-Absalomu."

UDavide watsi kubo bonkhe labakhonzi bakhe lababe naye eJerusalema: "Thindani, sihambe, ngobe angeke kubekho lomunye wethu lophuma ku-Absalome; fikeni ngokushesha, ngobe angase atifikeli, aze atiholele umonakalo, abulala lamadodana ledolobha ngesandla sekhebhu."
Baphendvula batsi: "Lokudla lokushiwo nguSimakadze longuSomandla, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, utsi: 'Lakho lilanga lakho liyawufika.'
Waphuma unkhosi, nayo yonke indlu yakhe yalandela; kodvwa wabashiya lamakhosikazi akhe lalishumi abehlala endlwini yakhe.
Unkhosi yaphuma, nayo yonke imikhosi yakhe ilandelana naye; bahlala endlu yekucala.

Nabo bonke abaphathi bakhe badlula phambi kwakhe, kanye nabo bonkhe labema-Kerethi nalaba-Pelethi, labahlala emnyango wenkhosi; nalabo bantfu baseGiti lamakhulu lamabili nesikhombisa, labebafike ngemuva kwakhe kusuka eGathi, badlula phambi kwenkhosi.
Unkhosi yatsi ku-Itai waseGiti: "Ngubani na loyawufika nathi? Yibuye, uhlale nami; ngobe wena ungumkhwenyana, waphuma ezweni lakho; buyela endaweni yakho.

Ufike kusasa nje; ngikuvumele yini kutsi uhambe nathi namuhla, ngobe angizange ngibone lapho ngiya khona? Yibuye, uthathe nabazalwane bakho nawe; Simakadze akwenzele wena inhlonipho yakhe neqiniso lakhe.

Itai waphendula ukumkani, watsi: "Ngiphila Simakadze, futhi nguNkulunkulu lophilayo lomphathi wami umkwetsimi, lapho umphathi wami umkwetsimi ekhona khona, noma ngabe kubulawa yini, noma ngabe kuphila yini, khona-ke nalowo mkhonzi wakho uya kuba khona."
UDavide watsi ku-Itai: "Thinda uhambe." Wahamba khona uItai, loGathi, naye wonke lamadoda akhe, nalabo bantwana labakhona naye.
Labantfu bonke belizwe batsatsa umsindo wabo, ngobe bonkhe bantfu babehamba; kodvwa ukumkani wadlula emfuleni weKidrone, ngobe bonkhe bantfu babehamba ngendlela lesuka eGibhithe.

Wakhona naTsadoki, nabo bonkhe labaLevi bakhe, babebeka khona ibhokisi lesivumelwano saNkulunkulu; bamisa ibhokisi laNkulunkulu, ne-Abhiyathari enikela ngenhlanhla, kuze kube bonke abantu bephele ngekuphuma emzini.
Unkhosi yatsi kuTsadoko: "Thiba ibhokisi laNkulunkulu libuye enhlokodolobha; uma uSimakadze engithandela, uyawungisa ngiyibone lebhokisi kanye nendawo yayo.
kodvwa uma esho kutsi: 'Angeke ngikuthande', khona-ke hlala lapha; akwenze kimi lokuhle kumehlo akhe.
Watsi unkhosi kuTsadoki, umLevi: "Asewubona yini lokubonako, wena lowo ubona lokudlalwa nguNkulunkulu? Yibuye edolobhani ngekuthula, wena no-Ahimahazi unyana wakho, na-Yonathani unyana ka-Abiyata.
Ngitahlala emahhashini emigwaqeni lemitfubi kuze kube ngithola umlayezo kusuka kuwe lokhuluma kimi kutsi kwenzekani."
Ngako-ke Sadoki naAbhiyathari babuyisela ibhokisi laNkulunkulu eJerusalema, bahlala khona.
UDavide waphuma waya emfuleni wema-Olivi, waphuma ekhala, agqoke inhlavu yakhe, wahamba ngenyawo zakhe; nabo bonke lababili laba naye bagqoke inhlavu yabo, baphuma belilingisa.
Bakhuluma kuDavide, batsi: "Ahitofeli na-Absalome baphikisana nabo." UDavide wathandaza watsi: "Simakadze, vumelani kutsi umyalo we-Ahitofeli ube yitfu.
UDavide wafika esiphelweni semhlabatsini, lapho bethandaza khona kuNkulunkulu; kodvwa ngaleso sikhathi uHushayi umArkiya waya kumhlangabeza, enesigqoko sakhe sicwebezelayo, nemanti enhlavu yakhe.
UDavide watsi kuye: "Uma usuya nami, ungeke ube ngumthwalo wami.

kepha uma ubuyela enhlokodolobha, utsi kuAbsalome: 'Ngingeke ngibe ngumkhonzi wakho, nkosi yami; ngibe ngumkhonzi wababa wakho, kodwa manje ngizoba ngumkhonzi wakho', khona-ke ungeke unciphise intela yaAhitofele.
Labo bakaSadoko naAbhiyathari, bantfu labangcwele, bakhona nawe khona; utawukhuluma kubo konkhe loko lokubonako endlwini yaSimakadze.
Bakhona khona nabo bantfu babo lababini, uAhimahazi, umsa kaTsadoki, naYonathani, umsa wa-Abiyata; thumelani kubo noma yini niyiva.
U-Hushai, umngane waDavide, waya enhlokodolobha, lapho abefika khona Abesalome eYerusalem.

UDavide wadlula emaphaketheni ambalwa enhloko yenduli, kwafika uSiba, umkhonzi waMephiboshethi, wamhlangana naye, abe nesihluku lesimbili segubhuzane, lesidlwengulako, linesidlo sakudla sama-kerubi lamakhulu mahlanu, namajikijolo lamakhulu lalishumi, nalesithelo sehlobo lamakhulu lamakhulu, kanye nebhodlela lewayini.

Unkhosi yatsi kuSiba: "Kuyini lokhu?" Siba waphendula watsi: "Lamabhubesi angeke abe ngumnikelo wekushiswa, kepha umsebenti wekudla kanye nemikhiqizo yebusika kumele bawudle; lewayini kufanele lidlalwe yilowo nalowo locebile emfuleni.
UMengameli watsi: "Uphi unyana wenkosi yakho?" Siba watsi kuMengameli: "Asehlala eJerusalema, ngobe uthe, 'Namuhla bantfu beSirayeli bangamibuyisela bukhosi boyise wami.' "
Unkhosi yatsi kuSiba: "Lakho konke lokubekiwe nguMephiboshethi, nguNkulunkulu wakho." USiba watsi: "Ngikuhlangula; ngifune ukuthula nawe, nkosi yami umkwehluleli.
UDavide wafika eBahurim, ngobe uSawula abehamba naye; watsi: "Ngitaphuma ngifike eBahurim." Waye waya eBahurim, lapho kwaphuma khona lomuntfu wendlu yaSawula, igama lakhe bekunguShimehi, umsa kaGera.
Wathi: "UDavide, nalabakhonzi bakhe bonke, batawutsi baphuma emphini yakhe; ngobe labantfu bonkhe kanye nebaholi bemandla babe ngakwesokudla kwakhe nakwesobunxele kwakhe.
Wayekhuluma, watsi: "Khangela, khangela, wena lombulalayo, wena longeke uphile!

Simakadze utawukubuyiselela phansi lilanga legazi lendlu ka-Sawuleli, lapho wahlala khona; ngobe Nkulunkulu wabanika ukumkani uAbsalome, umntwana wakho. Namuhla, bona, wena uphelelwe ngububi bakho, ngoba ungumfishane.
UAbishai, umsa wa-Zeruya, watsi kunkhosi: "Ngubani na lomuntfu lomfishane, kutsi aphambuse nkosi yami, umkwetsi? Lawula, ngiye khona ngiwucoce inhloko yakhe."

Unkhosi yatsi: "Nine yini naloko, bantfu ba-Saruhiya? Uma yena efuna kutsi anibulale, ngobe Simakadze abemphendvula watsi: 'Lala uDavide.' Ngubani na longeke ambuze kutsi: 'Ngubani na lowenza lokhu?'"

UDavide watsi ku-Abhishai, nakubo bonke labakhonzi bakhe: "U představe kutsi lobundlovukazi lufuna kundibulala; ngobe uBenjamini ungumntwana wami, umphefumulo wami kanye nenyama yami. Lawulahlani, lalamangele, ngoba uSimakadze wakhuluma kuye.
Ngabe uSimakadze uyakubona lokubi lokwenzelwa mina, bese unginikela ngekudla kanye nekudla lokubi ngaleso silamato sengikhuluma ngalo lilanga leli.
UDavide namadodana akhe bahamba ngendlela; Simeyi ke wahamba ngaphesheya komfula, ebhekene naye, wehlalela, wehlalela emacwecwe, wehlalela uthuli entangeni.
Befika khona ukumkani kanye nabo bonkhe bantfu bakhe, becebile kakhulu, baphumula khona.
Absalomu kanye nabo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli bafika eJerusalema, naAhitofele naye.
UHushayi, umngane waDavide, waseArki, waya ku-Absalomu, watsi kuye: "Kube kuphila ukumkani! Kube kuphila ukumkani!"
UAbsalome watsi kuHushai: "Kungenjalo yini kutsi ukhombisa kuthula kumfana wakho? Ngubani longeke ahambe nawe?"
UHushai watsi ku-Absalomu: "Kungeke kube njalo, kepha lowo lokhethiwe nguSimakadze, nalaba bantu, nalabo bonke lamadoda eSirayeli, naye ngiyawuhlala naye.
Ngabe ngiyawukhonza yini? Ngabe ngingasebenzisi lomnyaka munye? Njengalapho ngasebenzela khona ubaba wakho, ngiyakusebenzela nawe."
UAbsalome watsi ku-Ahitofeli: "Nceda utfume kutsi kufanele siyenze yini."

UAhitofeli watsi ku-Absalomu: "Lala nabangane bakababa wakho, labashiwo kutsi bagcine indlu; khona-ke bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli baya kuzwa ukuthi uyawuphazanyiswa ngubaba wakho. Nabo bonke labo abakhokelayo bakho bazobe benamandla."
Bamisa khona itenti ku-Absalomu emnyango wendlu yasebukhosini. U-Absalomu wahlala nalabakhonzi bakayise, phambi kwalabo bonke labaseSirayeli;
Ngaleso sikhathi, incazelo ye-Ahitofeli yathathwa njengelizwi laNkulunkulu; kanjalo kwabonakala kuDavide naAbsalome ngaso sonke isiphakamiso sa-Ahitofeli.
Ahitofele watsi kuAbsalomu: "Laba, ngizokhetha lamakhulu lamabili nelishumi elinesihlanu lamadoda, ngifike ngalebusuku ngitsalele Davide.
Ngitafika ngaye lapho ecebile khona, ngitawumuhlasela, ngiwuphazamise, ngobe bonke bantfu bakhe bayawubaleka; kodvwa ngitawubulala ukumkani kuphela.
ngobe ngitawubuyela kubo bonkhe bantfu kuwe, bese kubulawa lowo muntfu lowalandela wena; khona-ke bonke bayawubuyela kuwe, nabo bonkhe bantfu babe nekuthula.
Lombono wawuhle ku-Absalome, kanye naletinye tikhulu teSirayeli.
UAbsalome watsi: "Thipha naHushai, umArkiya, sikhulume naye kutsi yini leyawukhuluma."
UHushayi wafika, Absalomu watsi kuye: "Ahitophelele utfume kutsi kufanele sikwenze yini; noma ngabe akazange atfume, khona-ke usinike imibono yakho."
UHushai watsi ku-Absalomu: "Lendzaba leAhitofeli abeyinikela ngalo nyaka ayilungile."

UHushayi watsi kuye: "Uyazi ubaba wakho kanye nebantfu bakhe, kutsi bangabaphikisi bokulwa; nabo bafana nalowo mdlovukazi atshiswayo ngezingane zakhe. Nakuba ubaba wakho ungumkhosi, angeke ahlale embhedeni nalolu hlanga lwabantu.

Ase ufike ubone, ngobe angeke abe khona lapho; kodvwa ngaleso sikhathi angase afike emphini, noma ekungeneni kwemphini, bese kubulawa bantfu bakho ekuqalekeni komkhosi. Natsi nalowo lokubonako, utawuthi: 'Kunekufa kwabaholi be-Absalomu!'

Ngako-ke nalowo muntfu lonamandla, lowo umphefumulo wakhe ufana neleyo lenyoni, angeke abe nenhlanhla; ngobe bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli bayazi kutsi ubaba wakho ngumfati lomkhulu, nabo bonke labanye labakhona naye bangamavi.
Lakho ngikucebisa, hlangana nawe bonkhe labaSirayeli, kusuka eDani kuya eBheer-sheba, bangaba nenani njengenhlabathi leselwandle; wena uyawuhamba nabo emphini.
Siyawuhlasela uDavide lapho atholakala khona, siyawufika kuye njengobe umfula uphuma emhlabatsini; ngeke kushiyeke namunye kubo, nome nguDavide, noma yimuphi lamadoda akhe.
Uma efika emgwaqeni, bonkhe bantfu beSirayeli batawubeka tintambo kulo mgwaqweni, siyawuwususa ufike efulethini, kuze kungeke kube khona linye licwecwe.

Wathi Abesalomu kanye nabo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli: "Imtsetfo waHushai, umArki, ungcono kunemtsetfo wa-Ahitofele." Kube kwakusuka kuSimakadze kutsi aphedze mthetho omuhle wa-Ahitofele, ngobe Simakadze abefuna kutsi abe nenkinga ngeAbsalomu.
UHushayi waphendvula watsi: "Ahitofeli wakhuluma ku-Absalomo kanye nabaholi beSirayeli kutsi bakwenze lokhu; kepha ngiyawubatshela ukuthi bakwenze lokho.
Ngako-ke, thumelani kuDavide, nitsi kuye: Ungahlalanga ngalolubusuku emabhishi lasentshonalanga yetfu; vuka ufike elwandle, ungabi necala lobukhosi kanye nabo bonkhe bantfu labahamba naye.
Jonathani naAhimaze bahlala e-En-rogeli, lapho kwafika khona umkhwenyana, wabatshela khona; nabo bafike bakhuluma kubo Simakadze Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, kutsi bangabi nenkinga yekungena emizini.
Wababona umshayeli, wabatshela Abesalomu. Bahamba nabo bobabili bafike eBahurim endlwini yamuntu lothile, lowo wangena emgwaqeni wakhe, wabeka phandle ifulegi lakhe, baphuma khona.
Umfazi walo muntfu wehla embhedeni wakhe, wafaka umlenze, wawumisa phezu kwendlebe yebhodlela, wabeka tingulube ngaso; ngobe angeke kube khona lowaziyo ukuthi bakhona.
Bafika ema-Abhisalomu endlu yakhe, babuza lowesifazane bati: "Uphi uAhimahazi naYonathani?" Lowesifazane watsi: "Bafike bedlula emfuleni." Baye bafuna, kodvwa bangawatholanga, babuyela eYerusalem.

Baphuma baphuma efuleni, batsi: "Akhimahazi naYonathani baphuma efuleni, bafike bekhuluma kunkhosi Davide, batsi kuye: 'Thina-ke sihambe sikhawulele umfula; ngobe Ahitophelele utsatsela liciniso kuwe.'
Baphuma khona Davide nebantfu bakhe bonke, badlula eJordane; bafika lapho lilanga liphuma khona, bafike badlula eJordane.

UAhitofeli, lapho ebona khona kutsi umyalo wakhe awungconywa, wamisa inkunzi yakhe, wabuyela ekhaya lakhe, waya emzini wakhe, walungisa impahla yakhe, wehlisa isandla sakhe, wafa, wabanjwa esibhedlela sababa bakhe.
UDavide wafika eMahanayini, kodvwa uAbsalomu wadlula eJordane, yena nebantfu bonke baseSirayeli.

UAbsalome wabeka uAmasa njengesikhulu semkhosi endaweni ka-Yowabe; Amasa waba nguyise wemuntfu lokuthiwa yi-Ithra, umSirayeli, lowo akazange akwati Abigaili, intombi kaNahashi, umsa waSeruya, umkhuluwa ka-Yowabe.
ISirayeli ne-Absalome bamisa tindlu tabo ezweni leGileyadi.
Wafika uDavide eMahanayini, naye Shobi, umsa waNahasi, wase-Rabha yebantfu be-Ammon, naMakiri, umsa waAmieli, waseLodebari, naBarzilayi, waseRogelimi weGileyadi.
banikela ngemibhede, nemabhodlela, nemiti yemhlabatsi; banikela nasengcotsheni, nesobho, nemhluzi, nekudla lokucwebezelayo, nemifino, nama-lentils, nembewu ecwebezelayo;

laba clipps, nenyama yengulube, nenkukhu, nemmbila, kanye nalesinyosi lesiphuma ekudlaleni kwaDavide nasebantwini bakhe. Batsi: "Laba bantu bangeke babe nendlala, nabo bayaphazamisana, nabo bazamuka emgwaqeni."
UDavide wabala labantfu labakhona naye, wabeka bomkhuluwa bamakhulu kanye nebomkhuluwa bemashumi lamabili.

Wathumela lamakhosi emindenini lemithathu, wabeka uYowabhi ngaphesheya kwelinye, na-Abishai, umsa kaZeruhiya, umngane wakhe, ngaphesheya kwelinye, na-Itai waseGiti ngaphesheya kwelinye. Unkhosi yatsi kubo: "Ngiyaphuma ngihamba nani."

Batsi kubo: "Ungeke uphume, ngobe uma siphuma, bangasicaci. Nakuba sinye sesivuno sakho singafa, bangasicaci; kepha wena ungaba ngumakhulu lamashumi lamabili ebantfu bami. Kulungile kuwe ukuba uhlale kulo mji, ube liciniso lokutfumisana nathi."
Unkhosi yatsi kubo: "Lokudla lokulungile enhliziyweni yenu, ngiyawukwenza." Unkhosi yahlala eduze kwesango ledolobha; ngobe livi lonke laphuma lihamba ngamakhulu namakhulu lamakhulu.

Unkhosi yaletsa uYowabhi, na-Abishai, na-Itai, yatsi: "Nceda nigcine umfundi wakhe, uAbsalome, ngesandla sami." Lawo mabutfo layawuva kutsi ubukhosi bukhuluma kubo bonkhe bantfu labakhulu mayelana naAbsalome.
Lamadoda laDavide aphuma emhlabatsini, ahlasela iSirayeli; nemphi yadlalwa emfuleni wa-Efraim.
Batfunywa khona bantfu beSirayeli phambi kwabangani bakaDavide, babulawa lilanga lelinyenti kakhulu, lamakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamane.
Lemphi yasakazeka emhlabatsini lonke, nesihlahla sabulala abantu abaningi ngaleso sikhathi kunalo licwecwe.

UAbsalomu wahlangana nalabo bantu bakaDavide; uAbsalomu wayehamba ngengulube yakhe, nelungule lakhe lafika ngezansi kwemikhono lemile yesihlahla se-oak esikhulu. Lenhloko yaAbsalomu ifike ihlangane nemthendeni, waya emhlabatsini, bese lelilungule lihamba.
Wakubona lomuntfu, watsi kuYowabha: "Namuhla ngibona Absalomu eshonile ensimini ye-oak."
UYowabhi watsi kulowo mntu labewukhuluma kuye: "Wena uyawukubona; kungani ungamshaya khona phansi? Ngingeke ngikunike ishekeli letilishumi tesiliva nelinye legolide kanye nemlenze."
Zitat aus dem deutschen Sprachführer bei Goethe,. Aus der Schweiz?: Aus Polen kommend,. (Deutsche Übersetzung) aus dem Deutschen Sprachraum): Aus der Schweiz kommend,.
Uma ngibe sengiphazamisa ukumkani, ngawubulala unyana wakhe, ngobe kutsi akukho lokufihliwe kunkhosi, khona-ke ukumkani wangesazi, ningeke ningivikele.
UYowabhi watsi: "Ngingeke ngihlale ngihamba nawe." Wafaka emacwecwe lamakhulu amathathu esandla sakhe, wabeka emilenzeni ka-Absalome, lapho ahlala khona emgodini.
Bafike bahlanganisana na-Absalomu, babulala lamadodana lalishumi abebephethe isandla seYowabe.
UYowabhi watsi: "Ngubani na lowo muntfu?" UYowabhi watfumisa imphimbo, lamadoda akhe abuyela emuva, aphindze ahambe alandzela Israele.
Bathatha u-Absalomu, bawubeka emfuleni lomkhulu embuzweni, bawufaka phezu kwawo izingcezu letikhulu; kodvwa bonke bantfu baseSirayeli babaleka bebuyela emakhaya abo.

U-Absalomu, lapho ehlala khona, wamisa inhloko yesiliva, leyikhona emfuleni wasebukhosini; ngobe watsi: "Anginanyana loyawugcina igama lami liphila." Wabeka inombolo yenhloko yakhe ngegama lakhe, wayisabiza ngokuthi "Inhloko ya-Absalomu" kuze kube manje.
UAhimahazi, umsa waTsadoko, watsi: "Lapha ngizohamba ngifike ngibulele ukumkani kutsi Simakadze utawumukhulula emlonyeni wema-Israyeli."
UYowabhi watsi kuye: "Ngoku ungeke ube ngumbhali wezindaba namuhla, kepha ngelilanga lelinye, ngobe umntwana waSimakadze ufile."
UYowabhi watsi kulowo wase-Ethiyopi: "Thiba ufike utshele ukumkani lokho lokubonako." Lomuntfu wase-Ethiyopi wehlisa isandla sakhe kuYowabhi, wabaleka.

UAhimahazi, umsa waTsadoki, watsi kuYowabha: "Kutsi kube yini, ngiyakucela uvumele ngihambe ngaleso sicushi." Wati-Jowabha: "Ngubani na wena loya khona, umntwana wami? Angeke ube nemnikelo wekushiswa ngalolu lwazi."
Waphendvula watsi: "Kutsi yini, ngizohamba." UYowabhi watsi: "Hamba!" Akhehamase wabaleka ngendlela yase-Arabha, wadlula lomuntu wase-Ethiyopi.

UDavide wahlala phakathi kwesango lengaphakathi nesango lengaphandle. Umlingiswa wafika efulethini lelingene ngesango, waya emgwaqeni, wehlisa imehlo akhe, watsi: "Ngibona mntu lohamba lomunye wedwa."
Umphathi wakhuluma, watsi kunkhosi: "Ngabe uhlala nguNkulunkulu kuphela, khona-ke uyawufika ngezindaba." Lomkhwenyana wafika, wafika, wafika.
Wabona namunye umuntu ehamba, watsi kulowo logcina isango: "Bonani, kukhona omunye umuntu ehamba nguNkulunkulu kuphela." Unkhosi yatsi: "Naye naye uyawufika nezindaba."
Watsi umphathi: "Ngibona lowo wesifazane wekucala ehamba njenge-Ahimahazi, unyana waTsadoko." Unkhosi yatsi: "Umuntfu lolungile; ufika nezindaba ezinhle."

UAhimahazi watsi kunkhosi: "Kunekuthula!" Wayihlangula buso bakhe emhlabatsini phambi kwenkhosi, watsi: "Buyiselani uSimakadze Nkulunkulu wenu, lowo wanikela phansi labo bantu lababulale umphathi wami, ukumkani."
Unkhosi yatsi: "Uphila yini lomuntfu lomncane, uAbsalome?"Ahimahazi watsi: "Ngibona kuthula lokukhulu lapho umkhonzi wakho, uYowabha, amemetela khona; kepha angizange ngibone ukuthi kwakuni."
Unkhosi yatsi: "Thintela bese uhlala lapha." Waphuma, wahlala khona.
Wafika nalowo muntfu wase-Ethiop, watsi: "Kunezindaba ezinhle kumphathi wami umkwetsi; Simakadze utawukukhulula ngalolusuku kusuka emandlani lalabo bonke labaphikisayo wena."

UMbuso watsi ku-Ethiyopi: "Ube sewuphila yini lomunye umfana, uAbsalome?" Lomuntfu wase-Ethiyopi waphendula watsi: "Nabo bonke bobubi benkosi yami, ukumkani, kanye nabo bonkhe labo labaphuma bakhombise ububi kuwe, bangaba njengelowo mfundi!"

Unkhosi yatsi: "Kunebuhlungu kakhulu!" Waya egumbini lelikhulu, waya emnyango wasekhaya, watsi: "Mntwana wami u-Absalome! Mntwana wami u-Absalome! Mntwana wami u-Absalome! Ngibe sengifile nguNkulunkulu endaweni yakho! Absalome, mntwana wami, mntwana wami!"
Bakhuluma kuYowabi batsi: "Lamuhla ubukhosi bukhala, bugula ngeAbsalome."
Ngako-ke, lilanga lelinyenti labahlaseli babuyela ekubuyiseleni, ngobe labahlaseli babeva kutsi batsi: "Ubukhosi buhlupheka ngenxa yomntwana wakhe."
Kulelo lilanga bafika enhloko-dolobha, bengena ngekuthula, njengabahlaseli labakhathazwa ngaloko, ngobe baphuma emkhosini.
Unkhosi yaletsa ibuso bayo, yatsi: "Mntwana wami Absalomu! Absalomu, Mntwana wami, Mntwana wami!"

Wafika uYowabhi endlwini, waphuma waya kunkhosi, watsi: "Usewuphazamisa namuhla wonke lamadodana akho, agcinele namuhla impilo yakho, nempilo yabantwana bakho nabangane bakho, nekuphila kwabesifazane bakho, nekuphila kwalabakhonzi bakho.

Uyawuthanda labo labakukhohlisa, uyawukhathala labo abakuthandela. Namuhla sewubonakalisile kutsi abaholi bakho nalabo batfumi bakho bangaba lutho kuwe; ngobe ngikwabona ukuthi, uma abephila Absalomu ngoLwesihlanu, nami-ke sengifile namhlanje, ungeke ube nenkinga.

Hlala manje, phuma uphume, uncede abantu bakho; ngobe ngitsi nguSimakadze, kutsi uma ungaphumanga, angeke kube khona umuntu lohlala nawe ngelilanga lelinye. Lento ingeke ibe nzima kuwe kunazo zonke izinkinga letibe nezo kusukela ekukhuleni kwakho kuya kumanje.

Unkhosi yaphuma, yahlala emnyango wedolobha. Bakhuluma kubo bonkhe bantfu besithi: "Ubukhosi buhlala emnyango." Bafike kuye bonke bantfu, kodvwa bonke lamadoda aseSirayeli akazange ahambe kuwo wonke lamadolobha abo.
Bakhona labantfu bekhuluma nabo, batsi: "UMbuso waseSirayeli wawusisindisile kusuka kuma-Amoni, wasisivikela emaFilisti; kepha manje uphuma kulelizwe ngenxa kaAbsalome.
Na-Absalome, losihlanganisile kutsi abe ngunkhosi yethu, wafa emkhosini; ngobe yini naloko kungeke kube khona umuntu lokhuluma ngekubuyisa ukumkani?

Unkhosi Davide yathumela kuTsadoko naAbhiyathari, bantfu labangcwele bakhe, isithi: "Nitsi kubo bonkhe labaholi bakaJuda: 'Ngubani lokugcina ekubuyiseleni ukumkani ekhaya lakhe? Lami ngiva kutsi bonke laSirayeli bekhuluma ngekubuyisela umkwehluleli endlini yakhe.
Niyimndeni wami, nilenyama yami; yini-ke kutsi nibe batsatfu ekubuyeni kwenkhosi?'
Watsi ke ku-Amasa: UNkulunkulu angakwenza lokudla kwami kanye nesikhumba sami, akwenze njalo-ke nami, aze aninike nakunye, uma sengikwenta wena umholi webantfu bami endaweni kaYowabe.
UDavide wehlisa umphefumulo wabo bonkhe bantfu base-Yuda, bahlangana babe linye ibandla; bathumela kunkhosi bati: "Buka ubuye nawe nabo bonke labakhonzi bakho."
Unkhosi yabuyela, yafika eJordane; bonkhe bantfu beJuda bafike eGilgali kutsi bayihlangane nenkhosi, kutsi bayigcine idlula eJordane.
UShemeyi, umsa waGera, waseBhenjamini, lohlala eBahurim, wahamba ngesandla namadodana aYuda, waya emkhosini wakwaDavide.

Wabe naye lamakhulu lamadoda aBenjamini, naSiba, umkhonzi wendlu ka-Sauli, naye wahlala khona, naye nalabo bakhe lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu, nabo labakhonzi bakhe lamashumi mahlanu. Bafike badlula eJordane bahlangana nonkhosi.
Baye bahamba bedlula, batsi: "Siyawufika ngaleJordane," ngobe lomuntfu waSimakadze abefuna kutsi afike eJodhani; kodvwa uShemeyi, umsa kaGera, wehla phambi kwenkhosi, watsi:
watsi ukumkani: "Ngikucela, nkosi yami, ungeke ungibeke enhliziyweni yakho lento engiyibekile umkhonzi wakho ngalolusuku lapho waphuma khona eJerusalema; ngikucela, ungeke uyibeke emlonyeni wakho.
Nami, umkhonzi wakho, sengikholwa kutsi ngadlwengula; ngobe ngitsi: Namuhla ngiyaphuma kuqala kubo bonkhe bantfu ba-Yusufu, ukuze ngimhlangabeze unkhosi yami ukumkani.
Ngako-ke Abishayi, umsa waZeruya, watsi: "Akufanele yini kutsi uShimehi abulawe ngalolu daba, lapho ephula khona ukumkani lokhethiwe nguSimakadze?"

UDavide watsi: "Nini na, bantfu ba-Saruhiya? Ngubani na lokwenta namuhla kutsi ngibe ngumfoti wami? Ingabe namuhla kumele kube khona umuntu lobulawa eSirayeli? Ngabe ngiyazi kutsi namuhla sengibuye ngaba ngunkhosi yeSirayeli?"
Unkhosi yatsi kuShimeyi: "Ungeke ufe!" Unkhosi yamisa umkhosi wakhe kuye, yakhuluma naye.

NaMephiboshethi, umntwana wa-Sauli, waphuma waya kumyalela ukumkani; akazange ahlanze tinyawo zakhe, nalowo mlomo wakhe, naleyo ingubo yakhe, kusukela kuleso sikhathi lapho ukumkani esuka khona kuya kuleso sikhathi lapho ebuyela khona ephephile.
Afika eJerusalema kutsi ahlangane nonkhosi, inkhosi yatsi kuye: "Ngubani na longeke waphuma nami, Mefiboshethi?"
Waphendula watsi: "Mphathi wami, nkhosi, umkhonzi wakho ungikhohlisa; ngobe ngitsi: 'Sebenzisa inkunzi yami ukuze ngihambe nobukhosi.' Ngako-ke lowo mkhonzi wako ufile.
Siba ukhuluma lutho ngami kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wami; kodvwa Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wami, ufana nendvodzakati yaNkulunkulu; wena, Nkulunkulu wami, yenza lokuhle emehlo akho.

Lomndeni wonke wenkosi yami, lomkhulu wami, akazange afune lutho ngaphandle kokufa ebusweni baSimakadze Nkulunkulu wami; kodvwa wena ungibeka phakathi kwalabo labadla emgodini wakho. Ngabe nginelungelo yini lokucela ubukhosi?
Unkhosi yatsi kuye: "Ngubani na lokhuluma, ngobe ngitsi kutsi wena neSiba kumele nihlukanise lemhlaba phakathi kwenu.
UMephiboshethi watsi kunkhosi: "Ake athathe konkhe loku, ngobe ngiyethemba kakhulu kutsi lonkosi wami uyawubuyela ekhaya lakhe ngekuthula."
NaBarzilayi, umGileyadi, waphuma eRogelimi, wadlula nenkhosi eJordane, kutsi afike ambone nguNkulunkulu.
Wabe uBarzilayi mkhulu kakhulu, eneminyaka lemashumi lamakhulu lamabili nesikhombisa; waba nguwo lowo wanikela ngekudla ukumkani lapho ahlala khona eMahanayim; ngobe wayengumntu lokhulu kakhulu.
Unkhosi watsi kuBarzilayi: "Thiba nami ufike eJerusalema, khona ngitakulethela ukudla."
Barzilayi watsi kunkhosi: "Kuphi iminyaka yami yekuphila, kutsi ngihambe nenkhosi ngiye eJerusalema?

Namuhla ngineminyaka lemashumi lamakhulu lamabili nesikhombisa; ngabe sengikhona yini kutsi ngibone lokuhle nalolobi? Ingabe umkhonzi wakho unekhono lokudla noma lokudlisa? Ngabe ngingatsi ngalilalela lizwi labafileyo nalabaphilayo? Nami, lowo mkhonzi wako, kufanele ngenze yini kube nzima kakhulu kumphathi wami ukumkani?
Lomuntfu wakho uyawudlula eJordane ngendlela lencane kuphela kanye nonkhosi; ngobe yini kutsi inkhosi imnike lomnikelo lonjalo?

Lapha, ngiyakucela, uvumele umkhonzi wakho abuye, ngife enhloko yami, enhliziyweni yababami nenkosi yami; kepha hlala lapha umkhonzi wakho Kimhamu, ahambe naye nomphathi wami ukumkani, uyenise lokuhle emlonyeni wakho.
Simakadze watsi kuye: "Kimham utawuhamba nami, ngobe ngitakwenza kutsi kube kahle emehlo akho; nanoma yini lengingakucela yona, ngiyakuyikwenza kuwe."
Batsi bonke bantfu badlula eJordane, naSimakadze wadlula naye; ngobe Simakadze abemkhwehlela uBarzilayi, wabambisana naye. Wabuyela ekhaya lakhe.
Wahamba unkhosi iye eGilgala, naye Kimham wahamba naye; nabo bonkhe bantfu base-Yude naphesheya kwelwandle labaseSirayeli bahamba naye.

Bafike bonke lamadoda eSirayeli kunkhosi, batsi kuye: "Ngubani na lomkhuluwa wethu, lamadoda eYuda, abewudlwengula ukumkani, bewubeka phezu kweJordane, yena nomndeni wakhe, nabo bonkhe bantfu bakaDavide?
Baphendvula batsi: "Ngobe uMbuso ungumhlobo wethu; kungani nine buhlungu ngalolu daba? Siye sadla yini ekudlaneni kwenkhosi, nome siye wanikela yini ngemnikelo?"

Lamadoda ase-Isirayeli aphendule lamadoda eYuda, watsi: "Sinengxenye lelishumi lobukhosini, kanye nelungelo kuDavide kunenu; kungani natsi nisikhohlisa? Asikubi yini kutsi siye sakhuluma kuqala ngekubuyisa lomkhosi wethu?" Lamadoda eJuda akazange akhulume kahle kunamadoda e-Isirayeli.

Asekho khona, ngaleso sikhathi, umholi webantfu, lokuthiwa nguSheba, unyana kaBikri, waseBenjamini; watsi: "Singeke sibe necala kuDavide, singeke sibe necala kumntwana waJese. Yiya ekhaya lakho, Israele!"
Basuka bonke lamadoda eSirayeli baya kuDavide, balandela Sheba unyana kaBikri; kodvwa lamadoda eYuda ahlala alandzela ukumkani wabo kusukela eJordane kuya eJerusalema.

UDavide wabuyela ekhaya lakhe eJerusalema, watsi: "Lamadodana akhe lalishumi abewashiya agcine indlu yakhe, uDavide wababeka emgwaqeni, wabanikela ngekudla, kodvwa akazange abone nabo; bahlala befihlakele kuze kufike kusuku lwakhe lokufa, baphila njengema-uware."
Unkhosi yatsi ku-Amasa: "Susa lamadodana eJudha emveni kwelilanga lesithathu, nawe ufike lapha."
Amasa ke waphuma waya kutsi abambe lamadodana eYuda, watsi: "Ngitahlala lapha kuze kube kuphele iminyaka lelishumi nambili."
UDavide watsi ku-Abhishai: "Sheba, umsa waBikri, utawutibulala kakhulu kuna-Absalome; khipha lamadodana ami, uye kumcasha, aze afike emizini eqinile, aze ahambe emehlweni ethu."
Lamadoda aYowabha, nalabaKherethi, nalabaPhelethi, nalabo bonke labafayo, baphuma eJerusalema nabo-Abhishai, baya kuSheba unyana kaBikri.

Bafika eGibeboni, bafike emfuleni lomkhulu, khona kwafika Amasa, wahlangana nabo. UYowabhi ubenesigqoko sakhe sekulwa, abenesibhakabhaka umlenze wakhe, nesandla sakhe esiswini saso; lapho afika khona, isandla sakhe saphuma.
UYowabe watsi ku-Amasa: "Uphila kanjani, mkhuluwa wami?" Watsi uJowab abambe ngesandla sakhe sokudla imilenze ka-Amasa, kutsi amcube.

Amasa akazange aqaphele kutsi isandla saYowabe sisemandleni akhe, kodvwa uJowab wehlule emphinjeni yakhe, waphuma lokudla kwakhe kumhlaba; Joabhu watsi: "Asekuvumelekile ukuba ngiwuphuze lilanga lesibili," ngobe Amasa ubefile. Ngako-ke Joabhu naAbhiyasi, umzalwane wakhe, balandela Sheba, umsa kaBikri.
Lomunye wabaholi be-Yowabhi waya esigabeni se-Amasa, watsi: "Lowo lokhuluma nge-Yowabhi nalowo ofuna uDavide, ahambe ngemuva kwe-Yowabhi!"

Ase-Amasa wahlala ephakathi kwendlela, encibilika emlonyeni wakhe. Lomuntu watsi: "Labo bonke labamnyama bahamba bebuyela emuva." Waphuma wesuka emigwaqweni waya emahlathini, wehlisa umlenze phezu kwakhe; ngobe wonke lowo lodlulayo wayehlala phansi.
Baphuma besuka endlela, bahamba nabo bonke labaseJowabhi, kutsi baphazamise Sheba unyana waBikri.
USheba wadlula kuwo wonke lamadolobha eSirayeli, waya ku-Abeli neBeth-Maaka; nabo bonke labahlali baseBheri bahlangana behamba ngemuva kwakhe.
Befika lamadoda aYowabha, bahlasela Sheba e-Abeli yeBhete-Maaka, bamisa umkhumbi wemhlaba phezu kwedonga ledolobha; bonkhe bantfu lababe nabo uYowabha baphuma beshaya ngedonga, befuna liphule.
Kuze kwaphuma indodana yemuntfu lohlakaniphile esuka edolobhaneni, yatsi: "Nitshele, nitshele, nitsi kuYowabha: 'Thiba lapha, ngitakhuluma naye.'"
UYowabha wafika, lowesifazane watsi kuye: "Wena-ke uYowabha?" Waphendvula watsi: "Ngimi." Yatsi kuye: "Hlaza kutsi ngikhuluma yini umkhonzi wakho." Waphendula watsi: "Ngihlaza!"
Watsi: "Ezikhathini tangaphambili, abantu bakhuluma bethi, 'Thumela ku-Abele bese ucela umyalo wakhe,' futhi ngaleyo ndlela baxazulula inkinga yabo.
Natsi siphila ngekuthula eSirayeli, sikholwa kuSimakadze; ngobe nifuna kutsi niphule lomndeni waseSirayeli. Ngabe nifuna kuphi ukubulala lendlu yaNkulunkulu?"
UYowabhi watsi: "Kungeke kube njalo! Ngingeke ngidle noma ngiphule lutho!

Lokho akusho lutho, kepha kukhona umuntu lokuthiwa nguSheba, unyana waBikri, wase-Ephrayim emhlabatsini, wesuka ekungeneni kwenkhosi Davide; nimnike yena, ngizophuma kulo mji. Wathi lowesifazane kuYowabha: "Ihlavu lakhe liyawutfunywa kuwe ngaphesheya komgwaqo."

Waphuma lowesifazane, wafika ebantwini bonke ngembono yakhe. Batsipha inhloko yaSheba unyana kaBikri, bayisa kuYowabha; watsi Yowabha: "Phikisa intaba-mlilo!" Lamadodana akhe asuka emizini yabo waya emakhaya abo. UJowabha wehla kuye ukumkani eJerusalema.
Jowabe waba nguMengameli webantfu bonkhe base-Israyeli; naBenaya, umsa waJehoyada, waba ngumholi wemaKherethi newamaPlethi.
Adoniram waba nguMengameli webantfu labasebentisa; Jehoshaphatsi, umsa wa-Ahilodi, waba ngumbhali.
Sheva waba ngumbhali wenkhosi, naTsadoko naEbiyathari babe ngabaholi besive.
Na-Ira waseYairi waba ngumnikelo wekushiswa waDavide, waba ngumholi wenkhosi.

Kuye kwaba nendlala iminyaka lengemashumi lamane ngelilanga lebukhosi beDavide. UDavide wabuza uSimakadze ngalolu daba, watsi: "Ube nguSawula kanye nendlu yakhe; babenecala lokudlwengula, ngobe Sauli wababulala labaGibeboni."

Watsi unkhosi yabiza labaGibeoni, yayikhuluma nabo. (LabaGibeoni abengabe baSirayeli; bekungulomsindvo lesasingemagremu lamakhulu lamabili nemashumi mahlanu esiliva nalama-200 wegolide) 11BasiRabheni baseGibeoni babengeke bangabi ngalabaSirayeli, kodvwa kwaba nguSawuleli loye wafuna kutsi abophe kubo, ngobe waba nenhlanhla kakhulu ngebantfu bakaSirayeli kanye nabaYuda.
UDavide watsi kulabo baseGibeboni: "Ngingeke ngikwenze yini kuwe? Ngubani longeke ngiwubuyisele umonakalo, kutsi nibambise abantu bakaSimakadze?"

Labenga-Gibeboni baphendvula batsi: "Asikusiyo isiliva noma igolide esivumelwaneni sethu naSawula kanye nendlu yakhe, futsi asikusiyo sinqumo sethu sokubulala umuntu eSirayeli." Davide watsi: "Lokho lokhuluma ngalo, ngiyawukwenza.
Baphendvula batsi: "Sawule wafuna kutsi atfume, wacabanga kutsi atfume, ngobe angeke sihlale sikhona eSirayeli lonke.

Namuhla, nikelani nathi lamadodana akhe lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa, sitawuwakhonta phambi kwaSimakadze eGibeha ka-Sauli, emzini womntu lowawukhethiwe nguNkulunkulu. Unkhosi yatsi: "Ngiyawukunquma."
Lonkhosi yaletsa uMephiboshethi, unyana ka-Yonatan, lomkhuluwa waSawula, ngenxa yesive saDavide kanye na-Yonatan, lesabambisene naso phambi kwaSimakadze.

Unkhosi yathatha Armoni naMephiboshethi, bantfu lababini abebazalwa nguRispa, intombi ka-Aya, layawuzala kuSawula, kanye nemadvodzana lamabili aMerabi, intombi ka-Sauli, abebadzala ku-Adriel, intombi kaBarzilayi waseMehola.

Wabanikela emandlani labaseGibeboni, lababulale emadolobheni asentshonalanga phambi kwaSimakadze; bafa bonke labo besitsatfu kanye. Babulawa ngelilanga lokuqala lokuvuna, ngaleso sikhathi lapho kuqale khona ukuvuna ijusi.

Rispa, intombi ka-Aya, yathatha isikhumba lesingwevu, yamisa kuyo ehlathini, yahlala khona kusukela ekuqalekeni kwemnyaka lomusha kuze kufike lilanga lemvula ligwaca phezu kwabo; akazange avumele tingulube kutsi zitfole kubo ngebusuku, naletinye tilwanyana temhlaba kutsi zifike kubo ngebusuku.
Bakhuluma kuDavide kutsi uRispa, indodana ka-Aya, umkhonzi waSawula, wenzani.

Wahamba, wathola emathambo aSawula namantfwana yena Jonathan kulabo labahlalazza eAbhesi-gileadi, lapho babeka khona inhloko yabo enhliziyweni yeBeth-shaan, lapho labaFilistina bebabeka khona emathambo abo emfuleni wa Gilboa.
UDavide wakhipha khona ticubu ta-Sauli netaticubu ta-Jonathani, unyana wakhe; wahlanganisa naleticubu talabo bantu besitsatfu lababiwe.
Bafaka emathambo aSawula neyala yena Jonathane ethempelini laKishi, uyise waSauli, eZela, elinamaBhenjamini; bakwenta konkhe loko lokumwise lona ukumkani. Ngako-ke Simakadze wabaphendulela ngemhlaba.
Bekuphinde kwavuka kulwa phakathi kweFilisti neSirayeli; Davide waphuma, yena namadodana akhe, waya emphingeni neFilisti, watsi: "Nginendlala kakhulu!
Ishibi-benobi, lomunye walabo labaphuma ku-Rafa; naye abenesibhakabhaka sesiliva lesilinganiselwa emashumini lamane nesihlanu emashekeli, waba nesibhakabhaka esisha, wafuna kutsi abulala Davide.

UAbishai, umsa waZeruprhiya, wehla wamsiza Davide, wabulala loFilisti, watsi: "Labo bantu bakaDavide bakhuluma kuye bethi, 'Ungeke uphume nathi emkhosini; wena ungusibhakabhaka seSirayeli, asivumele sibhakabhaka sakho siphele.'"
Kwaba nesikhathi lapho kwavuka khona ukulwa nalabaFilisti eGobhe, lapho Sibbekai waseHusha abulala khona Saphi, lomunye wemadvodzana a-Rafa.
Kwaba nemphi eGob, lapho Elhanani, umsa waYare-Oregim, waseBethlehem, ahlasela khona labaFilisti, wabulala uGoliathi weGati; umlotshe wakhe wawunemilenze leyindilinga njengemikhono yalowo lothunga.

Kwaba nemphi eGathi, lapho kwabe khona umuntu lomkhulu kakhulu, labenemikhono leyisishiyagalombili ngesandla sakhe ngasinye, nemisipha leyisishiyagalombili ngenyawo lakhe ngalinye, labamashumi lamabili nesihlanu; naye waba ngumunye walabakhulu.
Wayibulala iSirayeli, kodvwa Jonathane, umsa wa-Shimehi, lomkhuluwa kaDavide, wambulala.
Loba bane basuka ku-Rafa, eGathi; wababulala Davide namadodana akhe.
UDavide wakhuluma kuSimakadze amazwi lalelo lingoma, ngelilanga lapho Simakadze abemsindise ngayo kusuka kubo bonkhe bomfishane bakhe, nasuka kuSawula.
Wathi: "Simakadze ngumlilo wami, nendlu yami, nalowo longisasindisa.
UNkulunkulu ngumlilo wami, ngaye ngisahamba; inhloko yami, nemandla ami ekubuyiseleni kwami; intaba yami, nendawo yami yekuphumula. Lowusindiso lami, uyawungisisa kusuka kumuntu lobushelelezi.
Ngiye ngitsi kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, nguNkulunkulu loyawubonga, ngobe sengikhululwe emgodini wami.
Amehlo ami angabonakali, kodwa ngiyakhumbula izibusiso zami kanye nempilo yami.
Tintambo ta-Hadeshi zamitfwala ngami, kanye netibondza tekufa kwatiwa phambi kwami.
Etinhlelweni zami ngitsi: 'Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wami!' UNkulunkulu wangena enhliziyweni yami; walalela izwi lami kusuka ethempelini lakhe, umsindo wami ufike emandlebeni akhe.
Lemhlaba wawugcwala, wajika, isisekelo sezulu sakhatshulwa, sakhatshulwa, ngobe waba nebuhlungu.
Kusuka emlonyeni wakhe kwaphuma umphunga, kanye nemlilo lobulalayo kusuka emphinjeni yakhe; emacwecwe abulalayo aphuma kuwo.
Wavula izulu, wehla phansi, nebumnyama bungaphansi kwenyawo lakhe.
Wahamba ngetinyawo, wafika, wehla ngetinyawo temoya, waya emhlabatsini.
Wagcoba nguNkulunkulu ngemanti amnyama, abe njengetindlu letimnyama, netintaba temvula, netintaba tezulu.
Kusuka ekukhanyani kwakhe, kwaphuma lilanga lemlilo lelingadli.
USimakadze wehla emhlabatsini, nelizwi leNgcwele lafika, wakhuluma ngaso.
Wayisusa imicibisholo yakhe, wabaphazamisa labaphikisayo bakhe; wayalela umlilo, wabaphazamisa.
Lamandla elwandle abonakala, nesisekelo semhlaba sabonakaliswa, lapho uSimakadze ekhuluma khona ngesandla sakhe, nangemoya wemphimbo yakhe.
Waba nesandla sakhe saphuma phansi, wancenga, wanciphisa ngaselwandle lokukhulu.
Wamitfwala emphinjeni yami lenamandla, kanye nalabo labangikhohlisa, ngobe belikhulu kakhulu kungi.
Bemihlasela ngelilanga lenkinga yami, ngobe Simakadze abengivikela.
Waphuma ngami emhlabatsini, wakhipha ngami, ngobe akazange anikeze kuthula.
Simakadze ungikhokhele, ngobe ngakwenza lokuhle; wangisabalalisa ngesandla sami lesingcwele.
ngobe sengihamba ngendlela yaSimakadze, ngingabi nento yebubi, ngisuka kuNkulunkulu wami.
Natimiso takhe zonke ngizigcine phambi kwami, Nami ngatsi: "Ngingeke ngihambe kude nemtsetfo wakhe."
Ngabe sengilungile phambi kwakhe, ngagcina nguNkulunkulu kutsi angabi nesono.
Ngako-ke Simakadze ungikhokhele kutsi ngakwenza lokuhle, ngobe wabona isandla sami sigcwele.
Kulabo labakholwayo, bonisa ukuthi uthembekile; kulabo labangenacala, bonisa ukuthi awunacala; kulabo labangenacala, bonisa ukuthi ulungile.
Kulabo labacophelela, ukhombisa kutsi ucophelela; kepha kulabo labaphikisayo, ubonisa ukuthi unentsandvo.
Uphindze usindise labancane, kepha lamehlo akho abheke labo bakhulu, kutsi ubakhuphe.
UNkulunkulu, wena ungusibhakabhaka sami; Simakadze uyawukhanyala timnyama tami.
Ngesizo sakho sengingeke ngihlasele umbuso, ngeNkulunkulu wami ngingeke ngikhuphuke phezu kwedonga.
Indlela yaNkulunkulu ilungile, nguNkulunkulu lokhuluma ngeqiniso, lowo ungcwele; yena ngusibhakabhaka kubo bonke labahamba kuye.
ngobe yini leNkulunkulu ngaphandle kweSimakadze, yini lemlilo ngaphandle kweNkulunkulu wethu?
LoNkulunkulu ngumandla wami, umkhonto wami loqinile, lowo lobeka indlela yami ibe lungile.
Uyamisa tinyawo tami njengetinyawo tengulube, wamisa ngekuthula emadolobheni ami aphakeme.
Usebentisa isandla sami emphilweni, ngobe tinyawo tami tingeke tibeke lilanga lesiliva.
Ungitfumele inhloko yakho yekubuyisana nami, kanye nekuthula kwakho kungenza ngikhulu.
Ufike wawisa indlela yenyawo lami, ngobe tinyawo tami tingeke zivimbe.
Ngiye ngaphazamisa bobubi bami, ngibabulala; ngingabuyeli kuze kube sengibahlukumeza.
Ngabasusa, ngababulala, ngobe bangeke baphinde babuye; babulawa ngaphansi kwenyawo lami.
Ungisinika mandla emphilweni, wabeka ngaphansi kwami labo labaphazamisayo.
Wababeka emuva bobubi bami, wababushiya; ngawabulala labo labameteka mina.
Bafuna, kodvwa angeke kubekho loyawubasindisa; bathandaza kuSimakadze, kodvwa akabaphenduli.
Lami ngabaphuca njengenhlayiya yemhlaba, ngabaphazamisa, ngabaphazamisa njengobe lukhuni lwetendlela.
Umingisile lapho labantfu bami bengihlasela khona; umile ngami kutsi ngibe ngumholi webantfu, nalabo abengabazange ngibabone bayawungikhonza.
Labasemazweni langaphandle bahamba ngami; Batsi bakhuluma ngimi, balalela.
Labangaphandle balahlekelwa ngumoya wabo, bese bephuma bahlala emakhazeni abo.

Waba nguThixo wangami, lowusindisa abasolwa bami, wabeka imihlanga phantsi kwesandla sami.
Uyawungikhulula kulabo bami, uyawungisa ngasebunzini bam, uyawungisisa ebantwaneni bemi.
Lakho, Simakadze, ngiyawukubonga emehlweni ebantfu, ngitawulingisa igama lakho.
Lowunika umphathi wakhe lokukhulu lokusindisa, lowenza ukuthula kumholi wakhe okhethiwe, kuDavide nemadvodzana akhe kuze kube sekupheleni.
Lemibhalo yaDavide, yekucala, isho kutsi: "UDavide, umsa wa-Isayi, ukhuluma, yena lomkhulu kuSimakadze, lowo Nkulunkulu wema-Yakobi, umphathi wakhe, lobhalela ingoma yaseSirayeli.
UMoya waSimakadze ukhuluma ngami, nelizwi lakhe lisenhliziyweni yami.
Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, wakhuluma, iRhokha yema-Israyeli yatsi kuye: "Kunenkhosi lelawula ngemtsetfo, lelawula ngekuthula,
Uyafana nekukhanya kwesokudla lapho lilanga liphuma khona, emhlabeni longenasibhakabhaka; uyawufanana nemthunzi welilanga ngemuva kwentwasamlilo, leyenza tingulube temhlabato zikhule.
Angeke-ke Simakadze akwenze njalo ngendlu yami? Wakwenza nami umnqophiso lohlala kuze kube sekupheleni, ulungile ngaso sonke simo sakhe; wangisinika kutfunywa kwami, watsi: "Uya kutsi ngikhule"?
Lababi bafana netinsika letiboshwa, angeke kube khona lowo loyawuzikhipha ngesandla sakhe.
Wonke lowo lotawubacosha, kumele abe nesandla sensimbi noma sibhakabhaka; bese bacutshungulwa ngemlilo lapho behlala khona.

Lemi magama labaholi labakhulu labebakhona kuDavide: uJosheb-bashebhethi, umTakemoni, umsa wa-Adino, wase-Eznani, waba nguMengameli webantfu labalishumi elinesihlanu; wabulala bamakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamane ngalinye.
