Nasemuva kwakhe kwaba ngu-Eleazari, umsa kaDodayi, waseAhohiya, lomunye wabaholi labathathu labahamba neDavide, lapho behlangana khona namakhosi aseFilisti emphini, ngobe lamadodana eSirayeli akazange ahambe.

Le-Eleazari wahlala khona, wababulala labaFilisti, kuze kube isandla sakhe siphelelwe lukhuni, saceba ngekhebula lakhe; ngobe Simakadze abewenza lokudla lokukhulu ngalolusuku. Baphinde babuyela kuye kuphela kutsi babuyele kulabo abafayo.
Nasekudla kwakhe kwakunguShama, umsa waHageyi, waseHarare; labaFilisti bahlangana lapho kwabekhona khona isihlahla se-oatmeal, ngobe bantfu beSirayeli babegibela phambi kwabo.
Wahlala ephakathi kwemhlaba, wawuvikela, wabulala labaFilisti; ngobe uSimakadze wabanika lokukhulu kakhulu lokulwa.

Kuye kwatsi, lapho kuphekwa khona, labathathu kubo bonkhe labaholi bemadvodza lamashumi lamakhulu mahlanu, baphuma bahlangana naDavide efuleni le-Adulam; lamakhosi aseFilisti ahlala efulani laseRefayi.
UDavide waba khona lapho esitezi lesiphakeme, nalabaFilisti babekhona begcina Bethlehemu.
UDavide wafuna kakhulu amanzi, watsi: "Ngabe kukhona longeke amnike amanzi lokudlisa eBethlehem, emfuleni wemnyango!"

Lamadodana lamandla amathathu abulala emaFilisti, wakhipha amanzi emfuleni waseBethlehem, lapho kungena khona isango, wayawanikela kuDavide; kodvwa yena akazange ayidle,ūzifafaze umnikelo wekushiswa kuSimakadze.

Watsi: "Simakadze, ngingawudla lomnikelo wekushiswa, kodvwa ngiyawudla igazi lalaba bafileyo, labo lababeka kuphila kwabo engozini lokuwuthola." Akazange awudle. Lemicimbi lemikhulu yalaba balingisi labathathu yayifana naleyo.

UAbishai, mkhuluwa ka-Yowabe, unyana wa-Zeruya, waba nguMengameli wabo bonkhe labathathu; yena wabeka isandla sakhe esibhakabhakeni, wahlasela lamakhulu mathathu, wawabulala, waba negama phakathi nalabathathu.
Waba ngumunye webantfu labathathu labebahloniphekile kakhulu, waba ngumphathi wabo, kepha akazange abe ngumunye walabathathu.
Benaya, umsa wa-Jehoyada, waba ngumuntfu lonamandla, waseKabseeli, lowenzako mandla amakhulu; yena wabulala labakhulu lababini baseMoabi; naye waphuma efuleni ngelilanga lekhephu, wabulala linyo.

Wabulala namunye umSirayeli, lomkhulu kakhulu; naye wabeka sandla sakhe esibhakabhakeni. UBenayaha waya kuye enesibhaka-bhaka, wehlisa isibhaka-bhaka esandlani somSirayeli, wambulala ngesibhaka sakhe.
Lamandla lawa awenza Benaya, umsa wa-Yoyada; ngobe waba nemlando phakathi kwalabo labakhulu lalabathathu.
Wabe mkhulu kunabo bonkhe labamashumi lamane, kodvwa akazange ahlukaniswe nalabathathu; Davide wambeka phezu kwalabo labagcina isandla sakhe.
Lalaba balishumi elinamashumi lamane: Asaheli, umsa kaJowabe; Elhanani, umsa waDodo waseBethlehem;
Shamha waseHarodi, neElika waseHarodi,
Helezi wePalthi, neIra, umsa wa-Ikeshi waseTekoa,
Abiezeri waseAnathothi, neMebunnai waseHusati,
Salmoni we-Ahoyi, neMaharai waseNetofa,
Heleb, umsa waBaana, waseNetofa; Itai, umsa waRibai, waseGibeha eBenjamini;
Benaya wasePirathoni, Hidayai waseGhasha,
Abi-Albon, Arbathite, Azmavet, Barumite,
uElihaba waseSaloni, nemadvodzana aJashen, naJonathane,
Shamha, umHarari; Ahiyamu, umsa waSharari, umHarari;
Elifeleti, umsa wa-Ahasbai waseMaakathi; Eliam, umsa wa-Ahitofeli waseGilo;
Hezro waseKarmeli, nePaarai waseArbi,
Igal, umsa waNathani, waseSobha, wemadvodzana aGadi;
Seleki, umAmoni, neNaharayi waseBeerothi, lowo waba nesibhakabhaka saYowabe, umsa waZeruya;
Ira wase-Itri, Gareb wase-Itri,
na-Uriya, umHeti; laba bonkhe babemashumi lamane nesikhombisa.
UNkulunkulu wabuyela ekuphazamiseni bantfu beSirayeli, watsi kuDavide: "Thinda ubala lamadodana eSirayeli nalawo eJuda."
Watsi unkhosi watsi kuYowabhi, umphathi wesive, lobe naye: "Thinda uhambe ngaso sonke isihlanganisi seSirayeli, kusuka eDani kuya eBheri-sheba, ubala abantu, ngibone ukuthi bangaphi.

UYowabhi watsi kunkhosi: "Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, ugcine laba bantu bangaba makhulu kakhulu kunalabo abakhona manje; ngobe umphathi wami, ukumkani, aphile, namehlo akhe abone lokhu; kodvwa kungani lomphathi wami, ukumkani, efuna ukwenza lomsebenzi?
Lakho kutsi uYowabha nebaholi bebutfo baphuma ekungeneni kwenkhosi, batsi: "Sifike sibeke linani lebantfu base-Isirayeli."
Badlula eJordane, bamisa tindlu tabo eAroeri, enyakatho-ntshonalanga yenhloko-dolobha yaseGadi, bese befika eYazeri.
Bafika eGileyadi, nemhlaba weTathi-Hodshi, bafike eDani-Yaani, nalapho besuka khona kuSidoni.
Bafike bafika eTire, lapho behlala khona, nakweminye imifula yalabaHivi nelabaKananani, bafika bafika eBeer-shebha, enyakatho yeYuda.
Bafike babuyela eJerusalema, ngemuva kwemnyaka wesishiyagalolunye nelilanga lemashumi lamane, lapho bebehlele khona yonke lelizwe.

UYowabhi waphendvula watsi: "Umbuso waseSirayeli ubenamaphesenti lamashumi lamabili nemakhulu lamashumi lamane ebantfu labanamandla, bengenasibhakabhaka, kanye namakhosikazi aseJuda abenamaphesenti lamakhulu mane."

UDavide wahlupheka kakhulu emphefumulweni wakhe, ngemuva kokuba uDavidi abeke linani labantu. Wakhuluma kuSimakadze watsi: "Ngibe necala elikhulu ngaleso sinqumo sami; kepha manje-ke, Simakadze, ngikucela ukuthi unciphise ubugebengu bomkhonzi wakho, ngobe sengihlukumele."
Kwafika lilanga lesikhombisa, ngaphambi kokuba uDavide afike, ilizwi laSimakadze lafika kuGadi umprofeti, lobonako waDavide, litsi:
Hamba ufike ukhulume naDavide, utsi: Simakadze utsi: Ngikunikela kuwe ngezinto ezintathu; khethe esinye sazo, ngikuyenze kuwe.

Gade wafika kuDavide, watsi kuye: "Ufuna yini kutsi kube nendlala iminyaka lesikhombisa ezweni lakho? Noma ungafuni yini kutsi uhambe emaviki lasitfupha phambi kwalabo abatfusa wena, nabo batfuse wena? Noma ufuna yini kutsi kube nendlala emaviki lalishumi elinesihlanu ezweni lakho? Hlala ucabange, bese ubona ukuthi ngiyawuphendula yini lowo lomile."
UDavide watsi kuGadi: "Nginenkinga enkulu; hlala sitsi sesihleli esandlani saSimakadze, ngobe ukuthula kwakhe kukhulu kakhulu; kepha ngingeke ngihlehle esandlani sema-Israyeli."

Ngako-ke uSimakadze wehlisa umkhuhlane eSirayeli, kusukela ngaleso sikhathi kuze kube yilapho wabeka khona isikhathi sakhe; kwashona abantu lamaphesenti lamashumi sishiyagalombili kusuka kuDani kuya eBherishebha.

Ngako-ke uSimakadze watsi kuye: "Kulungile, khipha isandla sakho!" Kube khona lilanga lesibili, lapho inkhosi yaseYiputa yafika eJerusalema. USimakadze wehlule ngaleso sigubhu, watsi: "Kulungile, khulula isandla sakho."

UDavide wakhuluma kuSimakadze, lapho ebona khona sentombi leyawubulala labantfu, watsi: "Ngiye lowo muntfu lophelelwe ngububi, nalowo muntfu lophikile; kodvwa laba bantu bafana nengulube; yini labeyenza? Nceda, uphindze uncede mina kanye nendlu yami.
UGadi wafika kuDavide ngalolusuku, watsi kuye: "Thinda, uvule ithempeli kuSimakadze emhlabatsini la-Aronah, umJebusi."
UDavide wehla, njengobe Gadhi abekhuluma kuye, njengobe Simakadze abemwise.
Aravna wabuka, wababona ukumkani nebantfu bakhe befika kuye; wehla waya ekungeneni kwenkhosi, watsi: "Ngubani na lowo umkhonzi wakho?"

Watsi uAronayi: "Ngubani na lomphathi wami, ukumkani, lofike abone umkhonzi wakhe?" UDavide watsi: "Kuthenga lendlu yakho yekudla, kutsi ngibuyele kuSimakadze, ngibuyele ne altare, ngisuse lesi sifo emphakathini.
Watsi Aravna kuDavide: "Mphathi wami, umkwehluleli, uthathe lokudla lokungekuhle emehlo akho, uyeke; bona lengulube yemnikelo wekushiswa, bona netinkomishi tekudla kanye nemjovo yalengulube yemlilo.
Unkhosi yami, mina-Aronah ngiyawunikela kuwo wonke lamandla ebukhosini.'" 20Watsi uAronah kuSimakadze watsi: "UNkulunkulu wakho, Nkulunkulu wemaSirayeli, abe nekuthula nawe!

Wathi uMosi ku-Aronah: "Kungeke kube njalo, představa ngikuflare wena; ngeke nginike umnikelo wokushiswa kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wami, ungeniseni kwami." UDavide wathenga lendlu kanye nengulube ngeshekeli lesiliva elilodwa namakhulu lamashumi mahlanu e shekeli.
UDavide wabambise khona ithempeli kuSimakadze, wanikela khona ngeminikelo yekushiswa neminikelo yekuthula; ngobe Simakadze abewuphendula lomhlaba, nalesi sifo sabuyela kubo-Israyeli.
1Kgs: UMbuso WaseDavide waba mkhulu kakhulu, waphelelwa ngumnyaka mncane; bantfu bakhe babewugcoba ngemigqomo yakhe, ngobe angeke abe nekushisa.

Baphendvula batsi: "Lakho, sifune kunkhosi yami umkakhe indodana lencane, indvodzakati yemuntfu lomshado, lengeke isebenzela ukumkani, ibe ngumkhonzi wakhe, ihlale embhedeni wakho, bese unkhosi yami umkakhe iphumula.
Baye bafuna umfana lobukekayo kuwo wonke lamadolobha eSirayeli, bathola abebhisagi waseShunemi, bamletha kunkhosi.
Lendodakazi yabe inhle kakhulu, yahlala iphakela ukumkani, ibe ngumkhonzi wakhe; kodvwa ukumkani akazange amhlangane.
UAdoniya, umsa waHagithi, indodana kaDavide, waba mkhulu, watsi: "Ngiya kuba ngunkhosi." Wakha imoto yekulwa, nabahhashi, namadoda lamashumi mahlanu ahamba phambili kwakhe.
Ubaba wakhe akazange amcaphune, watsi: "Ngubani lokwenza lokhu?" Wabe ubukeka kahle kakhulu, wazalwa ngemuva kuka-Absalome.
Wakhuluma na-Adoniya, umsa wa-Zeruya, ne-Abhiyathari, umLevi; nabo balandzela yena, bamsekela.
Kodwa Sadoki, umLevi, naBenaya, umsa wa-Jehoyada, naNathani umprofeti, naShimeyi, naRehi, nalabakhulu labanamandla laDavide, bangeke babe ngaseAdoniya.

U-Adoniya wanikela ngenkomo, nengulube, nenyama yenkomo, kanye nemfuyo, ethempelini leZohelethe, elinama-En-rogeli; wabiza bonke labazalwane bakhe, bantfu labasebukhosini, nabo bonkhe labaphathi benkhosi baseYuda.
Ngako-ke uNathani umprofeti, naBenaya, nebantfu labakhulu, naSolomoni, umsa wakhe, akazange abonise.
UNathani wakhuluma kuBathesheba, umkakhe uSolomoni, watsi: "Ungazi kutsi uAdoniya, unyana kaHagithi, usewube ngunkhosi, naDavide, lomphathi wethu, akawazi?
Lakho, hlala ufike ngikunike umyalo kutsi ugcine impilo yakho kanye nempilo yeSolomoni, umsa wakho.

Hamba ufike kunkhosi Davide, utsi kuye: Mphathi wami, Simakadze, awuzange ungisibekele ngesandla, utsi: USolomoni, umntwana wakho, kumele abe ngubukhosi ngemuva kwami, naye kufanele ahlale emphini yami? Kungani khona kutsi Adonijah abe nguMbuso?"
Nalapho wena uhlala khona ukhuluma naSimakadze, ngitafika ngemuva kwakho, ngatsi: "Kulungile lokho lokushoyo."
Bate-sheba wafika ekungeneni kwenkhosi, waya kuyo endlini yakhe yangasese; inkhosi yabe ineminyaka emikhulu kakhulu ubudala, futhi Abishagi waseShunemi wayemsiza.
Bathe-ke Bathsheba yatsi: "Ngubani na wena?"Bathe-ke Batseba: "Ngubani na wena? "
Wathi kuye: "Mholi wami, wena ungisibulale ngeSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho, watsi: 'Solomoni, umntwana wakho, kumele abe ngunkhosi ngemuva kwami, naye kufanele ahlale enhloko yami.'
Manje-ke, bona, uAdoniya ube ngunkhosi; nawe, nkosi yami, ukumkani, awusazi kutsi.

Uye wanikela ngenkomo, nenyama yenkomo, nengulube, ngenani elikhulu kakhulu, wamemela bonke bantfu benkhosi, na-Abhiyathari umpristi, na-Yowabu umphathi wesibhakabhaka, kodvwa angeke ammeme mkhonzi wakho uSolomoni.
Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, watsi: "Ngubani na loyawuhlala esihlalweni sakho sebukhosi ngemuva kwakho, wena Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wami?
Ngase-ke, uma ningeke nikwenze, lapho umphathi wami, ukumkani, ekufa khona, bese efakwa emndenini wakhe, mina naSolomoni, unyana wami, sitawubekwa njengebabusi.
Ngako-ke, ngelicala yena ekhuluma nenkhosi, kwafika uNathani umprofeti.
Bakhuluma kunkhosi batsi: "Nathani umprofeti ukhona!" Wafika, wehlisa isandla sakhe emhlabatsini phambi kwenkhosi.
Watsi uNathani: "Mphathi wami, bukhosi! Usho yini kutsi: 'Adoniya uzoba ngunkhosi ngemuva kwami, yena utawuhlala enhloko yami'?

Uye watsi: "Namuhla-ke ufike, wabulala inkunzi nenyama yenkomo kanye nemfuyo leminingi. Uyawubiza bonke bantfu benkhosi, nabaholi boMbuso waseSirayeli kanye noAbhiyathari umpristi; bona badla nabo baphuza phambi kwakhe, batsi: 'Kuhlale kuphila ukumkani Adonijah!'
Nami, umkhonzi wakho, naSadoko umnikelo wesono, naBenaya, umsa waYehoyada, naSolomoni umkhonzi wakho, akazange amkhokele.
Ukwenze yini lokhu, umsa wami ukumkani, ngaphandle kwekutitshela umkhonzi wakho kutsi ngubani loyawuhlala ebukhosini ngemuva kwakhe?
Unkhosi Davide yatsi: "Thiphani Bathsheba." Waye waya, wahlala phambi kwenkhosi.
Unkhosi yakhuluma, yatsi: "Ngiphila Simakadze, lowo lamikhipha kuwo wonke umonakalo,

Ngako-ke, njengobe ngikuvilele ngesandla saSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, ngitsi: "Solomoni, umntwana wakho, uyawuhlala ebukhosini ngemuva kwami, yena utawuhlala esihlalweni sami sasebukhosini endaweni yami," kanjalo-ke namuhla ngiyakwenza.
Bathe-ke Bathsheba yahlaliswa ngebuso bayo emhlaba, yaba ngumnikelo wekushiswa kunkhosi, yatsi: "Ubukhosi benkosi yami uDavide buhlale buphila kuze kube sekupheleni!"
Unkhosi Davide yatsi: "Thiphani uTsadoko, umLevi, naNathani lomprofeti, naBenaya, umsa waYehoyada."Bafike ba ngaphambilini kwenkhosi.
watsi kubo: "Nithatheni nabo labakhonzi bami, nifake uSolomoni, umsa wami, emphilweni yami yengulube, nimukhuphule eGiyoni.
khona-ke Sadoki, umLevi, kanye naNathani lomprofeti batawumupha kutsi abe nguMbuso waseSirayeli; bese niphuza inhlamvu yemphimbo, ningatsi: Ubukhosi beSolomoni buphile!
Baye babuyela emuva, batsi: "Sifike sihlale ebukhosini benkhosi yami; yena kumele abe nguSimakadze longuSomandla, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli nawaseJuda.
Benaya, umsa waYehoyada, watsi kunkhosi: Ameni; Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, umphathi wami, ukumkani, akhulume kanjalo.
Kube Simakadze abe nenkosi yami, ukumkani, njengobe abe nenkhosi yami, umkwetsi, naye abe noSolomoni, aze agcine isithende sakhe sikhulu kunasesibhedlela senkosi yami, umkwetsi Davide.
Baphuma khona Sadoki, umLevi, naNathani, umprofeti, naBenaya, umsa wa-Jehoyada, nalabaKherethi, nalabaPhelethi, babeka uSolomoni emphilweni yenkhosi Davide, bamhambisa eGihoni.
Sadoki, umsa waSimakadze, watsi: "Lakho lilanga lelingcwele leLivi Lelihle liyawufika enkhosini yaseGibhithe; uSawula kanye nebantfu bakhe baphuma kuleyo ndawo.
Bafike bonkhe bantfu babuyela emuva kwakhe, bebhota ngemiphimbo, bebulela kakhulu; kwatsi nemhlaba wawudlidliza ngalembulelo wabo.
UAdoniya kanye nabo bonkhe labamenywa bakhe bakhuluma, lapho bephelelwa khona ukudla. NaJowab, lapho elalela khona umsindo wemphimbo, watsi: "Ngubani na lowo mhlambi lohamba ngemphimbo?"
Ube sewukhuluma, kwafika uJonathani, umsa waAbhiyathari, umLevi. UAdoniya watsi: "Thinase sifike, ngobe wena umuntfu lolungile, uyengabi nezindaba ezinhle."
UJonathani watsi ku-Adoniya: "Kungeke kube njalo; ngobe unkhosi yethu, uMbuso WaseDavide, ugcine uSolomoni ngunkhosi.
Unkhosi yathumela naye Sadoki, umsa waSimakadze, naNathani umprofeti, naBenaya, umsa waJehoyada, nalabaKherethi, nalabaPlethi, batsi: "Thina-ke sitawuhamba nawe ngemuphi yenkhosi."
Sadoki, umLevi, kanye naNathani, lomprofeti, bamphisa kutsi abe ngunkhosi yakhe eGihoni. Baphuma khona bephumula, ngobe ledolobha lonke lidlale; lena yinye intshukumo niyikhulumayo.
Batsi naSolomoni wahlala emphini yebukhosi.

Baye bafika nabo labakhonzi bakankhosi, batsi: UNkulunkulu wakho ugcine igama laSolomoni lihamba phambili kunalelo lakho, ugcine isithende sakhe siphakeme kuneso sakho. Nakho ukumkani wabuyela emuva, wehla embhedeni wakhe.
Watsi naSimakadze, watsi: "Ungcwele Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, lowo wanikela namuhla ngendlu yami yebukhosi, ngiyibone ngemehlo ami."
Labo bonke labamenywe nguAdoniya bakhatshulwa, baphuma, batsi: "Siyahamba, siyawubuyela ekhaya."
Adoniya waphuma, wabuyela enkhosini yakhe, watsi kuye: "Kutsi Simakadze akazange akuvumele ufike ethempelini lakhe.

Bakhuluma kuSolomoni bati, "Bonani, Adonijaha uyala ukumkani uSolomoni; bona, ubambe izingcezu zesibhedlela, watsi: 'UMbuso waseSolomoni kumele aphike ngami ngalolusuku, kutsi ngeke ambulala mkhonzi wakhe ngekhefu.' "
Watsi uSolomoni: "Uma ebonakala sengathi ungumuntfu lolungile, angeke yinye inwele yakhe iphele phansi; kepha uma kufunyelwa khona lokubi kuye, uya kufa."
UMbuso WaseSolomoni wathumela, wakhipha uAdoniya ethempelini, waya wehla, waba ngumnikelo wekushiswa kubukhosi baseSolomoni. UMbuso waseSolomoni watsi kuye: "Hamba uye ekhaya lakho."
Wafika sikhatsi saDavide sokufa, waletsa uSolomoni, umsa wakhe, watsi:
"Nami ngiyawuya ngendlela le揚isiwe kulowo nalowo lohlala emhlabatsini; kodvwa wena, ube ngumfati, uhlale ungumuntfu.

"Ungeke uhambe ngendlela yakhe, ugcine imiyalo yakhe, nemiyalo yakhe, nemithetho yakhe, namasiko akhe, kanye nemvume yakhe, njengobe kubhalwe emthethweni kaMosesi; ngobe khona lapho uzophumelela kuwo wonke lomsebenzi wakho, nakwesokudla kwakho, nakwesobunxele kwakho.

UNkulunkulu utawugcina amazwi akhe akhuluma ngami, watsi: 'Uma izingane zakho zihlala zihamba phambi kwami ngeqiniso, ngentliziyo yabo yonke nemoya yabo yonke, ngeke kubekho mntu wakho ebukhosini be-Israyeli.'

Nawe uwazi nalokho lokwenzele kuYowabhi, umsa waZeruya, lapho abulala khona lamadodana mabili enkhosini yaseSirayeli, uAbner, umsa kaNeri, noAmasa, umsa kaJetheri, ngesikhathi sekuthula, njengesikhathi sokulwa; ngobe gazi labo lalibanjwa emlenzeni wakhe kanye netinwele zakhe.
Ufike uhambe naye ngemandla akho; angeke abe mkhulu, aze aphume eGibhithe ekuthula.
Lasemadvodzana aBarzilayi, loGileyadi, utawubanika inhlonipho; bangadla embhedeni wakho, ngobe bamisekela lapho ngiphuma khona phambi kwa-Absalome, umsa wakho.

Uyawukhumbula naShemeyi, unyana kaGera, umBenjamini waseBahurimi, lokhona nawe; ngobe waphazamisa ngesandla sakhe esibi kakhulu ngaleso sikhathi lapho ngihamba khona eMahanayim. Ngako-ke watsi: "Ngiya kuJordane kutsi amhlanganise nami." Ngaye ngakhuluma kuye nguSimakadze, esithi: 'Angeke ngiyakubulala ngesigwebo.'
Ngako-ke, ungeke umvumele ahlale ephephile; ngobe wena ungumuntfu lohlakaniphile, utawuzi kutsi yini lekufanele uyenze kuye. Uyawufa ngegazi emshadweni wakhe."
UDavide wehla embhedeni wakhe, washiswa, wabanjwa nababa bakhe emzini waDavide.
UDavide waba ngunkhosi yaseSirayeli iminyaka lengema-40; eHebroni kwaba yiminyaka lesikhombisa, eJerusalema kube yimnyaka lositfupha nesihlanu.
USolomoni wahlala enkhosini yaDavide, ubaba wakhe; ukumkani wakhe waba mkhulu kakhulu.
UAdoniya, umsa waHagithi, waya kuBathesheba, umnambitsi kaSolomoni; yena watsi kuye: "Ufika kanjani ngekuthula?" Waphendula watsi: "Ufika njani ngekuthula?"
Watsi kuye: "Nginento lengingakukhuluma ngayo." Yati, "Thina sihambe."

Watsi: "Uyazi ukuthi ubukhosi bebube bukhona kimi, nebantfu bonke baseSirayeli babeke isandla sabo ekuphileni kwami kutsi ngibe ngunkhosi; kepha kubonakala sengathi uMbuso wabuyela kumngane wami, ngobe Simakadze wawuwunike yena.
Ngaye, ngiyakucela into eyodwa; wena, ngicela, ungeke ungisinike." Yathi kuye: "Thintela."
Watsi: "Nceda ukhulume naSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, kutsi amnike Abishagi waseShunemi ukuba abe ngumkakhe; ngobe angeke akubeke phansi.
Batsheba yatsi: "Kulungile, ngitakhuluma nawe kunkhosi."

Batesheba wafika kunkhosi Solomonu, watsi kuye ngeAdoniya. Unkhosi yaphuma yahlangana naye, yawubuka, yahlala esihlalweni sayo, yaletsa isitulo senkosi yakhe, wayibeka embhedeni wakhe, wayala ukuba ahlale ngasekudla kwakhe.
Waye watsi kuye: "Nginembuzo loncane kuwe; ngingakuphoxeli, ngiyakucela." UMbuso wase watsi kuye: "Nceda, umama wami, ngeke ngikuphoxele."
Waye watsi: "Abhisagasi wase-Suneni aphindze abe ngumkakhe Adonija, abe ngumfazi wakhe."

USolomoni waphendula watsi kunina wakhe: "Ngubani na lofunayo Abishagi waseShunemi kutsi abe ngu-Adoniya? Nifune naye ukumkani, ngobe umkhulu kunami; naAbhiyathari, umpristi, kanye noYowabhi, umsa waZeruya, bahamba naye."
UMbuso waseSolomoni wanikela ngesipho kuSimakadze, watsi: "Nkulunkulu aninike lokhu kanye nalokuningi, uma uAdoniya angeke afune lesi sifiso ngempilo yakhe.

Nase-ke uSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, watsi: "Lakho kulungile; ngobe Simakadze langisibeka ebukhosini benkhosi yami Davide, nami wangisinika indlu yasebukhosini, njengobe wakhuluma; ngiphila Simakadze, namuhla uAdoniya utawufa!"
UMbuso WaseSolomoni waletsa uBenaya, umsa ka-Jehoyada, watsi: "Lonkhe lolu hlelo luhle kakhulu.

Watsi ukumkani kuAbhiyathari, umLevi: "Thumela eAnathothi, emasimini akho, ngoba wena ufanele kufa; kepha namuhla ngingeke ngikufeze, ngobe wena wakhipha ibhokisi laSimakadze Nkulunkulu wami kuDavide, ubaba wami, uye waba nesibopho sezinto zonke lapho ubaba wami ahlupheka khona."
Ngako-ke uSolomoni wakhipha Abeyata, kutsi angeke abe ngumnikelo wesono kuSimakadze, kutsi kube nguNkulunkulu lowo lakhuluma ngendlu kaEli eSilo.
Wafika uYowabha, wabaleka waya etentini leSimakadze, wabamba izingcezu ze altare; ngobe uYowabha waba ngasekudla kwe-Adoniya, kepha akazange abe sekudla kwe-Absalomu.
Bakhuluma kuSolomoni, batsi: "Jowab uhambe waya etentweni taSimakadze, uye wahlala eduze kwe altare." USolomoni wathumela Benaya, umsa ka-Jehoyada, watsi: "Thiba naye!"

UBenaya wafika etentini laSimakadze, watsi kuYowabha: "Unkhosi itsi: 'Thinake!'" UYowabha wathi: "Akunjalo, ngizofa lapha." UBenaya wabuyela kunkhosi, wamtshela, watsi: "Ngalendlela uYowabha akhuluma ngayo, ngalendlela aphendule ngayo."
Unkhosi yatsi kuBhenaya: "Yenza njengobe ukhuluma; hlasela naye, uyifake embhedeni wakhe, ngobe ngingeke ngibe negazi lelingabi necala, laliboshwe nguYowabha, ngalendlu yoyise.

UNkulunkulu utawumubuyiselela igazi lakhe, lapho ehlasela khona lamadodana amabili angcono kuye kanye nalabo abakhulu kunaye, wabulala kubo, Davide, ubaba wami, angawazi: u-Abner, umsa kaNeri, umkhosi waseSirayeli, no-Amasa, indodana kaJetheri, umkhosi weYuda.
Lemfucuza yabo ifike kuYowabhi nemadvodzana akhe kuze kube sekupheleni; kodvwa Davide, nemadvodzakati akhe, nendlu yakhe, nesikhundla sakhe, Simakadze utawubanika kuthula kuze kube sekupheleni.
Waphuma khona Benaya, umsa wa-Jehoyada, wehla, wambulala uYowabha; wabanjwa endlwini yakhe emfuleni waseGileyadi.
Unkhosi yabeka Benaya, umsa ka-thonini waJehoyada, njengesikhulu semabutfo endaweni yakhe, naSadoko, umLevi, esikhundleni saAbhiyathari.
Unkhosi yatsi: "Thiba indlu eYerusalem, uhlale khona, ungaphumanga kuphi naphi nalapho.
"Thina-ke sitawutsi, ngelilanga letfu lokuphuma wena udlula egwadini laseKidrone, uyawufa; igazi lakho liyawuba ngenhlavu yakho."
UShemeyi watsi kunkhosi: "Kulungile; njengobe Nkulunkulu wami, ukumkani, ekhuluma, lomuntfu wakho uyakwenza." UShemeji wahlala eYerusalem iminyaka leminingi.
Kwatsi sekuphelile iminyaka lemithathu, kwaphuma labakhonzi lababini ba-Shimeyi besuka ku-Akishi, umsa waMahaka, ukumkani waseGathi. Bakhuluma ku-Shimeyi batsi: "Bonani, labakhonzi bakho baseGathi."
Wayiphuma, waya eGathi ku-Akishi, watsi: "Ngifuna labakhonzi bami." Wahamba, wababuyisela labakhonzi bakhe baseGathi.
Bakhuluma kuSolomoni batsi: "Shemeyi ufike eJerusalema eGathi, wabuyela."

Unkhosi yatsi: "Thiba uShimeyi, utsi kuye: 'Ngingeke yini ngikubeke esivumelwaneni noSimakadze, ngibengele kuwe, ngithi, 'Lemini lapho uphuma khona, usuka khona, uyawufa'? Nakho wena wakhuluma ngami watsi: 'Kulungile lokho lokushoyo; ngiyakwenza.'
Kungani-ke kutsi ningeke nigcine mnikelo wenu kuSimakadze, naleso simiso sengikutsile?
Watsi ukumkani ku-Shemeyi: "Uyazi nguNkulunkulu wenhliziyo yakho yonke lebubi labewukwenzela uDavide, ubaba wami; ngobe Simakadze utawukubuyisela kuwe lobubi bakho.
Kube uSolomoni, umphathi, uya kubambisana, nesikhundla seDavide siyawutsi siqinile phambi kwaSimakadze kuze kube sekupheleni.
Unkhosi yaletsa uBenaya, umsa waYehoyada, waya wabulala Shimeyi, watsi: "Uyawufa!" Ngako ubukhosi buphinde babutsiwe esandlani saSolomoni.
USolomoni wahlangana neFaro, ukumkani wase-Ejipt, wamnika intombi yakhe, wayibeka eMzini kaDavide, kuze aqedele ukwakha indlu yakhe, nendlu yaSimakadze, nasengcezu yeJerusalema ngaso sonke isikhathi.
Labantfu babehlala benikela emadolobheni lasentshonalanga, emadolobhaneni asekhaya; kodvwa indlu yaSimakadze yayingeke ibe yenziwe kuze kube ngaleso sikhatsi.
USolomoni wathandana noSimakadze, ehamba ngemithetho kaDavide, ubaba wakhe; kodvwa wanikela neminikelo yekushiswa emadolobheni aphakeme.
Unkhosi yafika eGibeoni, yanikela khona; ngobe lapho kwakungumhlabatsi lomkhulu kakhulu. Solomone wanikela khona ngemnikelo wekushiswa ema-1.
EGibeboni, Simakadze wabonakala kuSolomoni emphupheni ngebusuku; Nkulunkulu watsi kuye: "Sicela yini kutsi ngikunike."

Solomoni watsi: "Uye wakhombisa umkhonzi wakho, uDavide, ubaba wami, inhlonipho enkulu, njengoba wayehamba phambi kwakho ngeqiniso, nangenhlonipho, nangenhlonipho yomphefumulo; nawe uyawubonisa yena lemincintiswano yakhe enkulu, ubemnikela umntwana lohlala ebukhosini bakhe ngalolusuku.
Namuhla, Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wami, ungenza umkhonzi wakho abe ngunkhosi endaweni kaDavide, umsa wami; kodvwa mina sengumntwana loncane, angizange ngibe nekhono lokuya nangekubuya.
Nami, umkhonzi wakho, sengiphakathi kwebantfu bakho labewakhethele wena, indvodza lelikhulu kakhulu, nebantfu bayo baningi kakhulu, kutsi bangacinywa.
Namuhla, nikela umkhonzi wakho ngenhliziyo lelalelayo, kutsi ngibe ngummeli webantfu bakho, ngihlukanise lokuhle nelobi; ngobe yini lengeke ivumeleke kutsi ibe ngummeli walemindeni yakho emikhulu?
UNkulunkulu wathandana naSolomoni, ngobe abewucela lomsebenzi.

Nkulunkulu watsi kuye: "Ngikutshele, ngobe ucele lokhu; awuzange ufune impilo ende kuwe, noma impahla, noma umphefumulo walabo bakhohlisayo; kepha ucele ukuba ube nengqondo, ukuze ukhulume ngendlela efanele.
Ngitakwenza lokudla kwakho, ngikunike umphefumulo webwenge newukuqonda; ngobe sekungeke kube khona lowo ufana nawe ngaphambilini, kuze kube khona lowo ufana nawe ngemuva kwako.
Lakho-ke lokungewucela, ngakunikela kuwe, kanye netfu, nekuthula; ngobe angeke kube khona ukumkani lofana nawe nsuku zonke zekuphila kwakho.
Uma uhamba ngendlela yami, ugcina imiyalo yami nemtsetfo wami, njengobe wahamba Davide, umsa wakho, ngitakulethela iminyaka leminingi.

USolomoni wavuka, wabona ukuthi kwakuyiphupho. Wabuyela eJerusalema, wahlala phambi kwebhokisi lesivumelwane saSimakadze, wanikela ngeminikelo yekushiswa neminikelo yekuthula, walungiselela isidlo sabaphathi bakhe bonke.
Usuku lwesinye, kwafika emabhishobhi lasitfupha enkhosini, wahlala phambi kwakhe.
Lomunye wabaphendvula watsi: "Ngikucela, nkosi yami, mina naleso sifazane sihlala ndawonye efulethini; ngazala lapho ikhona.
Watsi: "Kunelilanga lesithathu ngemuva kwekuzalwa komntwana wami, lowesifazane wazala naye umntwana. Sibe singesinye; kwakungakho namunye endlu ngaphandle kwethu simbili.
Lomuntfu walowo dzimate wafa ngebusuku, ngobe wajika waya phezu kwakhe.
Yaphuma ngebusuku, yakhipha umntwana wami embhedeni wami, ngobe ngibe sengifile, ngaye wabeka emlenzeni wakhe, wabeka nomntwana wayo lofile emlenzeni wami.
Ngekuvuka kwami ngasebusuku kutsi ngitfume unyana wami, ngobe wafile; kodvwa lapho ngiwubuka khona ngekukhanya kwelilanga, ngobe angeke abe ngumntwana labemidzala.'

Lowesifazane lomunye watsi: "Akekho, kepha lowo ophilayo unyana wami, futhi lowo ofile unyana wakho." Lowesifazane wekucala watsi: "Akekho, kodwa lowo ofile unyana wakho, futhi lowo ophilayo unyana wami." Bakhuluma njalo phambi kwenkhosi.
Watsi ukumkani: "Lomunye wenu uthi, 'Lena ngumntwana wami lophilayo, kodwa umntwana wakho ufile.' Lomunye wenu uthi, 'Akunjalo, kepha umntwana wakho ufile, nami ngiphila.'"
Unkhosi yatsi: "Ninikele ngesandla." Bafike banikela ngesandla kunkhosi.
Unkhosi yatsi: "Cinga lomuntfu lophilayo emaviki lasitfupha, niwunike ingxenye yakhe kumnye, nengxenye yakhe kumnye."

Watsi umfazi lophilayo, lapho ebona khona kutsi umntwana wakhe uyaphilile, watsi kunkhosi: "Ngikucela, Nkulunkulu wami! Nceda usinike lowo mncane ophilayo; ungawubulala." Lowesifazane waphendvula watsi: "Angeke abe nami noma ube wena. Uyawudlwengula!"
Watsi ukumkani, watsi: "Ninise lowesifazane lowo lophilayo; ngobe yena ngumama wakhe, ningawubulala."
Labo bonkhe baseSirayeli bakhuluma ngaleso sinqumo senkhosi, bamhlonipha kakhulu; ngobe babebona kutsi Nkulunkulu wabanika ubuhlakani bokwenza lomtsetfo.
Lonkhosi Solomoni yaphindze yaba nguMbuso waseSirayeli.
Nalaba baholi bakhe: Azariya, umsa waTsadoko, waba ngumnikelo wesono.
Elihorefi na-Ahiya, bantfu labancane ba-Shisha, babebabhali benkhosi; neJosaphatsi, Nkulunkulu wema-Ahilodi, waba ngumbhali.
Benaya, umsa wa-Jehoyada, waba nguMengameli wesive; Sadoki naAbhiyathari babe baLevi.
Azariya, umsa waNathani, waba nguMengameli wemadolobha; neZabudi, umsa waNathani, waba ngumkhonzi, waba ngummeli wenkhosi.
Akhisari waba ngumphathi wendlu yasebukhosini, naAdoniram, umsa wa-Abda, waba nguMengameli webantfu labasebentisa.
USolomoni waba nebantfu labalishumi elinambili labalawula ema-Israyeli, labaphazamisa uMbuso kanye nendlu yakhe; lomunye walabaphazamisa ngenyanga yemnyaka.
Lemi magama abo: u-Ben-Huri, emhlabatsini waEfraim.
Ben-Dekeri, eMakazini, neShaalbim, neBet-shemeshi, naElon, neBet-hanani.
u-Benheshedi, e-Arubhothi; neSokho, nayo yonke ilizwe le-Hefer, yayiyawuye.
u-Abinadabi, umsa wa-Abhina揚i, waba ngaso sonke sikhulu seDori; yena wayeyinkosikazi kaTafati, intombi kaSolomoni.
Baana, umsa wa-Ahilodi, waba neTaanakhi naMegido, nayo yonke iBet-shean, ecaleni kweSarethani, ngaphansi kwaJezreyeli, kusukela eBet-sheani kuya eAbel-mehola, kuze kudlula eJokmeam.

u-Benhabhere, eRamoti-gileyadi; waba nemadolobhana kaYahiri, umsa waManase, akhona eGileyadi, kanye nesifunda saseArgobi, esiseBashani, namadolobha ayo amakhulu lamashumi lamane, anetingetelo, nezingcezu zesiliva emasango awo.
Ahinadab, umsa wa-Iddo, eMahanayim.
Ahimaazi, eNaphtali; yena washada neBasemati, intondza kaSolomoni.
Baana, umsa waHusai, eAsere neBealothi.
Jehoshafati, umsa waParuahi, e-Issakhareni.
Shimeyi, umsa waEla, eBenjamini.
Geberi, umsa wa-Uri, eGileyadi, ezweni lelinguSihoni, ukumkani wema-Amori, neOgi, ukumkani weBashani; waba nguMengameli wemhlaba wonke.
BaJuda neSirayeli bebengaba makhulu kakhulu, njengobe lilanga leliselwandle likhulu; badla, baphuza, baphumula.
USolomoni waba ngunkhosi yato tonkhe tive, kusuka eMfula i-Euphrates kuya ezweni laFilisti, kuze kufike emgwaqeni waseMijiphu; banikela ngemnikelo waso, babe ngumkhonzi wakhe yonke imihla yakhe.
Lokudla kwendlu kaSolomoni lilanga ngalinye kwakungu-kore lamashumi lamakhulu mahlanu esiliva nelibomvu, na-kore lamashumi lasikhombisa egolide lelibovu,
tingulube letilishumi letimisiwe, tingulube temhlabatsini letimashumi lamabili nesihlanu, nemfuyo lemikhulu lamakhulu lasitfupha, kanye nenyama yesihlalo, negazilele, nemvu, nenyama yenkukhu.
Waba ngunkhosi yato tonkhe tive letisentshonalanga yeMfula i-Ephrathi, kusuka eTiphashi kuya eGaza, naletinye tive letisentshonalanga yeMfula i-Ephrathi; waba nekuthula ngaso sonke sikhatsi.

BaJuda nalabaSirayeli bahlala bephephile, kusukela eDani kuya eBheer-sheba, bonke bantfu, lomndeni ngamunye ngaphansi kwesihlahla sewayini sakhe kanye nesihlahla sesifonyo sakhe, sonke isikhathi saSolomoni.
USolomoni wayenemahhashi lamashumi lamane lamakhulu emoto yakhe, nemahhashi lalishumi elinambili lamakhulu.
Labaphathi baleyo ndawo babenikela ngekudla kunkhosi Solomone, nakubo bonke labadla embhedeni wakhe; lomunye wabanika ngenyanga yakhe, ngobe bengeke kube nento lengekho.
Baphindze banikela ngeju kanye nengwevu emabhubesi emoto kanye namabhubesi ahamba ngesivinini, kuwo wonke lamadolobha, ngaso sonke sikhatsi.
Simakadze wanikela kuSolomoni ngenhlonipho, nekuqonda lokukhulu kakhulu, namandla engqondo afana nemanti aselwandle.
Kube khona ubuhlakani bukaSolomoni, bukhulu kunebuhlakani bawo onkhe emadolobha aseMpumalanga, kanye nebuhlakani bakhe bonke baseMisri.
Wabe umkhulu kunabo bonke labema-Israyeli, naphezu kweEthani lo-Ezrahi, naphezu kwaHeman, naphezu kwaKalkoli, naphezu kwaDarda, bantfu baseMaholi; wabeka igama lakhe emazweni onke angaphandle.
Wakhuluma imvumo lemibili, wabhala emacwecwe lamakhulu lamabili nesihlanu.
Wakhuluma ngemithi, kusukela ngesidlovu esikhulu esiseLibanoni, kuze kube yi-ysop ekhulayo emgwaqeni; wakhuluma nenyama lephilayo, nezinyoni, nezinto letihamba phansi, nasenhlanzini.
Kusuka kuwo wonke lamazwe kwafika labo bafuna ukulalela ubucwebe bukaSolomoni, kusuka kubo bonkhe bantfu bemhlaba, labakhuluma ngebucwebe bakhe.

Hiram, ukumkani waseTire, wabathumela labakhonzi bakhe kuSolomoni. (Huram, umkwetsi weTyre, ubeyawuthanda Davide iminyaka leminingi; kodvwa lapho ekubona kutsi uSolomone washiswa abe ngunkhosi endaweni yobaba wakhe, wehla waya kuye.)
USolomoni watsi ku-Hiramu:

"Uyazi kutsi uDavide, lobaba wami, akazange akwazi ukwenza indlu ngegama laSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wakhe, ngobe abe nemibhikisho nalabo ababemcophelela ngaso sonke isikhathi, kuze kube Simakadze wababeka ngaphansi kwenyawo lakhe.
Ngako-ke Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wami, ungivumele ngikhululeke ngaso sonke simo; angeke kube khona umfowabo, noma yini lebuhlungu.

"Namuhla ngicabanga ukwakha indlu ngegama laSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wami, njengobe Simakadze abekhuluma kuDavide, umsa wami, watsi: 'Unyana wakho, longeke ngiwubeke ebukhosini bakho endaweni yakho, yena uyawukwakha indlu ngegama lami.'

Namuhla uvumele kutsi kube nemithi yesidvondza eLibanoni, ibe yinikwe mina; nalabo labasebenza nami bangaba kanye nalabo labasebenza nawe. Nami ngitawunikela kulabo labasebenzela wena ngaso sonke sibalo lesitsiwe nguSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, ngobe uyazi kutsi asikho sabantu bami lasengcolisa njengelabaSidoni.
UHiramu, lapho akubona khona amazwi kaSolomoni, wakhululeka kakhulu, watsi: "Buyiselani namuhla uSimakadze, lowo wabanika uDavide umntwana onengqondo phezu kwaloluhlanga olukhulu.
Hiramu waphendula watsi kuSolomoni: "Ngifike ngakhuluma nawe; ngiyakwenza konkhe lokudingako mayelana nesihlahla sesedvondza kanye nesihlahla se-cypress.

Labasebenzi bami bangawakhuphula kusuka eLibanoni kuya emfuleni, ngiyawuwabeka emigodini ngelwandle kuze kube yilapho ukhetha khona; khona ngitawuwahlukanisa, wena utawuwakhipha. Nakho-ke wena utawunginikela ngekudla lomunye wemindeni yami."
Hiramu watsi kuSolomoni: "Uyawunikela ngetinkhuni tesedari netinkhuni te-cypress, njengobe utawufuna."

USolomoni wanikela kuHiramu ngekudla kwendlu yakhe, ngetinkomishi letilishumi nambili lamakhulu lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu sengulube, netinkomishi tamakhulu lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu sephethroli; njalo-ke uSolomoni wabanika uHiramu iminyaka yonke.
Simakadze wabanika uSolomoni ubuhlakani, njengobe abemwisile; kwaba nekuthula phakathi kwaHiram naSolomoni, babuye babe nemhlangano.
UMbuso waseSolomoni wakhipha ema-Israeli lamakhulu lamashumi lasitfupha ezigidi kutsi asebenze kuye.
Wabathumela eLibanoni, emaphesenti lamashumi lamabili ngemnyaka lomunye; behlala inyanga eyodwa eLibanoni, nenyanga lemibili ekhaya labo. Adoniram wabekwa phezu kwalabo labasebenzela.
USolomoni waba nemakhulu lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu ema-Israyeli abebahambisa impahla, namakhulu lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu lama-Israyeli abebebhaka-bhaka emfuleni.
Naphezu kwalaba, kwaba nebaholi bemsebenzi, labamakhulu mathathu, lamashumi lamane, labalawula labo abasebenza kuwo.
Batsi: "Kulendlu yaSimakadze, sitawukhipha ematshe lamakhulu kanye nemacwecwe egolide, nesiliva, negolide lelihlanganisiwe.
Labaholi bendlu yaSolomoni, nebaholi bendlu yaHiramu, nalabo baseGibaleni, bacwebezela, balungiselela isihlahla kanye nematshe ekwakha indlu.

USolomoni waqala ukwakha indlu yaSimakadze eminyakeni emakhulu lamane, lamashumi lasikhombisa, ngemuva kokuphuma kwabaSirayeli emazweni aseMijiphu, ngonyaka wesine wekubusa kwakhe phezu kwaSirayeli, kumnyaka waZivu, lomnyaka wesibili.
Lendlu lenkhosi Solomone yayikwakha kuSimakadze, yayimamitha lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa ebude, namamitha lamashumi lasitfupha nesihlanu ebubanzi, namamitha lamashumi lasitfupha nesihlanu ebude.
Nalendlu yangaphambili yesakhiwo, imamitha lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa ububanzi bayo, ngaleyo ndlela lendlu nayo ibe bubanzi bawo; yafika kumamitha lamashumi lamabili namakhulu lasitfupha.
Wakwenza emafasitela ethempelini, angeke avuleke, abe nemiganga.
Ngetindonga tangaphandle tendlu enkulu kanye negumbi lengaphakathi, wasungula isakhiwo semfuleni wendzawo yekugcina impahla.

Naye wakhipha isandla sakhe, watsi: "Lasephansi libanga lamamitha-skwele ayisishiyagalolunye ububanzi, lephakathi libanga lamakhulu lamabili nemashumi amathathu bubanzi, naleso sesithathu libanga lalishumi elinesihlanu bubanzi."

Ematshe asetshenziswa ekubumbeni kwethempeli lacutshungulwa kanye nekugcwaliswa emadolobheni, ngakho-ke angeke kube khona umkhonto, isandla, noma linye lithuluzi lelibomvu lelihlanganiswe netempele lapho likhiwa khona.
Emnyango wegumbi leliseceleni kwalelindlu yakubo ecaleni lasenyakatho-ntshonalanga lendlu, nalapho kwafika khona umkhumbi losuka lapho wafika efulethini leliphakathi, lafika efulethini lesithathu.
USolomoni wehla indlu, watsi uyiphelele; wayenza ngetinsindza tesedari netibombo tasedari.
Wakwakha emagumbi lamacala eduze kwendlu, ngaso sonke isikhathi; ngaso sonke sibhedlela kwakunguma-digri lasitfupha lokuphakama kwayo; wahlanganisa naleyo indlu ngemiganga yesedari.
Lamazwi laSimakadze afike kuSolomoni, watsi:
Lendlu lewuyawuyikwakha, uma uhamba ngemiyalo yami, uyenzile mtsetfo wami, ugcine lamandla ami onke, ngitawukwenza kuwe konke lokudlalela Davide, ubaba wakho.
Nami ngiyawuhlala phakathi kwalabaSirayeli, kodvwa ngiyoshiya bantfu bami labaSirayeli.
USolomoni wasungula indlu, watsi uyiphele.
Wabeka emafasitela langaphakathi ngetibhodi tesedari, kusuka emhlabatsini kuya emgangathweni; wabeka tibhodi te-cypress phezu kwemhlabatsi.
Wakha nendlu yaseceleni kwethempelini, yakhiwa ngetinyawo letimashumi lamane, ngamatfuba esidvondza, kusukela emhlabatsini kuya emgodini; lendlu yangaphakathi, ingcwele kakhulu.
Lendlu lemkhulu ecaleni kwegumbi lasemceleni bekungukwemamitha lama-40 ngebude.
Lendlu yakhiwa ngesedari ngasenshonalanga, nesedari ngasenyakatho, nesedari ngasenyakatho-ntshonalanga, nesedari ngasenyakatho-mpumalanga.
Walungiselela nendlu yangaphakathi yethempelini, kutsi揚e ibhokisi lesivumelwane saSimakadze.

Lendlu yangaphakathi yayimamitha lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu ubude, namamitha lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu ububanzi, namamitha lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu ubude; wayibopha ngegolide lelihle. Wayibopha ne altar yesedari.
USolomoni wabeka phansi indlu ngegolide elifihlekile, wafaka emakhonsathi egolide phambi kwendlu yangaphakathi, wabeka phansi ngegolide.
Wabeka negolide kuwo wonke lomnyango wendlu yaSimakadze, wabeka negolide kuwo onkhe emacala endlu, kuze kuphele. Wabeka negolide nasenhliziyweni yendlu yasebukhosini.
Wakwenza emaphiko lambili endlu yangaphakathi yesihlahla se-olive; ubude besinye salelo sihlahla bekungama-cubit lalishumi.
Isibhakabhaka salowo lophilayo ngasinye bekungama-degree lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu; kusukela ekugcineni kwesibhakabhaka esisodwa kuya kwekuphelela kwalo sibhakabhaka, kwakungu-degree lama-10.
Nalenyama yesibili, nayo yalinganiselwa ibe nguma-kubitji lalishumi; lembili zato zazifana ngebukhulu nebuhlobo.
Lomhlabatsi lomncane wemuntfu lophilayo wawunemilebe lelishumi.

Wabeka lezinto eziphilako ngaphakathi kwendlu, wamisa imilenze yawo evulekile; imilenze yesinye sazo yafika emgwaqeni lomunye, nemilenze yesinye sazo yafike emgwaqweni owodwa, naleyo yemilenze yabo yafinyelela embindini wendlu.
Wabeka emaphiko abo ngegolide.
Nasekufuleni lokugcwele ethempelini, kanye netingcezu letingaphakathi naletingaphandle, wakha imihlobiso yetinyama letinamaphiko, netinhlamvu tesihlahla sepali, netikhanga.
Wabeka negolide emhlabatsini lwetindlu, kanye nemhlabatsini lwetindlu lezingaseceleni.
Waya emasango egumbini leliseceleni, wakwenza emasango esihlahla se-olive; umbhoshongo wakhe kanye nemilenze yakhe yayimihlanu.
Wakha emasango lalawo emapulangwe lamakhulu lasitfupha, wabeka emaphiko, netintaba-mlilo, natimbali letivulekile; wababeka ngegolide, wamisa igolide phezu kwemaphiko netintaba-mlilo.
Wakha nemiganga yemnyango wendlu yasebukhosini, wayenza ngetihlahla tesihlahla se-olive; yabeka emaphiko lamane.
Wayenza iminyango lemibili yesihlahla se-cypress; ngayinye yaleyo minyango yayineminyango lemibili.
Wakha khona emaphiko, nemithi yetimbali, netikhongo letivuliwe; wabeka igolide kuwo wonke lamakhilogremu.
Wakwakha nendzawo yekungenela yangaphakathi ngemijovo lemithathu yematshe acwecwe, nemijovo lemihlanu yetigcawu tesedlovu.
Lesisekelo sethempelini laSimakadze safakwa ngonyaka wesihlanu, kumnyaka wa-Zivu.
Lendlu yaphela ngonyaka weshumi nalinye, kumnyaka waBulu, lowo ngumnyaka wesikhombisa; yonke impahla yayo yaphelela ngaleyo ndlela. USolomoni waba neminyaka lelishumi elinesihlanu ekwakha indlu.
NaSolomoni wabambisa indlu yakhe; wahlala iminyaka lelishumi nesihlanu, watsi uyiphele.

Wakwakha indlu yesihlahla se-Lebanoni, imamitha lamakhulu lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu ubude, namamitha lamashumi lasitfupha nesihlanu ububanzi, namamitha lamashumi lamane nesikhombisa ubude; yakhiwa ngemijovo lemine yesedari, ibe nemijovo yesedari ekhonjiswe emijovo.
Lendlu yakhiwa ngesedari, ibekwe phezu kwemiganga lemine nemashumi lamane namakhulu mahlanu emilenze, imiganga lelishumi lelinesihlanu ngayinye.
Kube netingcweti tefenisha emgwaqeni wesithathu, netingcweti letibhekene linye ngalinye, ngayinye ibekwe esigabeni lesithathu.
Lamandla emnyango kanye nemilenze yawo yayimiganga yesikwere, natiphaneli tibhekene linye nelinye, ngayinye ibekwe emgwaqeni.
Wakwenza nendlu yetimbhoshongo, imilenze lengema-50 ubude bayo, nemilenze emashumi lamane bubanzi bawo; kwabe khona nendawo yekuphumula phambi kwayo kanye nembhoshongo wayo.
Wakwakha nendlu yebukhosi, kanye nendlu yemtsetfo, lapho aphindze abe ngummeli webantfu khona; wayihlobisa ngesedari kusuka emhlabatsini kuya entanyeni.
Nasendlu yaSolomoni, lapho ahlala khona, wayenza ngendlela lenjalo, ngasemgwaqeni lomunye, ngemuva kwendlu yenkhosi; wayenza nendlu yenkosikazi ka-Farao, lowesifazane wakhe, efana nalendlu.
Letindlu zonke latingcwatshwe ngemihlaba yegolide, ticutshungulwe ngaseceleni nasenshonalanga, kusuka esisekelo kuze kube phezulu, kanye nengaphandle kuze kufike emgwaqeni lomkhulu.
Lesisekelo sakhiwa ngetikhontsi letikhulu, tentengo lephakeme, tikhontsi letilishumi kanye netikhontsi tasikhombisa.
Ngato kwabekwa emacwecwe esiliva negolide, acwecwe ngebukhulu bawo, kanye netingcezu tesedari.
Nalesitezi lesikhulu sakhiwa ngemijovo lemibili yesiliva, neyegolide, neyegolide, neyegolide, neyegolide, neyegolide, neyegolide, neyegolide, neyegolide, neyegolide.
UMbuso WaseSolomoni wathumela waya ku-Hiram, wamkhipha eTyre.

Ubaba ka-Hiram waba nguwesifazane waseNaphtali, ubaba wakhe waba ngumTyri, wasebenza ngesiliva; naye-ke u-Hiram ubegcwele ubuhlakani, nekuqonda, nekhono lokwenza nhlobo yemisebenzi yegolide. Wafika ekungeneni kwaSolomoni, wayenza yonke lemisebenzi yakhe.
Wayenza imilenze lemibili yesiliva, yinye揚ti lengema-18, nelinye lingama-12.
Wakwenza netibopho letimbili tesiliva lelibomvu, kutsi atibeke phezulu kwetinhloko; bude besibopho ngasinye kwakungukuba ngudvondza lamabili.
Inhloko leyinye nenhloko yelinye yabe inetji, ibe nemhlobiso wetintambo letiboshwako; kwakungumashumi lasikhombisa enhloko leyinye nenhloko yelinye.
Wakwenza izingcezu letintsatfu tegranate letingwevu, ngaso sonke sitfubi, kutsi tibekwe phezu kwetinhloko; njalo-ke wakwenza ngetinhlavu letimbili.
Letinhloko temihlobiso emnyango wangaphambili zakhiwa njengelilili, lamamitha lasitfupha lobude.
Ngetinhloko temisonto lemibili, ngase-ke, kwabekhona ema-granates lamakhulu mahlanu, etigcongweni letibunjiwe likhulu.
Wabeka tikhontsi emnyango wendlu yaSimakadze, watsi: "Letikhontsi letisenyakatho-ntshonalanga wazisa kutsi yiJakin; neletikhontsi letisenyakatho-mpumalanga wazisa kutsi yiBohazi."
Lamandla emilenze layawufana nebuciko belili; kanye naleyo misebenzi yemilenze yaphela.
Wakwenza nengilazi yesiliva lelibomvu, ilikhulu elinama-decimitha lamashumi lamabili kuya kwamakhulu mahlanu; wayenza ngegolide elingenalutho.
Ngaseceleni kwalo, ngaso sonke simo, kwabe khona izingcezu letimbili tetikhilomitha letilishumi; latingcezu talelo lwandle latingconywako.

Lolwandle lwabe lubekwe ngetingulube tesiliva lelishumi nembili, letithathu tibheke ngasenyakatho, netitsatfu tibheke entshonalanga, netithathu tibheke emgwaqeni, netisikhombisa tibheke emaphandleni. Lolwandle lwabe lubekwe phezu kwato, kanye namacala lazo asentshonalanga.
Isibhakabhaka sayo sifike kubukhulu besandla esisodwa, nemilenze yaso ifana nemilenze yegobolondo, ibe njengenhlonipho yelili; yafaka ema-bathoni lamakhulu mahlanu.
Wakwenza netibondza letilishumi tesiliva, lokubude belinye likhulu elinamashumi lamane, bubanzi bayo libe likhulu lelinemakhulu mahlanu, bese kuphakama kwelinye lihleli e nalesihlanu.
Lemiganga yakhiwa ngalendlela lelandelayo: yayinemiganga yesobunxele ekhonjiswe emabhokisi.
Nalemihlobiso lemincane yakhiwa ngegolide, nesiliva, negolide, negolide, negolide, negolide, negolide, negolide, negolide, negolide.
Nalendawo yaso iphindze ibe netigcawu tesiliva letine, namatigodzi esiliva lamane; kuleyo ndawo yesihlanu kwabekhona tikhonjiwe tesiliva letine, kanye netikhonjiwe tegolide.

Ngemuva kwetinyawo kwabekhona umjovo loyindilinga, wamamitha lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu ngebubanzi bakhe; kanye nalapho kubekwe khona tikhonkolo letincane. 11Ekungeneni kwalo mjovo kwakunebhokisi lelinemikhono emibili yegolide.
Lamagalelo lamane abe ngaphansi kwemigodlo, namatindlela lamagalelo afike kuleso sitsi; ngayinye yaleyo migodlo ibe likhulu elinamashumi lamabili nesihlanu lemile.
Lemijikelo yakhiwa njengemijikelo yemoto; imijovo yayo, nemilenze yayo, namatindlela ayo, namahhashi alo, laphindze afakwe ngegolide.
Lomhlabatsi ngalunye lalinemikhono lemine, lomunye ekhoneni ngalinye, wakhiwa ngesandla esisodwa.
Ngaphesheya kweso sikhala sawo, kwabe khona intambo leyindilinga ephakeme ngema-kubit lasitfupha. Tikhonto kanye netinhlamvu ngaphesheya kweso sikhala sawo zakhiwa ngetikhonto.
Describiendo los lo que dijeron de su vida y de sus obras, con una de las más agradables de las que han leído impunes.
Ngalendlela lenjalo wazenza tinyawo letilishumi; zonke zakhiwa ngelinye licwecwe, nesinye sibalo, nesinye sakhiwo.
Wakwenza namatikisi lalishumi esiliva; tibati lama-40 tafakwa ematikisini ngalinye, nebubanzi bawo bube ngutinyawo letintsatfu. Tikitisheni letimashumi lamabili kwakungumatikisi asitfupha ngayinye.
Wabeka tigodzi letisihlanu ecaleni lesempumalanga lendlu, naletisihlanu ecaleni lesempumalanga lendlu; wabeka nelwandle ecaleni lesempumalanga lendlu, eningizimu-ntshonalanga.
UHiramu wakwenza nemibhede, netimbhoshongo, netibondza; watsi uHiramu aphelile yonke misebenzi yakhe loyawuyenza kubukhosi beSolomoni endlwini yaSimakadze:
tinhloko letintsatfu, netinhlavu letimbili tetinhloko, netingcweti letingaba ngema-nets latigcobisako tinhlavu letimbili tetinhloko;
nama-granates angaba ngumakhulu lamane, abekwe emabhokisini lamabini emesh; izingcezu ezimbili zama-granates ngayinye ifakwe kumaboxi mabili emesh.
netibondza letilishumi, namatiko lamashumi lamabili abekwe etibondzani;
kanye nelwandle, nalabo timbuti letilishumi lelikhulu ngaphansi kwalo;
kanye nemabhodlela, nama-oveni, namabhaka; zonke lezi zinto azenzayo uHiramu kuSolomoni ukumkani endlwini yaSimakadze, zazingwe ngesiliva lelihlanganiswe.
UMbuso wase-Asiriya wabeka emacwecwe emhlabatsini, ensimini yeJordane, phakathi kweSukhothi neSaretani.
Solomoni akazange alinganisele nalinye lalawo macwecwe, ngobe abemakhulu kakhulu; bunzima besiliva negolide akufanele kucace.
USolomoni wakwenza naletinye tive letibe endlwini yaSimakadze: i-altari yegolide, netafula legolide, lapho kubekwe khona emacwecwe emnikelo wesono phambi kwaNkulunkulu;
namatishi lamandla egolide aphelele, mahlanu ngasenyakatho, namasihlanu ngasentshonalanga, phambi kwendlu yangaphakathi; nemihlobiso yegolide, namatishi lamandla egolide, namatishi lamandla egolide.

kanye netinkomishi tegolide lelihle, netingcindezi, netimbhoshongo, netimgodzi, netibondza; kanye nemingcele yegolide yemivalo yendlu yangaphakathi, leyingcwele kakhulu, nemingcele yendlu yasethempelini.

Waphela ke lomsebenzi wonke lowo uSolomoni wabawenza endlwini yaSimakadze, wabeka kuwo lezinto labezinikela ngazo uDavide, ubaba wakhe, isiliva negolide naleyo mibhoshongo, waya kuzibeka emakhazeni ethempelini laNkulunkulu.

USolomoni, ukumkani, wahlangana nabaholi beSirayeli eJerusalema, nabo bonke bomkhuluwa bamakhosi, nebaholi bezindlu zababa baseSirayeli, ukuba akhuphule ibhokisi lesivumelwane saSimakadze kusuka eZiyone, emzini kaDavide.
Bahlangana bonke lamadoda aseSirayeli ekungeneni kwaSolomoni emthendelekweni lomnyaka wa-Ethanimi, lowo ngumnyaka wesihlanu.
Bafike bonkhe bantfu labakhulu ba-Israyeli, batsi: "Siyawufaka ibhokisi."
Bafaka phansi ibhokisi laSimakadze, netenti lekuhlangana, nezinto zonke letingcwele labezikhona etenteni; labaLevi nalabaLevi bazisa.
Unkhosi Solomonu nebantfu bonkhe baseSirayeli labahlangana naye, babe phambi kwebhokisi, benikela ngenkomo nengulube, kutsi kungeke kube khona lokwenta noma ukubalwa, ngenxa yenani labo.
Bafike bafaka ibhokisi lesivumelwane saSimakadze emnyango wendlu yaNkulunkulu, lapho lingcwele kakhulu khona, bayibeka ngaphansi kwemilenze yalenyama lephilayo.
Batsi labaphilayo baphindze bafaka imilenze yabo phezu kwendawo lapho ibhokisi lakuboniswa khona, nemilenze yabo yavala ibhokisi kanye nemacwecwe ayo ngaseceleni.
Lemikhono yaba likhulu kakhulu, ngobe imilenze yayo yabonakala emnyango wendlu yasebukhosini, kepha ngasenkundleni yangaphandle akayibona; yahlala khona kuze kube manje.

Kubekho lutho ebhokisini, ngaphandle kwetibopho ezimbili zesiliva lelive, labewazibeka khona uMosi emfuleni iHoreb, lapho Simakadze abengenelela khona lamadvodza aseSirayeli, lapho aphuma khona eMijiphu.
Baphuma emabhishobhi ethempelini langcwele, bese lilanga ligcwele indlu yaSimakadze.
Bekungaba khona kutsi labaLevi bahlale besebenza, ngenxa yemvula; ngobe kuthula kweSimakadze kwakugcwele indlu yakhe.
USolomoni watsi: "Simakadze ukhuluma kutsi uzohlala emhlabatsini lomnyama.
Ngikubuyele ngekwakha indlu lekahle kuwe, indawo lapho ungahlala khona kuze kube sekupheleni.
Unkhosi yajika ibuso bayo, yabambisa lonke libandla leLisrayeli, laba bebengasekhona.
Watsi: "Kunekuthula kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, lowo lakhuluma ngendlebe yakhe kuDavide, umsa wami, wakwenza ngesandla sakhe, watsi:

Ngaleso sikhathi lapho ngakhipha khona bantfu bami baseSirayeli eMfuleni i-Egipta, angizange ngikhethe dolobha kuloluhlanga lwesive seSirayeli kutsi libuye libe yindlu yegama lami, kodvwa ngakhetha Davide ukuba abe nguMengameli webantfu bami baseSirayeli.
UDavide, ubaba wami, wabeka engqondweni yakhe yonke kutsi abe nendlu ngegama laSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli.
kodvwa Simakadze watsi kuDavide, ubaba wami: Ube nenhliziyo yakho yonke ekwenzeni indlu ngegama lami; wakwenza kahle lapho ube nalomoya wakho.
kodvwa wena ungeke ube nguwo loyawukwakha indlu, kepha umntwana wakho, lowo uyakwakha indlu ngegama lami.

"Simakadze ugcine amazwi akhe, abekhuluma ngawo; ngobe ngisemile endaweni kaDavide, umsa wami, ngahlala esihlalweni sebukhosi sakwaSirayeli, njengobe Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli washo. Nami sengisungule indlu ngegama laNkulunkulu waseSirayeli.
Nami sengilungiselele khona indawo yesakhamuzi, lapho kubekwe khona umhlangano waSimakadze, lowawuye wabambisana nawo lababa bethu, lapho abewakhipha ezweni leMijiphu.
USolomoni wahlala phambi kwe altare yaSimakadze, ebhekene nabo bonkhe bantfu beSirayeli, wehlisa isandla sakhe emazulu,

watsi: "Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, akukho nguNkulunkulu lofana nawe, entabeni yasezulu noma phansi emhlaba; wena lowo ugcina inhlanganiso nothando kubo bonkhe labakhonta kuwe ngenhliziyo yabo yonke.
Lowugcinele umkhonzi wakho, uDavide, umsa wami, lokusho kwakhe ngendlebe yakho; nawe wakwenza ngesandla sakho, njengobe kubonisiwe ngalolusuku.

Namuhla, Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, gcina kulowo mkhonzi wakho, uDavide, umsa wami, lokuye wakhuluma kuye, watsi: 'Kungeke kube nendodana yakho ehlala phambi kwami ihlala esihlalweni sebukhosi sakwa-Israyeli, uma nje abantwana bakho behlala behamba phambi kwami, njengobe wena ubehamba phambi kwami.'
"Ngaye manje, Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, liqinisekiswe lilanga lakho, lelitselelwe umkhonzi wakho Davide, umsa wami.
Ngabe unguNkulunkulu lohlala emhlabatsini? Lamandla asezulu angeke akubambe, kuphi nalendlu lengisayikwakha?
Kulelinye icala, Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wami, lalela umthandazo womkhonzi wakho kanye nemthandazo yakhe, ulalele lokushayela kanye nomthandazo lomkhonzi wakho ewuthandaza kuwe namuhla.
Lamehlo akho ahlale ebheke lendlu, busuku nebusuku, lapho utsi khona: 'Ligama lami liyawuhlala khona.' Ulalele lomthandazo lomkhonzi wakho abewuthandaza kulona mhlaba.
Hlala ulalele imithandazo yomkhonzi wakho, neyebantfu bakho baseSirayeli, lapho bethandaza lapha ezweni lenu; lalela emazulu, emgwaqeni wakho wokuhlala, lalela, uyenge.
Uma umuntu ephikisane nomunye wakhe, bese kubekwa kuye umkhosi kutsi aphike, aze afike aphike phambi kwendlu yakho yasebukhosini,
bese ukhuluma emazulu, uyeke ukwenze, ube ngummeli phakathi kwabakhonzi bakho, unqume lowo muntfu lobi ngecala lakhe, ugweme lowo muntfu ongenacala ngecala lakhe.
Nakuba bantfu bakho, iSirayeli, bahlaselwa ngumoya lomfishane ngenxa yesono sabo sakho, bese bebuyela kuwe, bekhuluma ngegama lakho, bethandaza, becela kulowo ndlu,
uphindze ulalele emazuluni, ukhulule isono sema-Israyeli, ubabuyise babuye kulelizwe labewulike wabanike lababa babo.
Uma izulu licutshungulwa, kungabi nemvula, ngobe babusise kuwe; bese bethandaza kuleyo ndawo, bekubonga igama lakho, bese bebuyela emlonyeni wabo, ngobe utawubaphazamisa;

bese ukhuluma emazulu, ukhulule umonakalo wabakhonzi bakho nalabahlali bakho baseSirayeli, ubafundise indlela ekahle yokuyihamba, uye ugcwalise ngemvula lelizwe labewulile labahlali bakho kutsi babe nelifa lakho.

Uma kunendlala noma umkhuhlane lobulalayo emhlabatsini, noma lapho kushiswa khona mbewu ngesifo noma ngemuthi, tingulube noma tingulube, noma lapho lomshadvo ubhekene nenye yemadolobha abo, noma ngabe yini inhlekelele noma umkhuhlane ufika,
lomunye lomthandazo, noma yini leyawufunwa nguSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, lapho ebona khona ubuhlungu benhliziyo yakhe, bese emisa isandla sakhe lesibheke kulendlu,
bese ukhuluma emazulu, endawo yakho yokuhlala, ube nekuthula, uyeke, uhambe, ugcine lomuntu ngaso sonke simo sakhe, njengoba uwazi intliziyo yakhe; ngobe wena kuphela lowazi intliziyo yabantfu bonke.
kutsi bakubukele wena nsuku zonke lapho behlala khona emhlabatsini welizwe labewunike lababuphikisi bethu.
Ngako-ke nalowo mhlali, longeke abe yibantfu bakho labaseSirayeli, utawufika emhlabatsini lokude, ngenxa yegama lakho.
ngobe bayawuva igama lakho lelikhulu, nesandla sakho esinamandla, nemilenze yakho eyimtfubi, bese befika bethandaza kuleyo indlu,

khuluma ngasezulu, emgwaqeni wakho lohlala kuwo, uyenze yonke imiyalo leyawukucela yona lowo mkhwenyana; ukuze zonke imindeni yemhlaba ibone igama lakho, ibe nekuthula nawe, njengebantfu bakho labaSirayeli; nabo babone ukuthi igama lakho litsiwe kulendlu leyo ngiyibonile.

Uma abantu bakho bephuma emkhosini babhekane nalowo mfishane wabo, lapho utawubathumela khona, bese bethandaza kuSimakadze, bebheke ledolobha labewukhethele wena, nendlu leyo ngiyibulalele igama lakho,
bese ulalela emavi abo kanye netibopho zabo kusuka esibhakabhakeni, ube ngusondza wabo.
Nakuba babusise kuwe, ngobe akukho muntu longeke abusise, wena ufike ungavimbi kubo, wabanikela emkhosini womshayeli wabo, nabo babekwa ejele ezweni lomshayeli babo, libe lide noma libe likhulu;
bese babuyela emphefumulweni wabo ezweni labo lababoshwa kulo, bebuya becela kuwe khona, besithi: Siphelelwe licala, sesivumile, sesivelile;

bese bebuyela kuwe ngenhliziyo yabo yonke nemoya yabo yonke, ezweni lebantfu babo lababathathela emakhaya abo, bathandaza kuSimakadze, bebhekisa ezweni lakho labewanikela kubo-abo babafazi babo, emzini lowo lowazikhethele wona, nasendlwini leyo ngiyibulalele igama lakho,
bese ukhuluma emazulu, emhlabatsini lokuhlala kwakho, mthandazo wabo kanye nemthandazo yabo, ube nelungelo labo.
Lambisa kubo bonkhe bantfu bakho, labaphikisayo kuwe; lisabalalise yonke inkohlakalo yabo yakhona; lambisa labo labababulalayo, babekezele.
Baye babantu bakho, nempahla yakho, labewakhipha e-Egypti, emfudlaneni wensimbi.
Lamehlo akho ahlale evulekile kulowo mkhonzi wakho, nakubo bonkhe bantfu bakho labaseSirayeli, kutsi ubalalele ngaso sonke isikhathi lapho bekhuluma kuwe.

Ngako-ke wena, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, utawubakhipha kuwo wonke lamazwe emhlaba, ube yimpahla yakho, njengobe wakhuluma ngesandla saMosi, umkhonzi wakho, lapho wabakhipha khona bababa bethu emaGibhithe, Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu.

Watsi lapho uSolomoni ephelele khona lokuthandaza, naleso siphakamiso sakhe kuSimakadze, wahlala phambi kwesihlalo sobukhosi saNkulunkulu, lapho angeke abeke khona imilenze yakhe emlonyeni wakhe, nemilenze yakhe ephindwe ngaphesheya.
Wahlala khona, wabambisana nebantfu labanyenti baseSirayeli, watsi ngelizwi elikhulu:

"Kubhekiwe uSimakadze, lowo wanikela ngesikhashana ngekuthula kubo bonkhe bantfu bakhe baseSirayeli, njengobe wakhuluma; akukho linye lamazwi akhe alungile, lawo akhulume ngaso Mosi, umkhonzi wakhe, elingenakuphikwa.
Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wethu, abe nathi, njengobe abe nabobaba bethu; angeke atishiye, angeke atiyeke.
Ase abeke inhliziyo yethu kuye, kutsi sihambe ngazo zonke izindlela zakhe, sigcine imiyalo yakhe, nemithetho yakhe, namasiko akhe, abewisela ema-Israyeli.
Lemilomo yami, engicela ngayo kuSimakadze, ihlale eduze kwenguNkulunkulu wethu, ubusuku nebusuku, aze afike kumkhonzi wakhe nakubo bonkhe bantfu bakhe baseSirayeli, ngendlela yemihla ngemihla.
Lakho kuyawucacisa kuwo wonke lamazwe emhlaba, kutsi uSimakadze nguNkulunkulu, angeke kubekhona omunye.
Niye nihlale nilandzela Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, kutsi nihambe ngemtsetfo wakhe, nigcine imiyalo yakhe, njengobe nikwenza namuhla.
Unkhosi, nayo yonke i-Israyeli naye, yanikela ngenhlanhla kuSimakadze.

USolomoni wanikela ngeminikelo yekuthula kuSimakadze, ingulube lamawaka lamashumi lasitfupha nemibili, nemfuyo emawaka lamakhulu lamabili namakhulu mahlanu. Ngako-ke ukumkani kanye nabo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli bamisa indlu yaSimakadze.

Ngolosuku lwentandza lowo, ukumkani wanikela khona ngenhla kwendlu yaSimakadze, engxenyeni yesiphakathi sesitezi; ngobe lapho wanikela khona ngeminikelo yekushiswa, neminikelo yesonka, naleyo yemifino yemincintiswano yekuthula; ngoba i-altari yesiliva leliyobe likhona phambi kwaNkulunkulu yayincane kakhulu, angeke ikwazi kubekwa kuyo.

Baye bahlela losuku lokuphumula ngaleso sikhathi, nabo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli naye; kwafika ibandla elikhulu kakhulu lasuka lapho bedlula khona eHamati emaphandleni asenyakatho kuya emfuleni waseMisri emaceleni asentshonalanga. Balungiselele phambi kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wethu iminyaka lesikhombisa nemashumi lamabili namakhulu mahlanu.

Baye babuyela emakhaya abo, bebulele ukumkani, baphuma becebile, nenhliziyo yabo ikhululeke kakhulu, ngenxa yezinto zonke ezinhle loSimakadze abezenza kuDavide, mkhonzi wakhe, nakubaSirayeli, bantu bakhe.
USolomoni waphela ukwakha indlu yaSimakadze, nendlu yasebukhosini; nalowo wonke umnqweno wakhe waba wukwenza.
Simakadze wabonakala kuSolomoni lilanga lesibili, njengobe wabonakala kuye eGibeboni.

USimakadze watsi kuye: "Ngikulalela umthandazo wakho, kanye nemthandazo wakho lowubeke phambi kwami; ngiyingcwele lendlu labewenzile, kutsi libekwe khona igama lami kuze kube sekupheleni; imehlo ami nenhliziyo yami kumele zihlale khona nsuku zonke.
Nakho-ke wena, uma uhamba phambi kwami, njengobe wahamba Davide, umsa wakho, ngekuthula kwenhliziyo yakho, nekwenza lokulungile, ukwenta konkhe longangikuletsako, ugcine imiyalo yami nemtsetfo wami;
ngitawubeka phansi isithende sakho sokubusa eSirayeli kuze kube sekupheleni, njengobe ngakhuluma kuDavide, ubaba wakho, ngobe ngitsi: Ungeke ube nendodana lehlala esihlalweni sebukhosi saSirayeli.

"Lakho-ke, uma niye nabantwana bakho nibuyela emuva, ningaba ngimi, ningeke nigcine imiyalo yami nemithetho yami engibeka phambi kwenu, kodvwa nihambe nisebenzele bonkulunkulu babanye, nisebunjwe kubo;
ngobe ngitawucindza iSirayeli emhlabatsini labengingawanikela kubo; nendlu lenjalo, lapho ngiyingcwelele khona igama lami, ngiyawuyishiya; ibe ngumbukiso kanye nemfihlakalo phakathi kwebantfu bonke.
Lendlu lenjalo, nakuba inkulu kakhulu, lowo lohamba ngaleyo ndlu ungeke akhululeke, kodvwa utawutsi: 'Ngubani Simakadze lawenza lokhu kulelizwe nalendlu?'

Batawuphendula bati, 'Bayawushiya uSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wabo, lowo wakhipha bantfu bakhe ezweni le-Egypt, baphindze balandzela bokhokho babo, bathandaza kubo, babe nabo; ngakho-ke Simakadze wabaletha kuyo yonke lenkinga.'
USolomoni wahlala iminyaka lengema-20 ekwakha lezindlu ezimbili, indlu yaSimakadze kanye nenkhosikati.
Hiramu, lomkhulu eTyre, wanikela kuSolomoni yonke imithi yesedari, negolide leningi kakhulu. Ngako-ke uMosi Tunta uSolomoni wanikela kuHiramu ngemadolobha lamashumi lamabili emhlaba weGaliliya.
UHiramu waphuma eTire, wababona lamadolobha aSolomoni abeyawumnikela kuye; kodvwa awathandanga.
Watsi: "Ndvuna yami, yini lemidzi lemincane lemitfubi engingayinikela kuwe?"Wathi: "Imhlaba weKabul," lokusho kutsi ulungile kunoma yini, nalapho kuthiwa khona kuze namuhla.
Hiramu wathumela kunkhosi italente lelikhulu nemashumi lamane egolide, kanye nema-shekeli lamakhulu lamabili.
Lokho kungenxa yebantfu labasebentisa uMbuso waseSolomoni, lapho wasungula khona indlu yaSimakadze, nendlu yakhe, neMilo, nesitezi seYerusalem, namadolobha eHazori, neMegido, naGezeri.

Farao, umphathi weMisri, ubesele eGezer, wayawuyihlasela, wayibopha ngemlilo, wabulala nabo bonkhe bantfu baseKanana labahlala khona, wabanika lomhlaba njengendlu yenkosikazi yakhe, indodana yakhe, indodana kaSolomoni.
Wayibuyela kabusha Gezeri, wabuyela kabusha neBethoroni lephansi,
Bhalathi, neThamari, emhlabatsini welizwe lakhe.

Wakwakha naletinye tinhloko-dolobha takubo, nemadolobha emahhashi akhe, nemadolobha lamahhashi akhe, kanye naloluhlobo lwezinto angeke afune ukwakha kuJerusalema, naseLebanoni, nakuleyo mhlaba wonke abewulawula.
Kwatsi kwashiwo kutsi kushiyeke lamakhosikazi e-Amori, ne-Hethi, ne-Perizi, ne-Hivi, na-Jebusi, angeke abe yibantfu bakaSirayeli.
Bebabantfu labase-Asiriya, kanye nalabasemaSirayeli, kanye nalabo baseGibhithe, kanye nalabo base-Amori, kanye nalabo baseGibhithe, kanye nalabo base-Asiriya.

NaseSirayeli, uSolomoni akazange abonise noma ngubani kutsi abe ngumkhonzi wakhe; bebengabe ngubaholi bakhe bokulwa, nabangani bakhe, nabahlengikazi bakhe, nabahlengikazi babo, nabahlengikazi babo, nabahlengikazi babo, nebahlengikazi babo.
Kwabekhona nabaholi bemisebenzi yaSolomoni, lamakhulu mahlanu nemashumi lamabili nesihlanu, labalawula abantu labasebenza kulomsebenzi.
Wakha naMilo, lapho indvodzakati yaFaro yaphuma khona edolobhani laDavide, yafika endlwini yakhe, leyo Solomone abeyibuyele yona.
Nakho uSolomoni wanikela ngemnikelo wekushiswa kanye neminikelo yekuthula emahoreni lasitfupha ngaleso sibhedlela, lapho abewubuyele khona kuSimakadze; watsi: "Namuhla ngikulungiselele indlu yami.
UMbuso WaseSolomoni wakha netinqanawa e-Ezion-Geberi, lapho kune-Elathi, emgwaqeni welwandle lwesiSundu, ezweni leEdomu.
UHiramu wathumela bantfu bakhe, labahamba ngemanti, labawazi lwandle, ukuba basebenze nebantfu bakaSolomoni emasinti.
Bahamba ngelwandle bafika e-Ofiri, batsi: "Sifike sakhipha kuSolomoni italente yegolide lelikhulu nemakhulu lasitfupha namashumi lamabili nesihlanu, kanye nemilenze lemine nesikhombisa.
Lenkhosi yase-Sheba yafika, yakhuluma ngebukhosi beSolomoni, yatsi: "USolomoni ugcwele igama leSimakadze," waphuma waya kutsi amyeketise ngemibuzo leyinzima.

Wafika eJerusalema, naye nabangani bakhe abaningi kakhulu, netingcweti letinesiphunga, negolide elikhulu kakhulu, nesiliva nelitshe; wafika kuSolomoni, wakhuluma naye ngaso sonke leso sakubo emlonyeni wakhe.
uSolomoni wakhuluma ngayo yonke lemibuzo yakhe; akukho lutho lwabe lufihlakele kuSimakadze, ngobe angeke amcacise.
Wayibona inkhosi yase-Sheba yonke imicabango kaSolomoni, nendlu yakhe leyawuyikwakha.

nekudla kwakhe emehlweni akhe, nekuhlala kwabaphathi bakhe, nalabo abasebenza naye ngemigqomo yabo, nalabaphakelayo bakhe, neminikelo yakhe yokushiswa endlwini yaSimakadze, walahlekelwa ngumoya wakhe.
Waye watsi kunkhosi: "Kulungile lokudlalelwa ezweni lami dicituro yakho, kanye nekhono lakho lelihle.

Ngingeke ngiyikholwa lemicabango, kuze ngifike ngiyibone ngemehlo ami; kodvwa ngabona kutsi nephesenti lesincane sezinto asikucacelwanga. Ube ukhulu kunalabo labengingabakhuluma nabo ngenhlonipho yakho nemandla akho.
Kuhle kakhulu kubantfu bakho, nebaholi bakho labo, labahlala bekhona phambi kwakho nsuku zonke, belalela ubuhlakani bakho!

Hamba ubulelele Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, ngobe wakuthanda wena kutsi akubeke ebukhosini beSirayeli. Ngako-ke, njengobe uSimakadze uyawuthanda siSirayeli kuze kube sekupheleni, wakwenza ube ngunkhosi yakho, ukuze wenze lokuhle nelokuhleka.

Wayinikela kunkhosi italente lelikhulu nemashumi lamane egolide, namatilitha lamakhulu lamabili nesihlanu wesiliva, kanye nemakhamuzana amakhulu kakhulu, namatshe abalulekile. Akukho muntfu lofike wakhipha emakhamuzana lamakhulu njengawo abemnike ubukhosi beSolomoni umkhwenyana waseSheba.
Nasensiminini yaHiramu, lesuka eOfiri ifike negolide, yafika nayo eOfiri nesihlahla se-almugi, nesiliva, nesiliva, negolide.

Nalo mhlambi wesihlahla se-almugi, lomkhuluwa wakhe wayawuwusebenzisa ekwenzeni ifenisha yendlu yaSimakadze, nekhaya lenkhosini, nalapho abewenza khona ama-harpa nama-piano lalabo labadlalayo; akazange afike afike abone lesi sihlahla sa-almugi kusukela ngalomnyaka.
UMbuso WaseSolomoni wanikela kunkosikazi yaseSheba ngaso sonke lesifunayo, akazange ayifune, ngaphandle kwaleyo leyawuyinika ubukhosi benkhosi yakhe. Wabuyela ezweni lakhe yena nalabo bakhe.
Lamandla egolide lafika kuSolomoni ngaleso sikhatsi abengamakhuluweryane, namashumi lamabili nesihlanu ematalente.
Lakho kwakungemali yebantfu labahamba ngempahla, nemali yalabo abahamba ngempahla, naleyo yabavela kubo bonkhe bantfu base-Arabha, nalabaphathi belizwe.
Unkhosi Solomonu yakhipha tibhaka-bhaka letikhulu tamakhulu lamane, egolide lelihlanganisiwe; lishekeli lesixhenxe legolide lafakwa kusinye sibhaka-bhaka.
Wakha naletibhaka-bhaka letincane lamakhulu lamabili nemashumi matatu, egolide lelihlanganisiwe liyimine ezintathu ngalinye. UMbuso waseSirayeli wababeka endlini yesihlahla seLibanoni.
UMbuso WaseRoma wahlela nesikhundla esikhulu segolide, wamisa igolide elihle.
Lendlunkulu yalaba nemilenze lemine, inhloko yayo ibe yindilinga; kwabe khona imilenze ngaso sonke simo salapho behlala khona, kanye nalelishona lisecaleni lesinhlelweni.
Kwabe khona tingulube letilishumi nembilithonikondza, tahlala emadolobheni lamane, ngaso sonke siphenyane sendlela.

Nabo bonke bokhokho bakaSolomoni babe yigolide, nalabo bonkhe labapheki bendlu yaseLibanoni babe yigolide elifihliwe; kwakungusiliva kuphela, ngobe isiliva lakuboniswa njengelincane ezikhathini taSolomoni.
Unkhosi yabe nayo imikhumbi elwandle, kanye nemikhumbi kaHiramu; ngamnyaka munye wafika umkhumbi wegolide, nesilivere, nenkomo, nemaphiko, nama-pawoti.
UMbuso WaseSolomoni waba mkhulu kuna očini, nasenhlo scenario, kunabo bonke bobukhosi basemhlaba.
Lonke mhlaba wawufuna ubuso bukaSolomoni, kutsi alalele ubucwebe bakhe, loNkulunkulu abewubeka emphefumulweni wakhe.
Nawo wonke lafika, iminyaka ngeminyaka, wanikela ngensipho yakhe: impahla yesiliva, negolide, nemigqomo, nemfuyo, nemithi leyimfishane, nemahhashi, nemamule.
Solomoni wahlanganisa ema-carriages nemahhashi, abenama-carriages lamakhulu mahlanu, nama-horsemen lamakhulu lamabili nasitfupha; wababeka emizini yema-carriages, naye eJerusalema.
Unkhosi wayibeka igolide nesiliva eJerusalema njengetitshe, nesedari ibe njengemihlambi yetingcotshelo letihlala emaphandleni.
Baphuma e-Ejipt banikela ngemahhashi kuSolomoni; labapheki bebukhosi babethenga emakhowe, ngamanani alinganiselwe.
Baphuma eMijiphu, bathengisa imoto yekulwa ngeshekeli lesihlanu sesiliva, nengulube ngeshekeli lelikhulu namashumi mahlanu; nabo bonke bobukhosi be-Heti, kanye naboMbuso waseSiriya, babebathenga.
UMbuso WaseSolomoni wathandana nabesifazane abaningi bakwamanye amazwe, ngaphandle kwenkosikazi kaFaro; kwaba yiMoabi, neAmoni, neEdomu, neSidoni, neHeti.

Bavela emazweni amanye, lapho uSimakadze abewisela khona laSirayeli, watsi: "Ningeke nibe nendodana kubo, nabo bangaba nendodana yenu; ngobe bangeke balungise intliziyo yenu belandela bonkulunkulu babo." Ngako-ke uSolomoni wahlala nalaba besifazane ngethando.
Wabe namakhosikazi lamakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamabili nesikhombisa, namadodakazi lamakhulu matatu; kodvwa amadodana akhe akazange amnike kuthula.

Kwatsi lapho uSolomoni eneminyaka emikhulu, lamadodana akhe aphakamisa intliziyo yakhe abelandela bonkulunkulu babanye; intliziyo yakhe ayizange ibe lilungile kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakhe, njengobe yayibe yintliziyo kaDavide, umsa wakhe.
USolomoni walandela i-Astorethe, inkhosi yalabaSidoni, ne-Milkom, lokudla lokubi kwabana-Ammon.
USolomoni wakwenza lokudla lokubi emehloni kaSimakadze,weryanga kutsi alandele Simakadze kahle-kahle, njengobe uDavide, umsa wakhe, abewulandela.
Ngeleso sikhathi uSolomoni wasungula indawo ephakeme ku-Kemoshi, lokudla lokubi kwaMoabi, emfuleni obhekene neJerusalema; wasungula naloko ku-Moloki, lokudla lokubi kwabaseAmmon.
Wayewenza njalo kubo bonkhe labesifazane bakhe bangaphandle, labaphazamisako kanye nalabanikelayo emkhondweni wabo.
USimakadze wehlule ngeSolomoni, ngobe intliziyo yakhe yabuyela emuva kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, lowo wabonakala kuye kambili.
Ngako-ke uSimakadze wabawisela ngalolu daba, watsi: "Ungeke ulandele bonkulunkulu babanye." Kodwa uSolomoni akazange agcine lomthetho wakhe.
UNkulunkulu watsi kuSolomoni: "Ngenxa yokuthi ukwenze lokhu, futhi awuzange ugcine umyalelo wami kanye nemithetho yami engikulembise yona kuwe, ngizokususa umbuso, ngiwunike umkhonzi wakho.
Ngakho-ke, ngaleso sikhathi sekuphila kwakho ngingeke ngikwenze lokhu, ngenxa yaDavide, ubaba wakho; ngesandla somntwana wakho ngiyawucisha.
Nase ngingeke ngicishe loMbuso wonke, kepha ngitawunika umntwana wakho isihlanganisi esisodwa, ngenxa yaDavide, mkhonzi wami, kanye neJerusalema, lapho ngayikhethile khona.
Simakadze wavusa umkhonzi kuSolomoni, uHadadi wase-Edomu, losuka emndenini webukhosi base-Edomu.
Ngaleso sikhathi, lapho Davide ehlasela khona Edomu, uYowabhi, umphathi wesive, waphuma waya kubulawa labafileyo, wabulala wonke lamadoda eEdomu.
Wahlala khona emaviki lamane, yena naJowa揚e nabo bonkhe labaSirayeli, kuze abulala wonke lowesifazane eEdomu.
Adade waphuma, waya eMijiphu, naye nalabaphathi be-Edomu lababenesibopho sababa wakhe; Hadadi ke waba ngumfana.
Basuka eMidiyani, bafika eParan; bathabathela nabo amadoda lavela eParan, bafike eMisri kuFaro, ukumkani weMisri; naFaro wabanika Hadadi indlu, nekudla, nemhlaba.
UFaro wathandana naHadadi, wabanika indodana yakhe yenkosikazi yakhe, iTahpenesi, umsa wenkhosi.
Nenkosikazi yakhe iTafenis yazala uGenubhathi, umsa waHadadi; neTafenis yamukhula endluni kaFaro. Wahlala khona Genubhathi phakathi kwabantwana bakaFarao.
Adade wafika eYiputa, watsi kuHadadi: "UDavide ufile, kanye na-Yowabe, umphathi wenkhosi." Adade wathi kuFaro: "Lahla ngihambe ngiye ezweni lami."
UFaro watsi kuye: "Ufuna yini lapha nami, kutsi uhambe uye ezweni lakho?" Adade watsi: "Akukho lutho, kepha ngiyakucela uvumele ngiye."
Simakadze wavusa umkhonzi wesibili kuSolomoni, Rezonu, umsa waEliyada, loyawusuka eHadarezeri, ukumkani waseZoba, lomphathi wakhe.
Rezon wahlangana naye, waba nguMengameli webantfu labahlaselayo, ngemuva kwekudlwengulwa kukaDavide eTsoba; bafika eDamaskus, bahlala khona, baba nguMbuso waseDamaskus.
Waba nguReshon umfoti waSirayeli nsuku zonke zekuphila kukaSolomoni, kanye naHadadi, lowo loyawuphazamisa; waba ngumfoti waSirayeli, wahlala eAram.
NaYerobohama, unyana waNebati, umEfrathi waseZeredha, lomunye wabaphathi baSolomoni, nalowo labenguSeruwa, indodana yenkosikazi, wayalela ukumkani, watsi:
USolomoni wasungula iMillo, wavala umgodzi wedolobha laDavide, ubaba wakhe, watsi: "Asekho muntfu longeke afike eSirayeli, ngaphandle kwaSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakhe.
USolomoni, lapho ebona khona uYerobohabhi, lomunye walabo labasebenza kahle kakhulu, watsi: "Uyawube ngumphathi wabo bonke labo labehlelwa msebenzi, labaseSibhani-Josefu."
Ngeleso sikhathi Jeroboamu waphuma eJerusalema, wahlangana naye enhliziyweni uAhiya umprofeti waseShilo; Ahiya ubenesigqoko esisha; bababili bebengaba khona emgwaqeni kuphela.
U-Ahiya watsi: "Lakho kungenxa yemanti lamasha, angeke abe nalo, ngobe uSimakadze utsi: 'Kunebantfu labalishumi elinambili.

watsi kuYarobheham: "Thintela wena emacwecwe lamashumi lamabili; ngobe Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, usho kutsi: 'Njengobe ngiwucishe lombuso ngesandla saSolomoni, ngikunike wena imindeni lelishumi.
Kube nguSolomoni kuphela longeke agcine inhlanganiso eyodwa, ngenxa yalowo mkhonzi wami uDavide, kanye neJerusalema, ledolobha labengisalikhethela kusuka kuwo wonke lamadolobha aseSirayeli.

Lokusho kwami kungenxa yokuthi bamihetse, banikela ku-Astorethe, inkhosi yalabaSidoni, ne-Kemoshi, ingcwele yeMoabi, ne-Milkom, ingcwele yabana-Amoni; bangahamba ngezindlela zami, bangakwenza lokuhle enhliziyweni yami, bangagcina imiyalo yami namasiko ami, njengakwaDavide, ubaba wakhe.

Kusekho, ngeke ngithathe ubukhosi bonke esandlani saSolomoni; ngobe ngitakwenza abe ngunkhosi yonke imihla yakhe, ngenxa yaDavide, umkhonzi wami, lowo ngawukhethile, logcine imiyalo yami nemithetho yami.
Ngase ngitawukhipha ubukhosi esandlani semuntfu wakhe, ngikunike wena imindeni lelishumi.
"Ngitanikela ngenkhosi kuyise, ngobe lomuntfu wami Davide utawuhlala eJerusalema, lenhlokodolobha lapho ngifuna khona kutsi irimise khona igama lami.
Lakho-ke, wena ngitakwenta ube ngunkhosi yakho ngaso sonke sifiso senhliziyo yakho; nawe utawuba ngumphathi waSirayeli.

"Nase ukhuluma ngaso sonke lesi ngikuwisela kuso, uhamba ngendlela yami, wenze lokho kulungile enhliziyweni yami, ugcine imiyalo yami nemtsetfo wami, njengobe umkhonzi wami Davide wakwenza; khona-ke ngiya kuba nawe, nami ngitakulethela indlu eqinile, njengoba ngiyenzile kuDavide, futhi ngitakunika iSirayeli.
Nami ngiya kutfumisa imbewu yaDavide, ngobe nguNkulunkulu, kepha angeke kube njalo.
USolomoni wafuna ukumbulala uYerobohamu; kodvwa uYerobohamu wehla, waya eYiputa, ku-Shishaki, inkhosi yaseYiputa. Wahlala eYiputa kuze kube sekufa kwaSolomoni.
Lokunye loSolomoni akwenzayo, naleyo yonke imisebenzi yakhe, kanye nekhono lakhe, kubonakala sengathi kubhalwe encwadini yemisebenzi kaSolomoni.
USolomoni waba ngunkhosi eJerusalema, kuwo wonke laSirayeli, iminyaka lemashumi mane.
USolomoni waphumula, wabanjwa enhlokodolobha yaDavide, ubaba wakhe; Rehabeam, umsa wakhe, waba ngunkhosi yakhe.
Roboame waya eShekhemi, ngobe bonkhe bantfu beSirayeli babefike eShekhemi kutsi baphindze bamuvumele abe ngunkhosi.
Yabo waya eYiputa, wahlala khona lapho afike khona kutsi agweme ubukhosi bukaSolomoni, ngobe wababona laba baseYiputa bekhuluma naYerobohamu, umsa kaNabati.
Labantfu bathumela batsi: "Vuma ufike!" Wafika khona Jeroboamu kanye nemsebenti wemaSirayeli, wakhuluma kuRehoboam watsi:
ubaba wakho watfumisa umsebenzi wethu; kodvwa manje, khululeka kulowomsebenzi lobuhlungu kanye nesibopho lesinzima lesababeka kuso ubaba wakho, sitawukukhonza.
Wayiphendvula watsi: "Thumelani lilanga lesithathu, bese nibuyela lapha kimi." Labantfu baphuma.
UMbuso WaseRhobhohamu wakhuluma nalabakhulu, lababe bakhona phambi kwaSolomoni, ubaba wakhe, lapho ephila khona, watsi: "Nini ninicebisa kutsi ngiphendule yini kulabo bantu?"
Baphendvula batsi: "Wena-ke, uma namuhla uyawuba ngumkhonzi walaba bantu, utawubahlonipha, utawubaphendula ngemazwi alungile, bangabe bakhonzi bakho kuze kube sekupheleni.
Aye ashiya intfwasabelo labakhulu abemnike yona, wakhuluma nabangani bakhe labakhulele naye, lababe behlala emnyango wakhe.
Wabaphendvula watsi: "Nini nitsi kutsi siphendule yini kulabo bantu labakhuluma nami, besithi: 'Nciphisa lesibopho labesinikelwe ngubaba wakho?'"

Bakhuluma kuye labancane labakhulela naye, batsi: "Lebantfu bakhuluma kuwe bethi, 'Ubaba wakho utfubile impahla yethu, kepha wena siwukhulule.' Uyawubaphendvula utsi: 'Isandla sami esincane sibushelelezi kunalo lomlenze wababa wami.
Ubaba wami wakwenta kube nzima impahla yenu, kepha mina ngiyawuyenza ibe buhlungu; ubaba wami wakwenta kube nzima impahla yenu, kepha mina ngiyawukwenza ibe buhlungu.
Yabo waya kuRehobhoamu ngelilanga lesithathu, yena nabantfu bonkhe, njengobe ukumkani abewawutsi, watsi: "Buyele kungi ngelilanga lesithathu."
Unkhosi yaphendula laba bantu ngesandla esibuhlungu, yashiya inhlolovo labeyitfumelele lamadoda amakhulu.
Wakhuluma kubo, watsi kubo: "Ubaba wami wakwenza kube nzima umsebenzi wenu, kepha ngiyawuwubeka buhlungu; ubaba wami wakwenta kube lulala, kodwa ngiyawukwenza lube lulala kakhulu.
Ngako-ke ukumkani akazange akhulume nalaba bantu; ngobe lokhu kwakusuka kuSimakadze, kutsi kube sekuphele amazwi akhe, lawo akhuluma ngaye uAhiya waseShilo kuYerobohama, umsa waNebati.

Batsi lapho bonke bantfu baseSirayeli bebona ukuthi ukumkani akazange abonise, baphendvula batsi: "Sineliphi isikhundla eDavideni? Asikho nesinye isikhundla kumntwana ka-Isayi! Yiya etindlini zakho, Israele; Davide, lungisa indlu yakho."
NalabaSirayeli labahlala emadolobhani aseYuda, Roboame waba ngunkhosi yabo.

UMbuso waseRhobhoyamu wathumela uHadoram, lobengumphathi webantfu labasebentisa ema-Amori; kodvwa bonke bantfu baseSirayeli bamemetela ngemlilo, waba mnyama. UMbuso waseRhobhoyamu wehlisa ibhasi lakhe, waya eYerusalem.
Ngako-ke iSirayeli yaphuma emndenini waDavide, kuze kube namuhla.
Batsi bakubona bonke laSirayeli kutsi uYerobhoamu wabuyela, baphuma bemukhipha, bakwenza abe ngunkhosi kuwo wonke laSirayeli; kwakungulo suku lwaYuda kuphela loluhlala lulandzela indlu kaDavide.

Wafika eJerusalema, wahlangana nabo bonkhe bantfu baseYuda nabaseBenjamini, lamakhulu lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa lamakhulu, labakhethiwe bokulwa, kutsi babuye bahlangatshezwane naSirayeli, kutsi babuyisele ubukhosi kubo Roboame, umsa waSolomoni.
Kuye kwafika lomunye umlayezo waSimakadze kuShemaya, indodana yaNkulunkulu, watsi:
"Ukhulume naRehoboamu, unyana kaSolomoni, ukumkani wase-Yude, kanye nabo bonkhe bantfu base-Yude neBenjamini, nalabo bonke labanye abantu, utsi kubo,

Simakadze utsi: "Mna-ke ningeke nifike nihlasele labangani benu, bantfu bakaSirayeli; buyelani kuwo wonke umuntu ekhaya lakhe, ngobe ngiyawukwenza lomsebenzi." Baye balalela amazwi kaSimakadze, babuyela endlini yabo, njengobe Simakadze abekhuluma.
Yarobheam wahlala eShekem, emhlabatsini waseEfraim, wahlala khona; waya lapho, wasungula Penuheli.
UYerobohabhi wacabanga enhliziyweni yakhe, watsi: "Namuhla ubukhosi buyawubuyela emndenini kaDavide.

Uma laba bantu behamba banikela ethempelini laSimakadze eJerusalema, khona-ke intliziyo yabo iyawubuyela kumphathi wabo, kuRehoboamu, ukumkani wakwaYuda; bangamibulala, babuye babe nguRehoboamu, ukumkani wakwaJuda.
Watsi Simakadze, watsi kubo: "Kunebuhlungu kakhulu kuwe kutsi ufike eJerusalema; bonani, Israele, lonkulunkulu bakho labatfumelele wena emazweni la-Egipta!"
Wabeka ingulube elinye eBetheleli, nelinye laletsa eDani.
Lento yafika ibe yisono, ngobe bafike be揚isa lengulube kuze kube nguDani.
NaYerobhoamu wakha emathempelini emhlabatsini, wakhipha labangcwele bakhe kubo bonkhe bantfu, nakuba bebengaba ngalabaLevi.

UYerobohabhi wamisa umthendeleko kumnyaka wesitsatfu, ngemhla lesilishumi lelinesihlanu wenyanga, njengemcimbi lowawudlalwa eYuda. Wanikela emadini esibhedlela sakwa-Bethele; wabanikela kumadlelo laye ayewalungiselela, abeka nabo emkhosini waseBhetheli labaphatsimandla bezindawo ezisephakeme abewabewazi.

Waphuma eBheteli, wafika ethempelini lakhe, layawuyenza eBetheleli, ngelilanga lelishumi lelinesihlanu lenyanga yesishiyagalolunye, lomnyaka lomncintiswano abewukhethele yena; wasungula liholidi kuboSirayeli, wafika ethempelini lakhe, wakhipha umlilo.
Batsi kwafika umuntu waNkulunkulu waseYuda eBheteli, ngelizwi laSimakadze; naYerobohabhi wayeseceleni komnikelo wesono, wakhipha uvumba.

Umuntfu waNkulunkulu wehla ethempelini ngelizwi laSimakadze, watsi: "Ethempelini! Ethempelini!
