Lokho kusho Simakadze: Bheka, umndeni kaDavide utawuzalwa umfana, igama lakhe liyawuba nguYosiya; naye uya kunikela phezu kwakho labaphatsimandla bemadolobha aphakeme, labo batfumisako umlilo phezu kwakho, natinhloko tabantu kumele zicutshwe phezu kwako.
Wanikela ngephawu ngalolo lilanga, watsi: "Leli phawu litsi: Simakadze ukhuluma; bona, lelithende lengcwelengcwele liyawuphucuka, kanye nemanti ayo atawugwaca."

USimakadze watsi kuYerobhoamu, utsi: "Ngisho nesandla sakho, utsi: 'Thintela!'" Ngako-ke lapho ukumkani ekhuluma ngaleso lizwi lomntu waNkulunkulu, akazange avule isandla sakhe, ngobe lamehlo akhe abemnyama kakhulu.
Naletindlu letingcwele tahlukaniswa, lilanga lemlilo lalibanjwa, njengobe lomuntfu waNkulunkulu abesho, ngaleso sibonakaliso Simakadze abesivelile.

Watsi ukumkani kulowo muntu waNkulunkulu: "Nceda, thandaza kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, ukhulume nami; ngizobuya ngesandla sami." Lomuntu waNkulunkulu wehlalela Simakadze, isandla sokumkani sabuyela kuye, saphinde sabuye sifana neleso sangaphambili.
Watsi ukumkani kulowo muntu waNkulunkulu: "Thiba nami ekhaya, uphuze, ngitakunikela ngemnikelo."
Lomuntu waNkulunkulu watsi kunkhosi: "Nakuba ungisinika ingxenye yezinto zakho, ngingeke ngifike nawe; ngingeke ngidle inyama nome nginywe amanzi kulendawo.
Simakadze wakhuluma kimi, watsi: 'Ungeke udle inhlanzi noma unywe amanzi; ungabuyeli ngendlela lowahamba ngayo.'
Wahamba ke ngendlela lehlukile, akazange abuye ngendlela abefike ngayo eBetheli.
Wahlala khona umprofeti omdala eBheteli. Bafike bakhuluma kubo, batsi: "Lawo madodana akhe akazange akhulume nalowo mntu waNkulunkulu, ngobe wakhuluma kuSimakadze."
Ubaba wabo wababuza watsi: "Uyaphi ngendlela yakhe?" Labantwana bakhe bakutsile indlela lapho lomuntfu waNkulunkulu losuka eYuda ahambe ngayo.
Wabaphendvula watsi: "Sebenzisa umkhwenyana wami." Baye bamisa umkhwenyana wakhe, yena waphuma ehamba.
Wahamba walandela lomuntfu waNkulunkulu, wamthola ehlala phansi ngaphansi kwesihlahla se-oak; watsi kuye: "Uye yini lowo muntu waNkulunkulu losuka eJuda?" Waphendvula watsi: "Ngimi."
UMosi watsi kuye: "Thiba nami ekhaya, udle inhlanzi."
Wati kuye: "Ngingeke ngibuye ngakho, ngifike ekhaya lakho; ngingadla nemfuyo yakho, ngisadla namanzi akho kulendawo lenjalo.
Simakadze wakhuluma nami, watsi: 'Ungeke udle inhlanzi noma unywe amanzi khona; ungabuyeli ngendlela lowahamba ngayo.'
Watsi kuye: "Nami sengumprofeti njengawe, ngobe ngifike ngakhuluma ngesandla saSimakadze, ngithi: 'Thiba naye ekhaya lakho, aze adle inhlanzi, anywe amanzi.'" Akazange akhulume lutho naye.
Wabuyela naye, wadla inhlanzi, wanywa amanzi endlwini yakhe.
Bafike bahlala embhedeni, kwafika lomunye umlayezo waSimakadze kulowo mprofeti lomkhulu, lowo wambuyisela.

Watsi: "Kungekuhle kuwe, uMosi, uma ukhuluma kulowo muntu waNkulunkulu losuka eJudha, watsi: 'USimakadze usho kutsi: 'Wena-ke ungenqumi amazwi kaSimakadze; awugcinenga umyalo lowo Simakadze Nkulunkulu wenu abekuwiselayo.
ngobe ubuye wadla inhlanzi, wadla namanzi lapho Simakadze abekusho kuwe khona, watsi: 'Ungadli inhlanzi, ungadle namanzi'; ngako-ke umphefumulo wakho angeke ungeniswe ethempelini lababa bakho.
Watsi lapho lomuntfu waNkulunkulu ephelile ekudleni kwakhe nekudla kwakhe, uMosi wehlisa umkhwenyana wakhe.
Waye ehamba ngendlela yakhe, wahlangana naye linyoni enhliziyweni yendlela, wayibulala; lenyama yakhe yabe ibekwe enhliziyweni yendlela, nedoli liseceleni kwalo, nalelinyoni laliseceleni kwalo.
Batsi bahamba, babona lenyama ibekwe endlelani, nelibomvu liseceleni kwalo; bafike bekhuluma kulo mji lapho loprofeti omdala abehlala khona.

Watsi lapho umprofeti lomusha, lowo wambuyisela emuva, ekubona khona, watsi: "Umuntfu waNkulunkulu uyawushiywa lizwi laSimakadze; ngobe Simakadze abemnikela kulelo linyo, lelinye lalima, lalimbulala, njengobe Nkulunkulu abemwisile."
Watsi kubo kutsi: "Sebenzisa ledoli kimi." Baye bayisebenzisa.
Wahamba, wathola lenyama ibekwe phandle kwendlela, nedoli liseceleni kwalo, nalelo langa lisecaleni kwalo; leli langa alingelilidle lenyama, lalingelile nalodoli.
Watsi uprofeta wakhipha umphefumulo wemuntfu waNkulunkulu, wawubeka phezu kwedlovukazi, wayawubuyela enhlokodolobha yakhe, kutsi abe nekuthula naye, nome kutsi angeke agweme.
Wabeka umphefumulo wakhe emgodini wakhe, wathandaza kuye, watsi: "Awo, mkhulukazi wami!"

Watsi, ngemuva kokuba lomuntfu waNkulunkulu abulawe, wakhuluma kubonyana bakhe, watsi: "Uma ngifa, ningibulele embhedeni lapho lowo muntu waNkulunkulu ebulawe khona; nibeke ticubu tami ngaseticubuni takhe.
Lamazwi akhe, akhuluma ngaye ngesandla saSimakadze, ngaleyo ndlu lengcwelengcwele eBetheleli, kanye naleyo ndlu yonke yemadolobha ase Samaria, layawufika.

Naleso simo, Jeroboamu akazange abuye ekuhambeni kwakhe lokubi; wabuyela ekwenzeni labaphatsimandla bemadolobha lasentshonalanga, wabakhipha kuwo wonke umuntu, watsi: "Lowo lofuna ukuba ngumphatsimandla wemadolobha lasentshonalanga, utawubekwa khona."
Lokudla lokubi kwaba ngumnikelo wekushiswa wendlu yaYerobhoamu, kutsi ihlukaniswe nemhlaba, ibe yitfu.
Ngeleso sikhathi uAbiya, umsa waYerobhoamu, wehluleke.

Wathi uYerobohabhi kundvodzakati yakhe: "Khangela, phakamisa isandla sakho, ugqoke ingubo yakho, ukuze angeke kube khona lokwazi ukuthi wena ungumfazi wami; uye eShilo, ngobe lapha kukhona uAhiya umprofeti, lowo wamtshela kutsi ngiyawuba ngunkhosi yalabo bantu.
Ufike uthathe ngesandla sakho tingulube letilishumi, nekudla lokuphekwe kahle, nengilazi yejusi, uye kuye; yena uyakutshela kutsi yini lekumele ihambe ngayo lomuntfu.
Indvodzakati yaYerobohami yakwenza njengobe wakhuluma; yaphuma, yahamba yafika eShilo, yafika ekhaya la-Ahiya. (Ahiya ke akazange abone, ngobe waba mnyama ekukhululeni kwakhe.)
USimakadze wabakhuluma ku-Ahiya, watsi: "Thina-ke, indvodzakati yaYerobohamu iyakubuza ngalowo mntwana wayo, ngobe ufile; khuluma ngayo lemilomo yami; uma ifika, ingeke ibe ngumunye.
UAhiya, lapho akubona khona umsindo wenyawo lakhe emnyango, watsi: "Ngena, nkosikazi ka-Yarobhoamu; kungani ukhuluma ngabanye? Ngithunyelwe kuwe ngezindaba letibi.
Yeba uhambe, utfole kuYarobohabhi, utsi: Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, uthi kutsi, Ngikuphakamisile emehlweni ebantfu, ngikwenza ube nguMengameli wabahlali bami base-Israyeli.

"Nase ngicishe ngicishe ubukhosi emndenini kaDavide, ngakunikela kuwe; kepha wena awuzange ube njengemkhonzi wami uDavide, logcinela imiyalo yami, walandela ngami ngentliziyo yakhe yonke, ekwenzeni nje lokho kulungile enhliziyweni yami.

Uye wakwenza lokubi kakhulu kunabo bonke labazange bafike phambi kwakho; uyawukha unguNkulunkulu wakho lomunye, imifanekiso yegolide nesiliva, ukuze unyuse ingcindezi yami, uyewubeka phansi umlenze wakho.

ngobe, bona, ngiyawuletha umonakalo emndenini waYarobhoamu; ngiyakususa kuwo wonke lamadodana kaYarobhoamu eSirayeli, abe ngumuntfu lomkhonto nalowo lophilayo. Nami ngitawutfusa indlu yaYarobhoamu ngemlilo, njengobe umuntu atfusa ukungcola kwakhe, kuze kuphele.
Lokufa edolobhani, lomndeni waYerobhoamu, utawudla umkhwenyana wakhe, nalowo ofa emhlabatsini, uyawudla intaka yakhe; Simakadze ukhuluma.
Lakho wena, buyela ekhaya lakho; bese ufika edolobhaneni, umfana uya kufa.

Nabo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli batawumsola, bayawumufaka; ngobe yena kuphela emndenini kaYerobohabhi longeke afake emgodini, ngoba yena kuphela emndenini wakhe lokhe wathola kulungile kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli.
Simakadze utawuphakamisa ukumkani phezu kweSirayeli, loyawubulala indlu ka-Yarobhoamu. Losuku luyafika, namanje.

Simakadze utawubulala iSirayeli, ibe likhulu kakhulu, ibe sengathi intaba emanzini; uyawukhipha iSirayeli kulelizwe lelihle labewanikela ngalelo kubabusi babo, wabalalisa ngaphesheya komfula i-Euphrates, ngobe babulale iAshera, bephazamisa Simakadze.
Uya kushiya laSirayeli, ngenxa yebubi bakhe, labewubembise uYerobohabhi, abeyawubeka laSirayeli ebubini.
Lendvodzakati yaYerobhoamu yaphumathoni, yahamba, yafika eTirsa; lapho ifike emgwaqeni wendlu yayo, umfana washona.
Nabo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli bamfatile, bamphilela, njengobe Simakadze abesho ngesandla sakhe somkhonzi wakhe, nguAhiya umprofeti.
Lokunye lokushiwo nguYerobohami, nendlela akwenzela khona kutsi abe ngunkhosi, kubonakala sengathi kubhalwe encwadini yemlando wamakhosi aseSirayeli.
Wahlala ebukhosini iminyaka lemashumi lamane nambili; wafa, waba nguSawula umsa wakhe.

U-Rehoboamu, unyana kaSolomoni, waba ngunkhosi yaseYuda; ubeminyaka imashumi mane nalinye aneminyaka elishumi nesikhombisa elawula eJerusalema, emzini lapho Simakadze abewukhethile kuwo wonke lamakhosi aseSirayeli, ukuba abeke khona igama lakhe. Umzali wakhe waba nguNaama, umAmoni.
Lamadodana eYuda akazange akwenze lokubi emlonyeni waSimakadze, kodvwa ayemkhangisa ngebubi bakhe, ngaphezu kwekungebe bayawukwenza lababa babo.
Bakha nabo emaphandle aphakeme, netikhilomitha, netishitukulwane te-Ashera, ngaso sonke isitembu esiphakeme, kanye ngaphansi kwesitimela lesimhlophe.
Kubekho namadodana engcwele ahamba ngemikhosi kulelizwe; nabo bakwenza zonke izinto letibi tamasiko lalawo mazwe, lawo Simakadze abewakhuphula phambi kwalabaSirayeli.
Ngemnyaka wesihlanu wekubusa kwenkhosi Roboamvú, wafika Shishaki, inkhosi yema-Egipta, waya eJerusalema.
Wathatha nempahla yendlu yaSimakadze, nempahla yendlu yesikhashana senkhosi; wakhipha njalo-ke, naletinye tinduku tegolide azenzayo uSolomoni, wazisa.
Ainsi fut-il fait. Et voici, il y eut des gardes qui gardèrent la porte du palais irirent à l'entrée de la maison royale.
Nalapho ukumkani ephuma khona endlwini yaSimakadze, labakhonzi babeka emajikijolo lawo, bese bewafaka emuva endlini yabakhonzi.
Lokunye lokushiwo nguRhobhoyamu, naleyo yonke imisebenzi yakhe, akubonakali kubhalwe encwadini yemlando wamakhosi eYuda?
Kube nekulwa phakathi kweRehoboam naYerobohambi, nsuku zonke.
URehabhi waphumula, wahlala nababa bakhe enhlokodolobha yaDavide. Umkakhe waba nguNaama, umAmoni; uAbiyamu, unyana wakhe, waba ngunkhosi yakhe.
Ngomnyaka weshumi nasitfupha waYerobhoamu unyana waNebati, waba ngunkhosi yakaJuda.
Wahlala iminyaka lemibili eJerusalema, waphindze waba ngunkhosi yakhe iminyaka lesikhombisa.
Wayehamba ngezinto zonke letibi lobaba wakhe abezenza ngaphambi kwakhe; intliziyo yakhe yayingeke ibe lungile kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wakhe, njengentfungo kaDavide, umsa wakhe.
Kodwa-ke, ngenxa kaDavide, Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakhe, wabanika uAbiyamu isibani eJerusalema, wamnikela kutsi abe ngunkhosi ngemuva kwakhe, wagcina iJerusalema iqinile.

UDavide wakwenza njalo, ngobe abewenza lokuhle emehloni kaSimakadze; uDavide akazange ahambe ngaso sinye isive sakhe kusuka kunoma yini labemwise yona uSimakadze, ngaphandle kwecala lika-Uriya umHeti.
Kube nekulwa phakathi kwaRehoboam naYerobhoamu, kuze kube sekuphele iminyaka yaAbiyamu.
Lokunye lokushiwo nguAbiyamu, kanye naleyo yonke imicimbi yakhe, akubonakali kubhalwe encwadini yemlando wamakhosi eYuda? Kube nekulwa phakathi kwaAbiyama noYerobohabhi.
UAbiyamu wehla embhedeni wakhe, washonelwa edolobhani laDavide; uAsa, umsa wakhe, waba ngunkhosi yakhe.
Ngomnyaka wemashumi lamabili nesihlanu waYerobhoamu ukumkani kwaSirayeli, Asa waba ngukumkani waseYudačine.
Wahlala eJerusalema iminyaka lemashumi lamane nalinye; umkakhe waba nguMahaka, indodana ka-Abhiyasalomu.
Asa wakwenza lokuhle emehloni kaSimakadze, njengobe wabambisene naloDavide, umsa wakhe.
Wakhipha ema-Amori emhlaba, wasusa imihlobiso lemikhulu yegolide neyesiliva, kanye naleyo mihlobiso lemincane yegolide, labababuleki bakhe babeyenza.
NaMahaka, mkhulu wakhe, wayawuyisa kutsi angeke abe ngunkosikazi yakhe, ngobe wabambisene na-Ashera ngekudla lokubi; Asa wehlisa lokudla kwakhe, wakutsisa emfuleni weKidron.
Lemihlaba yephakeme ayiyisuswa; kodvwa intliziyo ka-Asa yabe ilungile kuSimakadze, iminyaka yakhe yonke.
Wabeka ethempelini laSimakadze isiliva negolide, nezinto letingcwele, letibondza lobaba wakhe naye labanikela kubo.
Kube nekulwa phakathi kwa-Asa naBaesha, inkhosi yaseSirayeli, iminyaka yabo yonke.
Baasa, inkhosi yaseSirayeli, waya eYuda, wakwakha Rama, kutsi angeke kube khona lophumayo noma lofikayo kuAsa, inkhosi yaseYuda.

Ase wakhipha isiliva kanye negolide lelisele emakhazeni ethempelini laSimakadze, kanye nekhaya lebukhosini, watsi linike kulabo labasebenza kuye, wabathumela kuBenhadada, umsa kaTabrimmoni, umsa kaHeziyoni, ukumkani wase-Aram, loyawuhlala eDamaskus, watsi:

"Sibe nesivumelwano phakathi kwami naSimakadze, njengobe kwakunguyise wami nayise wakho; bona, sengikulethela umklomelo wesiliva negolide. Yiya uphule isivumelwano sakho naBahasha, inkhosi yase-Israyeli, kutsi ahambe nami."
UBehadada walalela ukumkani Asa, wathumela bomkhuluwa besive sakhe emadolobhani lakwaSirayeli, wahlasela iIjon, neDani, naAbeli-beth-maakha, nayo yonke iKinnerethi, kanye nalomhlaba wonke weNeftali.
Baasa, lapho akubona khona, wayeka ukwakha Rama, wahlala eTirsa.

UMbuso waseAsa wakhipha umyalo kuwo onkhe emadolobha aseYuda, angeke kube nemuntu longenacala; baphuma nabo ematshe naletihlahla, abewasebenzisa uBaesha ekubuyeni kweRama; ngawo uMbuso waseAsa wabambise iGebha yaBenjamini neMizpa.
Lamanye lamacala aAsa, nemandla akhe, naleyo mikhosi yakhe abeyenzayo, nalawo madolobha labewasungula, bona, ayabhalwe encwadini yemlando wabaholi benkhosi yakaJuda.
Asa waphumula, washonwa nababa bakhe edolobhani laDavide lobaba wakhe; Jehoshaphat unyana wakhe waba ngunkhosi yakhe.
Nadabu, umsa waYerobhoamu, waba ngunkhosi yaseSirayeli eminyakeni lemibili yaAsa ukumkani wakwaYuda; Nadabu waba ngunkhosi yaseSirayeli iminyaka lemibili.
Wakwenza lokubi emehloni kaSimakadze, wahamba ngendlela yababa wakhe, nesono sabo labaSirayeli, lapho babambisene khona.
Baesha, umsa wa-Ahiya, wase-Issakhareni, waba ngumfoti kuNadabhi, watsi: "Baesha wambulala eGibethoni, inhloko yemaFilisti, lapho Nadabhi nebantfu bakhe baseSirayeli behlasela khona.
Baasa wabulala Nadabhi, ngonyaka wesithathu waAsa ukumkani wakwaYuda, waba ngunkhosi yakhe endaweni yakhe.

Baasa, lapho efika ebukhosini, wabulala indlu yonke yaYerobohabhi; akazange ashiye namunye lophilayo kuYerobohabhi, ngobe wababhubhisa, njengobe Simakadze abekhuluma ngalowo mkhonzi wakhe Ahiya waseShilo.

Ta happened because ofa sins Jeroboam had committed and had made Israel committy andtory ha ha matar LORDsaangryueloutelholywood Tuns Israelcommitted and had made Israel committed and had made Israel cometty andtory
Lokunye lokushiwo nguNadabhi, kanye naleyo yonke leweryane nayo, akubonakali kubhalwe encwadini yemave yabaholi beSirayeli?
Kube nekulwa phakathi kwa-Asa naBaesha, inkhosi yaseSirayeli, iminyaka yabo yonke.
Ngomnyaka wesithathu waAsa ukumkani wakwaYuda, uBahasha, umsa wa-Ahiya, waba nguMbuso waseSirayeli bonkhe, eTirsa, iminyaka lemashumi lamane nane.
Wakwenza lokubi emehloni kaSimakadze, wahamba ngendlela yaYerobohabhi, nesono sakhe, lapho abeke khona labaSirayeli emtweni.
Kusuka kuSimakadze kwafika kuJehu, umsa waHanani, kutsi akhulume naBaesha, watsi:

"Nasekube ngikwehla wena emhlabatsini, ngakwenza ube nguMengameli webantfu bami baseSirayeli; ngobe uhambe ngendlela yaYerobohabhi, wabeka bantfu bami baseSirayeli emthethweni wokudla lokubi, watsi: 'Nginenkinga nawe.
Ngitabulala inkhosi yakho, nendlu yayo, nemadvodzana ayo kanye nemadvodzakati ayo; ngiyawukwenza indlu yakho ibe njengendlu yaYerobohabhi puhlontiwe nguNebati.
Lokufa edolobhani laBahasha, emakhwenkwe azowudla; nome lofa emhlabatsini, tingulube zizowudla.
Lokunye lokushiwo nguBahasha, nekudla kwakhe, nemandla akhe, akusho yini kutsi kubhalwe encwadini yemave yamakhosi aseSirayeli?
Baasa walala naye, wabanjwa eTirsa; Ela, umsa wakhe, waba ngunkhosi yakhe.

Kube kwafika igama laSimakadze ngesandla se-Yehu umprofeti, unyana kaHanani, kuBhaasha nendlu yakhe; ngenxa yetintfo letibi taBaesha emehloni yaNkulunkulu, kutsi aphindze abe njengemndeni waYerobohabhi, kuze kube yilapho wababulala khona indlu yaYarobehami.
Ngomnyaka wemashumi lamabili nesikhombisa waAsa ukumkani wakwaYuda, uEla, umsa kaBhaasha, waba ngunkhosi yaseSirayeli eTirsa, iminyaka lemibili.
Zimri, umkhonzi wakhe, umphathi wesishiyagalombili samandla akhe ekulwa, wakwenza lokubi kuye; (Ela ke wayeseTirhaka, emdlalweni wendlu ka-Arsa, lobenguMengameli wendlu yaseTirhaka.)
Wafika khona Zimri, wahlasela Ela, wambulala kumnyaka wemashumi lamabili nesikhombisa waAsa ukumkani wakwaYuda; naZimri waba ngubukhosi bakhe.

Kwatsi lapho Zimri ephuma ebukhosini, ehlala esihlalweni sakhe sebukhosi, wabulala yonke indlu ka-Baesha; akazange ashiye namunye lowesifazane, noma ngabe waba ngumndeni wakhe noma ngabe waba ngumngane wakhe.
Ngako-ke uZimri wabulala yonke indlu kaBhaasha, njengobe Simakadze abekhuluma ngaBahasha ngesandla saYehu umprofeti.
Lokhu kwaba sekungenxa yaleyo ndlala yeBahasi, nendlala ka-Ela unyana wakhe, leyayibaphazamisa nabo bonkhe labaSirayeli, babulala Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wemaSirayeli, ngezinto tabo ezingenalutho.
Lokunye lokushiwo nguElaha, kanye naleyo yonke imisebenzi yakhe, akubonakali kubhalwe encwadini yemlando wamakhosi ase-Israyeli?
Ngomnyaka wemashumi lamabili nesikhombisa waAsa ukumkani wakwaYuda, uZimri waba ngukumkani eTirsa, iminyaka lelishumi nesihlanu; ngobe lamadvodza aka-Israyeli abeseGibhethoni, lalabaFilisti.

Batsi bakubona bonke bantfu labakhona emgwaqeni, besithi: "Zimri ukhiphe umshado, wabulala ukumkani na!" Ngako-ke bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli bakhipha Omri, umkhosi wakhe, waba nguMbuso waseSirayeli ngalolusuku, emphini.
UOmri waphuma eGibethoni, naye nabo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli bahamba naye, bahlasela Tirsa.
Zimri, lapho ebona khona kutsi lomhlaba uthathwe, wafika enkundleni yendlu yasebukhosini, wehlisa indlu yakhe ngemlilo, watsi: "Ngubani na lowo muntfu?
Wafa ngenxa yebubi bakhe, ngobe abewenza lokubi emehloni kaSimakadze, wahamba ngendlela yaYerobohabhi, nesono sakhe, lapho abeke khona laSirayeli emthethweni.
Lokunye lokushiwo nguZimri, kanye nesinqumo sakhe kutsi agweme ukumkani, akusho yini kutsi kubhalwe encwadini yemave yama-Israyeli?
Batsi bahlukaniswa bantfu beSirayeli babemiphiko mitsatfu: ingxenye yabo yafuna ukwenza Tibni, unyana waGinathi, waba ngunkhosi; ingxenye yabo yalandela Omri.
Batsi labasebenza kuOmri babenamandla kunalabo abasebenza kuTibni, unyana waGinathi; watsi Tibni: "Umri waba ngunkhosi."
Ngomnyaka wamashumi lamakhulu mahlanu nalinye kaAsa, ukumkani wakwaYuda, uOmri waba ngunkhosi yaseSirayeli iminyaka lengema-12; eminyaka lesikhombisa abenguMbuso waseTirsa.
Wathenga lomhlabatsi weSamariya ku-Shemer ngemali yegolide, wabambisa lomhlabatsi, wabeka khona dolobha, wabiza igama lakhe ngegama la-Semer, umnikazi womhlabatsi.
UOmri wakwenza lokubi emehloni kaSimakadze, waba nebubi kakhulu kunabo bonkhe labankhosi abazange babe naye.

Wahamba yonke indlela kaYarobhoamu, unyana waNabati, nebubi bakhe, lapho akazange abonise khona laSirayeli kutsi bagweme; ngobe babencusa kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, ngezinto zabo ezingalungile.
Lokunye lokushiwo nguOmri, kanye nemandla akhe, akukhona yini kutsi kubhalwe encwadini yemlando wamakhosi ase-Israyeli?
UOmri waphumula, wabanjwa eSamari; uAhabhi, umsa wakhe, waba ngunkhosi yakhe.
Ngomnyaka wesikhombisa nemashumi lamane nasitfupha waAsa, ukumkani wakwaYuda, uAhabhi, umsa ka-Omri, waba ngubukhosi baseSirayeli eSamariya iminyaka lemashumi lamabili nambili.
UAhabeki, umsa wa-Omri, wenza lokudla lokubi emehloni kaSimakadze, ngaphezu kwalabačini bakhe bonke.
Abe sekungekuhle kuye kutsi ahambe ebubini baYerobohabhi, unyana waNebati; ngobe washada naJezebeli, indodana ka-Ethbaal, ukumkani waseSidoni, wakhonza naBaali, wathandaza kubo.
Wamisa ithempeli kuBaali, endlwini yaBaali, leyawuyikwakha eSamari.
UAhabhi walungisa ne Ashera, wakwenza njalo kutsi agweme uSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, ngaphezu kwalabo bonkhe bantfu bakaSirayeli labangaphambilini kwakhe.

Hiyeli waseBhetheleli wabuyela eJerikho ngelilanga lebukhosi be-Ahabhi; wabeka isisekelo sayo ngekuphila kwakhe uAbironi, lomkhulu wakhe, wamisa iminyango yayo ngekuphila kwakhe uSegub, loncane wakhe, njengobe Simakadze abekhuluma ngalo ngaYoshuwa, umsa kaNun.

UEliya waseTishbi, lohlala eGileyadi, watsi kuAhabhi: "Ngiphila Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, lowo nguNkulunkulu wami, ngeke kube khona umfula noma imvula kuleminyaka lembalwa, ngaphandle kwekutsi ngisho."
Kuye kwafika igama laSimakadze kuEliya, watsi:
Yeka lapha, uye emaphandleni, ufihlakele efulethini lelinguKherithi, lisenyakatho yeJordane.
Wena utawudla kuleyo lwandle, nami ngibembise tingulube kutsi zikulethe ukudla kuwe khona.
UEliya wakwenza njengobe Simakadze abekhuluma kuye; waya, wahlala efulani laKheriti, ngasentshonalanga yeJordani.
Lamahhashi afike amnikela ngekudla kanye nenyama ekuseni, nekudla kanye nenyama kusasa; wadla namanzi lasuka emfula.
Kusukela lapho, umfula waphuma, ngobe bekungeke kube nemvula kulemhlaba.
Kuye kwafika kubo lizwi laSimakadze, watsi:
"Thinda, uye eSarephathi, eSidoni, uhlale khona; bona, ngibembise khona indodana yenkosikazi kutsi ikuletise wena."
UEliya wehla waya eSarepta, wafika emgwaqeni wedolobha, wabona khona indodana yenkosikazi iphindze yahlangana nemanti; watsi kuye: "Nceda, nikela ngamanzi ambalwa emgodini, ngiphule."
Watsi yena esuka evútela, watsi kuye: "Nceda, nininike nelinye licondza lekudla."

Waye watsi: "Ngiphila Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, angeke ngibe nekudla lokuphekiwe, kepha nginesandla esisodwa sesiliva embhedeni wami, nemafutha lambalwa emgodini wami; ngase ngicule timbuti letincane, ngihambe ngilungiselele lokudla kimi nalowo mntwana wami, sitawukudla, bese sifa."

Eliya watsi kuye: "Ungabi nebuhlungu; buyela ekhaya lakho, uyeke ukwenze lokhu lokushoyo; kepha ngaleso sikhathi, lungiselela kimi kuqala inhlama lencane yekudla, uyifikele; wena kanye nonyana wakho, lungiseleleni.
Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, ukhuluma njalo: Umnikelo wesono ngeke uphele, namafutha ebhodlela angeke aphele, kuze kube yileso sikhathi lapho Simakadze lakhipha khona umhlwa phezu kwemhlaba.
Waye, wakwenza njengobe Eliya abemphendvula watsi: "Kube nekudla lilanga ngalinye kuEliya, kuye kanye nemndeni wakhe.
Umhluzi webhotela wawungeke uphele, namafutha ebhotela angeke aphele, njengobe Simakadze abesho ngesandla saEliya.
Kwatsi ngemuva kwelilanga lelinyenti, unyana wendvodzakati yendlu leyo wahlupheka kakhulu, wakhula ebuhlungu, watsi angeke aphume.
Watsi kuEliya: "Umuntfu waNkulunkulu, yini engingakwenza nawe? Ufike lapha kutsi ungikumbulise isono sami, uyawubulala lomfati wami?"
UEliya watsi kuye: "Nceda, nikela kumntwana wakho."Wamkhipha emlenzeni wakhe, wamphakamisa waya egumbini lelikhulu lapho ahlala khona, wabeka phezu kwebhedu lakhe.
Watsi: "Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wami, ngabe utawudlalwa lowesifazane lowo, lapho ngihlala khona, uyawubulala umntwana wakhe?"
Watsi: "Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wami, ngiyakucela, uvumele umphefumulo walo mntwana uphinde ufike kuye."
Simakadze waphendula umlomo ka-Eliya, umphefumulo wakhe wabuyela kuye, waphila.
UEliya wehlisa lomuntfu, wamfaka egumbini lelikhulu, wamkhipha endlwini, wamnikela emama akhe, watsi: "Bona, unyana wakho uphila!"
Watsi lowesifazane kuEliya: "Namuhla ngiyazi ukuthi wena umuntfu waNkulunkulu, futhi kutsi amazwi aSimakadze lakhulumayo nguNkulunkulu weqiniso."
Kwatsi sekudlule iminyaka leminingi, ngonyaka wesithathu, kwafika igama laSimakadze kuEliya, watsi: "Yala, bonisana naAhabhi; ngobe ngitawukhipha umhlwa phezu kwemhlaba."
UEliya waya kutsi abonakaliswe ku-Ahabhi. Lendlala yabe ikhulu kakhulu eSamaria.
UAhabhi watsi ku-Obadiya, umphathi wendlu yakhe; ngobe uObadiya waba nekuthula lokukhulu kuSimakadze.

U-Obadiya, lapho iJezebeli ibulala khona bantfu labaprofeti baSimakadze, wathatha labaprofeta bamakhulu lamakhulu, wabafihla emabhishi mabini, amashumi lamabili nesihlanu emabhishi ngalinye, wayabanikela ngekudla namanzi.
UAhabhi watsi ku-Obediya: "Thinda uhambe ngalolu mhlaba, ufike emafuleni onke, netintaba tonke; kungase sithole tingulube, sihlale siphila ngemahhashi namatingulube, singeke sesivune nemfuyo."
Bahlukanise khona lelizwe labaphikisayo; Ahabhi waya ngendlela yakhe, naye Obadiya waya ngendlela yakhe.
U-Obadiya wayehamba, ngobe, bona, Eliya wahlangana naye. U-Obadiya wambona, wehla ngebuso bakhe emhlabatsini, watsi: "Ukho yini wena, nkosi yami uEliya?"
UEliya watsi kuye: "Ngimi; hlala ufike utsi kumphathi wakho, 'Namuhla uEliya usekhona.'"
Watsi yena: "Ngubani na longangidlwengula, kutsi unginikela umkhonzi wakho ku-Ahabhi, kutsi amfa?

Ngabe uphila Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, angeke kube khona nation noma kingdome lapho umphathi wami angase asuse khona abantu kutsi akufune khona; kodvwa uma bethi, Akho lapha, wabeka isandla sakhe kuleyo kingdome naleso natione, watsi: Bangeke bakuthole.
Ngako-ke wena utsi: 'Thiba, khuluma kumphathi wakho utsi: 'Eliya ukhona lapha!''

"Ngitsi, uma ngiphuma kuwe, uMoya waSimakadze utawukususa lapho awazi khona; bese ngikhuluma ku-Ahabhi, aze akuthole, uyawumibulala; kodvwa mina, umkhonzi wakho, sengikholwa kuSimakadze kusukela ngasencane.

Angeke kube kuthiwa kuwe, nkosi yami, yini lengiyenzile lapho i-Yezebeli ibulala khona boprofeta bakaSimakadze, kutsi ngafihla labaprofeti baSimakadze lamakhulu mahlanu, namashumi lalishumi elinesihlanu ngalinye, emigodini mibini, nami ngibanikela ngenkukhu nemanti.
"Nasemanje wena utsi: 'Thiba, ufike utshele lomphathi wakho kutsi, 'Eliya ukhona!'' ngobe utawungibulala."
Eliya watsi: "Ngiphila Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, loNkulunkulu labengisa kuye, namuhla ngiyawuvela kuAhabhi."
UObadiya watsi kuye: "Uya kuhlangana na-Ahabi, uyawukhuluma naye." Na-Ahabi waya kuhlangana noEliya.
Ahabe, lapho ebona khona Eliya, watsi kuye: "Uye yini lowo lobulalayo iSirayeli?"
UEliya watsi kuye: "Ngingeke ngibise iSirayeli, kodwa wena kanye nendlu yababa bakho. Niyeke imiyalo kaSimakadze, nilandela labaBaali.
Manje thumela, uhlangabeze bonkhe labaSirayeli bami emfuleni iKarmeli, nalabaprofeti beBhaali lamakhulu mane nemashumi mahlanu, nalabaprofeta beAshera lamakhulu mane, labadla embhedeni waYezebeli.
UAhabhi wabathumela kubo bonkhe bantfu beSirayeli, wahlangana nalabo baprofeti eMfula iKarmeli.

UEliya waya kubo bonke bantfu, watsi kubo: "Kude nini nizohamba nisuka ekugcineni nifike kulunye uhlangothi nakwesinye? Uma uSimakadze unguNkulunkulu, landzelani yena; kepha uma uBahali unguThixo, landelani yena."
UEliya wabaphendvula watsi: "Ngihlala ngiye kuphela emprofetini waSimakadze, kepha uBahali unebaprofeta bamakhulu lamane namashumi mahlanu.

Nifikeni nani nengulube lemibili, baprofeta bakaBahali bangakhetha kubo inkunzi yegolide, bayicishe ibe yizicubu, bayibeke phezu komlilo, kodvwa bangawufaki umlilo kuwo; nami ngitawulungiselela inkunzi yesiliva, ngiyibeke phezu komlilo, kepha ngeke ngifake umlilo kuwo.
Batsi: "UNkulunkulu uyawuphendula ngemlilo, lowo nguThixo." Labantfu bonke baphendvula batsi: "Kulungile lokho lokushiwo. "
UEliya watsi kubaprofeti ba-Baali: "Nikhetheni yinye yengulube, niyilungiselele ngaphambilini, ngobe ningabaningi; bese nicela igama laNkulunkulu wenu, kepha ningawufaki umphunga."

Bathatha khona inkunzi yengulube, bayilungiselela, bacela igama laBhaali kusukela emini kuya emveni kwebusuku, besithi: "Baali, uphendule nathi!" Bekungasekho umsindo, nanoma ngubani lophendulayo. Badlala ngaso sonke isikhathi ecaleni lelihhovisi labo labalibambisene nalo.

Kuye kwafika ekudlaleni kwelilanga, uEliya waqala kubomisa, watsi: "Cinga ngemandla; angeke abe nguNkulunkulu yini? Ngabe sewufuna kucabanga, noma usuhambe khona, nome usekwesinye isikhulu, noma ngabe uyalala, kufanele atiwe."
Batsi baphuma bekhala, bajika-ke, njengobe bahlala bekwenza, ngesandla kanye nemphiko, kuze kube ligazi liphuma kubo.
Bekudlula ekuseni, baphuma bedlala kuze kube lihora lokunikela ngesondlo sakusihlwa; kodvwa kwakungusa, kwakungaphenduli, kwakungekho namunye lolalela.
UEliya watsi kubo bonkhe bantfu: "Nifike lapha kimi." Bayawufika kuye bonke abantu, kodvwa yena walungisa i-altari yaSimakadze, leyayibiwe.
UEliya waba netimkhonto letilishumi nelimbili, ngasinye sihlanganiso semadvodzana aYakobi, loNkulunkulu abekhuluma kuye watsi: "Igama lakho liyawuba ngu-Israyeli."
Nalemigodi yakhiwa khona ithempeli ngelinye lamagama kaSimakadze, wakha nesango likhulu elinamashumi lamabili nesihlanu ema-epha embewu libekwe kulo.
Wamisa isihlahla, wamisa nengulube, wayisa phezu kwesihlahla, watsi: "Funelela emabhodlela lamakhulu mane amanzi, bese uyala ngemnikelo wesono kanye nesihlahla."
Watsi: "Yenzani lilanga lesibili," bayawukwenza; watsi: "Yenzani lilanga lesithathu," bayawukwenza lilanga lesithathu.
Lamanzi asuka ecaleni lelihhovisi, lafika nasentafuleni, wagcwalisa ngawo amanzi.

Kwafika isikhathi sokudla imnikelo wesono, Eliyasi umprofeti wafike wathi, "Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wa-Abrahama, na-Isake, na-Israyeli, ngobe kucace namuhla ukuthi wena uNkulunkulu e-Israyeli, nami sengumkhonzi wakho, nangemazwi akho ngikwenze lezi zinto zonke.
Yiphendule, Simakadze, uyiphendule, ukuze laba bantu babone ukuthi wena, Simakadze, uNkulunkulu, nawe lowubeka phansi intliziyo yabo kuwe.
Waphuma umlilo kuSimakadze, wehlisa iminikelo yekushiswa, nemithi, netingcweti, nemhlabatsi; wamisa namanzi akhona emfuleni.
Nalapho bonke bantfu bekubona khona, batsi: "Simakadze uNkulunkulu, Simakadze uMoya!" Batsi: "Simakadze uNkulunkulu, Nkulunkulu!
UEliya watsi kubo: "Gcwabeni labemaprofeti ba-Baali, angeke kungabikho namunye wabo lophumayo." Bayawugwaba, babeka Eliya esihlahleni saseKishoni, wabulala khona.
UEliya watsi ku-Ahabhi: "Yihamba, udle uphuze; ngobe ngitsi: 'Kufika lilanga lemvula.'"
UAhabhi wehla waya kudla nekudla, uEliya ke wehla wafika esiphelweni semfula iKarmeli, wehla emhlabatsini, wabeka ubuso bakhe phakathi kwemilenze yakhe.
Watsi kumkhonzi wakhe: "Suka, ubheke eningizimu yelwandle." Ufike umkhonzi wakhe, wabheka, watsi: "Akukho lutho khona!" Eliya wamphendvula watsi: "Thumela emuva, ubone."

Watsi kube sekwesihlanu, watsi: "Ngibona umfudlana omncane, lofana nesandla sentliziyo yemuntu, uphuma elwandle."Eliya wathi: "Yala, utsi ku-Ahabeki: 'Tisa imoto yakho bese uya phansi ngaphambi kokuba limvula litfole.'
Batsi bafika eJizreyeli, bebona lizulu limnyama kakhulu, nemvula iphuma, nemlilo uphuma, nemvula iphuma. Ahabhi waya eJizreeli.
Watsi kuyawufika umlomo waSimakadze kuEliya, watsi: "Thintela ingubo yakho emlenzeni wakho, uhambe phambi kwaAhabhi kuze kube seJezreeli."
UAhabhi wakhuluma ku-Yezebeli zonke izinto labezenza uEliya, nendlela abewabulala ngayo bonkhe labaprofeti ngesandla.

UYezebeli wathumela umyalezo kuEliya, watsi: "UNkulunkulu angifisele lokhu naleso simo, nome anganciphise kanjalo-ke, uma sengingeke ngaleso sikhathi ngibeke impilo yakho njengempilo yalowo mprofeti!"
UEliya wakhathazeka, watsi: "Ngase ngihambe ngekuphila kwami." Wafika eBeer-Shebha eYuda, washiya khona umkhonzi wakhe.

Wahamba esigabeni semhlabatsini, wahamba ngendlela yelilanga lelinyenti, waya ekungeneni kwesihlahla lesincane, wahlala ngaphansi kwalo, watsi: "UNkulunkulu, nginendlala; khipha umphefumulo wami, ngobe sengingeke ngibe ngcono kunalabo bami."
Wahlala phansi ngaphansi kwesihlahla, waphumula; kodvwa ngaleso sikhathi kwafika angelu, watsi kuye: "Suka udle."
Wabheka, wabona embhedeni wakhe kungenxa yemlilo, kube khona inkomishi yenkukhu nengilazi yamanzi; wadla, wadla, wehla wahlala.
Wayibuyela inkhosi yaSimakadze, wayicosha lilanga lesibili, yatsi: "Suka udle; ngobe indlela yakho inkulu kakhulu kuwe."
Wavuka, wadla, wadla, waba nemandla kulo kudla, wahamba ngelilanga lemashumi lamane nebusuku bemashumi lamane, waya eHorebhi, emfuleni waNkulunkulu.
Wafika khona ekungeneni kwegcongolo, wahlala khona ngebusuku. Nalapho kwafika kubo lizwi laSimakadze, watsi kuye: "Uyini lokwenza lapha, Eliya?"

Waphendvula watsi: "Ngibe nendlala kakhulu ngenxa yaSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli; ngobe bantfu beSirayeli babusise umhlangano wakho, babulala ema-altari akho, babulala nabo boprofeta bakho ngesandla; ngisele ngiye kuphela, futhi namuhla bafuna ngami kutsi bangamifisha."

Simakadze watsi kuye: "Thina, phuma uhlale kulo mfula phambi kwaSimakadze." UNkulunkulu wehla wadlula; khona-ke kwafika umfutho omkhulu kanye nemvula enamandla, yamisa imifula, yaphula ematshe, ihamba phambili kuSimakadze, kepha Nkulunkulu akazange abe kulo mtfutho. Emva komfutho kwavela intaba-mlilo, kodwa Nkulunkulu akazange abe kulo mtfutho.
Nalapho kutfutfuka khona, kwafika umsindo; Simakadze angeke abe kulo msindo. Nalapho kutfufuka khona, kwafika umsindo puhlaza-phuza.
UEliya, lapho akubona khona, wafihla ubuso bakhe ngemanti lakhe, waya ngaphandle, wahlala emnyango wesango; kodvwa kwafika izwi litsi kuye: "Ukwenza yini lapha, Eliya?"

Waphendvula watsi: "Ngibe nendlala kakhulu ngenxa yaSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli; ngobe bantfu beSirayeli babusise umhlangano wakho, babulala ema-altari akho, babulala nabo boprofeta bakho ngesandla; ngisele ngiye kuphela, futhi namuhla bafuna ngami kutsi bangamifisha."
USimakadze watsi kuye: "Buka, buyela ngendlela lapho ufike khona, uye emasikweni aseDamasku; bese uma ufika khona, unciphisa uHazayeli abe nguMbuso wase-Aram.
Unciphisa Jehu, umsa waNimshi, abe ngunkhosi yakaJuda; unciphisa Elisha, umsa waShafati, waseAbele-Mehola, abe ngumprofeti endaweni yako.
Nalowo lophuma ngesandla seHazayeli, uYehu uzowubulala; nalowo lophuma ngesandla seYehu, Elisha uzowubulala.
Ngase ngiyawushiya eSirayeli lamakhulu lamabili nesikhombisa, angeke abeke isandla sakhe ku-Baali, noma angeke avule umlomo wakhe.

UEliya wehla waya khona, wahlangana na-Elisha, unyana kaShafati, lapho ebhadla khona; abe nemindeni lelishumi elinambili yenkomo ihamba phambi kwakhe, naye wayehamba nemindeni lelishumi elinambili. UEliya wafika kuye, wamisa ingubo yakhe phezu kwakhe.

UElisha washiya inkunzi, wabaleka waya ku-Eliya, watsi: "Nceda, vumelani kutsi ngiphuze ubaba wami nemama yami, bese ngikulandzela." UEliya watsi: "Hamba uhambe; yini lengiyenzile kutsi ngikuvumele uhambe?"
Wabuyela, wathatha inkunzi yakhe lemibili, wayawuyibulala, wamisa inyama ngemanti, wabanika abantu, badla; watsi: "Uya, landela uEliya, ube ngumkhonzi wakhe."
UBehadada, ukumkani wase-Aram, wahlanganisa lonke livi lakhe, abe nenkhosi letimashumi lamane nambili naye, nemahhashi, nemiyalelo yekulwa, waphuma waya eSamariya, wahlasela.
Wathumela labaholi emzini wakhe ku-Ahabi, ukumkani waseSirayeli, watsi: "Bendahadadi utsi:
'Silivere sakho negolide lakho očini, namakhosikazi akho nabantwana bakho labahle nabo bami.'
Umkwetsi weSirayeli waphendula watsi: "Ngobe usho njalo, nkosi yami umkwetsi; mina ngiye wena, naletinye tintfo letimi tiye nawe."
Babuyela batsi: "Bena-Hadadi ukhuluma njalo, watsi: 'Ngathumela kuwe ngithi, 'Nceda unike isiliva yakho, negolide yakho, nabesifazane bakho, nabantwana bakho.'
Ngaleso sikhathi sengitawuthumela kuwe labangani bami, bese befuna indlu yakho kanye nemindeni yalabo lababangani bakho; nabo bayawuthatha zonke izinto takho letibalulekile.

Unkhosi yase-Isirayeli yahlanganisa bonkhe labaholi belizwe, yatsi: "Bonani, lomuntfu ufuna buhlungu; ngobe wathumela kutsi afike amfune lamadodana ami, nezingane tami, nesilivere sami, negolide yami, kodvwa angiwuphotisele."
Batsi kuye bonkhe labaholi nebantfu bonke: "Ungamlalela, ungawuvumelanga lomsebenzi wakhe."

U-Ahabha wabatshela labathunywa baka-Benhadadi, watsi: "Nitsi kumphathi wami, ukumkani: 'Kuwo wonke lamagama labewusho umkhonzi wakho kuqala, ngiyakwenza; kepha ngalolu daba angeke ngikwenze.'" Labathunywa baphuma, babuyela ku-Benhadadi.
U-Benhadad wathumela kuAhabhi, watsi: "Labangcwele bangenza lokudla lokungekuhle kutsi kube khona lilanga eSamariya, lifike lelinye lamadoda ami afake emgodini wakhe."
Umkwetsi weSirayeli waphendula watsi: "Nitsi kuye, 'Umuntfu logqoka impahla yakhe yekulwa angeke ajabulise njengelowo loyikhipha ngemuva kwemphiko.'"
Bena-Hadadi, lapho ekhuluma ngalowo mazwi, yena nabaholi bebantfu bakhe bedla emakhazeni abo, watsi kubo bonkhe bantfu: "Nceda nihambeni!" Baye bahamba bahlasela lomhlaba.

Watsi, kwafika umprofeti kuAhabhi, ukumkani waseSirayeli, watsi kuye: "Simakadze usho kutsi: 'Ubona yini lomphakathi lowo omkhulu? Namuhla ngitawuwunikela esandla sakho, nawe utawuzi ukuthi mina ngiNkulunkulu.' "

Ahabhi watsi: "Nguwuphi lowo loyawukwenza?" UMosi waphendula wathi, "UNkulunkulu utsi: 'Labo baholi bemadolobheni labancane batawuyenza.' "Ahabe aphendvula atsi: "Ngubani loya kuqalisa umkhosi?" Umprofeti wehlule watsi: "Wena."
U-Ahabi wahlangana nabaholi bemadolobha, lamakhulu mahlanu nemashumi lamane nambili; wahlangana nabo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli, labalishumi elinasikhombisa.
Baphuma ekudlaleni kwelilanga, ngobe u-Benhadad abesedolobheni lakhe, emdlalweni wakhe, nalabo makhosi lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu ayawusekela.
Baphuma kuqala labangani babaholi bemadolobha. Labaphenyi baka-Benhadadi bamtshela batsi: "Bakhona abantu labaphuma eSamari."
Watsi: "Nakuba baphuma befuna ukuthula, noma ngabe baphuma befuna kulwa, niwathathe ngečini."
Lamadodana enkhosini aphuma emgwaqeni, lamadvodza lahamba ngemuva kwabo.
LaSirayeli babaleka, laSirayeli bebalandela; kodvwa uBenhadadi, ukumkani waseSirayeli, waphuma ehamba ngenja yakhe, naye nalabo abahamba nenja yakhe.
Waphuma ukumkani waseSirayeli, wahlasela emabhubesi nemikhumbi, wabulala laSirayeli ngemphiko lelikhulu.
Uprofeta lwafika kunkhosi yase-Israyeli, watsi kuye: "Yala, uqinise livi lakho, bese ubona kutsi yini lokufanele uyenze; ngobe lapho lilanga liphuma khona, ukumkani wase-Aram uyakuhlasela."
Batsi kuye labakhonzi bakankhosi yase-Aram: "UNkulunkulu wabo nguNkulunkulu wemhlabatsi, ngakho bakhulu kunethu; kepha uma siyawukulwa nabo emfuleni lophansi, khona-ke sitawuba namandla kunabo."
Uyawukwenza lokhu: utawukhipha bonkhe bantfu basebukhosini emandlani abo, utawubeka baholi bamaphoyisa endaweni yabo.

Wathi kubo: "Ninikele, nihlanganisene naSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, kutsi nibuye nibe nemkhosi lofana nalowo lowulahlekile, nemahhashi ngemahhashi, nemoto ngemoto; bese sibhekana neSirayeli emhlabatsini, khona sitawuba ngamandla kunabo."
Ngemnyaka wekucala, uBenhadada wahlanganisa laSirayeli, waphuma waya eAfeki, waba nemphi yase-Isirayeli.

Lamadoda ase-Israyeli ahlangane nabo, wabanikela ngekudla, waphuma waya kuwo; lamadoda ase-Israyeli ahlala esiteshini esibheke kubo, abe njengemihlambi emincane lemibili yezinkomo; kodvwa laSirayeli bagubungela lemhlaba.

Wafika lomuntfu waNkulunkulu kunkhosi yaseSirayeli, watsi: "Simakadze usho kutsi: 'LasiArami sitsi: Simakadze nguNkulunkulu wemifula, kepha angeke abe nguThixo wemifula; ngobe ngitakulethela emandleni akho lonke lolu hlu lwalabakhulu, nibone ukuthi mina ngiye Nkulunkulu."

Bahlala bahlangana lilanga lesitsatfu, kuze kufike lilanga lesisikhombisa. Kulelo lilanga lesibili kwaqala ukulwa, laSirayeli babulala ema-Arami lamaphesenti lamakhulu lasitfupha ebantfu labahamba ngenyawo ngosuku lolunye.
Labanye baphuma befika emzini wa-Afeki, ngobe umgwaqo wawudlwengula lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa lamakhulu; naBenhadadi waphuma waya enhlokodolobha, wafihla emagumbini.

Batsi kuye labakhonzi bakhe: "Thina sesikufundile kutsi bantfu baseSirayeli bangabambisana; sifike sigqoke ingubo yesiliva negolide, sifake tintambo emilenzeni yethu, siphume kunkhosi yaseSirayeli; kungase kube uyakushiya uphile."

Baphindze bagqoka ingubo yesiliva negolide, babeka tintambo emilenzeni yabo, batsi kunkhosi yaseSirayeli: "Umkhonzi wakho u-Benhadada uthi: 'Nceda unciphise impilo yami.' "Ahabe watsi: "Uphila na? Umkhuluwa wami."
Bafike bakhuluma naye, batsi: "U-Benhadad, umngane wakho!" UAhabhi watsi: "Thina siyawufika siwufune." Ngako u-Benhadad waphuma, uAhabhi wamfaka ebhokisini lakhe lekudla.

Wathi kuye uBenhadadi, "Lamadolobha lababami abewathatha kubaba wakho, ngiyawuwabuyisela kuwe, nawe ube nezindawo zakho zokuhweba eDamaskus, njengobe babami babezenza eSamariya." Akazange akhulume naye, watsi: "Ngelendlela lenjalo ngiyakushiya uhambe." Wakwenza khona umhlangano naye, waphuma naye.
Wathi lomunye webantfu labaprofeti kumunye wabo, ngelizwi laSimakadze, watsi: "Nceda umphile!" Kodwa lowo muntu akazange amphile.
Wathi kuye: "Ngitsi, ngobe ungeke walalela lizwi laSimakadze, ngaleso sikhathi lapho ungishiya khona, ingulube iyakubulala." Nalapho lomuntu ephuma khona, ingulube yafika yayawubulala.
Wahlangana namunye umuntu, watsi kuye: "Nceda, cindezela ngami." Lomuntu wehla wamphuca, wambulala.
Wahamba lowo mprofeti, wehla waya endlela yenkhosi, washintsha isikhumba sakhe, watsi: "Ngiye ngifake ingubo yami emlonyeni wami.

USawula watsi kuye: "Ngubani na lowo muntu?" Akazange aphendule, kodvwa watsi: "Ngiye ekungeneni kwemphi yenkhosi." Lomuntfu waSimakadze watsi kuye: "Mkhonzi wakho ufike enhliziyweni yemkhosi, wafika nami umkhwenyana, watsi: 'Gcwalisa lomuntu; uma engekho, utawunikela ngekuphila kwakhe ngekuphila kwakho, noma ngesiliva lelikhulu nemashumi lamane.'
Ngako-ke, lapho umkhonzi wakho esebenza khona lapha nalapho, lomuntu akazange afike. UMbuso waseSirayeli watsi kuye: "Lele linye licala lakho; wena ngokwakho ukhulume."
UMosi wehla, wakhipha intambo emlonyeni wakhe; ngobe ukumkani waseSirayeli wambona kutsi ungumunye wabaprofeti.

Watsi kuye umprofeti: "Simakadze ukhuluma njalo, watsi: 'Wena wakhipha esandla sakho kulowo muntfu longeke ngiwususe; ngobe kuphila kwakho kuyawuhlala endaweni yakhe, nebantfu bakho bahlale endaweni yabo.'"
Unkhosi yaseSirayeli yabuyela ekhaya layo eSamariya, ihlupheke kakhulu, ibe nebuhlungu.
Ase kube khona ngemuva kwaleso sikhathi umuntu lokuthiwa nguNabothi, umJezreyeli; yena wayenevini lakhe eJezreeli, lalingene nendlu ka-Ahabhi, inkhosi yaseSamari.

Ahabhi watsi kuNabothi: "Nceda ungisinike ivini lakho, kutsi ngiyigcine ibe yigadi lekudla, ngobe liseceleni kwendlu yami; nami ngitakunika ivini elihle kuneleyo, noma, uma kukuhle kuwe, ngiyakunikela ngemali yayo."
Nabothi watsi ku-Ahabhi: "Simakadze angeke amvumele ukuthi ngikunike lemhlaba lowuhlala kuwo lababami."

UAhabhi wehla endlwini yakhe, ehloniphekile kakhulu, ekhathele kakhulu, ngobe Nabothi waseJezreyeli abekhuluma kuye, watsi: "Angeke ngikunike mhlaba lowuhlala kuwo labafowethu nababami," wafika embhedeni wakhe, wabeka ubuso bakhe emgangathweni, akadli ukudla.
Afike naJezebeli, indodana yakhe, wafika watsi kuye: "Ngubani lenkinga yakho, ngobe awudli kudla?"
Wati kuye: "Ngikhuluma naNabothi wase-Jezreyeli, ngitsi: 'Thiphani mina ivini lakho, noma, uma uthanda, ngitakunikela ngelinye ivini;' kodvwa yena watsi: 'Angeke ngikunike ivini lami.'"
UJezebeli, indodana yakhe, yatsi kuye: "Ikhona yini indlela yakho yokubusa njengenkhosi yaseSirayeli? Sukela, udle kudla, ukhululeke; ngitakulethela ivini laNabothi waseJizreyeli."
Wayibhala incwadi ngegama la-Ahabhi, wayibeka ngesandla sakhe, wayisa kubaholi nebantfu abakhulu labahlala emzini kaNabothi.
Wayibhalela emibhalweni, yatsi: "Nceda nimeme lilanga lekufa, ninike Nabothi isikhundla esiphakeme phakathi kwabantu.
bese nimisa ecaleni lakhe lamadodana lalababi lababili, bafike bagweme kuye, bethi: "Uye waphula umthetho waNkulunkulu nawasebukhosini." Ngako-ke nimuphumele, nimwise ematshe aze aphele.
Lamadoda amakhulu, nalabo abakhulu edolobhani lakhe, bakwenza njalo, njengobe iJezebeli yatsi kubo, kanye neletambiko labeyithumela kubo.
Bamemetela kudla, babeka Nabothi embhedeni lomkhulu kubo bonkhe bantfu.
Bafika laba bantu lababi, bahlala phambi kwakhe, bakhuluma ngaNabothi ebusweni bebantfu, batsi: "Nabothi ubulale Nkulunkulu nakumkani." Bamukhipha emgwaqeni, bamshaya ngemlilo, washona.
Bathumela kuJezebeli, batsi: "Nabhoti utfunywe ngemlilo, wafa."

Yatsi, lapho iJezebeli ikhuluma kuAhabhi kutsi uNabothi washiswa ngemlilo, watsi kuye: "Suka, uthathe indlu yasevini yaNabothi wase-Izreyeli, leyo akazange akuthengise kuwe; ngobe Nabothi akaphila, wafa."
Ngako-ke, lapho akubona Achabe kutsi Nabothi ufile, waphuma, waphuma waya eJezreeli kutsi athathe ivini laNabothi waseJezreeli.
Kuye kwafika izwi laSimakadze kuEliya waseTishbe, watsi:
Ufike ufike uhlangane naAhabhi, inkhosi yaseSirayeli, lohlala eSamariya; bona, ukhona esivini seNabothi; waphuma waya kuyo kutsi ayinikele.

Watsi kuye: UNkulunkulu usho kutsi, 'Uyawubulala yini lomuntu, kuze ube nemhlaba wakhe?' Wathi kuye kanjalo-ke: "Lomuntfu waSimakadze ukhuluma njalo: Kuleyo ndawo lapho emakhowe abulale khona igazi laNabhoti, nemakhowe azofulala khona igazi lakho.
Wathi uAhabi kuEliya: "Ungithole yini, wena umfowethu?" UEliya watsi: "Ngikuthole; ngobe sewuthengise wena ngokwakho ukuba wenze lokubi emehloni kaSimakadze.
Simakadze utsi: "Ngitakulethela buhlungu phezu kwakho, ngikuphelise, ngiwuphelele lowesifazane wemndeni wa-Ahabhi eSirayeli, umkhonzi nalowo ophilayo.
kodvwa ngitakwenza indlu yakho ibe njengendlu yaYerobhoamu unyana waNebati, nendlu yaBhasha unyana wa-Ahiya, ngobe ungiphazamise, uye wabangele kutsi iSirayeli ihlupheke.
Ngako-ke ngeJezebeli, Simakadze utsi: Emacwecwe azodla iJezebeli kanye nesitezi seJezreyeli.
Lokufa edolobhani la-Ahabhi, emakhwenkwe azowudla; nome lofa emhlabatsini, tingulube zizowudla."
Akukho muntfu lofana na-Ahabhi, lowo wanikela ngokwakhe kutsi akwenze lokubi emehloni kaSimakadze, ngobe iJezebeli, indodana yakhe, yayimupha.
Wakwenza izinto letibi, wahamba esigabeni setigodvo, ngaso sonke simo lapho labaAmori behlala khona, labantfu labebakhipha Simakadze phambi kwamadvodzana a-Isirayeli.
UAhabhi, lapho ekhuluma ngalowo mazwi, waluka ingubo yakhe, wagqoka ingcotjo, wehla embhedeni, walala ngengcotjo, wahamba ngekuthula, ebuhlungu.
Kuye kwafika izwi laSimakadze kuEliya waseTishbe, watsi:
Ubona kutsi uAhabhi sewuphucukile phambi kwami? Ngako-ke, ngobe aphucukile, ngingeke ngifikele lokubi emhlabeni wakhe; kepha ngelilanga lendvodzakati yakhe ngitawufika kumndeni wakhe.
Kwahlala iminyaka lemibili kutsi kube nemavi phakathi kwe-Aram ne-Israyeli.
Kwaba ngumnyaka wesithathu lapho uJosaphatsi, ukumkani wakwaJuda, ehla ekubona inkhosi yaseSirayeli.
Unkhosi yaseSirayeli yatsi kubo bonkhe bantfu bakhe: "Niyazi kutsi iRamoti-Gileyadi iyawuba lethu; kungani natsi sihlala singesabi ukuyibuyisela emkhosini wenkhosi yaseSiriya?"

Wathi kuJosaphat: "Uyahamba nami ukulwa eRamoti-Gileyadi?" UJosaphat watsi kunkhosi yaseSirayeli: "Ngiye nawe kulo lonke uhambo; abantu bami bangaba bantu bakho, nemahhashi ami angaba amahhashi akho."
UJosaphat waphendvula watsi kunkhosi yaseSirayeli: "Nceda, buza Simakadze ngalolusuku.

Unkhosi yase-Israyeli yahlangana nabaprofeti, labamalunga namakhulu amane lamadoda, wayibuza watsi: "Ngaya emkhosini eRamoti-gileyadi, noma ngiyibeke phansi?" Baphendvula batsi: "Yahamba, ngobe Simakadze uyawuyisa esihlalweni sebukhosi."
Jehoshafati watsi: "Asekho lapha umprofeti waSimakadze, kutsi siwubuze?"

Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli watsi kuJosaphat: "Kusekhona omunye umuntu longeke siwubuze uSimakadze ngaye, kepha ngiyawumukhathalela; ngobe akakhuluma nami lutho oluhle, kodvwa akusho nje lokubi. UMikaya, umsa waJimla." Napo-ke Josafati wathi: "Akufanele ukumkani akhulume njalo!"
Unkhosi yase-Israyeli yabiza umkhonzi wakhe, yatsi: "Thinda ufike uMikaya, umsa ka-Imla."

Unkhosi yase-Israyeli neJehoshafati, inkhosi yakaJuda, bahlala begqoke ingubo yabo yebukhosi, bese behlala emahhovisi abo, ngaphesheya kwesango laseSamariya; nalabaprofeti bonke babeshumayela emazulu phambi kwabo.
UZedekiya, umsa waKenanaha, wabambisene netibondza tensimbi, watsi: "Simakadze utsi: 'Ngalezinto utawubopha laSirayeli kuze bakhululwe.' "
Nalabaprofeti bonke babekhuluma njalo, besithi: "Thinda ufike eRamoti-Gileyadi, uphumelele; ngobe Simakadze utawuyinikela emkhosini."

Wakhuluma kuye umphathi, lowo wangena wakhipha Mikaya, watsi: "Bonani, labaprofeti bonke bakhuluma ngesandla esisodwa, bekhuluma ngekuhle kunkhosi; hlala ukhuluma ngesandla sakho kanye nabo, bese ukhuluma ngekuhle."
Mikaya watsi: "Ngiphila Simakadze, loNkulunkulu lokhuluma nami, lowo ngiwukhuluma."
Ufike kuye ukumkani, ukumkani watsi kuye: "Mikaya, kufanele sihambe sibhekane ne Ramoth-gileyadi, noma siyeke?"UMikaya watsi: "Thiba uphumelele; ngobe Simakadze uyakuyinikela emkhosini waSimakadze."
Unkhosi yatsi kuye: "Kuphi kuphi lapho kufanele ngikuvumele khona kutsi ungakhuluma nami ngaphandle kweqiniso ngegama laSimakadze?"

Watsi: "Ngibona bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli behlukanisiwe emadolobheni, njengetingulube letingeke zibe nemfuyi; Simakadze watsi: 'Lemindeni lemi ayisekho umnikazi wayo; ngase ahambe wonke umuntu ekhaya lakhe ngekuthula.'"
Unkhosi yaseSirayeli yatsi kuJosaphat: "Ngakuphendvula ngitsi: Angeke akhulume kahle ngami, kepha lobubi kuphela."
Watsi ke yena: "Lakho, nikhulume nelizwi laSimakadze: Ngibe ngibona Simakadze ehlala esihlalweni sakhe sebukhosi, nalo lonke livi lezulu liseceleni lakhe, ngakwesokudla kwakhe nakwesobunxele kwakhe.
Simakadze watsi: 'Ngubani longeke avumele uAhabhi ukuba ahambe eRamoti-Gileyadi, aze afe khona?' Lomunye wakhuluma linye, lomunye wakhuluma elinye.
Waphuma umphefumulo, wahlala phambi kuSimakadze, watsi: 'Ngiya kumkhangisa.'
USimakadze watsi: 'Ngani?' Lomoya wathi: 'Ngizophuma, ngibe ngumphefumulo weqiniso emlonyeni wabaprofeti bakhe bonke.' UNkulunkulu watsi: 'Uya kumkhangisa, uyawuphumelela; hlala uyenzile.'
Ngako-ke, bona, Simakadze umise umphefumulo webubi emlonyeni walabaprofeti bakho bonke; ngobe Nkulunkulu wemaSirayeli utsi: "Ngitakulethela kutfusile."
Watsi uZedekiya, umsa waKenanana, afike, wahlaba Mikaya ngesandla, watsi: "Ngayiphi indlela loMoya weSimakadze wawusuka nami kutsi ukhulume nawe?"
Hezekiya watsi: "Utakubona ngalolusuku lapho uphuma khona uye egumbini lengaphakathi, ufike ufihlakale."
Watsi ukumkani waseSirayeli: "Thiba uMikaya, umbuyisele ku-Amoni, lomphathi wedolobha, neYoashi, usihlalo webukhosi.
Nitsi kubo: Lokho kusho ukumkani: Nciphisa lomuntfu emgodini, nimnike ukudla kanye namanzi, kuze ngibuye ngekuthula.'
Watsi Mikaya: "Uma ubuyela ngekuthula, Simakadze angeke abekhuluma ngami." Watsi: "Nikhulume ngalolu daba, nibantfu bonke!"
Batsi: "Lenkhosi yaseSirayeli neJehoshafati, inkhosi yakaJuda, bafike befika eRamoti-gileyadi.
Unkhosi yase-Israyeli yatsi kuJosaphat: "Lami ngizoshintsha ingubo yami, ngifike emidlalweni; kodvwa wena ugqoke ingubo yakho." Ngako unkhosi yase-Israyeli yashintsha ingubo yakhe, yafika emdlalweni.
UMbuso wase-Aram ubewisela bomkhuluwa bakhe labathathu nemashumi lamane nambili, watsi: "Lungelelani nanoma ngubani, mkhulu noma mncane, ngaphandle kwenkhosi yaseSirayeli."
Batsi, lapho labaholi bemikhumbi bebona uJosaphat, batsi: "Kungeke kube ngunkhosi yaseSirayeli!" Babuyela emuva kutsi bagweme yena; kodvwa uJosaphat waphuma emphilweni.
Babona kutsi angeke abe ngukumkani waseSirayeli, babuyela emuva bengenakuwulandzela.

Watsi lomuntfu wakhipha umcibisholo, watsi: "Asekho umsebenti wami!" Lawo mcibisholo wamshaya ukumkani waseSirayeli phakathi kwemikhono yakhe nemilenze yakhe. Unkhosi yathi kumkhweli wakhe wemoto: "Thintela, uyenza ngiphume emgwaqeni; ngobe sengitfuba kakhulu."
Lempi laliba nzima ngalolusuku lonke, kodvwa uMbuso wase-Amori wahlala ekhephuni lakhe, ebhekene neSirayeli, kuze kwafika ekuseni, wafa; negazi lakhe lelihlanganisiwe lisuka ekhephuni lekhephuni.
Batsi lilanga liphuma, kwasuka kugwaza emkhosini kutsi: "Lomunye nibuye enhlokodolobha yakhe, lomunye nibuye emhlaba wakhe!"
Wafa ke ukumkani, wafakwa eSamariya, wafunjwa khona.
Bahlamba imoto yakhe emfuleni waseSamariya, nesilwane salisa gazi lakhe; nalapho bahlamba khona lababhishi, njengobe Simakadze abesho.
Lokunye lokushiwo ngu-Ahabhi, naleyo yonke into ayenze, nendlu yegolide leyawuyikwakha, nalawo madolobha layawuyisa, akunjalo, kubhalwe encwadini yezimlando yamabukhosi baseSirayeli?
UAhabhi wafa, uOhaziya, umsa wakhe, waba ngunkhosi yakhe.
UJosaphat, umsa wa-Asa, waba ngunkhosi yaseYuda eminyakeni lemine yaAhabhi ukumkani kwaSirayeli.
UJehoshafati ubeneminyaka engama-35 ubudala lapho afika ebukhosini, wahlala iminyaka lemashumi lamabili nesihlanu eJerusalema; umsa wakhe waba nguAzuba intombi kaShilhi.

Wahamba yonke indlela ka-Asa, umsa wakhe; akazange ahambe kuyo, wakwenza lokuhle emehloni kaSimakadze. Kuze kube tinhloko temadolobha lasogwini zange zasuswa; abantu babehlala benikela khona ngeminikelo yekushiswa neyemlilo.
NaJosaphat wakwenza kuthula nenkhosi yase-Isirayeli.
Lokunye lokushiwo nguJosaphat, kanye nemandla akhe ayawukhombisa, nalabo abelwela nabo, akusho yini kutsi kubhalwe encwadini yemlando wamakhosi aseYuda?
Nalabo labashiywa enkhosini, labaseBenjamini, labengaba khona ngetikhatsi ta-Asa, ubaba wakhe, wabasusa ezweni.
Ngaleso sikhathi, kungakabikho inkhosi e-Edomu; kube khona umphathi.
UJehoshafati wabambisa inqanawa letikhulu, kutsi zihambe ziye eOfiri ngegolide; kodvwa azange zihambe, ngobe zagwazeka eEzion-Geberi.
UAhaziya, umsa wa-Ahabi, watsi kuJosaphat: "Labaphathi bami bangahamba nalabaphathi bakho emikhumbini," kodvwa Josaphat akazange avume.
UJosaphat wehla embhedeni wakhe,, wahlala nababami bakhe enhlokodolobha yaDavide; uYoramu, umsa wakhe, waba ngunkhosi yakhe.
UAhaziya, umsa wa-Ahabi, waba ngunkhosi yaseSirayeli eSamari, ngonyaka welishumi lelinesikhombisa waJosaphatsi, ukumkani wakwaYuda; waba nguMbuso waseSirayeli iminyaka lengemahlanu.
Akazange ahambe ngendlela yababa bakhe, nome indlela yemama yakhe, noma indlela yaYeroboamu, mwana wa Nebati, lowo wamsusayo Israila ekufa.
Wakhonza uBaali, wathandaza kuye, wehlisa umsindo kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, njengobe wabambisene nabo bonkhe bantfu.
2Kgs: LakwaMowabi, ngemuva kwekufa kwe-Ahabhi, kwaphuma ebantwini beSirayeli.
UAhaziya wehla emnyango wendlu yakhe yasemaphandleni yaseSamariya, wahlaselwa buhlungu; watsi kubo: "Niye nibuze uBaale-Zebub, loNkulunkulu waseEkroni, kutsi ngizophiliswa yini kulelo gciwane."

Kodwa angeluSimakadze watsi kuEliya waseTishbi, utsi: "Suka, uyeke uhlangane nalabo abathunyelwe ngunkhosi yaseSamariya, uwabuze kutsi: 'Asekho yini Nkulunkulu eSirayeli, ngobe niya kubuza uBaale-zebub, lonkulunkulu waseEkroni?'
Ngako-ke Simakadze utsi: Ungeke uphume embhedeni lowuhlala kuwo, ngobe utawufa.' Eliya ke waphuma, wabuyela ekhaya lakhe.
Bafike babuyela kuye, watsi kubo: "Ngubani na loyawubuyela kuwe?"

Baphendvula batsi: "Umntu ufike esigabeni sethu, watsi kuye: 'Thumelani kumkwehluleli loyawutfumelela niye, nitsi kuye: UNkulunkulu akakho eSirayeli, ngobe uthumela umbuzo ku-Baale-zebubi, Nkulunkulu wema-Ekron? Ngako-ke ngeke uphule isibhedlela lapho uhlala khona, kepha utawufa.' "
Simakadze wababuza watsi: "Ube ubukeka kanjani lomuntu labesuka ekubonani, wakhuluma nani la mazwi?
Baphendvula batsi: "Ube ngumuntu lonamawele, kanye nemilenze yakhe ibe nemlenze wesikhumba." Unkhosi yatsi: "Waye uEliya waseTishbi."
Wathumela kuye umphathi wemadvodza lamashumi mahlanu, naye namadoda akhe lamashumi mahlanu; wahamba waya kuye, watsi kuye: "Womuntu waNkulunkulu, Simakadze utsi: 'Thinda phansi.'"

Eliya waphendula watsi kuye: "Uma sengumntu kaNkulunkulu, khona-ke mlilo uyawuphuma emhlabathini, uyewudla wena nalaba hamsini bakho." Umlilo wehla emhlabatsini, wawudla lowo mphathi wemashumi lamane nelaba hamsini bakhe.
USimakadze watsi kuEliya: "Womuntu waNkulunkulu, Simakadze utsi: 'Thinda bese usukela phansi.'"

Eliya waphendula watsi kuye: "Ngabe sengumntu waNkulunkulu, khona-ke mlilo uphule kusuka esibhakabhakeni, uwudle wena nalaba hamsini bakho!" Umlilo waSimakadze wehla kusuka esibhakabhakeni, wawudla lowo mphathi wemashumi lamane kanye nabohamsini bakhe.

Wathumela uMengameli wesihlanu, naye nalabamashumi mahlanu akhe; wafika lomkhuluwa wesikhombisa, wehla embhedeni wakhe phambi kwaEliya, wamsola, watsi kuye: "Mntwana waNkulunkulu, ngiyakucela, gcina impilo yami kanye nempilo yalabamashumi mahlanu labangani bakho.
Watsi: "Namuhla, ngiyakucela, ugcine imphilo yami, ngobe umlomo wami ugcwele livi; ngobe umoya waphuma esibhakabhakeni, wawudla labakhulu labambili kanye nebantfu babo.
Watsi angeluSimakadze akhuluma kuEliya, watsi: "Thiba naye; ungamkholeli." UEliya wehla, waphuma naye waya kumkwetsi.

UEliya watsi kunkhosi: "Simakadze utsi: 'Wena wathumela labangani kutsi babuze uBaale-Zebubi, Nkulunkulu wema-Ekroni, sengathi angeke kube nguNkulunkulu eSirayeli lokufanele ubuze?' Ngako-ke, ngobe ukwenze lokhu, ngeke uphume esibhedlela lapho uhlala khona, kepha utawufa.' "

Wafa ke Ahaziya, njengobe Simakadze abekhuluma ngaye ngesandla saEliya. NaJoram waba ngunkhosi esikhundleni sakhe, ngobe angeke abe nemntwana, kumnyaka wesitsatfu waJehoram unyana waJosaphat, ukumkani wakwaYuda.
Lokunye lokushiwo nguAhaziya, nalapho akwenze khona, kubonakala kutsi kubhalwe encwadini yemave yamakhosi aseSirayeli.
Kwatsi lapho Simakadze engeke athabathe khona uEliya entangeni ngemlilo, waphuma uEliya naElisa eGilgal.
UEliya watsi ku-Elisha: "Nceda, hlala lapha, ngoba uSimakadze ungithumela eBetheleli." UElisha wathi: "Ngiphila Simakadze, netfu liphila, ngingeke ngikushiye!" Baye bahamba nabo befika eBetheleli.

Baphuma khona labaprofeti eBheteli bafika ku-Elisha, batsi kuye: "Uyazi yini kutsi Simakadze utawuthatha umkhonzi wakho ngalolusuku kusuka esihlalweni sakho?" Akazange aphendule: "Ngiwuwazi; ungakhuluma ngayo."
UEliya watsi kuye: "Elisa, hlala lapha, ngiyakucela, ngoba uSimakadze ungithumela eJerikho." UElisha wathi: "Ngiphila Simakadze, nangemphefumulo wakho, ngeke ngikushiye!" Bafike bafika eJerikho.
Batsi bafika labaprofeti eJerikho ku-Elisha, batsi kuye: "Uyazi yini kutsi Simakadze utawuthatha umkhonzi wakho namuhla emhlane wakho?" Waphendvula watsi: "Ngiwazi; ungakhuluma ngalo."
UEliya watsi kuye: "Nceda, hlala lapha, ngoba uSimakadze ungithumela eJordane." Elisha wathi: "Ngiphila Simakadze, nangemphefumulo wakho, ngeke ngikushiye." Bahamba nabo bobabili.
Bahamba namadoda lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu emndenini wemaprofeti, bahlala eduze kwabo; Eliya kanye noElisha bahlala eJordane.
Eliya watsi: "Ngubani na lowo?" Eliya wakhipha imicambo yakhe, wayijika wayakubetha emanzini; lamanzi ahlukaniswa ngakwesokudla nekwesobunxele, badlula bobabili ngemhlabatsi.
Bafike badlula, Eliya watsi ku-Elisha: "Nceda ukhulume nami; yini lengingakwenza kuwe ngaphambi kokuba ngithathelwe kude nawe?" UElisha watsi: "Nceda unciphise umphefumulo wakho."
UEliya watsi kuye: "Ucela into ebuhlungu; kepha uma ungangibona lapho ngithathwa kuwe, uzoyithola; kodwa uma ungangiboni, awungeke uyithole."
Bahamba bekhuluma, babona imoto yemlilo nemahhashi emlilo aphuma emehlweni abo; Eliya wafika esibhakabhakeni, wafika emhlabeni.
Elisha wakubona, watsi: "Baba wami, baba wami, imoto yaSimakadze, nalabakhweli ba-Israyeli!" Akazange aphinde ambone; ngobe Elisha abewuthatha umgqomo wakhe, wawushiya yinye nenye.
Wayifaka imicambo yemanti leyayidliwe nguEliya, wabuyela emuva, wahlala emphemeni waseJordane.
Wathatha iingubo yakhe, leyo yaphuma emlenzeni waEliya, wayishaya amanzi, watsi: "Uphi uSimakadze, Nkulunkulu waEliya?" Wabetha amanzi, ahlukaniswa ngasekunene nakwesobunxele, Elisha wadlula.
Batsi bakubona, labaprofeti labasuka eJerikho, besithi: "Lomoya waEliya ukhona ku-Elisha." Bafika bamhlangana, bawubuka phansi ngemhlaba.

Baphendvula batsi: "Thina, labakhonzi bakho, sinebantfu labakhulu lamashumi mahlanu; bangaye bafune umphathi wakho; kungase kube nguMoya waSimakadze lowutfumele, uyawubeka emfuleni, noma emfulani." Elisha watsi: "Akekho, ungabathumelanga!"
Baye bakhuluma naye, watsi: "Thumelani!" Bathumela amadoda lamashumi mahlanu, afuna iminyaka emithathu, kodvwa awatholanga uEliya.
Babuyela kuye eJerikho, lapho ahlala khona. Wabaphendvula watsi: "Ngatsi yini kutsi ningayeki?!"
Batsi bantfu baseJerikho ku-Elisha: "Thiba, nkosi yami, lendlu iyindawo enhle, njengobe ubona; kepha amanzi angcolile, imhlaba ungeke ukhule kahle."
UElisha watsi: "Ninikele ibhotela elisha, nifake khona umhluzi." Bafike bamnike.
Waphuma waya emfuleni, wabeka khona umhluzi, watsi: "Kutsi kusho Simakadze: 'Ngikuphilise amanzi lawo; angeke aphinde abe ngumfutho wekufa, noma ukulimala kwemhlaba.' "
Lamanzi ayawuphiliswa kuze kube namuhla, njengobe Elisha abesho.
Ngawo Elishea wafika eBetheleli, kwathi lapho wayehamba ngendlela, kwafika abafana abancane besuka edolobhaneni, bekhuluma naye, besithi, Yiya phezulu, ubala, Yiya phezulu, ubala!
Wababona, wabuyela emuva, wabaphazamisa ngegama laSimakadze; khona-ke kwaphuma ema-orenji mabini emhlabatsini, abulala labakhwenyana labamashumi mane nalabahlanu.
Elisha wasuka khona waya emfuleni iKarmeli, wabuyela khona eSamariya.
UYoramu, umsa wa-Ahabhi, waba ngunkhosi yaseSirayeli eSamari, ngonyaka wesikhombisa nemashumi lamabili nalinye kaJosaphatsi, ukumkani wakwaYuda; waba neminyaka lelishumi nambili.
Wakwenza lokudla lokubi emehloni kaSimakadze, kepha akazange akwenze njengobe baba wakhe nababa bakhe babekwenza; wasusa ithempeli laBaali, labelibambisene nalo.
Wayehlala ekuhlukumezeni kwaYerobhoamu, unyana waNebati, lowawuyawutfumisa labaSirayeli kutsi bahlupheke; akazange ahambe kuwo.
Mesha, ukumkani waseMoabi, waba nemindeni leminingi; wanikela kunkhosi yaseSirayeli ngelilanga ngalinye ema-andele lamakhulu lamakhulu, nalomhlambi wema-andele lamakhulu lamakhulu.
Ase kube, ngemuva kwekufa kwa-Ahabhi, unkhosi yaMoabi yaphuma kunkhosi yaseSirayeli.
Kulelo lilanga unkhosi Joramu yaphuma eSamari, yahlanganisa bonkhe bantfu base-Israyeli kutsi bahlangane.

Wathumela kuJosaphatsi, ukumkani wakwaYuda, watsi: "Umkwetsi weMoabi ungishiya; uyawufika nami yini kutsi sihlangane naMoabi?" UJosaphatsi watsi: "Ngiya, ngiya nawe kulo lonke uhambo; abantu bami bangaba bantu bakho, nemahhashi ami angaba mahhashi akho."
Waphendvula watsi: "Ngayiphi indlela kumele sihambe?" Joramu watsi: "Ngendlela yetfu le-Edomu."
Wahamba ke ukumkani waseSirayeli, naye ukumkani wakwaYuda, naye ukumkani waseEdomu; wahamba nabo lilanga lesitsatfu, wafika lapho angeke kube khona amanzi emndenini wakhe, noma ekudlaneni kwabo.
Watsi ukumkani waseSirayeli: "Akekho, ngobe Simakadze ufike wahlanganisa lamakhosi lasitfupha kutsi atfuse eMoabi!"

Jehoshafati watsi: "Asekho lapha umprofeti waSimakadze, kutsi sikhulume noNkulunkulu ngaye?" Lomunye wabakhonzi bakankhosi yaseSirayeli waphendula watsi: "Asekho lapha Elisha, umsa ka-Shafati, lowawudlalela amanzi emilenzeni kaEliya."
UJehoshafati watsi: "UNkulunkulu ukhona naye." Ngako loMbuso waseSirayeli, noJehoshafati, kanye nobukhosi be-Edomu, babuyela kuye.

Elisha watsi kunkhosi yaseSirayeli: "Iyini inkinga yakho nami? Yeka uhambe ufike kumaprofeti bakababa wakho nemama wakho." Hezekiya waseSirayeli watsi: "Akekho, ngobe nguSimakadze lowubeka emabutfo lamakhulu mathathu emphilweni yethu, kutsi atawutinikela emkhosini waMoabi."
Elisha watsi: "Ngiphila Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, lowo nguNkulunkulu lokhuluma naye, uma sengingeke ngihloniphe uJosaphatsi, ukumkani wakwa-Yuda, angikuboneli wena, ngakucacelanga.
Ngako-ke, nifikeni nami nemuntfu lodlala icwecwe.'" 17Lemdlali wecwecwe waphuma emphilweni yakhe, bese kuyawufika amandla aSimakadze phezu kwaElisha.
Watsi: "Kuye kutsi uSimakadze uthe, 'Cinga tigodzi kulo mfula wonke.'
Simakadze utsi: Angeke nibone umoya, nasentwasahlobo, kodwa logwadule luya kugcwele amanzi; niyawudla, nani kanye nenyama yenu, nangetilwane zenu.
Lento ilula kuSimakadze, ngobe utawunikela neMoabi emandleni akho.
Uyawuhlasela wonke lamadolobha anemigodi, kanye nesiteji lesingenhla; utawubulala yonke isihlahla esihle, utawuvala imifula lemikhulu, nemhlaba wonke lomusha utawuwuphazamisa ngetintaba.
Kutsi kube sekuphele lilanga, lapho kulungiselelwa khona iminikelo yekushiswa yekusasa, kwafika amanzi esuka emgwaqeni we-Edomu; nemhlaba wawugcwele amanzi.
Batsi bakubona bonke bantfu baseMoabi kutsi labankhosi bafike behlasela, bahlangana nabo bonkhe labaholi babo, labancane nalabakhulu, bonke labo bangaba nemiyalelo yekulwa, bahlala emfuleni.
Besuka bavuka ekuseni kakhulu, ngobe lilanga lalibalekela emanzini; bese bebona emaMowabi asemaphandleni efulethini, lamehlo abo abemnyama njengaligazi.
Batsi: "Leli ligazi! Kube kungenxa yokuthi lamakhosi ahlasele, wabulalana; hlala lapha, uMowabi, sifike sithathe lokunye kwabo!"
Bafika emaMowabi emgwaqeni waSirayeli, laSirayeli baphakamisa isandla sabo, bahlasela, babaleka; bafika ezweni lababulala emaMowabi.

Babulala emadolobha, nabo bonkhe labaholi bemihlambi yabo bahlaba litshe labo ngalinye emhlabatsini lobuhle, kuze kube likhulu kakhulu; bavala imifula yonke, bacotsa isihlahla sonke esihle. Kuphela Kir-hareshethi kuphela lapho kwahlala khona umgwaqo wayo wegolide, kodvwa labakhonjiswe ngetibhande, bahlasela.
Wabona uMbuso waseMoabi ukuthi umkhosi utawuwuhlasela, wathatha lamadoda angamakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamane, aphuma emphini yakhe, afuna ukudlula kuye lobukhosi be-Edomu; kodvwa abakwazi.

Wathatha unyana wakhe lomkhulu, lowo abengeke abuye abe ngunkhosi esikhundleni sakhe, wamnikela ngemnikelo wekushiswa emnyango wendlu yakhe; wafika umsindo omkhulu kuSirayeli, baphuma kuye, babuyela ezweni labo.

Wafika umkakhe wesinye semindeni yemaprofeti, watsi kuElisha: "Umkhonzi wakho, lowesifazane wami, wafa, ngobe wayemhlonipha Simakadze; kodvwa manje uyawufika lowo angeke abe nemali yakhe, aze athathe labantwana bami bobabili abe ngutisebenti zakhe.
UElisha watsi kuye: "Ngingeke ngikwenze yini kuwe? Nceda ungangitshela kutsi uneni ekhaya lakho?" Yati, "Indvodzakati yakho ayisekho nalutho endlwini yami, ngaphandle kwengilazi lencane yemawoti."
Elisha watsi: "Hamba uhambe, ufune emabhodlela agcwele kubo bonkhe labangani bakho; thola njalo-njalo.
bese uya, uvale umva wakho wena nemadvodzana akho, ufafaze uphethiloli emabhodleleni lawo onkhe; bese lapho ligcwele khona, libeke phansi.
Waphuma, wavala umvalo ngemuva kwakhe naye nemadvodzana akhe; bafike bamniketa emabhodlela, yena wakhipha.
Wathi kuyise: "Nceda, nginike nelinye ingilazi." Waphendvula watsi: "Akukho linye ingilazi lekhona." Nalapho uphethiloli waphela.
Waye waya wayitshela lomuntfu waNkulunkulu, watsi kuye: "Hamba uthengise umsi, ukhokhe inhlawulo yakho; wena nemadvodzana akho nihlale niphila nalapho kusele khona.
Elisesha waya eSuneni, lapho kwabekhona indodana yenkhosi. Wayemcela kutsi ahlale khona abe nekudla; watsi kuye: "Kutsi-ke, uma udlula lapha, uhlala khona ube nekudla."
Watsi kumfazi wakhe: "Namuhla ngibona kutsi lomuntfu waNkulunkulu, lohamba nathi, ungcwele.
Ngeke sibuye senze igumbi lelincane embhedeni, sifake khona isibhedlela, netenti, nesihlalo, nelanga, kutsi uma efika nathi ahlale khona.
Kwatsi lilanga elinye Elisha waya, wafika embhedeni wakhe lophakeme, walala khona.
Watsi kuGhehazi, umkhonzi wakhe: "Vuma lowesifazane waseSunami." UGehazi watsi kuye: "Vuma!" Wafika wahlala phambi kwakhe.

Elisha watsi kuGhehazi: "Thinga kuye, 'Ufike ufike utfusa simo sethu; yini lesingakwenza kuwe? Ingabe singakhuluma nawe kunkhosi, noma kumphathi wesive?'" Wayiphendvula yatsi: "Ngihlala phakathi kwabantfu bami."
Elisha watsi: "Ngingeke ngikwenzeni yini?" Gehazi waphendula watsi: "Asekho mntwana wakhe, nomkakhe ubudala."
Elisha watsi: "Thipha yona." UGehazi wehla waya kuyo, wahlala emnyango.

Elisha watsi kuye: "Ngemnyaka lolandelayo, ngalolu sikhathi, utawuba nendvodza emlenzeni wakho." Wayiphendvula yatsi: "Kungeke kube njalo, umsa wami, muntu waNkulunkulu; ungamkhohlisi umkhonzi wakho!"
Lowesifazane wakhulelwa, wazala unyana ngeleso sikhathi semnyaka lolandelayo, njengobe Elisha abemphendvula watsi:
Wakhula lomunye umfana, waphuma ekuseni waya kuyise, watsi: "Ubaba wami uhlala nalabo basebenti bekulima.
Watsi kubaba wakhe: "Inhloko yami, ibuhlungu kakhulu." Ubaba wakhe watsi kumkhonzi wakhe: "Thumela kuye emama akhe."
Lomuntfu waSimakadze watsi kuye: "Ngubani nalowo mntwana?" 31Wamkhipha, wamnikela emama akhe; wangena emlenzeni wakhe kuze kube ngubusuku bokudla.
Wayikhipha, wayifaka embhedeni wemuntfu waNkulunkulu, yavala umvalo, yaphuma, yabuyela endlwini yakhe.
Wayibiza indodana yakhe, yatsi: "Thumela kimi, ngiyakucela, lomunye webantfu labancane kanye nedoli; ngizohamba ngejule kuye lowo muntu waNkulunkulu, bese ngibuyela."
Wathi kuye: "Ngubani na loya kuye ngalolusuku, ngobe angeke kube ngumnyaka mtfubi noma ngeSabhati?" Yatsi yena: "Kunekuhle."
Waye wamisa ibhutsi, watsi kulowo wesifazane wakhe: "Thintela bese uhamba ngokushesha; ungabi nenkinga nami kuze ngikutshele."
Waye waya, wafika kulowo muntu waNkulunkulu emfuleni iKarmeli; lapho lomuntfu waNkulunkulu akubona khona ngasenyakatweni, watsi kuGehazi, umkhonzi wakhe: "Bonani, lena ngumfana waseShunemi!
Watsi yena: "Kungekuhle kutsi uhambe ufike kuyawuhlangana naye, bese ukhuluma kuye utsi: 'Uphila kanjani? Nguwuphi umshado wakho? Nguwuphi umntwana wakho?'" Waphendula watsi: "Uphila."

Wafika lapho umkakhe waNkulunkulu efulethini, wabamba tinyawo zakhe. UGhehazi wehla waya kutsi ayisaleke; kodvwa lowo mkakhe waNkulunkulu watsi: "Lahla yena, ngoba ubuhlungu bakhe bukhulu kakhulu, ngobe Simakadze abemifihla, angicacisi yini."
Watsi yena: "Ngakucela yini wena, nkosi yami, umntwana? Ngakuphendvula ngitsi: 'Ungeke ungivumele ngifune'?"

Elisha watsi kuGhehazi: "Cinga ingubo yakho emlenzeni wakho, uthathe isandla sami, uyeke; uma uhlangana nanoma ngubani, ungawuhlanganisi; noma ngabe ubani ukhuluma nawe, ungawuphendulanga; bese ubeka isandla sami phezu kobuso bomuntfu."
Watsi: "Ngiphila Simakadze, netfu liphila, ngingakushiya." Elisha waphuma, walandela.
UGhehazi wadlula, wabeka isandla sakhe esihlalweni somfana; kodvwa kwatsi kungeke kube khona umsindo, noma lutho lokuphilako. Wabuyela wahlangana na-Elisha, watsi kuye: "Umfana akazange avuleke."
Ngako Elisha wafika endlwini, watsi: "Ngibona kutsi lomuntfu ufile embhedeni wakhe.
Elisha waphuma, wavala imnyango ngemuva kwabo bobabili, wathandaza kuSimakadze.
Ufike embhedeni, wehla phezu komntwana, umlomo kulomlomo, mehlo kulawo mehlo, nesandla kuleyo sandla; waphuma waya kuye, wamisa ubuso bakhe kutsi bufuduke.
UElisha wehla, wahamba ngendlu, wabuyela emuva nasemva kanye; watsi: "Njengomntwana lo!" Waphuma, wahlala phezu kwakhe. Lomntwana ukhwehlela izikhathi lesitsatfu, wavula amehlo akhe.
Elisha wayalela Gehazi, watsi: "Thipha lowesifazane waseSunami." Wamubiza, wafika, watsi kuye Elisha: "Thipha unyana wakho!"
Wayifika, waphuma, wehla emadolo akhe, wabuyela phansi emhlabatsini, watsi: "Ngubani na lowo muntfu?"

Elisha wabuyela eGilgala; kwabe khona ndlala kulomhlaba, nebantfu labaprofeti behlala phambi kwakhe. Watsi watsi kulowo wesifazane wakhe: "Thinda ibhodlela elikhulu, ulungiselele lokudla lokuphekiwe kubaprofeta balo."

Lomunye wabo waphuma emhlabatsini kutsi acule, wathola isihlahla setinsika, wavuna timbali tetinsika letiningi kakhulu kuze kube kufike kulomgqomo wakhe, wabuyela, watsatsa wazisa emgodini wekudla lokuphekwako, ngobe akazange azi ukuthi ziyini.
Bafike banikela kubo; baphuma bedla, batsi: "Umuntfu waNkulunkulu, lilanga lekufa likhona emgodini!" Bengeke bakwazi kudliwa.
Elisha watsi: "Nceda, nininike umhluzi." Wawubeka emgodini, watsi: "Ninikele kubo bonkhe bantfu kutsi baphile." Kusuka lapho kwangena lutho lokubi emgodini.

Kwafika umuntu eBaali-Shalisa, wanikela kumuntfu waNkulunkulu ngekudla lokungemashumi lamakhulu lamakhilogremu, lokudla lokungemashumi lamakhulu lamakhilogremu lokuphekwe ngeju, kanye nekudla lokungemashumi lamakhulu lamashumi lamakhulu lamakhilogremu lokuphekwe ngeju; watsi kuye Elisha: "Ninike labo bantu kutsi badle."
Watsi umkhonzi wakhe: "Ngingeke yini ngimise lokhu phambi kwamadoda lamakhulu?" Elisha watsi: "Nceda unciphise kulabo bantu kutsi badle; ngobe Simakadze utsi: 'Batawudla, baphindze batfole.'"
Wayibeka phambi kwabo, badla, kwatsi kube sekusele, njengobe Simakadze abekhuluma.

UNaamani waba nguMengameli wesive senkhosi yase-Aram, wabekwa phezulu kakhulu emphini yakhe, wahlonishwa kakhulu ngumphathi wakhe, ngobe ngesandla saNaamani Simakadze abewutfumisa umkhosi wase-Aram. Wabe uNaamani, lomuntfu lonamandla lokujikela enhliziyweni, naye wayenendlala yesikhumba.
Batsi bafika eSirayeli labahlaseli baka-Aram, baba nendvodzakati lencane, yaba ngumkhonzi womkakhe Naamani.
Waye watsi kunkhosi yakhe: "Kungeke kube kahle uma umphathi wami ehamba kuye lomprofeti lohlala eSamari, ngobe utawuwuphilisa umkhuhlane wakhe."
Namane waphuma, wakhuluma kunkhosi yakhe watsi: "Lendvodzakati yase-Isirayeli itsi: 'Ngikutshele.'"

Watsi ukumkani wase-Aram: "Thiba, ngiyawuthumela incwadi kumkani waseSirayeli." UNaamani wehla, athabathela esandla sakhe isiliva lelikhulu nemashumi lamane, negolide elinamaphesenti lasitfupha, naletigqoko letilishumi.
Waye waya kunkhosi yase-Israyeli, wathumela incwadi ethi: "Namuhla ngitfumele kuwe umkhonzi wami Naamani, kutsi uyawuwuphilisa umkhuhlane wakhe."

Unkhosi yaSirayeli, lapho ifunda khona incwadi yalencwadi, yatsi: "Ngabe ngiNkulunkulu yini? Ngawubulala yini lophilayo, nome ungawusindisa lofileyo? Lomuntfu uthumela kuye kutsi aphilise umdlavuza wakhe. Kubonakali sengathi ufuna kulwa nami."

UElisha, umuntu waNkulunkulu, lapho akubona kutsi unkhosi yaseSirayeli icwebile ingubo yayo, wayalela ukumkani waseSirayeli watsi: "Ngubani na lowo locwebile ingubo yakhe? Thumela yena kum, aze abone ukuthi kukhona umprofeti eSirayeli."
Wafika khona Naamane nemahhashi akhe, nemoto yakhe, wahlala emnyango wendlu kaElisha.
Elisha watsi kuye: "Thina-ke, phuma uhambe uphumule emaviki lasikhombisa eJordani; isikhumba sakho siyawubuyela kuwe, nawe utawuhlanzeka."

Naamani wagwema, wehla waya, watsi: "Ngibe ngicabanga kutsi utawuphuma, uyawuhlala khona, uyawucela igama laSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakhe, utawuphakamisa isandla sakhe phezu kwecala, uyawuphilisa umkhuhlane wami.
Asekho yini umfula waseDamaskus, iAbana neFarfara, longcono kunawo wonke amanzi aseSirayeli? Ngabe sengingeke ngiwudle khona, ngihlale ngihlanzekile?" Wabuyela emuva, waphuma ngebuhlungu.
Bafike bakhuluma naye, batsi: "Baba, uma umprofeti akusho kuwe into ebuhlungu, ngabe awuzange uyikwenze yini? Ngako-ke kungani ungayisebenzisi kutsi utsi: 'Lula bese uhlanzwa'?"
UNaamani wehla, wafika eJordane, wajikela kuwo emaphiko lasikhombisa, njengobe lomuntfu waNkulunkulu abekhuluma naye; nesikhumba sakhe sabuyela emuva, safana nesikhumba somntwana omncane, wahlanzeka.

UNaamani wabuyela kulowo muntu waNkulunkulu, yena nebantfu bakhe bonke, wahlala phambi kwakhe, watsi: "Namuhla sengikholwa kutsi angeke kube khona Nkulunkulu emhlabeni wonke ngaphandle kweSirayeli; namuhla, ngiyakucela, thola lomnikelo kusuka kumkhonzi wakho."
Elisha watsi: "Ngiphila Simakadze, loNkulunkulu wami, ngingawufogadi." Na-Naamani wakhuluma naye kutsi amnike, kodvwa yena akazange avume.

Namane watsi: "Uma ungafuni, ngikucela, vumelani umkhonzi wakho athathe imbewu emibili yengulube; ngobe umkhonzi wakho angeke abe nemnikelo wokushiswa noma wesondlo kulowo Nkulunkulu, ngaphandle kweSimakadze.

Lokwesinye sinqumo, uSimakadze asuse umkhonzi wakho kulolu daba: lapho umphathi wami ephuma ethempelini la-Rimoni kutsi abuke, ahlala enhliziyweni yami, ngase ngibeke phansi khona; lapho ngibeka phansi khona ethempelini la-Rimoni, uSimakadze asuse lomsebenzi womkhonzi wakho kuloludaba.
Elisha watsi kuye: "Hamba uhambe ngekuthula." Na-Naaman waphuma, wahamba umzuzwana.

Gehazi, umkhonzi wa-Elisha, indodana yaNkulunkulu, watsi: "Lomuntfu waseSiriya, loNaamani, umsebenti wakhe wawulula kakhulu, ngobe umphathi wami akazange athathe lokho abekulethela; ngiphila Simakadze, ngitahamba ngemuva kwakhe, ngifike ngifune lutho kuye."
Gehazi wehla walandela Naamani. NaNaaman, lapho akubona ehamba ngemuva kwakhe, waphuma enkundleni yakhe waya kuye, watsi: "Kulungile yini?"

UGehazi watsi: "Kulungile. Umphathi wami ungithumela kutsi angiti, 'Namuhla ngifike kulowo mhlabatsini wa-Efrayim labangani lababini abavela emndenini wemaprofeti; ngiyakucela utawubanikela ngesiliva lamashekeli lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa kanye nemgqomo lemibili yekudla."

UNaamani watsi: "Nceda, thola ema-shekeli lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa." Waye wancenga uGhehazi kutsi athathe lemali. Wayibeka emigodini emibili ngemigqomo emibili yekudla, wayawanikela kulabo labancane bakhe bobabili; nabo bayisa phambi kwakhe.
Wafika Gehazi, wakhipha esandlani labangani bakhe, wabafihla endlini, washiya laba bantu bahambe, batsi: "Tsimo senu silungile."
Wafika Gehazi, wahlala phambi kwenkhosi yakhe. Elisha watsi kuye: "Ube ukhona kuphi, Gehazi?" Waphendvula watsi: "Lomuntfu wakho akazange ahambe kuphi naphi."

Elisha watsi kuye: "Imoya yami ayikho nawe, lapho lomuntu ephuma ekhephuni lakhe ekusihlangana nawe? Nguleso sikhathi kutsi uthathe imali, nempahla, nemazayimane, namavini, nemfuyo, nabangani bakho nabangani bakho?
Nakho, ngesaba kutsi indlala ye- Naamani iyakushiya wena kanye nemadvodzana akho kuze kube sekupheleni.' " 20Ghehazi waphuma waya kuElisha; ngobe ubuso bakhe bebube bumhlophe njengethebhu.
Batsi kubo Elisha: "Bonani, lendawo lapho sihlala khona lapha kuwe incane kakhulu kuyena.
Sihambe sifike emfuleni iJordane, sithole khona lomunye nelinye licwecwe, sibuye sihlale khona. Elisha watsi: "Yiya!"
Watsi lomunye wabo: "Nceda, landzelana nalabakhonzi bakho." Elisha watsi: "Ngiyafika."
Wahamba nabo, wafika eJordane, baphindze bacubhukela tihlahla.
Lomunye wabo, lapho ecubha sihlahla, isandla sakhe sensimbi saphuma emanzini. Watsi: "Akekho, mkhulu, ngiyidlulile!"
Lomuntu waNkulunkulu watsi kuye, "Yadlwengula kuphi?"Wamukhombisa lendawo, watsi: "Elisa ucofe umkhonto, wawubeka emanzini, lakwenza insimbi ihambe ngaso.
Wathi kuye: "Thipha!" Wayiphakamisa isandla sakhe, wayithatha.
Unkhosi yase-Aram yahlasela bantfu beSirayeli, wakhuluma nabaholi bakhe, watsi: "Ngiya kuhlala lapha nasekhona, khona lapho ngizohlala khona."
Lomuntfu waNkulunkulu wabathumela kunkhosi yaseSirayeli, watsi: "Gcwalisa kutsi ungabi khona lapho, ngobe la-Arami baphuma khona."
Watsi unkhosi yase-Isirayeli yathumela kulapho lomuntfu waNkulunkulu abembutsa khona, watsi kuye: "Uyawufika lapha"; Elisha wehlilela kutsi afike lapho, kodvwa yena akazange afike.
Unkhosi yase-Aram yakhathazeka kakhulu ngalolu daba, watsatsa labaphathi bakhe, watsi kubo: "Ngubani nawaseSirayeli lokhuluma nenkhosi ye-Israyeli?"
Lomunye wabaholi bakhe watsi: "Akukho nani, nkosi yami, ngobe uElisha, umprofeti waseSirayeli, ukhuluma kunkhosi yaseSirayeli amazwi lawukhuluma embhedeni wakho."
Watsi ukumkani: "Niya, nibone lapho akhona khona, kutsi ngitawuthumela ngiwuthathe." Baphendvula batsi: "AseDothani."
Wathumela khona emabhubesi, nemikhumbi, nemkhosi lomkhulu; bafika ngebusuku, bamcosha umjikelo wedolobha.
Waphuma umkhonzi wemuntfu waNkulunkulu emini, wehla waya emehlweni akhe, watsi: "Lemikhosi nemahhashi namadivaysi lokugibela ligcwele ledolobha." Wathi kuye: "Asekho, unkhosi yami; yini sitawuyenza?"
Elisha watsi: "Ungakhathazeki, ngobe labo labakhona nathi bangamakhulu kunalabo abakhona nabo."

Elisha wathandaza watsi: "Simakadze, vule lamehlo akhe aze abone!" Simakadze wabavula lamehlo lomshado wakhe, wehla wayabona, wayibona intaba igcwele amahhashi namadivaysi emlilo emgwaqeni wase-Elisa.
Bafike baphuma kuye, Elisha wathandaza kuSimakadze, watsi: "Nceda, bulala laba bantu ngendlala!" Simakadze wababulala ngendlala, njengobe uElisha abekhuluma.
UElisha wabaphendvula watsi: "Lendlela ayikho leyiyo, nalesi sixeko asikho lesi; landzelani nami, ngiyawukulethela kulowo muntu niwufunayo." Wabahambisa waya eSamariya.
Bafika eSamariya, Elisha watsi: "Simakadze, vule amehlo lalaba bantu ukuze babone." UNkulunkulu wavula amehlo abo, babheka, babona, bese behlala emaphakathi neSamariya.
Watsi lapho inkhosi yaseSirayeli ibabubona, yaphendvula Elisha, yatsi: "Ngaba ngiyawubabulala yini? Ngabe ngiyawubabulala yini, tate?"

Elisha watsi kuye: "Ungababulala yini? Utawuwabulala kanjani lamadoda atfunywe ngesandla sakho kanye nentambo yakho? Nceda ubanike inyama namanzi, baphuze badle, bese ubavumele babuye babuyele kumphathi wabo."
Wabalungiselela khona umkhosi omkhulu, badla nabo baphuza, wabavumela bahambe beya kumphathi wabo. Lakwa-Aram akazange aphinde afike emazweni aseSirayeli.
Ngaleso sikhathi, uBenhadada, inkhosi yase-Aram, wahlanganisa lonke livi lakhe, waphuma waya eSamariya, wayibamba.

Kwaba nendlala enkulu enhliziyweni yaledolobha, kuze kufike lapho inhlavu yedoli ithengwa khona ngeshekeli lemashumi lamakhulu lamabili esiliva nalinye, kanye nembhoshongo wenyama yenkomo ngeshekeli letisihlanu zegolide.
Watsi lapho ukumkani waseSirayeli ehamba ngasemgwaqeni, kwafika indodana eyodwa yakhuluma kuye, yatsi: "Nceda, umsa wami!"
watsi kuye: "Kube Simakadze angeke akusize, yini lengingakusiza ngayo? Ingabe nginekudla lokusuka emgodini wesimo semhlabatsini, noma iwayini lokusuka emphekeni?"
