Unkhosi yathi kuye, "Ngubani na?" Yati, "Lowesifazane wakhuluma nami watsi, 'Ninise unyana wakho kutsi siwudle namhlanje, bese sidla unyana wami ngekusasa.'
Siwuphe unyana wami, sawudla; ngobe ngitsi kuye ngelilanga lesibili: Ninikele lomuntfu wakho kutsi siwudle; kodvwa yena wafihla lomuntfu wakhe.

Kungekucace kutsi, lapho ukumkani ekhuluma ngaleso sicanucano sendvodzakati yakhe, washiya iingubo zakhe, wahamba phezu kwedonga; ngobe labantfu bebona, bese babona kutsi, bona, ubenesigqoko lesingwevu ngaphansi kwesikhumba sakhe.
Watsi: "Nkulunkulu aninike lokhu kanye nalokunye, uma uElisha, umsa waShafati, ekugcineni kwakhe namuhla, inhloko yakhe ihlala emlenzeni wakhe!"

Elisha wahlala ekhaya lakhe, nabaholi bedolobha bahlala naye. Wathumela umthunywa phambi kwakhe; kodvwa ngaphambi kokuba umthunywa afike, uElisha watsi kubo: "Nibona yini kutsi lobulalayo uthumela lowo mkhwenyana ukuba anike inhloko yami? Namuhla, lapho umthunywa efika khona, vulani umvalo, niwuvale ngemuva kwakhe. Ngabe awukho umsindo wemilenze yomphathi wakhe enhliziyweni yakhe?"
Watsi lapho ekhuluma nabo, kwafika umlayezo kuye, watsi kutsi: "Kusuka kuSimakadze lokubi kwalo; yini lengingakulibala ngayo Simakadze? "

Elisha watsi: "Dlalela lizwi laSimakadze; Simakadze utsi: 'NgoLwesihlanu, ngaleso sikhathi, emnyango weSamariya, imitha lemibili yesiliva nelinye lesilivere, kanye nemitha lelishumi nesihlanu sejubane liyinye lesilivere.' "

Waphendula lowo mphathi, lomuntfu waSimakadze abehlala emphilweni yakhe, watsi kuye: "Nase Simakadze avule ifenisha entabeni, ngabe kungaba khona lokhu?" Elisha watsi: "Uyakubona ngamehlo akho, kepha awungeke udle kuyo."
Bakhona amadoda lamane anesifuba ahlala emnyango wedolobha, waphendvula watsi: "Ngubani na lohlala lapha kuze sife?"

Uma sitsi: 'Thinge sifike enhlokodolobha,' siyawufa khona; ngobe kukhona ndlala enhlokodolobha; kepha uma sihlala lapha, siyawufa. Lapha-ke, sihambe sifike emkhosini weSirayeli, senze kutsi batfume; bangasishiya basiphile; kodwa bangasibulala, sitawufa."
Baphuma, bafika emgwaqeni weSira; bafike ekugcineni komgwaqeni, ngobe kwakungasekho namunye umuntu lapho.
Ngako-ke uSimakadze wabakhipha emgwaqeni waSirayeli, watsi: "Kungekubi, ngobe unkhosi yaseSirayeli isebentise bobukhosi be-Hethi nabombuso we-Egipta kutsi bafike kubo."
Baphuma, babaleka ngasebusuku, bashiya tindlu tabo, nemahhashi abo, nemadlelo abo; bashiya lesitezi sakubo sengathi sikhona, babaleka kutsi bagcine kuphila kwabo.

Bafika emaphandleni, bafike etentini lelinye, badla nekudla, baphuza, bakhipha khona isiliva, negolide, naletigqoko, batsi: "Siye siyifihla." Babuyela, baphuma etentini lelinye, bakhipha nalo, balizifihla.
Batsi: "Lento esiyenzayo ayilungile. Namuhla ngusuku lwezindaba ezinhle, siyawuyigcina; uma sihlala kuze kube ekuseni, sitawugwenywa. Siye sesivulele endlu yasebukhosini, sifike sikhulume nabo."

Baye baphuma, bakhuluma kubo bonkhe bantfu labahlala emnyango wedolobha, batsi: "Sifike emgwaqeni wema-Aram, sabona kutsi angeke kubekho muntu khona, noma kungenaso sicobo somuntu; kwakukhona kuphela amahhashi nedlovukazi elalibandlululiwe, kanye netindlu letingenjalo.
Labahlengikazi baphuma bekhuluma ngalolu lwazi, kwatsi kucatshulwe ngaphakathi endlu yasebukhosini.

Unkhosi yavuka ngebusuku, yatsi kubaphathi bayo: "Ngitakusitshela kutsi laSirayeli bakwenzeni yini. Bayazi ukuthi sifile lilanga; baphuma emgwaqeni, basifihla emhlabatsini, besithi: 'Uma laSirayeli bephuma emizini yabo, sitawubabulala baphila, siyawufika emizini yethu.'"

Lomunye wabaholi bakhe watsi: "Kufanele kube nebantfu labathatha emabhubesi lamashumi lamabili emahhashi asele kuledolobha, kutsi uma bafa, bangabi nabuhlungu kunabo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli labashiywe lapha, kanye nabo bonke labo abafileyo; sitawubathumela sibone.
Bathatha khona imoto lemibili nemahhashi, unkhosi yathumela emphini la-Aram, yatsi: "Niye nibone."

Bafike balandela laSirayeli kuya eJordane, bebona indlela igcwele ingubo nempahla yekulwa, labaSirayeli babeyikhipha lapho behamba ngejubane. Labathunywa babuyela batsi kunkhosi: "Asekho namuntfu lophuma ezweni lelingu-Egipta.

Baphuma ke bantfu, bakhipha emphini yakwa-Aram; nemitha yesiliva lelikhulu lathengwa ngeshekeli eyodwa yegolide, nemitha yesiliva lelishumi nalinye lathengwa ngeshekeli eyodwa yegolide, njengobe Simakadze abesho.

Unkhosi yabeka umphathi wakhe, lowo abehlala emphilweni yakhe, kutsi ahlale emnyango; kodvwa labantfu bamshaya ngesandla emnyango, wafa, njengobe lomuntfu waNkulunkulu abesho, lapho ukumkani ephuma khona kuye.

Kutsi kube sekwenzeke njengoba lomuntfu waNkulunkulu abekhuluma kunkhosi, watsi: "Namuhla ngeleso sikhathi, imitha lelishumi nesikhombisa yejubane lizoba ngushekeli lelinye lesiliva, kanye nemitha lesitfupha nesihlanu segolide, emnyango weSamaria."
Lomuntfu waNkulunkulu wabaphendvula watsi: "NaseSimakadze avule ishaweni yasezulu, ngabe kungaba khona lokhu?" Elisha watsi: "Uyawukubona ngemehlo akho, kodvwa awungeke udle kuso."
Kuye kwaba njalo, ngobe labantfu batfumisa phansi emnyango, watsi: "Wafa!"

Elisha wakhuluma nomkakhe, lomunye wemadvodzana akhe, akazange amvuselele, watsi kuye: "Thiba uhambe wena nemndeni wakho, uyeke uhlale khona lapho ungahlala khona; ngobe Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli umeme ndlala, nayo yafika kulomhlaba iminyaka lesikhombisa."
Waphuma lowesifazane, wakwenza njengobe lomuntfu waNkulunkulu abesho; waya, yena nemndeni wakhe, wahlala ezweni laFilisti iminyaka lesikhombisa.
Wafika ekupheleni kweminyaka lesikhombisa, wabuyela ezweni laFilisti; waphuma waya kunkhosi, watsi: "Ngikubuyele indlu yami nemhlaba wami."
Lenkhosi yakhuluma naGehazi, umkhonzi wemuntfu waNkulunkulu, watsi: "Nceda ukhulume nami ngezinto zonke ezinkulu letiyawukwenta Elisha."

Bekungenjalo, lapho ekhuluma kunkhosi kutsi uElisha waphilasa umfana lofileyo, ngaleso sikhathi lendodana yakhe yafika icela ukumkani indlu yayo nemhlaba wayo. Watsi Gehazi: "Mphathi wami, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli! Lowo ngumkakhe, nalo lowo ngumkakhe, lowabulala Elisha."

Unkhosi yabuza lowesifazane, wakhuluma kuye; ngobe Simakadze abemnikela umphathi wakhe, watsi: "Nceda ubuyisele konkhe lokubekiwe lona, kanye nekudla kwakhe emhlabatsini kusukela kuleso sikhatsi lapho aphuma khona kuze kube manje."
Elisha wafika eDamaskus. UBehadada, inkhosi yase-Aram, wayefile. Bakhuluma kunkhosi batsi: "Umntu waNkulunkulu ufike lapha."
watsi kuHazayeli: "Thiba nemnikelo esandla sakho, uye kumhlangana lomuntfu waNkulunkulu, ubuze Simakadze ngaye, utsi: 'Ngizophiliswa yini kulolugciwane?'"

UHazayeli wehla wahlangana na-Elisha, watsi: "Nginesibopho sekudla lokuhle lokusuka eDamaskus, nginetimfuyo letilishumi elinamashumi lamane." Wafika, wahlala phambi kwakhe, watsi: "Unyana wakho uBenhadadi, ukumkani wase-Aram, ungithumela kutsi ambuze ukuthi: 'Ngizophiliswa yini kulesi sifo?'"
Elisha watsi kuye: "Thiba, utsi kuye: 'Uya kukhululeka;' kodvwa Simakadze ungikhombisa kutsi uya kufa."
UElisha wehla emehlo akhe kuHazayeli, kuze angeke akhululeke; ngobe lomuntfu waNkulunkulu abelile.

UHazayeli watsi kuye: "Ngubani na wena, nkosi yami?" Elisha watsi kuye: "Ngiyazi kutsi utawubambisa kanjani bantfu beSirayeli; utawubeka emathempeli abo emlilo, uyawubulala labangane babo ngekhebhu, utawubulala labancane babo, utawuvula abesifazane babo labakhulelwe."
UHazayeli watsi: "Ngingeke ngikwenze yini lomsebenzi wakho, ngobe sengumkhwenyana?" Elisha watsi: "Simakadze ungikhombisa kutsi uzoba ngunkhosi yase-Aram."
UHazayeli washiya Elisha, wabuyela kumphathi wakhe. UBenahadadi watsi kuye: "Utsi yini lokushoyo nguElisha kuwe?" UHazayeli watsi: "Wathi kutsi utawuphiliswa."
Kwatsi ngelilanga lesibili, Hazayeli wakhipha umlenze, wawumisa emanzini, wawubeka phezu kwebuso bakhe, waya kufa; watsi uHazayeli waba ngunkhosi endaweni yakhe.
Ngomnyaka wesihlanu waYoramu, umsa ka-Ahabhi, waba ngunkhosi yaseSirayeli; naJosaphat, umsa ka-Jehoshaphat, waba ngunkhosi yaseYuda.
Wabe ubudala beminyaka lemashumi lamane nambili kutsi abe ngunkhosi, wadzala iminyaka lengema-8 eYerusalem.
Wayehamba ngendlela yamakhosi aseSirayeli, njengendlu ka-Ahabhi beyihambe ngayo; ngobe waba nendodana ka-Ahabhi; wakwenza lokudla lokubi emehloni kaSimakadze.
Kodwa-ke, uSimakadze akazange afune ukubhubhisa eYuda, ngenxa yaDavide, umkhonzi wakhe, njengoba abesho kutsi utawunika uDavide nemadvodzana akhe isibani sonke.
Ekubeni uYoramu ungukumkani, Edomu yaphuma kubukhosi benkhosi yaseYuda, yaba ngumphathi wayo.

UYoramu wafika eZayiri, naye nemindeni yakhe leyayihamba ngetibhayela; kodvwa laba-Edomu babemcophelela yena nabaholi betibondza lakhe. Waphuma ngasebusuku, wabahlasela, watsi: "Lowo mkhosi ufike etindlini zawo."
Ngako-ke iEdomu yaphuma ngaphansi kwesandla seYuda, kuze kube namuhla; neLibna nayo yaphuma ngalolusuku.
Lokunye lokushiwo nguYoramu, naleyo yonke imisebenzi yakhe, akubonako kubhalwe encwadini yemlando wamakhosi eYuda?
UYoram waphumula, wahlala nababa bakhe, wafunwa edolobhani laDavide; uAhaziya, umsa wakhe, waba ngunkhosi yakhe.
Ngomnyaka wesikhombisa waJoramu, unyana waAhabhi, waba ngunkhosi yaseSirayeli, Ahaziya, unyana waJoramu, waba nguMbuso waseYuda.

Ahaziya ubeneminyaka lemashumi lamane nambili ubudala lapho aphuma khona ebukhosini, waba ngunkhosi iminyaka lelishumi elinesihlanu eJerusalema; umzali wakhe waba nguAthaliya, intombi ka-Omri, ukumkani waseSirayeli.
Wahamba ngendlela yendlu ka-Ahabhi, wakwenza lokubi emehloni kaSimakadze, njengendlu ya-Ahabhi, ngobe waba ngumndeni wakwa-Ahabhi.
Wahamba naJoram, umsa wa-Ahabhi, ekulwa neHazayeli, ukumkani waseSiriya, eRamothi-gileyadi; kodvwa baSiriya babulala Joram.

Wasuka ke ukumkani Joramu, wabuyela eJezreyeli kutsi aphiliswe kulawo magciwane abewabulala ema-Arami eRama, lapho ayedlalwa khona nguHazayele, inkhosi yama-Aram; kodvwa Ahaziya unyana kaJoramu, umkwetsi wenkhosi yaseYuda, wehla waya eJezreeli ukubhekana noYoramu, umsa kaAhabhi, ngobe wabanjwa.
Elisha umprofeti watsi kumunye webantfu labashumayela, watsi kuye: "Thintela ingubo yakho emlenzeni wakho, uthathe lebhodlela lelincane lamafutha, uye eRamoti-gileyadi.
Ufike khona, ufune Jehu, umsa waJosaphatsi, umsa waNimshi; uye kuye, umsuse emehlweni labangani bakhe, umnike egumbini leliseceleni.
bese uthatha ibhodlela lemafutha, ulayishe phezu kwehlavu lakhe, utsi: UNkulunkulu uthe kutsi: 'Ngikuphekile wena ube ngunkhosi yaseSirayeli.' Uvule umvalo, uhambe, ungabi nenkinga.
Waye ke lomuntfu lomncane, lowo mprofeti, waya eRamoti-Gileyadi.
Wafika, wabona labaholi besive behlala ndawonye, watsi kubo: "Nginekukhuluma nawe, uMengameli." Jehu watsi: "Kuwuphi lomunye wenu?" Waphendvula watsi: "Kuwe, uMengameli."
UJehu wehla, wafika ekhaya, wageza umsi phezu kwehlavu lakhe, watsi kuye: "Ngitsi Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, ngikuphekile wena ukuba ube nguMengameli webantfu baka-Israyeli baSimakadze.

Uya kubulala indlu yaSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, bese ukhipha indlu ka-Ahabhi umphathi wakho; ngobe ngitayisa eJezebeli igazi labangani bami labaprofeti, negazi lalabo bonke abakhonzi bakaNkulunkulu, labeyababulala.
Lomndeni wonke wa-Ahabhi utawufa, ngobe ngitawususa lowesifazane wendlu ya-Ahabhi eSirayeli, nalowo ongeke abe ngumkhonzi, nalowo ongeke abe ngumuntfu.
Ngitakwenza indlu yaAhabhi ibe njengendlu yaYerobohamu, umsa waNabati, nendlu yaBaesha, umsa waAhiya.
Lamadodana akhe ayawudla iJezebeli emgwaqeni weJizreyeli, kodvwa ngeke kubekho lowo loyawuyifaka.'" Wavula umnyango, wabaleka.

UJehu wehla waphuma waya kubaholi benkosi yakhe, watsi kuye lomunye wabo: "Kunekuthula yini? Ngubani na lowo muntfu lomdlovukazi lofika kuwe?" Jehu watsi: "Lowo muntu uwazi, kanye nezinto akhuluma ngazo."
Baphendvula batsi: "Kungeke kube njalo; khuluma nathi." Jehu watsi: "Wakhuluma nami, watsi: 'Ngitsi Simakadze, ngikuphekile wena ube ngunkhosi yaseSirayeli.'"
Baye bahamba, bawasusa lamacala abo, wabeka ngaphansi kwa-Yehu emadolobheni, baphuza inkungu, batsi: "Yehu ubengunkhosi!"
Ngako Jehu, umsa waJosaphatsi, usana lwakhe laNimshi, waba yinkohlakalo kuYoramu; (Joram nalaba bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli babehlala eRamathi-gileyadi, ngenxa yaHazayeli, ukumkani waseSirya.)

Unkhosi Joramu yabuyela eJizreyeli kutsi iphilise emacwecwe ayo, lawaseSiriya abembulala lapho ahlasela khona Hazayeli, inkhosi yaseSiriya. Jehu watsi kuye: "Wena-ke, uma ukhona nami, ngeke kube nemuntu lophuma emizini leya kukhuluma eJizreyeli."
UYehu wafika eJezreeli, watsi: "Joram ufile," ngobe Ahaziya, inkhosi yakaJuda, wayesele afike aze ambone Joramu.

Watsi lapho umkhonzi lohlala emgodini waseJizreyeli ebona livi laJehu lifika, waphendvula watsi: "Ngibona imindeni lemikhulu." UYoram wathi: "Thuntela lomkhweli wakhe afike abonise kutsi baphuma ngekuthula?"

Waphuma umkhweli, wahlangana naYehu, watsi: "Umkwetsi uthi, 'Ufika ngekuthula yini?'" Jehu watsi: "Ngubani wena lokhuluma ngekuthula? Thumela emuva kwami!" Umkhonto wenkhosi ufike wabatshela, watsi: "Lomthunywa ufike kubo, kodvwa akabuyeli."
Unkhosi yathumela umkhwenyana wesitsatfu, wafika kubo, watsi: "Umkwetsi uthi, 'Ukuthula yini?'" Jehu watsi: "Ngubani na wena lokhuluma ngekuthula? Thumela emuva!"
Wakhuluma lowo umkhonzi, watsi: "Wafika kubo, kepha akabuyeli; kuhamba kwakhe kufana nokuhamba kweYehu, unyana kaNimshi; ahamba njengemuntfu lophukile."

UYoram watsi: "Nciphisa imoto yami." Baphuma, uYoram, ukumkani waseSirayeli, noAhaziya, ukumkani waseYuda, ngamunye wabo ebhasini lakhe, bahlangana naYehu; bahlangana naye ensimini yaNabothi waseJezreyeli.

UJoram, lapho ebona khona Jehu, watsi: "Kunekuthula yini, Jehu?" Jehu waphendvula watsi: "Ngabe kungeke kube nekuthula, uma i-Jezebeli, umnandza wakho, ikhuluma ngemikhosi yayo kanye nemfihlakalo yayo?
UYoramu wabuyela emuva ngecarriole yakhe, wabaleka, watsi ku-Ahaziya: "Kubi, Ahazia!"
UYehu wehlisa isandla sakhe, wabulala uYoramu phakathi kwemilenze yakhe; umlenze waphuma enhliziyweni yakhe, waba mnyama ekarithini lakhe.

Watsi Jehu ku-Bidkari, umphathi wemoto yakhe: "Thiba, wufake emhlabatsini lwaNabothi wase-Jezreyeli; khumbula lapho mina nawe sihamba khona kanye ngemuva kuka-Ahabi, ubaba wakhe, lapho Simakadze akhuluma khona ngalomazwi lawa kuye:

"Ngikubone igazi laNabhothi, neligazi lemadvodzana akhe, ngelilanga lelidlule," kusho Simakadze, "lasesiteji lesi, ngobe ngitakusibuyisela kuwe,' kusho Nkulunkulu. 'Ngaye uthathe lomuntfu, uyeke kuleso siteji, njengobe Simakadze abesho."

UAhaziya, ukumkani wakwaYuda, lapho ekubona khona, wabaleka waya emgwaqeni wase-Bet-hagani; Jehu wehla emuva kwakhe, watsi: "Vula naye!" Bamubulala ngemoto yakhe ekuhambeni kweGuri, enhliziyweni ye-Ibleam. Waphuma eMegido, wafa khona.
Amakhosi akhe ayawufaka eJerusalema, waphindze wafunwa nguSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, watsi: "Thina sitawukwenta kutsi umsebenti wakhe uphele.
UAhaziya waba ngunkhosi yaseYuda eminyakeni lelishumi elinanye yaJehoramu, umsa wa-Ahabi, ukumkani wakwaSirayeli.
Jehu wafika eJizreyeli. Ngako-ke, lapho iJezebeli ikubona lokhu, yabeka mehlo ayo, yamisa inwele zayo, yabheka ngaphandle kwetebhu.
Wayefika emnyango, yatsi: "Kunekuthula yini, uZimri, lowo lobulala umphathi wakhe?"
UYehu wehlisa imehlo akhe emnyango, watsi: "Ngubani loyawungisekela? Ngubani?" Batsi labaphathi bendlu yasebukhosini lababili noma bathathu babheka phansi.
Watsi Jehu: "Tshubulani!" Bawushubula, waphuma umfucuko wegazi lakhe emnyango nasemahhashini; lamahhashi ayawuphuca lilanga.
UJehu wafika, wadla nekudla, watsi: "Thintela lowo muntfu lolamisiwe, nimfunse; ngobe ube yindvodzakati yebukhosi."
Baye baphuma beyawuyifaka, batsi: "Asekho lutho lokushiwo, ngaphandle kwekhanda lakhe, nemilenze yakhe, nesandla sakhe."
Babuyela bakhuluma kuJehu, yena watsi: "Kuye kube njalo njengoba uSimakadze washo ngesandla semuntfu wakhe uEliya waseTishbi, watsi: 'Emgwaqeni weJizreyeli, inja itawudla inyama kaJezebeli.
Nalenyama yeJezebeli itawube seyifana nekudla lokudliwe emhlabatsini, ezweni leJizreyeli, kuze kungeke kube khona lokhuluma kutsi: Lowo nguJezebeli.'"

Abe nguAhabhi labenemadvodzana amashumi lamabili nesikhombisa eSamari; Jehu wabhala lamagama, wabathumela eSamari kubaholi baJezreyeli, nakwabaphathi, nakwalabo labaphazamisa labantwana baka-Ahabhi, watsi:
"Namuhla, lapho lolubhalo lufika kuwe, khumbula kutsi nine izingane taSimakadze Nkulunkulu wenu, kanye nemoto yekulwa, nemahhashi, nedolobha lelinetingqikithi, kanye nemfuyo yenu.
khetheni longcono nalowo ohamba phambili emndenini waSimakadze Nkulunkulu wenu, umubeke esihlalweni sebukhosi sababa wakhe, nihlangane ngendlu yaSimakadze Nkulunkulu wenu.
Baze bakhathazeka, batsi: "Mabukhosi lababili angeke abe nemandla lokuwumelana naye; ngobe sitawuba khona kanjani?

Watsi lowo wabeka phansi indlu, nalowo wasemgwaqweni, nebaholi, nalabo labaphazamisayo bathumela kuYehu, besithi: "Sibe tikhonzi zakho; siyawukwenza konke lokutsi wena. Singeke sinike umuntu isikhundla sokuba ngunkhosi; yini lekuhle emehlo akho, uyenze."

Jehu wababhalela incwadi yesibili, watsi kubo: "Uma ningami, futhi uma nikhuluma ngamazwi ami, nifikeni nami ngekusasa ngalolu suku eJizreyeli, nani nenhloko yalabo bantfu labalishumi elinasishiyagalombili, labangane benkhosi, abakhulekwa ngabakhulu balo mji.
Bafike befika kulo mbhalo, batsi: "Thina-ke sitawukhipha lamadodana enkhosini lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa, siyawuwabulala, sitawubeka inhloko yabo emabhokisini, siyawuyisa kuye eJezreyeli."
Wafika umthunywa, wakhuluma kuJehu, watsi: "Bafike banikela ngenhlavu yemadvodzana ankhosini." Jehu watsi: "Nizibeke emgodini wenhloko yedolobha ematshe lamibili, kuze kube ekuseni."

Kwatsi kube ngekusasa, Jehu waya ngaphandle, wahlala phambi kwebantfu bonke, watsi kubo: "Ningakabi necala; ngibe nguwo lowo lobeke isandla sakhe emkhondweni wami, ngawubulala; kepha bangabaphi labo lababubulala?
Ngenani leli, khumbulani kutsi kungeke kube nelinye lamagama aSimakadze akhuluma ngendlu ka-Ahab; Simakadze utawukwenza lokudla kwakhe lokuye watsi ngaso mkhonzi wakhe Eliya.
UYehu wababulala bonke labashiywa nguAhabhi e-Jezreyeli, nalabakhulu bakhe, nebangane bakhe, nalabaphatsimandla akhe; akazange ashiye namunye lophila.
UJehu wehla waya eSamariya, wafika eBethe-ekedi, lapho labahlengikazi bekhulisa khona tingulube zabo.
Wahlangana nabangani baka-Ahaziya, inkhosi yaseYuda; watsi kubo: "Nibani?" Baphendvula batsi: "Sibengabanani ba-Ahaziya; sifikile lapha kutsi sibone labantwana benkhosi, nemadvodzana ankosikazi."
UYehu watsi: "Thiphani baphila." Bathi, "Thiphani baphila," wabulala lamadoda lamashumi lamane namakhulu lamabili nesihlanu efulethini leBethe-Eked; akazange ashiye namunye kubo.

Waye waya khona, wahlangana naJonadabu, unyana ka-Rekabu, esuka emyalweni wakhe. Wayemlalela, watsi kuye: "Ungikholwa yini kimi, njengobe ngikukholwa wena?" Waphendula Jonadabu watsi: "Ngiyikholwa." Jehu watsi: "Uma ungumKristu, nikela ngesandla sakho!" Uye wamnika isandla sakhe, wehla naye ehhashini.
Jehu watsi kuye: "Thinda nami, bese ubona kutsi nginetfu lokukhulu kuSimakadze."Jonadabu wahamba naye ekarikhe.
Wafika eSamari, wabulala bonke labashiywa nguAhabhi eSamari, wayabasusa, njengobe Simakadze abesho kuye Eliya.
Jehu wahlangana nabo bonkhe bantfu, watsi kubo: "Ahabe wabambisana neBhaali kancane; Jehu utawubambisana naye kakhulu.

"Ngaleso sikhatsi Jehu wakhuluma kubo, watsi: "Namuhla nifike nihlangane nalabaprofeti bonke ba-Baali, nabo bonkhe labakhonjiswe nguBhaali, nabo bonkhe labaphatsimandla bakhe; angeke kube khona lowo ungekho, ngobe ngizonikela ngemnikelo lomkhulu ku-Baali. Nalowo longeke afike, uyafa."
Watsi Jehu: "Bukelani kuhlangana lokungcwele kuBaali." Bayawububula.
UYehu wabathumela kuwo wonke lamakhosi aseSirayeli, bafike bonke labakhonzayo uBahali; akazange ashiye namunye kubo. Bafika endlwini ka-Bahali, kuze igcwele kusukela kwelinye icala kuya kwelinye.
UYehu watsi kulowo owayehlala ebhokisini lemigqomo: "Thinda imigqomo kubo bonke labakhonti ba-Baali." Wakhipha imigqomo yabo.

Wafika khona Jehu neJonadabu, umsa wa-Rekabu, endlwini kaBhaali; Jehu watsi kubo bonkhe labakhonta kuBaali: "Thintela nibone kutsi angeke kubekho lapha nani nalabakhonta kuSimakadze, kepha bangabakhonti baBaali kuphela."

Bafike banikela ngemnikelo wekushiswa nemnikelo wesono. Jehu wabeka phandle amadoda lamashumi lamakhulu lasitfupha, watsi kubo: "Lomuntfu loyawushiya namunye webantfu labengitawubanikela kuwe ahambe, ungeke abe nekuphila kwakhe."

Athi ke Jehu, lapho aphelelwe khona ekunikela ngesondlo somlilo, kulabo labahamba phambili nalabaphambukeli, watsi kubo: "Ngeni, babulala; ngeke kube nemunye lophuma." Bawabulala ngesandla sabo. Labo abahamba phambili nalabaphambukeli babakhipha, bafika endlwini kaBaali.
Baphuma ethempelini laBaali, bakhipha ema-ashtorethi abo, bayawuwabulala.
Babulala ithempeli laBaali, babulala nendlu yaBaali, bayiguqula ibe yindawo yekuphumula, kuze kufike ngalolusuku.
Ngako-ke Jehu wasusa uBaali eSirayeli.
Ngako-ke uYehu akazange ahambe ekufeni kwezintombi taYarobhoamu, umsa waNebati, lowawuyawukwenza laSirayeli abe nezintombi tegolide eBheteli naDani.

USimakadze watsi kuYehu, "Ukwenze kahle ekuphumeleni kwakho lokulungile enhliziyweni yami; ngaso sonke sinqumo sami sendlu ka-Ahabhi, wakwenza kahle. Amakhosikazi akho azohlala ebukhosini beSirayeli kuze kube yiminyaka lemine."
Kodwa-ke, Jehu akazange acabangele kutsi ahambe ngemtsetfo waSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, ngentliziyo yakhe yonke; akazange abuyele emibiweni kaYerobohabhi, lowawuyawubeka iSirayeli embi.
Ngaleso sikhathi uSimakadze waqalisa kutsila laSirayeli, watsi: "Hazayeli wababulala emaphandleni abo onke."
Wayikhipha iJordani, kanye nemhlaba wonke weGileyadi, lapho behlala khona labaGadhi nalabaRubeni nalabaManasethi, kusukela eAroeri ensimini yaseArnon, kuze kube yiGileyadi neBashani.
Lokunye lokushiwo nguYehu, naleyo yonke imisebenzi yakhe, nemandla akhe, akusho yini kutsi kubhalwe encwadini yemlando wamakhosi ase-Israyeli?
Jehu walala naye, wabanjwa eSamari; uJoahazi, umsa wakhe, waba ngunkhosi yakhe.
Jehu waba ngunkhosi yaseSirayeli eSamari, iminyaka lemashumi lamane nesikhombisa.
Ataliya, umsa waAhaziya, lapho ebona kutsi unyana wakhe ufile, wehla abulala bonkhe labazalwa ngubukhosi.

Lakho Jehosheba, intombi kankhosi Jehoramu, indvuna ye-Ahaziya, yathatha uYoashi, unyana wa-Ahaziya, wayisusa emehlweni labaholi labangeke babulawa, wayifihla yena nalowo owayemfuyi wakhe ekamelweni lokuphumula; kodvwa Ataliya akazange amthole, watsi: "Uyawufa!"
UYoashi wahlala naye, nalowo layawumvikela endlwini yaSimakadze iminyaka lemibili; Ataliya ke waba ngunkhosi yelizwe.

Ngomnyaka wesikhombisa uYehoyada, umLevi, wathumela wayawamukela labaholi bemikhulu, nalabo base-Kerethi, nalabo base-Gideoni, wababeka endlwini kaSimakadze, wakwenza nabo sivumelwano khona, wabakhipha emkhondweni ethempelini likaNkulunkulu, wababonisa unyana womkwetsi.
Wabaphendvula watsi: "Lelu hlelo lokufanele nilugcine: Lomunye wesikhombisa wenu, labaphuma ngeSabhati, kumele bagweme indlu yebukhosi.
Lomunye utawuhlala emnyango weSur, lomunye utawuhlala emnyango waseSuri, kanye nomunye utawuhlala emnyango osuka ngasemuva kwalabo abagcina tindlu.
Lemihlangano yenu lemibili, labo labaphuma emsebentini ngeSabhati, kumele bayigcine indlu yaSimakadze kutsi igcinwe ngunkhosi.
Batsi: "Nifikeni kunkhosi, niyibambe ngesandla sibhakabhaka senu; nalowo loyawufika emgwaqeni wenu kumele abulawe. Nihlale eduze kwenkhosi lapho iphuma khona."

Labaholi bemikhulu yamakhulu bakwenza njalo, njengobe uYehoyada umsa waSimakadze abewaphendvula watsi: "Lowo muntfu waSimakadze uyawufika eJerusalema ngelilanga leSabhati, ngobe livi lakhe litsi: 'Inkhosi yami iyafika.'
Umnikelo wekushiswa wabanikela kubo, abebeka emacwecwe kanye nemingcele yenkhosi Davide, leyayisendlwini kaSimakadze.
Batsi babeka lamaphoyisa, wonke anesibhakabhaka sakhe esandlani sakhe, kusuka ecaleni lasenyakatho lendlu kuya ecaleni lesempumalanga yendlu, ngase-altari nasenkabeni yendlu, emgwaqeni wenkhosi.
Joyadi wakhipha unyana wenkhosi, wamisa phezu kwakhe isiliva negolide, watsi: "Namuhla ngikunikela kuwe kutsi ube nguSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli naNkulunkulu wama-Israyeli."
Ataliya, lapho elalela khona umsindo wema-Israyeli, wafika kulowo mkhosi endlwini yaSimakadze.
Wabona, wabona ukumkani ehlala eduze kwesihlalo sebukhosi, kanye nabaholi benkhosi nelabo labaphuza timphimbo; nabo bonkhe bantfu belizwe baphumula, baphuza timphimbo. Atalaliya watsi: "Kubi! Kubi! "

UJehoyada, umsa waSimakadze, watsi kubaholi bemashumi lamakhulu, lababekwe phezu kwemkhosi, watsi: "Niyiphumeze emehlweni ebantfu, nalowo loyawuya ngemuva kwayo, bulala yena!" ngobe uSawula abesho kutsi: "Akufanele abulawa endlini yaSimakadze."
Bafike beyibulala lapho yafika khona ekungeneni kwendlu yasebukhosini, wabulawa khona lapho.
UYehoyada wamisa isivumelwano phakathi kweSimakadze, nenkhosi, nalaba bantu, kutsi bangabe babantu beNkulunkulu; wamisa nesivumelwano phakathi kwenkhosi nalaba bantu.

Bafike bonke bantfu belizwe endlwini kaBhaali, batsi: "Siyiphula lendlu yaBhaali; sibulale ema-altari ayo kanye nemifanekiso yakhe yegolide. Babulala naMatani, umpristi waBhaali, phambi kwalama-altari."

Waba nebaholi bemashumi lamakhulu, nabahlengikazi, nabahlengikazi, nabo bonkhe bantfu belizwe, wabeka lobukhosi phansi endlwini yaSimakadze, wafika ngendlela yesango lebahlengikazi, waya endlu yasebukhosini. UMbuso waseRoma wehla esihlalweni sobukhosi.
Batsi bonke bantfu belizwe baphumula, nalapho lomhlaba uhlala khona; kodvwa Ataliya wabulawa ngesandla endlwini yaSimakadze.
UYoashi ubeneminyaka lesikhombisa ubudala lapho afika ebukhosini.
Ngomnyaka wesikhombisa waYehu waseSirayeli, uYoashi waba ngubukhosi; waba ngunkhosi iminyaka lemashumi mane eJerusalema; umzala wakhe waba nguSibiya waseBher-sheba.
UYoashi wakwenza lokuhle emehloni kaSimakadze, iminyaka yonke leJehoyada, umLevi, abemfundisa ngayo.
Kuze kube tindzawo letiphakeme tingakasuswa; bantfu bahlala benikela khona ngeminikelo yekushiswa netfufu.

Watsi uYoashi kubaLevi: "Nciphisani yonke imali yezinto letingcwele letifakwa endlwini yaSimakadze, izimali zebantfu labafunwa, nezimali zeminikelo yekushiswa, nezimali letiboniswayo ngesandla ethempelini laSimakadze.
Lomnikelo wekushiswa kumele uthathwe ngulowo mnikelo wesono, ngalowo mnikelo wesono lotawufakwa endlu yaSimakadze.'
Kusemnyaka wemashumi lamane nasitfupha wasebukhosini buka-Yoashi, labaLevi babengeke balungise indlu yaSimakadze.

Watsi unkhosi Joashi yabiza iJehoyada, umLevi, nalabaLevi, yatsi kubo: "Ngubani na longeke alungise lendlu? Ngakho-ke ningeke nithathe imali kulabo labasebenza kwenu; nikelani ngayo kutsi nilungise lendlu."
Labaholi bebandla bavuma kutsi bangakhokhi lutho kubantfu, futsi bangabi nesibopho sokulungisa indlu yaNkulunkulu.

UJehoyada, umLevi, wathatha ibhokisi, wavula umnyango wayo, wayibeka eduze kwethempeli lase-Israyeli, ngasekudla lapho befika khona endlwini yaSimakadze. Lamadodana laLevi agcina umngcele ayewafaka kulo bhokisi lonke lemali labelifakwa endlwini yaSimakadze.
Nalapho bebona khona imali leningi ebhokisini, wafika umbhali wenkhosi kanye nesikhulu semabhishobho, babala izimali letifakwa endlwini yaSimakadze, babeka emabhokisini.
Baye banikela lemali emandlani lalabo labaphatha umsebenzi wendlu yaSimakadze, lababeka emakhazeni nalabakhonzi, labasebenza emsebenzini wendlu yaSimakadze,
Nabo banikela ngemali yabo kulabo labahamba ngetinyawo, nalabakhonta ematshe, nalabacosha ematshe, kutsi babuye balungise indlu yaSimakadze, kanye nezinto zonke ezidingekayo ukuze ilungiswe.
Ngemali labeyifakwa endlwini yaSimakadze, akazange afake emabhodlela esiliva, nemacwecwe, nama-altare, nama-trumpets, noma siphi nasinye isikhwama segolide nome sesiliva esibekwe endlini.
Baye bayinikela kubo labasebenzela, basebenzisana nabo ekulungiseni indlu yaSimakadze.
Bafike bacela labaphathi kutsi babeke icala ngemali yabo, ngobe bebengabi nebuhlakani buphelele.
Lemali yemnikelo wesono, neyemnikelo wekushiswa, akazange ayingenise endlwini yaSimakadze; yayiyawuba yiyo yamaLevi.
Ngeleso sikhathi Hazayeli, ukumkani wase-Aram, wahlasela eGathi, wayawuyibulala; watsi: "Ngiye kuJerusalema, ngibuye ngekulwa nalo.

UYoashi, ukumkani wakwaYuda, wathatha zonke izinto ezingcwele abezinikela ngazo uJosaphat, noYoram, noAhaziya, bantfu bakhe bangaphambilini, bonkhe lamakhosi enkhosini yaseYuda, kanye nezinto lakhe lalizinikela ngazo, negolide lonke elalifunwa emigodini yendlu kaSimakadze, neyendlu yakhe, wayalela kuHazayeli, ukumkani waseSirhiya; watsi: "Hazayeli, buyela eYerusalem."
Lokunye lokushiwo nguYoashi, naleyo yonke imisebenzi yakhe, akubonakali kubhalwe encwadini yemlando wabaholi beYuda?
Basebenti bakhe bahlangana naye, babulala uYoashi eBet-Milo, enhliziyweni yendlela lesuka eSila.

Abaholi labayawubulala ngu-Yozabadi unyana waShimeathi, ne-Yozabadi unyana waShomeri; watsi: "Uyalala nababa bakhe, washiswa naye, wabanjwa nabo edolobhani laDavide." UAmasiya, unyana wakhe, waba ngunkhosi yakhe.
Ngomnyaka wamashumi lamakhulu mathathu waJoashi, unyana waAhaziya, ukumkani wakwaYuda, waba nguJehoyakimu, unyana waYehu, ukumkani kwaSirayeli eSamari, iminyaka lelishumi linamihlanu.
Wakwenza lokubi emehloni kaSimakadze, walandela iminikelo yekushiswa yaYerobohami, unyana waNebati, lowawuyekisa laSirayeli; akazange ahambe nayo.
Ngako-ke uSimakadze wagwema kakhulu bantfu beSirayeli, wabanikela kuHazayeli, ukumkani waseSiriya, naBenhadadi, umsa wakhe, iminyaka leminingi.
UJehoahazi wathandaza kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, watsi: "UNkulunkulu wamlalela; ngobe wabona lokubi lokwenta ngunkhosi yaseArami kuboSirayeli.
Simakadze wabanikela eSirayeli umsindisi; baphuma ngaphansi kwesandla se-Aram, bahlala bephephile emigodini yabo, njengaleso sikhathi.
Nakuba, bebengasukanga emibiweni yendlu ka-Yarobhoamu, loyawubeka bantfu baseSirayeli embikweni wakhe; baqhubeka nabo; ne Ashera yahlala ikhona eSamari.

Lamandla laJehoahazi akazange aphelela emaphenyane lamashumi mahlanu, nemilenze lelishumi, nalabahamba ngenyawo lamakhulu lasitfupha; ngobe lomuntfu waSimakadze wababulala bonke labashiywa ngunkhosi yase-Aram, wababeka njengenhlaba yemhlabatsi.
Lokunye lokushiwo nguJehoahazi, naleyo yonke imisebenzi yakhe, nemandla akhe, akunjalo, kubhalwe encwadini yemave yamakhosi aseSirayeli?
UJehoahazi walala naye, wabanjwa eSamari; uJoashi, umsa wakhe, waba ngunkhosi yakhe.
Ngomnyaka wamashumi lamakhulu mahlanu nesikhombisa waseYoashi, ukumkani wakwaYuda, waba ngunkhosi yaseSirayeli eSamariya Joashi, umsa kaJoahazi, iminyaka lelishumi namane.
Wakwenza lokubi emehloni kaSimakadze; angeke ahambe nakwesinye sesive saYerobhoamu, unyana waNebati, loyawubeka laSirayeli ekubeni nesive; wahamba ngaso.
Lokunye lokushiwo nguYoashi, kanye nalokudla kwakhe, nemandla akhe, nendlela abelwela ngayo ku-Amasiya, ukumkani wakwaYuda, akubonako kubhalwe encwadini yemlando wamakhosi aseSirayeli?
UYoashi wafa, waba nguYerobohabhi umholi wakhe; uYoashi wafunwa eSamariya, latiwa khona namakhosi aseSirayeli.
Elisha wahlupheka ngesifo lesibulala kuphila kwakhe. UYoashi, ukumkani waseSirayeli, wehla waya kuye, watsi: "Bami, bami!" Watsi: "Lamahhashi enkhosini yaseSirayeli, nalabakhweli bayo."
Elisha watsi kuye: "Thintela intambo kanye nemilenze." Unkhosi yathatha intambo nemilenze.
UElisha watsi kunkhosi yaseSirayeli: "Thipha intambo ngesandla sakho." Wathi, "Thipha intambo ngesandla sakho." Elisha wabeka isandla sakhe phezu kwesandla sebukhosi.

Elisha watsi: "Vula ifenisha lebheke emaphandleni." Wayivula, watsi: "Vula!" Wavula, watsi: "Leli yiso lesibulalayo saSimakadze, lesibulalayo seSirayeli; wena utawuhlasela Sirayeli e-Afeki kuze kube kuphele."
Elisha watsi kuye: "Thiba lamahhashi." Kwatsi lapho ukumkani ethatha khona lamahhashi, Elisha watsi kuye: "Thiba mhlaba ngawo." Wabetha mhlaba kathathu, wahlala.

Umuntfu waNkulunkulu wehlulekile kuye, watsi: "Bekufanele uhlasele lilanga lesihlanu noma lesithandathu; khona-ke ungewabulala laSirayeli kuze kube kuphelile; kepha manje utawuwahlasela laSirayeli kathathu."
Elisa wafa, bamfatile, ngobe kwafika emhlabatsini ngaso sonke sikhatsi imindeni yalabahlaseli beMoabi.

Bafika babulala lomuntfu, batsi: "Lomuntu ufile!" Kutsi kube sekuphele iminyaka lelishumi nesikhombisa. 11Bekube kungakapheli sikhatsi lesidze labaSirayeli bekubopha lowo muntu; ngobe kwabonaka kutsi bangabi nalowo mhlambi wema-Amoni.
Hazayeli, ukumkani wase-Aram, wabaphazamisa bantfu beSirayeli tonkhe tikhatsi tekubusa kukaJoahaz.

Nase uSimakadze wabambisana nalabaSirayeli, wabahloniphela, waya kubo ngenxa yesivumelwano sakhe neAbrahama, ne-Isake, ne-Yakobi; akazange afune kuwabulala, akazange abophe kubo phambi kwakhe kuze kube ngalolusuku.
UHazayeli, inkhosi yase-Aram, wafa; uBenhadadi, umsa wakhe, waba ngunkhosi yakhe.

NaJoashi, intondza ka-Jehoahazi, wabuyisela kuBenhadadi, intondza ka-Hazayeli, imijikelo leyawuyikhipha kwa-Yoahazi ubaba wakhe ngekulwa; watsi: "Yebo, lilanga lesithathu Joashi wamhlasela Benahadadi, wabuyela emindenini yaSirayeli.
Ngomnyaka wekucala waJoashi, unyana waJehoahazi, waba ngunkhosi yaseSirayeli, watsi: "Amasiya, unyana waYoashi, waba nguMbuso waseYuda."
Wabe ubudala beminyaka lemashumi lamabili nesihlanu, lapho afika ebukhosini; waba neminyaka lelishumi nanamihlanu enkhosini eJerusalema.
Wakwenza lokuhle emehloni kaSimakadze, kodvwa akazange akwenze njengobe wakwenta Davide, ubaba wakhe; watsi ngaso sonke leso sayekhe Joasi, umsa wakhe.
Kuze kube tindzawo letiphakeme tingakasuswa; bantfu bahlala benikela khona ngeminikelo yekushiswa netfufu.
Ngako-ke, lapho afike ebukhosini, wabulala labaphathi lababulale ubaba wakhe, ukumkani.

Labo babulala labantwana bakhe, akazange abophe kubo; ngobe kwabhalwe encwadini yemtsetfo waMosi, lapho Simakadze abewisela khona, watsi: "Abazali bangafa ngenxa yalabo abantwana babo, nalababantwana bangafa ngenxa yalabo abadala babo; wonke umuntu kumele afe ngesono sakhe."
UAmasiya wabulala ema-Edomu lamakhulu lalishumi eGoli leLinsini, waba neSela ngekulwa, wayisabiza ngokuthi iJokteeli, kuze kube namuhla.
Ngako-ke uAmasiya watsi kuYoashi, umsa kaJoahazi, umsa waYehu, ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, watsi: "Thiba, sibhekene ngemphi. "

Kodvwa Joashi, inkhosi yaseSirayeli, watsi ku-Amasiya, inkhosi yakaJuda: "Itsi: Isihlahla setfu lesikhona eLibanoni sathumela kusithelo setfu lesikhona eLibanoni, sitsi: 'Nceda usinike indodana yakho kumntwana wami kutsi abe ngumfazi wakhe.'
Lakho kungenxa yakho, ngobe uyawuhlasela iEdomu, bese uhlala endlulweni yakho; yini na kutsi ufune lokubi, lokuya kutfusa wena kanye neJuda nawe?
Waphuma ke uYoashi, inkhosi yaseSirayeli, waya emphini, wabhekana naye, yena na-Amasiya, inkhosi yakaJuda, kutsi bahlangane emdlalweni eBethe-shemeshi, leyayise-Yuda.
Amakhosi aseSirayeli abulala lamadodana eJuda; lamadodana eJudha aphuma, wonke esuka etenteni lakhe.

UYoashi, inkhosi yaseSirayeli, wabulala eBethe-shemeshi uAmasiya, umsa kaJoashi, loyise waAhaziya, ukumkani waseYuda; waya eJerusalema, waphula umgcobo wayo kusukela emnyango waEfremu kuya emnyango wesiganeko, icala lelikhulu nemashumi lamabili nesihlanu lamamitha.
Wathatha lonke legolide nesilivere, naletinye timpahla letifunwa endlwini yaSimakadze, kanye netingcweti tendlu yasebukhosini; wakhipha nabo bonke lababi, wabuyela eSamari.
Lokunye lokushiwo nguYoashi, nemandla akhe, nendlela abehlasela ngayo uAmasiya, ukumkani wakwaYuda, akubonakali kubhalwe encwadini yemlando wamakhosi aseSirayeli?
UYoashi waphumula, washonwa eSamari, naletinye tinhloko tebukhosi beSirayeli; uYerobohabhi, umsa wakhe, waba ngunkhosi yakhe.
UAmasiya, umsa waJoashi, ukumkani wakwaJuda, wabaphila iminyaka lengema-15 ngemuva kwekufa kweYoashi, inkhosi yaseSirayeli.
Lokunye lokushiwo nguAmasiya, nome lokwentako, akushoni kutsi kubhalwe encwadini yemlando wamakhosi eYuda?
Baphikisana naye eJerusalema, waphuma waya eLakhishi; kodvwa bathumela ngemuva kwakhe eLakhishi, bamubulala khona.
Wafakwa emahhashini, wafunwa nababa bakhe eJerusalema, edolobhani laDavide.
Batsi bonke bantfu beYuda bathatha Azariya, lobe uneminyaka lelishumi linamihlanu ubudala, bakwenza abe ngunkhosi endaweni yobaba wakhe Amazia.
UAzariya wabambisa Elati, wayawuyibuyisela enkhosini yaseYuda, ngemuva kwekufa kwenkhosi ubaba wakhe.
Ngomnyaka wesihlanu waAmasiya unyana waYoashi, ukumkani wakwaYuda, waba ngunkhosi yaseSirayeli eSamariya Jeroboamu unyana waYoashi, iminyaka lemashumi mane nelinye.
Wakwenza lokubi emehloni kaSimakadze; akazange ahambe nakwesinye sesibambiso saYerobohabhi, unyana waNebati, lowawuyenzile laSirayeli.

Wabuyisela umkhawulo weSirayeli, kusukela lapho befika khona eHamati ngaseNtshonalanga kuya kuLwandle Lokudliwe ngaseMpumalanga; njengobe Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, abekhuluma ngalo mkhonzi wakhe, uYonasi, umprofeti, umsa waAmitayi, waseGathi-Heferi.
Simakadze wabona buhlungu bendlala yalabaSirayeli, kanye nalabo labakhululekile nabo; kwakungekho lowo loyawubasiza.
Simakadze akazange athethe kutsi uyawucisha igama laSirayeli emhlaba; ngobe wabasindise ngesandla saYerobohami, umsa kaYoashi.

Lokunye lokushiwo nguYerobhoamu, naleyo yonke imisebenzi yakhe, nemandla akhe, nendlela abehlasela ngayo, kanye nendlela abuyisele ngayo kuma-Israyeli iDamasko neHamati lakubo Yuda, akukabhalweni encwadini yemlando wamakhosi e-Israyeli.
UYerobhoamu wehla embhedeni wakhe, washonwa namakhosi aseSirayeli; uZekariya, unyana wakhe, waba ngubukhosi bakhe.
Ngomnyaka wamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa waYerobhoamu ukumkani kwaSirayeli, uAzariya unyana ka-Amasiya waba ngukumkani waseYuda.
Wabe uneminyaka lengema-16 ubudala lapho aphuma ebukhosini, waba ngunkhosi iminyaka lemashumi mahlanu nambili eJerusalema; umsa wakhe wawunguJekoliya waseJerusalema.
Wakwenza lokuhle ekuboneni kwaSimakadze, njengobe wakwenta uAmasiya, umsa wakhe.
Kuze kube tindzawo letiphakeme tingakasuswa; bantfu bahlala benikela khona ngeminikelo yekushiswa netfufu.
USimakadze wehlalela ukumkani umkhuhlane kuze kungakapheli usuku lwakhe lokufa, wahlala endluni lehlukile;Jothamu unyana wakhe waba nguMengameli wendlu yakhe, walungisa abantu belizwe.
Lokunye lokushiwo ngu-Azariya, naleyo yonke imisebenzi yakhe, akubonakali kubhalwe encwadini yemlando wamakhosi eYuda?
U-Azariya waphumula, wahlala nababa bakhe, wafunwa edolobhani laDavide; uJothamu, umsa wakhe, waba ngunkhosi yakhe.
Ngomnyaka wamashumi lamakhulu mahlanu nesikhombisa waseUzariya, ukumkani wakwaYuda, uZekhariya, umsa kaYerobohama, waba ngunkhosi yaseSirayeli eSamariya, waba inyanga lesihlanu.
Wakwenza lokubi emehloni kaSimakadze, njengobe babekwenzela bantfu bakhe bangaphambili; akazange ahambe emiphumeleni yesono saYerobohabhi, unyana waNebati, lowo wabangele iSirayeli ukuba ihlupheke.
Sallum, umsa waJabheshi, waba ngumfoti kuZekhariya, wamhlasela ebusweni bebantfu, wambulala, wehla waba ngunkhosi endaweni yakhe.
Lokunye lokushiwo nguZekariya, akubonakali kubhalwe encwadini yemave yamakhosi aseSirayeli?
Kuye kwaba njalo, kutsi lamazwi aSimakadze afike ku-Yehu, watsi: "Siza sakho siyawuhlala ebukhosini beSirayeli kuze kube yiminyaka lemine."
Sallum, umsa waJabheshi, waba ngunkhosi kumnyaka wesikhombisa nemashumi lamane nalinye ka-Uziya ukumkani wakwaYuda; waba nkhosi iminyaka lelishumi elinesihlanu eSamariya.
Menahemhi, unyana waGadi, wehla eTirsa waya eSamariya, wahlasela Shalumu, unyana waJabheshi, wambulala, waba ngunkhosi yakhe endaweni yakhe.
Lokunye lokushiwo nguShalumu, kanye nesinqumo sakhe, akubonakali kubhalwe encwadini yemave yamakhosi ase-Israyeli?

Ngeleso sikhathi Menaheme waphuma eTirsa, wahlasela Tifsah, nalabo bonke labakhona kulo, kanye nemhlaba wakhe wonke; wababulala, ngobe bangeke bamvule, watsi: "Labo bonkhe bantfu baseTifsah labakhulelwe, uyawuwavula."
Ngomnyaka wamashumi lamakhulu mahlanu nesikhombisa waseUzariya, ukumkani wakwaYuda, uManahemu, umsa kaGadi, waba ngunkhosi yakaJuda, eSamariya, iminyaka lengemashumi.
Wakwenza lokubi emehloni kaSimakadze; ngaso sonke isikhathi sekuphila kwakhe, akazange ahambe ekufeni kwezinto letinene taYerobhoamu, unyana waNebati, lowo wabangele kutsi labaSirayeli baphe.
Kwafika naPhul, ukumkani wase-Ashuri; Menaheme wabanikela kuPhul ngegolide lelikhulu nemashumi lamane emilenze, kutsi abe ngumkhonzi wakhe, aze abambe ibukhosi bakhe.

Manaheme wakhipha lemali eSirayeli, watsi: "Lowo lomkhulu kulowo utawukhokha ishekeli lesihlanu segolide," wanikela ngalo kumkwenkhosi yase-Ashuri; ngobe inkhosi yase-Ashuri yabuyela emuva, akazange ahlale ezweni.
Lokunye lokushiwo nguManaheme, naleyo yonke imisebenzi yakhe, akubonakali kubhalwe encwadini yemlando wamakhosi aseSirayeli?
UManaheme wafa, uPekahiya, umsa wakhe, waba ngunkhosi yakhe.
Ngomnyaka wesihlanu waUzariya ukumkani wakwaYuda, Pekahiya unyana waManahemu waba ngunkhosi yaseSirayeli eSamariya, waba iminyaka lemibili.
Wakwenza lokubi emehloni kaSimakadze; akazange ahambe emiphumeleni yesono saYerobohabhi, unyana waNebati, lowo wabangele kutsi labaSirayeli baphe.

Napheka, unyana kaRemaliya, lomunye wabaholi bakhe, wabambisana naye. Wafika eSamariya, wahlasela uPekahiya emgwaqeni wendlu yasebukhosini, wabulala yena na-Argob na-Arye, wahlala khona njengenkhosi yakhe, naye abe nemadvodza lamashumi mahlanu amakhosikazi aseGileyadi.
Lokunye lokushiwo nguPekahiya, naleyo yonke imisebenzi yakhe, akubonakali kubhalwe encwadini yemave yama-Israyeli?
Ngomnyaka wesihlanu wesitsatfu waUzariya ukumkani wakwaYuda, Peka unyana kaRemaliya waba ngukumkani waseSirayeli eSamariya iminyaka lemashumi lamabili.
Wakwenza lokubi emehloni kaSimakadze; akazange ahambe emiphumeleni yesono saYerobohabhi, unyana waNebati, lowo wabangele kutsi labaSirayeli baphe.

Ngelilanga lePeka ukumkani kwaSirayeli, waya Tiglathi-pileseri, ukumkani waseAshuri, wahlasela Ijoni, neAbeli-beth-maakha, neYanoa, neKedeshi, neHazori, neGileyadi, neGaliliya, nayo yonke ilizwe laNeftali, wabakhipha eAsuri.
NaHoseya, unyana wa-Ela, wabambisana noPekahi, unyana waRemaliya, wamshaya, wambulala, waba ngunkhosi yakhe endaweni yakhe, ngonyaka wemashumi lamakhulu mahlanu kaJothamu, unyana waUziya.
Lokunye lokushiwo nguPekahi, kanye naleyo yonke imisebenzi yakhe, akusho yini kutsi kubhalwe encwadini yemave yama-Israyeli?
Ngomnyaka wesibili waPekahi unyana waRemaliya waba ngunkhosi yaseSirayeli, Jothamu unyana waUziya waba ngunkhosi yaseYuda.
Wabe ubudala beminyaka lemashumi lamabili nesihlanu kutsi abe ngunkhosi, walawula iminyaka lengema-16 eJerusalema; umsa wakhe waba yiJerusha intombi kaTsadoko.
Wakwenza lokuhle emehloni kaSimakadze, njengobe wakwenta uUziya, ubaba wakhe.
Kuye, emathempelini lasentshonalanga akazange asuswa; bantfu bahlala benikela khona ngeminikelo yekushiswa netfufu. UJothamu wasungula iGate ephakeme yendlu yaSimakadze.
Lokunye lokushiwo nguJothamu, naleyo yonke imisebenzi yakhe, akusho yini kutsi kubhalwe encwadini yemlando wamakhosi eYuda?
Ngaleso sikhathi Simakadze waqalisa kutfumisa eYuda Resini, ukumkani wase-Aram, naPekahi, umsa kaRemaliya.
UJothamu waphumula, washonelwa nababa bakhe enhlokodolobha yaDavide, umsa wakhe; u-Ahazi, umsa wakhe, waba ngunkhosi yakhe.
Ngomnyaka wesikhombisa waPekahi, unyana waRemaliya, waba ngunkhosi yaseSirayeli, Ahazasi, unyana waJothamu, waba ngunkhosi yaseYuda.

Akaze ubeneminyaka engama-20 ubudala lapho aphuma ebukhosini, waba nguMbuso waseJerusalema iminyaka lengema-16. Akazange akwenze lokulungile enhliziyweni yaSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakhe, njengobe wakwenza Davide lobaba wakhe.
Wayehamba ngendlela yamakhosi aseSirayeli; wadlula nalowo mntwana wakhe emlilweni, ekwenzeni zonke izinto letibi tamazwe laSimakadze abewukhuphule phambi kwalabo baLevi.
Wanikela ngeminikelo yekushiswa emaphandleni aphakeme, nasebunhlebeni, nangaphansi kwalowo mtfubi lomhlophe.
Ngeleso sikhathi Resini, ukumkani wase-Aram, naPekahi, umsa waRemaliya, inkhosi yaseSirayeli, baphuma behlasela iJerusalema; bahlaba Ahazi ngemphi, ngobe akazange amcolise.
Ngeleso sikhathi Resini, ukumkani wase-Aram, wabuyisela eElathi ku-Aram, wakhipha khona bantfu beJuda; kodvwa Edomu yafika yahlala e-Elathi kuze kube manje.
Akaze watsi kuTiglathi-pileseri, ukumkani wase-Ashuri: "Ngiye umkhonzi wakho nemuntfu wakho; phuma usindise emkhosini wenkhosi yase-Aram nembuso waseSirayeli, laba bahlasela."
Akaze wathatha isiliva negolide lelibakhona ethempelini laSimakadze, nalapho kugcinwa khona impahla yendlu yakhe, wayalela ukumkani wase-Ashuri umnikelo.
Unkhosi yase-Ashuri yalalela, yahlasela iDamaskus, yayibulala, yayisabela eKire, yabulala naRezini.

UMbuso Wase-Ahazi wehla waya eDamaskus, wahlangana neTiglathi-pileseri, ukumkani wase-Ashuri; lapho wabona khona ithempeli, wathumela kuUriya, umLevi, imibhalo yalethempeli kanye nembhalo wayo, kutsi ayenze.

Uriya, umLevi, wabambisene nabo bonkhe bantfu, watsi: "Njengombhalo lonjalo kanye naleyo mifanekiso lenkhosi Ahazi abeyithumela kusuka eDamaskus, uUriya, umLevi, wayakhela i altare, kuze kufike inkhosi Ahazi yaseDamaskus.
Watsi lapho unkhosi ibuyela khona eDamaskus, yabona le-altari, waphuma waya kuyo, wanikela ngayo.
Wakhipha iminikelo yakhe yokushiswa nemnikelo wayo wesonka, wageza nemnikelo wakhe wokudla, wehlisa negazi lelihlanganisiwe lelihlanganiswe neminikelo yakhe yekuthula ema-altare.
Wakhipha ne altare yesiliva, leyo yabe ibekwe phambi kuSimakadze, wayayifaka phambi kwendlu, phakathi kwe-altare entsha nendlu kaSimakadze, wayibeka ecaleni lelinye le-altare entsha, enyakatho.

Unkhosi Ahazi yaletsa uUriya, umLevi, watsi: "Le altare lelikhulu nelinye, likhulu kakhulu, khipha kuyo iminikelo yekushiswa yekusasa neyekusihlwa, nemnikelo wekushiswa wenkhosi, nemnikelo wayo wekudla, neminikelo yokushiswa, neminikelo yayo yekudla, neminikelo yayo yewayini yabantfu bonke belizwe; geza phezu kwayo yonke insangu yeminikelo yekushiswa neyesidlelo; kepha i-altar yegolide iya kuba yami lapho ngicela khona."
Uriya, umsa waSimakadze, watsi: "Ngubani nalowo muntfu?

Unkhosi Ahazi yaletsa imilenze yetibopho tesiliva nelibomvu, yasusa emabhodlela egolide, wakhipha lwandle lwesiliva nelibomvu kusuka kulabo timbuti tesiliva nelibomvu, latawulibeka phezu kwesisekelo sesiliva.
Wakhipha nendlela yeShabbati, leyo yakhiwa ethempelini laSimakadze, nalapho kungenelela khona ukumkani ngaphandle kwethempelini laSimakadze, wakwenza kube lula kunkhosi yase-Asiri.
Lokunye lokushiwo ngu-Ahazi, nome kutsi wakwenza yini, akubonakali kubhalwe encwadini yemave yamakhosi eYuda?
Akaze waphumula, washonwa nababa bakhe edolobhani laDavide; uHezekiya, umsa wakhe, waba ngunkhosi yakhe.
Ngomnyaka weshumi nambili wa-Ahazi ukumkani kwaYuda, uHoseya, umsa waEla, waba ngunkhosi yakaJuda, eSamariya, iminyaka lemashumi lamane.
Wakwenza lokubi emehloni kaSimakadze, kodvwa akazange akwenze njengobe bakwentela bantfu labakhulu baseSirayeli labebangaphambili kwakhe.
UShalmaneseri, ukumkani wase-Ashuri, wahlasela Hoshea; Hoshea waba ngumkhonzi wakhe, wanikela kuye ngemnikelo wekushiswa ngonyaka ngamunye.

Watsi lapho ukumkani wase-Ashuri ebona kutsi uHoseya aphikisana naye, watsi: "Hosheya wathumela kuSo, inkhosi yaseMijiphu; kodvwa yena wehlisele ukunikela ngemnikelo wekushiswa kumphathi we-Ashuri, njengoba abekwenza iminyaka yonke." Ngako lonkhosi ye-Ashuri yabeka Hosheya emgodini.
Wafika unkhosi yase-Ashuri waya ezweni lonke, wafika eSamariya, wayihlasela iminyaka lemithathu.
Ngomnyaka wesithoba wekubusa kukaHoseya, ukumkani wase-Ashuri wahlasela iSamaria, wakhipha laSirayeli e-Ashuri, wababeka eHala, naseHabori, emfuleni waseGozani, nasezikhungweni zebantfu baseMedi.
Kuye kwaba njalo, ngobe bantfu baseSirayeli baphelelwe nguSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wabo, lowo wabakhipha ezweni leMijiphu ngaphansi kwesandla seFaro, ukumkani waseMijiphu, besaba bokhokho babo.
Baye bahamba ngemasiko ebantfu labaSimakadze abewakhipha phambi kwabo, nemasiko lamakhosi aseSirayeli abehleli kuwo.

Bami baSirayeli bakwenza ngesandla izinto letingeke zibe kahle kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wabo; bakha emabhishi aphakeme kuwo wonke lamadolobha abo, kusukela emgodini loncane wenkhosi kuya emgwaqeni omkhulu.
Bangebeka ema-ashere nemihlobiso yetitshe letingcwele phezulu kuwo wonke umfula lophakeme, kanye ngaphansi kwalowo mtfubi lomhlophe.
Bafuya emathempelini lamakhulu, njengakube bekwenzela lamazwe aSimakadze abewakhipha ebusweni babo; bakwenza izinto letinene, labaphazamisa Simakadze.
Bakhonza tigodvo, lapho Simakadze abekhuluma khona kubo, watsi: "Ningeke nikwenze lokhu."

USimakadze ubewuvimbela Israele naYuda ngesandla semaprofeti bakhe bonke, ngalabo ababonayo, watsi: Buyele endlela yenu ebi, nigcine imiyalo yami nemithetho yami, nguNkulunkulu lowawubawisela wona lababa bakho, kanye noNkulunkulu lowasithumela ngawo labakhonzi bami bamaprofeti.
Baye, ngobe bengeke balalele, baphindze baphikisa imilenze yabo njengemilebe yababa babo, lababengakholwa kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wabo.

Baphuca imiyalo yakhe, nesivumelwano sakhe, abesenza nababa babo, kanye nemvume yakhe, abeyisabalalisa kubo; balandela izinto ezingenalutho, babe yizinto ezingalungile, behamba ngendlela yebantfu labaseceleni kwabo, labo Simakadze abewaletsa ukuba bangabi nesimo sabo.
Baye basuka kuwo wonke lamandla kaSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wabo; bakhipha ingulube lemibili eyenziwe ngegolide, ne-ashere, bathandaza kuleyo mihlaba yonke yasezulu, bakhonza uBhaali.
Banikela ngemadvodzana abo kanye nemadvodzakati abo emlilweni, bakhuluma ngesimo sezulu, bakhuluma ngezinhlamvu zemanti, bathengisa lamandla abo ukwenza lokubi emehloni kaSimakadze, kutsi bamkhabe.
Ngako-ke uSimakadze wehluleke kakhulu ngeSirayeli, wabasusa ebusweni bakhe; kwatsi kungakabi nalinye lihlanga laYuda kuphela.
NaseYuda akazange agcine imiyalo kaSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wabo, kodvwa wahamba ngemasiko aseSirayeli, abewamisa.
Ngako-ke uSimakadze wehlule yonke imfuyo yaSirayeli, wabaphazamisa, wabanikela emlonyeni walabo lababulalayo, kuze atawubasusa phambi kwakhe.

Ngako-ke uSimakadze wehlule laSirayeli emndenini waDavide, batsi: "Sebenta uYerobohabhi, unyana kaNebati, waba ngunkhosi yenu." UYerobohabhi wabasusa laSirayeli emkhosini waNkulunkulu, wababeka kwenzeke isono esikhulu.
Lamadvodza aseSirayeli ahlala ekwenzeni tonkhe tigebengu taYerobhoamu, angeke ahambe kuzo.

kuze kufike lapho uSimakadze asuse khona iSirayeli ebusweni bakhe, njengobe wakhuluma ngaso ngesandla salabo bonke labakhonzi bakhe labaprofeti; ngobe lamakhosikazi aseSirayeli abeboshwa emazweni abo waya e-Ashuri kuze kube ngalolusuku.
Unkhosi yase-Ashuri yakhipha abantu eBhabheli, neKuta, ne-Avva, neHamati, neSefarwayim, yababeka emizini yeSamariya endaweni yalabaSirayeli; bathatha iSamariya, bahlala emizini yayo.
Ekupheleni kokuhlala kwabo khona, bangeke babe nekuthula kuSimakadze; ngobe Simakadze abethumela ema-lions phakathi kwabo, lawabulala kuwo.

Bakhuluma kunkhosi yase-Ashuri, batsi: "Laba bantu labewadlulisela bahlala emadolobhani aseSamariya, bangazi indlela loNkulunkulu welizwe leli; ngobe wathumela ema-lions phakathi kwabo, bona, la ma-lions awabulala, ngoba awazi indlela LoNkulunkulu welizwe.
Watsi unkhosi yase-Ashuri: "Thumela emuva lomunye walabaphatsimandla, niyawuyisa khona, aze ahambe ahlale khona, aze awafundise indlela yeNkulunkulu walelizwe."
Wabuyela lomunye wabaphatsimandla, lababeka eSamariya, wahlala eBheteli, wabafundisa indlela yekutsi bangabe bathandaza kuSimakadze.
Ngako-ke, ngaleso sikhathi imindeni yabo yahlala emadolobheni abo; kodvwa linyenti lebantfu lalike lwakhe unkulunkulu bakhe, wabeka kuwo emathempelini emadolobha asephakeme abakwaSamariya abewahlela.
Labantfu base-Babyloni bakhipha Sukhothi-benoti; labaholi be-Kuta bakhipha Nergal; labaholi be-Hamati bakhipha Ashima.
La-Avithi bakhipha Nibhazi neTarhaki; la-Sepharvithi babulala bantfu babo ngemlilo, banikela ku-Adrammeleki na-Anameleki, labangcwele be-Sefarvayim.
Bayawubalekela kuSimakadze, baphindze bakhipha emaLevi kuwo wonke lamadodana abo abe ngumnikelo wesono emadolobhani aphakeme; nabo babe ngumnikelo wesono kubo emgodini.
Bathandaza kuSimakadze, bakhonza nabo bonkulunkulu babo, behamba ngendlela yalawo mazwe labehlanganiswe khona.

Baye bahamba ngendlela yabo yangaphambilini, kuze kube ngalolusuku; bangeke babe nekuthula naSimakadze, noma ngemiyalo yakhe, noma ngezimiso zakhe, noma ngomthetho wakhe, noma ngomyalelo wakhe, lapho awiselise khona umndeni kaYakobi, lowawutsi igama lakhe nguSirayeli.
USimakadze wabambisana nalabaSirayeli, watsi kubo: "Ungababi bonkulunkulu babanye, ungeke ubabuke, ungeke ubasebenzele, ungeke ubanikeze insipho.
Simakadze, loyawutfumisa ezweni leMijiphu ngemandla amakhulu nesandla esiqinile, yena kuphela niyawuthandaza kuye, niyawunikela ngenkemba yakhe.
Lemiyalo yakhe, nemithetho yakhe, namasiko akhe, nemtsetfo wakhe, kanye nemyalelo wakhe, labewabhalela kuwe, niwugcine, niwuphumele mihla lenu yonke.
Mna-ke ngingakukhohlwa lomnikelo wami wesono, ngobe ngiwubeke phambi kwenu.
ngobe Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, niyawuwuhlonipha; yena utawukukhulula esandlani sema-Israyeli, abe ngubomi bakho.
Batsi: "Akekho, kodvwa bahamba ngendlela yabo yangaphambilini."
Lamazwe lalawo ayawuthandaza kuSimakadze, kodvwa ayawukhonza nemifanekiso yabo; nabantwana babo kanye nemadvodzana abo kanye nemadvodzakati abo bayakwenza kanjalo-ke kuze kube namuhla.
Kumnyaka wesithathu waHoseya, umsa wa-Ela, ukumkani kwaSirayeli, uHezekiya, umsa wa-Ahazi, waba ngukumkani waseYuda.
Wabe ubudala beminyaka lemashumi lamabili nesihlanu, lapho aphuma ebukhosini, waba neminyaka lelishumi nanamihlanu elawula eJerusalema; umkakhe waba nguAbi, intombi kaZekariya.
Wakwenza lokuhle emehloni kaSimakadze, njengobe wakwenta Davide, umsa wakhe.

Wasuswa emathempelini aphakeme, waphula imihlobiso yegolide, waletsa i-ashera, wabulala nenyoka yesiliva leMosese abeyenze; ngobe kuze kube ngaleso sikhathi bantfu beSirayeli babeyifuyisa; wabizwa ngokuthi nguNehushtani.
Hezekiya wakholwa kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli; kwabangayena lofana naye kubo bonkhe bantfu benkhosi yakaJuda, labazange babe phambi kwakhe, nalabo ababemuva kwakhe.
Wayilandzela isandla saSimakadze, angeke ahambe esuka kuye; wagcina imiyalo yaSimakadze, loyawutsi Musa.
UNkulunkulu waba naye, waphumelela kuwo wonke lomsebenzi wakhe. Waphuma kunkhosi yase-Ashuri, akazange amkhonze.
Wabulala labaFilisti kuya eGaza, kanye nemhlaba wayo, kusukela emgodini loncane wekutsi, kuze kube kufike emgwaqeni omkhulu.
Ngomnyaka wesihlanu waHezekiya ukumkani, lobe ngumnyaka wesikhombisa waHoseya unyana ka-Elahu, inkhosi yaseSirayeli, wafika Salmanasar, ukumkani waseAshuri, waya eSamariya, wayibamba.
Kwaphela iminyaka lemithathu, laAsiriya ayawuyibulala; emnyaka wesihlanu waHezekiya, lowube ngumnyaka wesithoba kaHoseya ukumkani kwaSirayeli, Samaria yatiwa.
Unkhosi yase-Ashuri yabeka bantfu beSirayeli e-Ashuri, yabamisa eHala, naseHabori, emfuleni waseGozani, nemadolobha aseMediya.

Lokhu kwaba, ngobe bengeke balalele lizwi laSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wabo, kodvwa babewuphula umyalelo wakhe, nabo bonkhe labaMosi, mkhonzi waNkulunkulu, abebawisela kuwo; bebengawulalela, bangawulandzela.
Ngomnyaka welishumi elinesihlanu waHezekiya, uSanheribi, inkhosi yase-Ashuri, waphuma waya kuwo wonke lamadolobha aseYuda anesibhakabhaka, waba nemandla awo.

Hizekiya, inkhosi yaka-Israyeli, waya kunkhosi yaseAshuri eLakishi, watsi: "Mine sengihlukumekile; khululeka ngami, nami ngitakulethela lokudla lokungekuhle." UMbuso wase-Asiriya wacela uHizkiya, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, kutsi amnike isiliva lelikhulu nemashumi lamakhulu lamane emashekeli kanye negolide elinamaphesenti lamahlanu.
Hizekiya wanikela ngesiliva lonke lelibakhona endlwini yaSimakadze, nasensimini yenkhosi yakhe.
Ngeleso sikhathi uHezekiya wasusa negolide lelineminyango yethempelini laSimakadze, kanye nemilenze yayo, legolide lelibekiwe nguHezekiya, watsi linike ukumkani wase-Ashuri.

Watsi unkhosi yase-Ashuri yathumela uRahabhi, ne-Arfaxadi, na-Ahikamu eJerusalema kusuka eLakhishi kuye kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, ngaso sonke isikhathi; bafike befika eJerusalema, bahlala emnyango welwandle lwesibhakabhaka esiphezulu, endlela leya emhlabatsini lowase-Egipta.
Batsi bakhuluma kuSimakadze, watsi kubo: "Nine-ke Simakadze Nkulunkulu wenu, ngobe nimi; nginikhipha enkhosini yenu, ngiyibeka ngaphansi kwesandla sakho, ngiyibeke ngaphansi kwesandla sakho.
Rakabu wabaphendvula watsi: "Nitsi kuHezekiya: USimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Ashurimi, utsite kutsi: 'Kuyini lolukhululo lwakho?
Utsi: "Nine umbono, nine amandla ekulwa," kepha la mazwi angeke abe khona lutho. Nini niyawuthembela kuye, kutsi ningaba nemiphi?
Kutsi, wena uyala ku-Ejipta, itfu lelibomvu lelingcolisa lokuhamba; uma umuntu ekhonta kuyo, iyawugoca umlomo wakhe. Lowo nguFaro, ukumkani wase-Ejipta, kuwo wonke lowo uhlala kuye.

"Nase ungangiti, 'Sihlala sithembela kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wethu'? Ngabe angeke abe nguye lowo lapho Hizkiya ekhipha khona izindawo zakhe eziphakeme nezindawo takhe letingcwele, watsi: "UHezekiya watsi kwaYuda nakwaJerusalema: 'Kulethempelini lelihle lasesiYerusalem niyawuthandaza.'
Ngako-ke, hlala udlala nonkhosi yami, ukumkani wase-Ashuri; ngitakunikela ngemahhashi lamakhulu mabini, uma ungaba nebantfu labahamba kuwo.
Ngabe ungeke ube nekhono lokulwa nalowo mkhulu kunabo bonke labakhonzi benkhosi yami, ngobe uhlala eMijiphu ngemikhumbi yakho nebahhashi bakho?
Ngabe sengifike ngihlasele lendawo, ngiyibhubhise ngaphandle kwaSimakadze? Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli watsi kuye: Yikhuphule lelizwe, uyibhubhise.'
UEliyakimu, umsa waHilkiya, naShebna, naJoha, batsi ku-Arpaksade: "Nceda ukhulume nalabakhonzi bakho ngesiArami, ngoba siyayiqonda; ungakhuluma nathi ngesiHebhere emlonyeni walebantfu labasesitezi."

U-Raphayeli watsi kuye: "UNkulunkulu wami ungisithumela kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, kanye nawe, kutsi ngikhulume lamazwi lawa? Natsi nalabo bantu labahlala phansi emnyango, nabo batawudla ukungcola kwabo, nekudla kwendlala yabo, njengenu.
Watsi u-Arpaksade ahlala, wakhuluma ngesiHebhere, watsi: "Dlulisa lizwi lenkhosi enkulu, inkhosi yase-Ashuri!
Simakadze Nkulunkulu wenu utsi: Angeke Ezekiyi akwenteni lutho, ngobe ngeke akwazi kutsi anivikele esandla sami.
"Lakho-ke, ningavumeli uHizekiya akuvumeleni ukuba nithembe kuSimakadze, nitsi: 'UNkulunkulu utawusikhulula; lodolobha leli ngeke linikezwe emkhosini wenkhosi ye-Ashuri.'

"Ungamlalelanga Ezekiya, ngobe kutsi unkhosi yase-Ashuri ikhuluma njalo, isithi: 'Ninikele nami, nifike nimi; khona-ke nitawudla niyawudla ngalesihlahla setiye kanye nesihlahla semfiko, niyawudla niyawudla, niyawudla niyawudla, niyawudla niyawudla.

kuze ngifike ngikuthatheni ezweni lelifana nelizwe lenu, emhlabatsini kanye newayini elisha, emhlabatsini lomhluzi nalelivini, emhlabatsini lwetimbali te-olive kanye nejusi; khethe ukuphila, hhayi lokufa; ngobe angeke nivumeli Ezekiyi kutsi akukhohlise, athi: Simakadze ungisusa.
Ngabe kukhona Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli loyawuvikela umhlaba wakhe emandleni enkhosini yaseAshuri?
Baphi labangcwele beHamati nalabangcwele beArpadi? Baphi labangcwele beSepharvayim, neHena, nalabangcwele beIva? Bangamkhulula yini Samaria emandleni ami?
Nguwuphi lomunye walabo bonkulunkulu balezi mhlaba, laweza kutsi agcine ilizwe lakhe lisuka kum? Ngabe Simakadze utawugcina kanjani iJerusalema lisuka kum?"
Batsi: "Asikuphenduli lutho, ngobe ukumkani ubememetele, watsi: 'Ungamuphendulanga.' "

Watsi uEliyakimu, umsa waHilkiya, lobengumphathi wendlu yasebukhosini, neShebna umbhali, naJoha, umsa waAsaphi, umbhali wezinhlolovo, bafika kuHezekiya, benemigqomo yabo ihlanganisiwe, batsi kuye amazwi ka-Arpaksade.
Kutsi lapho uHezekiya, ukumkani, ekubona khona, waluka iingubo zakhe, wagqoka isiliva negolide, waya endlwini kaSimakadze.
Wathumela naEliyakimu, umphathi wendlu, naShebna, umbhali, nebaholi bebandla labangcwele, bagqoke ingubo yegolide, kuIsaya umprofeti, unyana ka-Amozi.
Batsi kuye: "Hizekiya ukhuluma njalo, watsi: 'Lemininingwane yinye yebuhlungu, nenkundla, nenhlonipho; sifana nemkhwenyana ehlelekile ekubeletheni, kepha angeke abe nemandla lokuzala.

Kungeke kutsi Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, alalele amazwi ka-Arpaksade, lowathumela umphathi wakhe, ukumkani wase-Ashuri, kutsi aphuce uNkulunkulu ophilayo, kube nguSimakadze longuSomandla wakho, Nkulunkulu wakho, lowo utawumubulala ngalawo mazwi, abewuva; ngobe sewuyawuthandaza kubo bonke labashiwo.
Befika bantfu benkhosi Hezekiah kuIsaya,
UIsaya wabaphendvula watsi: "Nitsi kumphathi wenu, Simakadze usho kutsi: 'Ungabi nenkinga ngemazwi lawuva, abaholi bakakumkani wase-Ashuri abekhuluma ngawo ngami.
"Ngitsi, ngitawumisa umoya kuye, aze afike ezweni lakhe, abe nezindaba kutsi uyawubuyela ezweni lakhe; khona-ke ngitawumubulala ngesandla ezweni lakhe."'"
Wabuyela Raphayeli, watsi kutsi inkhosi yase-Ashuri yaphuma eLakishi; wahlangana nayo ihlasela Libnani.
Unkhosi yase-Ashuri yatsi: "Thirhaka, ukumkani wase-Ethiopya, uphuma ekulwa naye." Wayemthuma umphathi wakhe waya kuHezekiya, watsi:
Nitsi kuHezekiya, ukumkani wakwa-Israyeli: UNkulunkulu wakho, lowo ukholwa kuye, angakukhohlisa, esithi, IJerusalema angeke ifakwe emandleni kankhosi yaseAshuri.
Ngiyakubona, wena ukhuluma lokudla kwabo bantfu base-Asiriya kuwo wonke lamazwe, kutsi bawubulala wonke umhlaba; yini na, wena ungeke uphile?
Bami, bangawukhulula yini lomhlaba lamakhosi awo, labo abafowethu nababami bayawubulala? bangawukhulula yini Gozani, neHarani, neRezephi, nalabo baseEdeni labahlala eTelasari?
Kuphi ukumkani weHamati? Kuphi ukumkani wa-Arpadi? Kuphi bantfu beSefarwayim, neHena, neIva?"
Hizekiya wakhipha incwadi emlonyeni wabathunywa, wayibona, waphuma waya endlwini yaSimakadze, watsi: "Hhizekiya uvule incwadi phambi kwaSimakadze.

UHezekiya wathandaza kuSimakadze, watsi: "Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, wena lohlala ebukhosini bakho phakathi kwee-kerubi, wena kuphela uNkulunkulu we tonkhe tive temhlaba; wena lowo wakwenza izulu nemhlaba.
Nciphisa ndlebe yakho, Simakadze, ulalele; vula amehlo akho, Nkulunkulu, ubone; lalela amazwi laSenhakeri, lowo wathumela kutsi aphuce uNkulunkulu lophilayo.
Kulungile, Nkosi yami, kutsi bantfu base-Ashuri babulala lamazwe lawo kanye nemadolobha abo.
Bayawubeka ema-Ashurini ema-Amoni emlilo, ngobe angeke abe ma-Ashurini ema-Amoni; ngobe bebengama-Ashurini, kutsi bangabi nema-Ashurini, kodvwa babe ngumsebenti wesandla somuntu.
Manje-ke, Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wethu, sisindise emandleni akhe, ukuze zonke imindeni yemhlaba ibone ukuthi wena kuphela, Simakadze, uNkulunkulu.
Watsi uIsaya, umsa waAmozi, watsi kuHezekiya: "Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, uthi: 'Lento lowuthandaza kuyo mayelana naSenhakeribi, ukumkani waseAshuri, ngiyiva.
Lelinye lamazwi aSimakadze akhuluma ngawo, watsi: "Inkosikazi yeSiyoni iyakuhoxa, iyakucosha; idolobha leJerusalema liyakucosha inhlavu yayo ngemuva kwakho, lapho uphuma khona.
Utsi: "Ngubani na lowuphazamisa, lowo utawuphazamisa? Ngubani na lowuyephula, lowo uyawupheka? Nguwo Longcwele waseSirayeli!

Ngendlela yetibopho takho, utfusa uSimakadze, watsi: Ngamabhasi ami amakhulu, ngifike emifuleni ephakeme kakhulu, emaphethelweni aseLibanoni; ngadlwengula imihlahla yayo emikhulu, nemithi yayo ehlelekile; ngafika emaphandleni ayo, emhlabathini wayo lomnyama.
"Ngicubhukile, ngadla amanzi abo; ngetinyawo tami ngitawucubha yonke imifula yase-Egypt."'"

Utsi: "Asewukubonanga? Ngaleso sikhathi sengingeke ngikwenze; ngaleso sikhathi sengingeke ngibe nembono, kodvwa manje sengitawukwenza. Ngitakusibeka emabhishi asemgwaqeni abe ngumahhashi emhlabatsini.

Ngako-ke abantu babo balahlekelwa ngumandla wabo, bahlupheka, bakhatshulwa; babe sekuba njengentaba yemhlabatsini, njengentaba leluhlaza, njengentaba yendlu yasemadvolweni, ekhulisa ngaphambi kokuba ikhule.
Nami ngiyakukhumbula lapho uhlala khona, nalapho uphuma khona, nalapho ufika khona; ngiyakukhumbula buhlungu bakho labani.
Ngako-ke, ngobe utsalile ngami, ngobe ngiva kukhuluma kwakho, ngobe ngitawubeka umkhonto wami emlonyeni wakho, nemphimbo yami emlomo wakho, ngikubuyele ngendlela leyawufika ngayo.

Lento ingeke ibe yiphawu kuwe, Ezekiyasi: Lomnyaka lomusha utawudla lekudla lokusuka emhlabatsini, nawasenyaka olandelayo uzodla lapho kukhulela khona; kepha ngonyaka wesithathu uzama ukutshala kanye nokuvuna, wamisa imivini uyewudla umkhicito wayo.
Nalabo labafile, nalabashiyelwe eYerusalema, baphindze batfume emajikijolo abo phezulu, nabo batfume emajikijolo abo phansi.
Bayawuphuma eJerusalema labafileyo, nelabo labagcotshwa emfuleni iSiyone; loku kungeke kwenzeke ngenxa yekuthula kweSimakadze.
Ngako-ke Simakadze utsi kunkhosi yase-Ashuri: Angeke afike kulo mji, angeke afake khona isandla sakhe, angeke afike kuyo ngesibhakabhaka, angeke abe nendlunkulu emnyango wayo.
Ngendlela afike ngayo, uyawubuyela kuyo; ngeke afike kulo mji, kusho Simakadze.
ngobe ngitawuvikela lomhlaba kutsi ngiwusindise, ngenxa yami kanye nenkhosi yami Davide.
Ngelobusuku waphuma angeluSimakadze, wabulala ema-Ashurini emawaka lamakhulu lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa namane; bavuka besuka ekuseni, babona, kwabe khona ticubu kuwo wonke umhlaba.
Ngako-ke Sanheribi, inkhosi yaseAshuri, wabuyela emuva, wabuyela ekhaya lakhe, waya eNineve.

Watsi, lapho ethandaza endlwini kaNisrokhi, loNkulunkulu wakhe, Adrammeleki naSharezeri, lamadvodzana akhe, bambulala ngesandla, baphuma befika ezweni le-Ararati; Esar-Haddone, umsa wakhe, waba ngubukhosi bakhe.
Kuye kwaba ngaleso sikhathi kutsi uHezekiya waba nesifo sekufa. UIsaya umprofeti, umsa wa-Amozi, waya kuye, watsi kuye: "Ngitsi Simakadze: Linganisa isikhundla sakho; ngobe uyafa, awunakuphumula."
Hizekiya wabuyela umlomo wakhe emnyango, wathandaza kuSimakadze watsi:
Simakadze, khumbula manje, ngiyakucela, kutsi sengihamba ngeqiniso phambi kwakho ngentliziyo yami yonke, ngakwenza lokuhle emehlweni akho.' "
Hezekiya akazange aphume enkundleni yekucala, ngobe livi leSimakadze lwafika kuye watsi:

"Thumela ufike utsi kuHezekiya, umholi webantfu bami: USimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, uthe kutsi: 'Ngikulalela umthandazo wakho, ngikubona lamehlo akho; ngiyakuphilisa. Ngosuku lwesithathu utawuya ethempelini laSimakadze.

Nase ngitawukusebentisa iminyaka lelishumi lelinesihlanu, nami ngitakukhulula wena nalesi sixeko kusuka emandlani kwenkhosi yase-Ashuri; ngobe ngiyawuvikela lesi sixeko ngenxa yami, nemsebenti wami waDavide.
Hezekiya watsi: "Thintela umhluzi wema-figo." Bawuthatha, bawubeka emphinjeni; khona-ke uHezekiya waphiliswa.
Hizekiya waya kuIsaya, watsi: "Iyini uphawu lokuba uSimakadze ungiphilise, nalapho ngizohamba khona endlwini yaSimakadze ngelilanga lesithathu?"
UIsaya watsi: "Leli phawu livela kuSimakadze, kutsi Simakadze utawukwenza lokhu akushoyo. Ingabe isithunzi siyawuhamba phambili emaphakheji lalishumi, noma sibuye emuva emaphakheji lalishumi?"
Hizekiya watsi: "Kulula kakhulu kutsi sikhala sihambe emaphakheji lamashumi lamabili; kufanele sibuye kumaphakheji lalishumi."
Hezekiya umprofeti watsi kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli; Simakadze wabuyela emuva isithunzi semamitha lamashumi lamabili esigabeni saAhazi.
Ngeleso sikhathi, Merodaki-baladani, umsa waBaladani, ukumkani waseBabiloni, watsi kuHezekiya: "Thumela incwadi kanye nesipho; ngobe wakhuluma kutsi uHezekiya ubefile.

Hizekiya wayabamukela, wabakhombisa konkhe lokwako endlwini yakhe yegolide nesiliva, naleyo golide, nalelo liphunga, neleyo mafutha abalulekile, nekhaya lakhe lemikhosi, nalokho konke lokubekiwe emakhazeni akhe; kwakungeke kubekho lutho endluni yakhe noma kuwo wonke ummandla wakhe lapho Hizekiya angababonise khona.
UIsaya umprofeti wafika kunkhosi Hezekiah, watsi kuye: "Njani laba bantu batsi? Bafike kuphi?"Hezekiya watsi: "Bafike kusuka ezweni lelikude, kusukela eBabyloni."
Hezekiya watsi: "Babona yini endlwini yakho?" Hizekiya watsi: "Babone yonke into lekhona endlwini yami; angeke kube khona lutho emabhokisini ami, ngobe ngitawubakhombisa."
UIsaya watsi kuHezekiya: "Dlulisa amazwi kaSimakadze:
Bheka, kuyawufika usuku lapho konke okukhona endlwini yakho, kanye nezinto labobaba bakho labagcwaliswe ngazo kuze kufike ngalolusuku, kuzofakwa eBabheleni; ngeke kushiyeke lutho, kusho Simakadze.
Nabo labaphuma emndenini wakho, labo baphuma emilenzeni yakho, baya kuthathwa, babe ngabaphathi bendlu yasebukhosini baseBabeline.'
Hizekiya watsi kuIsaya: "Ilizwi laSimakadze lowakhulumayo lilungile." UHezekiya wacabanga, "Kungeke kube khona kuthula nekuthula emhlabeni wami."

Lokunye lokushiwo nguHizekiya, kanye nemandla akhe onke, nendlela abewenza ngayo umgodzi, nalapho abeka khona amanzi enhliziyweni yedolobha, kubonakala sengathi kubhalwe encwadini yemave yamabukhosi beYuda.
Hezekiya wafa, watsi: "Manase, umsa wakhe, waba ngubukhosi bakhe."
UManase ubeneminyaka lengema-12 ubudala lapho aphuma ebukhosini, waba ngunkhosi iminyaka lemashumi mahlanu nesihlanu eJerusalema; umzala wakhe wakunguHefzibha.
Wakwenza lokubi emehloni kaSimakadze, walandela imicabango lemibi yalawo mazwe aSimakadze abewukhuphule phambi kwalabaSirayeli.

Wayilungisa kabusha imihlaba ephakeme, leHezekiya, ubaba wakhe, abeyisusa, waphakamisa ema-altari kuBaali, wakhipha i-ashere, njengobe akazange akwenze uAhabe, ukumkani waseSirayeli; wanikela ngesandla sakhe kuwo onke lamandla ezulu, wabakhonza.
Wakha ema-altari endlwini yaSimakadze, lapho Simakadze abesho khona kutsi: "EJerusalema ngitawubeka igama lami."
Wakha ema-altari kuwo wonke lamandla ezulu, emafasiteleni amabili endlu yaSimakadze.

Wabeka unyana wakhe emliloni, wakhuluma ngemanti, waba nezinhlamvu, waya kulabo labafuna ukukhuluma ngezinto eziphilayo kanye nalababonako. Wakwenza lokudla lokubi kakhulu enhliziyweni yaSimakadze, kutsi angeke abe nomsindo kuye.

Wathatha i-ashere leyingcweti, layawuyenza, wayisa endlwini lapho Simakadze abekhuluma ngayo kuDavide naSolomoni, unyana wakhe, watsi: "Endluni lenhle, naseJerusalema, lapho ngiwukhethele khona kuwo wonke lamadolobha aseSirayeli, ngitawubeka igama lami kuze kube sekupheleni.

Nami ngingeke ngiphinde ngibeke isandla saSirayeli ebusweni belizwe labengisinike bobaba babo, uma nje bagcina bekwenza konke lokudlalelayo, nalapho ngibawiselise khona, kutsi bagcine bonke mthetho wami, lowo Mosesi, umkhonzi wami, abewaletsa.
Ngako-ke lamakhosi akazange alalele; kodvwa Manase wayawuphazamisa lamadolobha, waya ekwenzeni lokubi ngaphezu kwalawo mabutfo laSimakadze abewabulala phambi kwemadvodzana aSirayeli.
Wakhuluma Simakadze ngesandla setibondza bakhe labaprofeti, watsi:
"Manase, ukumkani wakwaYuda, wenza lezi zinto ezibi kakhulu, wakwenza kubi kakhulu kunalabo base-Amori labahlala lapha ngaphambi kwakhe, wabeka nenkhosi yaseJuda ejele ngemihlobiso yakhe.
Ngako-ke Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, utsi: Namuhla ngiyawuletha eJerusalema naseYuda indlala, kutsi lowo lokhuluma ngayo angeke abe nendlebe lephumayo.

Ngizoyilinganisela iJerusalema ngentambo yami, ngaleyo ngiyibeke eSamariya, nentambo yami, ngaleyo ngiyibeke emndenini wakwa-Ahabhi; ngobe ngitawuyihlanza iJerusalema, njengobe umuntu ahlanza isidlo, esiyahlanza, esiyayisa phansi.
Nami ngiyawushiya labo labashiywe, nalabo abashiywe kubo bonkhe bantfu bami, ngiyobanikela emandlani lababuphikisi babo; nabo bonke babuphikisi babo baya kubaphuca, baya kubathwala nempahla yabo.
ngobe bakwenta lokubi emehlo ami, bemikhazamisa, kusukela kulelo langa labababa babo baphuma khona e-Egypt kuya kulo langa.'

UManase wabulala nabo labangenacala kakhulu, kuze wagcwalisa iJerusalema ngegazi labo kusuka kwelinye icala kuya kwelinye, ngaphandle kwesono sakhe lapho abeke khona Yuda ekwenzeni lokudla lokubi emlonyeni kaSimakadze.
Lamanye lamacala aManase, naleyo yonke imisebenzi yakhe, kanye nesono sakhe sakhe, akubonakali kubhalwe encwadini yemlando wamakhosi eYuda?
UManase waphumula, wabanjwa efulethini lakhe, efulethini la-Uza; uAmoni, umsa wakhe, waba ngunkhosi yakhe.
UAmoni ubeneminyaka lemashumi lamane nambili ubudala lapho aphuma ebukhosini, waba ngunkhosi iminyaka lemibili eJerusalema; umzali wakhe waba nguMeshulemethi, intombi kaHaruzi waseJotbha.
Wakwenza lokubi emehloni kaSimakadze, njengobe wakwenta Manase, ubaba wakhe.
Wahamba ngendlela yakhe yonke, abe ngubaba wakhe; wakhonza imifanekiso leyingcwele, loyise ayawuhlala kuyo, wababophe.
Wayishiya indlela yaSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, akazange ahambe ngendlela yakhe.
Lamadvodza la-Amoni aphindze aphikisana naye, wabulala ukumkani endlu yakhe.
Lakho bantfu belizwe babulala bonke labo labaphikisayo kunkhosi Amone; kodvwa bantfu belizwe baphindze bakhipha uMosi, umsa wakhe, waba ngubukhosi bakhe.
Lokunye lokushiwo nguAmoni, nome lokwentako, akushoni kutsi kubhalwe encwadini yemave yamakhosi eYuda?
Wafunwa, wafakwa ethempelini lakhe, efulethini la-Uza; watsi: "Josiya, unyana wakhe, waba ngubukhosi bakhe."
UYosiya ubeminyaka imashumi lamabili nesihlanu eneminyaka engu-8 ubudala kutsi abe ngunkhosi, wadzala iminyaka lelishumi nalinye eJerusalema; umsa wakhe waba yiJedida intombi kaAdaya waseBozkati.
Wakwenza lokuhle emehloni kaSimakadze, wahamba ngendlela yaDavide, umsa wakhe; akazange ahambe ngasekunene noma ngasekhohlo.
Ngomnyaka wesikhombisa nemashumi lamane uYosiya waba ngunkhosi, wathumela endlwini yaSimakadze Shafani, umsa ka-Azaliya, umsa kaMeshulamu, umbhali, watsi:
"Thumela ku-Hilkiya, umLevi wasebukhosini, ukhokhe imali lefakwe endlwini yaSimakadze, leyobahleli bemnyango bayawuyikhokha kubo bonkhe bantfu.
Baye bayinike kulabo labaphethe umsebenzi wendlu yaSimakadze, batawubanikela kulabo labasebenza ekulungiseni lokubi ethempelini laSimakadze.
labakhonti, nalabakhangisi, nalabakhonta emapulangwe; bathenge nemithi, bacwebeze ematshe, balungise indlu.
Bangeke babe nenkinga yekubambisana ngemali yabo, ngoba bayawukhululeka."
UHilkiya, umpristi omkhulu, watsi kuShafani, umbhali: "Ngithole incwadi yemtsetfo ethempelini laSimakadze."Waye wanikela incwadi kuShafani, wayayifunda.
UShafanu, umbhali, waphuma waya kunkhosi, watsi: "Labaphathi bakho bakhiphe imali lefunyelwe endlwini yaSimakadze, bayinikela kubo labaphatha umsebenzi wendlu ka-Simakadze."
UShafanu, umbhali, wabatshela ukumkani watsi: "Hilkiya, umsa waSimakadze, waninikele incwadi."U-Shafanu wehla waya kumkani.
Batsi: "Kuye kwenzeka kutsi, lapho unkhosi ikhuluma amazwi encwadini yemtsetfo, inhlavu yakhe yaluka.
Waletsa uHilkiya, umLevi, na-Ahikamu, umsa waShafani, na-Akbori, umsa waMika, na-Shafani, umbhali, na-Asaya, umkhonzi wenkhosi, watsi:

"Niye nibuze uSimakadze ngami, nalabo bantu, nebantfu bonke base-Juda, mayelana nalencwadi lefunyelwe; ngobe kukhulu kakhulu inkohliso yaSimakadze, itfule phezu kwethu, ngoba labababutsi bethu bangakulalela amazwi alo ncwadi, bangeke benze konke lokubhalwe kulo.

Hilikiya, umpristi, ne-Ahikam, ne-Akbor, ne-Shafan, ne-Asaya, bafike ku-Hulda, indodana ka-Salumu, unyana ka-Tikwa, unyana ka-Harhasi, umphathi wempahla yasebukhosini, lahlala eJerusalema, emgwaqeni lomusha, bekhuluma naye.
Wabaphendvula watsi: "Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, utsi: Nitsi kulowo muntu loyawutfumisa kuye:
Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli watsi: "Simakadze usho kutsi: 'Ngitawuletha buhlungu kulona lendawo kanye nalabahlali bayo, njengobe kubhalwe encwadini labeyayifunda ukumkani wakwaYuda.
Bemishiya, banikela ngemnikelo wekushiswa ema-Amori kanye nalabo baseGibhithe, nabo bonkhe labaholi babo; ngobe banciphise isandla sami ngaleso sithendeni saSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wabodwa.
"Nasenkhosini yaseYuda, leyawukusithumela kutsi nibuze uSimakadze, nitsi kuye: Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, uthe njalo mayelana nalawo mazwi lawuvayo;

ngobe intliziyo yakho yakhululeka, nawe wahlupheka phambi kwaSimakadze, lapho ukhuluma khona ngalendawo kanye nalabo bahlala kuyo, kutsi bangabi lutho, babuye babe lilangabhe; ngobe usawotise iingubo zakho, wathandaza phambi kwami; ngakho nami ngikuphendulile, kusho Simakadze.
Lakho, bona, ngiyakususa ufike ubahlangabeze nababa bakho, ube nekuthula; wena ungeke ubone lokubi kakhulu longingakulethela kulendawo.' Baye bakhuluma kunkhosi, batsi: 'Ngubani lowo muntfu?'
Lenkhosi yatsi: "Ngubani nalowo muntfu longeke afike eJerusalema, kutsi abe nguSimakadze Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli?"

Waya endlwini kaNkulunkulu, naye wonke lamadoda aseYuda, nalabahlali baseJerusalema, nabo bonke abaLevi, nabaprofeti, nabo bonke lamakhosi, kusukela emncane kuye emkhulu; wafunda kuwo wonke amazwi encwadini yesivumelwano esifunwa ethempelini likaNkulunkulu.

Wahlala khona ukumkani, wakwenza isivumelwano phambi kwaSimakadze, ukuba alandele Simakadze, nakuba agcine imiyalo yakhe, nemizekelo yakhe, nemithetho yakhe, ngentliziyo yakhe yonke, nangemphefumulo wakhe wonke, ukuze aphumeze amazwi esivumelwano esibhalwe kulo ncwadi. Nabo bonke abantu bavuma ukuba bagcine lesisivumelwano.

Unkhosi yaletsa uHilkiya, umLevi omkhulu, nalabaLevi besigaba sesibili, nalabo abagcina isango, ukuba basuse ethempelini laSimakadze zonke izinto ezihlelwe nguBaali, neAshere, naleyo mihlaba yonke yezulu; wayazibulala ngaphandle kweJerusalema, emahlathini aseKidroni, wazisa inkungu yayo eBheteli.

Wakhipha nabo bonke labaphatsimandla, labo bantfu labangcwele, labababuyisa emathempelini aphakeme emadolobhani lakaJuda neyeJerusalema; wabasusa nalabo lababusa kuBaali, nelanga, nenyanga, namaplanethi, naleyo mihlaba yonke yasezulu.
Wakhipha i-Ashera ethempelini laSimakadze, wayisa emfuleni weKidroni, ngaphandle kweJerusalema, wayawuyibulala khona, wayibopha ibe nguthuli, wamisa uthuli lwakhe emasimini ebantfu labajwayelekile.
Wabulala naletinye tindzawo letiphakeme tekudla, letibekhona endlwini yaSimakadze, lapho labesifazane bekhipha khona tingwevu ta-Ashera.

Josiya wakhipha bonkhe labapristi emabhishi eYuda waya kuJerusalema, wabasusa emathempelini aphakeme lapho bashiswa khona inkungu, kusukela eGebha kuya eBher-sheba; wabulala nalabangcwele beminyango yedolobha, labangasemgwaqeni wemnyango kaJoshua, umphathi womgwaqo, abesekwesobunxele uma uphuma emgwaqweni womhlaba.
Kuye kwaba khona lapho labaphakheji bemadolobha aphakeme abazange bafike ethempelini laSimakadze eJerusalema, kodvwa babedla umnikelo wesono kanye nalabaphakheji babo.
Wayibulala neTophethi, efulani la-Ben-Hinom, kutsi angeke kube khona lowo lokhipha unyana wakhe noma intombi yakhe ngemlilo kuMoleki.

Wakhipha nemahhashi, amakhosi eYuda ayewanikela ngawo kulilanga, awabeka emgwaqeni wendlu yaSimakadze, eduze kwegumbi lesikhulu, ligama lakhe bekunguNathani-meleki, emphilweni. UYosiya washiswa ngemikhumbi yelanga, waba yinkhosi yaseJerusalema.

Nalemibhede lama-altari, abeyayilungisa bantfu benkhosi yakaJuda, ayawuyisa phansi; nalemibhede lama-altari, abeyayilungiselela Manase, lawasesitezi esiphansi sendlu kaSimakadze, ayawuyisa phansi, wamisa khona, wabeka emacwecwe ayo emfuleni weKidron.

Lamadolobha amakhulu aseJerusalema, lasenyakatho-ntshonalanga kweNtaba yeMfofu, lapho uSolomoni, ukumkani waseSirayeli, abewukwakha khona iAshtorethi, into ebuhlungu yalabaSidoni, naKemoshi, into ebuhlungu yalabaMoabi, naMilkomi, into ebuhlungu yalaba-Ammoniti, lobukhosi bakhe babususa.
UYosiya waphula nemihlobiso yetitshe, wabulala netinhlabamkhosi te-ashere, wabeka emathambo labantu endaweni yabo.
Wayibulala ne altare eBetheleli, nalapho kufike khona uYerobohabhi, umsa waNebati, lowo wabangele livi laSirayeli; wayala khona lapho kufike khona, wayibopha ibe ngumhlabatsi, wehlisa i-ashere.

Josiya wabuka, wabona tigodzi letisemhlabatsini, wakhipha tigodzi, wabashisa ethempelini, watsi: "Ingcwele lengcwele, ingcwele lengcwele, ingcwele lengcwele, ingcwele lengcwele, ingcwele lengcwele, ingcwele lengcwele, ingcwele lengcwele!"

Josiya watsi kuye: "Iyini lemihlobiso yetinhloko letiboshwe ngegolide, lapho ngiyibona khona?" Lamadoda edolobha laphendvula atsi: "Lemihlobiso yetinhloko tiboshwe ngegolide, ingcwele kamuntfu waNkulunkulu, lofike eYuda, wakhuluma ngalezinto letinjalo, labewenzako ema-altari aseBheteli."
Watsi uYosiya: "Lahlani, ngobe akukho muntu longeke asuse ticubu zakhe." Bagcina khona ticubu zakhe kanye neticubu zemuntfu lomprofeti labesuka eSamari.
Josiya wakhipha naleyo mifula yeSamariya, nemindeni yalemihlaba yemhlabatsini, leyayikhiwa ngubukhosi beSirayeli, lababeka uSimakadze emlonyeni; wabambisene nabo njengobe abehlele eBetheli.
Wabulala bonkhe labaphatsimandla bemadolobha lasentshonalanga ema-altari abo, wafudukela eJerusalema.
Unkhosi yaletsa bonke bantfu, yatsi: "Nceda nigcine iPasha kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wenu, njengobe kubhalwe kulo ncwadi yemtsetfo."
Kungakabi kwenziwe iPasha lenjalo kusukela kuleso sikhathi lapho abavikeli bephatha khona bantfu baka-Israyeli, nakuso sonke isikhathi samakhosi e-Israyeli nawaseJuda.
