Kwaba ngumnyaka wesikhombisa nemashumi lamane namakhulu lamabili nakulishumi elinesihlanu kunkhosi Josiase, lapho kwabekwa khona iPasha kuSimakadze eYerusalem.

UYosiya wakhipha nalabo abakhuluma ngezinto eziphilayo, nelabo labafuna ukubona ikusasa, nama-theraphoni, nama-idoli, kanye naloluhlobo lonke lwezinto ezibi ezibonakale eYuda naseJerusalema, ukuze aphumeze amazwi emtsetfo abhalwe encwadini kaHilkiya, umLevi, lafunwa endlwini yaSimakadze.
Akukho ukumkani lofana naye, ngaphambili kwakhe noma ngemuva kwakhe, lowo wabuyela kuSimakadze ngenhliziyo yakhe yonke, nemphefumulo wakhe wonke, nemandla akhe onke, ekwenzeni konke umthetho waMosi.
Naphezu kwalo, Simakadze akazange abuyisele emuva buhlungu bakhe obukhulu, lobushiyelwe eYiputa, ngenxa yaleyo mikhosi yonke yenkhosi Manase, lapho ayemkhazalisa khona.

USimakadze watsi: "NaseYuda ngiyawuwususa phambi kwami, njengendlela lapho ngiwususe khona iSirayeli; neJerusalema, ledolobha labengilikhethile, kanye nalendlu, indawo lapho ngitsi khona: 'Ligama lami lizoba khona.'
Lokunye lokushiwo nguYosiya, naleyo yonke imisebenzi yakhe, akubonakali kubhalwe encwadini yemave yamankhosi yaYuda?
Ngomnyaka waJosiya, uFaro-Nekho, ukumkani waseMisri, wehla ekungeneni kwenkhosi yaseAshuri emfuleni iFurathi; inkhosi Josiasi yaphuma yekulwa naye. Wayemthola kuMegido, wambulala khona.

Abaholi bakhe baphuma eMegido, bafike eJerusalema, bamfaka emtimbeni wakhe, watiwa ethempelini lakhe; kodvwa bantfu belizwe bathatha uJoahazi, unyana kaYosiya, bamphisa, bakwenza waba ngunkhosi endaweni yoyise.
UJehoahazi ubeneminyaka engama-23 ubudala lapho afika ebukhosini, waba ngunkhosi iminyaka lengemashumi lamane nasitfupha eJerusalema; umsa wakhe wakunguHamutali intombi kaJeremiasi waseLibna.
Wakwenza lokudla lokubi emehloni kaSimakadze, njengobe babekwenzela bantfu bakhe.
UFaro-Nekho wamshiya eRibla, ezweni leHamati, angeke abe ngubukhosi baseJerusalema; wabeka kuJuda isiliva elinamathani lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu, negolide elinamathani lamakhulu mahlanu.
UFaro-Nekho wabeka uEliyakimu, umsa kaJosiya, waba ngunkhosi endaweni kaJosiya, ubaba wakhe, washintsha igama lakhe abe nguJehoyakim; watsi uYoahazi afike eYiputa, wafa khona.
Joyakimi wanikela kuFaro ngesiliva negolide, njengoba akazange afune; wakhipha naleyo nyika, ngaso sonke simo sawo, wanikela ngesiliva negolide, kutsi abe nguFaro-Nekho.
UYoyakimu ubeneminyaka lemashumi lamane nesihlanu ubudala lapho aphuma khona ebukhosini, waba ngunkhosi iminyaka lengema-11 eJerusalema; umzala wakhe wawunguZebida, intombi kaPedaya waseRuma.
Wakwenza lokudla lokubi emehloni kaSimakadze, njengobe babekwenzela bantfu bakhe.
Ngelilanga lebukhosi beJoyakimu, wafika Nebukhadnezari, ukumkani waseBabiloni, waya ezweni leli, watsi: "Joyakimu utawube ngumkhonzi wakhe iminyaka lemithathu; kodvwa wabuyela emuva, wamshiya.

Ngako-ke uSimakadze wathumela emabhishobhi eBhabhiloni, namabhishobhi eAram, namabhishobhi eMoabi, nemabhishobhi lamadvodza aseAmoni, kutsi ahlasele uJehoyakim, watsi: "Tsuse umbuso waseYuda," njengobe Simakadze abekhuluma ngalabo bantu bakhe labaprofeti.
Kuye kwaba njalo kuYuda, ngenxa yemtsetfo waSimakadze; ngobe wabasusa emehlweni akhe, ngenxa yebubi baManase, kanye naletinye tindzawo letiphakeme lapho abehlala khona.
Nase ngenxa yegazi lelingabi necala, labelihlanjululwe nguManase; ngobe wabangisisa iJerusalema ngegazi lelingabi necala; Simakadze akazange avumele kutsi likhululwe.
Lokunye lokushiwo nguYehoyakimi, naleyo yonke imisebenzi yakhe, akubonakali kubhalwe encwadini yemlando wamakhosi eYuda?
UJoyakimu wafa, uJehoyakini, umsa wakhe, waba ngubukhosi bakhe.
Unkhosi yase-Egipta akazange aphinde aphume ezweni lakhe; ngobe inkhosi yaBabiloniya yayithathe yonke lelizwe lakhe, kusukela emfuleni we-Egipta kuya emfuleni iFurathi.
UJehoyakini ubeneminyaka lengema-18 ubudala lapho aphuma ebukhosini, waba nguMbuso waseJerusalema iminyaka emihlanu; umzali wakhe wakunguNehushta, intombi kaElnathani waseJerusalema.
Wakwenza lokudla lokubi emehloni kaSimakadze, njengobe kwaba sekwenzeke kuyise.
Ngeleso sikhathi, labaphathi baNabukodonozore, ukumkani waseBabiloni, bafika eJerusalema, bahlasela lomhlaba.
NaNabukodonozore, ukumkani waseBabiloni, waya kulo mji, ngobe labaphathi bakhe bebengawukhuli.

Waphuma uYoyakimu, umkwetsi weYuda, waya kunkhosi yaseBhabheli, yena nenkosi yakhe, nabangani bakhe, nabaholi bakhe, nalabaphathi bakhe; ngamnyaka wamashumi lamakhulu mahlanu wokubusa kwakhe, ukumkani waseBabheleni wabakhipha.

UNebhukhadnezari wakhipha zonke izimali zendlu yaSimakadze, nezendlu yenkhosi, wabulala naletinye zinto tagolide, azenzayo uSolomoni, ukumkani waseSirayeli, ethempelini laSimakadze, njengobe Simakadze abesho.

Wababulala bonke bantfu baseJerusalema, nalabaphathi bonke, nalabo bonkhe labaholi bokulwa, labalishumi elinamawaka, kanye nalabo bonke labo basebenza ngesandla kanye nelabo labasebenza ngensimbi; akazange ashiye ngaphandle kwabafileyo ezweni.
UNebhukhadnezari wakhipha uJehoyakini waya eBhabheli, naye umkakhe, namakhosikazi akhe, nabaholi bakhe, nebaholi belizwe lakhe; wabakhipha bonke eJerusalema waya eBhabheli.

Nakho ukumkani waseBabiloni wakhipha eBabiloni lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa lamadoda anamandla, kanye namakhulu mahlanu labaholi bemikhosi, nalabo labasebenza ngesandla, nabo bonkhe labo labacoshayo, labalungele ukulwa.
UMbuso waseBabiloniya wabeka Mathaniya, umngane wakhe, waba ngunkhosi phandle kwakhe, washintsha igama lakhe abe nguZedekiya.
UZedekiya ubeneminyaka engama-21 ubudala lapho aphuma ebukhosini, waba ngunkhosi iminyaka lelishumi elinanye eJerusalema; umzala wakhe wawunguHamutali, intombi kaYeremiya waseLibna.
Wakwenza lokubi emehloni kaSimakadze, njengobe uJoyakim akwenze.
Lento yonke yafika eJerusalema naseYuda, ngenxa yendlala kaSimakadze, kuze atawuyikhipha phambi kwakhe; ngobe uZedekiya wabuya wahlasela ukumkani waseBabhibheli.

Ngomnyaka wesithoba wekubusa kwakhe, kumnyaka weshumi, ngelilanga lelishumi, wafika Nebukhadnezare, ukumkani waseBabhileyoni, yena nemsebenti wakhe wonke, eJerusalema, bamisa isikhulu esibhekene naleyo ndawo, babuye basungula izingcezu zokulwa phezu kwayo.
Ledolobha lalibanjwa kuze kube ngumnyaka wesitsatfu wenkhosi Sedekiya.
Ngemnyaka wesihlanu, ngelilanga lesithoba lenyanga yesikhombisa, ndlala yafika enhloko-dolobha, kuze kwatsi kungakabi nekudla kubo bonkhe bantfu.

Baphuma nabo bonke lamadoda emphini, babaleka ngebusuku, besuka emgwaqeni lophakathi kwemigwaqo lemibini, lapho kwabekhona igadi yenkhosi; ngobe labaChalebhi babesemgwaqweni womjikelo wedolobha. UMbuso wase-Asiriya wahlasela umfula iJordane.
Lase-Ashurini nalabo baseBabiloniyi balandzela ukumkani uZedekiya, bamfika emahlathini eJerikho; nabo bonkhe labaholi bakhe baphuma kuye.
Baphindze babulala uMbuso WaseBabiloni, bayawukhipha ekungeneni kwakhe kunkhosi yaseBabiloni eRibla, wabeka sinqumo sakhe.
Babulala labantwana baka-Zedekiya phambi kwakhe, baphuca imehlo ka-Zedekiya, babeka emgodini wakhe, bayawukhipha eBabilonini.

Ngomnyaka wamashumi lamane nesikhombisa wemnyaka wesisihlanu waseNabukodonozore, ukumkani wakwa-Babiloni, ngemhla lesishumi nalinye lenyanga yesishiyagalombili, wafika eJerusalema Nebuzaradani, umphathi wemagwebu, lomunye wabakhonzi bakankhosi yaseBabiloni.
Wayibulala ngemlilo indlu yaSimakadze, nendlu yasebukhosini, naletinye tindlu taseJerusalema; nayinye lendlu enkulu wayayibulala.
Nawo wonke umkhosi weSirayeli, lobe ngaphansi kwenhloko yetive, waphula imiganga yaseJerusalema yaso.
Nabo labashiywa edolobhani, kanye nalabo labehleli emzini wakhe, nabo bonkhe labo baphuma kunkhosi yaseBhabheli, kanye nebantfu labasebukhosini, Nebuzaradanu, umphathi wetente, wabeka kuwo.
Kusekho nabanye labafileyo ezweni leli, lomkhuluwa wemagwebu wabashiya kutsi basebenzela emavini nemhlabatsini.

Nalemibhoshongo yesiliva neleyo yemacwecwe egolide, naleso sibhedlela sesiliva kanye nesolwandle lesimhlophe lesingasethempelini laSimakadze, labaBabiloniyi basibulala; bayawukhipha isiliva nalolimo lwegolide laseBhabhiloni.
Bathabathe netinkomishi, netingconyana, netimbhoshongo, netikhongo, naletinye tindzawo letiphakeme letisetshenziswa kumsebenti wesiliva.
Umphathi wemagwebu wakhipha tibhaka-mlilo, netibopho letiboshwako, naletinye tindzawo letiphakeme tekudla, tonkhe tive tegolide letihle kanye nesive lesihle.
Lesiliva, lelinetinhloko ezimbili, nelwandle lolunye, naletinyawo letiphansi, loSolomoni abeyawuzenza endlwini yaSimakadze, yayikhulu kakhulu kutsi ingacinywa.

Inhloko lesinye setihlombe samamitha lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu ngebude, nalapho inhloko lesinye setihlombe samamitha lamakhulu lasitfupha nesikhombisa ngebude, kwabe khona inhlanganisela yetinhlamvu tesiliva netinhlamvu tesiliva netinhlamvu tegolide.
Nase-Ahiya, umsa waSeraya, umLevi, neSofaniya, umLevi wesibili, nalabathathu labagwema umnyango, wabakhipha ejele.

Wathatha lamadoda asemaphandleni, abe ngumphathi webantfu labahamba ngemlilo, nalabahlanu ababonako ebusweni benkhosi, nalowo umbhali wesikhulu somkhosi, lowo wakhipha bantfu belizwe emkhosini, nalabamashumi lamane labasemhlabatsini labafunwa enhliziyweni yedolobha.
Nabuzaradani, umphathi wetive, wabathatha, wabeka kubo emkhosini waseBabheleni, eRibla.
Wababulala khona eRibla, ezweni leHamati, ukumkani waseBabiloni; ngobe batfunywa bantfu baseYuda emasimini abo, baboshwa emazweni abo.
NaNabukodonozore, ukumkani waseBabheleni, wabeka Gedaliya, umsa ka-Ahikamu, unyana ka-Shafani, waba nguMengameli webantfu labashiwo eYuda.

Bafike kuboGedaliya eMiphatha, bonke abavikeli bamaphoyisa, nabo bonkhe bantfu babo, beva kutsi ukumkani waseBhabheli wabeka uGedaliya njengomphathi; kwafika khona uIshmayeli unyana kaNethaniya, noYohanani unyana kaKareha, naSeraya unyana kaTanhumethi waseNetofa, naYazaniya unyana kaMaakathi, nabo bonke abantu babo.
Gedaliya wababulale nabo bonkhe bantfu bakhe, watsi kubo: "Ungabi nenkinga nabaholi beBabiloniya; hlalani kulelizwe, nisebenzela ukumkani waseBabheli, khona-ke kutawuba lula kuwe."

Lamuhla, ngemnyaka wesikhombisa, kwafika uIshmayeli, umsa waNethaniya, usana lwakhe Elishama, wesifazane wasebukhosini, namadoda lalishumi naye, bahlasela nekubulala Gedaliya, kanye nabo bonkhe bantfu baseYuda nalabaBabiloniyi lababe naye eMizpa.
Lakho bonkhe bantfu, kusukela kulomncane kuya kulomkhulu, kanye nabaholi besive, baphuma bafika eYiputa; ngobe babengeke bakhululeke emkhosini ngenxa yalabaBabheli.

Ngomnyaka wamashumi lasitfupha nesikhombisa ngemuva kwekuboshwa kukaJoyakimu, ukumkani wakwaYuda, kumnyaka weshumi nambili, ngenyanga yesihlanu, ngosuku lwesikhombisa nesikhombisa, Evil-Merodaki waba ngukumkani waseBabheleni; ngaleso sikhathi wakhipha Joyakimu, ukumkani wakwaJuda, emgodini.
Wakhuluma naye ngekuthula, wabeka isikhundla sakhe phezulu kunabo bonkhe bantfu labakhona naye eBabiloni.
UJehoyakini wehlisa ingubo yakhe yekuboshwa, wahlala ekudlaleni embhedeni wenkhosi yonke imihla yakhe.
Unkhosi yayawunikela kuye ngekudla kwakhe lilanga ngalinye, kuze kube sekuphila kwakhe.
1Chr: Adami, naSethi, naEnosi,
Kenani, neMahalaleli, naJaredi,
Henoki, neMethusela, naLameke,
NaNowa, naShem, naHami, naJafeti, bantfu labafileyo.
Labantwana bakaJaphethi: Gomer, neMagog, naMadai, naYavan, naTubal, naMesheki, naTirasi.
Lamadvodzana aGomer: Ashkenazi, neDipata, naTogarma.
Lamadvodzana aJawan bekunguElisha, neTarshishi, naKithimi, naRodani.
Labantwana bakaHami: Kushi, neMizrayim, naPhuti, naKanana.
Labantwana bakaKushi: Seba, neHavila, neShabtha, neRaama, neSabteka; labantwana baRaama: Sheba naDedani.
Kushi waba ngubaba kaNimrodi, lowo wakhula waba ngumkhosi lomkhulu emhlabeni.
Mitsraim waba ngumzala wa-Ludi, na-Anami, na-Lehabi, na-Naftukhi,
nePathusi, neKasluhi (kubo kwaphuma nalabaFilisti), neKaftorithi.
Kenani waba ngumzali waSidoni, umzali wakhe wesifazane, neHeti.
Waba nguyise we-Jebusi, ne-Amori, ne-Girgasi, ne-Amori.
ne-Hivi, ne-Arki, ne-Sini,
ne-Arvadite, ne-Zemarite, ne-Hamathite.
Labantwana baka-Shem: Elami, naAshuri, naArfaxadi, naLudi, naArami, naUzi, naHuli, naGetheri, naMesheki.
Arfaxadi waba ngumzali wa-Shela, na-Shela waba ngumzali wa-Héberi.
Na-Héberi waba nemadvodzana lamabili; igama lomnye lakunguPelege, ngobe eminyakeni yakhe yahlukaniswa umhlaba; negama lomkhulu wakhe lalinguJoktan.
Joktani waba ngumzali wa-Almodad, naShelef, naHazarmaveth, naJera,
Hadoram, neUzal, neDikla,
Ebali, neAbimayeli, neSheba,
Ofiri, neHavila, naJobabi; labo bonke babemadvodzana aJoktan.
Laba ba-Shem: Shem, neArfaxadi, naShela,
Eberi, nePelege, neRehu,
Serugi, neNahori, naTera,
kanye naAbrama, lokuthiwa nguAbrahama.
Lamadvodzana aAbrahama bekungu-Isake ne-Ishmayeli.
Lolu hlobo lwabo: Umzali wa-Ishmayeli waba nguNebaiothi; Kedari, naAdbeeli, naMibshami,
Mishma, Duma, Massa, Hadadi, Tema,
Laba nguJethuri, naNafishi, naKedema; lalaba ngumadvodzana aIshmayeli.
Ketura, umkakhe uAbrahama, wazala Zimrani, Jokshani, Medani, Midyani, Ishbaki, Shuha; labantwana bakaJokshani: Sheba neDedan.
Labantwana baka-Midyani: Efa, ne-Efer, ne-Enoki, ne-Abida, ne-Eldaa; labo bonke bamakhosikazi kaKetura.
Abrahami waba ngumzali wa-Isake; labantwana ba-Isake: Esawu ne-Israyeli.
Labantwana baka-Esau: Eliphazi, naRehuweli, naJeusi, naJalamu, naKorahi.
Labantwana baka-Elifazi: Temana, naOmar, naZephi, naGatham, naKenazi, naTimna, naAmaleki.
Lamadvodzana aReuheli bekunguNahati, neZeraha, naShama, naMiza.
Labantwana bakaSeiri: Lothani, neShobali, neSibeoni, naAna, naDishoni, naEzeri, naDishani.
Lamadvodzana aLothani bekunguHori, neHomam; nalowesifazane waLothani bekunguTimna.
Labantwana bakaShobali: Aliyani, naManahati, naEbali, naShefi, naOnam; labantwana baSibeoni: Ahiya neAna.
Unyana waAna ube nguDishon; nemadvodzana aDishon bekunguHamrani, ne-Eshbani, ne-Itranhi, ne-Kerani.
Labantwana ba-Ezeri: Bilhan, neZaavan, neYaakan; labantwana ba-Dishan: Uz neAran.
Labo babengubukhosi base-Edomu, ngaphambi kokuba kubekho uMbuso waseSirayeli: Bela, umsa waBeori; igama ledolobha lakhe lakunguDinhaba.
NaBela wafa, waba nguSimakadze longuSomandla, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, utsi: Utsi.
Wafa uJobabi, waba nguMbuso waseHusham, welizwe letemanani.
Wafa Husham, waba ngunkhosi esikhundleni sakhe Hadadi, umsa waBedadi, loyawuhlasela iMidyani emhlabatsini weMoabi; igama ledolobha lakhe lakunguAviti.
NaHadadi wafa, Samla waseMasreka waba ngunkhosi yakhe.
Samla wafa, waba nguMbuso waseShawuli waseRehobothi eMfula i-Erani.
Wafa uShawule, wahlala khona Baale-hanani, umsa wa-Akbori, waba ngunkhosi.
Baale-Hanani wafa, waba ngubukhosi bakhe; Hadadi waba ngunkhosi yakhe; igama ledolobha lakhe lakunguPahi; umsa wakhe waba nguMehetabeli, intombi kaMatredi, intombi kaMezahabi.
NaHadadi wafa. Lamadodana lamakhosi eEdomu: Timna, neAliya, naJethethi,
Aholibama, neEla, nePinoni,
Kenazi, neTeman, neMibsari,
Magdiyeli, ne-Iram; laba babengubaholi beEdomu.
Lokho kwakungaba ngumnikelo wesono waSirayeli: Rubeni, neSimeoni, naLevi, naJuda, naIssakha, naZabuloni,
Dan, naJoseph, naBenjamini, naNaphtali, naGadi, naAseri.

Oonyana bakaYuda: uEr, noOnan neShela; labo bathathu babezalwa nguwesifazane waseKanana, intombi ka-Shua. Nalo Er, lomkhulu kunabo bonke emndenini wakwaJuda, wawubi phambi kwamehlo kaSimakadze; Simakadze wambulala.
NaTamari, inkosikazi kaYuda, wazala kuye uPerezi neZeraha; bonkhe lamadvodza akaJuda babe ngumakhulu mane.
Lamadvodzana aPerezi bekunguHeshroni naHamuli.
Lamadvodzana aZera bekunguZimri, neEthan, naHeman, naKalkoli, naDara, labahlanu.
Umnyaka waKarmi waba ngu-Ahari, lowo wabulala bantfu bakaSirayeli, watsi: "Ngiye kutsi ngibuyele eGibhithe.
Umnyaka wa-Ethani waba ngu-Azariya.
Labantwana labazalwa nguHeshroni: uJerahmeel, naRam, naKalebu.
Ramu waba ngumzali wa-Aminadabi, na-Aminadabi waba ngumzali waNahshoni, umholi wemadvodzana aYuda.
Nashoni waba ngumzali waSalma, naSalma waba ngumzali waBoazi.
Boasi wazala Obedi, Obedi wazala Isayi.
Lomnyaka wesitsatfu wa-Isai waba nguEliaba, lomnyaka wesithathu waba nguAbinabadi, lomnyaka wesithathu waba nguShimea,
wesihlanu wakhe waba nguRadayi,
lomnyaka wasikhombisa ube nguOzemi, lomnyaka wesihlanu ube nguDavide.
Nabo-ke boyise babo: Serehiya naAbigayeli; nemadvodzana aSeruhiya lamashumi matatu: Abishayi, neYowabe, naAsaheli.
UAbihayeli waba ngumzali wa-Amasa; ubaba wa-Amasa ube nguJetheri, umIshmaeli.
Kalebe, umsa waHezroni, waba nemadvodzana aAzuba, indodana yakhe, neJeriothi; bonkhe bantfu ba-Azuba: Yeseri, Shobab, naArdon.
Azuba yafa, Kalebe washada neEfrata; yena wazala Huru.
Huri waba ngumzali waUri, Uri waba ngumzali waBesaleleli.
Nalapho Hezroni eneminyaka leyisishiyagalombili ubudala, washada nendvodzakati yaMahiri, umsa kaGileyadi; yena wazala Segub.
Segub wazala Yairi, lowo waba nguMengameli wemadolobha lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu ezweni leGileyadi.
Geshuri naArami bakhipha emabhishi eYairi, neKenati kanye nemadolobhana ayo, emabhishi lamashumi lamane; labo bonke babebantfu labazalwa nguMahiri, ubaba kaGileyadi.
Nalapho Heshroni efa eKalebe-Efrata, Abiya, indodana yakhe, yazala Ashuri; yena waba nguyise waTekoa.
Nabo-ke lamadvodzana aJerahmeel, lomzali waHezroni: Ramomzali wakhe, naBuna, naOren, naOzem, naAhiya.
UJerameheli wayenenkosikazi yesibili, igama lakhe lakunguAtara; yena waba ngumama kaOnam.
Labantwana baka-Ram, lomkhulu la-Yerahmeel: Maazi, neJamini, naEkeri.
Lamadvodzana aOnam bekunguShamai neYada; Lamadvodzakati aShamai bekunguNadab naAbishuri.
Igama lendvodzakati ya-Abishuri lakungu-Abihayeli, wazala uAhbani naMolidi.
Lamadvodzana aNabadi bekungu-Seledi ne-Afayami; kepha Seledi wafa, angeke abe nendvuna.
Umnyaka wa-Apayami waba ngu-Ishi; mnyaka wa-Ishi waba ngu-Sheshan; mnyaka wa-Sheshan waba ngu-Ahlai.
Labantwana bakaJada, lomkhuluwa ka-Shamai, nguJether neJonathani; Jether wafa angeke abe nemntwana.
Labantwana baka-Jonathani: Pelethi naZaza; laba babengumadvodzana aJerahmeeli.
Sheshani akazange abe nemadvodzana, kodvwa waba nemadvodzakati. Wabekhona umkhonto wakhe waseMijiphu, lokuthiwa yiJarha.
NaSheshani wabanika intombi yakhe Jarha, umkhonzi wakhe, kutsi abe ngumkakhe; yena wazala Atayi.
Atai waba ngumzali waNathani, Nathani waba ngumzali waZabadi.
Zabhadi waba ngumzali waEfrali, Efrali waba ngumzali waObedi.
Obedi waba ngumzali waJehu, Jehu waba nguyise waAzaria.
Azariya waba ngumzali waHelezi, neHelezi waba ngumzali waEleasa.
Elisa wazala Shishmayi, Shishmayi wazala Shalumu.
Shalumu waba ngumzali waJekamiya, Jekamiya waba ngumzali waElishama.
Nabo-ke lamadvodzana aKalebe, lomkhuluwa kaJerameheli: Mesha, umzali wakhe wokuqala, lowo waba nguyise waZifa; naMaresha, umzali wakhe, lowo waba nguyise waHebroni.
Labantwana baka-Hebroni: Kora, neTaphuayi, naRekemi, naShema.
Sema waba ngumzali waRahamu, waba ngumzali waJorkeamu; Rekem waba ngumzali waShamai.
Umnyaka waShamai waba nguMaoni; Maoni waba ngumzali waBeth-Tsuri.
Epha, umkakhe waKalebi, wamzala Harani, naMoza, naGazezi; Harani waba ngubaba kaGazezi.
Lamadvodzana aJahadi bekunguRegem, neJothani, neGeshani, naPeleti, naEfahi, naShaafi.
NaMaaka, indvodzakati kaKalebe, yazala Sheberi naTirhana.
Wazala naShafa, ubaba kaMadmana, neSheva, ubaba kaMakbena neGibeha; lomunye wemadvodzana aKalebe waba nguAksha.
Lokho kwakuye kwaba ngumnyaka wa Kalebe: lamadvodzana aHure, lomzali weEfrata: Shobali, umsa waKiriyati-Yearim;
Salma, umsa waBethelehemu, naHarephu, umsa waBeth-gaderi.
Lamadvodza laShobali, umsa waKiriyati-yearimi, abe nguHarohe naphesheya kwalabo baMenuhati.
Laba baphuma eKirihati-yearimi: laJethiti, nalabaPhuti, nalabaShumati, nalabaMishrayi; kubo kwaphuma labahlali baseZora neEshtaoli.
Labantwana bakaSalma: laba baseBethlehem, nalaba baseNetofati, nalaba baseAtroti-beth-Jowabhi, nengxenye yabemaManahati, nalaba baseZori.
Laba bami baseJabhesi, laba nguTirathi, neShimeati, neSukati; labo bangabe yimadvodzana aHamati, lobaba bemndeni wakwaRekabu.
Labo bazalwa nguDavide eHebron: lomkhulu wakhe waba ngu-Amnoni, waAhinoamu waseJezreeli; wesibili waba nguDaniele, waAbihayeli waseKarmeli.
lomunye waba nguAbsalomu, waMahaka, indodana kaTalmai, ukumkani waseGeshuru; lowesibili waba nguAdoniya, waHagiti.
wesihlanu uShefatiya, wa-Abitale; wesithandathu uYitreyami, wa-Egla, indodana kaDavide.
Lalaba sishiyagalombili bazalwa nguDavide eHebroni, lapho waba ngunkhosi iminyaka lesikhombisa namashumi lamane nesihlanu; eJerusalema waba ngubukhosi beminyaka lemashumi mathathu namahlanu.
Alaba bazalwa kuye eJerusalema banga-Shimea, naShobab, naNathani, naSolomoni; umzali wabo waba nguBatshua, indodana ka-Amiyeli; laba banesihlanu.
kanye na-Ibhari, neElishama, neElifeleti,
Noga, Nefegi, Japhia,
Elishama, neEliyada, neElifeleti; laba babemashumi lamane.
Labo bonke babenemadvodzana aDavide, ngaphandle kwemadvodzakati ema-Abhisheki akhe; naTamari waba nguyise wabo.
USolomoni waba nguRehoboamu; uRehoboamu waba nguAbiya; uAbiya waba nguAsa; Asa waba nguJosaphat.
Unyana waJosaphat waba nguJoramu, unyana waJoramu waba nguAhaziya, unyana waAhaziya waba nguYoashi.
uJoashi waba nguAmasiya; uAmasiya waba nguAzariya; uAzariya waba nguYothamu.
Umnyaka waJothamu waba ngu-Ahaza; umnyaka waAhaza waba ngu-Hezekiya; umnyaka waHezekiya waba nguManase.
Unyana waManase waba nguAmoni, unyana waAmoni waba nguYosiya.
Labantwana bakaYosiya: uJohanani, lomkhulu kubo; uJehoyakim, lowesibili; uZedekiya, lowesithathu; naShalumu, lowesihlanu.
Lamadvodzana aJoyakim bekunguJekoniya unyana wakhe, neSidekiya unyana wakhe.
Lamadvodzana aJekoniya, lakubotiwa ejele:Shealtiyeli umsa wakhe;
Malkhiram, nePedayaya, neShenazari, naJekamiya, naHoshama, naNedabiya.
Labantwana ba-Pedaya: Zerubabele naShemeyi; labantwana ba-Zerubabele: Meshulamu naHananiya; nenkosi yabo, Shelomitha.
NaZerubabele waba nemadvodzana lamabili: Hashubha, naOheli, naBerekiya, naHasadiya, naJushabheshedi.
Labantwana baka-Hananiya: Pelatiya, neJeshaya, nabana ba-Refaya, nabana ba-Arnan, nabana ba-Obadiya, nabana ba-Shekaniya.
Unyana waShekaniya waba nguShemaya; nemadvodzana aShemaya bekunguHatushi, ne-Igal, naBariya, naNearya, naShafati.
Lamadvodzana aNeari bekunguElioenai, neHizekiya, naAzrikam.
Labantwana baka-Eliyonai babesikhombisa: Hodaviya, neEliyasibhe, naPelaya, naAkubu, naJohhanane, naDelaya, naAnani.
Lamadvodzana aJuda bekunguPerezi, neHezroni, neKarmi, naHuri, naShobali.
Reaya, umsa waShobali, waba ngumzali waJahati; naJahati waba ngumzali waAhumayi naLahadi; laba bakungumndeni wakwaSorati.
Lalaba ngubana baka-Ethamu: Jezereli, ne-Ishma, ne-Idbashi; igama lenkosikazi yabo lakunguHazelelponi.
Penuheli waba ngumzali waGedori, ne-Ezeri waba ngumzali waHusha; labo babenemadvodzana aHur, lomkhulu laEfrata, lobaba waBethelehemu.
Ashuri, umsa waTekoa, waba nemadvodzana lamabili:Hela naNaara.
Naara wazalwa nguAhuzam, neHefer, naTemani, naHahastari; labo babenemadvodzana aNaara.
Lamadvodzana aHela bekungu-Zerethi, ne-Izhari na-Etnani.
Hakosi waba ngumzali wa-Anub, naSobheba, kanye nemindeni ya-Aharheli, umsa kaHarum.
Yabeze waba ngumuntfu lohle kunalabo labangane bakhe, ngobe indzimate yakhe yayawubiza igama lakhe ngeJabeze, watsi: "Ngimzalile ngebuhlungu."

Yabese wathandaza kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, watsi: "Nceda, unciphise lemhlaba, ugcine isandla sakho nami, uyengeze lutho lokubi kimi, ukuze ngibe sengibuhlungu." Simakadze wamnika lomnikelo wakhe.
Kelubi, mkhuluwa wa-Shuha, waba ngumzali waMehiri, lowo waba ngumzali wa-Eshtoni.
Eshtoni waba ngumzali waBeth-rapha, naPaseha, naTehina, umzali wa-Ir-nahashe; labo babengamadodana aReka.
Lamadvodzana aKenazi bekungu-Othniyeli, neSeraya; lamadvodzakati kaOthniyeli bekunguHathathi.
Meonothai waba ngumzali wa-Ofra; Seraya waba ngumzali wa-Yowabe, lowo wasungula iGheharashimi, eLwandle lwabaNdlovukazi; ngobe laba baseMeonothayi bebengabahleki.
Labantwana bakaKalebe, umsa waJefune: Iru, neEla, naNaam; unyana waEla ube nguKenazi.
Lamadvodzana aJehaleleli bekunguZife, neZifa, naTiriya, naAsareli.
Labantwana baka-Ezra: Jetheri, neMeredi, neEferi, neJaloni; kanye nendvodzakati ka-Meredi, lezala uMiryami, naShamai, naIsbha, umsa wa-Eshtemoa.
Naye u-Ahira, indodana ya-Amoni, wazala uJaredi, umsa kaGedori, na-Eberi, umsa kaSokho, na-Jekutieli, umsa kaZanoa; laba babenemadvodzana aBithiya, intombi ka-Farao, lobeMered abeyise.
Lamadvodza laHodiya, umkakhe waNaham, abenemadvodzana aKehila weGarmi, na-Eshtemoa waseMaakathi.
Labantwana bakaShimoni: Amnoni, neRina, naBenhanani, naTiloni; labantwana baka-Ishi: Zohati, naBenzohati.
Labo babe ngu:Shela, umsa wa-Juda; Er, umsa waLekha; Laada, umsa waMaresha; kanye nemindeni yalabo labasebenzela eBetha-Ashbea.
NaJokim, namadodana eKozeba, naYoashi, naSaraphi, labaphathi beMoabi, naYashubi-Lehem; la mazwi abhalwe kusukela kuleso sikhathi.
Loba babenetindlu tegolide, behlala eNethaim neGedera; bahlala khona, basebenzela ubukhosi.
Lamadvodzana aSimeoni bekunguNemuyeli, neJamini, neJaribi, naZera, naShawuli.
Umnyaka wa-Sauli waba nguShalumu; umnyaka wa-Salumu waba nguMibsam; umnyaka wa-Mibsam waba nguMisma.
Lamadvodzana aMishma bekunguHamuyeli lomnyaka munye, neZakhuri lomnyaka munye, naShimeyi lomnyaka munye.

Simeyi waba nemadvodza lalishumi elinamane emadvodzana nemadvodzana asikhombisa; kepha labazalwane bakhe bangeke babe nabantwana abaningi, ngobe lomndeni wabo wonke wawungaba khona njengaleso sihlanga se-Israyeli waJuda.
Bahlala eBeer-sheba, neMolada, neHasar-Shuali,
neBhila, neEzem, neToladi,
Betuele, neHorma, neSiklagi,
Bet-Markabothi, neHazari-Sushimi, neBet-Biri, neShaaraim; lamadolobha lawa abenewo kuze kube uDavide waba ngunkhosi.
Lamadolobha abo akungu-Etam, neAyin, neRimon, neToken, neAshan; lamadolobha lamabili.
nabo bonkhe labasemaphandleni labahlala emadolobheni lawo, kuze kube nguBaali; lawa lamadolobha abo, lapho bahlala khona, kanye nemindeni yabo.
Meshobab, neJamleki, naJosha, umsa waAmasiya,
Joeli, neJehu, umsa waJosibiya, umsa waSeraya, umsa waAsiyeli,
Eliyonani, naJakoba, naJesohaya, naAsaya, naAdiyeli, naJeshimieli, naBenaya,
kanye naZiza, umsa waShifi, umsa waAloni, umsa waJedayaya, umsa waShimri, umsa waShemaya.
Lamadodana lawa, abhalwe ngemagama abo, labenetinhloko temindeni yabo; nemindeni yabo yakhula kakhulu.
Baye bahamba kuze kufike emgwaqeni weGedori, ngasenyakatho-ntshonalanga yefula, befuna mhlabatsini lokudla lemfuyo yabo.
Bathola khona tingulube letitfubile, netilwane letihle, kanye nemhlaba lowuvulekile, nemhlaba wekuthula, nemhlaba wekuphumula. Kubekhona nalabahlali baHami lapho ngaphambili.

Lamadoda labhalwe magama lawo afike ezikhathini taHezekiya, inkhosi yaseYuda, wahlasela emaHamithi, nalabo baseMeunithi, labahlala khona, wababulala ngesandla sabo kuze kube ngalolusuku; bahlala endaweni yabo, ngobe kwakukhona khona tingulube zabo, nabo bahlala khona.
Besuka kubo emaSimeoni lamakhulu lamabili nemashumi mahlanu, baphuma beya emhlabatsini waseSeiri, nabo-Pelatiyahu, naNearyahu, naRefayahu, naUziyele, bantfu baseIshi, labasebaphathi babo.
Babulala nalabo labashiywa ngu-Amalekhi, bahlala khona kuze kungakapheli losuku.

Lokho kwakunguRubhene, umzali kaSirayeli; ngobe yena waba ngumzali wakhe, kepha ngenxa yokuthi wahlangana nenye yemindeni yababa bakhe, ilungelo lakhe lokuzalwa lidlulile kubonyana bakaJoseph, unyana kaSirayeli. Ngako-ke Rubeni akazange abe ngumzali wakhe emndenini wabo.
UJuda waba mkhulu kunabo bonkhe labazalwane bakhe, waphuma kuye umholi; kepha uJosefa waba ngumnyaka wesitsatfu.
Lamadvodza laRubeni, lomkhulu ku-Israyeli, lakunguHanok, naPallu, naHezroni, naKarmi.
Lamadvodzana aJoyele bekungu-Shemaya uyise, neGoge uyise wa-Shemaya, neShimeyi uyise wa-Goge,
uMika, umsa waShimeyi; uRehaya, umsa waMikaya; uBaali, umsa waRehaya;
naBeera, umsa waBaali. Tiglathi-pileseri, ukumkani waseAshuri, waya eBeera; Beera waba nguMengameli wekwaRubheni.
Amakhosikazi akhe, ngemindeni yabo, kanye nalabo lababhalwa emndenini wabo: uJeyeli, umholi, neZekaria,
naBela, umsa waAzazi, umsa waShema, umsa waJoyele; laba bahlala emhlabatsini kusuka eAroeri kuya eNebo neBaale-meoni.
Nasekumalanga bahlala kuze kube yilapho kudlula khona itfu, elwandle lwase-Euphrates; ngobe imihlambi yabo yayikhulu kakhulu kunaleyo yaseGileyadi.
Baye bahlasela emaHagiri, babulala labaholi babo, bahlala etintfweni talabaHagiri, ngaso sonke saseGileyadi lapho kuphuma khona lilanga.
Nase-Gadi, lahlala emhlabatsini lwawo, ezweni leBashan, kuya eSalekani.
Joeli waba nguMengameli, Shafami ube ngumunye, Janai neShafati eBashan.
Nabo-ke labangane babo, ngemindeni yabo: uMikayeli, naMeshulamu, naSheba, naJorai, naJakani, naZiha, naHéberi, labasikhombisa.
Loba babenemadvodzana aAbihayeli, indodana kaHuri, indodana kaJaroa, indodana kaGileyadi, indodana kaMikayeli, indodana kaYesishai, indodana kaYahodo, indodana kaBuzi.
Ahi, umsa waAbdiyeli, umsa waGuni, waba ngunhloko yemindeni yabo.
Bahlala eGileyadi, naseBashan, nemadolobha ayo, kanye naletinye tinhloko-dolobha teSaroni, kuze bafike lapho.
Labo bonke babhalwa encwadini yemindeni yabo, ngelilanga leJothamu inkhosi yaseYuda, nelilanga leYerobohamu inkhosi yaseSirayeli.

NaseRubeni, naseGadi, nasesiphelweni semndeni waManase, kwaba ngumakhulu mane lamashumi amane nesihlanu lamawaka, lalikhulu elinamanci七 nesishiyagalolunye; laba bekungumadoda anamandla, abengenasibhakabhaka kanye nemacwecwe, abengetela umcibisholo, abaqeqeshiwe ekulwa.
Baye bahlasela laHagarithi, neJeturu, neNafishi, neNodabi.

Nkulunkulu wabasiza emphilweni, wabeka ema-Hagrithi kanye nalabo bonke abahamba nabo emandleni abo; ngobe bathandaza kuNkulunkulu empilweni yabo, watsi: "UNkulunkulu uyawubaphendulela, ngoba bakholwa kuye."

Babulala imindeni yalabaHagarithi, ibe yimihlambi yengulube emashumi mahlanu lamakhulu, neyemvu emawaka lamakhulu lamabili namashumi mahlanu lamakhulu, neyebhotsi emashumi mabini lamakhulu; babulala nabo abantu abalikhulu elinamakhulu.
Babulala baholi babo abaningi, ngobe lokulwa kwabe sekweNkulunkulu; bahlala kulomhlaba kuze kufike kutfunywa kwabo.
Nabo bonkhe bantfu labahlala kulomhlaba, kanye nesihlanu semndeni waManase, bakhulela kakhulu, besuka eBashan kuya eBaale-Hermon, naseSeniri, nasentaba yeHermon.
Laba nguEpher, ne-Ishi, ne-Eliel, ne-Azriel, ne-Jeremiah, ne-Hodaviah, ne-Yahudiel; laba baholi bemindeni yabo; babemadodana amakhosi, abebaholi bemindeni yabo.
Baye baphazamisa uNkulunkulu wababuphikisi babo, balandela imikhosi yabantu balomhlaba, labo Nkulunkulu abewabulala phambi kwabo.

Ngako-ke Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli wavusa Phuli, ukumkani wase-Ashuri, nome Tiglathi-pileseri, ukumkani wase-Ashuri, wabakhipha eRhubeni, neGadi, naphesheya komfula weManase, wawafaka eHalaha, naseHabori, naseHara, kanye nemfuleni iGozani, kuze kube namuhla.
Lamadvodzana aLevi bekunguGershoni, neKehati, naMerari.
Labantwana bakaKehati: Amrami, ne-Izhari, neHebroni, naUziyeli.
Labo batitukulwane ta-Amram: uAron, naMosesi, naMiryami; nabo batitukulwane ta-Aaroni: Nadabu, naAbihu, naEleazari, naIthamari.
Eleazari wazala Phinehasi, Phinehasi wazala Abishuwa.
Abishuwa waba ngumzali waBuki, Buki waba ngumzali waUzi.
Utsi waba ngumzali waZerahiya, neZerahiya waba ngumzali waMeraiothi.
Merayothi waba ngumzali waAmariya, naAmariya waba ngumzali waAhitubi.
Ahitub wazala Sadoki, Sadoki wazala Ahimaazi.
Ahimaasi wazala Azariya, Azariya wazala Johanani.
U-Yohanani waba ngumzali wa-Azariya, lobe ngumnikelo wesono endlwini yaSimakadze, lapho uSolomoni abewukwakha khona eJerusalema.
Azariya wazala Amariya, Amariya wazala Ahitubu.
Ahitub wazala Sadoki, Sadoki wazala Shalumu.
Shalumu waba ngumzali waHilkiya, Hilkiya waba ngumzali waUzariya.
Azariya waba ngumzali waSeraya; Seraya waba ngumzali waJozadaka.
Jozadaka wafakwa ejele, lapho Simakadze aphindze asuse khona bantfu baJuda neJerusalema ngesandla saNebhukadnezari.
Lamadvodzana aLevi bekunguGershoni, neKehati, naMerari.
Lamagama lamadvodzana aGershoni: Libni naShimeyi.
Labantwana bakaKehati: Amrami, ne-Izhari, neHebroni, naUziyeli.
Lamadvodza laMerariya: Mahli naMushi; lemihlambi yalabaLevi, ngemindeni yabo kanye nemindeni yabo.
Lamadvodzana aGershoni bekungu-Libni uyise, neJahati uyise, neZima uyise,
neJoa unyana waZima, neIddo unyana waJoa, neZeraha unyana waZeraha, neYetharai unyana waZeraha.
Lamadvodzana aKahati bekungu-Aminadabi unyana wakhe, ne-Kora unyana wakhe, na-Asiri unyana wa-Kora,
uElkana, umsa wa-Asiri; uEbiasafe, umsa wa-Elkana; uAsir, umsa wa-Ebiasafe;
Tahati unyana waAsiri, neUriyeli unyana waTahati, neUziya unyana waUriya, neShawuli unyana waUziya.
Lamadvodzana aElkana bekungu-Amasai na-Ahimothi.
Lamadvodzana aElkana bekungu-Zofayi unyana wakhe, neNahati unyana waSofayi,
Eliabu, umsa waNahati, neYerohamu, umsa waEliabu, neElkana, umsa waYerohamu.
Labantwana baka-Samuele: uJoyele, umzali wakhe, noAbiha, lomunye wabo.
Lamadvodzana aMerariya bekunguMaheli, Libni uyise waMaheli, Shimeyi uyise waLibni, Uza uyise waShimeyi,
Shimea unyana waUza, Hagiya unyana waShimea, Asaya unyana waHagiya.
Loba bakhona labaDavide abewabeka phezu kwemiculo yendlu yaSimakadze, ngemuva kwekutsi ibhokisi lemtsetfo lalinendawo yekuphumula lifike khona.
Baye basebenza ekudlaleni emacwecwe phambi kwendlu, itente lekuhlangana, kuze kube uSolomoni wasungula indlu kaSimakadze eJerusalema; basebenzela umsebenzi wabo ngemihlangano yabo.
Laba bakhona labasebenza, nabo bonkhe bantfu babo: emndenini wakwa-Kehati, uHeman, umculi, umsa waJoyele, umsa waSamuweli,
lowo ngu-Elkana, lowo ngu-Yerohama, lowo ngu-Elieli, lowo ngu-Toha,
unyana wa-Sufe, unyana wa-Elkana, unyana wa-Mahati, unyana wa-Amasai,
unyana wa-Elkana, unyana wa-Joyele, unyana wa-Azariya, unyana wa-Zefaniya,
unyana waTahati, unyana waAsiri, unyana waEbiyasaf, unyana waKorahi,
yena u-Izhari, yena u-Kehati, yena u-Levi, yena u-Isirayeli.
Ngakwesokudla kwakhe kwahlala Asafu, umshado wa-Heman; Asafu waba ngumnyaka wa Berekiya, waba ngumnyaka wa Shimea,
unyana waMikayeli, unyana waBaaseya, unyana waMalkiya,
unyana wa-Etni, unyana wa-Zeraha, unyana wa-Adaya,
yena u-Ethani, yena u-Zima, yena u-Shimeyi,
lomnyaka waJahati, womnyaka waGershoni, womnyaka waLevi.
Ngasekwesokudla kwaHeman, kwaba nemindeni yabo yemadvodzana aMerari; umholi wabo waba nguEthani, umsa waKishi, umsa waAbdi, umsa waMaluku,
unyana waHasabiya, unyana waAmasiya, unyana waHilkiya,
yena u-Amzi, yena u-Bani, yena u-Shemeri,
lomnyaka waMaheli, womnyaka waMushi, womnyaka waMerari, womnyaka waLevi.
NalabaLevi, bazalwane babo, babenesibopho sokwenza yonke imisebenzi yendlu yasebukhosini, indlu yaSimakadze.

Aharon nemadvodzana akhe banikela ngeminikelo ku-altari yemnikelo wesono, bakhipha uvumba ku-altari yomlilo, besebenza kuwo wonke umsebenzi wendawo enhle kakhulu, bekwenza lokukhululwa kwaSirayeli; njengobe Mosesi, mkhonzi waSimakadze, abewisela umthetho.
Lokho kwakungubomi ba-Aron: uEleazari, umsa wakhe; Phinehasi, umsa wa-Eleazari; Abishuwa, umsa wa-Finehasi;
Bukhi unyana waAbishuwa, Uzi unyana waBuki, Zerahiya unyana waUzi,
Merayothi, umsa waZerahiya; Amariya, umsa waMeraothi; Ahitub, umsa waAmariya;
Sadoki, umsa wa-Ahitubi, ne Ahimaazi, umsa wa-Ahitubi.
Lolu hlobo lwamakhaya lamakhosikazi la-Aron, kanye nemadolobha abo emhlabatsini lwawo. Lamadodana la-Aron, asuka kumndeni wakwa-Kehati, wathola lomhlabatsini ngesipho.
Babanikela ngeHebroni, ezweni laYuda, kanye nemadolobha ayo asogwini lwakhe.
Lemihlaba yemhlaba kanye nemadvondza lasemaphandleni enhloko-dolobha, wabanika Kalebe unyana waJefune.
Bebanikela kubomadvodzana a-Aron, bebabunika Hebroni njengedolobha lelingu refu, neLibna kanye neJathiri naEshtemoa; ngayinye yato ibenemifula yayo.
Hileni, neDebiri, kanye nemadolobha ayo,
ne-Ashan, ne-Bet-shemesh, ngayinye nayo ibe nemhlabatsine wayo.
Nasesukuneni sa-Benjamini: Gebha nemadolobha ayo, naAlemethi nemadolobha ayo, naAnathothi nemadolobha ayo; tonkhe tinhloko-dolobha tamakhosikazi eKehati zabe yilishumi linamathathu.
Labo baphelelwa ngumadvodzana a-Kehati, batfunywa ngesandla emadolobha lalishumi, kusuka kumndeni wakwa-Manase, kanye nemindeni yabo.
Labo baLevi, ngemindeni yabo, babe nemadolobha lamashumi lamane namakhulu lasitfupha, asuka eSisakari, nase-Aseri, naseNaphtali, kanye nengxenye yemndeni waManase eBashan.
Labo baLevi, ngesandla sabo, babenemadolobha lalishumi elinambili eRhubeni, neGadi, naZebuloni, ngemindeni yabo.
Lamadvodza ase-Israyeli atawubanika labaLevi lamadolobha lawa kanye nezindawo takubondza kuwo.
Babanikela ngesandla, babeka emabutfo abo emindenini yemadvodzana aJuda, nemadvodzakati aSimeoni, namadodana eBhenjamini.
Lakwa-Efrayi kwabe nemindeni yalabaKehati, labaniketwe emabhishi lawase-Efrayi.
Bebanikela ngeSikheme, inhloko-dolobha yendawo yekuphumula, emhlabatsini waseEframu, neGezeri, ngaso tonkhe tindzawo letiphakeme letingaphansi kwayo;
neJokmeam, neBeth-horon, ngayinye nayo imifula yayo;
na-Ayaloni, neGati-Rimoni; ngayinye yato nayo ibe nemifula yayo.
Nase-Kehatini, emindenini yabo, batfunywa emabhishi abo ngaphesheya kweLwandle iJordane, kanye nemadolobha abo.
Nabo-ke lamadvodzana aGhershoni: kusuka emndenini wesihlanu semndeni waManase, Golani eBashan, neAshtarothi, ngaso tonkhe tidolobhana zalo.
kanye nemadvodzana a-Issakhar:Kedeshi, neDaberathi, ngalowo nalelo lifula lakhe;
neRamoti, ne-Anem, ngayinye nayo ibe nemfula wayo.
kanye nemadvodzana a-Aseri:Mashali, naAbdon, ngaso tonkhe tindzawo letiphakeme letingaphansi kwayo;
neHukok, neRehoboh, ngayinye nayo ibe nemfula wayo.
Nasesukunjeni laNeftali: iKedesh eGalilaya, neHamon, neKiritayim, ngayinye nayo imifula yayo.
Labo baLevi labashiywe, bantfu bakaMerariya, babe nemadolobha lalawa: kusuka emndenini waZebuloni, iRimmoni nezindawo zayo ezisemadolobheni, neTabhori nezindawo zayo ezisemadolobheni.
Nasesukuneni sakwaRubeni, ngaleso sinye seJordane ecaleni leJerikho, enyakatho-ntshonalanga: Beseri emhlabatsini, neYahaza, kanye nemadolobha ayo;
neKedemothi, neMefaati, ngalowo naleyo mhlaba wakhe.
Nasesukuneni saGadi: Ramothi eGileyadi, neMahanayim, ngayinye nayo imifula yayo;
neHeshboni, neJazeri, ngayinye nayo imifula yayo.
Nabo-Issakhar waba nemadvodza lasitfupha: Tola, naPua, naYashub, naShimron.

Lamadvodza laTola abe nguUzi, neRefaya, naJeriyeli, naJamai, naJibshani, naShemueli; laba babe yinhloko yemindeni yabo emndenini wakwa-Tola, bebabaholi bokulwa. Nalabo ababhalwa kubo emavikini kaDavide babengamakhulu lamabili namashumi mabini namahlanu, kanye nemawaka ayisishiyagalombili.
Umnyaka wa-Uzi waba ngu-Izrahiya; mnyaka wa-Izrahiya waba ngu-Mikayeli, ne-Obadiya, na-Joyele, na-Ishiya. Bobahlanu babe ngabaholi.
Batsi babenemadodana lamakhulu lamashumi lasitfupha namane, alungele ukulwa; ngobe babe nemadvodzana kanye nemadvodzakati lamakhulu.
Amakhosi abo, kuwo wonke lamadodana e-Issakhari, abebaholi bekulwa, lababhaliswe ngemindeni yabo, babemakhulu asibhozo namashumi lamabili nesikhombisa.
NaBenjamini waba nemadvodza lasitfupha: Bela, naBekheri, naJediayeli.

Bela waba nemadvodzana a-Eshboni, ne-Uzi, ne-Uzieli, ne-Jerimothi, ne-Iri; laba babebaholi bemindeni yabo, bantfu labacobile kakhulu; babalwa ngemadvodza lamashumi lamabili nambili lamakhulu mathathu nanhlanu.
Labantwana bakaBekheri: uZemira, naJoashi, naEliezeri, naElioenai, naOmri, naJerimothi, naAbiya, naAnathoti, naAlemethi; labo bonke babenemadvodzana aBekheri.
Lemibiko yemndeni wabo yakhombisa bomkhulu bemindeni yabo kanye namakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamane emawaka lasitfupha namakhulu lamabili namakhulu lamabili.
Unyana waJediayeli waba nguBhilahani; nemadvodzana aBhilahani bekunguJeushi, naBenjamini, naEhudi, naKenanaha, naZethani, naTarshishi, naAhisahari.
Labo bonke laba baseJediayeli, bomkhuluwa bemindeni yabo, babe ngumakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamane nesikhombisa, lamakhulu mahlanu namakhulu lasitfupha, bantfu labaciniso lokulwa, labaphuma emphini.
Shuphim neHuppim, laba ngumadvodzana a-Ir; Hushim waba ngumntwana wa-Aher.
Labantwana baka-Naphtali: Jahziyeli, neGuni, neJezeri, naShalumu; laba babengabana baBhila.
Lamadvodza laManase: Asriyeli, umkakhe, lowase-Aram; yena wazala naMahiri, umsa kaGileyadi.
NaMahiri waba nendvodzakati yalabaHupimi nalabaShupimi; igama lenkosikazi yakhe lakunguMahaka; nalowo wesifazane, igama lakhe lalinguCelofehadi; naye wayenemadvodzana.
NaMahaka, indodana yaMakhire, wazala unyana, wababiza igama lakhe nguPereshe; negama lomkhulu wakhe bekunguSheresh; nalabo madvodzana akhe bekunguUlam noRakem.
Lomunye wemadvodzana aUlam bekunguBedan; labo babenemadvodzakati laGileyadi, umsa waMahiri, umsa waManase.
Na-Hammolekethi, mkhuluwa waGileyadi, wabazala uIshodi, naAbiezeri, naMahala.
Lamadvodzana aShemida bekungu-Ahiyana, neShekem, naLikhi, naAniam.
Lamadodana kaEfremu: Shutela unyana wakhe, Beredi unyana waShutela, Tahathi unyana waBeredi, Eleada unyana waTahata, Tahathi unyana waEleada,
Zabadi, umsa waTahati, neSutela, umsa waZabati; naEzeri naEleadi, bantfu baseGati, labazalwa kulomhlaba, babulala lamadodana kaEfraim, lapho abehleli khona befuna ukuthatha isilwane sebantfu.
UEframu, ubaba wabo, wababulale iminyaka leminingi, bafika nabo bonkhe labangane bakhe kutsi bamphilise.
Wabuyela wahlangana nenkosikazi yakhe, wakhulelwa, wazala unyana, watsi kuye igama elithi Beria, ngobe kwabe kubuhlungu emndenini wakhe.
Indvodzakati yaEfremu yayiyeShera; yena wabambisana naBeth-horoni ephansi nephezulu, naUzen-Shera.
Lamadvodzana aBeriya bekungu-Refa yena, ne-Reshefi yena, ne-Tela yena, ne-Tahani yena.
Ladani unyana waTahani, Ammihudi unyana waLadani, Elishama unyana waAmmihudi,
Na-Nun, umsa waElishama, naJoshua, umsa waNuni.
Lemifula yabo, nemadolobha abo, lakunguBhethele nemadolobheni alo, neNaaran enyakatho, neGezere enyakatho nemadolobheni alo, neShekem nemadolobheni alo, kuze kufike eAza nemadolobheni alo.
Nasekunhlanganiso kwemhlaba waManase kwakunguBethe-shean, neTaanakhi, naMegido, naDori kanye nemindeni yawo; lamadvodza laJosefa, umsa kaSirayeli, ahlala emadolobhaneni lawa.
Labantwana baka-Asere: Imna, ne-Ishwa, ne-Isvi, naBeriya; nalowesifazane wabo uSera.
Lamadvodzana aBeriya bekungu-Héberi, neMalkhiyeli; Malkhiyeli ubeyise waBirzayi.
Héberi waba ngumzali waJaflethi, naShomeri, naHothami, naShua, umngane wabo.
Labantwana bakaJaflethi: Pasha, neBimhali, neAshwathi; labo babengabana baJaflethi.
Lamadvodzana aShomeri bekungu-Ahi, neRoga, naJubba, naAram.
Lamadvodza la-Helem, umngane wakhe: Tsofa, Imna, Sheleshe naAmali.
Lamadvodzana aSofa bekungu-Suha, neHarneferi, naShuali, naBeri, naImra,
Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilsha, Ithrani, neBeera.
Lamadvodzana aJetheri bekunguJefune, nePispa, naAraha.
Lamadvodzana aUla bekunguAraha, neHaniyeli, neRisiya.

Labo bonke babe yimadvodzana a-Asere, bekungubaholi bemindeni yabo, bekufanele bahlangane nekulwa, bekufanele babe ngabaphathi. Babalwa ngemindeni yabo labamashumi lamane namane lamakhulu lamabili nesihlanu, abengenakuhlasela.
Lomkhulu laBenjamini waba nguBela, lowesibili waba nguAshbeli, lowesithathu waba nguAhara,
uNoha wesihlanu, neRafa wesihlanu.
Lamadvodzana aBela bekungu-Adari, neGera, naAbihudi,
Abishua, Naamani, Ahoha,
Gera, neShefufan, naHiram.
Lokho kwabe kungumndeni wa-Ehudi, laba ngubaholi bemindeni yabo, labahlala eGibeha, labagcwaliswa eManahati.
Naamane, ne-Ahiya, neGera; ne-Gera waba ngumholi wabo lapho besuka khona; yena waba ngumzali waUza naAhhud.
NaShaharayimi waba nemadvodzana emhlabatsini kweMoabi, ngemuva kwekutikhipha emadzimate akhe, aHushim naBaara.
NaHodeshi, indodana yakhe, waba nemadvodzana: Jobabi, neSibiya, naMesha, naMalkham,
Jehuzi, neShakiya, neMirma; labo babenemadvodzana akhe, babebaholi bemindeni yebantfu.
NaHushimi waba nemadvodzana: Abitub naElpaali.
Labantwana baka-Elpaali: Héberi, neMishamhi, naShemedhi; Shemedhi wasungula Ono, naLodi kanye nemadolobha abo.
Beriya naShema, laba bekungubomkhulu bamakhosi labahlala e-Ayaloni; nabo bakhipha labo baseGati.
Ahio, neShashaki, neJeremota,
Zebadia, neArad, neEder,
Lamadodana aBeriya: uMikayeli, ne-Ishpa, naJoha.
Zebadia, Meshulam, Hezkiya, Heberi,
Ishmerai, ne-Izliya, ne-Yobab, laba ngubana bakaElpaali.
Jakim, neZikri, neZabdi,
Eliyenayi, neZilethai, neEliele,
Adaya, neBeraya, neShimrathi, laba ngumadvodzana a-Shimeyi.
Ispan, ne-Eber, ne-Eliel,
Abdoni, neZikri, naHanani,
Hananiya, neElam, naAnothiya,
Iphedeya, nePenueli, laba ngumadvodzana aShashaki.
Shamsherai, Shehariya, Ataliya,
Jaareshiya, neEliya, naZikri, laba ngubana bakaJerohamu.
Labo bonke babe ngubaholi bemindeni yabo, babhalwa encwadini yemindeni yabo; babe ngabaphathi, bahlala eJerusalema.
EGibeboni kwahlala uJeyeli, umsa waGibeboni; igama lendvodzakati yakhe lakunguMahaka.
Umnyaka wakhe wesifazane waba nguAbdon; bonkhe bantfu bakhe babe nguSuri, neKishi, naBaali, naNadab,
Gedori, neAhio, neZekeri,
naMiklothi, umsa waShimea; nabo bahlala kanye nemadvodzana abo eJerusalema.
Ner waba ngumzali waKishi, Kishi waba ngumzali waSawule, Sawule waba ngumzali waJonathani, naMalki-shuwa, naAbinabadi, naEshbhaali.
Umnyaka waJonathani waba nguMeribi-bhaali; nomeMeribi-bhaali waba ngumzali waMika.
Lamadvodzana aMika bekunguPithoni, neMeleki, neTareya, naAhaza.
Ahazi waba ngumzali waJehoyada; Jehoyada waba ngumzali waAlemeti, naAzmaveti, naZimri; Zimri waba ngumzali waMoza.
Moza wazala Binea; unyana waBinea waba nguRafa; unyana waRafa waba nguEleasa; unyana waEleasa waba nguAseli.
Na-Aseli waba nemadvodza lamane, lamagama abo lakunguAzrikam, naBokeri, naIshmayeli, naShearya, naObadiya, naHanani; labo bonke babemadvodzana a-Aseli.
Nabo-Esheki, umngane wakhe, waba nemadvodzana: Ulam, lomnyaka munye wakhe; Jeusi, wesitsatfu wakhe; Elifeleti, wesithathu wakhe.

Lamadvodza la-Ulam abenemadvodzana nemadvodzana a-Ulam, labazange bahlangane naSimakadze, ngobe bebengabesilisa labakhulu kakhulu, babenesibhakabhaka; babeneminyaka lelikhulu nemashumi mahlanu eminyaka. Lokho konke kwakunguBenjamini.
Nabo bonke bantfu baseSirayeli babhalwa ngemindeni yabo, bona babhalwe encwadini yamakhosi aseSirayeli; kodvwa lamadodana eYuda athathwe eBabheleni, ngobe abengeke abonise kuNkulunkulu.
Batsi: "Labo baphindze babuyela emazweni abo, bangabaSirayeli, labaLevi, kanye nalabaLevi baseTempele.
Bakhona labahlala eJerusalema, besuka kumadvodzana aJuda, nemadvodzana aBenjamini, nemadvodzana aEfraim, nemadvodzakati aManase.
KwaJuda: Uthai, umsa wa-Ammihud, umsa wa-Omri, umsa wa-Imri, umsa wa-Bani, wemadvodzana aPerezi, indodana ya-Yuda.
Kulabo baseShiloni: uAsaya, umzali wakhe, naye nemadvodzana akhe.
Lamadvodza laJehuyeli, umsa wa-Zera, abe ngumakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamane nasitfupha emadvodzana aJuda.
ngomnyaka wasikhombisa, u-Ahimeleki, umsa wa-Eliyahazi, umsa wa-Eliyazabhethi, umsa wa-Eliyazabhethi;
Wakhona na-Ibneya unyana waYerohamu, na-Ela unyana waUzi, unyana waMikri, na-Meshulam unyana waShefatiya, unyana waReuheli, unyana wa-Ibneya.
Nabo-ke labangane babo, ngemindeni yabo, babemakhulu lamane, lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu nasitfupha; labo bonke labamadodana emadvodzana aLevi.
Kulabo baLevi, kwaba nguJedayaya, naJoyaribi, naJahini.
Na-Azariya, umsa kaHilkiya, umsa kaMeshulamu, umsa kaTsadoko, umsa kaMerayothi, umsa kaAhitubi; Azariya waba nguMengameli wendlu yaNkulunkulu.
kanye naAdaya, umsa waYerohamu, umsa waPashuri, umsa waMalkiya; kanye naMaasai, umsa waAdiyeli, indodana yaJazera, indodana yaMeshulamu, indodana yaMeshilemitha, indodana yaImeri.
Labo bonke abaLevi, baholi bemindeni yabo, laba ngumakhulu mahlanu, lamakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamabili nesikhombisa; babemikhulu kakhulu, babekwa emisebenzini yendlu yaSimakadze.
NaseLevini: Shemaya, umsa waHashub, umsa waAzrikam, umsa waHashabhiya, wemadvodzana aMerariya.
NaBakbakhar, naHereshe, naGalali, naMatania, umsa waMika, umsa waZikri, umsa waAsaphi.
kanye na-Obadiya, umsa waShemaya, umsa waGalali, umsa waJeduthuni; kanye na-Berekiya, umsa waAsa, umsa waElkana, labahlala emabhishi lalabaNetofati.
Labagcina-sango: Shalumu, neAkubu, neTalmoni, neAhimanani, nabangane babo; Shalumu waba nguMengameli wabo.
Kuye kuleso sikhathi babehlala emnyango wenkhosi, ngasenyakatho; bebengaba ngubahleli besango lesiteji semaLevi.

Sallum, umsa waKore, umsa waEbyashaphe, umsa waKora, naye kanye nabangani bakhe bomndeni wakhe, imindeni yabo yalaba Korahi, bebengaba ngalabo abagcina iminyango yetenti; ngobe bababa babo babehlala esiteji saSimakadze begcina umngeniso.
Phinehasi, umsa wa-Eleazari, waba ngumphathi wema-poortwachters; ngobe Simakadze abe naye.
UZekariya, umsa waMeshelemiya, waba ngumphathi wemnyango ekungeneni kwetenti lekuhlangana.

Babo bonke labazange bahlukaniswe, bebengaba ngumakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamane nambili, babe ngabahlengikazi emasango; babhaliswa emindenini yabo, emadolobhaneni abo; Davide kanye noSamuele lokubonayo wababeka kubo.
Labo, kanye nemadvodzana abo, babehlala emnyango wendlu yaSimakadze, endlwini yetente.
Bekube nebahlengikazi emigwaqeni lemine: enyakatho, emfuleni, entshonalanga, nasenshonalanga.
Labo bahlangana nabo emadolobheni abo bekufanele bafike ngaleso sikhathi bese bahlukaniswa umsebenzi wabo ngelilanga lesisikhombisa ngasinye.
Batsi laba chefani beminyango lemine, labaLevi, babe nemsebenti wabo, behlala emagumbini nasezikhungweni tendlu kaNkulunkulu.
Bahlala busuku nebusuku ethempelini laNkulunkulu, ngobe bekufanele bayigcine, bekumele bayivule ekuseni nakusasa.
Bakhona nabanye labengaba nesibopho sokunakekela impahla lesetshenziswa ekukhonzeni ethempelini, bakwenta ukubalwa kwayo lapho ifakwa khona nelapho iphuma khona.
Nabanye babekwa ngaphansi kwendlu, kanye naleyo mpahla lengcwele, kanye nesiliva negolide, nemvinyo, nemafutha e-olive, netfufu, nezinto letiphuzako.
Bakhona nabanye baLevi labahlanganisela lemiphunga.
Kubekhona neLevi lokuthiwa nguMatithiya, umzali waShalumu, waseKora, labekwa kutsi alungiselele inyama yemnikelo wesono.
Labanye labangane babo, labasemndenini wakwa-Kehati, babenesibopho sokulungiselela umnikelo wesono ngeSabhati.
Bakhona nabanye labazangeli, bomkhuluwa bemindeni yalabaLevi, labahlala emagumbini, bangabi nesibopho sokunye; ngobe babenemisebenzi yabo ekuseni nakusasa.
Labo bonke babenetinhloko temindeni yeLevi, babhalwe emavesi emndenini wabo; bebengabaphathi; bahlala eYerusalema.
EGibeboni kwahlala uJeyeli, umsa waGibeboni; igama lendvodzakati yakhe lakunguMahaka.
Umnyaka wakhe wesifazane waba nguAbdon, nemadvodzana akhe: Suri, neKishi, naBaali, naNeri, naNabadi,
Gedori, neAhio, neZekariya, neMiklothi.
NaMiklothi waba ngumzali waShimeam; nabo bahlala nalabahlobo babo eJerusalema.
Ner waba ngumzali waKishi, Kishi waba ngumzali waSawule, Sawule waba ngumzali waJonathani, naMalki-shuwa, naAbinabadi, naEshbhaali.
Umnyaka waJonathani waba nguMeribi-bhaali; nomeMeribi-bhaali waba ngumzali waMika.
Lamadvodzana aMika bekunguPithoni, neMeleki, naTareha, naAhaza.
Akaze waba ngumzali waJara; Jara waba ngumzali waAlemethi, naAzmaveti, naZimri; Zimri waba ngumzali waMoza.
Moza wazala Bineya; u-Bineya waba nguRefaya; u-Refaya waba nguEleasa; u-Eleasa waba nguAseli.
Na-Aseli waba nemadvodza lamane, lamagama abo lakunguAzrikam, naBokeri, naIshmayeli, naShearya, naObadiya, naHanani; laba bamadvodzana a-Aseli.
BaFilisti bahlasela bantfu baka-Israyeli, batsi: "Laba-Israyeli baphuma emphinjeni yeGilboa, bese begwaca.
Bafike bahlasela uSawula nemadvodzana akhe, babulala uJonadabu, neAbinabadi, naMalkishi-sua, lamadvodzakati aSauli.
Lomphiko lwaba buhlungu kakhulu kuSawula, kodvwa labahlabani bafike bamfika, bamphasa.

USawula watsi kumshayeli wakhe: "Susa isikhephe sakho, bulala ngaso; ngobe bangafika laba bangatshiswanga, baphikisane nami, bangambulala." Kodwa umshayeli wakhe wakhathazeka kakhulu kutsi akwenze njalo. Ngako uSawula wathatha isikhephe sakhe, waphuma waya kuyo.
Wayebona kutsi uSawuleli ufile, watsi: "Naye-ke uSauli ufile!" Watsi naye wagwaca ngesikhephe sakhe, wafa.
Ngako-ke wafa uSawula, nemadvodzana akhe lasitfupha, nemndeni wakhe wonke bafile kanye.

Batsi bonke bantfu baseSirayeli, labaseGileyadi, babone ukuthi lamadoda ayawuhamba, naSawula nemadvodzana akhe babefile; bashiya imijikelo yabo, babaleka nabo. Bafika khona labaFilisti bahlala emijikeli yawo.
Kube kube ekuseni, lapho bafika khona labaFilisti kutsi baphule labafayo, batsi: "Sawuwe nemadvodzana akhe belibafile emfuleni iGilboa."
Batsi: "USauli uyawufa, ngobe akazange abe ngumuntfu waSimakadze." 21Bemsusa ezweni lonke lalabaFilistayi, kutsi bakhulume ngalolu daba kuma-idoli abo kanye nebantfu babo.
Babeka sibhakabhaka sakhe ethempelini laNkulunkulu wabo, batsi: "Inhloko yakhe ibekwe ethempelini la-Dagon."
Batsi bafundile bonke bantfu baseJabhesi-Gileyadi kutsi labaFilisti bakwenze yini kuSawula,
Baye bahamba, bonke labaholi babo, batsi: "Thintwa nguSawula nemadvodzana akhe, bafike befika eJabhesi, bafihla ticubu tabo ngaphansi kwe-Ashtorethi eJabhesi, baphumula lilanga lesitsatfu.
USawula wafa, ngobe akazange alalele ilizwi laSimakadze; watsi: "Ngakho-ke uSauli wabuza indodana yemuntfu lokhuluma ngemanti, watsi: 'UNkulunkulu ukhona.'
ngobe akazange abuze uSimakadze; kodvwa Simakadze wambulala, wanikela ukumkani kuDavide, umsa ka-Isai.
Bahlangana bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli kuDavide eHebroni, batsi: "Thita, thina sigazi lakho nenyama yakho.

Ngaleso sikhathi, nalapho uSauli ehlala khona njengenkhosi, wena ubewuphuma uye wababuyisela laSirayeli; Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, wakhuluma kuwe watsi: 'Uya kuba ngumhlambi webantfu bami baseSirayeli, nawe uzoba nguMengameli webantfu bami baseSirayeli.'"

Bafike bonke bomkhuluwa baSirayeli kunkhosi Davide eHebroni, wabambisana nabo khona lapho phambi kwaSimakadze; batsi: "UDavide ube ngukumkani waSirayeli, njengobe Simakadze abesho ngesandla saSamuweli."
Wahamba uDavide kanye nabo bonkhe labaSirayeli, wafika eJerusalema (lapho kwakunguJebhusi), lapho kwaba khona iJebusi.
Bathi kuboDavide, "Ungeke ufike lapha!" Ngako-ke Davide wahlasela iSiyoni, leyisikhulu sendlu yasebukhosini, leyawuba nguMfula kaDavide.
UDavide wakhuluma watsi: "Lowo loyawuhlasela iJebhusi kumele abe nguMengameli wesive." UYowabhi, unyana ka-Zeruhiya, waba ngumholi, waba nguMengameli.
UDavide wafika esitezi lesiphakeme, ngobe sabizwa ngokuthi yidolobha laDavide.
Wakwakha umjikelo wedolobha kusukela eMillo kuya kuwo wonke, walungisa nelinye icala lelikhulu ledolobha.
UDavide waba mkhulu kakhulu, wahamba ekhula; ngobe uSimakadze Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli ube naye.
Lokho kwabe kuyinhloko yebantfu labakhulu labebakhona kuDavide, kanye nabo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli, basekela uDavide kutsi abe ngubukhosi bakhe, njengobe Simakadze abekhuluma ngeSirayeli.
Lokho kungenxa yebantfu labakhulu labebakhona kuDavide: Yashobeam, waseHakmoni, waba ngunhloko yalabamashumi lamane; yena wakhipha isandla sakhe ekufaneni namakhulu lamabili nesikhombisa.
Emva kwakhe kwafika uEleazari, umsa waDodo, wase-Ahohiya; waba ngumunye walabo labakhulu labathathu.
Waye naDavide ePasdamini, lapho labaFilisti behlangana khona kutsi bahlasele; kwakungumhlabatsi logcwele ijusi. BaSirayeli babaleka phambi kwalabaFilisti.
Eliezeri naDavide bahlala emiphakathini yalendawo, bavikela lendawo, babulala labaFilisti; Simakadze wabanika lokukhulu kakhulu.
Baphuma bafike kuDavide, labathathu kubo bonkhe labaholi labamashumi lamane, befika emfuleni we-Adulam, lapho livi leFilisti lihlala khona efulani laseRefayi.
UDavide waba khona lapho esiteji, kodvwa ibutfo lalabaFilisti labakhona eBethlehem.
UDavide wafuna kakhulu amanzi, watsi: "Ngabe kukhona lowo longeke amnike ubisi lokudlidliza eBethlehem, emgodini wemnyango!"

Lamadoda lamakhulu mathathu abulala emaFilisti, wakhipha amanzi emfuleni waseBethlehem, losemnyango wedolobha, wayawanikela kuDavide; kodvwa uDavide akazange ayidle, watsi: "Ngiwudla ngesandla sami, ngiwuphuze ngesandla sami."

UDavide watsi: "UNkulunkulu angeke amvumele ukuthi akwenze lokhu, ngingadla yini igazi lalaba bantu, lababeke engozini impilo yabo?" Ngako-ke uDavide akayidla legazi, ngobe babeka engozini impilo yabo. Lokho kwakuye kwaba ngumsebenzi walaba balingiswa bokulwa labathathu.
U-Abishai, mkhuluwa ka-Yowabe, waba nguMengameli wabo bonkhe labathathu; yena wabeka isandla sakhe esibhakabhakeni, wabulala lamakhulu mahlanu, waba negama phakathi kwabo bonkhe labathathu.
Ube mkhulu kunabo bonkhe labathathu, waba nguMengameli wabo; kodvwa akazange abe ngumunye walabathathu.
UBenaya, umsa wa-Yoyada, waba ngumuntfu lonamandla, waseKabseeli, lawenza mandla amakhulu; yena wabulala labakhulu labahlanu baseMoabi, waphuma waya emgodini ngelilanga lekhephu, wabulala linyo.

Wabulala umSirayeli lomkhulu kakhulu, wamamitha lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu enyawo. UmSirayeli lowo ubenamacwecwe afana nentambo yembuti; kodvwa yena waya kuye ngesandla esisodwa, wehlisa emacwecwe emilenzeni yomSirayeli, wambulala ngawo.
Lamandla lawa aBenaya, umsa wa-Yoyada, abe ngumsebenzi wakhe lomkhulu; waba negama phakathi kwalabakhulu labathathu.
Ube mkhulu kunabo bonkhe labamashumi lamane, kodvwa angeke abe ngumunye walabathathu; Davide wambeka phezu kwalabo labagcina isandla sakhe.
Na-Asaheli, mkhuluwa ka-Yowabe, waba ngumuntfu lonamandla; na-Elhanani, umsa waDodo waseBethlehem;
Shamothi waseHarori, neHelezi wePeloni,
Ira, umsa wa-Ikeshi waseTekoa; Abiezeri waseAnathothi;
Sibekai waseHusati, neElai waseAhohi;
Maharayi waseNetofa; Heled, umsa waBaana, waseNetofa;
Ithai, umsa waRibai, waseGibeha eBenjamini; Benaya, wasePirathoni;
neHurai waseGhasha, naAbieli waseArbati;
Azmavethi waseBaharumi, neElihaba waseShaloni;
bantfu bakaHashemi, umGishoni; Jonathani, umsa waShagi, umHariti;
Ahiyami, umsa waSakhari waseHarare; Eliphali, umsa wa-Ur;
Hepher waseMekerathi; Ahiya wasePeloni;
Hezro waseKarmeli, neNaarayeli umsa wa-Ezbai;
Joeli, mkhuluwa waNathani; Mibhari, umsa waHagri;
Zeleki lo-Ammonita, neNaharai wase-Beerothi, lowo waba nesibhakabhaka saYowabe, umsa waZeruya;
Ira wase-Itri; Gareb wase-Itri;
Uriya, umHeti; Zabadi, umsa waAhlai;
Adina, umsa waShisa, wase-Rubeni, umholi wabaLevi ba-Rubeni, naye namadoda lamabili nemashumi lamane;
Hanan, umsa waMahaka; Josaphatsi, umMithini;
Uziya wase-Ashtarothi; Shama naJeyeli, bantfu baseHothami base-Aroeri;
Jediayeli, umsa waShimri, naJoha, lomfana wakhe waseTisi;
Eliyeli waseMahabhi, neJeribayi naJoshaviya, bantfu baseElnaamu, neIthama waseMoabi;
Eliyeli, ne-Obedi, ne-Yaasieli waseMezobha.
Nalaba bafika kuDavide eSiklagi, lapho angeke abe nguSawuleli unyana waKishi; laba bekungumunye wemadvodza layawusekela Davide emkhosini.
Babe banesibhakabhaka, besaba nesandla sasekudla kanye nesinye saso sekwesobunxele, baphindze babe nesandla sekwesokudla kanye nesinye saso sekwesobunxele. Bekungumndeni wakwa-Sauli waseBenhani.
Akhezere waba nguMengameli wabo, kanye naJoashi, bobabili bantfu baseGibeha; neJeziyeli, nePeleti, bonkhe bantfu baseAzmavethi; naBeraka, naYehu waseAnathothi;
Ishmaya waseGibeoni, lomunye walabalishumi elinamashumi lamane, waba nguMengameli wabomakhulu lamane; naYeremiya, naYahaziyeli, naYohanani, naJozabade waseGedera;
Eluzai, Jerimote, Bealiya, Shemariya, Shefatiya lowaseHarufi,
kanye na-Elkana, ne-Ishiya, ne-Azareli, ne-Joezeri, ne-Yashobeam;
kanye naJoyela neZebadia, bantfu baseJerohamu baseGedori.

Kwafika nalabaGadi kuDavide, efulethini lakhe lelihlele emhlabathini; laba bekunguboshwa bokulwa, babenesibhakabhaka kanye nesikhongo; imibuso yabo yayifana nemibuso yalelinyoni, bahamba ngejubane njengetingulube letihlala emadolobheni.
Ezer waba nguMengameli, Obadiya ube ngumunye, Eliabu abe ngumunye,
Mishmanaya wesitsatfu, uYeremiya wesisihlanu,
Atayi wesishiyagalolunye, Eliyeli wesitsatfu,
uJohhanane wesikhombisa, uElzabade wesihlanu,
uYeremiya wesikhombisa, naMakbannai wesihlanu.
Laba baGadi babe ngabaholi bemphi; loncane kubo waba nemashumi lamakhulu, kodvwa lomkhulu wabo waba nemakhulu lamakhulu.
Bafike badlula eJordane ngenyanga yokuqala yemnyaka, lapho iphuma khona emanzini layo kuwo wonke emagwaca ayo; babulala bonke labahlala emifuleni, emaphandleni nasemanhlalweni.
Kwafika nabo bonkhe bantfu baseBhenjamini nabaseJuda kuDavide esitezi lesikahle.

UDavide waphuma wahlangana nabo, watsi kubo: "Uma nifika ngekuthula kutsi ningisize, ngiya kuwe; kepha uma nifika kutsi nimikhonze kulabo baholi bami, nakuba angeke kube nento lebi engiyenzayo, khona-ke Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli utawukubona, utawukubulala.

UMoya ufike ku-Amasai, lomkhulu lalabathathu, watsi: "Sikhona kuwe, Davide, sikhona nawe, unyana waJese. Sihle, sihle kuwe, nalabo abakusizayo baphile; ngobe Nkulunkulu wakho usiza wena." UDavide wababulela, wababeka njengenhloko yebantfu bakhe.

NaseManase kwafika labanye labafike kuDavide, lapho waya khona nalabaFilisti ekulwa naSawula; kodvwa Davide namadodana akhe akazange abonise labaFilisti. Batsi bakhuluma nabo, baholi bamaFilisti bamshiya, besithi: "Uyawubuyela kumphathi wakhe uSawula ngenhloko yethu."

Wafika uDavide eSikelagi, wahlangana naye lamadodana laManase: Adnah, naJozabade, naJediayeli, naMikayeli, naJozabade, naElihu, naZilethai; lomunye wabo waba nguMengameli wemashumi lamakhulu lamakhosi eManase.
Baye basiza Davide ekulwa nalabahlaseli, ngobe bebengabaphikisi labakhulu, bebengabaphathi emkhosini wakhe.
Kusuka kusuku kuya kusuku kwafika labakhona kutsi basebentise Davide, kuze kube abe nemkhosi omkhulu njengemkhosi waSimakadze.
Lolu hlelo lwabaphikisayo labafika kuDavide eHebron, kutsi bamnike ubukhosi beSawula, njengobe Simakadze abekhuluma.
NgaseJuda kwafika lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa emakhulu lamane, abeluhlobo lwemikhosi, abenesibhakabhaka kanye nesikhongo.
Ku-Simeoni kwakungumakhulu lamabili nesikhombisa, namakhulu lasitfupha, labaphatsimandla ekulwa.
KuLevi kwaba ngumakhulu lasitfupha, lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu.
Jehoyada, umholi wemndeni wakwa-Aron, wafika naye lamakhulu mathathu, lamakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamane.
wafika naTsadoko, umshado lomusha, umtfubi wekulwa, naye abe nebaholi bemndeni wakhe labamashumi lamane nambili.
NgaBenjamini, emndenini ka-Sauli, kwafika lamakhulu amathathu; kuze kube ngaleso sikhathi, labaningi babo babenendlu ya-Sauli.
Ku-Efrayim kwakungumashumi lamabili nemakhulu lamane, lamadoda anamandla ekulwa, abenamavi emikhosini yabo.
Nasemnyaka wesitsatfu, kwafika lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa emakhulu mahlanu ema-Amoni, aphuma kunkhosi Davide.
Kutsi naleso sikhathi, kwaphuma e-Issacar labaholi labalishumi elinambili, lababonako kutsi yini lekumele bayenze bantfu baseSirayeli; bonkhe labazalwana babo babehamba ngemandla abo.
NgaseZabuloni kwakungumakhulu lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu ebantfu labaqeqeshiwe, labalungele ukulwa ngeso sonke sibhakabhaka; nabo bonke banikela kuboDavide.
Ku-Naphtali kwaba ngumakhulu lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa, abenesibhakabhaka kanye nesilenge.
Ku-Dan, kwaba ngumashumi lasitfupha nesikhombisa emakhulu lamabili namakhulu lamane, labalungele kulwa.
Ku-Asere kwafika lamashumi amane lamawaka, abeluhlobo lolubomvu, labalungele kulwa.
Nalapho enyakatho-ntshonalanga yeJordane, kwasuka kuRubeni naGadi naphesheya kwezilwandle kwemphi yaManase, kwaba ngumakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamane lamakhulu, labalungiselelwe yonke imikhosi.

Labo bonke babebaholi bekulwa, bafika eHebroni ngemandla aphelele, kutsi bafake Davide waba ngunkhosi kubo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli; nabo bonke labanye bantfu baseSirayeli babe nesandla esisodwa kutsi bafake Davide waba ngunkhosi.
Bahlala khona naDavide iminyaka lemibili, bedla nekudla, ngobe labangane babo babebalungiselelile.

Nabo nalabo labahlala nabo, kuze kube ku-Issakhar, neZebuloni, naNephthali, bafike benikela ngekudla emabhotsini, netingcweti, namamuleti, nengulube; kwafika nekudla okuningi: umnikelo wesono, nemajikijolo, nama-raspberries, newayini, nephethroli, nenyama yenkomo, nekove; kwaba nekuthula okukhulu eSirayeli.
UDavide wakhuluma nabaholi bakhe bamakhulu nemakhulu lamakhulu, nabo bonkhe bantfu bakhe labakhulu.

Watsi kubo bonke bantfu baseSirayeli, watsi: "Uma kulungile emehlo enu, uma kusuka kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wethu, sithumelele labahlobo bethu kuwo wonke lamadolobha aseSirayeli, kanye nalabaLevi nabo emasinagogeni abo, bafike bahlangane nathi.
Sifike siyibuyisele lapha nathi ibhokisi leNkulunkulu wethu, ngobe asizange siyifune kuleso sikhatsi lapho uSawuleli abe ngukumkani.
Lakho kwavunyelwa libandla lonke kutsi likwenze, ngobe bonke bacabanga kutsi kuyinto lefanele kusetjenziswa.
UDavide wahlangana nabo bonkhe labaSirayeli, kusukela emfuleni i-Shihor waseMijiphu kuya ekufikeni eHamati, kutsi bafike babe nebhokisi laNkulunkulu lisuka eKiriyati-yearim.

Waya khona Davide kanye nabo bonkhe labaSirayeli eBhala, (leyiKiriyati-yearimi, eYuda), kutsi babuyisele phansi ibhokisi laSimakadze Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, lohlala emehlweni ema-kerubi, ibhokisi elalibizwa ngegama lakhe.
Babeka ibhokisi laNkulunkulu ebhasini elisha, balisa kuyo kusuka endlwini ka-Abinabadi; Uza naAhio babehamba nebhasi.
UDavide kanye nabo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli bedlala phambi kwaNkulunkulu ngemandla abo wonke, nemiculo, nemsindo, nema-harps, nama-pipers, nama-tamburins, nama-cymbals, namathumbu.
Bafike bafika emgwaqeni waChidonu, lengulube yajika; Uza wehlisa isandla sakhe kutsi abambe ibhokisi lenkhosi.
USimakadze wehlule kakhulu ku-Uza, watsi: "Lowo uyawufa lapho phambi kwaNkulunkulu, ngobe wafaka isandla sakhe ebhokisini."
UDavide waba nebuhlungu, ngobe Simakadze abewutfusa umsindo wakhe ku-Uza; ngobe kwashiwo igama lelikhona litsi: Perese-Uza, kuze kube manje.
UDavide wakhathazeka kuSimakadze ngalolusuku, watsi: "Ngiyawuyifaka kanjani etiveni taNkulunkulu nami?"
Ngako-ke uDavide akazange afake ibhokisi laSimakadze kuye edolobhani laDavide, kodvwa wayalela kutsi libekwe endlini ka-Obede-Edomu waseGathi.
Ibhokisi laNkulunkulu lahlala nemndeni wa-Obede-Edomu, endlwini yakhe, iminyaka lemibili; Simakadze wabambisana nendlu yakhe kanye naleyo yonke into yakhe.
UHiramu, ukumkani weTire, wathumela labaholi kuDavide, nasetindzaweni tesedari, nebahlengikazi, nebahlengikazi, kutsi bavule indlu yakhe.
UDavide wakhumbula kutsi uSimakadze ubewumisa waba ngunkhosi yaseSirayeli, ngobe ubukhosi bakhe bebuphakeme kakhulu ngenxa yalabahlali bakhe baseSirayeli.
UDavide waba nemadvodzana kanye nemadvodzakati lakubo eJerusalema, wahlala khona iminyaka lemibili.
Lemi magama abo labazalwa kuye eJerusalema: Shamua, naShobab, naNatan, naSolomoni,
Ibhaari, neElishuwa, neElpeleti,
Noga, Nefegi, Japhia,
Elishama, neBelyada, neElifeleti.
Bafike balalela kutsi uDavide ubephucukile waba ngunkhosi yabaFilisti, bonkhe bantfu base-Israyeli babuyele befuna Davide; Simakadze wakhuluma kuDavidi, watsi: "Thumela emafilisti emphini abo.
Bafilisti bafika, bahlasela eningizimu yeGibhithe kanye neGibhithe.
UDavide watsi kuNkulunkulu: "Ngaya kulwa nalabaFilistimi, utawubanikela emkhosini wami?"USimakadze watsi kuye: "Hamba, ngiyawubanikela emkhosini wakho."

UDavide namadodana akhe bafika eBaale-Perasimini, wababulala khona, watsi Davide: "Nkulunkulu uvule umgodzi ngesandla sami, njengawo amanzi avule umgodzi"; ngakho kwatsi kubizwa linye lamadolobha ngokuthi liBaale-Perasimini.
Bayawushiya khona boFilisti labangcwele babo; Davide waphendvula watsi: "Boni, batawubabulala.
BaFilisti baphinde bahlasela lomhlabatsini.
UDavide wabuza uSimakadze, Simakadze watsi kuye: "Ungabahlasela ngaso hlangothi; buyela emuva kwabo, ubahlasele ngaso hlangothi lwetimbali te-alfalfa.
Uma ukhuluma ngaso sesibhakabhaka, khona-ke uyaphuma ube kulwa; ngobe Nkulunkulu uyaphuma phambi kwakho, aze ahlasele umkhosi wemaFilisti.
UDavide wakwenza njengobe Simakadze abemwisile, wababulala emaFilisti lasuka eGibeoni waya Gezeri.
UDavide waba mkhulu kakhulu emazweni lawo wonke, ngobe Simakadze abewubeka umfutho wakhe kuwo onkhe emazwe.
UDavide wabambise indlu yakhe edolobhani laDavide, walungiselela indawo yesandla saNkulunkulu, wamisa itenti lakhe.

UDavide watsi: "Kungeke kubekho umuntu loyawuthwala ibhokisi laNkulunkulu ngaphandle kwalabaLevi; labo Simakadze wabakhethele ukuba baphathe ibhokisi laSimakadze, nekubambisene naye kuze kube sekupheleni."
UDavide wahlangana nabo bonkhe labaSirayeli eJerusalema, kutsi bakhuphule ibhokisi lenkhosi kuleyo ndawo abeyilungiselele.
Wahlangana nemadvodzana a-Aron kanye naLevi, watsi kubo:
Lamadvodza laKehati abe ngu-Uriyeli, umholi, nalabo bonkhe bantfu bakhe labamakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamane.
Nasemadvodzana aMerari:Asaya, umholi, nemadvodzakati akhe lamakhulu lamabili namashumi mahlanu.
Lamadvodza la-Ghershoni: uJoyele, umholi, nabangani bakhe lamakhulu lamabili nemashumi matatu.
Kulabo bantfu ba-Elizafan, kwaba nguShemaya, umholi, kanye nabangane bakhe lamakhulu mahlanu.
Kulabo bantfu base-Hebroni: uEliyeli, umholi, kanye nabazalwane bakhe labamashumi lamakhulu.
Lamadvodza la-Uziyeli abe ngu-Aminadabi, umholi; nabo bonkhe bantfu bakhe babe ngumakhulu lamabili nesihlanu.
UDavide wabiza uTsadoki naAbhiyathari, labaLevi, kanye naUriyeli, naAsaya, naJoyele, naShemaya, naEliele, naAminadabi.
Wabaphendvula watsi: "Niyinhloko yemindeni yalabaLevi; ningcwele, nine nabangani benu, nifike nifake ibhokisi laSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, endaweni lapho ngiyilungiselele khona.
Niye, niLevi, akwenteni njalo kuqala; ngobe umsebenti waSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wethu, waphuma ebusweni bethu, kodvwa singeke sikhulume naye ngendlela lekahle.
BaLevi nalabaphatsimandla bangcwele babungcwele, besuka eJerusalema, befika eGibhithe, befaka ibhokisi laSimakadze Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli.
NalabaLevi babambe ibhokisi laNkulunkulu ngemikhono yabo emlenzeni wabo, njengobe Mosi abewisela umthetho ngalolo lizwi leSimakadze.
UDavide waphendvula watsi: "Labo baseLevi batawubeka ema-Amori, kanye nalabo baseGibhithe, kanye nalabo ase-Asiriya, kanye nalabo ase-Egipta, kutsi babe ngubandlululo lwami.
Batsi labaLevi bamisa Hemani, umsa waJoyele, na-Asaphe, umsa waBerekiya, umshado wakhe; nalaba Merari, umshado wabo, Ethani, umsa waKushaya.

Nabo nabo babe nemadvodzana abo:Zekariya, naBeni, naYahaziyeli, naShemiramoti, naJehiyeli, naUnni, naEliabu, naBenaya, naMaasihiya, naMatathiya, naEliphelehu, naMikneya, kanye na-Obedi-Edomu, naJeieli, labagwebi.
Nabo-Heman, na-Asaphe, na-Ethani, labazangeli, babe netinhlamvu tesiliva nelibomvu.
NaZekhariya, naAziyele, naShemiramoti, naJehiyeli, naUnni, naEliabu, naMaaseya, naBenaya, badlala ngetincopho letiphakeme, titsi: iAlamoth.
Matitiya, Eliphelehu, Mikneya, Obede-Edomu, Jeieli, naAzaziya babekhuluma ngemibhoshongo lemincane, ebizwa ngeSheminiti.
NaChenaniya, lomunye wabaholi beLevi, waba ngumqondisi bokudlalwa kwengoma; wabafundisa bokudlalwa kwengoma, ngobe wayenekhono.
Berekiya neElkana babengeke bagcine ibhokisi.
NaShebaniya, naJosaphat, naNethaneli, naAmasai, naZekariya, naBenaya, naEliezeri, bantfu labaLevi, babephuza tindlebe phambi kwebhokisi laNkulunkulu; naObedi-Edomu, naYehiya, bagcina bhokisi.
UDavide, nebaholi beSirayeli, nabemakhulu lamakhulu asuka endlwini ka-Obede-Edomu, baphuma nabo, bafike befaka ibhokisi lesivumelwane saSimakadze, beyawujabula.
Banikela ngenkunzi yenkomo yesishiyagalombili nemvu yesishiyagalombili, ngobe uNkulunkulu wabasiza labaLevi ababambe ibhokisi lesivumelwano seSimakadze.
UDavide wagqoka ingubo yelinen lemhlophe, nalabaLevi bonke labahambisa ibhokisi, nalabo bakhulumayo, naChenaniya, umphathi wokukhuluma; uDavide waba ne-ephod yelinen.
Ngako-ke bonkhe labaSirayeli baphakamisa ibhokisi lesivumelwano saSimakadze, beshaya ngemiphefumulo, nasengumsindo wezinhlamvu, netingcweti, nasendleleni, nezingcezu, nezingcumbu.

Kwatsi lapho ibhokisi lesivumelwane saSimakadze lifika eMzini waDavide, uMikhayeli, intondza kaSawula, ebheka ngetefuleni, wabona ukumkani uDavide edlala nekudlalela; watsi ngubi kuye enhlilweni yakhe.
Bafike bafaka ibhokisi laNkulunkulu, bayibeka emiphakathini yetenti leDavide abeyilungiselele; banikela ngeminikelo yekushiswa neyekuthula kuSimakadze.
UDavide, lapho ephelele khona ekunikela ngeminikelo yekushiswa neyekuthula, wabambisana nabo bonkhe bantfu ngegama laSimakadze.
Wabanikela kubo bonkhe labaSirayeli, besifazane namadoda, ngemnikelo wesono, nekudla lokucwebezelayo, newayini.
Wabeka nalabaLevi kutsi basebenze phambi kwebhokisi laSimakadze, bekhuluma, bebonga, nekuvamisa Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli.

Asafhi waba nguMengameli, neZekariya abe ngumunye, naJeyeli, naShemiramoti, naJehieli, naMatathiya, naEliabu, naBenaya, naObedi-Edomu, naJeyeli, labadlala isandla kanye necwecwe; naAsaphu wadlala ngezinhlamvu.
Benaya neYahaziyeli, bantfu labangcwele, babehamba bephuza timphimbo ngaso sonke isikhathi phambi kwebhokisi lesivumelwano saNkulunkulu.
UDavide waqalisa ngalolusuku ukukhuluma kuAsaphe nabangane bakhe, watsi: "Niyawubonga Simakadze ngalengoma.
Hambani nibonga uSimakadze, nitsi igama lakhe; khuluma kubantfu kutsi akwenze yini.
Wamlalela, wamhlonipha, wakhuluma ngawo wonke lamandla akhe ajabulile.
Lijabulise igama lakhe lengcwele; Lijabulise intliziyo yalabo labafunayo uSimakadze.
Lingisani kuSimakadze kanye nemandla akhe, lingisani kuye njalo.
Khumbulani izinto zakhe ezimangalisayo, azenzayo, nemilingo yakhe, nemtsetfo wakhe abewukhuluma.
Nisitfunywa saSirayeli, mkhonzi wakhe, nimadvodzana aYakobi, labewakhetha.
Uye Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wethu; imiyalo yakhe ibonakala emhlaba wonke.
Khumbulani umyalelo wakhe kuze kube sekupheleni, incwadzi legocotwayo yakhe yekucala, kuya kumashumi lamakhulu eminyaka.
Lomkhonto wakhe lowenza ne-Abrahama, kanye nalowo mnikelo wakhe wesono lowawunikezwa uIsake.
Wakwenza kube ngumthetho kuYakobi, kube ngumnikelo wekushiswa kuSirayeli.
watsi: "Ngitakunikela ngemhlaba waseKanana kutsi ube ngumnikelo wenu wesono."
ngobe nibebantfu labancane kakhulu, nalabo baphumayo emhlabani lenu.
Bahamba basuka ezweni lelinye baya kwelinye, bese besuka ebukhosini bomhlaba kuye ebukhosini bemhlaba.
Akazange avumele namunye ukuba abonise kubo buhlungu; watsatsa livi lakhe lamakhosi ngenxa yabo,
"Ungabi nenkinga nalabo bangcwele bakho, ungabi nenkinga nalabaprofeti bakho!"
Lingisani kuSimakadze, umhlaba wonke, khuluma ngalokusindisa kwakhe usuku lonke.
Kubaniseni kubo bonkhe bantfu inhlonipho yakhe, nemisebenzi yakhe emangalisa.
UNkulunkulu umkhulu kakhulu, ufanele kuhlonishwa kakhulu; kumele abe nekuthula ngaphezu kwalabo bonke labangcwele.
Lamandla emhlaba onke anjengemihlobiso, kepha uSimakadze wenza izulu.
Ubuhle nebunyenti buyawumuhlanganisa, umsebenti wakhe kanye nekuthula kutawuwugcwele.
Banikelani kuSimakadze, mindeni yenu yebantfu, banikelani kuNkulunkulu ubuhle nemandla.
Nceda ninike uSimakadze kuthula lokufana negama lakhe. Ninikele iminikelo yenu, nifike phambi kwakhe; nibukeni kuNkulunkulu ngebuhle bengcwele bakhe.
Lala ebusweni bakhe, mhlaba wonke! Lihlabathi lihlala liqinile, angeke liqhume.
Lijabulise lizulu, nemhlaba ukhululeke; batsi phakathi kwebantfu: UNkulunkulu ungumphathi!
Laselwandle, nalo tonkhe tive letikhona kulo, latse lijabulise; lasemhlabatsini, nalo tonkhe tive letikhona kulo, lijabulise.
Lesihlahla semhlabatsi siyawujabula phambi kwaSimakadze, ngobe yena uyafika enkantolo yemhlaba.
Bambisani naSimakadze, ngobe ulungile, ngobe kuyawuhlala khona uthando lwakhe kuze kube sekupheleni.
Nitsi: Sisindise, Nkulunkulu wekubuyisana kwethu; sihlanganiseni, nitfumise ema-Israyeli, ukuze sibonga igama lakho elingcwele, sijabulise ekubonga kwakho.
Lambisani uSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, kuze kube sekupheleni, kuze kube sekupheleni. Batsi bonke bantfu: "Amen!" Lambisani Simakadze.
UDavide washiya khona Asafu nabangani bakhe phambi kwebhokisi lesivumelwane saSimakadze, kutsi basebenzela khona njalo, nsuku zonke, njengoba bekufanele.
Washiya nabo Obede-Edomu, umsa waJeduthuni, kanye naHosa, labengabaphathi bemnyango, nabangani bakhe labamashumi lamane namakhulu lasikhombisa.
UDavide washiya uTsadoko, umLevi, kanye nalabaLevi bakhe, phambi kwendlu yaSimakadze, ethempelini elikhulu laseGibeboni.
banikela ngeminikelo yekushiswa kuSimakadze, ekuseni nakusihlwa, ngaso sonke isikhathi, emgodini wemnikelo wekushiswa, njengobe kwabhalwa kulomthetho waSimakadze, lowo awungcolisa wona laSirayeli.
kanye nabo-Heman, neJeduthuni, nabanye labakhethiwe ngemagama abo, kutsi babembisane noNkulunkulu, batsi: "Lenkundla yakhe ihlala kuze kube sekupheleni."
Hemani naJeduthuni babe netibopho, nama-cymbals, neminye imiculo yekudlalela kuNkulunkulu; bonkhe bantfu labasemnyango bebengaba ngubana baJeduthuni.
Ngako bonkhe bantfu babuyela emakhaya abo, naDavide wabuyela emndenini wakhe kutsi abembisane nabo.
UDavide, lapho ehlala khona ekhaya lakhe, watsi kuNathani umprofeti: "Bonani, ngihlala endlini yesedari, kepha ibhokisi lesivumelwano seSimakadze lihlala emafasitela."
Nathani watsi kuDavide: "Lakho konke lokusenhliziyoni yakho, yenza; ngobe Nkulunkulu ukhona nawe."
Naleso busuku, kwafika kutsi kuNathani ilizwi laNkulunkulu, watsi:
Watsi Simakadze: "Thiba, ufike ukhulume naDavide, umkhonzi wami, watsi: 'UNkulunkulu uthe kutsi: 'Akho wena loyawungikwakha indlu ngihlale kuyo.
Ngekube ngahlalanga endlwini kusukela kuleso sikhathi lapho ngakhipha khona bantfu beSirayeli emaGibhithe, kuze kube ngalolusuku lwamanje; ngobe ngihambe ngisuka etenteni ngiye etindlini.
Nakweyiphi na indawo lapho ngihamba khona nami bonkhe labaSirayeli, ngabe sengikhuluma yini kulowo muntfu waSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wami, ngatsi: 'Ngubani longeke angenise indlu yesedru?'
Ngaleso sikhathi utawukhuluma kumkhonzi wami Davide, utsi: Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli usho kutsi: Ngikutsatsele emgwaqeni, ngakwesokudla kwesilwane, ukuze ube nguMengameli wesive sami saseSirayeli.
ngibe nawe kuwo wonke lamadolobha labewuhamba kuwo, ngatondza bonke bobubi bakho phambi kwakho; ngiyakwenza igama lakho libe likhulu, njengegama labakhulu abakhona emhlabeni.
Nami ngitawulungiselela indawo kulabo bantu bami base-Israyeli, nami ngiyawubamisa khona, aze ahlale ekhaya lakhe, angeke abe nenkinga nhlobo; nalabo lababi bangabaphazamisi njengalesosikhathi,
Nakho-ke, ngikutshela kutsi Simakadze utawukwakha kuwe indlu, nendlu yebukhosi, kanye nendlu yaSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho, wena namakhosi akho, kanye nenkhosi yakho, kanye nemindeni yabo.
"Nalapho iminyaka yakho iphele khona, bese uhlala nababa bakho, ngiyawuphakamisa lomunye wemadvodzana akho, labaphuma emilenzeni yakho, kutsi abe ngunkhosi yakho; nebukhosi bakhe ngitawubuqinisa.
Lowo uyawukwakha indlu yami, nendlu yakhe yebukhosi ngitawuyimisa kuze kube sekuseni.
Ngabe ngiyawuba ngumfana wakhe, naye utawuba ngumntwana wami; ngobe ngingawususa lokuthula kwami kuye, njengobe ngawususa kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, lapho wahlala khona phambi kwako.
ngobe ngitawumisa phezu kwendlu yami nebukhosi bami kuze kube sekupheleni; isikhundla sakhe siyawuhlala njalo.'
Nathani watsi kuDavide konkhe loko lokushoyo nguSimakadze kulombono.
Wafika ukumkani Davide, wahlala phambi kuSimakadze, watsi: "Ngibani nami, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, yini lendlu yami, kutsi ugcine ngifike lapha?
Nakho, Nkulunkulu, lokhu akushonga kutsi kuncane emehlo akho; nawe ukhuluma ngendlu yalowo umkhonzi wakho loyawufika; wena, Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, uninikele kakhulu kumkhonzi wako.
Ngingeke ngikutshele yini wena, ngobe ungihloniphe ngalendlela lenjalo umkhonzi wakho? Uyazi lomuntfu lomkhonzi wako.
Simakadze, ngenxa yalowo mkhonzi wakho, kanye nenhliziyo yakho, uyawukwenza lomsebenzi omkhulu lowukhulu, utawubonisa zonke lezi zinto ezinkulu.
Simakadze, akukho lowo ufana nawe, naNkulunkulu awukho ngaphandle kwakho, njengobe sesivumile ngemehlo ethu.

Ingabe kunelinye ilizwe emhlaba lelifana nebantfu bakho, bo-Israyeli, loNkulunkulu afike awabuyele aze abe ngumndeni wakhe, abe ngumnikelo wesono, abe ngumnikelo wesono, abe ngumnikelo wesono, abe ngumnikelo wesono, abe ngumnikelo wesono, abe ngumnikelo wesono, abe ngumnikelo wesono, abe ngumnikelo wesono?
Uyawugcina bantfu bakho, iSirayeli, ibe nguNkulunkulu wakho kuze kube sekupheleni; nawe, Simakadze, waba nguNkulunkulu wabo.
Manje-ke, Simakadze, lizwi lakho, lowalikhuluma umkhonzi wakho nendlu yakhe, lihlale likhona kuze kube sekupheleni; yenza njengoba washo.

Uya kuqinisa igama lakho, uyasivikela kuze kube sonke isikhathi, bese bethi: UNkulunkulu wemikhosi, uThixo kaSirayeli, nguThixo kaSirayeli; futhi indlu yomkhonzi wakho uDavide ihlale iqinile phambi kwakho.
Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wami, uyawukhombisa umkhonzi wakho kutsi uyakwenza abe ngubukhosi; ngakho-ke umkhonzi wakho wathola isandla sakhe sokuthandaza kuwe.
Simakadze, wena uNkulunkulu, wekhuluma lokudla lokubi kumkhonzi wakho.
Ngiyakubonga, Simakadze, ngalendlu yalowo mkhonzi wakho, kutsi ihlale ihlala phambi kwakho kuze kube sekupheleni; wena, Nkulunkulu, uyawuyibhalisela, ibe yingcwele kuze kube sekupheleni.
Naleso sikhatsi Davide wababulala labaFilisti, wababeka ngaphansi kwesandla sakhe, wakhipha eGathi nemadolobha ayo emaFilistini.
Wahlasela naMoabi, wabeka Moabu emkhondweni kaDavide, abe ngumnikelo wekushiswa.
UDavide wahlasela naHadarezere, ukumkani weZoba, eHamati, lapho aphuma khona ukubeka isandla sakhe emfuleni i-Ephrathi.
