UDavide wehlisa kuye ema-carriages lamakhulu lamashumi lamabili, nama-horsemen lamakhulu lasikhombisa, nalabahamba ngenyawo lamakhulu mahlanu; wabulala wonke lamahhashi e-carriage, ngaphandle kwama-carriages lamakhulu lamakhulu.
Befika baArami baseDamasko, besiza kuHadarezere, ukumkani waseZoba; kodvwa Davide wababulala laba Arame baseDamasko lamakhulu matsatfu namashumi lamabili nembili.
UDavide wabeka emabhuleki ebukhosini be-Aram, eDamaskus; bafike babe ngabakhonzi bakaDavide, benikela ngeminikelo. Simakadze wabavikela uDavide lapho waya khona.
UDavide wathatha tibhande tegolide, letibekiwe nguHadadarezere, wazisa eJerusalema.

NaseTibhathi nasenkuneni, emadolobheni aHadarezere, Davide wakhipha isiliva elikhulu kakhulu; nalo lisebentiswe nguSolomoni ekwenzeni lelwandle, nemilenze yayo, nempahla yalo yegolide yasendlwini yaSimakadze.
Towu, inkhosi yaseHamati, waphendvula watsi: "Davide wehlule lonke livi leHadarezere, inkhosi yaseZoba."

wathumela uHadoram, umsa wakhe, kunkhosi Davide, kutsi amhlelele, naye abuletele, ngobe abewuhlasela Hadadi-ezer; (naseHadadi-ezer waba nekulwa naTowe), naye wanikela ngetinhlamvu tegolide, netinhlamvu tesilivere, netinhlamvu tesiliva.
Wabanikela kuSimakadze, kanye nesiliva naleyo dlaka abeyithole emazweni onke: eEdomu, neMowabi, nemadvodzana a-Ammon, neFilisti, ne-Amaleki.
UAbishai, umsa waZeruya, wababulala ema-Edomu lamakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamane eminyaka eGoli leLifula.
Wabeka emabhubesi e-Edomu, nabo bonke labase-Edomu bafike babe ngabakhonzi bakaDavide; Simakadze wabavikela Davide lapho waya khona.
Davide waba ngunkhosi yabantfu bonkhe beSirayeli, wakwenza lokuhle nelokuhle kubo bonkhe bantfu bakhe.
Joabhu, umsa waZeruya, waba nguMengameli webantfu; naJosaphat, umsa waAhilodi, waba ngumbhali.
Sadoki, umsa wa-Ahitubi, naAbimeleki, umsa wa-Ebiyathari, babe baLevi; Shavusha waba ngumbhali.
Benaya, umsa wa-Jehoyada, waba nguMengameli webaKherethi nalabaPhelethi, labagcina inhloko yenkhosi; nemadvodzana aDavide bekungubaholi bobukhosi.
Naleso sikhathi wafa uNahasi, ukumkani wema-Ammoniti; waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe umsa wakhe.

UDavide watsi: "Ngiyawukhombisa inhlonipho ku-Hanuni, unyana kaNahasi, njengoba ubaba wakhe wabonisa inhlonipho kuye." UDavide wathumela labangani bakhe kutsi bamphilise ngenhlonipho yakhe ngoyise. Bafika ezweni lama-Ammonita, befika ku-Hanuni, kutsi bamphilise.

Batsi labaholi bemadvodzana a-Ammon ku-Hanun: "UbeDavidi u honorela yini ubaba wakho, ekuboneni kwakho, lapho ethumela khona lamadodana akhe kutsi akhotse kuwe? Bafika kutsi bahlolisise lelizwe, nekuyicashunisa, nekusibulala."
UHanuni wababamba labakhonzi bakaDavide, wabasabalalisa imilenze yabo, washiya ingubo yabo ngaphesheya kuya emphinjeni, wabasusa.
UDavide wathumela labaholi kutsi bahlangana nabo, ngobe laba madoda angeke aboniswe, watsi kubo: "Bukelani eJerikho kuze kukhule imilenze yenu, bese nibuyela ekhaya."

Babona bonkhe bantfu be-Ammon kutsi bayawubaphazamisa Davide, Hanuni nemadvodzana akhe bayathumela igolide lelikhulu elinamaphesenti lamashumi lamabili namakhulu mahlanu (520 000) edrachma, ukuze bakhokhele emabhasi kanye nabakhweli baseMesopotamiya, naseAramu-Maaka, nakuZoba.

Bafike baqasha emabhokisi emlilo lamakhulu lamashumi mathathu nambili, nenkhosi yeMahaka nayo yonke imikhosi yayo, yafika yahlala eMediba; nabo-ke bantfu base-Ammon bahlangana emizini yabo, baphuma bahlasela.
UDavide, lapho akubona khona, wathumela uYowabha kanye nebantfu bakhe bonke labakhulu.
Lamadvodza ase-Ammon aphuma, wamisa umkhosi emnyango wedolobha lakhe; labaholi labafika nabo bahlala emakhaya abo emgwaqweni lovulekile.
UYowabhi, lapho ebona khona kutsi umkhosi ubekwe phambi kwakhe nasemva kwakhe, wakhetha labaseSirayeli abakhethiwe, wababeka emgwaqweni lokulwa ne-Aram.
Wabeka lokunye kwalabo bantu ngaphansi kwesandla senkosi yakhe, Abishayi; bamisa icala labo labanina ba-Amoni.
UYowabhi watsi: "Ngase-Asiriya bebanamandla kunami, wena uyawufika ungangisiza; kodvwa ngasemadvodzana a-Ammon bebanamandla kunakho, khona-ke mina ngitakusiza.
Kutsi wena, ube ngumuntfu lonamandla, sihlale sihlelekile ngenxa yebantfu bethu kanye nemadolobha eNkulunkulu wethu; ngobe Simakadze angeke akwenze lokubi emlonyeni wakhe.
UYowabhi nebantfu bakhe baphuma behlasela laSirayeli, batsi: "Thina-ke sitawuzama ukulwa nabo."
Bekubona bantfu be-Ammon ukuthi laSirayeli babaleka, baphuma nabo phambi kuka-Abishai, umsa ka-Yowabhi, babuyela emzini wabo; watsi uYowabhi: "Ngiye eJerusalema.
Babona-ke laSirayeli kutsi bahlaselwe nguSirayeli, bathumela labaphambukeli, batsi: "Thina siyawufika lapha ngaphesheya komfula i-Euphrates," naShofakhi, umkhosi waHadarezere, waba phambi kwabo.
Bathi kuboDavide, watsi: "Lowo nguSawula!" Wayihlanganisa yonke inkhosi yaseSirayeli, wadlula eJordane, waya kubo, wamisa umkhosi wakhe phambi kwa-Aram, wabahlasela.
LaSirayeli babaleka phambi kweSirayeli, Davide wabulala ema-Arami lamakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamabili nesihlanu lamaphoyisa, nalabahamba ngenyawo lamakhulu mane; wabulala naShofaki, umkhosi wakhe.
Batsi labakhonzi ba-Hadarezere, bebona ukuthi bahlaselwe nguSirayeli, babambisana naDavide, bafike babe ngabakhonzi bakhe. Bashiya ukusiza bantfu baka-Ammon.

Kwatsi lapho kungakapheli iminyaka lemibili, ngaleso sikhathi lapho lamakhosi ephuma khona emkhosini, waphuma uYowabhi, wahlasela ilizwe lamadvodzana a-Ammon, wafika waya eRabha, wahlasela Rabha; Davide wahlala eJerusalema. UYowabhi wahlasela iRabha, wayibulala.

UDavide wathatha inhloko yenkhosi yabo, wayisa ekhanda lakhe; bekuyigolide lelikhulu nemashumi lamane nesihlanu lama-akshatha, yabe inesiliva negolide, ibe yigolide lelihle kakhulu. Wayibeka phezu kweglavu laDavide; uDavide waba nempahla enkulu kakhulu emzini.

Wabakhipha khona, wababeka emabhutsini, nasemabhotsini ensimbi, nasetfuleni; njalo-ke uDavide wakwenza kuwo wonke lamadolobha lamadvodza ase-Ammon. UDavidi wabuyela eJerusalema, yena nebantfu bakhe bonke.
Kwaba khona umkhosi nalabaFilisti eGezeri, lapho uSibekai waseHushathi abulala khona uSipai, lowaseGhabha; kodvwa labaFilisti bahlaselwa.
Kwaba nemphi lelinye nalabaFilisti; Elhanani, unyana waYairi, wababulala Lami, lomkhuluwa kaGoliathi waseGati; isandla sakhe sakubo sabe siqinile njengetinyawo temuntfu lothunga.

Kwaba nekulwa eGathi, kwabe khona umfana lomkhulu kakhulu, labenemikhono leyisishiyagalombili ngesandla sakhe ngasinye, nemikhono leyisishiyagalombili ngenyawo lakhe ngalinye, labamashumi lamabili nesihlanu; naye waba ngumunye walabakhulu.
Wayibulala iSirayeli, kodvwa Jonathane, umsa waShimeha, lomkhuluwa kaDavide, wambulala.
Loba babenemadvodzana a-Rafa eGathi;Davide kanye nemadvodzakati akhe abewabulala labo.
Satana wehla eSirayeli, watsi kuDavide kutsi abeke linani labaseSirayeli.

UDavide watsi kuYowabi kanye nebaholi bebantfu: "Niya nibala lamadodana eSirayeli, kusuka eBhe-shebha emfuleni losentshonalanga kuya eDani emfuleni losentshonalanga; bese ningabatshela kutsi bangaphi.

UYowabhi watsi: "Simakadze afake ebantwaneni bakhe bangaphi namashumi lamakhulu kunalabo abakhona manje; ngobe, nkosi yami umkwehluleli, bangabe bangabakho bonke labakhonzi bakho? Ngubani lofuna ukwenza lokhu? Ngubani lofuna ukufaka isono ku-Israyeli?"
Lakho, umyalo wenkhosi watsi: UYowabha ufike, wahamba ngaso sonke saseSirayeli, wabuyela eJerusalema.

UYowabhi watsi kuDavide: "Kubo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli, kwaba ngumakhulu lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu ezigidi kanye nalikhulu elinamakhulu lama-Israyeli labasebentisa sikhephe; nabo tonkhe tive taYuda babe ngamamitha lamakhulu mane nesishiyagalolunye emawaka.
Labo baLevi nalabaBenjamini, Joabhu akazange abonise kubo; ngobe lomthetho wenkhosi wababi kakhulu kuYowab.
ANkulunkulu akazange akhululeke kuleso sinqumo, ngobe uSimakadze wabulala bantfu bakaSirayeli.
UDavide watsi kuNkulunkulu: "Ngibe nesono esibi kakhulu lapho ngikwenzela khona lokhu; kepha manje, ngiyakucela, shiya umonakalo lomkhonzi wakho, ngobe sengisebenzele ngendlela engumgogodla."
Simakadze watsi kuGadi, lokubonako kwaDavide:
Hamba ufike ukhulume naDavide, utsi: Simakadze utsi: Ngikunikela kuwe ngezinto ezintathu; khethe esinye sazo, ngikuyenze kuwe.
Gade wafika kuDavide, watsi kuye: "Simakadze utsi: 'Khetha wena:

ungakhetha yini: iminyaka lemithathu yendlala, noma inyanga lemithathu uhlupheke phambi kwalabo abakuhlaselayo, bese umlomo wabo ufika kuwe; noma lilanga lemihlanu kube khona umlomo waSimakadze, nesifo lesibulalayo ezweni, nasengumlingiswa waSimakadze lobulala kuwo wonke laSirayeli. Namuhla cabanga ukuthi ngitawuphendula yini lowo wamthumelayo."
UDavide watsi kuGadi: "Nginenkinga enkulu kakhulu; hlala ngisesandlani saSimakadze, ngobe luthando lwakhe lukhulu kakhulu; hlala ngisesandlani samuntu.
Ngako-ke uSimakadze wakhipha umkhuhlane omkhulu eSirayeli, watsi: "LabaSirayeli labamashumi lamane lamakhulu lafa.

ANkulunkulu wathumela indvuna yekuhlasela iJerusalema. Lendoda yafika yayibulala, kodvwa uSimakadze wababona, watsi: "Kulungile! Kulungile!" Wayehlala esiteji sa-Ornani, umJebusi, lapho ingena khona ingcweti yaSimakadze.

UDavide waphakamisa amehlo akhe, watsi: "Ngibona indvodzakati yaSimakadze ihleli phakathi kwemhlaba nezulu, inesandla sayo sisemlonyeni wayo, isuka eJerusalema; khona-ke uDavide kanye nabaholi bakhe, begqoka iingubo zamagilavu, bahlaliswa ngebuso babo phansi.

UDavide watsi kuNkulunkulu, "Ngibe ngitsi: 'Ngubani na loyawubala bantfu?' Ngiye lowo labewudlwengula nguNkulunkulu, lowenza lokubi; kepha laba bantu bafana nengulube; yini lebayenze? Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wami, ngiyakucela, isandla sakho sihlale kimi kanye nendlu yami yenkhosi, kodvwa angeke kube nalolubhubhiso ebantwini bakho."
Watsi ngalelo langa laSimakadze, waphendvula Gadi, watsi: "Ufike ukhulume naDavide kutsi ahambe abe ne altare kuNkulunkulu esiteji saOrnani waseJebusi."
UDavide waphuma, watsi kuGadi: "Uya kutsi uhambe ngegama laSimakadze."
U-Ornani, lapho ebhadla khona imbewu, wabuyela emuva, watsi: "Ngibona Nkulunkulu!" Amakhosikazi akhe lasitfupha abehamba naye bafihla.
UDavide wafika, Aoronani wehla, wambona, watsi: "Ufike uphume embhedeni, ubeke isandla sakhe esihlalweni sakubo Davide, buso bakhe bube phansi.
UDavide watsi ku-Ornani: "Nceda ungangithengise lesibhedlela, kutsi ngibuyele kuyo indlu yekuphumula yaSimakadze; ngingayithengise ngentengo yayo yonke, ukuze lesifo siphele kubo bonkhe bantfu."

U-Ornani watsi kuDavide: "Uyithathe, unkhosi yami ukumkani ayenze kutsi kube kuhle emehlo akhe; bona, ngitakunikela ngenkomo njengesondlo sokudla lokushiswayo, netingcotjo njengemlilo, nengulube ibe ngumnikelo wesono; ngiyakunikela ngako konke.
Unkhosi Davide yatsi ku-Ornani: "Kungeke kube njalo, kepha ngiyawunikela ngentengo lephelele; ngobe angitawutinikela kuSimakadze ngalento yakho, kodvwa ngitawunikela ngesondlo lesingenamkhawulo.
UDavide wanikela ku-Ornani ngeleyo ndawo isiliva lelikhulu nemashumi lamane.

UDavide wasungula khona ithempeli kuSimakadze, wanikela khona ngeminikelo yekushiswa neminikelo yekuthula; wathandaza kuSimakadze, watsi: "UNkulunkulu uphendule ngamlilo kusuka esibhakabhakeni, waya ethempelini lemnikelo wesono.
USimakadze watsi kusengumlingisi, ngobe sengumlingisi, wabeka isandla sakhe emlonyeni wakhe.
Ngeleso sikhathi, lapho Davide ebona khona ukuthi uSimakadze usamuphendule esiteji seOrnani waseJebusethi, wanikela khona.
Letenti leSimakadze, leliMosi abelile esiyalweni, kanye ne altare yemnikelo wekushiswa, kwakungulapho eGibeoni lapho kuphakeme khona.
UDavide akazange afike khona aze abuze uNkulunkulu, ngobe wakhathazekile ngesandla sema-Israyeli senkhosi.
UDavide watsi: "Leni likhaya leSimakadze Nkulunkulu wenu, nalesi sibhedlela seminikelo yekushiswa yeSirayeli."
UDavide waphendvula watsi: "Sitawuhlangana nebantfu labangaphandle, labahlala eSirayeli, bese sihlanganisa nalabakhonta ematshe, kutsi bakhonte ematshe ekwakha indlu yaSimakadze.
UDavide wanikela ngesiliva, negolide, negolide yetinhlamvu, negolide yetinhlamvu, negolide yetinhlamvu, kanye negolide yetinhlamvu.
Wabanikela netingcweti tesedvondza, lezingacinywanga; ngobe laSidoni naTiri babebeka sentsandvo yesedvondza kuDavide ngemandla.

UDavide watsi: "Solomoni, umngane wami, ungumncane, angeke abe nekhono, kepha indlu lekumele ikhonjwe kuSimakadze kumele ibe mkhulu kakhulu, ibe nomzabalazo, ibe namandla emhlaba wonke; ngakho-ke ngitawuyilungiselela."UDavide wahlela kahle ngaphambi kokuba aphele.
Wayibiza iSolomoni, indodana yakhe, watsi kuye: "Thinda indlu kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli.
UDavide watsi kuSolomoni: "Nyana wami, ngibe nenhloso yokwakha indlu ngegama laSimakadze Nkulunkulu wangami.
Lamuhla-ke uSimakadze wakhuluma kimi, watsi: 'Sewuphule igazi elikhulu kakhulu, ube nemikhosi emikhulu; wena awutawukwakha indlu ngegama lami, ngobe usewuphule igazi elikhulu emhlabeni phambi kwami.

Kunemnyaka lomunye utawuzalwa kuwe, lowo utawuba ngumfana wekuthula; ngobe ngitakulethela kukhululeka kubo bonkhe lababuphikisi bakhe labasemgwaqeni wakhe. Igama lakhe liyawuba nguSolomoni, nami ngitakulethela kuSirayeli kuphumula kanye nekuthula iminyaka yakhe yekubusa.
Lowo utawukwakha indlu ngegama lami; yena uya kuba ngunyana wami, nami ngiyawuba ngumtfubi wakhe; ngobe ngitamisa isikhundla sebukhosi bakhe phezu kwaSirayeli kuze kube sekupheleni.
Ngako-ke, unyana wami, Simakadze abe nawe, akwenze kube lula kuwe, ukwakha indlu yaSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho, njengobe wakhuluma.
Simakadze akunike ubuhlakani nekuqonda, aze akubeke phezu kweSirayeli, ukuze ugcine umthetho waSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho.
utawuphumelela, uma nje uhlala ulandzela imiyalo nemtsetfo loSimakadze abewise kuMosesi kutsi uwubambisene naboSirayeli. Bheka sandla sakho, ube ngumfati; ungalokothi, ungabi nebuhlungu bemehlo.

"Nami, ngenze kahle kakhulu, ngalungiselela indlu yaSimakadze igolide lelikhulu elinamakhulu lamane, nesiliva lelikhulu elinamashumi mathathu lamane, nensimbi kanye nensimbi engeke ibe nenani lokulilinganiselwa; nasetindzaweni netimkhonto ngizilungiselele; nawe utawuzithumele.
Unebasebenzi abaningi: labacubha ematshe, kanye nebahleli betindlu, nalabakhangisi, nabo bonkhe labo basebenza ngemandla kuwo wonke lomsebenzi.
Igolide, nesilivere, nesiliva, nensimbi likhulu kakhulu, angeke lihlukaniswe; hlala usebenze, Simakadze abe nawe.
UDavide watsi kubo bonkhe labaholi beSirayeli, kutsi basebentise umsa wakhe uSolomoni, watsi:

Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, angeke abe nawe yini? Utawukunikela ngenhlonipho ngaso sonke isikhathi; naye utawubeka ema-Israyeli kulelizwe emphilweni yami; lelizwe liyawube lingaphansi kwesandla saSimakadze kanye nebantfu bakhe.

Ngako-ke, lungisani umphefumulo wenu nenhliziyo yenu kutsi nilandele uSimakadze Nkulunkulu wenu; nifike nivule indawo lengcwele kaSimakadze Nkulunkulu wenu, nifake ibhokisi lesivumelwane saNkulunkulu kanye nezinto letingcwele taNkulunkulu endlwini leyawukhiwa igama laSimakadze.
UDavide waba mkhulu, wahlala iminyaka lengema-300. Wakwenza uSolomoni, umsa wakhe, abe ngunkhosi yaseSirayeli;
Wahlangana nabo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli, nalabaLevi, nalabaLevi nalabaLevi.
Babalwa labaLevi, abaneminyaka lemashumi lamane eminyaka nangaphezulu; kwaba ngumadodana lamakhulu lamabili nesikhombisa.
Wathi Davide: "Labo labamashumi lamakhulu lasitfupha nesikhombisa kumele babambe iqhaza emsebenzini wendlu yaSimakadze, nalabalikhulu lesihlanu kumele babe ngabaphathi kanye nabameli.
Lamakhulu lamane angeke abe ngabahlengikazi, lamakhulu lamane angeke abonise uSimakadze ngemiculo lemihle engiyenzayo.
UDavide wabahlukanise labaLevi ngemindeni yabo, ngemadvodzana aLevi:Gershoni, neKehati, naMerari.
NgaseGersoni: Ladan neShimeyi.
Ladan waba nemadvodza lasitfupha: Jehiyeli, umsa wakhe, Zethamu naJoyele.
Simeyi waba nemadvodzana lamabili:Shelomothi, naHaziyeli, naHarani; laba babenenhloko yemindeni yaLadani.
Lamadvodzana aShimehi bekunguJahati, neZina, naJeusi, naBeriya; labo bonkhe basitfupha babemadvodzakati aShimehi.
Yahati waba nguMengameli, neZiza ube ngumunye; kepha Jeusi naBeriya babengenamadvodza lamakhulu, ngobe bahlukaniswa abe yimindeni lemibili, ibe yinye.
Nake-ke lamadvodzana aKehati bekunguAmrami, neIzhari, naHebroni, naUziyeli.

Oonyana baka-Amram: uAron noMosese. U-Aron wahlukaniswa, yena nemadvodzana akhe, kuze kube nguNkulunkulu longcwele kakhulu, abe ngumnikelo wesono phambi kweSimakadze, abe ngumkhonzi wakhe, abe ngumsindisi ngegama lakhe, kuze kube nguNkulunkulu ongcwele.
Nase-Israyeli wahlala eGibhithe, watsi: "Lamadvodza laMosese, lomuntfu waNkulunkulu, ayawuhlala eGibhithi.
Lamadvodzana aMosi bekunguGershoni neEliezeri.
Ngemadvodzana aGershoni kwakunguShebueli.
Eliyezeri akazange abe nemadvodzana labanye, kodvwa Eliyezeri waba nemadvodzana amaningi kakhulu.
Lamadvodzana a-Izhare bekunguShelomith.
Lamadvodzana a-Hebroni bekunguJeriya lomkhulu, neAmariya wesithathu, neYahazieli wesithathu, neJekameam wesihlanu.
Lamadvodzana aUziyeli bekunguMika, lomkhulu kubo, neJishiya, lomunye.
Lamadvodzana aMerariya bekunguMaheli naMushi; Lamadvodzakati aMaheli bekunguEleazari naKishi.
Eleazari wafa, akazange abe nemadvodzana, kodvwa waba nemadvodzakati; lamadodana akhe ayehlala nalabahlobo babo, bantfu bakaKisi.
Lamadvodza laMushi abenemadvodzana matatu:Maheli, ne-Eder ne-Jeremota.

Lokho kwakunguLevi, ngemindeni yawo, ngabaholi bemindeni yabo, njengobe babhalwa amagama abo, bobabili labaneminyaka engu-20 ubudala nangaphezulu, labo babesebenza ekusebenzeleni endlwini kaSimakadze.
UDavide watsi: "Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, utawunikela ngekuthula kubo bonkhe bantfu bakhe; uhlala eJerusalema kuze kube sekupheleni.
LaLevi angeke abe nenkinga yekubambisa itabernakele, noma yinye yezinto letisetshenziswa ekusebenzeleni kwayo.
Kusuka kumnyaka wamashumi lamane namakhulu lasitfupha kuya kumnyaka wamashumi lamabili namakhulu lasikhombisa, labaLevi babalwa.
Baye bahlala emnyango wendlu yaSimakadze, nabo bonkhe bantfu benkhosi yabo kanye nemindeni yawo, nalabo bonke labahamba ngesandla sabo emkhondweni wasebukhosini waNkulunkulu.

Babe nemsebenti wekudla lokusetshenzisiwe embhedeni, kanye nesiliva lelihlanganiswe neminikelo yekushiswa, neminqumo yegolide, netinkomishi tekudla lokuphekwako, nekuxubana kwayo, kanye nanoma kuphi kulinganiselwa kwalo.
Bekufanele bafike ekuseni nakusihlwa, bebonga nekubambisana noSimakadze, kanye nekusasa nasebusuku.

Bekunikela ngeminikelo yekushiswa kuSimakadze, ngezinsuku teSabhati, nelilanga lemnyaka lomusha, naleso sikhathi sakusihlwa; besebenza phambi kwaSimakadze njalo-ke, ngokwenani labo, kanye nemithetho yabo.
LaLevi bagcina inkonzo yetenti lekuhlangana, nalapho kungcwele khona, kanye nabazalwane babo, bantfu baka-Aron, emisebenzini yasendlwini kaSimakadze.
Lokho kwakungukuhlukaniswa kwemadvodzana a-Aron: lamadvodzakati a-Aron: Nadabu, naAbihu, naEleazari, naIthamari.
Nadabu naAbihu bafa phambi kwababa babo, bebengaba nemntwana; kodvwa Eleazari neItamari babe ngumnikelo wesono.
UDavide wabahlukanisa ngesandla sa- Sadoki, umsa wa-Eleazari, nesandla sa-Akhimeleki, umsa wa-Ithamari, kutsi bahlukaniswe emaqembu abo.
Baye bahlukaniswa, ngobe lamadodana a-Eleazari abelikhulu elinamashumi lamabili nesihlanu; lamadodana e-Ithamari abemakhulu asibhozo.
Babahlukanise ngesandla, babeka sihlabani; ngobe labaphathi bendawo lengcwele, nalabaphathi bakaNkulunkulu, bekungu Eleazari kanye nemadvodzana a-Ithamari.

Shemaya, umsa waNethaneli, umbhali, waseLevi, wababhalela lamagama abo phambi kwenkhosi, nebaholi, naTsadoki umnikelo wesono, na-Akhimeleki umnikelo wesono, nabaholi bemindeni yalabapristi nalabaLevi.
Lokuhlukumezeka lokuqala kwaphuma kuJoyaribi, lokutsatfu kuJedaya,
lesithathu kuHarim, lesitsatfu kuSeorim,
lesihlanu kuMalkiya, lesithandathu kuMiyamini,
lesihlanu kuHakosi, lesikhombisa kuAbiya,
lesihlanu kuJeshuwa, leshumi kuShekaniya,
lelishumi nelinye kuEliyasibhi, lelishumi nembili kuJakim,
leshumi nambili kuHupha, lelishumi nalinye kuJeshebeab,
lelishumi lelinesihlanu kuBilga, lesikhombisa kuImer,
leshumi nasitfupha kuHeziri, lesikhombisa kuHapi-zezi,
lelishumi nesikhombisa yafika kuPetahiya, lemashumi lasitfupha yafika kuJehezkele,
lemashumi lasitfupha nalinye kuJakhini, lemashumi lalishumi nalamabini kuGamuli,
lemashumi lamakhulu mathathu kuDelaya, nemashumi lamakhulu mane kuMaasiya.
Lokho kwakuyisigaba sabo sokusebenza, lapho befika khona endlwini yaSimakadze, ngendlela yabo, njengobe uAron, loyise wabo, abemwise ngayo, njengoba Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, abemwisile.
Nalaba baLevi labashiywe: kubo-Amrami kwaba nguShubhayeli; kubo-Shubhayeli kwaba nguJedeya.
Lamadvodza laRehabiya abe ngu-Ishiya, umholi wabo.
Ngase-Izhari kwaba nguShelomothi, ngase-Isharhi kwaba nguJahati.
Labantwana baka-Hebroni: uJeriya lomkhulu, ne-Amariya lowesibili, ne-Yahazieli lowesithathu, ne-Jekameam lowesihlanu.
Umnyaka wa-Uziyeli waba nguMika; emadvodzana aMika bekunguShamire.
Umkhuluwa wakhe waba ngu-Ishiya, kanye nemadvodzana a-Ishiya: uZekariya.
Lamadvodzana aMerariya bekunguMaheli naMushi; lamadvodzakati aYahaziya bekunguBeno.
Lamadvodzana aMerariya, kusuka kuYahaziya:Beno, neShoham, neZakur, naIbri.
WaMaheli waba nguEleazari, kodvwa akazange abe nemadvodzana.
Ku-Kishi kwaba nguJerahmeel, umsa wa-Kishi.
Lamadvodzana aMushi bekunguMaheli, ne-Eder ne-Jerimothi; labo babenguLevi, lababhalwa ngemindeni yabo.

Nabo nabo bakhipha isipho phambi kwenkhosi Davide, neTsadoki, na-Akhimeleki, nabaholi bemindeni yemadvodzana aLevi kanye nemadvodzakati emadvodzana aLawithi; lomkhulu waba nemndeni wakhe, kanye naloncane.

UDavide kanye nebaholi besive bahlukanise nalabo labengaba ngu-Asaphe, na-Heman, na-Jeduthuni, labazange bakhulume ngemtsetfo, labazange bacwelise ngemiphimbo, nemvimbo, nezinhlamvu. Lolu linani lamadoda asebenza kulomsebenzi:
Labo babe nguZakur, naJoseph, naNethaniya, naAsarela; laba bangaphansi kwesandla sa-Asaphi, lokhuluma ngesiprofethi ngaphansi kwesandla senkhosi.

Ngabo-Jeduthuni: Gedaliya, neZeri, neJeshaya, neShimehi, neHashabhiya, naMatathiya; laba sishiyagalombili; nabo babe ngaphansi kwesandla seJedutuni, ubaba wabo, lokhuluma ngesikhashana ngecwecwe, bebonga, bebonga Simakadze.
Labo babe ngu-Eliyatha, neGiddalithi, neRomamthi-Ezer, naJosbekasha, naMalothi, naHotiri, naMahasiothi.

Labo bonke babenemadvodzana aHeman, lokubonako ukumkani, lowo Nkulunkulu abemtshele kutsi utawumuqinisa; ngobe Simakadze wabanikela kuHemane bantfu labalishumi linamahlanu lamadodana namakhosikazi lasitfupha.

Lamadoda lawo wonke ahlala ngaphansi kwenhloko yababa babo, ekudlaleni emacwecwe ethempelini lika-Simakadze, nezinhlamvu, nezingcezu, nezigcawu, ekusebenzeni endlwini kaNkulunkulu; kanye naAsaphi, naJeduthuni, naHemani, ngaphansi kwenhloko yenkhosi.
Labo, kanye nalabo labangane babo, bonke labaqeqeshiwe ekudlaleni ingoma yaSimakadze, bekungumakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamane nesihlanu.
Bonke bakhipha timali ngemisebenzi yabo, labancane kanye nalabakhulu, bodokotela nebafundi.
Lomnikelo wekushiswa we-Asaphi waphuma kuYosefu; lomnikelo wekushiswa wesibili ufike kuGedaliya, naye nabazalwane bakhe nemadvodzana akhe, labalishumi linamihlanu.
Isihlanu sifike kuZakhuri; yena, nemadvodzana akhe, nemadvodzakati akhe abelishumi linamihlanu.
Isihlanu safike ku-Izri; yena, nemadvodzana akhe, nemadvodzakati akhe, babelishumi linamihlanu.
isihlanu safike kuNethaniya; naye labenemadvodzana nemadvodzakati akhe, labalishumi linamihlanu.
isihlanu yafika kuBukiya; yena, nemadvodzana akhe, nemadvodzakati akhe, babelishumi linamihlanu.
isikhombisa yaphuma kuJesharela; yena, nemadvodzana akhe, nemadvodzakati akhe, babelishumi linamihlanu.
isikhombisa yafika kuJesahiya; yena, nemadvodzana akhe, nemadvodzakati akhe, babelishumi linamihlanu.
isikhombisa yafika kuMatania; yena, nemadvodzana akhe, nemadvodzakati akhe, babelishumi linamihlanu.
ishumi lafike ku-Shimeyi; yena, nemadvodzana akhe, nemadvodzakati akhe, labalishumi linamihlanu.
ishumi nalinye lafike ku-Azareli; yena, nemadvodzana akhe, nemadvodzakati akhe abelishumi linamihlanu.
ishumi nambili yafika kuHashabiya, naye ubenemadvodzana nebantfu bakhe labalishumi linamahlanu.
ishumi nambili yafika ku-Shubayeli; yena, nemadvodzana akhe, nemadvodzakati akhe abelishumi linamihlanu.
ishumi nambili yafika kuMatithaya; yena, nemadvodzana akhe, nemndeni wakhe, babelishumi linamihlanu.
ishumi nesihlanu lafike kuJeremota; yena, namadvodzana akhe, nabazalwane bakhe, babelishumi linamihlanu.
ishumi nasikhombisa yafika kuHananiya; yena, nemadvodzana akhe, nemadvodzakati akhe abelishumi linamihlanu.
ishumi nasikhombisa yafika kuJosbekasha; yena, nemadvodzana akhe, nemadvodzakati akhe, babelishumi linamihlanu.
isihlanu sekucala sifike kuHanani; yena, nemadvodzana akhe, nemadvodzakati akhe, babelishumi linamihlanu.
ishumi nasikhombisa yafika kuMalothi; yena, nemadvodzana akhe, nemindeni yakhe, labalishumi linamihlanu.
ishumi nambili yafika kuEliyata; yena, nemadvodzana akhe, nemndeni wakhe, babelishumi linamihlanu.
isikhombisa nemashumi lamane nalinye yafika kuHothiri; yena, nemadvodzana akhe, nemadvodzakati akhe, babelishumi linamihlanu.
ishumi nambili lafika kuGiddalthi, naye ubenemadvodzana nebantfu bakhe labalishumi linamihlanu.
ishumi nambili nesikhombisa yafika kuMahasiyothi; yena, nemadvodzana akhe, nemadvodzakati akhe abelishumi linamihlanu.
ishumi nambili nesikhombisa yafika kuRomamthi-Ezeri; nabo bonkhe bantfu bakhe babelishumi linamihlanu.
Lokho kwakungukuhlukaniswa kwebantfu labagcina umsango: kulabo base-Korhi, Meshelemiah, unyana wa-Kore, wemadvodzana a-Asaph.
Lamadvodzana aMeshelemiya bekunguZekariya, lomnyaka munye, Jediayeli wesitsatfu, Zebadiasi wesithathu, Jathanieli wesihlanu,
Elami wesihlanu, neYohanani wesithandathu, naElihoheni wesikhombisa.
Labantwana baka-Obedi-Edomu: uShemaya lomkhulu, ne-Yozabadi lowesibili, ne-Joah lowesithathu, ne-Sakhari wesibili, ne-Nethaneli wesihlanu,
u-Amiyeli wesishiyagalolunye, u-Issakhar wesishiyagalolunye, u-Pehulleti wesishiyagalolunye; ngobe Nkulunkulu abewubulele Obede-Edomu.
NaShemaya unyana wakhe waba nemadvodzana, lababe yinhloko yemindeni yabo, ngobe bebengamadodana anamandla.
Labantwana bakaShemaya: Otni, neRefayeli, naObedi, naElzabadi; nabo-Elihu naSemakiya, labangane babo, babemadodana anamandla.

Labo bonke babe yimadvodzana a-Obedi-Edomu, bona nemadvodzakati abo kanye nalabobazalwane babo, labazange bahlupheke, labanamandla amakhulu emisebenzini; bebengamashumi lamane nambili kulowo-ke Obedi-Edomu.
Meshelemiah waba nemadvodza lamakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamane, amakhosikazi nalabahlobo bakhe.
NaHosa, lowaseMerari, waba nemadvodzana: Shimri wayengumholi; ngobe akazange abe ngumzali wakhe, kodvwa ubaba wakhe wamkhipha abe nguMengameli.
Hilikiya wesibili, Tebaliya wesithathu, neZekariya wesihlanu; Hosa wabenemadvodza lamakhulu lamabili namashumi matatu.
Lemihlangano yalabagwebi, kanye nabaholi babo, babenemisebenzi yabo ekusebenzeni endlwini kaSimakadze, njengabahlobo babo.
Baphindze bakhipha tiphatsimandla ngetiphatsimandla, labancane kanye nalabakhulu, ngaso sonke isango.
Umnikelo wekushiswa wemnyango wasempumalanga waphuma kuShelemiya; bakhipha umnikelo wabokudla kuZekariya, unyana wakhe, ummeli lowaziyo, waphuma kuye umnikelo wokushiswa wemnyango wasenyakatho.
Isango laseMpumalanga lafike ku-Obedi-Edomu, kanye nendlu yetingcezu yafika kubonyana bakhe.
Isango lasenyakatho, nesango leSalekethi, endlela yephezulu, labekwa nguShuphim naHosa; labagwebi bahlala linye linye.
LaLevi lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu ahlala emaphandleni, lasitfupha enyakatho, lasikhombisa emfuleni, lalishumi elinesihlanu eningizimu, nalabatsatfu emnyango wendlu yasesitezi.
Emahhovisini lasentshonalanga, kwakunemakhulu lasitfupha endlela kanye nemashumi lamabili emahhovisi.
Lokho kwakungamaqembu labahlengikazi labasuka kubo-Korha nemadvodzana aMerari.
Nabo-ke labazalwane babo, labaLevi, ngaseAhiya, babenesibopho setingcweti tendlu yaSimakadze, netingcweti tezinto letingcwele.
Lamadvodza laLadani, abe nguGershoni, asuka ku-Ladani, abe nguJehiyeli, umsa waLadani, umGershoni.
Nabo-Zethamu, umsa waJehiyeli, naJoyele, umzalwana wakhe, babenesibopho sempahla yendlu yaSimakadze.
Lakwa-Amrami, ne-Izhari, ne-Hebroni, ne-Uziyeli:
Shebueli, lowaseGershoni, unyana waMosesi, waba ngumphathi wezinto letigcinwe etinhlelweni.
Amakhosi akhe asuka ku-Eliezeri: Rehabhiya, umsa wa-Eliezeri; Yeshaya, umsa wa-Rehabiya; Yoramu, umsa wa-Yeshaya; Zikri, umsa waJoramu; Shelomothi, umsa waZikri.

Shelomothi nabazalwane bakhe babe ngabaphathi baletinye tindlu letingcwele, lapho kwaba khona ubukhosi benkhosi Davide, kanye nenhloko temindeni yabo, kanye nabaholi bemakhulu nekhulu, kanye nabaholi bomkhosi.
Baye banikela ngezinto takuboshwa emkhosini kutsi balungise indlu yaSimakadze.

Nalo lonke lomnikelo loshiswa nguSamuweli lowo wekubona, naSawuleli unyana kaKishi, naAbheri unyana kaNeri, naYowabu unyana kaZeruhiya, kanye nalo tonkhe tive letingema-Amori neletisemaGibhithe, kwabe sekubekwe ngaphansi kwesandla saShelomothi nabazalwane bakhe.
Kulabo ba-Izharhi, kwaba nguChenaniha nemadvodzana akhe, lababenemisebenzi yendlu yaSimakadze; babe ngabaphathi nabamehluleli ku-Israyeli.

Kulabo base-Hebroni, kwaba nguHasabiya kanye nabazalwane bakhe, lamakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamane lamakhulu asithupha, labaqeqeshiwe ebantwini baseSirayeli ngasempumalanga yeJordane, besebenza kuwo wonke umsebenzi waSimakadze, nenkonzo yobukhosi.
Lase-Hebroni: uJeriya, umholi wemindeni yabo; lomnyaka wamashumi lamane wokubusa kukaDavide, kwafunwa emndenini wakhe amadoda anamandla kakhulu eJazeri eGileyadi.

Naye uJeriya waba nemadvodzana aJeriya, lababandlululo lamakhulu lamabili namakhulu ayisithupha, babebaholi bemindeni yabo; lonkhosi Davide yababeka ngaphesheya kweRubhene, neGadi, naphesheya komfula iManase, kuwo wonke umsebenzi waNkulunkulu nowobukhosi.

Lolu linani lamadodana eSirayeli asebenza kunkhosi: bomkhuluwa bemindeni yabo, nebaholi bamakhulu kanye namakhulu, nalabaphathi babo; nabo babekhonza ukumkani ngaso sonke simo, ngemikhosi yabo leyawufika nayo leyayiphuma inyanga nenyanga iminyaka yonke. Kuwo wonke umkhosi kwakunguma-24.
Ngesigaba sokuqala, kumnyaka wokuqala, kwaba nguYashobeam, umsa waZabdiyeli; nangesigaba sakhe kwaba ngumakhulu lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu.
Wabe ngumunye wemadvodzana a-Fareshi, bekunguMengameli webantfu bonke basejimini lakhe lomnyaka wesitsatfu.
Ngesigaba sakhe somnyaka wesitsatfu kwakunguDodayi, umAhohiya; nesigaba sakhe sabekwa uMiklothi; ngaso sigaba sakhe kwaba ngumakhulu lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu.
Umkhosi wesithathu, wenyanga yesithathu, waba nguBenaya, unyana ka-Jehoyada, umLevi; esigabeni sakhe sabekhona lamakhulu mahlanu namashumi lamabili nesihlanu.
Lowo Benaya waba ngumuntfu lonamandla, walabamashumi lamane, waba ngumholi wabomakhulu lamane; esigabeni sakhe kwakungu-Amizabadi unyana wakhe.
Lowesihlanu kumnyaka wesihlanu ube nguAsaheli, mkhuluwa ka-Yowabe; ngemuva kwakhe kwaba nguZebadia unyana wakhe; esigabeni sakhe kwabekhona lamakhulu mahlanu namashumi lamabili nesikhombisa.
Umphathi wesisihlanu wenyanga yesishiyagalombili ube nguShamuthi, umJizrahi; kusigaba sakhe kwaba ngumashumi lamakhulu mahlanu namane.
Umphathi wesishiyagalolunye kumnyaka wesithandathu ube nguIra, unyana ka-Ikeshi, waseTekoa; nalapho kuhlanganiswa khona labamashumi lamakhulu mahlanu nesihlanu.
Lowesihlanu kumnyaka wesikhombisa ube nguHelezisi, umPhelonita, waseEframu; nasenhlalweni sakhe kwabekhona lamakhulu mahlanu nemashumi mane.
Umphathi wesishiyagalolunye kumnyaka wesikhombisa ube nguSibbekai, umHushathi, waseZera; naye ngesigaba sakhe kwaba makhulu lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu.
Umphathi wesithoba kumnyaka wesihlanu waba nguAbiezeri waseAnathothi, waseBenjamini; nasenhlalweni sakhe kwabengaba ngumakhulu mahlanu nemashumi lamane.
Umphathi wesitsatfu wenyanga yesishiyagalombili ube nguMaharai waseNetofa, wabaseZera; kuhlangatshezwana naye labamashumi lamane namakhulu mane.
Umphathi wesishiyagalolunye wenyanga yesishiyagalolunye ube nguBenaya u-Pirathoni, waseEframu; kuhlangatshezwana naye labamashumi lamakhulu mahlanu namane.
Umphathi weshumi elinesihlanu kumnyaka wasikhombisa ube nguHeldai Netofathi, waseOthniel; nakwesigaba sakhe kwaba ngumakhulu mahlanu, lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu.
Nalaba babenetinhloko temindeni yaSirayeli: ku-Rubheni, Eliyezeri unyana waZikhri; ku-Simeoni, Shefatiya unyana waMahaka;
kuLevi: Hashabiya, umsa waKemueli; kumadvodzana a-Aharon: Sadoki;
ku-Juda nguElihu, umngane waDavide; ku-Issakhar nguOmri, umsa kaMikayeli;
ku-Zabuloni, Ishmaya unyana waObadiya; ku-Naphtali, Jeremothi unyana waAzriyeli;
ku-Ephrayi, Hoshea, umsa waAziyahi; engxenyeni yenkhosi yaManase, Joele, umsa waPedaya;
ngomnyaka wasikhombisa, kwaba nguJahazieli umsa ka-Abner; ngaleso sikhatsi kwabekhona eGileyadi Iddo unyana waZekaria;
NgeDani, Azareli, umsa waJerohamu; laba babengubaholi bemindeni yaSirayeli.

UDavide akazange abe nenani labo labaneminyaka lemashumi lamane namakhulu lasitfupha kuya kumashumi lamabili, ngobe Simakadze abetse kutsi uyawukwenza bantfu bakaSirayeli babe njengezinkanyezi zesibhakabhaka.
Joabhu, umsa wa-Zeruya, wabaqala kutsibala, kodvwa akazange aphele; ngobe kwafika ingcumbuko kuSirayeli ngenxa yekubala kwabo; ngobe inombolo yabo yonke ayibhalwanga encwadini yezindaba taDavide.
Waba nguAzmavethi, unyana kaAdiyeli, umphathi wezinto letigcinwe kubukhosi; wabe nguYonathani, unyana kaUziya, umphathi wezinto letigcinwa emaphandleni, emadolobhaneni, emgwaqeni kanye netingcweti.
NaEzri, umsa waKelubi, waba nguMengameli webantfu labasebenza emhlabatsini, labasebentisa lemhlaba.
UShimehi waseRama wabekwa phezu kwetintsimba; neZabdi, umSifemi, waba ngaphansi kwakhe, wabeka phansi uvini lwetintsimba.
Ba'ale-Hanani waseGederi waba nguMengameli wemihlambi yetimbali te-olive kanye netimfuyo te-figo; Joashi waba nguMengameli wema-olive.
Sitrayi waseSharoni waba nguMengameli webantfu labadla inyama eSaroni; Shafati, umsa waAdlai, waba nguMengameli webantfu labadla inyama emigwaqeni.
Obil, i-Ishmayeli, waba nguMengameli welive; Yedeya, umMeronothi, waba nguMengameli wemasinyane; Jahazisi, umHagiri, waba nguMengameli webantfu.
Labo bonke babengabaphathi bempahla yenkhosi Davide.
UJonathani, umngane kaDavide, waba ngumqondisi, indodana yemtsetfo, nombhali; uJehiyeli, unyana waHakmoni, waba ngumphathi wemadvodzana ankhosi.
Ahitophel waba ngummeli wenkhosi, naHushai, umArhithi, waba ngumunye wabaholi.
Emva kwa-Ahitofeli, kwaba nguJehoyada, umsa waBenaya, neAbhiyathari; Joabhi ke waba ngumholi wemphi yaSimakadze.

UDavide wahlangana nalabakhulu bonke baseSirayeli eJerusalema, nabaholi bemindeni yabo, nabahlengikazi bemikhosi yenkhosi, nabahlengikazi bamakhulu, nabahlengikazi bamashumi lamakhulu, nabehlengikazi beempahla kanye nenyama yenkhosi, nabahlengikazi bendlu yakhe, nalabo labanamandla, nabo bonkhe labo labacinane bokulwa.

Unkhosi Davide yahlala phansi, yatsi: "Ningilalele, bazalwane bami nebantfu bami; ngibe nemcabango wokwakha indlu yekuphumula yebhokisi lesivumelwane saNkulunkulu, ibe yindawo yokubeka tinyawo taSimakadze Nkulunkulu wethu, futhi ngibe nenhlanhla yokuyisungula.
"Lamuhla, Simakadze utsi: 'Ungeke ube nguwo lokwakha indlu ngegama lami, ngobe wena ungumuntu wekulwa, uyewuphuza gazi.'

Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, ungikhethile emndenini wami wonke, kutsi ngibe ngunkhosi yama-Israyeli kuze kube sekupheleni; wakhetha isizwe saYuda ukuba sibe yinhloko yawo, wakhetha emndenini wababami waseJuda, wakhetha labantwana bababami, wamthanda ngaye, watsi ngibambisene nabo bonkhe bama-Israyeli.
Nakuba uSimakadze wancede, watsi: "Ngubani nalowo longeke ahlale ebukhosini benkhosi yaseYiputa kanye nenkhosi yaseSirayeli?"
Wathi kuye: USolomoni, unyana wakho, loyawukwakha indlu yami netindlu zami; ngobe ngiyamkhetha abe ngumntwana wami, nami ngitawuba ngubaba wakhe.
Ngitagcina ubukhosi bakhe kuze kube sekupheleni, uma ehlala esenza imiyalo yami nemithetho yami, njengamanje.

Manje-ke, ngaleso sikhathi, phambi kwalabo bonke labaseSirayeli, ibandla leSimakadze, kanye nalapho uNkulunkulu wethu elalela khona, nigcineni kutsi niphumele yonke imiyalo yenkhosi yenu Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, ukuze niyibambe lelizwe lelihle, nilishiye kubantwana benu ngemuva kwenu kuze kube sekupheleni.

Nakho wena, Solomone, mntwana wami, qaphela uNkulunkulu wababa bakho, umkhonze ngentliziyo yakho yonke nemoya yakho ekahle; ngobe uSimakadze unquma imiphefumulo leminyenti, uyewuqonda wonke umcabango kanye nemibono. Uma uyawufuna, uyakuthola; kodwa uma uyawushiya, uzokususa kuze kube sekupheleni.
Thina-ke, khumbula kutsi uSimakadze wehlule wena ukuba ube yindlu yakhe, ibe yindawo yakhe lengcwele; ube nemandla, uyeke.

UDavide watsi kuSolomoni, umsa wakhe, imihlobiso yemnyango wendlu yaSimakadze, netingcweti zalo, netingcweti taleyo ndlu, netingcweti letiphakeme, netingcweti letingaphakathi, netingcweti tegumbi lelithoko.

Wamnikela ngemihlobiso yalendlu yaSimakadze, neminye imihlobiso yendlu yaSimakadze, naleyo yemihlobiso yendlu yaNkulunkulu, naleyo mihlobiso yezinto letingcwele, kanye naleyo mihlobiso yezinto letingcwele.
Wathi kubo: "Nifike nikhulume naSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, nitsi: 'UNkulunkulu waseSirayeli wanikela ngendlu yakhe kuSimakadze, umnikelo wesono.'

Wathi kuye kutsi kube yini legolide ekumele isebenzise kuleyo mpahla yegolide lesetshenziswa kuwo wonke lomsebenzi, kanye nekube yini lesiliva ekufanele isebenzise kuleyo mpahla yesiliva lekusetshenziswa kuwo wonke lomsebenzi.

Watsi: "Lenani legolide lokuya kusebentisa emakhandlela esiliva, nelamakhampasi alo; kanye naleyo imali yesilivere ekusebenziseni amakhaphethi amhlophe namaphakheji awo, ngaso sonke sidakambiso lesimnyama nesibhakabhaka sayo.
Waphendvula watsi: "Inani legolide lelifanele lisetjeniswe ngayinye yetibopho tekudla lokusetshenzisiwe, kanye nenani lesilivere lelifanele lisetjeniswe ngetibopho tesiliva.
Wathi kuye: "Inani legolide elifihlekile lokufanele lisetyenziswe ema-forks ekudla, nama-bowls, nema-jacks, kanye nenani legolide nesilivere lekumele lifakwe kuwo wonke umhlobiso wegolide nesilivere.
wakhuluma kuye ngegolide elifihliwe, lakufanele lifakwe emnyango wendlu yaSimakadze, naleyo nsimbi yemoto, naleyo golide lama-kerubi, abekwe emaphini abo phezu kwebhokisi lesivumelwano saNkulunkulu.
UDavide watsi: "Lento yonke ibhalwe ngesandla saSimakadze, ngobe wangisinika ukuqonda ngaso sonke lesi simo."

Wathi uDavide kuSolomoni, unyana wakhe: "Beka sandla sakho esiqinile, ube nekuthula, uyenzile lemisebenzi; ungakhathazeki, ungenasiqiniseko, ngoba uSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho, Nkulunkulu wami, uzobe nawe; akakushiyeli, akakushiya, kuze kube sekuphele yonke imisebenzi yenkonzo yasendlu kaNkulunkulu.

Batsi: "Namuhla, bona, sikhona isigaba semaLevi kanye nesigaba semaBhenjamini, esigabeni lesiphelele senkonzo yendlu yaNkulunkulu; nawe ukhona wonke umuntu lofisayo, lowo owaziyo kutsi akwenze yini yonke lemisebenzi; nabo bonkhe labaholi nalabanyenti batawukwenza konke lokuwuletsa.

Unkhosi Davide yatsi kubo bonkhe bantfu: "Solomoni, umntwana wami, lowo Nkulunkulu ayawukhethela, ungumncane, awunamakhono; lemisebenzi ikhulu kakhulu, ngoba lendlu ayikho yemuntu, kodwa nguSimakadze Nkulunkulu wenu.

Ngamandla ami wonke, sengilungiselele indlu yaSimakadze Nkulunkulu wami, igolide ngezinto zegolide, nesilivere ngezinto zesilivere, nesiliva ngezinto zegolide, nensimbi ngezinto zensimbi, nesihlahla ngezinto zetihlahla; ngalungiselela namatshe e-onyx, namacwecwe, namacwecwe amhlophe, namacwecwe lahlukene, naletinye tindzawo letiphakeme, kanye netinhlabamqoka.

Nase naleso simo, ngobe ngithanda indlu yaSimakadze Nkulunkulu wami, ngiyanikela ngezinto zami tegolide nesilivere endlwini yaNkulunkulu wami, ngaphandle kwezinto tonkhe letingeke ngizilungiselele lendlu lengcwele.
Namuhla ngitawunikela ngegolide lelingaba ngumathani lamakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamane eOfiri, nesiliva lelingaba ngumathani lamakhulu mahlanu nemashumi lamane, kutsi lihlobise imiganga yalendlu,
kanye naleyo mpahla yegolide neyesiliva, kutsi isebenze kulabo labahamba ngesandla; ngobe yini leyawucela umnikelo waSimakadze ngalolusuku?
Labaholi bemindeni, nabaholi bebantfu baseSirayeli, nabaholi bamakhulu nemakhulu labaholi, kanye nalabaphathi bomsebenzi wenkhosi, banikela ngesandla sabo.

Banikela ngemisebenzi yendlu yaSimakadze, ngegolide lamathani lamakhulu lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu, nesiliva lamathane lamakhulu lasitfupha, nesiliva lamathane lamakhulu lasikhombisa, nesiliva lamathane lamakhulu lalishumi, nensimbi lamathane lamakhulu lasitfupha, namakhulu lasitfupha.
Nalowo nalowo lobe nesiliva kanye negolide, wabanikela emnyango wendlu yaSimakadze ngaphansi kwesandla seJehiyeli, umGershoni.
Labantfu baphumula kakhulu, ngobe labaholi babo babenikela ngesandla sabo; ngobe benikela kuSimakadze ngentliziyo yabo yonke; naDavide, ukumkani, waphumula kakhulu.
UDavide wabonga uSimakadze phambi kwebandla lonke, watsi: "Ube mkhulu wena, Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, tatawethu, kuze kube sekupheleni!

Wena, Nkulunkulu, umkhulu, nemandla, nekuthula, nekuthula, nebuhle; konke okusezulu nasenhlabathini kuyawukho wena. Ubukhosi bukhona kuwe, Simakadze; wena uphakeme kakhulu, nguNkulunkulu wezinto zonke.
Kusuka kuwe kuyawuvela mandla nekuthula, wena ulawula yonke into; esandla sakho sikhona amandla namandla; wena lowenza wonke umuntu abemkhulu, nawe lowubambisa.
Ngako-ke, Simakadze Nkulunkulu wethu, siyawukubonga, siyawubonga igama lakho lelihle.
ngobe yini nami, yini nalaba bantu bami, kutsi sikwazi kunikela ngalendlela lenjalo? Lonke lutho luvela kuwe, kanye nesandla sakho sethu sikulethela wena.
Sibe ngamehlo akho sifana nebahleli bangaphandle, nabangani, njengobe babe nabo bonkhe bantfu labababa bethu; lilanga lethu emhlabeni lifana nesithunzi, lingeke lihlale.
Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wethu, lemali yonke esiyilungiselele kutsi sibuye senze indlu ngegama lakho elingcwele, ivela esandla sakho, liyawukho wena.

Nami, Nkulunkulu wami, ngiyazi kutsi wena unquma inhlitiyelelo yenhliziyo, nawe uthanda lokulungile. Ngase ngikunikela ngalo lonke lolu mnikelo ngesandla sami kanye nekuthula kwenhliziyo yami; namanje ngabona nabo bonkhe bantfu bakho labakhona bakunika lomnikelo wabo.
Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Abrahama, ne-Isakha na-Israyeli, abafowethu, ugcine lokhu engqondweni yalabo bantu bakho kuze kube sekupheleni; gcina intliziyo yabo ilungile kuwe.

Unike uSolomoni, umngane wami, inhliziyo lekahle kakhulu, kutsi agcine imiyalo yakho, namasiko akho, nemithetho yakho, abe ngumnikelo wesono, abe ngumnikelo wekushiswa, abe ngumnikelo wesono, abe ngumnikelo wesono, abe ngumnikelo wesono.
UDavide wathi kuwo wonke umhlangano: "Nceda nibonga uSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu!" Wonke umhlangano wabonga Simakadze, uNkulunkulu wababusi babo, babhujiswa phambi kuSimakadze kanye nobukhosi.

Ngosuku lwesibili banikela ngenhlanhla kanye neminikelo yekushiswa kuSimakadze, inkunzi yengulube lelikhulu, nemfuyo yemvu lelikhulu, namabele lamakhulu lamabili, kanye neminikelo yabo yokushiswa, nemnikelo wesono lowukhulu kuwo wonke laSirayeli.

Badla nabo baphuza phambi kuSimakadze ngalolusuku, nekuthula lokukhulu. Bakhipha uSolomoni, unyana kaDavide, waba ngunkhosi lilanga lesibili, bamutisa phambi kwaSimakadze abe ngumholi, bamutisa naTsadoko abe ngumpristi.
USolomoni wahlala esihlalweni sebukhosi saSimakadze, waba ngunkhosi endaweni kaDavide, ubaba wakhe; waphumelela, bonkhe labaSirayeli bamlalela.
Nabo bonkhe bantfu, nalabo baholi, nalabakhulu, nalabafileyo, kanye nabo bonkhe lamadvodza akaDavide, babe ngubukhosi baSolomoni.
Simakadze wavusa uSolomoni abemkhulu kakhulu emehlo lamadvodza aseSirayeli wonke, wabanika isikhundla sobukhosi esiphakeme kunawo wonke lamakhosi aseSirayeli angaphambili kwakhe.
UDavide, umsa wa-Isaye, waba ngunkhosi yalabanyenti base-Israyeli.
Kube iminyaka lemine nemashumi lamane abengunkhosi yaseSirayeli: eHebroni iminyaka lesikhombisa, eJerusalema iminyaka lelishumi nalamathathu.
Wafa emshadweni lokahle, ephila iminyaka lengema-250; uSolomoni, umsa wakhe, waba ngunkhosi esikhundleni sakhe.
Nalo lonke lokudlalwa ngunkhosi Davide, kusukela ekuqalekeni kuye ekupheleni kwalo, akunjalo kubhalwe embhalweni waSamuweli lokubonayo, nembhalo waNathani umprofeti, nembhalo waGadi lokubonayo?
Lolu hlelo lukhuluma ngaso sonke isimo sakhe sebukhosi, nemandla akhe, nalapho afike khona, nakwaSirayeli, nakubo bonke bantfu bemhlaba.
2Chr: Solomoni, umsa kaDavide, waqiniswa ebukhosini bakhe; Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakhe, waba naye, wamkhulula kakhulu.
USolomoni wakhuluma kuwo wonke lamakhosi aseSirayeli, emabutfo lamakhulu nemakhulu labaholi, nalabavikeli, nabo bonkhe labaphathi baseSirayeli, bomkhuluwa bemindeni yabo.

Wahamba uSolomoni, naye lonke ibandla lakhe, waya ethempelini elikhulu laseGibheboni; ngobe kwabekhona khona itente lekuhlangana laNkulunkulu, itenti leliMosese, umkhonzi waSimakadze, alifungisile efulethini.
Davide wakhipha ibhokisi laSimakadze eKiriyati-Yearim, waya kuyo lendawo abeyilungiselele yona, ngobe wabambisene netente eYerusalem.
Le altare yesiliva, leBesaleleli, unyana kaUri, unyana ka-Huri, ayenze, yayikhona lapho eGibeboni, phambi kwendlu yaSimakadze; wafika khona uSolomoni kanye nebandla lakhe, babuza Simakadze.
USolomoni wanikela phambi kwaSimakadze etintfweni tesiliva lelibomvu, etentini lengema-Israyeli, wanikela khona ngeminikelo yekushiswa emikhulu.
Ngobusuku balo, Simakadze wabonakala kuSolomoni, watsi kuye: "Lalela kutsi ngikunike yini."
Solomoni watsi kuNkulunkulu: "Uye wakhombisa ubaba wami, uDavide, inhlonipho enkulu nekuthula; wena ungenza ngibe ngunkhosi yakhe.
Namuhla, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, liqinisekiswe linye lisho lakho labeulikhuluma kuDavide, umsa wami; ngobe wena ungenza ngibe ngunkhosi yalaba bantu labaningi njengamatshe emhlaba.
Lakho, ngiyakucela, nginike ubuhlakani nelwazi, kutsi ngiphume ngifike kulabo bantu; ngobe yini lengeke ivumeleke kutsi ibe ngummeli walebantfu bakho abakhulu?

UNkulunkulu watsi kuSolomoni: "Lento ikhona emphefumulweni wakho; awucelenga mandla, noma imfuyo, noma inhlonipho, noma umphefumulo walelabo abakukhohlisayo, ngobe ungeke ufune iminyaka leminingi, kepha ucela ubuhlakani kanye nelwazi, ukuze ube ngummeli webantfu bami, labo ngakwenta wena ukumkani kubo.
ngiyakunikela ngenhlonipho nelwazi, ngikunike namandla, nempahla, nebucwebe, ngikubeke phezulu kunabo bonke bobukhosi labakhona ngaphambi kwakho, kanye nabo bonkhe labakhona ngemuva kwakho.
USolomoni wabuyela eJerusalema, waba ngunkhosi yaseSirayeli, watsi: "Lowo muntfu longcwele unguNkulunkulu wami, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli.

Solomoni wahlanganisa emabhasi namahhashi, abenamabhasi lamakhulu lamabili nemakhulu amane, namabhasi lamakhulu mahlanu, namahhashi lamakhulu lalishumi nasitfupha; wababeka emigwaqweni yemabhasi, naye waya eYerusalem.
Unkhosi wayibeka isiliva negolide eJerusalema njengetitshe, nesedari ibe njengesihlahla sesifonyo esiseGibhithe, ngalenani.
Lamahhashi laSolomoni aphuma e-Egypt ne-Ethiopia; labahwebi bebukhosi babewathenga e-Ethiopia.

Baphuma eMijiphu, bakhipha ema-carriages ngeshekeli lesiliva lamakhulu lamane ngayinye, nemahhashi ngeshekeli lesiliva lamakhulu lamashumi mahlanu ngayinye; nabo babewathengisa kubo bonkhe labankhosi be-Hethi, kanye namakhosi aseAram.
USolomoni wacabanga kutsi uyakwakha indlu ngegama laSimakadze, nendlu yakhe yebukhosi.

Wakhetha amadoda lamashumi lasikhombisa lamakhulu kutsi abambe umthwalo, namadoda lamashumi lamashumi lamakhulu kutsi acwembe emadolobheni, namadoda lamakhulu mathathu lamakhulu lamabili nesihlanu ukuba abe ngabaphathi babo.
USolomoni wathumela kuHurame, ukumkani weTire, watsi: "Sitsa nami izingcezu zesidlondza, njengobe usandisele uDavide, ubaba wami, lapho ayehlala khona.

"Ngiye ngibuyele eJerusalema, ngatsi: 'Namuhla ngifuna ukwakha indlu ngegama laSimakadze Nkulunkulu wami, kutsi ngiyilungiselele kuye, ukuze sifake khona umnqumo wephunga elimnandi phambi kwakhe, nekudla lokusetshenziswe njalo, kanye neminikelo yekushiswa yaso sonke isikhathi, ekuseni nakusihlwa, ngeSabhati, nangemikhosi yenyanga entsha, nangemcimbi waSimakadze Nkulunkulu wethu.'
Lendlu lengingayikwakha kufanele ibe mkhulu, ngobe Nkulunkulu wethu ukhulu kunabo bonkhe labangcwele.
Ngubani na longeke awubambise indlu yakhe, ngobe izulu lephakeme lingeke liwubambe? Ngubani na mina kutsi ngibuyele ekhaya lakhe, ngaphandle kwendlu yekushiswa kwetfufu phambi kwakhe?

Ngakho-ke, sithumelele umuntu owaziyo ukwenza ngegolide, nesiliva, nesiliva, nensimbi, nesikhumba esimnyama, nesingwevu, nesibhakabhaka, nome lowaziyo ukusika ngesandla, kanye nalabo baseYuda nabaseJerusalema labawaziyo, labebalungiselele Davide, umsa wami.

Nami, thumelani nami isihlahla sesedvo, nesihlahla se-almugi, nesihlahla se-albamugi kusuka eLebanoni; ngobe ngiyazi kutsi labakhonjiswe ngukho umsebenti wabo baphindze basebenze nalabakhonjiswe ngukho.
ngobe indlu lengisayikwakha kumele ibe mkhulu, ibe mkhulu kakhulu, ibe mkhulu kakhulu, ibe mkhulu.

Nakho-ke, bona, ngitawubanikela labo basebenti bakho labavuna imihlambi yemihlambi lelishumi nambili yetinkomo, nemashumi lamakhulu lamashumi lamabili egolide, nemashumi lamakhulu mahlanu esiliva, nemashumi lamakhulu lasikhombisa egolide.
Hiramu, inkhosi yaseTyre, waphendula ngencwadi watsi kuSolomoni: "Ngitsi, ngobe Simakadze ayawuthanda bantfu bakhe, yena utawukwenza ube ngunkhosi yabo."

UHirame wathi kanjalo-ke: "Kubhekiwe uSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, lowo wabambisene nezulu nemhlaba, lowo wanikela kunkhosi Davide umntwana onekhono, onengqondo kanye nokuqonda, loyawukwakha indlu yaSimakadze, nendlu yakhe.
Lakho, ngiyakusithumela umfana lowaziyo, onekhono elikhulu lokucabanga; igama lakhe nguHiram-Abi.

Uyise uyisiDani, umkakhe uyisiTyri; yena ufundile ukusebenza ngegolide, nesilivere, nesiliva, nensimbi, nensimbi, nesiliva, negolide, negolide lelibomvu, negolide lelibomvu, negolide lelibomvu, negolide lelibomvu, negolide lelibomvu, negolide lelibomvu, negolide lelibomvu, negolide lelibomvu; naye ufundile ukwenza ngaso sonke sitayelekile, nanoma yini eyenza ngayo isandla sakho, kanye nesandla senkosi yami Davide, umsa wakho.
Lokudla lokushiwo nguSimakadze longuSomandla, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, lokudla lokushiwo nguSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, utsi:
Sitawukususa eLibanoni, siyawukulethela ema-raftings ngelwandle kuze kufike eJopa, bese uyawuyifaka eJerusalema."
USolomoni wababala bonke labaseSirayeli, njengababalibele uDavide, umsa wakhe; kwaba ngumakhulu lamabili nemashumi mahlanu nesihlanu emawaka lamane, namakhulu ayisishiyagalombili.

Wababeka emaphesenti lamashumi sishiyagalombili kutsi babambe impahla, nemakhulu asibhozo lamacwecwe entaba-mlilo; wababeke emaphesenti lasitfupha namakhulu mahlanu ukuba babe ngabaholi bebantfu labasebenza.
USolomoni waqala ukwakha indlu yaSimakadze eJerusalema, enhliziyweni yeMoriya, lapho Simakadze abevele khona kuDavide, ubaba wakhe, esiteji sa-Ornani, umJebusi, lapho Davide abeyilungiselele khona.
Waqala ukwakha ngelilanga lesitsatfu lenyanga yesibili, ngonyaka wesihlanu wekubusa kwakhe.
Lemilinganiselo yendlu yaSimakadze, leSolomoni abembatshulwa ngayo isisekelo sendlu yaNkulunkulu, beyimashumi lamabili nesihlanu ema-inci, nemashumi lamane nemahlanu ema-inci ububanzi.
Nalendlu yangaphambili yethempelini, imamitha lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa ububanzi bayo, kanye nenyawo lelikhulu lokuphakama kwayo; wayibopha ngegolide elifihliwe.
Wabeka phandle kwendlu yenkhosi imibhede yesiliva negolide, wayibopha ngegolide lelihle, wayenza ibe nemhlobiso wesihlahla setiye kanye nemacwecwe.
Wayihlobisa indlu ngetitshe tegolide, negolide lelivela eParvayim, kutsi libe lihle kakhulu.
Wafaka negolide etigcemeni, nasemgwaqeni wemnyango, nasemgwaqweni, nasemgwaqeni wendlu, wabeka ema-kerubi emigwaqweni.
Wakwakha nendlu lengcwelengcwele, ibe likhulu elinamahebhu lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu, lifana nobubanzi bendlu, ibe likhulu elinamahebhu lamakhulu lasitfupha nesihlanu, wayibopha ngegolide elihle.
Isisindo sezinhlamvu zegolide safika kuma-shekeli lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu; wabeka emagumbi aphezulu ngegolide.
Wakwenza ema-kerubheni lamakhulu lamabili emhlabatsini longcwele, wabeka kuwo golide.

Isibhakabhaka sema-kerubi samamitha lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu; isibhakabhaka sesinye sama-kerubi samamitha lamakhulu lasitfupha, safika emnyango wethempelini; nesibhakabhaka sesinye sama-kerubi samamitha lamakhulu lasikhombisa, safike esibhakabhaka sekherubi lesitsatfu.
Isibhakabhaka sekerubi lesitsatfu safika emnyango wethempelini, sibe nemilenze lemine; nesibhakabhaka sakhe sesibili safike esibhakabhaka sekerubi esisodwa, sibe nemilenze lemine.
Lamaphiko lalaba kerubhi afike kumashumi lamabili nesihlanu emacwecwe; laba kerubhi bahlala ngenyawo zabo, bebheke endlu.
Wakwenza ifasitela lelinemibala yegolide, neyesibhakabhaka, neyesiliva, neyesiliva, kanye nelinen lelihlanganisiwe; wayenza ngemakerubi, abhalwe sandla.
Wakha ema-archs lamakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamane emamitha, wabeka ema-archs lamakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamane emitha phambi kwendlu.
Wakwenza izingcezu, wayazibeka phezu kwemikhonto; walungisa nama-granate lamakhulu, wayawafaka emikhontoni.
Wabeka tinhloko phambi kwendlu, yinye ecaleni lesempumalanga, nelinye ecaleni lasenyakatho; wabiza lelisempumalanga ngegama lakhe Jakin, nalolelisentshonalanga ngegama lakhe Boazi.
Wakwenza ne altare yesiliva, lelinemikhono lengema-20, ebanzi ngemikhono lengama-20, kanye nemilenze emikhulu.
Wakhipha netinhlamvu tesiliva letilikhulu, netinkhulungwane letingaba ngumashumi lasitfupha nemahlanu emasentimitha kanye namatilitha lalishumi elinesihlanu lama-decimita.

Ngaseceleni kwalo mnyango, ngaso sonke simo, kwabe khona imisindvo lesasingemagremu lamakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamane, lemihlambi yengulube, ejikelezisa ilwandle. Lemihlambi yengulube yabe ibekwe emabhokisini mabini, ibe yilinye nelwandle.

Lolwandle lwabe luhlala etinkunzi tesiliva lelishumi nembili, letithathu tibheke ngaseNtshonalanga, netitsatfu tibheka emgwaqeni, netisitfupha tibheke emaphandleni, netisikhombisa tibheke eningizimu; lolwandle belubekwe phezu kwato, kanye nemilenze yawo yabeka embindini.

Lolwandle lwaba likhulu kakhulu, lifike kumamitha lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu, lemilenze yayo yabe ifana nemilenze yegobolondo, ibe njengenhlonipho yelili; laliba ngumalitha lamakhulu lasitfupha namane.

Wakwenza nemibhede lelishumi lokuhlamba, wabeka emihlanu ecaleni lasempumalanga, neemihlanu ecaleni lasenyakatho; ngaleyo mibhede kwahlanzwa impahla yeminikelo yekushiswa; kepha ilwandle lalingumnikelo wekuhlamba kuwo labaLevi.
Wakwenza netinhlamvu tegolide letilishumi, ngendlela yato, wazisa ethempelini, tisikhombisa ngasenyakatho, netisikhombisa ngasentshonalanga.
Wakwenza netibopho letilishumi, wazisa ethempelini, lamashumi mahlanu ngasenyakatho, namakhulu mahlanu ngasentshonalanga; wakhipha netibopho tegolide lamakhulu.
Wakha nemphi yalabaphatsimandla, nemphi enkulu yengaphandle, wabeka emasango emphini, wabeka emasango ngesiliva.
Wabeka lelwandle ecaleni lasekudla, ngasenyakatho-ntshonalanga yendlu.
UHiram walungisa netinkomishi, netibondza, netibondza letincane. UHiram wehlise umsebenzi wakhe abewenza kunkhosi Solomone endlwini yaNkulunkulu:
imilenze lemibili; imimese lemibili eyindilinga yemilenze; izingcezu letimbili temihlobiso yenet lokugcoba imimese lemibili yemimese leyindilinga yemilenze;
namatsaba lamakhulu lamane, abekwe emabhokisini lamacala lamibili, emilenze lemibili yematsaba ngalinye, etigcobisa tigodzi letiphezulu temihlobiso yetinhloko;
tinyawo, kanye netibopho letisetinyawo.
kanye nelwandle, naleyo minja lelishumi lelinesihlanu ephansi kwalo;
kanye nemabhodlela, nama-shapes, nama-forks, naletinye tindzawo letiphakeme tekudla. Lamandla lawo wonke ayawukwenza nguHiram-abi kunkhosi Solomoni, endlwini yaSimakadze, ngesiliva lelihlanganisiwe.
UMbuso wase-Asiriya wabeka emabhodlela emhlabatsini ensimini yeJordane, phakathi kweSukhothi neSareda.
USolomoni wakwenza lezinto, ngobe kungeke kube khona lokwenta ubunzima begolide, ngobe kwabe kukhulu kakhulu.
USolomoni walungisa naletinye tindzawo letiphakeme letibekwe ethempelini laNkulunkulu: i-altari yegolide, netibopho tekudla lokusetshenzisiwe,
netinhlamvu tegolide lemhlophe, netinhlamvu tazo, kutsi ticwecwe phambi kwendlu yangaphakathi, njengobe mthetho utsi:
timbali tegolide, netinhlamvu, namatinji, akhiwa ngegolide lelihle;
namatfuba, namatigodzi, nemiti yegolide lehlelekile; namasango ethempelini, kanye nemasango langaphakathi alapho kungcwele kakhulu khona, nawo emasango endlu yasebukhosini abeyigolide.

Waphela lomsebenzi wonke loSolomoni abewenza endlwini yaSimakadze, wabeka kuwo zonke izinto letingcwele labezinikela kubo uDavide, umsa wakhe: isiliva, negolide, naletinye tinhlamvu; wabeka kuwo emakhazeni endlu kaNkulunkulu.

USolomoni wehla eJerusalema, wahlangana nalabakhulu baseSirayeli, nebaholi bonke bemindeni yabo, nabo bonkhe labaphathi bezindlu zabafami baseSirayeli, bafike bakhuphula ibhokisi lesivumelwane saSimakadze emzini kaDavide, lowo nguZiyone.
Bahlangana bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli kunkhosi ngemnyaka wesikhombisa, ngesikhathi sesuku lengcwele.
Bafike bonkhe bantfu labakhulu baseSirayeli, batsi: "Lawa makhulu emadvodzana a-Aroni layawuphuma enkhosini.
Bafike baphakamisa ibhokisi, netenti lekuhlangana, naletinye zinto letingcwele labezikhona kulo; labaLevi labaphaphama nabo.
Unkhosi Solomonu nebantfu labanyenti labaseSirayeli labahlangana naye phambi kwebhokisi, banikela ngenkomo nengulube, kutsi kungeke kube khona lokwenta noma ukubalwa, ngenxa yenani.
Bafike bafaka ibhokisi lesivumelwane saSimakadzembatsweni, belisa emnyango wendlu yaNkulunkulu, endlwini yengcwele kakhulu, belisa ngaphansi kwemilenze yama-kerubi.
Lama-kerubi aphindze afike emhlabatsini lapho ibhokisi lakuboniswa khona, wavala ibhokisi kanye nemikhono yayo.
Lemikhono yalaba likhulu kakhulu kuze kube kungabonakali ekugcineni kwayo kusuka phambi kwegumbi lengaphakathi, kepha hhayi kusuka ngaphandle. Basekhona namanje.

Kubekho lutho ebhokisini, ngaphandle kwetibopho ezimbili zesiliva lelive, labewazibeka kuyo uMosese emfuleni iHoreb, lapho Simakadze abebeke khona umnqophiso nalabaSirayeli, lapho bephuma khona eMijiphu.
Baphuma khona emabhishobhi emhlabatsini, nabo bonkhe lababhishobhi labakhona, bangcwele kakhulu, bangaphi nalabo labengaba nesigaba sabo.

Nabo bonkhe labaLevi, labazangeli: Asafhi, neHeman, neJeduthuni, nabomadvodzana abo kanye nabazalwane babo, babekhona ecaleni lasenyakatho-mpumalanga lethempelini, begqoke iingubo zesiliva negolide, bedlala ngezinhlamvu, nezingcweti, nezingconyana; nabaLevi bamakhulu mahlanu, namashumi lamabili nalinye lamakhosikazi aLevi abephuca tipho.

Nabo bonke labo bephuza intaba-mlilo, nalabo bengoma, bahlangana bobabili ngelizwi elinye, babonga uSimakadze; nabo bonke labaphuza intaba-mlilo, nalabo bephuza intaba-mlilo, nalabo bengoma, baphakamisa amazwi abo, babonga Simakadze, besithi: "Ulungile, ngobe uthando lwakhe luhlala kuze kube sekupheleni."
Bekungaba khona abaLevi labangeke bahlale besebenza, ngenxa yemvula; ngobe kuthula kweSimakadze kwakugcwele indlu kaNkulunkulu.
USolomoni watsi: "Simakadze ukhuluma kutsi uzohlala emhlabatsini lomnyama.
Ngikubuyele ngekwakha indlu lekahle kuwe, indawo lapho uhlala khona kuze kube sekupheleni.
Unkhosi yabuyela emuva, yabambisa lonke libandla leSirayeli, laba bonkhe behlala phansi.
Watsi: "Ungcwele uSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, lokhuluma ngomlomo wakhe kuDavide, umsa wami, wakwenta ngesandla sakhe, watsi:

Kusuka kuleso sikhathi lapho ngakhipha khona abantu bami ema-Egypt, angizange ngikhethe idolobha kuloluhlanga lwesiSirayeli lonke kutsi kube khona indlu lokwakha kuyo igama lami, nome ngikhethe nanoma ngubani ukuba abe ngumholi wabahlali bami baseSirayeli.
Ngiye wakhetha iJerusalema kutsi libekwe khona igama lami, naDavide ukuba abe nguMengameli webantfu bami baka-Israyeli.
UDavide, ubaba wami, wabeka engqondweni yakhe yonke kutsi abe nendlu lokwakha igama laSimakadze Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli.
kodvwa Simakadze watsi kuDavide, ubaba wami: Ube nenhliziyo yakho yonke ekubumbeni indlu ngegama lami; kube kahle kuwe kutsi ube nalomoya wakho wonke ekubuyeni kwakho.
Kube wena awuyikwakha indlu, kodwa unyana wakho lophuma emithini yakho, yena uya kubambisa igama lami.

"Simakadze ugcine amazwi akhe, abekhuluma ngawo; ngobe ngisemile endaweni kaDavide, umsa wami, ngahlala esihlalweni sebukhosi sakwaSirayeli, njengobe Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli washo. Nami sengisungule indlu ngegama laNkulunkulu waseSirayeli.
Nami ngimise khona ibhokisi, lapho likhona khona inhlanganiso yaSimakadze, loyawuyenza nalabaSirayeli.
USolomoni wahlala phambi kwe altare yaSimakadze, ngaso sonke sigungu seSirayeli, wakhipha isandla sakhe.

Solomoni wakhipha isandla sakhe, watsi: "Ngubani na lowo longeke abe ngumnikelo wesono?" ngobe uSolomone wabambisene nenkhosi yase-Egipta. 13Kodvwa Simakadze akazange amvumele kutsi afike eJerusalema; kodvwa waya emgwaqeni waseGibhithe, lapho wayehlala khona.

watsi: "Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, akukho nguNkulunkulu ofana nawe entabeni nasemhlaba; wena logcina inhlanganiso nothando kubo bonkhe labakhonzi bakho labalandela wena ngentliziyo yabo yonke.
Lowugcinele umkhonzi wakho, uDavide, umsa wami, lamazwi akho; ngobe wakhuluma ngomlomo wakho, wawenza ngesandla sakho, njengobe kuboniswe ngalolusuku.

"Nasemanje, Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, ugcine kulowo mkhonzi wakho, uDavide, ubaba wami, lokuye wakhuluma kuye, watsi: 'Kungeke kubekho umfana wakho lohlala phambi kwami ebukhosini bama-Israyeli, uma nje bantfu bakho begcina umthetho wami, bahamba ngawo, njengobe wena ubehamba wona.'
Ngako-ke, Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, liqinisekiswe lilanga lakho, lelitselelwe umkhonzi wakho Davide.
Ngabe unguNkulunkulu lohlala emhlabatsini nasemhlabeni? Lasezulu, kanye nezulu lelikhulu lasemazulu, angeke likwazi kukusekela; kuphi nalesindlu sengiyile?
Nasekungeke ulalele umthandazo womkhonzi wakho, nesipho sakhe, Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wami, ulalele umsindo kanye nomthandazo lomkhonzi wakho ewuthandaza kuwe.
Hamba ubheke lendlu ngasebusuku nasentwasahlobo, lapho watsi khona kutsi utawubeka khona igama lakho, ukuze ulalele luthandazo lomkhonzi wakho lokhuluma kulona.
Hlala ulalele imithandazo yomkhonzi wakho, nalabo bantu bakho baseSirayeli, lapho bethandaza kuleyo ndawo; lalela kusuka emazulu, emhlabatsini lokuhlala kwakho, lalela, uvumele.
Uma umuntu ephikisane nenkosi yakhe, bese kwenza kutsi aphike, aze afike aphike phambi kwendlu yakho yasebukhosini,
bese ukhuluma emazulu, uyeke ukwenze, ube ngummeli phakathi kwabakhonzi bakho, unciphise lowo muntfu lobi, uvumele lowo ongenacala aphume emthethweni, ube ngumnikelo wesono.
Nakuba bantfu bakho, iSirayeli, bahlaselwa ngumfowabo ngenxa yesono sabo sakho, bese bebuyela kuwe, bekhuluma ngegama lakho, bethandaza, becela usizo phambi kwakho kulo ndlu,
wena, lalela emazulu, ukhulule isono sema-Israyeli, bantfu bakho, bese ubabuyisele kuleyo nyika labewuyawubanikela ngayo kubo nabababo.
Uma lizulu licutshungulwa, kungabi nemvula, ngobe babusise kuwe; bese bethandaza kuleyo ndawo, bebonga igama lakho, bebuyela emlonyeni wabo, ngobe utawubaphazamisa;

bese ukhuluma esibhakabhakeni, uyeke umonakalo wabakhonzi bakho nalabo bantu bakho baseSirayeli, ubafundise indlela ekahle yokuyihamba; futhi unciphise imvula phezu kwemhlaba wakho, lowawuwunikela kubo bonkhe bantfu bakho ukuba babe yitfu.

Uma kwenzeka ndlala emhlabatsini, noma umkhuhlane, noma ukulimala kwemfuyo ngemvula lemnyama, noma ngumlilo, noma tingulube, noma tingulube letincane, noma uma lomfowabo ehlasela noma yimuphi wemadolobha abo; noma ngabe yini inhlekelele noma isifo sifika,
nanoma yimuphi umuntu, noma bantfu bakho bonkhe base-Isirayeli, bathandaza, becela kuwe, ngaso sonke isikhathi lapho bebona khona buhlungu babo, bese befaka isandla sabo kulendlu,
bese ukhuluma emazulu, lapho uhlala khona, uyeke, unciphise, uncede wonke umuntu ngendlela yakhe yonke, wena lowaziyo umphefumulo wakhe; ngobe wena kuphela lowaziyo imiphefumulo yalabo bantu.
ngobe batawukulalela, bahambe ngendlela yakho yonke lemihla labaphila ngayo phezu kwemhlaba labewanikela ngawo lababa bethu.

Ngako-ke nalowo mkhwenyana, longeke abe nguye kubo bonkhe bantfu bakaSirayeli, uma efika emhlabatsini lokude ngenxa yegama lakho elikhulu, nesandla sakho esinamandla, nemilenze yakho leyimisiwe, afike athandaza enhliziyweni yalendlu,

khuluma ngasezulu, emgwaqeni wakho, ukwenze konke lokunye lokuya kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, kutsi wonke lamakhosi emhlaba akwazi igama lakho, abe nekuthula nawe, njengebantfu bakho baseSirayeli; nabo babone ukuthi igama lakho litsiwe kulendlu lengiyenzile.
Uma abantu bakho bephuma bahlasela lomholi wabo, ngendlela loyawubathumela ngayo, bese bethandaza kuSimakadze, bebheke ledolobha leliwunelile, nendlu leyo ngiyibulale igama lakho,
bese ulalela emazulu thandaza kwabo nekufuna kwabo, utawubalekelela.

Nakuba babusise kuwe, ngobe angeke kube khona umuntu longenabubi, wena ufike ubulawe nabo, wabanikela esihlalweni semshadweni wabo, kutsi labo lababoshwa babovalelwe ezweni, libe lide noma libe likhulu;
bese babuyela emphefumulweni wabo ezweni labo lababoshwa kulo, bebuya becela kuwe khona, besithi: Siphelelwe licala, sesivumile, sesivelile;

bese bebuyela kuwe ngentliziyo yabo yonke nemoya yabo yonke, ezweni labo lababoshwa kulo, bese bethandaza bebheke lelizwe lakho labewanikela ngaso kubafazi babo, naleso dolobha labewukhethele lona, naleyo indlu ngiyibulalele igama lakho,
bese ukhuluma emazulu, emgwaqeni wakho lokuhlala, umthandazo wabo kanye netibopho babo, utawubalungisa, utawubakhulula abantu bakho labakhelele wena.
Manje-ke, Nkulunkulu wami, amehlo akho abe avulekile, nendlebe zakho zibe nemsindo, uma kusengatsalwa khona umnikelo wesono.

Namuhla, phumula, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, ufike endaweni yakho yokuphumula, wena kanye nebhokisi lemandla akho. UNkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, labangcwele bakho bagqoke lokusindisa, babe nenhlanhla kukuhle kwakho.
Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, ungavumi ukumkani wakho lophakiwe; khumbula inhlonipho yakho umkhonzi wakho Davide.
Kwatsi lapho uSolomoni ephelele khona lokuthandaza, mlilo wehla kusuka esibhakabhakeni, wadla imnikelo wekushiswa kanye neminikelo yekushiswa; nenkundla yaSimakadze yagcwalisa indlu.
Baphatsimandla bangeke bakwazi kungena ethempelini laSimakadze, ngobe lizulu lenkhosi lalibangisile.

Batsi bonke bantfu baseSirayeli, lapho bebona umlilo uphuma khona, kanye nenkundla yaSimakadze ibekwe phezu kwendlu, babuyela emuva ngebuso babo esiteji, bathandaza, babonga Simakadze, batsi: "UNkulunkulu ulungile, ngobe uthando lwakhe luhlala kuze kube sekupheleni."
Unkhosi nebantfu bonkhe banikela ngeminikelo yekushiswa phambi kwaSimakadze.

UMbuso waseSolomoni wanikela ngenkomo emawaka lamashumi lamabili nambili, nengulube emawaka lamakhulu mahlanu namakhulu lalishumi; ngobe ubukhosi kanye nabo bonkhe bantfu banikela ngendlu yaNkulunkulu.

BaLevi bahlala emsebentini wabo, kanye nalabaLevi nabo bahlala ngemihlobiso yaSimakadze, labeyawuyenza ukumkani uDavide, kutsi abembisana noNkulunkulu, lapho uDavide ekhuluma ngalemihlobiso yabo, watsi: "Lothando lwakhe luyahlala kuze kube sekupheleni."

USolomoni wanikela khona ngenhla kwendlu yaSimakadze, engxenyeni yesiphakathi sesitezi; ngobe lapho anikela khona ngeminikelo yekushiswa neminye yemihlambi yemihlambi yesive, ngoba i-altari yesiliva leyawuyikhipha yayincane kakhulu kutsi ibambe mnikelo wekushiswa, nemnikelo wesono, naleyo mihlambi.

Baye bahlela umnikelo wekushiswa ngelilanga lesitsatfu, nabo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli kanye naye, ibandla elikhulu kakhulu, labasuka lapho befika khona eHamati enyakatho kuya emfuleni weMisri entshonalanga.
Ngelilanga lesishiyagalolunye balungiselela kuhlangana lokukhulu, bahlela kutsi kube nesuku lesikhombisa lokufaka isandla kumnikelo wesono, naleso sithende sakusihlwa sezinsuku lesitsatfu.

Ngomhla wesishiyagalolunye wenyanga yesithupha, ngemnyaka wamashumi lamakhulu mahlanu nesikhombisa, uSolomoni wabasusa abantu besuka emindenini yabo, bejabuliseka kakhulu, benekuthula emphefumulweni wabo, ngenxa yalokho lokubi loNkulunkulu abekwenza kuDavide naSolomoni, naseSirayeli, bantfu bakhe.
USolomoni wehlule indlu yaSimakadze, nendlu yenkhosi; nome yini leyabe ikhona engqondweni yakhe, uSolomoni wayenza ngempumelelo ekhaya laSimakadze nendlu yakhe.
USimakadze wehla wabonakala kuSolomoni ngebusuku, watsi kuye: "Ngikuphendulile umthandazo wakho, ngikhethe lendawo ibe yindlu yami yokunikela khona.
Uma ngivula izulu, kutsi kungeke kube nemvula, noma uma ngitsi tingulube tidla mhlaba, noma uma ngithumela umkhuhlane kubo bonkhe bantfu bami,

baphikisane nabo bonkhe bantfu bami, labashiwo ngegama lami, bethandaza, bengifuna, bebuyela ekuphileni kwabo lokubi; khona-ke ngitawuva kusuka esibhakabhakeni, nekumkhulula emlonyeni wabo, nekuyiphilisa ilizwe labo.
Lamehlo ami atawube evulekile, nendlebe yami iyawulalela lomnikelo wekushiswa lapho.
"Nase ngikhethe lendlu, ngayingcwele, kutsi lihlale khona igama lami kuze kube sekupheleni; nemehlo ami kanye nemphefumulo wami kumele babe khona njalo.
Ngako-ke wena, uma uhamba ngimi, njengobe wahamba Davide, umsa wakho, ukwenta konkhe longangikuletsako, ugcine imiyalo yami nemtsetfo wami,
ngobe ngitsi kuDavide, ubaba wakho: 'Kungeke kubekho muntfu loyawuhlala enkhosini yaseSirayeli, kuze kube sekuphele iminyaka lelishumi.'
Kodwa-ke, uma nibuyela emuva, nishiya imiyalo yami nemtsetfo wami lowawuse phambi kwenu, niya kubambisana nalabo bonkulunkulu babanye, nibabulale,

ngobe ngitawucindza bantfu bakaSirayeli emhlabatsini lami, labengingawanikela kubo; nendlu lenjalo, lapho ngiyingcwelele khona igama lami, ngiyawuyishiya, ngiyawuyenza ibe ngumnikelo wekushiswa kanye nenkundla yekutsisa emazweni lawo wonke.
Lendlu, leyingcwele kakhulu namuhla, nanoma ngubani lodlula kuyo, ungeke akhululeke, kodvwa utawutsi: 'Ngubani na lowo Nkulunkulu labewenza njalo kulelizwe nalendlu?'

Batawuphendula bati, 'Ngitsi, ngobe bashiya uSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wabotata babo, lowo wabakhipha ezweni la-Ejipta, batsi: Sibophele kulabo bonkulunkulu babanye, sibabambisene nabo, sibasebenzele; ngakho wabeka phezu kwabo lonke lolubi.'
USolomoni wahlala iminyaka lemashumi lamane ekwakha indlu yaSimakadze nendlu yakhe.
USolomoni wakwakha kabusha lemijikelo leHurame abeyawuyinikela kuye, wababeka khona laSirayeli.
Solomone waya eHamati-Zoba, wayawuyihlasela.
Wakwakha naTadmori emasikweni, naletinye tinhloko-dolobha tetintfo letigcinwako, wazenza emaHamati.
Wakwakha kabusha iBeth-horon ephakeme neBeth-horon ephansi, imijiko leqinile, ngetingetelo, nezingcingo, nemingcele.

Wakwakha naBahalathi, nemadolobha layo onke ekugcina impahla, nemadolobha lawo emakhandlela, nemadolobha lawo lamahhashi; nalapho afuna khona wahlala khona eJerusalema, naseLebanoni, nangemhlaba wonke webukhosi bakhe.
Bakhona labashiywe, labaseHeti, nalabaseAmori, nalabasePerizi, nalabaseHivi, nalabaseJebusi, lababengabaSirayeli.
Laba bakubo labaSirayeli, labo abengabahlukumeza ezweni leli, labeSolomoni wababeka kutsi babe ngumkhonzi wakhe, kuze kube ngalolusuku.
LaseSirayeli ke, uSolomoni akazange amnikeze umsebenzi wakhe; babengabe ngubaholi bakhe bekulwa, nabahlengikazi bakhe, nabahlengikazi bemikhumbi yakhe, nabahlengikazi bokudla kwakhe.
Bakhona nalabaphathi bebukhosi baSolomoni, labamakhulu mahlanu nemashumi lamane, labalawula bantfu.

USolomoni waphakamisa intombi kaFaro kusuka eMzini wakwaDavide waya endlu yakhe, leyo ayeyikwakha kuye; ngobe watsi: "Kungeke kube khona indodana yami ihlala endlwini yaDavide, ukumkani waseSirayeli, ngoba lendawo lapho ibhokisi laSimakadze libekwe khona iyingcwele.
Kuleso sikhathi uSolomoni wanikela ngeminikelo yekushiswa kuSimakadze, phezu kwe altare yaSimakadze, leyo ayawuyenza phambi kwendlu.

Wakwenza njalo lilanga nelilanga, njengobe Mosesi abewutjela, ngezinsuku teSabhati, nemihla yenyanga entsha, nemithendeleko lemikhulu lemithathu: iMikhosi Yekudla Esingachumisi, neMithendeleko Lemisonto, neMithendeleko Yezindlu.

Wabeka, njengobe uDavide, umsa wakhe, abewumiselele, imindeni yalabaLevi emisebenzini yabo, nalabaLevi emisebenzini yabo, kutsi bashumayele, nekubambisana nalabaLevi, njengoba kwadingeka ngosuku ngalunye; wabeka nabo labagwebi, ngemindeni yabo, emnyango ngamunye; ngobe kwaba njalo lomthetho wakwaDavide, indodana kaNkulunkulu.
Bebengasuka kunoma yini lenkhosi yabawisela yona labapristi neLevi, kanye nalabo ababekwe ngaphansi kwempahla.
Ngaleyo ndlela yaqedwa yonke imisebenzi kaSolomoni, kusukela kuleso sikhathi lapho kwabekwa khona isisekelo sendlu yaSimakadze, kuze kube sekuphele; nendlu yaSimakadze yaphele.
Ngako-ke uSolomoni waya eEzion-Geberi, neElathi, ensimini yeEdomu.

UHirame wathumela kuye izinqanawa, nabangani bakhe labahamba ngelwandle; bahamba nebangani bakaSolomoni befika e-Ofiri, baphuma nabo benegolide lamatoni lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu, bamnika uMbuso waseSolomoni.

Waye eJerusalema, ekhuluma naSolomoni ngemibuzo leyinzima; wafika naye umkhwenyana wase-Sheba, abe nemindeni emikhulu kakhulu, nangetingulube letinesiphuzo, negolide, nesiliva, negolide, nesiliva, negolide, negolide, negolide, negolide, negolide, negolide, negolide, negolide, negolide, negolide, negolide, negolide, negolide, negolide.
uSolomoni wakhuluma ngayo yonke lemibuzo yakhe; akukho lutho lwaletingconywa nguSolomoni, lakazange alicacise.
Wabona unkhosi yase-Sheba yonke ingcweti kaSolomoni, nendlu yakhe leyawuyisa.

Wabona nekudla kwakhe emehlweni akhe, nalapho abaphathi bakhe behlala khona, nalapho labakhonzi bakhe besebenza khona, nalapho bagqoka khona, nalapho abebaphazamisi bakhe begqoka khona, nalapho anikela khona ngenhlanhla yakhe endlwini yaSimakadze; walahlekelwa ngumoya wakhe.
Waye watsi kunkhosi: "Kube kuyiqiniso lokudlalelwa ezweni lami ngezinto zakho kanye nekhono lakho.
Ngingeke ngikholwa la mazwi, kuze kube ngifike ngakubona ngemehlo ami; ngobe naphezu kwengxenye yemandla akho nekhono lakho, asikucacelanga; ukhulu kunalelo livi labengingalikhuluma.
Kuhle kakhulu abantu bakho, nebaholi bakho, labahlala bekhona phambi kwakho njalo, balalela ubuhlakani bakho!

Hamba ubulelele Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, lowo wesaba nawe, wakubeka wena esihlalweni sakhe sebukhosi kutsi ube ngunkhosi kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho; ngobe Nkulunkulu wakho ayawuthanda bantfu beSirayeli, abefuna kutsi bahlale beqinile kuze kube sekupheleni, wakwenza wena ukumkani wabo, ukuba wenze lomthetho nelokuhle.

Waye wanikela kunkhosi ngegolide lelikhulu nemashumi lamane emilenze, nemithi lemisiwe emikhulu kakhulu, nesiliva nemloti; akazange afike nalinye liphunga lelifana naloleyo inkhosi yase-Sheba yayawunikela kunkhosi Solomoni.
Nabo bantfu bakaHirami, nalabo bantfu bakaSolomoni, labasuka e-Ofiri batfumisa negolide, batfumisa nesihlahla se-almugibe, nesiliva negolide.
Ngetihlahla te-almugibe, uMbuso WaseRoma wakhipha tinyawo tendlu yaSimakadze, nendlu yobukhosi, kanye nezinhlamvu namatilasi lalabo labadlala; asikuzange kubonekale njalo eYuda.

UMbuso WaseSolomoni wanikela kunkosikazi yakhe yaseSheba yonke into leyayifuna, leyo yayicelayo, ngaphandle kwaleyo yayawunikela kuyo Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli. Waye waya ezweni lakhe yena nabangane bakhe.
Kusuka kuSolomoni kwafika lilanga ngalinye igolide lelikhulu nemashumi lamane nesihlanu ematoni.
ngaphandle kwegolide nesilivere lesiphuma kulabo labahamba ngempahla kanye nalabapheki; nabo bonkhe bantfu base-Arabha, nebaholi belizwe, babenikela ngegolide nesilivere kuSolomoni.
UMbuso WaseSolomoni wabakhipha emakhibhodi lamakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamane egolide, wasebenzisa ema-shekeli lalishumi nesihlanu egolide kuwo onkhe emakhibhodi.
Wakha netibhakabhaka letincane lamakhulu mathathu, wasebenzisa esiliva lelikhulu elinamashumi lamabili nesihlanu ema-denaries kusinye sibhakabhaka; ukumkani wawabeka endlini yesihlahla seLibanoni.
UMbuso WaseRoma wakhipha isikhundla lesikhulu segolide, wehlambisa ngegolide elihle.
Lesikhulu sakhona sinemilenze lemine, nesihlalo segolide lesibekwe ngaphansi kwayo; kwabe khona tinyawo ngalelinye icala nelinye lesikhundla, nalelinyoni liseceleni kwalo.
Kwabe khona tingulube letilishumi nembilithonikondza, tahlala emadolobheni lamane, ngaso sonke siphenyane sendlela.
Nabo bonke labapheki baSimakadze babeyigolide, nalabapheki bendlu yesihlahla seLibanoni babeyigolide elingenalutho; isiliva nesilivere akufanele kubhekwe njengelincane ngelilanga leSolomoni.
Unkhosi yabe inemindeni yemanti eTarshishi nemadvodzana aHirami; eminyakeni emithathu ngayinye yafika lemindeni yemanti, ibe negolide, nesiliva, nengalo yegolide, namahhashi, nalabomakhoboka.
UMbuso WaseSolomoni waba mkhulu kunabo bonke bobukhosi bemhlaba, ngemali nebwenge.
Lomhlaba wonke wawufuna ukubuka imehlo kaSolomoni, kutsi alalele ubucwebe bakhe, loNkulunkulu abewubeka emphefumulweni wakhe.
Bafike banikela ngezinto tesiliva, negolide, nemfuyo, nemikhosi, nemakhandlela, nemahhashi, namamuleti, iminyaka ngayinye.
USolomoni wayenemahhashi lamakhulu mane, nemilenze lemikhulu, nemiyalelo lemikhulu lelishumi linamihlanu; wababeka emizini yemiyalelo, nakwenkhosi eYerusalem.
Waba ngunkhosi yabo bonkhe bantfu, kusukela emfuleni i-Euphrates kuya ezweni laFilisti, kuze kufike emgwaqeni weMisri.
Unkhosi wayibeka isiliva negolide eJerusalema njengetitshe, nesedra ibe njengetihlahla tesifonyo letihlala emahlathini aphansi, ngalenani.
Kusuka e-Egypt kwafakwa emakhosi aSolomoni, kanye nasetindzaweni tonkhe.

Lokunye lokushiwo nguSolomoni, kusukela ekuqalekeni kuye ekupheleni kwakhe, akushoni kutsi kubhalwe emibhalweni kaNathani umprofeti, nasenhlalweni ka-Ahiya waseShilo, nasenhlalweni ka-Iddo lokubonayo mayelana naYerobhoamu unyana waNebati?
USolomoni waba ngunkhosi eJerusalema, kuwo wonke laSirayeli, iminyaka lemashumi mane.
USolomoni wehla embhedeni wakhe, washiswa, wabanjwa emzini kaDavide, ubaba wakhe; Rehabeam, umsa wakhe, waba ngubukhosi bakhe.
Roboame waya eShechem, ngobe bonkhe bantfu beSirayeli babefike eShechem kutsi baphindze bamuvumele abe ngunkhosi.
Bekutsi Jeroboamu, umsa waNebati, akubona lokhu, wababuyela eMisri, lapho abesuka khona kutsi agweme ukumkani uSolomoni.
Labantfu bathumela batsi: "Vuma ufike!" Wafika khona Jeroboame kanye nabo bonkhe bantfu beSirayeli, bakhuluma kuRehoboam, batsi:

ubaba wakho watsi kuye: "Ubaba wakho usisebenzele kahle kakhulu, wabeka umthwalo omkhulu emilenzeni yethu; kepha namuhla, sifafaze umsebenzi lonzima lowawusetshenzisiwe ngubaba wakho kanye nesibopho sakhe esibuhlungu, sitawukukhonza."
Wabaphendvula watsi: "Thumelani kuye ngemuva kwelilanga lesithathu." Labantfu basuka.
UMbuso WaseRhobhohamu wakhuluma nalabakhulu, lababe bakhona phambi kwaSolomoni, ubaba wakhe, lapho ephila khona, watsi: "Nini ninicebisa kutsi ngiphendule yini kulabo bantu?"
Bakhuluma kuye batsi: "Uma uyawuba ngumkhonzi kulabo bantu, ubayamukela, ukhuluma nabo amazwi alungile, bangabe bakhonzi bakho kuze kube sekupheleni."
Kodvwa yena washiya indzaba yebantfu labakhulu abemnike yona, wakhuluma nabangani bakhe labakhulele naye, labebasebenza naye.
Wabaphendvula watsi: "Nitsini kutsi siphendule yini kulabo bantu labakhuluma nami, besithi: 'Nciphisa lesibopho labesinikelwe ngubaba wakho?'"

Baphendvula batsi: "Kulabo bantu labakhuluma nawe, besithi: 'Ubaba wakho ubeke icala lethu linzima, kepha wena siwukhulule.' Uyawukhuluma nabo ngokuthi: 'Isandla sami esincane sibushelelezi kunemisipha yababa wami.
Ubaba wami wakwenta kube nzima impahla yenu, kepha mina ngiyawuyenza ibe buhlungu; ubaba wami wakwenta kube nzima impahla yenu, kepha mina ngiyawukwenza ibe buhlungu.
Yafika ke Jeroboame nebantfu bonkhe ku-Rehoboam ngelilanga lesithathu, njengobe ukumkani abesho, watsi: "Buyele kumnge ngelilanga lesithathu."
Unkhosi yabaphendulela impendulo ebuhlungu, watsi: "UMbuso waseRehoboamu awuzange ucabangele inhlolovo yalabakhulu,
wakhuluma nabo, watsi: "Ubaba wami ubeke umthwalo wenu ebuhlungu, kepha mina ngiyawuwubeka mkhulu; ubaba wami wakutsila nisebunzini, kodwa mina ngiyakusitsalisa ngetingulube."
Unkhosi akazange ayivumeli imvumi; ngobe lokhu kwabe kuyinto yaNkulunkulu, kutsi uSimakadze agcwaliseke lizwi lakhe, lelishowe nguAhiya waseShilo kuYerobohabhi, umsa waNebati.

Batsi bonke bantfu baseSirayeli bebona kutsi ukumkani akazange abonise, baphendvula batsi: "Sineliphi ilungelo eDavideni? Singeke sibenelicala kuyise we-Isayi! Yiya kuwo wonke lamakhosikazi aseSirayeli; Davide, hlala ekhaya lakho."
