NalabaSirayeli labahlala emadolobhani aseYuda, Roboame waba ngunkhosi yabo.

UMbuso waseRhobhohamani wathumela uHadoram, umphathi webantfu labasebentisa ema-Amori; kodvwa bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli bamshaya ngetinhlamvu kuze aphele. UMbuso waseRhobhohamani wehlisa imoto yakhe waya eYerusalem.
Ngako-ke iSirayeli yaphuma emndenini waDavide, kuze kube namuhla.

Wafika eJerusalema, wahlangana nabo bonkhe bantfu base Yuda naBenjamini, lamakhulu lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa lamakhulu, labakhethiwe kutsi bahlangane naSirayeli, kutsi babuyisele ubukhosi kubo Roboame.
Kuye kwafika lomunye umlayezo waSimakadze kuShemaya, indoda yaNkulunkulu, watsi:
"Ukhulume naRehoboamu, umsa waSolomoni, ukumkani waseYuda, kanye nabo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli eJudha naBenjamini, utsi:
Simakadze utsi: "Mna-ke ningayeki, ningabi nemphi nabazalwane benu; buyelani niya endlwini yenu, ngobe ngiyawukwenza lokhu." Balandzela amazwi kaSimakadze, bangayeki bahlasela uYerobohabhi.
Roboame wahlala eJerusalema, wakwakha emabhishi enkhosini yaseYuda.
Wakwakha Bethlehemu, neEtam, neTekoa,
Beth-sur, neSoko, neAdulam,
neGati, neMaresha, neZipho,
Adorami, neLakishi, neAzeka,
iSora, ne-Ayaloni, neHebroni; lamadolobha lawa akhiwa ngetindlu, eJuda naBenjamini.
Wayiqinisa lemikhumbi, wabeka kuwo labaholi, nekudla, nemafutha, newayini, kutsi kube khona.
Wabeka emabhubesi nemikhumbi emifuleni leminyenti, wayenza ibe namandla kakhulu; kodvwa Yuda naBenjamini bebengabe bakhona.
Baprista neLevi labasuka kuwo onkhe emadolobha ase-Isirayeli, bafike behlala naye.
LaLevi bashiya imifula yabo kanye nempahla yabo, bekimi eYuda naseJerusalema; ngobe uYerobohabhi namadvodzana akhe akazange abonise ukuba basebenze kuSimakadze njengenkhosi.
UYerobohabhi wabeka labangcwele bakhe emadolobheni, kanye netibondza letive labewakhayo.

Baye balandela labaLevi, befika eJerusalema, kusuka kuwo wonke lamadolobha aseSirayeli, labo ababeka umphefumulo wabo ekufuneni uSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, kutsi banikela ngenhlanhla kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wababa babo.
Baye baqinisa uMbuso waseYuda, basebentisa Roboame, umsa kaSolomoni, iminyaka lemithathu; ngobe babehamba ngendlela yaDavide naSolomoni iminyaka lemithathu.
Roboame washada neMahalathi, indodana kaJerimothi, umsa waDavide, nenkosikazi kaAbihayili, indodana kaEliabu, umsa waJesi.
Waba nawo lamadvodzana: Jeusi, neShemariya, naZahamu.
Emva kwayo washada neMahaka, intombi ka-Absalomu; yena wamzala uAbiya, naAtayi, naZiza, naShelomiti.

URehoboha wathandana naMahaka, intombi ka-Absalomu, kakhulu kunabo bonke labesifazane bakhe netibondza lakhe; ngobe abebenemakhosikazi lalishumi linamihlanu netibondza lamashumi lamane; waba nemadvodzana amakhulu mahlanu namadvodzakati amakhulu mane.
Roboame wamisa uAbiya, umsa kaMahaka, abe ngumholi phakathi kwabazalwane bakhe; ngobe wayecabanga kutsi uyakwenza abe ngunkhosi.
Wahamba ngemandla akhe, wabeka bonkhe bantfu baseJuda naBenjamini emadolobheni abo lasemgwaqeni; wabanikela ngenkemba nekudla kanye nabo, wayabathola amadoda amaningi.
Nalapho ubukhosi be-Rhobhoyamu bebuqinile, nalapho enamandla kakhulu, wabuyela emuva emthethweni kaSimakadze; nabo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli bakwenza njalo.
Ngomnyaka wesihlanu wekubusa kwenkhosi Roboame, wafika Shishaki, ukumkani waseMisri, waya eJerusalema; ngobe bebengabi nekuthula kuSimakadze.

Wafika namakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamane ema-arabu, namadoda angaba ngumashumi lamane lamakhulu; wafika naye eMijiphu, abe nebantfu labakhulu kakhulu, abengaba khona lokwenta inombolo yabo: baLibiya, neSukhi, neKushi.
Wahlasela emabhishi a Juda, wafika waya eJerusalema.
UShemaya umprofeti waya ku-Rehoboham nebaholi beYuda, labaseJerusalema bahlangane ngenxa ya-Shishaki, watsi kubo: "Simakadze utsi: 'Nimi ningishiye, ngobe nami nginishiye ngesandla sa-Shishaki.' "
Lamadvodza aseSirayeli, kanye nenkhosi, baphazanyiswa, batsi: "Simakadze ulungile."

Wayebona uSimakadze ukuthi bahluphekile, wafika umlayezo wakhe kuShemaya, watsi: "Bahluphekile; ngingababhubhisi; ngitawubasindisa ngaleso sikhashana, ngobe sengingeke nginciphise inhlonipho yami phezu kweJerusalema ngesandla saShishaki.
Bayawuba ngalabakhonzi bakhe, kutsi bafunde kutsi yini inhlanganiso phakathi kwekungisebentisa nami kanye nekusebentisa lamakhosi emanye amazwe.

Wafika eJerusalema uShishaki, ukumkani waseMisri, wakhipha impahla yendlu kaSimakadze, nempahla yendlu yesikhashana senkhosi; wakhipha njalo-ke, wakhipha nalesibhakabhaka segolide lesiSolomoni abesenzela.
Nakho unkhosi Roboame wayikhipha igolide, wayenza imikhumbi yesiliva kanye negolide, wayazinikela kubo bonkhe bantfu labahlala emnyango wendlu yaSimakadze.
Nalapho ukumkani ephuma khona endlwini yaSimakadze, befika nabo labakhonjiwe, bathabathela imilenze yabo, batsi: "Thina-ke siyawuyifaka kulendlu yabakhonjiwe."
Ngako-ke, ngobe uRehoboamu akazange akhululeke, wabuyela kuye umsindo waSimakadze, watsi: "Angeke ahlupheke nhlobo." Kubekho nakunye okuhle eYuda.

UMbuso waseRhobhohamu waba neminyaka lemashumi lamane nalinye ubudala lapho eqala ukumkani, wahlala iminyaka lengema-17 eJerusalema, emzini loNkulunkulu abewukhethela kuwo wonke amazwe aseSirayeli kutsi abeke khona igama lakhe. Umzali wakhe wayenguNaama weAmmonu.
Wakwenza lokubi, ngobe akazange abeke umphefumulo wakhe ekufuneni Simakadze.
Nabo bonkhe bantfu labayawukwenza Roboame, kusukela bokuqala kuya baphesheya, bangase babhalwe kanjani encwadini yaShemaya umprofeti, nencwadi ya-Iddo lokubonayo, encwadini yemindeni?
Robohamu waphumula, washonelwa enhlokodolobha yaDavide; uAbiya, umsa wakhe, waba ngubukhosi bakhe.
Ngomnyaka wamashumi lalishumi elinesibhozo wenkhosi Yarobhoamu, uAbiya waba ngubukhosi baseYuda.
Wahlala iminyaka lemibili eJerusalema, wadzala iminyaka lemithathu. Umzali wakhe waba nguMikaya, intombi ka-Uriyeli waseGibeha; kwaba nekulwa phakathi kwaAbiya naYerobohama.
UAbiya waphuma emphini namaphoyisa lamakhulu lamane lamawaka, abaholi bokulwa abakhethiwe; uYerobohabhi wehla emphini yakhe namaphoyisa lamakhulu asibhozo lamawaka, abaholi bokulwa abakhethiwe.
Abiya wahlala phezu komfula iZemarayimi, emhlabatsini waseEfraim, watsi: "Ningilalele, uYerobohabhi kanye nabo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli!
Awazi yini kutsi uSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, wanikela kuDavide ukumkani kwa-Israyeli kuze kube sekupheleni, kuye naye nabana bakhe, ngesivumelwano esingeke sibusiwe, nesivumelwano segolide?
Ngako-ke Jeroboamu, umsa waNebati, umkhonzi waSolomoni, unyana kaDavide, wehla, waba nebugebengu labanina bakhe.
Bahlangana naye lababi, nalababi kakhulu, bahlasela Roboami unyana waSolomoni; kodvwa Roboami ubencane, waba nebuhlungu, akazange abonise kubo.
Namuhla-ke nifuna ukulwa nebukhosi beSimakadze, obusesandlani samadvodzakati kaDavide; ningabantu abaningi kakhulu, nakhona nani nenkunzi yegolide, leyo Jeroboamu ayenze ibe ngumoya wenu.

"Ube ungeke yini ube nguSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli neNkulunkulu waseYiputa, bese ukhuluma kubo: 'Ngubani na loyawuphuma enkhosini yami?' 21Nakho ngitsi kulowo lafika ngendodana yengulube kanye nemfuyo leyisishiyagalombili ukuze alungiselele isandla sakhe, abe ngumLevi;
Natsi natsi, Simakadze uNkulunkulu wethu, asikushiyeli; kanye nabo bonkhe bantfu labangcwele, labasebenza kuSimakadze, bamakhosikazi la-Aron, nalabaLevi, labasebenza nabo.

Baye banikela ngemnikelo wesono, nefushane lelifudumele kuSimakadze ngaso sonke sikhatsi sakusihlwa nasenhliziyweni; nabo bangabeka ema-oveni ekudla lokusetshenzisiwe phezu kwetafula lesingenhla, kanye nemgodzi yegolide nenhlamvu yayo, kutsi ikhanya ngalosonke isikhathi sokusihlwa.

Bonani, Nkulunkulu ukhona nathi, ehamba phambili yethu; nalabangcwele bakhe balapha nabo benesibhakabhaka sokulwa nenu. Lamadodana aseSirayeli, ningadlaleni noNkulunkulu wababuphikisi benu, ngobe angeke niphumelele.

Yarobhoamu wathumela labaphikisayo emphilweni yebantfu base-Israyeli, wababeka ngasemphumalanga yenkhosi yaseYuda; ngobe itfu lelikhulu labe libhekene nenkhosi yaseJuda, nalabaphikisayo bebengasemphumalanga yabo.
Lamadoda eYuda abhekene nabo, labona kutsi bahlaselwa ngaphambili nasemva kwabo; watsila kuSimakadze, kodvwa labaLevi baphuca tindlebe.
Lamadoda eYuda aphuma emphilweni; ngobe lapho aphuma emphilweni, Simakadze wabulala uYerobohabhi nalabaSirayeli bonke phambi kwaAbiya nemadvodzana akhe.
Lamadvodza ase-Isirayeli asuka eYuda, ngobe Simakadze abewanikela kubo.
Abiya nebantfu bakhe babulala labanyenti kakhulu kubo; kwaba ngumashumi lamane lamakhulu lasitfupha ema-Israyeli akhethekayo, abefa.
Ngako-ke labaSirayeli bahlaselwa ngaleso sikhathi, kodvwa lamadodana eYuda akazange ahlupheke, ngobe abehlala enhliziyweni yaSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli.
Na-Abiya wehlisa uYerobohamu, wakhipha emabhishi akhe, aBetheleli, neJeshana, naEfroni, kanye nemadolobha abo.
Akazange aphinde abe nemandla kuYerobohabhi, kuze kube sekuphele iminyaka yekuphila kwaAbiya; ngobe Nkulunkulu wambulala, wafa.
Abiya wahlala enamandla, waba nemakhosikazi lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu, wazala amadodana lamashumi lamabili nalababini, nemadvodzana alishumi namane.
Lokunye lokushiwo nguAbiya, nekuphila kwakhe, namazwi akhe, bona, kubhalwe encwadini ka-Iddo umprofeti.
UAbiya wehla embhedeni wakhe, washonelwa enhlokodolobha yaDavide. Asa, unyana wakhe, waba ngunkhosi esikhundleni sakhe. Ezikhathini ta-Asa, lelizwe laliba nekuthula iminyaka lengemalishumi.
Asa wakwenza lokuhle nelokuhle emehlo laSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakhe.
Wakhipha ema-altari lakubo labangaphandle, nalapho kwabekwa khona i-Ashiraha, waphula imihlobiso yegolide, wasusa iAshera.
Wathi kuYuda kutsi bafune uSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, bagcine umthetho wakhe kanye nemyalo wakhe.
Wakhipha ema-altari emhlabatsini kanye nemahhashi ekufakelwa umlilo kuwo wonke lamadolobha eYuda; ubukhosi bebuhlala bukhululeke ngelilanga lakhe.
Wakwakha emabhishi aqinile eYuda, ngobe lelilizwe laliba nekuthula; kwakungumnyaka lomunye lapho kungasekho kulwa khona; ngobe Simakadze abemnika kuthula.

Wathi kubo-Juda: "Thintela lamadolobha lalawo, siwubeke phansi umgwaqo kuwo, siwuhlanganise netingcweti, nezingcingo, nemingcebo, nezinhlamvu; lelizwe likhona liniko, ngoba sibhekene noSimakadze Nkulunkulu wethu; sibhekene naye, wasisinika kuthula ngaso sonke isikhathi." Baphinde bakwakha, bakwenza kahle.

Wabe naAsa umkhosi waseYuda, labenesibhakabhaka kanye nesikhongo, lamawaka lamakhulu mathathu, nawaseBenjamini, labenesibhakabhaka kanye nesikhongo, lamawaka lamakhulu lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa; labo bonke babemihlabani emihle.
UZeraha wase-Etiyopiya waphuma wabahlasela, abe nemandla lamakhulu lamakhulu lamashumi lamabili eminyaka, naletinye tindzawo letiphakeme tekulwa, wafika waya eMaresha.
Asa waphuma wehla kuye, balungiselela ukulwa emfuleni iZefata, lapho kune-Maresha.

Asa wathandaza kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wakhe, watsi: "Simakadze, akukho muntu longeke asize lowo mkhulu emphilweni yakhe, ngaphandle kwakho. Sisebentise, Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wethu, ngoba wena sikwethembela kuwe; ngegama lakho safika kulo mkhosi omkhulu; ngobe wena, Simakadze, uNkulunkulu wethu, awuvumelenga umuntu ukuba abe ngumkhulu kuwe.
USimakadze wehlisa ema-Ethiopians phambi kwa-Asa neYuda, baphuma nabo ema-Ethiopians.

Asaba nalaba base-Ethiopya bahlasela, batsi: "Sifike eGera; ngobe laba base-Ethiopya babekhulu kakhulu kutsi angeke kubekho lowo loyawubuyela emuva. Bahlaselwa nguSimakadze kanye nemkhosi wakhe, kodvwa lamadodana kaYuda ayebakhipha emabinzana amakhulu.
Babulala tonkhe tidolobha letiseGerarini, ngobe kuyawufika kubo umsindo waSimakadze; babulala naletinye tindzawo letiphakeme tamadolobha labo, ngobe kwakukhona khona lokuningi lokudlwengula.
Bahlasele kanye nemindeni yalabo labafuyi, babulala timbuti netimfuyo letiningi, babuyela eJerusalema.
Wafika umoya waNkulunkulu kuAzariya, umsa kaOdedi.

Waphuma wahlangana na-Asa, watsi kuye: "Thingisani, Asa kanye nabo bonkhe bantfu base Yuda neBenjamini; Simakadze ukhona nani uma niye naye. Uma nimufuna, uyakuthola; kepha uma nimushiya, uzowushiya nawe.
Kube kungakapheli lilanga lelinyenti labaSirayeli bengenaNkulunkulu lokweliqiniso, bengenakubabusi bokufundisa, bengenamtsetfo.
Baye babuyela kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, ekuphambukeni kwabo, batsi: "UNkulunkulu waseSirayeli ukhona!"
Ngaleso sikhathi, angeke kube khona ukuthula lapho umuntu ehamba khona; kwabe sekunebuhlungu lokukhulu kubo bonkhe bantfu labahlala kulomhlaba.
Lizwe lalibambisana nelizwe, nedolobha nedolobha; ngobe Nkulunkulu wabaphazamisa ngaso sonke simo.
Lakho-ke wena, ube nemandla, ungabi nendlala; ngobe kuzoba khona inzuzo yemsebenti wakho.

UAsa, lapho elalela khona lamazwi lawa, amazwi ka-Odedi umprofeti, wehlise isandla sakhe, wasusa izinto letibi kuwo wonke umhlaba waseYuda nawaseBhenjamini, nasemadolobhani abewathatha emadolobheni asentshonalanga yeEfrayim; walungisa nesihlalo sobukhosi saSimakadze esingaphambilini kwendlu yaNkulunkulu.

Wahlangana nabo bonkhe base Yuda naBenjamini, kanye nebantfu labahlala nabo eEfrayini naManase naSimeoni; ngobe kwafika kubo bantfu abaningi baseSirayeli, lapho bebona kutsi uSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakhe ube naye.
Bahlangana eJerusalema kumnyaka wesitsatfu wekubusa kuka-Asa, iminyaka lelishumi nesihlanu.
Banikela ngemnikelo wekushiswa kuSimakadze ngalolusuku, ekudlaleni kwabo lokubuyayo: tingulube tamakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamane, nemfuyo yetinkomo letilikhulu.
Bafike bamisa isivumelwano sokufuna uSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, ngenhliziyo yabo yonke nemoya yabo yonke.
Wonke lowo longeke afune uSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, kufanele abulawe, kube ngumfana noma umtfubi, ndoda noma indoda.
Bakhuluma kuSimakadze ngelizwi elikhulu, nangemsindo, netinhlamvu temlilo, netinhlamvu temphini.
Nabo bonke base-Yuda baphumula, ngobe bebengabi nenhliziyo yabo yonke; bafuna uSimakadze ngentliziyo yabo yonke, watholakalela; Simakadze wabanika kuthula ngaso sonke isikhathi, ngaso sonke sikhatsi.

NaMahaka, mkhulu wakhe, ukumkani Asa wamsusa abe ngunkosikazi yakhe, ngobe akazange akwenzele i-Ashera imihlobiso lemibi; Asa wehlisa imihlobiso yalemihlobiso, wayibopha ibe nguthuli, wayawuyibulala emfuleni weKidron.
Tindlu letiphakeme atigiciwe eSirayeli; kodvwa intliziyo ka-Asa yabe ilungile lilanga lonke.
Wabeka ethempelini laSimakadze isiliva, negolide, netinhlamvu letingcwele, letibondza labetivela yena nababa wakhe.
Akukho kulwa kuze kube ngumnyaka wamashumi lasitfupha nesihlanu wekubusa kwaAsa.

Ngomnyaka wamashumi lamakhulu mathathu nesihlanu wekubusa kwa-Asa, waphuma Baasa, inkhosi yaseSirayeli, waya eYuda, wabambisa Rama, kutsi angeke kubekho lophumayo noma lofikayo ku-Asa, inkhosi yakaJuda.
Asa wakhipha isiliva negolide etintfweni tendlu yaSimakadze kanye netintfwalo tendlu yenkhosi, wabathumela kuBenhadada, inkhosi yase-Aram, lohlala eDamaskus, watsi:

Kube nesivumelwano phakathi kwami nakho, njengobe kwaba khona phakathi kwababami nababa bakho; bona, sengikulethela isiliva negolide; uye, uphule sivumelwano sakho naBahasha, inkhosi yaseSirayeli, kutsi ahambe nami.
Naye uBenhadi walalela ukumkani Asa, wathumela labaholi bemikhosi yakhe emadolobheni aseSirayeli, wabahlasela eIjone, neDani, na-Abeli-Mayim, kanye naletinye tinhloko-dolobha tempahla yeNephtali.
Baasa, lapho akubona khona, wayeka ukwakha iRama, watsi: "Angeke ngiyibuyele.
Ase uMbuso WaseAsa wahlanganisa bonke bantfu baseYuda, wabasusa ematshe eRama nemithi yayo, abeyisebenzisa uBaesha ekubuyeni kwayo; Asa wehlisa ngawo Geba neMishpa.

Ngeleso sikhathi wafika ku-Asa, ukumkani wakwa-Yuda, Hanani, lokubonayo, watsi kuye: "Ngikutshele, wena utawuhlala utsi uhlala umkwetsi we-Aram, kodvwa awungeke uhlale uhlala ukholwa nguSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho; ngakoloko livi lekumkwetsi we-Aram liyawushiya kuwe.
Bekungaba inkhosi yase-Etiyopiya naleyo yaseLibhiyanga livi lelikhulu, lalinemikhumbi nebantfu labahamba ngezinyawo abaningi kakhulu? Kodwa-ke, ngobe wakholwa kuSimakadze, wabanikela phambi kwako.
Lamehlo kaSimakadze abheke emhlabeni wonke, kutsi abe nemandla lalaba nguNkulunkulu lomtfubi emphefumulweni wabo. Niye nikwenze kahle kulolu daba; kusukela manje-ke nizobe nine timphi.
Asa wehlule lokubonayo, wabeka emgodini, ngobe waba nebuhlungu kuye ngaleso simo; kanye naleso sikhathi, Asa wabulala labanye labanyenti babantu.
Lamandla akhe, kanye nemsebenti wakhe, abhalwe encwadini yamabukhosi beSirayeli nawaseYiputa.

Ngomnyaka wamashumi lasitfupha nesikhombisa wekubusa kwakhe, uAsa waba nesifo semanyawo; lesifo sakhe sabe sinzima kakhulu; kodvwa naleso sifo sakhe akazange afune kuSimakadze, kodwa waya emadokotela.
Asa wafa kumnyaka wamashumi lamane nalinye wekubusa kwakhe.

Bamfaka ethempelini lakhe, labewakha edolobhaneni laDavide; bamisa embhedeni wakhe, bewubeka ngemiphunga lemihle, nemiphunga lemihle yalabo labalungiselela imiphunga, bamisa umlilo omkhulu kakhulu kutsi ahlolwe.
UJosaphat, umsa wa-Asa, waba ngunkhosi yakhe esikhundleni sakhe, waqinisa ubukhosi bakhe labaninaSirayeli.
Wabeka lamaphoyisa kuwo wonke lamadolobha aseYuda anesibhakabhaka, wabeka namagalelo emhlabatsini laseJuda, nasemindenini yaseEfraim, leyo Asa, ubaba wakhe, abeyithathe.
USimakadze waba neJosaphat, ngobe wahamba ngendlela yaDavide, ubaba wakhe, lapho ehlala khona; watsi: "Angeke asebenzela labaBaali."
Wahlala eJerusalema, walalela Simakadze Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, watsi: "Angeke ngibe nguSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, ngobe nimi.
Ngako-ke uSimakadze wehlisa ukumkani emlenzeni wakhe, ngobe bonkhe bantfu beYuda banikela ngemnikelo kuJosaphat; waba nemali kanye nebukhosi bukhulu.
Inhliziyo yakhe yabekwa phezulu, wahamba ngezindlela taSimakadze; wakhipha nalapho ema-Asheri kanye nemahhashi enkhosini yaseJuda.
Ngomnyaka wesithathu wekubusa kwakhe, wathumela labaphathi bakhe, uBenhayeli, no-Obediya, naZekariya, naNethaneli, naMikaya, kutsi bafundise emadolobhani laYuda.
Wabathumela nabo labaLevi: Shemaya, naNethaniya, naZebadia, naAsaheli, naShemiramoti, naYonathani, naAdoniya, naTobiya, naTobadinya; wabathumela nabo Elishama noJoramu, abaLevi.
Bafundisa abantu eYuda, bafike nabo nencwadi yemtsetfo waSimakadze; bahamba besuka kuwo wonke lamadolobha eJuda, bafundisa abantu.
Kuye kwafika ukuthula kweSimakadze kuwo onkhe emadolobha langaphansi kwenkhosi yaseYuda, kodvwa akazange aphume emkhosini naJosaphat.

NalabaFilisti banikela kuJehoshaphathi ngesipho, nemali njengenhlawulo; nalabo base-Arabha nabo babethumela kuye timbuti: tingulube lamaphesenti lamashumi lamabili nesishiyagalombili, namakhowe emaphesenti lasitfupha.
UJosaphat wakhula emandla akhe, watsi: "Ngiyawukwakha emakhampasi nemadolobha ekugcina impahla eYuda.
Wabeka impahla eminingi emizini yakaJuda, wagcina nabaseJerusalema labaholi bokulwa labaqeqeshiwe.
Lolu hlelo lwabo, ngemindeni yabo: Ku-Juda kwaba nguAdna, umholi wemakhulu lamashumi lamane, naye abe nemakhulu mahlanu lamawaka labaholi bekulwa;
ngemuva kwakhe kwaba nguJohanane, umphathi, naye abe nemakhulu lasitfupha namashumi lamabili.
Ngasekudla kwakhe kwaba nguAmasiya, unyana waZikhri, loyawunikela ngesandla sakhe kutsi asebenze kuSimakadze, naye abe nemashumi lamane lamakhulu lamahlanu emaBhenjamini.
Ku-Benjamini: Eliyada, umshayeli lonamandla, naye abe nemashumi lamane lamakhulu lababili, abenesibhakabhaka nesikhongo;
ngemuva kwakhe kwaba ngu-Yozabadi, naye abe nemakhulu lamashumi lamabili nasitfupha emawaka ebantfu labalungele ukulwa.
Loba bangabe basebenza kunkhosi, ngaphandle kwalabo abebeka kuwo emabhishi lasemgwaqeni kuwo onkhe emadolobha aseJuda.
UJehoshafati waba nemandla kanye nekuthula kukhulu, wahlangana naAhabhi, watsi: "Ngiya kuba ngunkhosi yakho."
Wafika eJerusalema, waya kuAhabhi eSamariya; wanikela ngemihlambi yengulube neyenkomo yakhe kanye nalabo labahamba naye, wakhuluma naye kutsi ahambe naye e Ramothi-gileyadi.

UAhabi, inkhosi yaseSirayeli, watsi kuJosaphatsi, inkhosi yakaJuda, watsi: "Uyahamba nami ukulwa neRamoti-Gileyadi?" UJosaphatsi watsi kuye: "Ngine nawe; abantu bami bangaba njengebantfu bakho; ngizofika nawe emphini."
UJehoshafati watsi kunkhosi yaseSirayeli: "Lamuhla, ngiyakucela, buza Nkulunkulu kutsi ukhuluma yini."

Unkhosi yase-Isirayeli yahlangana nabaprofeti, amadoda lamakhulu mane, wayibuza watsi: "Siya kuhlasela Ramothi iGileyadi, noma siyeke?" Baphendvula batsi: "Hamba, ngobe Nkulunkulu utawuyinikela emkhondweni waSimakadze."
kodvwa Jehoshafati watsi: "Asekho nakhona lapha umprofeti waSimakadze, kutsi siwubuze?"

Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli watsi kuJosaphat: "Kusekhona omunye umuntu longeke siwubuze uSimakadze ngaye, kepha ngiyawumukhohlisa; ngobe akusho lutho lokulungile ngalomi, kodvwa esho kuphela okubi. Nguwo Mikaya, umsa waJimla."Josaphat wathi: "Akufanele ukumkani akhulume njalo."
Unkhosi yase-Isirayeli yabiza umphathi, yatsi: "Thintela ufike uMikaya, umsa ka-Imla."

Unkhosi yaseSirayeli neJosaphatsi, inkhosi yaseYuda, bebengahlala emahhovisini abo, bagqoka iingubo zabo zebukhosi; bebengahlala emgwaqeni wesango leSamariya; nalabaprofeti bonke babekhuluma ngamazwi aNkulunkulu phambi kwabo.
UZedekiya, unyana waKenanaha, wabambisene netibondza tensimbi, watsi: "Simakadze utsi: 'Ngaleto utawubopha laSirayeli kuze baphelelwe.'"
Nalabaprofeti bonke babekhuluma ngaleso simo, besithi: "Khangela Ramoth-gileyadi, uyawuphumelela; ngobe Simakadze uyakuyinikela emkhondweni wenkhosi."
Lomfati loyawuphuma wakhuluma naye, watsi: "Bonani, labaprofeti bonke bakhuluma ngesandla esisodwa ngalokho lokulungile kunkhosi; hlala nawe ukhulume ngendlela yabo, bese ukhuluma ngalokuhle."
Hezekiya watsi: "Ngiphila Simakadze, loNkulunkulu wami angeke angiti kutsi ngikhuluma yini."
Wafika kunkhosi, inkhosi yatsi kuye: "Mikaya, kufanele sihambe sihlasele Ramoth-gileyadi, noma kufanele siyeke?" Waphendula watsi: "Hamba uphumelele; batawukunikela kuwe."
Unkhosi yatsi kuye: "Kuphi kuphi lapho kufanele ngikuvumele khona kutsi ungakhuluma nami ngaphandle kweqiniso ngegama laSimakadze?"

Watsi: "Ngibona bonkhe labaSirayeli behlukanisiwe emadolobheni, njengetingulube letingeke zibe nemfuyi; Simakadze watsi: 'Lemindeni lemi ayisekho umnikazi wayo; kumele ihambe ngasendlini yayo ngekuthula.'"
Unkhosi yaseSirayeli yatsi kuJosaphat: "Ngakusithi yini kuwe kutsi angeke akhulume kahle ngami, kepha lobubi kuphela?"
Wathi yena, "Lakho, lalela amazwi kaSimakadze: Ngikubona Simakadze ehlala esihlalweni sakhe sebukhosi, nalo lonke livi lezulu likhona ngakwesokudla kwakhe nakwesobunxele lakhe.
Simakadze watsi: 'Ngubani longeke avumele uAhabhi, ukumkani waseSirayeli, ukuba ahambe eRamoti-gileyadi, aze aphele khona?' Lomunye wakhuluma linye, lomunye wakhuluma elinye.
Waphuma umphefumulo, wahlala phambi kuSimakadze, watsi: 'Ngiyawumkhonta.' Simakadze wamphendvula watsi: 'Ngani?'
Watsi: 'Ngizophuma, ngibe ngumphefumulo webubi emilonyeni yalabaprofeti bakhe bonke.' USimakadze watsi: 'Uyawumukhohlisa, utawuphumelela; yiya uyenzile.'
Ngako-ke, bona, Simakadze umise umphefumulo webubi emlonyeni walabaprofeti bakho laba; ngobe Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli uthe lobuhlungu buyawufika kuwe.
Watsi uZedekiya, umsa wa-Kenanaya, afike, wahlaba Mikaya ngemphimbo, watsi: "Ngayiphi indlela loMoya weSimakadze ususuka nami kutsi ukhulume nawe?"
Hezekiya watsi: "Utakubona kuleso sikhathi lapho usuka egumbini ufika kwelinye, ukuze ufihlakale."
Watsi ukumkani waseSirayeli: "Thipha uMikaya, umbuyisele ku-Amoni, lomphathi wedolobha, neYoashi, umsa waSimakadze.
Nitsi kubo: Kushiwo nguSimakadze, utsi: Nciphisa lomuntfu emgodini, uncede kutsi abe nekudla lokuncane kanye namanzi, kuze ngibuye ngekuthula.
Watsi Mikaya: "Uma ubuyela ngekuthula, Simakadze angeke abekhuluma ngami." Watsi: "Kutsi niyikhumbula le nto, bonke bantfu!"
Batsi: "Lenkhosi yaseSirayeli neJehoshafati, inkhosi yakaJuda, baphuma behlasela Ramothi-gileyadi.
Unkhosi yase-Israyeli yatsi kuJosaphat: "Lami ngiya kungena emkhosini ngihlelekile, kodvwa wena gqoka iingubo takho zebukhosi." Ngako unkhosi yase-Israyeli yahlala ngenye indlela, yafika emkhosini.
UMbuso wase-Aram ubewisela bomkhuluwa babo, watsi: "Ningeke nihlangane nanoma ngubani, mkhulu noma mncane, ngaphandle kwenkhosi yaseSirayeli."

Batsi, lapho labaholi bemikhumbi bebona uJosaphat, batsi: "Lewo ngukumkani waseSirayeli!" Babuyela kuye kutsi bamphike naye; kodvwa uJosaphat wagwaza, ngobe Simakadze abemsiza; Nkulunkulu wabasusa kuye.
Babona kutsi angeke abe ngukumkani waseSirayeli, babuyela emuva bengenakuwulandzela.

Watsi lomunye wamaphoyisa ashaya umlenze, angeke abe nenhloso, wabulala ukumkani waseSirayeli phakathi kwemikhono yakhe nemilenze yakhe; watsi unkhosi kulowo lahamba ngemoto yakhe: "Cinga, uyeke kutsi ngiphume emgwaqeni, ngobe sengicwelile kakhulu."
Kube kulwa lokukhulu ngalolusuku lonke, ngobe inkhosi yaseSirayeli yahlala ihlala ekarithini layo ngase-Aram kuze kube sebusuku; kodvwa lapho lilanga liphuma khona, wafa.
UJosaphatsi, inkhosi yakaJuda, wabuyela ekhaya lakhe eJerusalema.
UJehu, umsa waHanani, lokubonayo, waya kuye, watsi kunkhosi Jehoshafati: "Uyawusiza yini umuntu lobi, uyawuthanda yini labo labaphazamisayo uSimakadze? Ngako-ke uSimakadze unelivi lakho.
Kuye, kukhona lokulungile kuwe; ngobe ususe iAshera ezweni lenu, uye wabeka umphefumulo wakho ekufuneni Nkulunkulu.

UJosaphat wahlala eJerusalema, watsi: "Waphinde waya emehlweni labantu, kusukela eBheri-sheba kuya ezweni lasephakeme leEfraim, wababuyisela kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, ngobe akazange abonise isandla sakhe.
Wabeka emajaji ezweni lonke, kuwo wonke lamadolobha aseJuda asemfuleni.
Wathi kumajaji: "Thintela lokudlaleni kwenu, ngobe ningeke nigweme kumuntu, kepha nigweme kuSimakadze; yena ukhona nani lapho nikhuluma khona.
Lokuthula kuSimakadze kumele kube nani, nicabangele lokudlaleni kwenu; ngobe Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wethu, angeke abeke icala, abhekene necala, noma athathe umkhonto.
NaseJerusalema, uJehoshafati wamisa labaLevi, nalabapristi, nebaholi bemindeni yebantfu baseSirayeli, kutsi babe ngabameli bakaSimakadze, bakhulumela ngemibuzo; bahlala eYerusalem.
Wabamisa, watsi kubo: "Nihlale nikhonza Nkulunkulu ngeqiniso, nangemphefumulo wenu wonke, nize nibe nekuthula kuSimakadze.

Nakuba labangani bakho labahlala emizini yenu befika kuwe ngecala lekubulala, nelinye lemthetho, nemyalo, nemibandela, nemithetho, khuluma nabo ngaso sonke lesi simo, ubabuvise kutsi bangabi necala kuSimakadze; ngobe kuyawufika umsindo wakhe phezu kwakho, nawe kanye nabangani bakho; wenze lokhu, ungabi necala.

UAmariya, umpristi omkhulu, utawube nguMengameli wenu kuwo wonke umsebenzi waSimakadze; neZebadiasi, umsa ka-Ishmayeli, umholi wemndeni wakwaJuda, utawube nguMengameli wenu kuwo wonke umsebenzi wenkhosi; nalabaLevi babe ngabaphathi bakho; nikhululeke, nisebenze, ngobe Simakadze ukhona nalowo lowenza kahle.
Ngaleso sikhatsi bafika bantfu baseMoabi nabase-Ammon, kanye nebantfu baseMeuni, behlasela Jehoshafati.
Bafika bakhuluma kuJosaphat, batsi: "Kukhona umkhosi omkhulu uphuma eEdomu, ngaphesheya komfula i-Edhomi, ufika kuwe; bona bakhona eHazason-tamari" (leso sithi Engedi).
UJehoshafati wakhathazeka, watsi: "Ngifuna kuthandaza kuSimakadze; ngamemezela kutsi bonke bantfu baseYuda bangeke badla."
Bahlangana nabo bonkhe bantfu base-Yuda kutsi bafune usizo kuSimakadze; kwafika nakubo tonkhe tive ta-Yuda, befuna umnikelo waNkulunkulu.
UJosaphat wahlala enkhosini yaseYuda naseJerusalema, ethempelini laSimakadze, phambi kwendlu lentsha.
watsi: "Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, wena uNkulunkulu wasezulu, awukho yini lowo ulawula kuwo wonke lamandla emhlaba, nawe unamandla netfu; akukho muntu longeke akwazi ukumelana nawe?
UNkulunkulu wethu, ngabe awuzange ukhiphe bantfu labahlala kulolu mhlaba phambi kwebantfu bakho base-Israyeli, wabanikela emndenini kaAbrahama, umngane wakho, kuze kube sekupheleni?
Bahlala kuyo, babuye bakwakha khona indlu ngegama lakho, batsi:

"Uma sifika engozini, umkhosi, inselelo, ubhubhane, noma ndlala, siyawuhlala phambi kwalendlu kanye nawe; ngobe igama lakho likhona kulendlu; siyawukhala kuwe ekufeni kwethu, wena utawutilalela, utawusisindisa."

Namuhla, bona lamadvodza ase-Ammon neMoab, nalabo baseSeiri emhlabatsini, lapho iSirayeli yaphuma khona eMfuleni iYiputa, wena utawutivumela kutsi bafike kulawo mazwe; kodvwa iSirayeli yabuyela kubo, yatsi: "Asikukhulumi.
Nakhona bona batfumisa kutsi bangatsi yini, befika befuna kutsi batfume ezweni lakho labewusinikela kulo njengelifa.
Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wethu, utawubamisa yini? Singeke sikwazi kumelana nalo mkhosi mkhulu loyawufika kuthi. Singazi kutsi singakwenza yini, kepha lamehlo ethu abheke kuwe."
Bakhona bonke lamadodana eYuda ahlala phambi kwaSimakadze, nabo bonkhe labancane babo, nemakhosikazi abo, nalabafileyo babo.
Wafika khona umoya waSimakadze kuYahaziyeli, umLevi, emndenini wakwa-Asaphi, unyana kaZekariya, unyana kaBenaya, unyana kaJehiyeli, unyana kaMatania, lapho abekhona emgwaqeni.

Watsi: "Thingisani, wonke lamakhosi eYuda, nalabahlali baseJerusalema, kanye noMbuso waseJosaphat. USimakadze ukhuluma nine, watsi: 'Ungabi nendlala, ungabi nenkinga ngenxa yalowo mkhosi omkhulu; lomphiko awukho wenu, kodwa nguNkulunkulu.
"Lamuhla nifike nibahlangane nabo; bona bayawufika ngendlela yeZize, nitawuwathola ekugcineni kwegcongolo, libheke efulethini leJeruyeli.

Ningeke nihlangane nabo emdlalweni lo; hlalani khona, nihlale phansi, nibheke kuSimakadze, kutsi akusindise wena, Yuda neJerusalema. Ungabi nalokukhathazeka, ungabi nalokukhathaza; phuma ufike kubo kusasa, ngobe Simakadze ukhona nawe.
UJehoshafati wehla ngebuso bakhe emhlabatsini, nabo bonkhe bantfu baseJuda nabaseJerusalema babukela phambi kwaSimakadze.
Batsi baphuma labaLevi, labasemndenini wakwa-Kehati nawaseKora, bamemetela uSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, ngezwi elikhulu.

Baphuma ekuseni, baphuma befika emfuleni iTekoa. Besuka lapho, uJosaphat wahlala khona, watsi: "Ningilalele, niJuda nalabahlali baseJerusalema! Nikholwa kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wenu, bese nihlala; nikholwa kumaprofeti bakhe, bese niphumelela."
Wakhuluma nabo, wabeka bobandlululo behamba phambili emkhosini, bebonga uSimakadze ngebuhle bakhe obungcwele, besithi: "Buyiselani Simakadze, ngobe uthando lwakhe luhlala kuze kube sekupheleni."
Baye bakhuluma, batsi: "UNkulunkulu uyawutsi: 'Laba base-Ammon, nalaba baseMoabi, nalaba baseSeiri, laba bafika eYehosafati, bangabi nekuthula.'
Batsi babuyela ema-Ammon nalaba-Moabi labahlala emfuleni iSeyiri, babulala bonke labahlala kulo; bese baphela nabo labahlala eSeyiri, babuyela bahlaselana nabo.
Bafika lapho bebona khona itfu, babheka emabutfo lamakhulu kakhulu; kodvwa bona, bona, bengasekho namunye lophumayo, ngobe laba ngalabo abafile emhlabatsini.

Yafika inkhosi Jehoshafati nebantfu bayo, yasuka yakhipha lemali, yathola phakathi kwalabo abafileko, nemfuyo, nemihlobiso, nezinto letinene; bathatha kakhulu kunalokho labangeke babe nalo; kwahlala lilanga lesithathu kutsi bafike bayisa.
Ngelilanga lesine bahlangana eGoli laBeraka, lapho babonga khona uSimakadze; ngobe kwashiwo kutsi liGoli leBeraka, kuze kufike ngalolusuku.
Baye babuyela eJerusalema, bonke bantfu baseYuda nabaseJerusalema, neJosaphat umholi wabo, bejabulile; ngobe Simakadze abebajabulisile ngalabo lababi babo.
Bafika eJerusalema, baphuma befika endlwini yaSimakadze, benezingoma, nezinhlamvu, nezingcingo.
Lakho kwafika ukuthula kuNkulunkulu kuwo wonke lamadolobha, lapho beva khona kutsi Simakadze abebhidlile nalabo abaphikisayo laSirayeli.
Umbuso waJosaphat ukhululeke, ngobe Nkulunkulu wakhe wamnika kuthula ngaso sonke sikhatsi.

UJehoshafati waba nguMbuso waseYuda. Wabe ubudala beminyaka lemashumi lamane nesihlanu, lapho aphuma ebukhosini, wahlala iminyaka lelishumi nambili nesihlanu eJerusalema; umzali wakhe waba nguAzuba, intombi kaShilhi.
Wayehamba ngendlela yaAsa, umsa wakhe; akazange ahambe ngaleyo ndlela, wakwenza lokuhle emehloni kaSimakadze.
Ngako-ke, emabhodlela emlilo akazange asuswa, ngobe labantfu bebengazange babeke intliziyo yabo kuNkulunkulu wababa babo.
Lokunye lokushiwo nguJosaphat, kusukela ekuqalekeni kwakhe kuya kukupheleni kwawo, akubonakali kubhalwe embhalweni waYehu unyana ka-Hanani, lobekwe encwadini yamakhosi aseSirayeli?
Naleso sikhatsi Jehosaphatsi, inkhosi yaseYuda, wahlangana naAhaziya, inkhosi yaseSirayeli, lobe ngumuntfu lobi kakhulu.
Batsi: "Sifuna ukwakha emabhishi e Tarshishi; sitawusungula emabhishi eEzion-Geber."

Ngako Eliyezeri, umsa waDodavahu, waseMaresha, waprofetisa ngeJehoshafati, watsi: "Ngitsi, ngobe sewuhlangane noAhaziya, Simakadze uyawubulala lomsebenzi wakho." Kuze inqanawa yashiswa, ingeke ihambe iTarshishi.
UJosaphat waphumula, wahlala nababa bakhe edolobhani laDavide; uYoram, umsa wakhe, waba ngunkhosi yakhe.
UYoramu ubenemadvodzana aJosaphat; Azariya, neJehiyeli, neZekariya, neAzariya, naMikayeli, naShefatiya; labo bonke babemadvodzakati kaJosaphat, ukumkani waseSirayeli.
Ubaba wabo wabanikela ngeminikelo emikhulu yesiliva, negolide, nezinto letinene, kanye namadolobha aphephile eYuda; kodvwa ukumkani wamnika uYoram, ngobe yena wayengumzali.
Yatsi lapho Joramu ephuma ebukhosini bakhe bobaba wakhe, bese eqinisa isandla sakhe, wabulala bonke labazalwane bakhe ngecwecwe, nabanye labakhulu baseSirayeli.
UYoramu ubeneminyaka lemashumi lamane nambili ubudala lapho aphuma khona ebukhosini, wahlala iminyaka lengema-8 eJerusalema.
Wayehamba ngendlela yamakhosi aseSirayeli, njengendlu ka-Ahabhi, njengoba beyenze; ngobe waba nenkosi yakhe, indodana ka-Ahabhi; wakwenza lokudla lokubi emehloni kaSimakadze.
Ngako-ke uSimakadze akazange afune ukubhubhisa indlu kaDavide, ngenxa yesivumelwano sakhe naDavide, njengoba abesho kutsi utawukhipha ilanga kuDavide kanye nembewu yakhe kuze kube sekupheleni.
Ekubeni uYoramu waba ngunkhosi, Edomu yaphuma kuSawula, yamisa ukumkani wayo.
Waya khona naJoram, naye nebaholi bakhe, naletinye timoto zakhe; kodvwa lapho eEdomu beyawumcophelela, wavuka ngebusuku, wabahlasela, yena nabaholi babo betimoto.
Ngako-ke iEdomu yaphuma ngaphansi kwesandla saYuda, kuze kube namuhla; neLibna naleyo mihla yabuyela emuva kuye, ngobe abeyawushiya uSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli.
Wakha kanye nezindawo letiphakeme emadolobheni aseYuda, wabeka eJerusalema enhliziyweni yakhe, abe yindoda yegolide; wabeka naJuda enhliziyweni yakhe.
Wafika lombiko ku-Yoram kusuka kuEliya umprofeti, utsi: Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Davide, uyise wakho, uthi: Awuhambe ngendlela kaJosaphat, umsa wakho, noma ngendlela kaAsa, ukumkani wakwaYuda.

Uye wahamba ngendlela yamakhosi aseSirayeli, wabeka uJuda nalabahlali baseJerusalema baphikisane nami, njengendlu ka-Ahabhi; nawe wabulala labazalwane bakho, labantwana bakababa wakho, labangcono kunakho.
Ngako-ke Simakadze utawubulala abantu bakho, nabangani bakho, nemadvodzakati akho, nemakhosikazi akho, nezinto tonkhe letikhona takho.
Nakho wena utawuhlupheka kakhulu ngesifo semathambo akho; kuze kube kuphele emathambo akho, kuze kube kuphuma.'"
Simakadze wavusa labaFilisti, nalaba-Arabha labahlala eduze kwe-Ethiopya, kutsi bahlasele uYoramu.
Bafika eYuda, bahlasela, babulala nalabo bonke labasendlunkuluni yakhe, nemadvodzana akhe, nemadvodzakati akhe; akazange ashiye ngaphandle kweJoahazi, lomnyaka mncane wakhe.
Ngako-ke, ngemuva kwaleso simo sonke, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli wabulala uYoramu ngesifo semgogodla, kutsi angeke abe nelungelo lokuphiliswa.
Waphela iminyaka lemibili, waphuma umgogodla wakhe ngenxa yesifo sakhe, wafa ebuhlungu kakhulu. Bami bakhe bangeke babe nemlilo wakhe, njengobe babebenewo ema-Amoni.

UYoramu ubeneminyaka engama-32 ubudala lapho afika ebukhosini, waba ngunkhosi iminyaka lemashumi lamane nambili eJerusalema. Akazange abe nenhlanhla kakhulu ekufeni kwakhe; wafunwa emzini kaDavide, kodvwa akafakwa emigodini yabaholi.

Bami baseJerusalema bakhipha Ahaziya, unyana wakhe omncane, waba ngunkhosi esikhundleni sakhe; ngobe labakhulu bonke babebiwe ngabahlaseli labafika emgwaqeni nalaba-Arabha; watsi Ahaziya, unyana waYoramu, ukumkani wakwaYuda, abe ngubukhosi.
U-Ahaziya ubeneminyaka lemashumi mane nambili ubudala lapho aphuma ebukhosini, waba ngunkhosi iminyaka lelishumi elinesihlanu eJerusalema; umzali wakhe waba nguAthaliya, intombi ka-Omri.
Wayehamba ngendlela yendlu ka-Ahabhi, ngobe umkakhe waba ngumcebisi wakhe kutsi ahambe ngendlela lebi.
Wakwenza lokubi emehloni kaSimakadze, njengendlu ya-Ahabhi; kodvwa ngemuva kwekufa kwababa wakhe, bafike babe ngabacebisi bakhe, kutsi abe necala.
Waye waphuma naJoram, umsa ka-Ahabhi, ukumkani waseSirayeli, waya ekulwa neHazayeli, inkhosi yaseAram, eRamothi-gileyadi; kodvwa laba-Aram babulala Joram.

UYoram wabuyela eJizreyeli kutsi aphiliswe kulawo magciwane abewabulala eRama, lapho ayehlasela khona uHazayele ukumkani wakwa-Aram; kodvwa Ahaziya, umsa kaJoramu, inkhosi yakaJuda, waya eJizreyeli kutsi avakashele Joramu, Nkulunkulu wema-Ahabi, ngobe wayefile.
Wafika lapho, waphuma naJoram, waya eJehu unyana kaNimshi, lowo Simakadze abewuphakile kutsi asuse indlu ya-Ahabhi. 20Watsi: "Lowo nguYoramu, umsa wa-Ahaziya; yena loyawuhlasela iJerusalema."
Bekube kungakapheli iminyaka lelishumi, lapho Jehu ehlasela khona indlu ka-Ahabhi, wahlangana nabaholi bakaJuda nemadvodzana a-Ahaziya abesebenza ku-Ahaziya, wababulala.

Wahamba wafuna uAhaziya, kodvwa lamadodana aYehu amthola eSamariya, bayawuletha kuYehu, bambulala, bamfihla; ngobe batsi: "Uyise kaJosaphat, loye wabhekana noNkulunkulu ngentliziyo yakhe yonke." Akukho mntu wendlu ya-Ahaziya owayenekhono lokuphatha ibukhosi.
Athaliya, umkakhe waAhaziya, lapho ebona kutsi unyana wakhe ufile, waphuma wabulala bonke labasebukhosini baseYuda.

Kodwa Jehoshabhethi, intombi yokumkani Joramu, yakhipha uYoashi, umsa waAhaziya, ekufeni kwabo bonkhe lamadvodzana ankhosini, wayifihla yena nenkosikazi yakhe ekamelweni lokuphumula. (Joshabhethi, intombi yokumkani Jehoramu, indodana ka-Jehoyada umpristi, yaba ngumngane wakhe,) Wayifihla lendvodzakati ku-Athaliya, ngobe i-Athaliya akayibulala.
Wahlala nabo ethempelini laSimakadze, wafihlakela iminyaka lemibili; Ataliya ke waba ngunkhosi yelizwe.

Ngomnyaka wasikhombisa, Jehoyada waba nekuthula, wahlangana nabaholi bemakhulu: Azariya unyana kaYerohamu, ne-Ishmayeli unyana kaYohanani, ne-Azaria unyana kaObedi, naMaeseya unyana kaAdaya, naElishafati unyana kaZikri;
Bahamba bafika kuwo wonke lamadolobha eYuda, bahlangana nabo bonkhe labaLevi, kanye nabaholi bemindeni yakwaSirayeli, bafike eJerusalema.
Batsi bonke labaholi bebantfu bamisa umhlangano nenkhosi endlwini yaSimakadze, watsi kubo Yehoyada: "Bonani, unyana wenkhosi uzoba ngubukhosi, njengobe Simakadze abesho ngemadvodzana aDavide.
Lakho kutsi nikwenze: linye lesithathu sabanye baLevi nalabapristi, labaphuma kumsebenti weSabhati, kumele bagcine emasango.
linye lesihlanu lihlale endlwini kankhosi, nelinye lesihlanu lihlale emnyango wesisekelo; labanye bonke bahlale emafasiteleni endlu yaSimakadze.

"Lakho-ke, ningeke nivumele noma ngubani ukuba afike endlwini yaSimakadze, ngaphandle kwalabaLevi nalabaLevi labasebenza; labo bangafika, ngobe bangcwele. Lakho-ke, bonke labanye abantu kumele bahlale phandle, bagcine umyalo waSimakadze.
LaLevi kumele ahlale ekungeneni kwenkhosi, ngaso sonke sibhakabhaka sakhe emlenzeni wakhe; nalowo lofika endlwini yaSimakadze, niyawuwubulala; hlalani ngaphansi kwenkhosi lapho iphuma khona.

LaLevi kanye nabo bonkhe bantfu base-Yuda bakwenze njalo, njengobe uYehoyada umsa waSimakadze abewaphendvula, watsi: "Lowo mkhulu kunabo bonke laphindze athathe lamadodana akhe, nalabo abaphumayo nelabafikayo ngeSabhati; ngobe uYehoyada Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli akazange avumele nalinye ibandla lihambe.
Joyada, umLevi, wabanikela kubo bonkhe labaholi bemakhulu emacwecwe, netimbhoshongo, netibombo letincane netibombo letikhulu letibe sezibekwe endlwini yaSimakadze.
Wabeka lamadoda onkhe, ngaso sonke isikhathi enesibhakabhaka sakhe esandleni sakhe, kusuka kwesokudla kwendlu kuya kwesobunxele, ecaleni lelihhovisi kanye nethempelini, emgwaqeni wenkhosi.

Baphuma bakhipha unyana wenkhosi, batsi: "Sitawumisa phezu kwakhe inhloko yebukhosi kanye nemtsetfo lomshado; siyawukwenza abe ngukumkani."Bemfafaza yena Jehoyada namadvodzana akhe, besithi: "Kuhlale kuphila ukumni!"
Na-Athaliya, lapho elalela khona umsindo webantfu labahamba nabo, bewudlalela ukumkani, waya kubo endlwini yaSimakadze.

Yabona, yabona ukumkani ehlala ngasenhloko yakhe emgwaqeni wesango, nalabaphathi bakhe kanye nelabo baphuma ngemibhoshongo behamba naye; nabo bonke bantfu belizwe babejabuliseka, bephuza imibhoshongo, nabacwengisi bezinhlamvu baboniseka. Athaliya watsi: "Labaphikisayo! Labaphikishayo!"

UJehoyada, umLevi, wathumela labaholi bemakhulu, lababekwe phezulu emkhosini, watsi kubo: "Niyiphumeze emehlweni ebantfu, nalowo loyawumlandela niwubulala." (Yoyadada, umLevi, wabaphendvula watsi: "Ungawubulala endlini yaSimakadze.")
Bafike beyibulala, yafika lapho kungena khona emnyango wengulube, endlwini yebukhosini, bayawubulala khona.
UYehoyada waba nesivumelwano phakathi kwakhe, kanye nalabo bonkhe bantfu, kanye noMbuso, kutsi bangaba bantu bakaSimakadze.
Baye bafika ethempelini laBhaali, balima, babulala ema-altari akhe nemifanekiso yakhe, babulala naMatani, umpristi waBhaali, phambi kwalama-altari.

UJehoyada wabeka ngaphansi kwesandla salabaLevi labangcwele, labaDavide abewahlukanisile emaqembu abo endlwini yaSimakadze, kutsi balungiselele iminikelo yekushiswa kuSimakadze, njengobe kubhalwe emthethweni kaMosi, nekuphumula kanye nokuzingela, njengoba kwashiwo uDavide.
Wabeka labagwebi emasango ethempelini laSimakadze, kutsi angeke afike nanoma ngubani longcolile ngesiphi simo.

Waba nebaholi bemashumi lamakhulu, nalabo abakhulu, nalabaphathi babantu, nabo bonkhe bantfu belizwe, wabeka ubukhosi phansi endlwini yaSimakadze, wafika ngendlela yesango eliphakeme, waya endlini kankhosi, wamisa ukumkani esihlalweni sobukhosi.
Nabo bonke bantfu belizwe baphumula, naleyo ndawo yakhululeka; kodvwa Ataliya wabulala ngesandla sakhe.
UYoashi ubeneminyaka leyisishiyagalombili ubudala lapho aphuma ebukhosini, waba ngunkhosi iminyaka lengema-40 eJerusalema; umzala wakhe wawunguSibiya waseBhersheba.
Joashi wakwenza lokuhle emehloni kaSimakadze, kuze kube sekuphele iminyaka yeYoyadaya, umsa waMosi.
Jehoyada wamthatha lamakhosikazi lababili, wadzala lamadodana namadvodza.
Ngaleso sikhathi, uYoashi wabeka enhliziyweni yakhe kutsi alungise indlu yaSimakadze.

Wahlangana nalabapristi neLeviti, watsi kubo: "Thumelani emabhishi eYuda, nisuse imali kuwo wonke lamadodana eSirayeli, ngemnyaka ngamunye, kutsi nilungise indlu yaNkulunkulu wenu; nize niyihambele." Kodwa labaLeviti bangeke bakhawule.

Unkhosi yabiza uJehoyada, umLevi omkhulu, yatsi kuye: "Ngubani na lokwenta kutsi labaLevi bangaba nesibopho sokubuyisa eYuda naseJerusalema iminikelo yekushiswa, leyo Mosesi, mkhonzi kaSimakadze, kanye nabo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli babeyibeke njengesibopho setenti lesingcwele?"
Atali, lowesifazane wesive lesibi, nemadvodzana akhe bafike bahlasela indlu yaNkulunkulu, bakhipha naleyo mpahla engcwele yendlu kaSimakadze, bayisebenzisela labaBaali.
Unkhosi yatsi: "Bayakwenza ibhokisi lesihlahla, bayibeke ngaphandle emnyango wendlu yaSimakadze."
Baphuma bamemetela eYuda naseJerusalema, kutsi bafike babe nesibopho kuSimakadze, lomnikelo wesono loMosese, umkhonzi waNkulunkulu, abewubeka kuma-Israyeli esiqhingi.
Labaholi bonkhe kanye nebantfu bonke bakhululeka, banikela ngemali yabo, beyifaka ebhokisini, kuze kube ligcwele.

Batsi lapho labaLevi befaka khona ibhokisi ema-Amori, bakubona kutsi kunemali leningi kulo, wafika umbhali wenkhosi kanye nesikhulu sema-Amori, bakhipha, babeka ibhokisi endaweni yalo; bakwenza njalo usuku ngalunye, bakhipha imali leningi.

Unkhosi neYehoyada banikela lemali kulabo labaphatha umsebenzi wendlu yaSimakadze, batsi: "Nikhokhele labaholi bemihlaba yesiliva negolide, nikhokhele nalabakhonzi bokhuni, nikhokhele nalabakhonzi bensimbi kanye nalabakhonzi bezibhakabhaka, kutsi balungise indlu yaSimakadze.
Labasebenzi basebenzela ngemandla, nemisebenzi yabo yahamba kahle; babuye bakwakha indlu yaSimakadze ngendlela yayo, bayiqinise.

Bafike baphela, batsi: "Lemali lesele siyawuyifaka emkhosini kanye naYehoyada; ngeleyo imali kumele senze izinto zendlu yaSimakadze, nezinto zokusebenzela endlwini yasebukhosini nasezinhlelweni temnikelo wesono, namabhodlela, nemfuyo yegolide neyesilivere. 21Nasebusuku bonke bekuphila kuka-Yoyadaya, kwafakwa emabhishodi enhliziyweni yaNkulunkulu.
Joyada wahlala iminyaka lengema-130, watsi: "Ngibe neminyaka lemakhulu lamabili namashumi lamane.
Wafunwa nguSimakadze, watsi: "Thintela umsebenti wakho, bese uhlala lapha eJerusalema, kuze kube sekuphele iminyaka lelishumi nesikhombisa.
Batsi, ngemuva kwekufa kweYoyadaya, kwafika labakhulu baseYuda, banikela emkhondweni lomkhuluwa wabo. Lomkhuluwa wakhuluma nabo,
Bashiya indlu yaSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, bakhonza ematshe eAshere nemifanekiso yegolide; ngobe kwafika buhlungu kuYuda naJerusalema ngenxa yalo monakalo.
USimakadze wabathumela kubo labaprofeti, kutsi ababuyele kuye; bakhuluma nabo, kodvwa bangawuvali undlebe.

Wafika umoya waNkulunkulu kuZekariya, unyana ka-Jehoyada, umLevi, wahlala emehlweni labantu, watsi kubo: "Simakadze utsi: 'Ngubani na lowaphula amazwi kaSimakadze? Angeke nisebenze kahle; ngobe niyawushiya Simakadze, naye uyakushiya.'"
Baye baphikisana naye; ngobe ukumkani abewisela, bamphikisa ngegolide, wafa emnyango wendlu yaSimakadze.
Unkhosi Joase akayikhumbula inhlonipho yakhe, leYoyada, ubaba wakhe, abeyawuyenza kuye, watsi: "USimakadze ubone, ubuye akubuyisele."
Ngemnyaka lolandelayo, kwafika umkhosi wase-Aram ukulwa noYoashi, wahlasela eYuda neJerusalema, wababulala bonke labakhulu bakaJuda, wabeka impahla yabo emkhosini wakhe eDamaskus.

Livi leSirayeli belingelinye lincane, kodvwa uSimakadze wanikela ebusweni babo livi elikhulu kakhulu, ngobe bashiye uSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Arami nawaseGibhithe. Lokho kwaba ngumnikelo wesono kuJoashi.

Baphuma basuka eSirhiya, babulala uYoashi; ngobe labakhonzi bakhe babewuphazamisa umkhosi wakhe, ngobe abewubulala unyana kaYehoyada, umsa waSimakadze. Bawubulala embhedeni wakhe, wafa, wabanjwa eMfuleni wakwaDavide, kodvwa akazange afakwe ekufeni kwamakhosi.
Lamadoda ayawuphazamisa lakunguZabadi, umsa waShimeathi, indodana ya-Ammon, neYozabadi, umsa waShimriti, indodana ya-Moabi.

Nasekukhulunywa ngawo lamadodana akhe, nezinto eziningi loNkulunkulu atawukhuluma ngazo kuye, kanye nendlela yakhe yokwakha indlu yaSimakadze, bona, lokhu kubhalwe encwadini yezindaba tamakhosi. U-Amasiya, unyana wakhe, waba ngunkhosi esikhundleni sakhe.
UAmasiya ubeneminyaka lemashumi lamane nasihlanu ubudala lapho aphuma ebukhosini, waba ngunkhosi iminyaka lemashumi lamane nesikhombisa eJerusalema; umsa wakhe waba nguJehoaddani waseJerusalema.
Wakwenza lokuhle ekuboneni kweSimakadze, kodvwa akazange akwenze ngenhliziyo yakhe yonke.
Watsi lapho ubukhosi bube buqinile ngaphansi kwakhe, wabulala labaphathi lababulale lomkhulu wakhe, ukumkani.

Labo bandza babo akazange abophe, njengoba kubhalwe emthethweni, encwadini kaMosi, lapho uSimakadze abewisela khona, watsi: "Abazali bangafa ngenxa yabantwana babo, nabantwana bangafa ngenxa yabafowabo; wonke umuntu kumele afe ngesono sakhe. "

U-Amasiya wahlanganisa lamadodana eYuda, wababeka ngemindeni yabo, ngabaholi bemikhulu nebanga lemakhulu, kuwo wonke amaJuda naBenjamini; babalwa labaneminyaka engama-20 ubudala nangaphezulu. Wathola amadoda angaba ngumashumi amathathu emawaka akhethelwe ukubekwa emkhosini, abengakabi nesibhakabhaka nemgqomo.
Wahlalala naletinye tintfo letinyenti, waqasha ema-Isirayeli lamakhulu lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu etina legolide.
Kwafika kuye umuntu waNkulunkulu, watsi: "Mphathina, asikuvumeleni kutsi livi leSirayeli lihambe nawe; ngobe uSimakadze akasekho neSirayeli, nalabo bonke labahlala eEfrayim.
Nakuba uphuma uyekulwa ngemandla, Nkulunkulu uyakushiya umfutsi wakho ephazamise wena. Nkulunkulu unesibopho sokusiza noma sokutfusa kuwe."
U-Amasiya watsi kulowo muntu waNkulunkulu: "Ube yini lemali yonke labengingayinikela emndenini wakwaSirayeli?" Lomuntu waNkulunkulu watsi: "Simakadze ukhona kutsi akunike kakhulu kunaleyo."
UAmasiya watsi kulabo labafika kuye kusuka eEfrayini: "Thumelani ekhaya lenu!" Baze baphoxeka kakhulu ngemadvodzana aYuda, babuyela endlini yabo bephumile.
UAmasiya wehlisa isandla sakhe, waphuma nebantfu bakhe waya eGoli leLintsa, wabulala lamakhulu lamabili ema-Seiri.
Lamadodana eYuda abulala lamakhulu lamashumi lamane, wabeka emadolobheni abo, wabafaka emahlathini, wabeka emakhazeni abo, wabeka emabhodleleni abo.
Batsi labahlaseli, labo abengabavumelenga uAmasiya ukuba bahambe befika emizini yaseYuda kusuka eSamariya kuya eBeth-horoni; bababulala lamakhulu mathathu kubo, babuyisa nempahla enkulu.
Watsi lapho abuyela khona eEdomu, uAmasiya wakhipha ema-Amori, wabeka ema-Amoni emgodini wakhe, wabeka ema-Amori emgodini wakhe, waya eSeyiri, watsi: "Laba-Amori bami!"
Ngako-ke uSimakadze wagwema ku-Amasiya, wathumela kuye umprofeti, watsi kuye: "Ngubani na lowukhonzako bonkulunkulu balabo bantu, ngobe bangakusindisi bantfu babo emandleni akho?

Watsi lomuntfu waNkulunkulu ekhuluma, ukumkani watsi kuye: "Sikubeke yini wena kutsi ube ngumcebisi wenkhosi? Nceda ukhululeke; kungani ungafa?" Lomuntfu waNkulunkulu wehlile, watsi: "Ngiyazi ukuthi Nkulunkulu useke wahlela kukubulala, ngobe wenze lokhu, uyengawulalela umyalo wami."
UAmasiya, ukumkani wakwa-Israyeli, wakhuluma nabaholi bakhe, wabathumela kuYoashi, umsa kaJoahazi, usana kaYehu, ukumkani waseSirayeli, watsi: "Thinda, sibonene ngemphi."

Joashi, inkhosi yaseSirayeli, watsi ku-Amasiya, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli: "Isihlahla setfu lesikhona eLibanoni sathumela kusitsedzeri esiseLibanoni sitsi: 'Nceda unike umfana wami indodana yakho kutsi abe ngumfazi wakhe.'
Utsi: 'Ngiwubulala Edomu.' Ngako-ke, hlala ekhaya lakho; kungani ucela umonakalo, loyawukususa wena kanye neYuda nawe?"
Ngako-ke uAmasiya akazange alalele; ngobe Simakadze abeyawubanikela esandlani salabo labaphazamisayo, ngobe babenekukhonza bonkulunkulu beEdomu.
Waphuma uYoashi, inkhosi yaseSirayeli, wahlangana naye na-Amasiya, inkhosi yakaJuda, babhekana nabo emkhosini eBethe-shemeshi, lebekwe eYuda.
LaSirayeli bahlasela laYuda, ngobe bonkhe bantfu beJuda babesuka babuyela endlwini yabo.

UYoashi, inkhosi yaseSirayeli, wabulala eBethe-shemeshi uAmasiya, inkhosi yakaJuda, intondza kaJoashi, intondza kaJehoahazi; waya eJerusalema, waphula indlu yaseJerusalema, kusukela ngesango laEfremu kuya ngesango lelisekunxele, ngamamitha lamakhulu lamabili nesikhombisa.

Wathatha yonke igolide nesilivere, naletinye timpahla letifunwa endlwini yaSimakadze, lapho abehlala khona Obede-Edomu, kanye nempahla yendlu yasebukhosini, wakhipha nabo bonkhe labaholi benkhosi, wabuyela eSamari.
UAmasiya, umsa waJoashi, ukumkani wakwaYuda, wabaphila iminyaka lengema-15 ngemuva kwekufa kukaYoahashi, inkhosi yakaJuda.
Lokunye lokushiwo nguAmasiya, kusukela ekuqalekeni kuye ekupheleni kwakhe, akubonakali kubhalwe encwadini yamabukhosi beYuda nabaseSirayeli?
Kusuka kuleso sikhathi lapho Amasiya esuka elandelanisa uSimakadze, kwaba nekuphazamisa kwakhe eJerusalema; waphuma waya eLakishi, kodvwa bathumela ngemuva kwakhe eLakishi, bamubulala khona.
Wafakwa emahhashini, wafunjwa nalabo bakhe, wabanjwa kanye nemadvodzana akhe edolobhani laYuda.
Batsi bonke bantfu base Yuda bathatha Uziya, lobe uneminyaka lelishumi linamihlanu ubudala, bamkhipha waba ngunkhosi endaweni yobaba wakhe Amazia.
U-Uziya wabuyela Elati, watsi yibuyisele kuYuda ngemuva kwekufa kwababa wakhe.
Uziya ubeneminyaka lengema-16 ubudala lapho afika ebukhosini, waba ngunkhosi iminyaka lemashumi mahlanu nambili eJerusalema; umzali wakhe wakunguJekoliya waseJerusalema.
Wakwenza lokuhle ekuboneni kwaSimakadze, njengobe wakwenta uAmasiya, umsa wakhe.
Wabhekana naNkulunkulu yonke imihla kaZekariya, lowo muntfu lowawumfundisa kutsi agweme uThixo; kuze kube sekuphele iminyaka yakhe ebhekene noSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wamvumela ukuba aphumelele.
Waphuma wahlasela labaFilisti, wabulala emasango eGathi, neJabne, neAshdodi; wabambisa imijikelo yaseAshdodi kanye neminye imijikelo yalabaFilisti.
Nkulunkulu wamsiza kutsi agweme labaFilisti, nalaba-Arabha labahlala eGur-bhaali, nalabaMeuniti.
Lamadvodza la-Ammon anikela ngemali ku-Uziya, wabekwa uphawu kuye kuze kufike emaphandleni aseMijiphu; ngobe waba ngumkhulu kakhulu.
U-Uziya wahlala eJerusalema, wakwakha imikhumbi ngeGate yeSibhakabhaka, neGate yeLwandle, nasengcelweni sesitezi, wazenza zibukhali.

Wakwakha namahhashi emhlabatsini, wavula imifula yamanzi emikhulu, ngobe wayenemihlambi leminingi emadolobheni lasogwini kanye nemadolobheni aphansi; waba nemfuyo yemhlabatsini kanye nemifuyo yewayini emadolobheni kanye nemadolobheni asogwini, ngoba wayethanda ukulima.

U-Uziya waba nebantfu labaqeqeshwe kahle, labehleli emkhosini, behlukaniswe ngemindeni yabo; babhalwa nguJeyeli umbhali, naMaaseya umphathi, ngaphansi kwesandla saHananiya, lomunye wabaholi bakankhosi.
Kube nemakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamane nasitfupha emabutfo aphindze asebentisa letinye timphi.
Ngabo kwakukhona livi lelingumakhulu amathathu, lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa lamawaka lamane, labaqeqeshiwe kukulwa ngemandla amakhulu, kutsi basebentise ukumkani emphilweni yakhe.
Uziya wanikela kuwo wonke umkhosi ngemikhumbi, netimbhoshongo, netingcweti, netibombo, netikhawu, namatindlela.

Wabeka eJerusalema emathuluzi, akhiwa ngesandla, lafakwa emigodini netingcezu tetingcezu, lasetshenziswa ekucoceni imilenze kanye nekucota emacwecwe amakhulu; wathola igama lakhe lide kakhulu, ngobe Nkulunkulu wakhe wamsiza ngezinto ezimangalisayo, kuze kube waba mkhulu.

Ngako-ke, lapho Uzziya ekhula emandlani kwakhe, inhlonipho yakhe yafika ekubhujisweni kwakhe; waba nebubi kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakhe, waphuma waya ethempelini laSimakadze, watsi: "Ngizofuyisa emakhandlela enhliziyweni yami.
UAzariya, umLevi, wafika ngemuva kwakhe, naye nalabaLevi bakaSimakadze labakhulu, lamashumi lamakhulu lamane.

Bafike bahlangana nonkhosi Uziya, batsi: "Uziya, awunakho umnikelo wesono lokuwunikela kuSimakadze, kepha wumnikelo wabaholi besive sa-Aron, abangcwele kutsi bafake umnikelo wesono; phuma kule ndawo ingcwele, ngoba sewuphule umthetho, ngobe Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli angeke akuhloniphe ngalolu daba.

U-Uziya abenesibhakabhaka esandlani sakhe, waba nendlala kakhulu; ngobe bekungekuhle kutsi abe nendlala kubo bonkhe labaphatsimandla ethempelini laSimakadze, phambi komnikelo wesono, waphuma umkhuhlane emlonyeni wakhe phambi kwabo.

UAzariya, umLevi omkhulu, nalabaLevi bonke babheka kuye, batsi: "Ubona yini lesifo sesikhumba emphinjeni yakhe?" Bamukhipha ngejubane ngaphandle kwendlu yaSimakadze; naye wahamba ngejubane kutsi aphume, ngobe Simakadze abemwise.

UUziya ukumkani waba nesifo lesibulalayo kuze kube ngusuku lwakhe lokufa, wahlala endluni lehlukile, ngobe abe nesifo lesibulalayo; akazange afike endlwini yaSimakadze, kodvwa uJothamu unyana wakhe wayengumphathi wendlu yakhe, walungisa abantu belizwe.
Lokunye lokushiwo ngu-Uziya, kusukela ekuqaleni kuya kukuphela kwalo, uIsaya umprofeti, umsa wa-Amotsi, wababhalela.
Uziya wehla embhedeni wakhe, wabulawa, wabanjwa nababa bakhe emgwaqeni wemabukhosi, ngobe kwatsiwa: "Ube nenkinga yesikhumba." NaJothamu, unyana wakhe, waba ngunkhosi.
UJothamu ubeneminyaka engama-25 ubudala lapho afika ebukhosini, waba ngunkhosi iminyaka lengema-16 eJerusalema; umzali wakhe wayeyiJerushatha intombi kaTsadoko.

Wakwenza lokuhle emehloni kaSimakadze, njengobe ubekwenzela u-Uziya ubaba wakhe; kodvwa akazange afike endlwini yaNkulunkulu, njengoba abeyawungena ubaba wakhe. Ngako-ke abantu baqhubeka besenza lokubi.
UJothamu wakwakha kabusha isango lelingenhla ethempelini laSimakadze, walungisa nedonga lase-Ofel ngemandla.
Wakwakha emadolobha emhlabatsini laYuda, wasungula netingcotjo kanye netingqungquthela emfuleni.

Wahlasela ubukhosi bemadvodzana a-Ammon, wababulala; bonkhe bantfu ba-Ammon babanikela kuye kulomnyaka lonjalo ngesiliva lamatoni lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu, nemilenze lelishumi yengulube, nemilenze lelishumi yejubane; kanye naleso sibalo sabelo seminyaka lemibili naleyo yesithathu babenikela kuye.
UJothamu waba mkhulu kakhulu, ngobe wahlala ehamba ngekuthula ngemuva kweSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakhe.
Lokunye lokushiwo nguJothamu, naleyo mibhikisho yakhe, nendlela yakhe, akubonako kubhalwe encwadini yamabukhosi beSirayeli nawaseYuda?
Wabe ubudala beminyaka lemashumi lamabili nesihlanu kutsi abe ngunkhosi, wadzala iminyaka lengema-16 eYerusalem.
Jothamu wafa, wahlala edolobhani laDavide; Ahazasi, umsa wakhe, waba ngunkhosi yakhe.

Akaze ubeneminyaka engama-20 ubudala lapho aphuma ebukhosini, waba ngunkhosi iminyaka lengema-16 eJerusalema; watsi: "Angeke ngikwenze lokho kulungile ekuboneni kwaSimakadze, njengobe wakwenza Davide lobaba wakhe.
Akazange ahambe ngendlela yamakhosi aseSirayeli, kodvwa wakwenza nemifanekiso yeBaali eyenziwe ngegolide.
Wakhipha netfu emfuleni wemadvodzana a-Hinom, wabulala nabantwana bakhe ngemlilo; waya ekudlaleni kwezinto letibi tamasiko lamazwe laSimakadze abewukhuphule phambi kwabantfu beSirayeli.
Wanikela ngeminikelo yekushiswa emabhodleleni, nakwemifula, kanye ngaphansi kwalowo mhlahlandlela lomhlophe.
Ngako-ke Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakhe, wamnikela emkhosini wakwa-Aram; wababulala, wabeka ejele labaholi bakhe, waya eDamaskus. Watiwa emkhosini waseSirayeli, wabulala lamakhosi akhe amakhulu kakhulu.
Ngako-ke uPekahi, umsa waRemaliya, wababulala eYuda emawaka lamakhulu lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa, abemikhulu, lilanga elinye; ngobe babeyawushiya Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli.
Zikri, umshayeli wema-Ephrayi, wabulala Maaseya, unyana wenkhosi, naAzrikam, umphathi wendlu yasebukhosini, naElkana, lomunye wabaphatsimandla bankhosi.
Lamadodana eSirayeli athathe lamakhulu mahlanu emaBhenjamini, kanye nemadvodzana abo kanye nemadvodzakati abo; bathatha naleyo mpahla yabakhulu kakhulu, bayisa eSamaria.

Kwabe khona umprofeti waSimakadze, igama lakhe bekungu-Odedi; waphuma waya emkhosini lapho befika khona eSamariya, watsi: "Bonani, Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, ngekuphoxeka kwakhe kuYuda, wabanikela enhliziyweni yenu, kodvwa niwabulala ngenjabulo, ibe yafike emazulu.
Namuhla-ke nicabanga kutsi niyawubeka lamadodana eYuda neJerusalema, amadoda namakhosikazi, abe ngabakhonzi benu; kodvwa ningabi nalowo mnikelo wesono kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wenu?
Ngako-ke, ngitsi kuwe: Buyisa labo labagcwalisweni, labebathathela ebantwaneni bakho; ngobe buhlungu bendlala yaSimakadze bukhona phezu kwenu.
Baye baphuma kubo bonkhe labaholi be-Ephrayi: Azariya unyana waJohanani, naBerekiya unyana waMesilemote, naJehizkiya unyana waShalumu, naAmasa unyana waHadlayi;

Batsi kubo: "Mna-ke ningabakhombisi labasolwa lapha, ngobe nifuna ukufaka icala lethu emthethweni kanye necala lethu kuSimakadze; ngobe livi lethu likhulu kakhulu, futhi umsindo wakhe ugcwele eSirayeli.
Baphindze bashiya lababoshwa kanye naleyo mpahla eyimisiwe phambi kwabaholi nebantfu bonke.

Lamadoda abhalwe amagama awo athathe labasolwa, wabeka emacwecwe kuwo onke labo abemnyama, wabeka emacwecwe kubo, wabeka emacwecwe kubo, wabanikela ngekudla nekudla lokudlisa, wabeka namaphilisi emilonyeni yabo. Nabo bonke labakhubazekile babeka emabhotsi abo, wabeka emabhotsi abo eJerikho, emzini wema-palms, waya kulabo abafana nabo, wabuyela eSamari.
Ngeleso sikhathi uMbuso Wase-Ahazi wehla wabambisana namakhosi e-Ashuri.
Lase-Edomu abuye afike, wahlasela eYuda, wathatha labasejele.
Baphilisithi bafika emadolobheni aseGibhithe, naseNtshonalanga yaYuda, babulala, bahlala eBethe-shemeshi, neAyaloni, neGederothi, neSoko, neTimna, neGimzo kanye nemindeni yawo.
USimakadze wehlisa Yuda, ngenxa ya-Ahazi ukumkani waseSirayeli, ngobe washiya Juda ahambe, waba nebubi lokukhulu kuye.
Wafika kuye Tiglath-pileseri, ukumkani wase-Ashuri; waphindze wambulala, ngobe akazange amsize.
Akaze wakhipha endlwini yaSimakadze, nasendluni yenkhosi, nasenhlalweni sebaholi, wabanikela kunkhosi yase-Ashuri; kodvwa akazange amsize.
Naleso sikhathi, lapho uMbuso Wase-Ahazi ehlupheka khona, waqhubeka ekhohlisa Simakadze.

Wanikela ngenhlanhla ema-Amori, abembulala, watsi: "Lama-Amori atawunikela ngenhlanhla ema-Amori, ngobe lababusiza; ngiyawunikela ngenhlanhla kubo, bangabambisana nami." Baye babe ngumonakalo wakhe kanye nalabaSirayeli bonkhe.
Akaze wahlanganisa naleyo mihlobiso yendlu yaSimakadze, wayisusa, wavala iminyango yendlu yaSimakadze, wabeka ema-altari kuwo wonke umngcele wendlela yaseJerusalema.
Wakha ema-altare emgwaqeni, ngaso sonke isikhulu senkhosi yaseYuda, wakhipha umnikelo wesono kulabo bonkulunkulu babanye, wabulala uSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli.
Lokunye kwakhe konke lokwenzayo, nendlela yakhe yonke, kusukela ekuqaleni kuze kube sekupheleni, akubonakali kubhalwe encwadini yamabukhosi beYuda nabaseSirayeli?
Akaze waphumula, wabanjwa eJerusalema, ngobe angeke abe emgodini wamakhosi aseSirayeli; uHezekiya, umsa wakhe, waba ngubukhosi bakhe.
UHezekiya ubeneminyaka engama-25 ubudala lapho aphuma ebukhosini, waba ngunkhosi iminyaka lengema-29 eJerusalema; umsa wakhe waba nguAbiya intombi kaZekariya.
Wakwenza lokuhle emehloni kaSimakadze, njengobe wakwenta Davide, umsa wakhe.
Ngemnyaka wokuqala wekubusa kwakhe, kumnyaka wesitsatfu webukhosi bakhe, ngenyanga yokuqala, wavula iminyango yethempelini laSimakadze, walungisa.
Wabeka emabhishobhi neLevi, wabahlanganisa esiteji lesivulekile esisenyakatho-mpumalanga.
watsi kubo: "Ningilalele, niLevi; nguNkulunkulu wenu, ngcweleni; ngcweleni indlu yaSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, khiphani kuleyo ndawo ingcwele yonke imivimbo.
Babethu baphelelwa licala, bakwenza lokudla lokubi emehloni kaSimakadze Nkulunkulu wethu, bayawushiya, babeka buso babo emehlweni akhe, babuyela emuva kwakhe.
Bavala iminyango yemnyango, badzimate nelanga, bengenakushiswa ngefutsi, banganikeli mnikelo wesono kuNkulunkulu waseSirayeli ethempelini.
Ngako-ke umlilo wendlala kaSimakadze ufike kuYuda neJerusalema, wabeka kutsi babe yinhlekelele yebantfu, nento ekhathazayo, nento enconywa ngayo, njengobe nibona ngemehlo enu.
Ngako-ke labababutsi bethu babulawa emkhosini, namadodana ethu, nemadvodzakati ethu, namakhosikazi ethu athathwa njengetiboshwa.
Lakho nguNkulunkulu, Nkulunkulu wema-Israeli, ngobe ngifuna ukwakha inhlanganiso naSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israeli, ukuze itfu lelibomvu lwakhe lihambe lisuka kuthi.
Labantwana bami, ningabi nenkinga namuhla; ngobe Simakadze ukhetheni kutsi nihlale phambi kwakhe, niphambukele kuye, nibe ngabakhonzi bakhe, nalabafuyisayo.

Batsi bafike labaLevi: emndenini wa-Kehati, Mahathi unyana waAmasai, naJoyele unyana waAzariya; emndenini wa-Merari, Kishi unyana waAbdi, naAzariya unyana waJehaleleli; emndenini wa-Ghershoni, Joha unyana waZima, naEdenu unyana waJoha.
ku-Elizafani: Shimri naJehuyeli; ku-Asaphi: Zekariya naMatania; ku-Elisafani: Meshulamu neMeshulam.
ngowemndeni wa-Hemani: Jehueli naShimeyi; ngowemndeni wa-Jeduthuni: Shemaya naUziyele.
Bahlangana nabomndeni wabo, bangcwele, befika bahlanza indlu yaSimakadze, njengobe ukumkani abewisela umthetho ngayo, ngemazwi aSimakadze.

Bafike emabhishobhi ethempelini laSimakadze, bengena ngaphakathi, kutsi bahlanze indlu yaSimakadze; bakhipha yonke imibimbi labeyithola ethempelini laSimakadze, bayifaka emgwaqeni wendlu yaSimakadze; labaLevi babeyithatha, bayisa emfuleni iKedron.

Baqale bamisa indlu ngelilanga lokuqala lenyanga yokuqala, bese befika kumnyaka wamashumi lamakhulu lamabili nesihlanu wenyaka wokuqala endlu yaSimakadze; 11bahlala khona kuze kube ngumhla lesishiyagalombili yenyanga yesitsatfu.
Bafike bafika kuHezekiya emkhosini, batsi: "Sike sahlanza indlu kaSimakadze yonke, nesitezi semnikelo wekushiswa kanye nezinto zayo zonke, neteso lekudla lokusetshenzisiwe kanye nezinto zalo zonke.

Nawo wonke amasiko, netintfo letingcwele, letiboshwa ngukumkani Ahazi, lapho abengumphathi wakhe, lapho ephazamisa khona uNkulunkulu, sitawuzilungiselela, siyawuzilahla; nabona, likhona phambi kwe altare yaSimakadze.
Hezekiya, inkhosi yaka-Israyeli, wavuka emini, wahlangana nabaholi bedolobha, wafika endlwini yaSimakadze.

Bafike banikela ngenkomo yesishiyagalombili, nemvu lesishiyagalolunye, nengulube lesishiyagalolunye, nebhokhwe lesishiyagalolunye, ibe yimnikelo wesono ngebukhosi, nendlu, nakwaYuda; ukumkani waphendvula watsi: "Labo baka-Aron, abaphatsimandla, kumele bayinikeze emadini engcwele kaSimakadze.
Baye babulala lamahhashi, bakhipha igazi labo, balihlisa ema-altari; babulala nalabo baLevi, balihlisa igazi labo ema-altari; babulala nalaba baLevi, balihlisa igazi labo ema-altari.
Bafike bafaka emabhotsi emnikelo wesono phambi kwenkhosi nebantfu, babeka isandla sabo phezu kwawo.

Baphambukela khona ema-okhi, babulala lamahhashi, bafafaza ligazi labo emgodini wemnikelo wekushiswa kanye nesondlo sesono, kutsi kube ngumnikelo wesono kubo bonkhe labaSirayeli; ngobe ukumkani wabaphendvula watsi: "Njenani iminikelo yekushiswa kanye nesondlo sesono kwalabaSirayeli bonke.

Wabeka nabo labaLevi endlwini yaSimakadze, nalesimbalo, nema-altare, nama-harpa, njengobe kwashiwo nguDavide, noGadi, lokubonayo ukumkani, noNathani umprofeti; ngobe kube ngumyalo waSimakadze ngesandla sakhe somprofeta.
NalabaLevi bahlala nabo ngemihlaba yeDavide, nalabaLevi bahlala nabo netibondza.

Hizekiya waphendvula watsi: "Ninikele mnikelo wekushiswa enhliziyweni lengcwele; lapho umnikelo wesono usuqalile khona, nengoma yaSimakadze nayo yaqala, kanye netiphoti namatindlela aDavide, inkhosi yaseSirayeli.
Labantfu bonkhe bathandaza, nalabo bengoma bekhuluma, nelabaphuza timphimbo beshaya, kuze kuphele imnikelo wekushiswa.
Bekuphelile lokudla, ukumkani kanye nabo bonke labakhona naye bakhonta, bathandaza.
Unkhosi Hezekiah nebaholi baphendvula batsi kuLevi: "Niyawubonga uSimakadze ngemazwi kaDavide, kanye na-Asaphe lokubonayo." Bayawubonga nabo ngenhlonipho, baphakamisa imilenze yabo, banikela.

Hezekiya watsi: "Namuhla niyawunikela kuSimakadze; nifike ninikeze iminikelo yekushiswa neyekubonga endlwini yaNkulunkulu." Labantfu banikela ngemnikelo wesono, nemnikelo wesono, nalowo lofuna umnikelo wekushiswa.
Banikela ngenkunzi yengulube leyisishiyagalolunye, nemhlambi wemvu lemiyane lamakhulu mahlanu, nembutfusi lamakhulu lasitfupha; laba bonke babe ngumnikelo wekushiswa kuSimakadze.
Lamanye ema-animals abekwe njengemnikelo wesono, lamakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamane, kanye nemfuyo lelishumi elinanye.

Kube khona bantfu labancane kakhulu labaLevi, abazange bavumelene nalabaLevi, kutsi bakhiphe isikhumba sazo tonkhe timnikelo tekudla lokushiswayo; kodvwa labaLevi babetawubasiza, kuze kube kuphele lemisebenzi, kanye nekuze kube khona labanye labaLevi labangcwele, ngobe labaLevi babengcwele kakhulu kunabo bonkhe labaLevi.
Kube neminikelo yekushiswa eminingi, kanye nemafutha emabhishobho ekuthula, nemnikelo wekushiswa lohambisana naleyo mnikelo wokushiswa; khona-ke kwamiswa umsebenzi wendlu yaSimakadze.
Hezekiya nebantfu bonkhe baphumula kakhulu, ngobe Simakadze abeyawukwenza kubo; kodvwa lokhu kwabe kungakapheli sikhatsi lesidze.
Hizekiya wathumela kubo bonkhe labaSirayeli nalabaYuda, wababhalela nelete kuEfremu naManase, kutsi bafike endlwini kaSimakadze eJerusalema, ukuze benze iPasha kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli.
Unkhosi nebaholi bakhe, nalabahlali bonke baseJerusalema, bakhuluma nabo, batsi: "Sifuna ukwenza iPasha kumnyaka wesitsatfu.
Bangeke bakwazi kuyenza ngesikhathi sayo, ngobe labaLevi bebengabi nenani lelikhulu, nabo bonkhe bantfu bangabe sebahlangana eJerusalema.
Lombono wawulungile ekuboneni kwenkhosi nebantfu bonkhe.

Batsi: "Sicela sithunyelwe kubantfu bonke base-Isirayeli, kusuka eBheshireba kuya eDani, kutsi bafike eJerusalema bagcine iPasha kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli; ngobe abaningi babo babengeke bayenze ngendlela lebhalwe ngalomthetho."

Bafike bafaka emavesi kuwo wonke lamakhosi eSirayeli neYuda, asuka kunkhosini nakwabaholi bakhe; ngaleso simiso sasebukhosini besithi: "Lamadodana aseSirayeli! Buyiselani uSimakadze Nkulunkulu wa-Abrahama, noIsake, nawaseSirayeli, aze akubuyele labo ababoshwe ngukumkani waseAshuri.
Musani kuba njengababa bakho nabangani bakho, lababekezelela lokubi kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wabotata babo; ngobe wabashiya abe livi, njengobe nibona.

Mna-ke ningabi nemilenze emikhulu, njengemilomo yababa bakho; nikelani ngemehlo enu kuSimakadze, nifike ethempelini lakhe, lelihlosiwe nguye kuze kube sekupheleni, nisebenzele Simakadze Nkulunkulu wenu, khona-ke indlala yebuhlungu bakhe iyakusuka kuwe.

Uma nibuyela kuSimakadze, khona-ke labantfu lababopha bazalwane benu nezingane zenu batawubanikela ngenhlonipho, nabo bayawubuyela kulelizwe leli; ngobe uNkulunkulu wenu nguSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, lowo unesibopho kanye nokuthula, ngeke alungise ubuso bakhe kuwe, uma nibuya kuye.
Bahamba basuka enhloko-dolobha kuya enhloko-dolobha, bedlula eEfraim naseManasethi kuze kufike eZebuloni; kodvwa babebacosha, babebaphazamisa.
Bakhona bonkhe bantfu base-Aseri, naseManasethi, naseZabuloni, labaphambukile, bafika eJerusalema.
NaseYuda, isandla saNkulunkulu sifike savusa inhlanganiso yebantfu, kutsi bahambe ngemtsetfo wenkhosi nabaholi bayo, ngamazwi kaSimakadze.
Bahlangana nabo eJerusalema ngemnyaka wesitsatfu, labaningi kakhulu, kutsi bagcine usuku lwemifino lengakaphekwa.
Basuswa ema-altari lakubo eJerusalema, bakhipha naleyo mihlobiso yemlilo, bayisa emfuleni weKidrone.

Babulala iPasha kumnyaka wesitsatfu, ngemhla lesilishumi lelinesihlanu wenyanga; labaLevi nalabaphatsimandla bahlupheka kakhulu, batsi: "Sifanele sikhululeke sinikeze mnikelo wokushiswa endlwini yaSimakadze."
Bafike behlala lapho, njengobe kusho mthetho waMosi, indodana yaNkulunkulu; labaLevi banikela ngegazi labo kubo bonkhe bantfu.
Baningi emphakathini abazange bangcwele; kodvwa labaLevi babulala tingulube tePasha kuwo wonke longakabi nephunga, kutsi babe ngungcwele kuSimakadze.
Batsi: "Kunebantfu abaningi eEfrayini, naseManasethi, naseIssakhareni, naseZabuloni, labazange bahlanzwe; kodvwa badla iPasha, nakuba akushonga njalo."
lababeka intliziyo yabo ekufuneni Nkulunkulu, Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, nakuba angeke abe mhlophe ngemithetho yendlu.
Simakadze watsi kuHezekiya, waphilisa labantfu.
Baphindze bahlela eJerusalema usuku lwemifino engumquba, liviki lesitsatfu, nekuthula okukhulu; labaLevi nalabaLevi babonga Simakadze ngosuku ngalunye, bekhuluma ngemibhoshongo yaSimakadze.

Hizekiya wayalela bonke labaLevi, labo abazange babone buhlungu ekusebenzeni kuSimakadze. Badla iminikelo yabo yesondlo, benikela ngenhlanhla, babonga Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, iminyaka lelishumi nesikhombisa.
Batsi bonke bantfu bakhuluma, batsi: "Sitaphila iminyaka lesikhombisa eyengeziwe." Bahlala nabo iminyaka lesikhombisa ngekuthula.

Hezekiya, ukumkani wakwaYuda, wabanikela kubo bonkhe bantfu ngemnikelo wesono, wanikela ngenkomo lelikhulu, nengulube lelishumi elinamahlanu; nabaholi banikela ngenkomo lelikhulu, nengulube lemashumi lamane.
Bayawujabula bonke bantfu baseYuda, nalabapristi, nalabaLevi, nebantfu bonkhe labasuka eSirayeli, nalabasemazweni langaphandle labasuka eSirayeli, nalabo abahlala eJuda.
Kube nekuthula okukhulu eJerusalema; ngobe kusukela ngelilanga leSolomoni, umsa waDavide, ukumkani waseSirayeli, kwakungeke kube khona njalo eJerusalema.
Baphuma khona labaLevi, babembisana nabo bonkhe bantfu; Simakadze wabaphendula, ngobe butfo babo babufike emhlabeni wakhe longcwele, esibhakabhakeni.

Bafike baphela, labaSirayeli bonke abakhona bephuma emadolobhani aseYuda, baphula imihlobiso yegolide nemibhoshongo yama-ashereshi, nalabo basemadolobheni kanye nezithende zakwaSimakadze babebopha kuwo wonke umhlaba waseJuda nawaseBhenjamini nakuEfrayini naseManasethi, kuze kube sekuphele konke. Babuyela emathempelini abo nabomhlaba wabo.

UHezekiya wabeka labaLevi nalabaLevi emasinagogeni abo, kuwo wonke lomsebenzi wabo; labanye banikela ngeminikelo yekushiswa neyekuthula, kanti abanye bakhonza, bebonga, bebonga emnyango wendlu yaSimakadze.

Unkhosi yanikela ngempahla yakhe, ngeminikelo yekushiswa yekusasa neyekusihlwa, kanye nemnikelo wekushiswa welilanga leSabhati, nenyanga entsha, nemikhosi, njengobe kubhalwe emthethweni wakwaSimakadze.
Waletsa nalabahlali baseJerusalema ukuba banike iminikelo yabo yabaLevi neyabaLevi-ke, ukuze bahlale benikela ngemtsetfo waSimakadze.

Batsi lapho lomthetho uphuma khona, bantfu base-Isirayeli banikela ngezinto takuqala tekudla kwabo, nembewu, newayini lelihle, nemafutha, nemvubelo, naleyo yonke imfuyo yemhlabatsini; banikela kakhulu, banikela ngeshumi lelinye laso sonke.

NalabaSirayeli nalabaYuda, labahlala emizini yaJuda, nabo bakhipha ingxenye yeshumi lemihlambi yabo nemfuyo yabo, nengxenye yesikhombisa yezinto ezingcwele zaSimakadze Nkulunkulu wabo, babeka ematshe amakhulu.
Kumnyaka wesithathu baqalisa ukwakha tigodzi, baphela kumnyaka wesikhombisa.
Hezekiya nebaholi bafike, babona lemihlambi, babonga uSimakadze, nabo bonkhe bantfu bakhe baseSirayeli.
Hizekiya wabuza labaLevi nalabaLevi kutsi bangabaphi lamagceke.

U-Azariya, umLevi omkhulu, wemndeni kaTsadoko, waphendula watsi: "Kusuka lapho baqala khona kunikela ngemnikelo endlwini yaSimakadze, sidle saphezeka, sashiya nenani elikhulu; ngobe Simakadze ubarekile bantfu bakhe, sashiya lenani elikhulu kakhulu.
Hezekiya watsi kubo kutsi balungiselele emagumbi endlu yaSimakadze; nabo bakwenza.
Bafike bafaka ngekuthula iminikelo yekushiswa, nengxenye yeshumi, nezinto letingcwele; naKonaniyasi, umLevi, waba nguMengameli wabo, naShimeyi, umkhuluwa wakhe, waba ngumholi.

Jehiyeli, ne-Azaziya, ne-Nahati, ne-Asaheli, ne-Jerimothi, ne-Yozabadi, ne-Elieli, ne-Ishmakiya, ne-Mahati, ne-Benaya, babekwa ngaphansi kwesandla saKonania naShemeyi, umngane wakhe; unkhosi Hezekiah ne-Azariya, umphathi wendlu yaNkulunkulu, babeka kubo.
UKore, unyana wa-Imna, umLevi, umphathi wesango lasenyakatho, waba nesibopho sezinto letikhethwako kuNkulunkulu, wanikela ngezinto letikhethwako taSimakadze kanye nezinto letinene kakhulu.

Nase ngaphansi kwakhe kwabekhona uEden, naMinaamini, naJeshua, naShemaya, naAmariya, naShekaniya; laba basebenza ngekuthula emizini yalabaLevi, benikela ngemifelokati yabo kubo bonkhe labaholi bomndeni wabo kanye nemindeni yabo.

Baye banikela ngemifelokati kubo bonkhe labesifazane labaneminyaka lemibili nangaphezulu, lababhalwa emindenini yabo, bonke labangena endlwini yaSimakadze, kutsi basebenze ngosuku ngalunye, ngemiyalo yabo, ngemisebenzi yabo.
Bebanikela ngemifelokati yabo kubo bonkhe labapristi, kanye nalabaLevi labaneminyaka lemashumi lamane ubudala nangaphezulu, ngemisebenzi yabo, nangemaqembu abo.
Babanikela nabo bonkhe bantfu labancane, nemindeni yabo,mbatfo, nemadvodzana abo, nemadvodzakati abo, abebhalwe encwadini yemndeni walowo mhlangano wonke; ngobe bagcine bengcwele.

Labo baLevi labahlala emadolobheni abo, kwaba khona lamadodana ka-Aron, emadolobhaneni abo, abekwa ngegama, kuwo wonke lamadolobha labo, kutsi abe nesibopho sokunikela ngemifelokati kubo bonkhe lamadodana ethempelini, nalabo bonke lababhalwa encwadini yalabaLevi.
Ngako-ke uHezekiya wakwenza njalo kuwo wonke lamadolobha eYuda; watsi: "Wakwenza lokuhle, nelona lilungile, nelona lithembekile phambi kwaSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakhe."
Nasekuqaleni kwakhe, lapho aqala khona umsebenzi wendlu yaSimakadze, nemtsetfo, naleso simiso, efuna Nkulunkulu wakhe ngentliziyo yakhe yonke, waphumelela.
Kuye kwenzeka, ngemuva kwalolu daba lonke, kutsi Sanheribi, ukumkani wase-Ashuri, wafika waya eYuda, wehla emadolobheni lasemgwaqeni, afuna kuwahlasela.
Hezekiya wabona kutsi Sanheribi ufike, watsi: "Ngifuna kuhlasela iJerusalema."
Wakhuluma nalabaphathi bakhe kanye nebaholi bebantfu bakhe, watsi: "Nifike nivale imifula lemikhulu engaphandle komgwaqo." Baye bamsiza.
Bakhona abantu abaningi bahlangana, bavala imifula lemikhulu kanye nemfula losuka emaphakathi kwelizwe, besithi: "Ngabe kungenxa yekuphi kutsi bantfu base-Ashuri bafike bafune amanzi agcwele?"

UHezekiya wehlisa ngemandla akhe yonke imijovo yesitezi, wakwakha izingcezu kulo; wasungula nesitezi esisenyakatho-ntshonalanga saso, wabambisa emaphahla edolobhani laDavide; walungisa namasindzi kanye nemikhumbi emikhulu.
Wabeka baholi bamaphoyisa phezu kwabantfu, wabahlanganisa esiteji lesivulekile semnyango wedolobha, wabasabisa, watsi:
Batsi: "Sihlekeleleni, nihlale ninemandla; ningabi nenkinga, ngobe unkhosi yase-Ashuri ikhona, kanye nemkhosi omkhulu loyawuhamba naye. Loyena lokhuluma nathi umkhulu kunelowo okhuluma naye.

Ngaye kukhona amandla lamuntu, nami ngineSimakadze Nkulunkulu wethu, kutsi anikhombise usizo lwakhe nekulwa lesivuno sethu.'" Batsi laba bantu bakhulisa inhliziyo yabo ngemazwi ka-Hezekiya, ukumkani wakwaYuda.

Ngaleso sikhatsi Sanheribi, inkhosi yase-Ashuri, wathumela labaphathi bakhe eJerusalema kuHezekiya, inkhosi yakaJuda, kanye nabo bonkhe bantfu beJuda labaseJerusalema; kodvwa yena nebantfu bakhe bonke babehlasela Lakish.
watsi: "Sanheribi, ukumkani wase-Ashuri, usho kutsi: 'Ngubani na lowukholwa kuye, ngobe nihlala eJerusalema, lapho libunjwa khona?
Hezekiya akakukhangisini, ngobe niyawufa ngendlala nasengcupheni, kusho kutsi: Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wethu, utawusivikela emkhondweni wenkhosi yase-Ashuri.
Hezekiya akazange asuse yini ema-altari emhlabatsini, kanye nema-altari akhe, watsi kuYuda neJerusalema: "Niyawuthandaza enhliziyweni lenye kuphela, niyeke umlilo phezu kwayo?"
Ungazi yini kutsi ngikwenze yini, mina nababami, kuwo wonke lamasiko emhlaba; bangalivikela yini imikhosi yalawo mazwe ilizwe labo emandleni ami?
Ngami, angeke kube khona nguNkulunkulu webantfu labazange batfunywe ngubabami; ngobe Nkulunkulu wenu angabavikela kanjani ebusweni bam?

Musani kutsi uHezekiya abusise, noma akucebisele ngale ndlela; ningamukholwa; ngobe Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli nawasebukhosini akazange akwazi ukukhulula bantfu bakhe emandleni ami, noma emikhosini yababami. Ngabe Nkulunkulu wenu akakuvikeleki yini enhliziyweni yami?
Bakhuluma kanjalo-ke naletinye tincwadzi tekucala titsi, "bakhuluma" Simakadze Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, kanye nemkhonzi wakhe Hezekiah.

Waye wabhala neletafula lokudlwengula uSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, kutsi akhulume naye, watsi: "Labangcwele bamazwe langaphandle abazange bavikele bantfu babo emandleni ami; ngakho-ke naNkulunkulu kaHezekiya angeke agcine abantu bakhe emandleni ami."
Bakhuluma ngesiHebhere kubo bonkhe bantfu baseJerusalema labasesitezi, kutsi babandlulule nabo, babonise kutsi bangawuhlasela lomhlaba.
Bakhuluma ngeNkulunkulu waseJerusalema, njengabangcwele babantfu bemhlaba, labangeke babe khona ngaphandle kwezinto leticutshungulwa ngamehlo emuntu.
Lenkhosi Hezekiah neIsaya umprofeti, umsa wa-Amozi, bathandaza ngalolu daba, batsi:

Watsi uSimakadze wathumela ingulube, yabulala bonke labakhulu emphini yenkhosi yase-Ashuri; Sanheribi wesuka lapho abuyela ezweni lakhe elifihliwe. Wafika endlini kaNkulunkulu wakhe, lakuboshwa khona ngekhefu ngalabo abaphuma emileniseni yakhe.

Ngako-ke Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli wavikela Ezekiyi, nalabahlali baseJerusalema, esandlani sa-Sanheribi, ukumkani waseAshuri, nesandlani salabo bonkhe lababuphikisayo; wabanikela ngenhlanhla ngaso sonke isikhathi.
Baningi bafike benikela ngemnikelo kuSimakadze eJerusalema, neminikelo yekushiswa kuHezekiya, ukumkani wakwaYuda; ngobe kusukela ngalomnyaka waphindze waba mkhulu kakhulu kubo bonkhe bantfu.
Ngaleso sikhathi uHezekiya wahlupheka kuze aphele, wathandaza kuSimakadze; Simakadze wamphendula, watsi: "Nceda unciphise isandla sakho, ngobe ngikunike umqondiso.
Ngako-ke uHezekiya wehlisa isandla sakhe, watsi: "Ngikubonga, Nkulunkulu wami," kodvwa akazange abe nekuthula naye; ngobe Simakadze wagwema yena, naJuda naYerusalem.
Ngako-ke uHezekiya nebantfu baseJerusalema baphazanyiswa, babuyela ekubumbeni kwabo; khona-ke buhlungu beSimakadze abuvakali kubo nsuku zonke taHezekiya.
UHezekiya waba nemandla amakhulu, wahlala ebukhosini. Wakha emagumbi empahla yegolide, nesiliva, negolide, negolide lelihle, nemithi lemfishane, nemilenze, naletinye tindzawo letiphakeme.
Wakha namahhovisi ekudla, newayini kanye nephethroli, naletindlu tekudla letihlukene, netindlu tekudla letincane.
Wahlala emadolobhaneni, waba nemindeni emincane nemfuyo leminingi, ngobe Simakadze abeyawumnika mandla amakhulu.
UHezekiya wavala umfula lophezulu weGihoni, wayalela amanzi kutsi afike emaphandleni lasentshonalanga yedolobha laDavide; uHezekiya waphumelela kuwo wonke umsebenzi wakhe.
