Ngako-ke, lapho labaphathi baseBabiloni bethumela labaholi bakhe kutsi bambuze ngaleso sibonakaliso esisha esibekiwe kulomhlaba, uNkulunkulu wamshiya angeke abe nenkinga naye, ngobe wayefuna ukubona zonke izinto ezikhona emphefumulweni wakhe.
Lokunye lokushiwo nguHizekiya, kanye nebuhehayo bakhe, akubonakali kubhalwe ekubukeni kukaIsaya umprofeti, unyana ka-Amozi, encwadini yamabukhosi beYuda nabaseSirayeli?

Hizekiya waphumula, wabanjwa efulethini leligcwaliswe khona lamakhosikazi aDavide; bonkhe bantfu base Yuda nabaseJerusalema bamnikela ngenhlonipho ekufeni kwakhe. UManase, unyana wakhe, waba ngubukhosi bakhe.
UManase ubeneminyaka lelishumi elinambili ubudala lapho aphuma ebukhosini, waba ngunkhosi iminyaka lengema-55 eJerusalema.
Wakwenza lokudla lokubi emehloni kaSimakadze, walandela imicabango lemibi yalawo mazwe aSimakadze abewukhuphule phambi kwalabaSirayeli.
Wayilungisa kabusha imindeni yemadolobha aphakeme, leHezekiya, ubaba wakhe, abeyibulala, waphakamisa ema-altari kuBaali, wakwenza i-ashere, wehla emehlo akhe kuwo wonke lamandla asezulu, wababulale.
Wahlala eJerusalema, wakha ema-altari endlwini yaSimakadze, lapho Simakadze abesho khona kutsi: "EJerusalema litawube likhona igama lami kuze kube sekupheleni."
Wakha ema-altari kuwo wonke lamandla ezulu, emifuleni lemine yendlu yaSimakadze.

Wabeka labantwana bakhe emlilweni efulani lase-Bene-Hinom, wakhuluma ngesimo sezulu, nesimo sezulu, nesimo sezulu, waphuma waya kulabo abakhuluma ngezinto eziphilayo nalabo abakhuluma ngezinto ezingaphilayo; wakwenza njalo lokudla lokubi kakhulu enhliziyweni yaSimakadze, kutsi amkhabe.

Wathatha igolide lelihlanganisiwe, layawulibeka endlwini yaSimakadze, lapho Simakadze abekhuluma khona kuDavide naSolomoni, unyana wakhe, watsi: "Endluni lenhle, naseJerusalema, lapho ngiyikhethele khona kusuka kuwo wonke lamadolobha aseSirayeli, ngitawubeka igama lami kuze kube sekupheleni.

"Nami ngingeke ngiphinde ngibeke isandla sami esihlalweni semaSirayeli, emhlabatsini lapho ngayinikela khona kubabusi babo, uma nje bagcina bekwenza konke lokutsile kubo, kanye nemithetho yabo, nemiyalo yabo, namasiko abo, abhalwe ngesandla saMosesi.
Ngako-ke uManase wabaphazamisa bantfu baseYuda nabaseJerusalema, kutsi bakwenze kube buhlungu kunaleyo mihlaba loNkulunkulu abeyibhubhisa phambi kwalabaSirayeli.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuManase nakubo bonkhe bantfu bakhe, kodvwa batsi: "Asikucaci.
Ngako-ke uSimakadze wababeka phezu kwabo abaphathi bemphi yenkhosi yase-Ashuri, lababamba Manase, bamisa intambo emlonyeni wakhe, bamboza ngemikhonto yesiliva, bayawufaka eBhabheli.
Ngako-ke, lapho ehlupheka khona, uManase wathandaza kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakhe, wehla phansi kakhulu phambi kweNkulunkulu wababusi bakhe.
Wathandaza, Simakadze wamlalela, waphendula lomthandazo wakhe, wababuyisela eJerusalema abe ngunkhosi yakhe. Ngako-ke uManase wayazi kutsi Nkulunkulu unguNkulunkulu.

Nalapho, ngemuva kwaleso sikhathi, uManase wakwakha umgwaqo wengaphandle wedolobha laDavide, enyakatho-ntshonalanga kweGihoni, efulethini, kuze kufike emgwaqeni wema-Inhlanzi; wahlanganisa iOfel, wayiphakamisa kakhulu, wabeka bomkhuluwa bamaphoyisa kuwo wonke lamadolobha aseJuda anesikhala.
Wakhipha ema-Asera ethempelini laSimakadze, nalabo bokhokho bakhe; wasusa naleyo mihlobiso lemikhulu ayawuyenza enhliziyweni yethempelini naseJerusalema, wayazibeka ngaphandle komgwaqo.
Wakwakha kabusha ithempeli laSimakadze, wanikela khona ngeminikelo yekuthula nemnikelo wesono, watsi kuJuda: "Nisebenzele Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli.
Labantfu bahlala benikela emabhodleleni, kodvwa kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wabo kuphela.

Lokunye lokushiwo nguManase, nesaba lakhe kuNkulunkulu wakhe, namazwi lalababonayo abekhuluma kuye ngegama leSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, akubonakali libhalwe encwadini yezimlando yamabukhosi bama-Israyeli?

Umthandazo wakhe, nendlela loNkulunkulu abewuphendula ngayo, naleyo ndzebe yakhe, naleyo ndzeba yakhe, nalapho abulale khona ema-altare, wabeka khona i-ashere, nalapho abeke khona imihlobiso yegolide, ngaphambi kokuba ahlupheke, bona, kubhalwe emibhalweni yalababona.
UManase waphumula, wabanjwa endlwini yakhe; uAmoni, umsa wakhe, waba ngunkhosi lomunye.
UAmoni ubeneminyaka lemashumi lamane nambili ubudala lapho aphuma khona ebukhosini, wahlala iminyaka lemibili eYerusalem.
Wakwenza lokudla lokubi emehloni kaSimakadze, njengobe wakwenzela uManase ubaba wakhe; watsi: "Amoni wanikela ngenhlanhla kuwo wonke lamagceke angcwele, abewalungisa uManase ubaba wakhe, wababopha.
Akazange akhululeke phambi kwaSimakadze, njengobe uManase, umsa wakhe, abewenza; kodvwa Amone wakhula ebubini.
Abaholi bakhe baphikisana naye, bambulala endlwini yakhe.
Batsi bantfu belizwe babulala bonke labakhembise isandla labanikeze ukumkani Amone; kodvwa bantfu belizwe babeka uJosiya, umsa wakhe, waba ngunkhosi esikhundleni sakhe.
UYosiya ubeneminyaka lemashumi lamabili nesikhombisa ubudala lapho aphuma ebukhosini, waba ngunkhosi iminyaka lemashumi lamane nalinye eYerusalem.
Wakwenza lokuhle emehloni kaSimakadze, wahamba ngendlela yaDavide, umsa wakhe; akazange ahambe ngaye ngasekunene noma ngasekhohlo.

Ngomnyaka wesikhombisa wekubusa kwakhe, lapho angeke abe neminyaka lelishumi elinambili, waqalisa ukufuna uThixo kaDavide, lobaba wakhe; ngaleso sikhathi waqalisa ukuhlanza Yuda neJerusalema kusuka emathempelini ephakeme, nase-Asheri, nasezikhungweni zegolide nezesiliva.

Wabona, waphula ema-altari eBaali, wasusa iinkunzi temlilo zato, wababulale ama-asheri, nemifanekiso yegolide neyesiliva, wayibulala ibe ngumhlabatsi, wawufaka emgodini walemihlambi yalabo labanikela kubo ngeminikelo.
Natingulube tabaholi bebandla lamaJuda atawuzibulala ema-altari abo, walungisa Juda neJerusalema.
Wakwenza njalo emadolobhaneni laManase, neEfrayim, naSimeoni, kuze kube nguNeftali, kanye nezindawo letilahlekile lapho.
Waphula ema-altari, wabulala i-ashera, nemifanekiso yegolide, waya emhlabatsini, wehlisa zonke izintaba-mlilo emhlabeni wonke waseSirayeli, wabuyela eYerusalem.

Ngomnyaka wesikhombisa nemashumi lamabili nesihlanu wekubusa kwakhe, lapho ehlanze khona ilizwe kanye nendlu, wathumela Shafani unyana ka-Azaliya, naMaeseya umphathi wedolobha, naYowahi unyana ka-Jehoahazi, umbhali, ukuba balungise indlu yaSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakhe.

Baye bafika kuHilkiya, umpristi omkhulu, banikela ngemali lefakwa endlwini yaNkulunkulu, labaLevi abagcinela inhloko, beyikhipha kubo-Israyeli, naseManase, naseEframu, nalabo baseSirayeli, nabo bonkhe bantfu beYuda neBenjamini, nalabahlali baseJerusalema.
Baye bayinikela kubo labaphatha umsebenzi wendlu yaSimakadze, nabo banikela ngemali kulabo abasebenzela ukulungisa indlu yenkhosi.
Baye banikela ngemali kulabo basemakhazeni nalabakhonzi, kutsi bathenge emacwecwe esiliva negolide, nemithi yekuhlobisa, neminye imihlobiso yetindlu, labankhosi yase-Yude babeyiphule.

Nalaba bantu basebenzela lemisebenzi ngekuthula; nebaholi babo bekunguYahati na-Obadiya, emaLevi emndenini waMerari, kanye naZekariya naMeshulamu, emaLevi emndenini waKahati; nabo bonke labaLevi babe ngabaculi abaqeqeshiwe.
babenesibopho salabo labasebentisa, nesibopho sokulawula bonke labo labasebenzela kulowo msebenzi; nalabaLevi bebengababhali, nebaholi, nebahlengikazi.
Baphuma bekhipha lemali labeyifakwe endlwini yaSimakadze, uHilkiya umLevi wathola incwadi yemtsetfo waSimakadze, lowetfwelwe ngesandla saMosi.
Hilikiya waphendula watsi kuShafanu, umbhali: "Ngithole incwadi yemtsetfo ethempelini laSimakadze." UHilkiya wamnikela incwadi kuShafanu.
Shafani wabeka incwadi kunkhosi, watsi kuye: "Labakhonzi bakho bayakwenza konkhe loku utibophele kubo.
Bakhiphe imali lekuboniswa endlwini yaSimakadze, bayinike labaphathi kanye nalabo abasebenza kulomsebenzi.
UShafanu, umbhali, wabatshela ukumkani watsi: "Hilkiya, umsa waSimakadze, ungisinikele incwadi." UShafanu wabhala kuyo phambi kwenkhosi.
Nalapho ubukhosi bekubonile lamazwi emtsetfo, baphuca ingubo yabo.
Wathi kuHilkiya, na-Ahikamu unyana waShafani, na-Abdonu unyana waMika, na-Shafani umbhali, na-Asaya umkhonzi wenkhosi:

"Niyeni nibuze uSimakadze ngami, nalabo labashiwo eSirayeli naseYuda, mayelana nemazwi lalesincwadi lesifunwa; ngobe kukhulu indlala yaNkulunkulu esivela kuthi, ngobe bantfu bakababa bethu bangeke balalele amazwi kaSimakadze, bakwenze konke lokubhalwe kulo ncwadi.
Hilikiya, kanye nalabo abathunyelwe ngukumkani, bafike ku-Hulda umprofeti, indodana kaShalumu, unyana kaTokhathi, unyana kaHasra, lobe ahlala eJerusalema eningizimu; bakhuluma kuye ngaleso sikhathi.
Wabaphendvula watsi: "Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, utsi: Nitsi kulowo muntu lowawunithumela kuye:
Simakadze usho kutsi: "Namuhla, ngiyawuletha umonakalo kulendawo kanye nabo bonkhe bantfu labahlala kuyo, ngaso sonke lesibhalwe encwadini lelihlanganisiwe emkhosini wenkhosi yaseYuda.
ngobe bamishiye, banikela ngefu kulabo bonkulunkulu bobanye, kutsi bangisicelele ngaso sonke sinqumo sesandla sabo; ngako-ke umsindo wami utawuphuma phezu kwalendawo, awuzange uphele.
"Nasenkhosini yase-Yuda, loyawuthumele kutsi nibuze uSimakadze, ningatsi kuye: Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, uthe njalo mayelana nemazwi lawuvayo;

ngobe inhliziyweni yakho yakhululeka, nawe wahlupheka phambi kwaNkulunkulu, lapho ukhuluma khona ngalendawo kanye nalabahlali bayo; nawe wahlupheka phambi kwami, waphula ingubo zakho, wehlalela phambi kwami; ngakho nami ngikuphendulile, kusho Simakadze.
Batsi: "Namuhla ngikushiya uhambe ngekuthula, uye kubabundza bakho; ngeke ube nethuba lokubona lokubi kakhulu engikushoyo kulona lendawo kanye nalabahlali bayo.' " Bafike bakhuluma kubonkhosi.
Unkhosi yahlangana nabo bonkhe bantfu base Yuda nawaseJerusalema.

Waya ethempelini laSimakadze, yena nebantfu bonke baseYuda nabaseJerusalema naye, kanye nabaLevi nalabaLevi, nabo bonkhe bantfu, kusukela kulabo abancane kuya kubakhulu; wafunda emlonyeni wabo wonke amazwi encwadini yesivumelwano esifunwa endlwini yaSimakadze.

Wahlala khona, wamisa isandla sakhe esihlalweni sakhe, wehla esivumelwaneni phambi kuSimakadze, kutsi alandele uSimakadze, agcine imiyalo yakhe, namasiko akhe, nemithetho yakhe, ngentliziyo yakhe yonke, nangemphefumulo wakhe wonke, ukuze aphumeze amazwi esivumelwano abhalwe kuloncwadi.
Wabakhipha eJerusalema naseBhenjamini, watsi: "Niyigcine lemithetho; ngobe nalaba baseJerusalema balandzela isivumelwano saSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli.

UYosiya wabasusa nalabo bobubi bonke emazweni onke lamadvodza aseSirayeli, wabeka bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli basebenzela uSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wabo; kuze kube sekuphele iminyaka yakhe, bayawuhlala belandela uSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli.
Josiya wamisa iPasha kuSimakadze eJerusalema, wabulala iPasha ngemnyaka wesitsatfu wenyanga yokuqala, ngelilanga lesihlanu.
Wabeka labaLevi emisebenzini yabo, wabavikela ekusebenzeleni kwabo ekhaya laSimakadze.

Wathi kubo labaLevi, labafundisa bonke bantfu baseSirayeli, abahlukaniswe kuSimakadze, watsi: Nciphisani ibhokisi lengcwele lisendlwini yenkhosi, lapho uSolomoni, unyana kaDavide, ukumkani waseSirayeli, abewukwakha khona; ningayibambe ngesandla senu. Manje nisebenzele Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, nebantfu bakhe baseSirayeli.
Nilungiselele ngemindeni yenu, ngamaqembu enu, njengobe wabhalela Davide ukumkani waseSirayeli, kanye naSolomoni umsa wakhe.
Nifike nihlale lapha engcweleni, nani kanye nalabaLevi, ngayinye ngemndeni wayo, nabo bonkhe bantfu labaphilako.
Nifilele inkunzi yepasha, nihlale ningcwele, niyilungiselele bazalwane benu, nikwenze njengobe Simakadze abewisela umthetho ngaMosesi.

UYosiya wabanikela kubo bonke labakhona, ngekudla kwepasha, emakhowe lamakhulu lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu, kanye nalabo bandzabo, kanye nengulube lamakhulu amathathu; lokhu kwakukhona kuwo wonke umkhosi wenkhosi.

Nabo bonkhe bantfu, kanye nabaholi bakhe, banikela ngesandla kwabo kubo bonkhe labaLevi; neHilkiya, neZekariya, neJehiyeli, abaphathi bendlu yaNkulunkulu, banikela kubaLevi ngeminikelo yekushiswa yePasha emaviki lamakhulu mahlanu, anamakhulu lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu, nengulube lamakhulu amathathu.

Konania, naShemaya, naNethaneli, naHasabiya, naJeyeli, naJozabadi, bazalwane bakhe, abaphathi beLevi, banikela kubo bonkhe labaLevi ngekudla kwePasha: emakhowe lamakhulu mahlanu, nengulube lamakhulu mane.
Bafike balungiselela umnikelo wesono, batsi: "LabaLevi nalabaLevi babekwe emsebentini wabo, njengobe ukumkani abewisela umthetho.
Babulala lilanga lePasha, labaLevi banikela ngegazi labo kuma-Abhisheki; aba-Abhisheki nabo bakhipha isikhumba salabo.
Babeka phansi iminikelo yekushiswa, batsi: "Sitawuyinikela kubo bonkhe bantfu, ngemindeni yabo, kutsi bayinike kuSimakadze, njengobe kubhalwe encwadini yaMosesi; kanye nengulube bayenze njalo.
Bapheka iPasha ngemlilo, njengobe kubhalwe emthethweni; nezinto letingcwele bazivuza emabhodleleni, nemabhodleleni, nama-pans, bahamba bezisa kubo bonke bantfu.

Baye balungiselela nabo, nalabaLevi, ngobe labaLevi, bantfu baka-Aron, babesebenza ekulungiseleleni iminikelo yekushiswa neyokudla lokusetshenzisiwe kuze kube sebusuku; kodvwa labaLevi balungiselele nabo, nalabaLevi.

Nabazangeli, bantfu base-Asaphi, babekhona emsebentini wabo, njengobe kwashiwo nguDavide na-Asaphi na-Heman na-Jeduthuni lokubonako ukumkani; nalabo labagcina umsango babekhona emgwaqeni ngamunye; bengeke bafune kushiya umsebenzi wabo, ngobe bazalwane babo, labaLevi, bebalungiselela.
Ngaleyo ndlela kwabekwa yonke inkonzo yaSimakadze ngalolusuku, kutsi bagcine iPasha, neminikelo yekushiswa, emgodini waSimakadze, njengobe ukumkani Josiah abewisela.
Lamadvodza ase-Israyeli akhona agcine iPasha ngaleso sikhathi, kanye nemnyaka wekucala wekudla kwekungekhejiwe, iminyaka lesikhombisa.

Akukho Pasha lonjalo eSirayeli kusukela ngezinsuku taSamuweli umprofeti, nakubo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli abazange bagcine Pasha njengeleyo ayenze uYosiya, nalabaLevi, nalabaLevi, nalabaYuda, nalabaSirayeli labakhona, kanye nalabo baseYerusalem.
Le Pasha yafakwa kumnyaka weshumi nesikhombisa wekubusa kukaYosiya.
Ngaleso sikhathi, lapho uYosiya elungiselela khona indlu yaSimakadze, waphuma Nekho, inkhosi yase-Egipta, waya emkhosini eKarkemishi, eMfuleni i-Euphrates. UYosiya waphuma wehlisana naye.

Nekho wathumela labaholi kuye, watsi: "Iyini inkinga yakho nami, Simakadze Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli? Namuhla angeke ngifike ngikuhlasele wena, kepha ngikuhlasele inkhosi yami; ngobe uNkulunkulu utsi: 'Thintela; ungabi nenkinga noNkulunkulu, lowo lokhona nami, ukuze akukhulule.'"

Yosiya akazange abuye, kodvwa washintsha isikhumba sakhe kutsi abe nemphi yakhe naye. Akazange alalele amazwi kaNekho, ngobe lamazwi abo ayesuka kuNkulunkulu; watsi: "Ngiya kulwa emahlathini eMegido."
Amakhosi abulala uJosiya, watsi kubo labaphathi bakhe: "Ninikele, ngidlwengula kakhulu!"
Bayawukhipha ebhasini lakhe, babeka ebhasini lelinye, bafike eJerusalema. Wafa khona, wafunwa ethempelini lababa bakhe; bonkhe bantfu baseYuda nabaseJerusalema babemlingisa uYosiya.

Yeremiya wabhalela uYosiya emacwecwe emphiko, abe ngumnikelo wekushiswa kuYosiya kubo bonkhe lababhikisayo, amadoda nabesifazane, kuze kube ngalolusuku; lemahcwecwe aphindze abuye abe ngumnikelo wokushiswa eSirayeli; bona, ayabhalwe encwadini yamacwecwe.
Lokunye lokushiwo nguYosiya, nalokho akwentayo, kutsi agcine konke okubhalwe emthethweni waSimakadze,
Nawo wonke lamasiko akhe, akuqala naphesheya, bona, ayabhalwe encwadini yamabukhosi beSirayeli nawaseYuda.
Labantfu belizwe bathatha Jehoahazi, unyana waJosiya, bakwenza abe ngunkhosi eJerusalema endaweni yobaba wakhe.
UJehoahazi ubeneminyaka lemashumi lamane nathathu ubudala lapho aphuma khona ebukhosini, waba ngunkhosi iminyaka lesikhombisa eYerusalem.

Watsi ukumkani waseGibhithe wamisa kutsi angeke abe ngukumkakhe eJerusalema, watsi kuleyolizwe: "Kunesiliva lelikhulu nemashumi lamane namakhulu lamabili nesikhombisa kanye negolide lelishumi nesihlanu."
Unkhosi yaseMijiphu yaletsa uEliyakimu, umshado wakhe, abe nguMbuso waseYuda nawaseJerusalema, washintsha igama lakhe waba nguJehoyakim; nome uJoahas, umshado wakhe, Nekho wamthatha waya eMisri.
UYoyakimu ubeneminyaka engama-25 ubudala lapho ephuma ebukhosini, wahlala iminyaka lengema-11 eJerusalema. Wakwenza lokubi emehlweni kaNkulunkulu wakhe.
Waphuma naye Nebukhadnetsara, ukumkani waseBabiloni, wabeka sandla sakhe emgodini wegolide, kutsi afike eBabiloni.
NaNabukodonozore wakhipha naletinye tive tethempelini laSimakadze waya eBabyloni, wababeka ethempelini lakhe.

Lokunye lokushiwo nguYehoyakimi, nezinto takhe letibi azenzayo, nalowo wonke umonakalo lofunyelwe kuye, bona, kubhalwe encwadini yamakhosi aseSirayeli nawaseYuda. UJehoyakini, unyana wakhe, waba ngunkhosi nguNkulunkulu.
UJehoyakimu ubeneminyaka eyisishiyagalombili ubudala lapho afika khona ebukhosini, waba ngunkhosi iminyaka lesikhombisa eJerusalema; wakwenza lokudla lokubi ekubukeni kwaSimakadze.

Nalokudlula iminyaka lesikhombisa, ukumkani Nebukhadnezari wathumela afike amkhwele eBhabheli, naye naleyo mihlobiso yendlu yaSimakadze, wabeka uZedekiya, umngane wakhe, waba nguMbuso waseYuda naseJerusalema.
UZedekiya ubeneminyaka engama-21 ubudala kutsi abe ngunkhosi, wahlala iminyaka lengema-11 eYerusalem.
Wakwenza lokubi emehloni kaSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wakhe; akazange akhululeke phambi kwaYeremiya umprofeti, lapho abekhuluma khona amazwi kaSimakadze.

Waye wahlasela uNabukodonozori, ukumkani, lowo abemvumele ukuba afake isandla sakhe kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli; waba nemilenze eqinile, angeke abuyele kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli.
Nabo bonke abaviwa emabhishobhi, nalaba bantu, bakhulela ekuphazamisekeni, belandela zonke izinto ezibi tamasiko lalawo mazwe, babulala nendlu yaSimakadze, leyo indlu ayawuyingcwelesa eYerusalem.
Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, wathumela kubo ngesandla sakhembatswane, watsi: "Ngubani na lowo muntfu longeke abe ngumnikelo wesono kuSimakadze?'"

Baye baphazamisa baholi bakaNkulunkulu, baphoxela amazwi akhe, bahlaba umxhwele boprofeta bakhe; kuze kwafika lapho indlala yaSimakadze iphuma ngayo kubo bonkhe bantfu bakhe, kube angeke abe nendlela yokuyisa.

Wababeka phezu kwabo ukumkani wakwa-Babyloni, wabulala labangani babo ngekhefu endlwini yabo lengcwele; akazange akhululeke umfana, noma indodakazi, noma umshado, noma lomusha, noma lomnyama; wabanikela kuwo.
Wonke umhlobiso wethempelini laNkulunkulu, omkhulu nancane, kanye nempahla yendlu yaSimakadze, nempahla yobukhosi nempahla yabaphathi bakhe, wazisa eBabheleni.
Batfusa indlu yaNkulunkulu, baphuca umbhoshongo weJerusalema, batfusa naleyo ndlu yonke, babulala zonke izinto letibalulekile.
Nalabo abazange bahlaselwe ngesandla, wabeka eBabyloni, babe ngabakhonzi bakhe kanye nabanake, kuze kube kwafika ubukhosi basePersiya.
Lakho kwabe kulungile, lokushiwo nguSimakadze ngesandla saYeremiya, kutsi lelizwe likhululeke ekuphumuleni kwayo; kuze kube kuphele iminyaka lemashumi lamane nesikhombisa.

Ngomnyaka wokuqala waKoresh, ukumkani wasePersiya, Simakadze watsi nguNkulunkulu lowo mlomo wakhe labewukhuluma ngesandla saYeremiya; ngobe uSimakadze wehlisele emlonyeni waKoresh, inkhosi yasePersiya, kutsi amemetele kuwo wonke umhlaba wakhe, abebhalela, esithi:

Kutsi kusho u-Koresh, ukumkani wasePersiya: Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wemazulu, uninikele tonkhe tive temhlaba; yena ungisikhethela kutsi ngikhembise indlu yakhe eJerusalema, elise-Yudea. Nalowo nalowo phakathi kwenu lobe ngumuntfu waNkulunkulu wakhe, angaya khona, ngobe Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wabo, uya naye.
Ezra: Ngomnyaka wokuqala waKoresh, ukumkani wasePersiya, Simakadze watsi nguNkulunkulu lowo mlomo wakhe labewukhuluma ngesandla saYeremiya; ngobe uSimakadze wehlisele emlonyeni waKoresh, inkhosi yasePersiya, kutsi amemetele kuwo wonke umhlaba wakhe, abebhalela, esithi:
Ngako-ke uKore, ukumkani wasePersiya, watsi: Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wemazulu, unginikela ngaso sonke ibukhosi bemhlaba; yena wangisikhethela kutsi ngikhembise indlu yakhe eJerusalema, lekubo Yuda.
Nalowo nalowo phakathi kwenu lobe ngumunye webantfu bakhe, afike eJerusalema eYuda; Nkulunkulu wakhe abe naye, aze avule indlu yaSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, yena uNkulunkulu waseJerusalema.

Nakweyiphi na indawo lapho kukhona khona lomunye webantfu bakhe, labahlali baleyo ndawo kumele bamcede ngesiliva, negolide, nempahla, nemfuyo, kanye neminikelo yekushiswa yendlu yaNkulunkulu eJerusalema.

Baphuma khona bomkhuluwa bamndeni wakwaJuda nawaseBhenjamini, kanye nabaLevi nalabaLevi, nabo bonkhe labo Nkulunkulu wabolile emphefumulweni wabo, besuka babuyela eJerusalema bakwakha indlu yaSimakadze.
Nabo bonke labo babahlala nabo babebasekela ngesiliva, negolide, nempahla, nemfuyo, nezinto ezicophelela, ngaphandle kwalowo wonke lomnikelo wesono.
Umkwehluleli u-Koresh wakhipha naleyo mihlobiso yendlu yaSimakadze, leNabukodonozore abeyisuse eJerusalema, wababeka endlwini yoNkulunkulu wakhe.
Kuye kuboshwa ngu-Koresh, inkhosi yasePersiya, watsi kuMithredathi, umphathi wempahla yegolide: wababala kuye uSheshbazar, lomkhuluwa waseYuda.
Lena inombolo yabo: tibhaka tegolide tamashumi lasitfupha, tibhaka tesiliva lamakhulu lamabili, nemacwecwe lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu,
emabhodlela egolide lamashumi lasitfupha, nemabhodlela esiliva lamakhulu laneshumi, neminye imihlobiso lemile.

Kube nezinto tonkhe tegolide, nesiliva, nesilivere, lamakhulu mahlanu, lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu; Sheshbazari wazisa nazo zonke ngesandla sakhe, lapho lababoshwa befika khona eJerusalema kusuka eBabeli.
Laba bayawubuyela eJerusalema naseYuda, ngamunye wabo waya emzini wakhe, labasuka ekuhambeni kwebantfu base-Asiriya, labakwaNabukodonozore, ukumkani waseBabiloni, abewakhipha eBhabhiloni.
Bafike naboZerubabele, neJeshua, naNehemiya, naSerayavalo, naRelayawalo,ماندهdekai, naBilshani, naMishpari, naBigwai, naRehumu, naBaana; le yinombolo yamadoda aseSirayeli:
Lamadvodza la-Paroshe alikhulu, elinamakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamatsatfu.
Lamadvodzana aShefatiya belikhulu, elinamashumi lamane nesikhombisa nambili.
Lamadvodza la-Araha, amakhulu lamabili nesikhombisa, lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu.
Lamadodana ePahati-Moabi, aJeshuwa naYowabe, lamakhulu mahlanu, emakhulu lasitfupha nemashumi lamabili nesikhombisa.
Lamadvodza la-Elam, lamakhulu lamabili nemashumi mahlanu nesihlanu.
Lamadvodzana aZathu bekungumakhulu lamane, lamashumi lamabili nasihlanu.
Lamadvodzana aZakhayi bekungumakhulu lamabili nesikhombisa namashumi lamane.
Lamadvodzana aBani bekungumakhulu lamane, lamashumi lamabili nesitfupha.
Lamadvodzana aBebayi belikhulu elinamakhulu lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu.
Lamadodana a-Azgadi, lamakhulu lamabili nemashumi mahlanu nasitfupha.
Labantwana ba-Adonikamu, makhulu mane, lamashumi lamane nesihlanu.
Lamadodana eBigwai, lama-2056.
Lamadvodza la-Adin alikhulu, elinamahlanu nasitfupha.
Lamadvodza la-Atere, asuka ku-Hezekiya, lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa namane.
Lamadodana aBezayi, lamakhulu lamabili nemashumi matatu nasitfupha.
Lamadvodzana aJora bekungumakhulu lamabili nesihlanu.
Lamadodana aHashumi, lamakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamane nasitfupha.
Lamadvodzana aGibhari bekungumashumi lamane nesihlanu.
Lamadoda eBethlehem, lamakhulu lamabili nemashumi matatu.
Lamadoda eNetofa, lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu.
Lamadoda eAnathothi, lamakhulu lamabili nemashumi mahlanu nasitfupha.
Lamadvodza la-Azmavethi, lamashumi mane namakhulu mahlanu.
Lamadoda eKirihati-Arim, neKefira, naBeerothi, lamakhulu lamabili nesikhombisa, lamashumi manhlanu nasitfupha.
Lamadodana eRama neGeba, lamakhulu mane, lamashumi lamabili nalinye.
Lamadodana eMikmasi, lamakhulu lamabili nemashumi mahlanu nasitfupha.
Lamadoda eBetheleli na-Ai, lamakhulu lamabili nemashumi mahlanu nesihlanu.
Lamadodana eNebo, lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu.
Lamadodana eMagbisi, lamakhulu lamabili nemashumi mahlanu namane.
Lamadvodzana a-Elam, labalikhulu elinamakhulu lasitfupha nesihlanu.
Lamadodana aHarimi, lamakhulu lamabili nemashumi matatu.
Lamadoda eLodi, neHadidi, na-Ono, lamakhulu lamabili nesikhombisa, lamashumi mahlanu.
Lamadodana eJerikho, lamakhulu matatu, lamashumi mane nesihlanu.
Lamadodana eSinaya, lamakhulu matatu, lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu.
LabaLevi: bantfu bakaJedaya, emndenini ka-Jeshuau, bamakhulu lamane, lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu.
Lamadodana a-Imeri, lamakhulu lamabili nemashumi mahlanu nasitfupha.
Lamadvodzana aPashuri belikhulu elinamakhulu lasitfupha nesikhombisa.
Lamadvodzana aHarimi belikhulu elinamahlanu namashumi lasikhombisa.
LaLevi: bantfu bakaJeshua naKadmiyeli, labaseHoeva, babemashumi lamane nesikhombisa nesihlanu.
Labangani ba-Asaf, labazangeli, babemakhulu lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu.
Labaphathi bemnyango: bantfu bakaShalumu, ne-Ateri, ne-Talmoni, ne-Akubi, ne-Hathita, ne-Shobai, lamakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamane nasitfupha nesikhombisa.
Lamadoda aNethinimi: lamadvodzana aZiha, neHasupha, naTabaothi,
Keros, neSiaha, nePadon,
Lebana, Hagaba, Akkub,
Hagabi, neShamlai, neHanani,
Giddele, neGahari, neReaya,
neRezini, neNekoda, neGazzam,
Uza, Paseha, Besai,
Asna, neMeunim, neNephisim,
Bakbuki, neHakupha, neHarhuri,
Bazluthi, neMehida, naHarsha,
Barkosi, neSisera, neTema,
Neziya, neHatipha.
Lamadodana labangani bakaSolomoni: amadodana kaSotai, neHasoferethi, nePeruda,
Jaala, neDarkoni, neGiddeli,
Shefatiya, Hathili, Pokhereti-Hazebayim, naAmi.
Bonke labaLevi bendlu yaSimakadze, kanye nemadvodzana aSolomoni,evayo, babemakhulu amathathu, lamashumi mahlanu namane nambili.
Bakhona labasuka emigwaqweni yaseTel Melah, Tel Harsha, Cherub, Addan, ne Immer, kepha bangeke bakwazi kukhombisa ukuthi mindeni yabo yavela e- ayarael.
Lamadvodza laDelaya, naTobiya, naNekoda abengamakhulu mane, lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu.
Labo baLevi: lamadvodzana aHobaya, bekuboHakosi, nemadvodzakati aBarzilayi; barzilayi abekwati indodana yaBarzilayi, loGileyadi, wathatha igama lakhe.
Baye bafuna amagama abo emibhalweni yemindeni yabo, kodvwa bangawatholanga; ngakho-ke abavunyelwe ukuba basebenze njengemabhishobhi.
Wabaphendvula watsi: "Akufanele nidle lekudla lokungcwele kakhulu, kuze kufike kube khona umkhonzi lokhuluma nge-Urim ne-Thummim."
Lomndeni wonke, kanye nabo, waba ngumashumi lamane nambili lamakhulu lamabili nemakhulu matatu, namashumi lasikhombisa,
ngaphandle kwalabo labasebenza nabo, abemikhulu lesikhombisa, nemakhulu matatu, namashumi lasitfupha nesihlanu; kanye nalabazangeli, abemikhulu lemibili.
Banemahhashi lamakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamane nesihlanu, nemamu afihle lamakhulu mahlanu namakhulu mane.
tingulube tamakhulu lamane, lamashumi lasitfupha nesihlanu, nemakhosa lamakhulu lamabili nasikhombisa.
Bafika ethempelini laSimakadze eJerusalema, banikela ngemnikelo lokudla kanye newayini, kutsi babuye bavule kabusha indlu yaNkulunkulu endaweni yayo.
Banikela kuleyo mali yekwakha, banikela ngemakhulu lasihlanu emakilogramu egolide, nemakhulu lasitfupha emakilogramu esilivere, namashumi lalishumi nemahlanu emaroba a aya kubabusi.
Bakhona labaLevi, nalabapristi, nebantfu, na pekoti, nalabo bagcina-mlilo, nalabo baseNethinimi, nabo bonkhe bantfu bakaSirayeli bahlala emadolobhani abo.áke bahlala emathempelini abo.
Wafika lomnyaka wesitsatfu, bantfu beSirayeli bahlala emadolobhaneni abo; bonkhe bantfu bahlangana njengelinye ibandla eJerusalema.

Baye bamisa Jesua, umsa wa-Yosadaki, nabangani bakhe labaLevi, naZerubabele, umsa waShealtiyeli, nabangani bakhe, bekwakha ithempeli loNkulunkulu waseSirayeli, kutsi banikela kuyo ngeminikelo yekushiswa, njengobe kubhalwe emthethweni kaMosi, indodana yaSimakadze.
Baye baphindze babuye bakwakha indlu yesithende sekudutshuzwako lapho behlala khona, banikela ngenhlanhla ngeminikelo yekushiswa kuSimakadze ngaso sonke isikhathi, ekuseni nakusihlwa.
Baye bahlela usuku lwetindlu letifile, njengobe kubhalwe emthethweni, benikela ngekudla lokubuswe ngaso sonke sikhatsi.
Ngemuva kwaleso, banikela ngemnikelo wekushiswa lohlala njalo, neminikelo yemikhosi yenyanga entsha, nayinye yemithendeleko lengcwele kaSimakadze, kanye nemnikelo wesono lokukhethwa nguNkulunkulu.
Baqale banikela ngeminikelo yekushiswa kuSimakadze kusukela ngosuku lokuqala lwenyanga yesishiyagalombili, nalapho isisekelo sethempelini laSimakadze sengingeke sibekwe khona.

Banikela ngemali kulabo labasebenza emapulangwe nalabakhangisi, banikela nekudla, nekudla lokudlidliza, nephethroli kulabo baseSidoni nabaseTyre, kutsi bafike besuka eLibanoni bafike eJopa ngelwandle, bekhipha isihlahla sesedolobheni, njengobe kwavunyelwa nguKoresh, ukumkani wasePersi.

Ngomnyaka wesibili ngemuva kokufika kwabo ethempelini laNkulunkulu laseJerusalema, ngenyanga yesikhombisa baqala uZerubabele mntwana waShealtiyele, naJeshua umnyana kaJozadaka, kanye nabo bonkhe lababoshwa babo abapristi neLevi, nabo bonke labo ababesuka entolongweni befike eYerusalem. Babeka emaLevi aneminyaka engama-20 kuya phezulu ukuba abe ngabaphathi bezindlu taSimakadze.

Bafike bahlangana Jesuha, nemadvodzana akhe, nemadvodzakati akhe, naKadmiyeli, nemadvodzakati akhe, lamakhosikazi eJudha, nabo bonkhe bantfu labasebenzela indlu yaNkulunkulu; nabomadvodzana aHenadadi, nemadvodzana abo, nemindeni yabo, labaLevi, babebasekela.

Nalapho labo bamisa isisekelo sethempelini laSimakadze, behlala khona labaLevi, bantfu base-Asafoti, nalabaLevi base-Amoni, nabo bonkhe labashumayeli kanye nemindeni yabo, bahlala lapha, bekhuluma kuNkulunkulu, njengobe uDavide, ukumkani waseSirayeli, abewise.

Bahamba nabo, babonga uSimakadze, besithi: "UNkulunkulu ungulungile; ngobe uthando lwakhe kuSirayeli luhlala kuze kube sekupheleni." 11Nabo bonke abantu babekhuluma ngezwi elikhulu lokubonga Simakadze, ngoba isisekelo sendlu ka-Simakadze sabekwa.

Baningi nabaholi bamakhosi, nemadvodzana a-Ahikamu, nemadvodzakati a-Ahikamu, labazange babone lendlu yangaphambilini, lapho kubekwe khona isisekelo sendlu leyo, baphuma beshaya ngesandla sabo; kodvwa abaningi nabo baphuma beshaya ngenhla.

Angeke kube khona lowo lokwaziyo kutsi kuphi kuhlukana phakathi kwelizwi lekuphumula nelizwi lekulingisa, ngobe labaholi bebantfu babekhuluma ngekuthula; ingoma yabo yatsi: "Lomuntfu waNkulunkulu uhlala eJerusalema"
Batsi labaphikisayo baYuda naBenjamini beva kutsivalo lokushiwo nguSimakadze,ماندهma weSirayeli, utsi: 21"UNkulunkulu wase-Israyeli uyawuhlala eJerusalema.

Bafike bahlangana naZerubabele nebaholi bemindeni yabo, batsi kubo: "Siyawukusekela kuwe ekwakhani, ngobe siyawukhonza Nkulunkulu wakho kanye nawe; naye siyawunikela ngenhlanhla kuye kusukela ngezinsuku ta-Esar-Haddonu, inkhosi yase-Ashuri, lowawutfusa lapha."

Zerubabele, naJeshua, nabanye bomkhuluwa bemindeni yakwaSirayeli baphendvula batsi: "Kungeke kube nani kanye nathi ekubumbeni indlu kuNkulunkulu wethu; siyawubuyela singenakho ukwakha indlu kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, njengobe uKoresh, ukumkani wasePersiya, watsi kuthi."
Batsi nabo bonkhe bantfu belizwe, batsatsa isandla sabo, batsi: "Asikuvumeleni kutsi nibuye nivule indlu yakho!"
Baye bakhokhela labaphambukeli, kutsi baphikisane nabo, batsuse umcabango wabo, kuze kube sekuphele iminyaka lemikhulu ka-Koresh, ukumkani wasePersi, kuya kuDariyosi, ukumkani wePersi.
Kuqaleni kwekubusa kuka-Asheshazari, babhalela icala labahlali baseYuda nawaseJerusalema, batsi:
Ezikhathini ta-Artaxerxeshasi, Bishlamu, naMitredatha, naTabeeli, kanye nebaholi babo babhalela ku-Artaxerxesi, inkhosi yasePersiya, ngesandla seSirayeli, nemibhalo yaso ngesiHebheru.
Rehum, umvikeli wenkhosi, neShimshai, lobhala, babhalela kutsi: "KuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, khuluma, utrakte iJerusalema.
Kusuka ku-Rehum, umvikeli wenkhosi, neShimshai, lobhalela, nabangane babo: labameli, nabaphathi, nabo bonkhe bantfu base Ereki, naseBabyloni, naseShushani eElam, kanye nalobunye buhlanga.
kanye nebantfu labase-Asiriya, labagcotshwa ngu-Ashurbanipala, lomkhulu nalowo mkhulu, wabeka kubo eJerusalema, nakweminye imifula yaseMfuleni i fikhetse.
Leyi kopi yeletafula labathumela kulo: "Kukumkani Artaxerxes, kusuka kulabo abasebenza nawe, labantfu baseMfuleni i-Ephratha.
Kucace kuye ukumkani, kutsi labaYuda labaphuma kuwe bafike nathi eJerusalema, bebuyela kulo mji longcolile nelobi, bewulungisa umbhoshongo wakhe, bewumisa isisekelo sakhe, bekhuluma kubo:
Kungafanele kube khona ubufakazi bokuthi uma le miji iphinde yakhiwa futhi imidwebo yayo iphele, bazoyeka ukukhokha tithembiso, imali kanye nemirhumo, ngakho-ke imali aya kulahlekelwa.
Lakho, ngobe sesikuhloniphi lendlu yasebukhosini, asifuni kubona kutsi loMbuso WaseRoma ushonwa; ngakho-ke siyawuthumela kunkhosi kutsi itsi:

ufike ufune encwadini yamasiko lababa takho, ubone kutsi ledolobha leli yidolobha elinobugebengu, nelinye lelibangele tinhlekelele kumabukhosi nemadolobha, kanye nendzawo yebugebengu kusukela kuleso sikhathi; ngakho lalinqunywe.
Sikhuluma kunkhosi kutsi, uma lodolobha leli likhiwa kabusha, netingqamuzana tayo tiqediwe, ungeke ube nento enyakatho-ntshonalanga yeMfula iFurathi.
Unkhosi yaphendvula yatsi: "Ku-Rehumu, umvikeli, neShimshai, umbhali, nabangane babo labahlala eSamariya, kanye nabo bonkhe bantfu basekuphesheya komfula i-Euphrates, sibonga.
Lencwadi lewutfumelele nathi lihunyushwe lifundwe kimi.
Ngatsi nginike umyalo, kwafunwa kutsi lowo mji uphindze ube sewuphucukile ekungeneni kwenkhosi kusukela kuleso sikhathi, kube yindawo yekuphazamisa kanye nekuphikisa.
Bakhona bantfu labakhulu labahlala eJerusalema, nakwesokudla kweMfula i-Euphrates; baphindze bakhokhelwa mnikelo wesono, neminikelo yekushiswa, neminye imvume.
Ngako-ke khipha umyalo kutsi laba bantu bagwenywe, ngobe lomhlaba ungeke ube sewukhiwa, kuze kube ngumthetho wami.
Lapha, qaphela kutsi ungeke ukhohlwe ngalolu daba; ngobe yini lenkinga ikhule ibe yingozi kunkhosi?"
Kuze kube incwadi yekumkani Artaxerxes yafundwa kuRehumu, neShimshai, umbhali, nalabo labahamba nabo, baphuma befike eJerusalema kubo bonkhe bantfu base-Israyeli, batsi:
Lendlu yaNkulunkulu yaseJerusalema yamiswa, yamiswa kuze kube ngumnyaka wesitsatfu wekubusa kukaDariuse, inkhosi yasePersiya.

La sinhe sifike eJerusalema, kwafika khona umprofeti Haggai kanye noZekariya unyana ka-Iddo, bakhuluma kubo bonkhe bantfu baseYuda nabaseJerusalema, bekhuluma nabo ngesiHebheru, ngegama leNkulunkulu waseSirayeli.
Zerubabele, umsa waShealtiyele, naJeshua, umsa waJozadaki, babuyela bekwakha indlu yaSimakadze eJerusalema; nabo babekhona bantfu labaprofeti baNkulunkulu lababasekela.

Ngeleso sikhathi wafika kubo Tatenai, umphathi wendzawo yebukhosi yaseMfula i-Euphrates, naShethar-bozenai, nalabo labahamba nabo, batsi kubo: "Ubani labekulethela imvume yokwakha indlu lenjalo, nokulungisa lodonga?
Baphendvula batsi: "Labaphi amagama labesifazane labasebenza kulendlu?"
Ngako-ke labaholi beSirayeli babe ngaphansi kwemtsetfo waNkulunkulu, kodvwa labavalo babengabavimbeli;ماندهma akazange abonise kuDariuse, kuze kube kwafika impendulo ngencwadi.
Lolu bhalo lubhalwe nguTatenai, umvikeli wendzawo yekubusa yaseMfuleni i-Euphrates, naShethar-bozenai, nalabo labahamba nabo, labameli baseMfula i-Euphrates, bathumela kunkhosi Dariosi.
Ba babhalela kutsi: "Kukumkani Dariusi, kuthula nekuthula.

"Kube kucace kubo kutsi sifike esifundazweni sakaJuda, endlwini yaNkulunkulu lomkhulu; ikhiwa ngetikhonkwane ezinkulu, netingcweti tifakwa emaphahleni; lemisebenzi icutshungulwa kahle kakhulu, futhi iyahamba kahle.
Sikhuluma kubo, sitsi: 'Ngubani lokwenta kutsi niphindenise indlu lenjalo, niqedele ledonga?'
Sicela nabo amagama abo, kutsi sibhale kuwe lamagama labaholi babo.
Batsi impendulo yabo, batsi: "Siye labakhonzi baNkulunkulu wezulu nemhlaba, sibuye sivule kabusha indlu leyo yakhiwa eminyakeni emikhulu edlule, lapho loMbuso WaseSirayeli omkhulu abewusungula khona.
Batawutsi batfu bakhabula uNkulunkulu wasezulu, wabeka emandleni kaNabukodonozore, umphathi weBhabhiloni, lowaseBabyloni; waphula indlu lenjalo, wakhipha labantfu waya eBhabheli.
Kusemnyaka wokuqala wa-Koresh, inkhosi yaseBabiloni, unkhosi Koresh yakhipha umyalelo kutsi lendlu yaNkulunkulu ibuyiselwe.

Nasetinhlamvu zegolide nezesiliva tethempelini laNkulunkulu, labeNabukodonozore abezikhipha eJerusalema, aze azifake ethempelini laseBhabhiloni, uMbuso waseKuro wazisa ethempelini laseBabyloni, wabanikela kulowo owayebizwa ngokuthi nguSheshbazar, lowawungumphathi.
UKore watsi kuye: "Thiba lezinto, uzibeke emuva ethempelini laseJerusalema, uvule kabusha indlu yaSimakadze endaweni yayo."
Wafika khona uSheshbazar, wabeka isisekelo sendlu yaNkulunkulu eJerusalema; kusukela ngalomnyaka wakhiwa, kodvwa kuze kube manje akazange aphelelwe.

Ngako-ke, uma kungukulungile kunkhosi, lifunwe ngencwadi yembuso yaseBabiloni, libone kutsi ngabe nguSimakadze longuSomandla, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, lowawutsi: "Yiba nendlu lengcwele kaNkulunkulu eJerusalema," khona-ke Simakadze utawutfumisa.
Watsi uMbuso WaseDariyosi wakhipha umyalelo, kutsi kuhlolwe emabhukwana agcinwe ethempelini laseBabeli.
Wafunwa umbhalo esiteshini sebukhosi sase-Ekbatani, esifundazweni saMediya, wabhalwa khona kutsi:

Ngemnyaka wokuqala waKumkani Koresi, kwaphuma umyalelo kuSimakadze mayelana nendlu yaNkulunkulu eJerusalema, watsi: 11"Lendlu lengcwele kufanele ibuyiselwe ibe yindawo lapho banikela khona ngeminikelo. Isisekelo sayo kumele sibekwe kahle; ubude bayo kumele bube ngama-cubits lamashumi lamabili namane kanye nobubanzi bawo bangama-cubits lamakhulu mane.
Lendlu kumele ibe nemiganga emithathu yetitshe letikhulu, kanye nemiganga lemibili yetihlahla letitsha; izindleko kumele zikhokhwe kusuka ezimalini tenkhosi.

Nase nezinto tegolide nesilivere tethempelini laNkulunkulu, leNabukodonozore abezikhipha ethempelini laseJerusalema wazisa eBabyloni, kumele zibuyiselwe ethempelini laseJerusalema, libekwe endaweni yalo ethempelini laNkulunkulu.
Watsi uDariuse wabhala, watsi: "Namuhla, Tatenai, umphathi wendzawo lephakeme yaseMfula i-Ephrathi, naShethar-Bozenai, kanye nabo bonkhe bantfu bakho baseMfula i-Ephrathi, hlalani lapha.
Watsi kubo: "Lahla lendlu yaSimakadze, kutsi umphathi wema-Israyeli na rephabliki lamaJuda abuye abe nendlu yaNkulunkulu kulendawo yayo.

Nami ngikulethela umyalelo kutsi nihlangane nalaba baholi beSirayeli, nivule lendlu yaNkulunkulu; nemali yenkhosi, esuka ema-arabu asentshonalanga yeMfula i-Euphrates, kumele ikhokhwe kubo bonke laba bantu, ukuze kube khona ukuthula.

Lokudla kwabo kumele kunikezwe nsuku zonke, ngaphandle kwenkinga: ingulube lencane, nemvu, nenyama yenkomo, njengeminikelo yekushiswa kuNkulunkulu wezulu; kanye nembewu, nefulawa, newayini, nephethroli, ngokwesicelo semaLevi aseYerusalem.
Baye banikela ngeminikelo yekushiswa efanele kuNkulunkulu wezulu, bathandaza becela kuphila kwenkhosi nemadvodzana akhe.
Nami ngiletsa kutsi, uma ngabe kukhona lashintsha lomthetho, kumele kucutshwe intambo ekhayeni lakhe, babekwe phansi bahlala kuyo; indlu yabo kufanele ibe ngudvo lwetikhukhula ngenxa yaleso.

LoNkulunkulu, loyawubeka khona igama lakhe, agweme ubukhosi kanye nebantfu labafuna kutsi bashintshe lesi sinqumo, basuse lendlu yaSimakadze eJerusalema. Ngiye, Dariosi, ngakhipha lesi sinqumo; kumele sicutshungulwe kahle.
Tatenai, umvikeli wendzawo lephakeme yaseGibhithe, neShethar-bozenai, nalabo labahamba nabo, bakwenta kahle konkhe loko lapho uMbuso WaseDariuse abewuletsa khona.

LamaJuda ahlala ekwakha, asebenza kahle, ngesandla semaprofeti uHageyasi neZekariya unyana ka-Ido; basungula indlu yaNkulunkulu waseSirayeli, kanye nemyalo waKoresh naDarioshi naArtaxerxesi, bobukhosi basePersiya, bamisa, bewuphelelisa.
Lendlu yaSimakadze yaqedwa ngelilanga lesithathu lenyanga ye-Adar, ngonyaka wesihlanu wekubusa kukaDario.
Ba sinheli, nalabaLevi, nalabaLevi, nabo bonkhe bantfu lababuyayo ebantwaneni babo, banikela ngekuthula indlu yaloNkulunkulu.

Banikela ekubetweni kwalendlu kaNkulunkulu ngengulube lelikhulu, nemvu lelikhulu lamane, nenyama yenkomo lelikhulu lamane; nabo banikela ngemnikelo wesono webantfu baka-Israyeli, ngembudzi lolishumi nambili, ngayinye inhlanga yemadvodzana a-Israyeli.
Babeka bantfu labapristi nelabaLevi ngemindeni yabo, kutsi basebenze kuSimakadze eJerusalema, njengobe bekubhalwe ekhulwini laMosi.
Labantfu labasuka ebutsheni bagcine iPasha ngelilanga lelishumi nelinesihlanu lenyanga yokuqala.
Baphindze banikela ngepasha kubo bonkhe bantfu lababuyayo, nabangane babo abaLevi kanye nabo; ngobe labaLevi nebaholi bemindeni yabo bebengabi nalutho ngaphandle kwalabo lababuyelayo.
Lamadvodza labuyela ebantwini base-Isirayeli ayawudla iPasha, kanye nalabo bonke labahlukaniswe nendlela lengcolile yebantfu baleso lizwe, kutsi babe nguSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Isirayeli.

Bagcine usuku lwemifino engaqhwabiwe iminyaka leyisithupha, bejabulile; ngobe Simakadze abebajabulise, washintsha umphefumulo wenkhosi yase-Ashuri, ukuba abambe isandla sabo emsebenzini wendlu kaNkulunkulu, loNkulunkulu waseSirayeli.
Ngaleso sikhathi, ngelilanga leArtaxerxesi, inkhosi yasePersiya, kwabekhona umuntu lokuthiwa nguEzra, unyana kaSeraya, unyana kaAzaria, unyana kaHilkiya,
lomnyaka waShalumu, womnyaka waTsadoko, womnyaka waAhitubi,
yena u-Amariya, yena u-Azaria, yena u-Merayothi,
lomnyaka waZerahiya, womnyaka waUzi, womnyaka waBukki,
lomnyaka wa-Abishuwa, womnyaka wa-Phinehasi, womnyaka wa-Eleazari, womnyaka wa-Aron, umLevi.

Lo Ezra waphuma eBabheleni, waba ngumfundi lowaziyo kahle umthetho waMosi, kanye nemtsetfo waSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, lowo umnikelo wesono. Unkhosi yanikela kuye ngaso sonke sipho sakhe, ngobe Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakhe, wayemsiza.
Bafike naye na sinhe semadvodzana a-Isirayeli, eJerusalema, kumnyaka wesitsatfu wenkhosi Artaxerxes, kanye nabaholi bebandla, neLevi, nalabobandlululi, nalabagwebi, nalabaNethinimi.
UEzra wafika eJerusalema kumnyaka wesikhombisa, ngenyanga yesihlanu yombuso.
Waphuma eBabyloni ngelilanga lokuqala lenyanga yokuqala, wafika eJerusalema ngelilanga lokuqala lenyanga yesihlanu; ngobe isandla lesihle saNkulunkulu sakhe sabe sikhona kuye.
UEzra wabeka umphefumulo wakhe ekufundeni mthetho kaSimakadze, kutsi awuphumele, nalapho efundisa khona emaSirayeli imiyalo nemithetho.
Lolu bhalo lubhalwe ngukumkani Artaxerxes, lwafakwa kuEzra, umLevi, umbhali, lowaziyo imiyalo yaSimakadze kanye nemithetho yakhe ngeSirayeli.
Artaxerxes, ukumkani wema-Israyeli, uya kuEzra, umLevi, lowaziyo mthetho waNkulunkulu wezulu: Sihlekelele.
Lapha ngikhipha umyalelo kutsi wonke lamakhosikazi aseSirayeli, nalabaLevi, nalabaLevi, labakhona ebukhosini bam, labo bafuna kuhamba neJerusalema, bangaya nawe.
ngobe wena uthunyelwe nguSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, utsi: 1valo lomtsetfo waNkulunkulu wakho,ماندهko akho kanye nemphilo yakho, niwugcine.
uthathe ngesandla sakho isiliva negolide, lenkhosi nalabameli bayo banikela ngayo ngokukhululeka kuNkulunkulu waseSirayeli, lohlala eYerusalem.

kanye negolide ne sinhebe lesisha lesikhona esifundazweni saseBauroni, kanye naleyo minikelo yekushiswa yebantfu neyebaholi bebandla labanikela ngesandla sabo ekhaya laSimakadze Nkulunkulu wabo, lelingaseJerusalema.
Uye usebenzise lemali, uthenge ngesandla ingulube, nemvu, nenyama yenja, kanye neminikelo yawo yekudla, neminikelo yayo yokushiswa, uyinikeze ethempelini laNkulunkulu wenu laseJerusalema.
Ngelegolide nesilivere lesiseleko, wena kanye nabangani bakho labaYuda ningeke nikwenze ngendlela lekahle emehlo enu, njengobe Nkulunkulu wenu afuna.
Utawunikela kuNkulunkulu waseJerusalema zonke izinto letitfunyelwe kuwe, kutsi usebentise endlwini yaNkulunkulu wakho.
Nakwesiphi nasinye sipho lesingeke sifuneke endlwini yaSimakadze sakho, ungasinikela kuleyo ndlu yenkhosi.

Nami, ukumkani Artaxerxes, ngibeka umthetho kubo bonkhe labaphatha impahla enyakatho yeMfula i-Euphrates, kutsi noma yini lapho Ezra umpristi, lofundi wemtsetfo waNkulunkulu wasezulu, akufunisa khona kuwe, utawuyinikela ngokushesha.

kuze kube ngumakhulu lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu ematoni esiliva, nama-cors lalikhulu letinkomo, nemalitha lalishumi elinamahlanu wewayini, nalamalitha lasitfupha nesikhombisa wamafutha omnqumo, kanye nemhluzi loyawufuna.
Lonke mthetho waSimakadze Nkulunkulu wemazulu, kumele ugcwaliseke ngesandla sakhe, kutsi kungeke kube nebuhlungu ebukhosini benkhosi nabendvuna bakhe.

Siyawukutshela kutsi angeke ukhokhe mnikelo wesono, noma iminikelo yekushiswa, nanoma yini ekhokhelwa ngaleyo indlu yaNkulunkulu kubo bonkhe labaphatsimandla, neLeviti, nabacwengisi, nalabagwebi, naseNethinimi.

Nakho wena, Ezra, sebenzisa ubuhlakani boNkulunkulu wakho, obubekwe esandla sakho, ubeke abameli nebaholi, balinganise bonke abantu baseMfula i-Euphrates, labawazi umthetho waSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho; nalowo angawufundi, ungawufundisa.
Nalowo longeke sinhlele umthetho waNkulunkulu wakho, namthetho wenkhosi, kufanele agwenywe ngokushesha, noma ngekufa, noma ngekuboshwa, noma ngekubanjwa kwempahla yakhe, noma ngekuboshwa.
UEzra watsi: "Kube kuhlonishwa uSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, lowo wabeka kulomoya wenkhosi kutsi ihlobise indlu yaNkulunkulu eYerusalem.

Nase-ke ngibe nemandla, ngobe uSimakadze Nkulunkulu wami ubengisekela; ngahlangana nabaholi bakaSirayeli kutsi bafike nami. 11Batsi: "Ngubani loyawuhamba nathi? UNkulunkulu wenkhosi yaseYiputa, lowo atawufika nani?"
Nalaba baholi bemindeni, kanye nalabo lababhalwa ngenombolo yabo, bafike nami kusuka eBhabheli, lapho uArthashasheti, inkhosi yasetrakthesari, ehlala khona.
Labo baphuma emndenini waPhinehasi, nguGershoni; labo baphuma emndenini wa-Ithamari, nguDaniele; labo baphuma emndenini waDavide, nguHatushi.
Labo babe nguZekariya, umsa waShekaniya, umsa waParoshi; naye abe nemadodana akhe labhaliswe ngemindeni yabo lamakhulu lamashumi mahlanu.
Ngabomadvodzana aPahati-Moab, bekunguElihoyenayi, umsa waZerahiya; naye nomesilisa langamakhulu lamabili.
Lamadvodza laShekaniya, umsa wa-Yahaziyeli, kanye naye lamadoda langamakhulu matatu.
Ngabomadvodzana aAdini bekungu-Ebed, indodana ya-Yonathani; kanye naye bantfu labamashumi lamane.
Nasemadvodzana aElam bekunguJesahiya, umsa wa-Athaliya; kanye naye bantfu labamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa.
Nasemadvodzana aShefatiya, bekunguZebadia unyana kaMikayeli, naye abesilisa lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu.
Ngabomadvodzana aJowabe: Obadiya, umsa waJehiyeli; kanye naye lamadodana lamakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamane nasitfupha.
Kulabo bantfu bakaShelomiti, nguYosifoya; naye nalabamadoda langamakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamane.
Nasemadvodzana aBebayi:Zekariya, umsa waBebayi; kanye naye lamadodana lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa.
Nasemadvodzana a-Azgadi bekunguJohhanane, umsa waHakatani; kanye naye amadoda lamakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamane.
Nasemadvodzana a-Adonikam: Elifeleti, neJeuel, naShemaya, kanye nabomadodana lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu.
Ngabomadvodzana aBigwai bekunguUthai neZabbud, kanye nabomadodana lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa.
Nami ngabahlanganisa eMfuleni losuka e-Ahava, sahlala khona ngelilanga lesithathu; ngabona labantfu nalabaLevi, ngobe abengakhona.
Nami ngathumela sinhembiso kuEliyezeri, na-Ariel, naShemaya, naElnathani, naJaribi, naElnathani, naNathani, naZekariya, naMeshulamu; naJoyaribi, naElnathani, labafundi.

ngabathumela ku-Iddo, umphathi waseKasifiya; nabeka emlonyeni wabo kutsi bangatsi yini ku-Iddo kanye nemindeni yakhe yebantfu bendlu yaseNethinimi eKasiphia, ukuze batfumise labakhonjiswe indlu yaNkulunkulu wethu.

Ngesandla esihle saNkulunkulu wethu esisetshenzisweni sethu, batfumelela umuntu onekhono, egama lakhe bekunguSherebiya, wemadvodzana aMaheli, umsa kaLevi, umsa ka-Isirayeli; naye nemadvodzakati akhe nabangane bakhe babemadodana lalishumi linamihlanu.
NaHasabiya, naye naJesahiya, lowaseMerariya, nabo bonkhe bantfu bakhe kanye nemadvodzana akhe, labamashumi lamabili.
Bafike nabo labaLevi, kanye nalabaNethinimi lamakhulu lamabilivalo nemashumi mahlanu, labeماندهma kaDavide nabaphathi bakhe abebeka kubo; bonke babhalwa ngegama.

Nalapho ngamemetela khona eMfula i-Ahava, kutsi singeke sidle, sithi: "Siyawuphazamisa ubuso bethu phambi kuNkulunkulu wethu," sacela kuye indlela lephephile nathi, nezingane zethu, naleyo yonke into esiyine.

Nami ngatsi: "Kungekuhle kutsi ngicele ukumkani umkhosi kanye nalabahamba ngezinyawo, bangasivikela ekuhlaseleni kwethu ngendlela; ngobe sakhuluma kumkasi sisithi: 'Isandla soNkulunkulu wethu singemuva kwalabo bonke labamlalelayo, kepha amandla akhe nebuhlungu bakhe bukhona kubo bonkhe labo abayawushiya.' "
Siye saphumula, sathandaza kuNkulunkulu wethu ngalolu daba, watsi: "UNkulunkulu wakho uyawutfumisa umphefumulo wami.
Nami ngahlukanisa emabhishobhi lamakhulu lamabili nesihlanu, naSherebiya, naHasabiya, nabazalwane babo balishumi.
Nababeke embhedeni, ngabala isiliva, negolide, netinhlamvu, lokudla lokunikezwa indlu yaNkulunkulu wethu ngukumkani, nalabameli bakhe, nabaholi bakhe, nabo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli.

Nami ngabalinganisela igolide lelikhulu nemashumi lamane nambili lama-talons, ne rephabliki yesiliva lelikhulu nemashumi lamane nama-talons, nerephabliki yegolide lelikhulu nemashumi lamane nama-talons,
tibhaka tegolide letilishumi nembili, lezingama-shekeli lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu; kanye nezinto ezimbili letihle tesiliva lelinemibala, letitraktwe njengegolide.
Watsi kubo: "Niyingcwele kuSimakadze, nelezinto zingcwele; lesilivere kanye negolide ngumnikelo wesono lokunikezwayo uSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Abati bakho.
Niyigcine nge sinhebe, kuze niyilinganise phambi kwalabaurobhe, nalabaLevi, nebaholi bemindeni yakwaSirayeli, enhliziyweni yendlu kaSimakadze eJerusalema."
BaLevi nalabaphatsimandla baphindze bamukela isiliva negolide, kanye nemacwecwe, nge repheke, kutsi abonise endlwini yaNkulunkulu wethu eJerusalema.

Sisuka emfuleni iAhava ngemnyaka wesitsatfu wenyanga yokuqala, siye eJerusalema; nesandla seNkulunkulu wethu sabe sikhona phezu kwethu, sasivikela ekuhlaselweni ngumfowabo kanye nalabo abasentolongweni.
Sifike eJerusalema, sahlala khona lilanga lesithathu.

Ngosuku lwesine, satimbanga isiliva negolide naleyo mibhoshongo endlwini yaNkulunkulu wethu, sayinikela kuMeremothi, unyana ka-Uriya, umLevi, kanye naye uEleazarhi, unyana ka-Phinehasi, naJozabadhi, unyana ka-Yeshua, naNoadiya, unyana ka-Binui, labaLevi.
Lakho konke kwacalwa, kwacinywa, naleso sikhathi sabhalwa nesisindo sakhe sonke.

Bayawunikela ngeminikelo yekushiswa kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli: inkunzi yengulube lelishumi elinambili, ngaso sonke isive sema-Israyeli, nemvu lemashumi lamakhulu asibhozo anesihlanu, namabele lamashumi lamakhulu asisikhombisa, namagodzi lalishumi elinambini, njengemnikelo wesono; konke lokhu kwaba yiminikelo yokushiswa kuSimakadze.
Batsi banikela ngemtsetfo wenkhosi kubo bonkhe labaphathi benkhosi, nebaholi bomhlaba waseMfula i-Euphrates; nabo balekelela bantfu kanye nendlu yaSimakadze.

Naleso sikhathi, lapho lezi zinto zaqedwa khona, bafike kubo bomkhuluwa bami, bethi, "Labo baseSirayeli, nalabangcwele babungcwele, nalabaLevi, bangasahlukanisi nemindeni yelawo malizwe abekwe ngaso; kodwa bayakwenza izinto letibi, njengabaKhanani, nalabaHeti, nalabaPerizi, nalabaJebusi, nalabaAmoni, nalabaMoabi, nalabaMijipi, nalabaAmori.

Bakwatile izingane zabo, banikela kubo nabantwana babo. Ngako-ke labangcwele bahlangane nabo bonkhe bantfu basemaphandleni; nebaholi babo kanye nalabo abaphethe isikhundla sabo bebengaba kuqala ekukhanyeni kwalolu daba.
Nalapho ngikubonile ngalolu daba, ngacandza ingubo yami netinwele zami, ngacisha tinwele zenhloko yami netinwele tamehlo ami, ngase ngihlala sengibuhlungu.

Bahlangana nami bonke labo labaphazanyiswa ngamazwi kaSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, ngenxa yesive sebantfu lababuyayo; ngobe ngibe sengihlala khona ngingakhululekanga kuze kufike isikhathi somnikelo wesono.
Ngaleso sikhathi semnikelo wesono, ngaphuma enhliziyweni yami, ngemigqomo yami nemilenze yami ihlanganisiwe, ngase ngijikele emadolo ami, ngafaka isandla sami kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wami,

"Ngiye ngitsi: 'Nkulunkulu wami, ngiyakhazaliswa kakhulu, nginenkinga yokuwuphakamisa umlomo wami kuwe, Nkulunkulu wami; ngobe tigebengu zethu zikhulu kunamehlo ethu aya emazulu, inkohliso yethu ifike esihlalweni.

Kusuka ezikhathini tababa bethu kuya kuleso sikhathi, inkohliso yethu ikhulu kakhulu; futhi ngenxa yezinto zethu ezibi sicutshungulwe, nathi, nababukumkani bethu, nababuphatsimandla bethu, sabekwa ngaphansi kwesandla senkhosi zakwamanye amazwe, safakwa emgodini, saboshwa, sadlalwa, sabulawa, kanye necala lelihle, njengobe kuboniswe ngalolusuku.

Ngako-ke Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wemaSirayeli, watsi: "Ngisho naleso sikhathi lesincane sitawutfunywa nguSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wemaSirayeli, kutsi usivumele sihlale lapha emhlabatsini sakhe esingcwele; ngobe uSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wemaSirayeli, usasinika umphefumulo kanye nemehlo ethu, kuze kube sekuphele iminyaka lemibili.

Sibe tikhonzi, kodvwa Nkulunkulu wethu asikushiyeli ekhonzweni lethu; wabonisa ukuthula kwethu emehlweni lamakhosi asePersiya, watfumisa inhliziyo yethu, wakwakha kabusha indlu yaNkulunkulu wethu, walungisa imihlaba yendlu yakhe, wamnika umhlobiso eYuda naseYerusalem.
Ngako-ke, Nkulunkulu wethu, yini lesiyakusho ngemuva kwalento? Siwuphula umyalo wakho,

ngobe utawuphula lamandla akho, nemithetho yakho, kanye nemtsetfo wakho, lowubeka ngesandla sabangani bakho labaprofeti, utsi: Lelizwe lenu lokuya kuloni, lingcolile; nalabahlali bayo balimele ngalezinto zabo ezibi, bayigcwele imibimbi yabo kusukela enhliziyweni kuya enhliziyweni.

Namuhla-ke, amakhosikazi enu angeke abe nemadvodzana abo, namadvodzakati enu angeke abe nemadvodzana abo; ningaze nifune kuthula kwabo noma kulungile kwabo, kuze nikhulule, nidla lokudla kwalomhlaba, niyishiye kubo bonkhe bantfu.'

Ngako-ke wena, Nkulunkulu wethu, ngemuva kwakho konke lokutsi kutfutfukile kuwe ngenxa yemisebenzi yethu lemibi, kanye nebubi bethu obukhulu, utawutibulala nguNkulunkulu wakho ngaphandle kwezinto letifaneleko, utawusishiya sihambe.
Ingabe siyawubuyela ekuphazamisiseni imiyalo yakho, sesivuna nalabo labasenza lezi zinto letibi? Ngabe ungeke ube necala lokukhulu kutfumisa nathi kutsi asishiyenga noma ngubani lophumayo?
Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, wena ulungile; thina sihlala namuhla sesihleli; bona, sikhona lapha phambi kwakho ngesono sethu, ngobe asikubi namunye wethu longeke ahlale ebusweni bakho.

Ngako-ke, lapho uEzra ethandaza khona, ekhuluma ngale mfundiso yakhe, elibalekela phansi phambi kwendlu yaSimakadze, wahlangana naye umkhosi omkhulu kakhulu wabaSirayeli, lamadoda nabesifazane nabantwana; nabo babelile kakhulu.
UShekaniya, unyana waJehiyeli, lowase-Elam, watsi kuEzra: "Sinecala lokukhulu kuNkulunkulu wethu, sahlala sishada nemakhosikazi lasemazweni angaphandle; kepha kunethemba laseSirayeli.

Lakho, sifake sivumelwano noNkulunkulu wethu, kutsi siyawushiya lamadodana nalababantwana babo, njengobe ukhuluma wena, umsa wami, kanye nabo bonke labakhathazayo ngemtsetfo waSimakadze Nkulunkulu wethu; kube njalo njengoba kusho umthetho.
Yifike, lena yindlela lekufanele uhambe ngayo, natsi sikhona afihlekile nawe; ube nekuthula, uyenzile.
UEzra wehla, wabeka emaLevi kanye nalabakhulu babaholi besive seSirayeli esivumelwaneni sokwenza njalo; nabo banikela.
UEzra waphuma phambi kwendlu yaNkulunkulu, waya ekamelweni laYohanani, unyana kaEliyashibhi; lapho akayidla inyama, akayidla namanzi, ngobe waba nebuhlungu ngenxa yesono sebantfu lababuyayo.
Baphuma bamemetela kuwo onkhe emadolobha laJuda neJerusalema, bekhuluma kubo bonkhe lababuyako repheni, kutsi bahlangane eYerusalem.
Nalowo longeke afike ngelilanga lesithathu, uyawulahleka yonke impahla yakhe, njengobe labaphathi nebaholi bebesho; naye uyasuswa emphakathini walabo ababuye babuyela.

Baye bahlangana bonke amadoda eJuda naBenjamini eJerusalema ngelilanga lesithathu, kumnyaka wamashumi lamane wenyanga yesishiyagalombili; nabo bonkhe bantfu babehlala emgwaqweni lovulekile phambi kwendlu yaSimakadze, bekhala kakhulu ngenxa yalento kanye nemvula.
UEzra, umLevi, wehla waya kubo, watsi kubo: "Nine niyawuphazamisa Simakadze, ngobe nibulale lamadodana lakwamanye amazwe, kutsi nikhulise inkohliso yaseSirayeli.
Namuhla, kholwani kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, nikwenze lokudla kwakhe; nihlukanise nabo bonkhe bantfu labangaphansi kwenu, nalabangaphandle kwenu.
Baphendvula batsi: "Kulungile; kufanele senze njengoba utsi."

Ngako-ke sikhona imindeni leminingi, kuze kube yisikhathi semvula; asikwazi kuhlala ngaphandle. Nasekungeke kusetjentswe ngalolu daba ngelilanga elinye noma limbili, ngobe sinabantu abaningi labafile ngalendlela.

Lamakhosi ethu kumele asebenze ngelinye ibandla lonke, nalowo wonke lohlala emizini yethu lakwatile indoda yakwamanye amazwe kufanele abe khona kuleso sikhathi esichaziwe, kanye nesikhulu sawo sonke semzini wakhe kanye nemajaji akhe, kuze kube sekuphele lokubi kwaNkulunkulu wethu ngaso lesi simo.
UJonathani, umsa wa-Asaheli, kanye naJahaziya, umsa wa-Tikwa, bebengasekho kulolu daba; Meshulam neShabetai, umLevi, babebasekela.

Bafike bakwenza njalo, ngobe Ezra umLevi wabeka labaholi bemindeni yemadvodzana a-Israyeli, lomuntfu ngamunye wemndeni wakhe, kanye nalabo lababhalwa ngamagama abo; bahlala khona ngelilanga lokuqala lenyanga yeshumi.
Baphela nabo bonkhe bantfu lababulale labesifazane bangaphandle, kuze kube ngumhla wokuqala wenyanga yekucala.
Nalaba baLevi, lababulale amadoda lasemazweni angaphandle: kuleso sigaba semadvodzana aJeshua, umsa wa-Yosadaki, nemadvodzakati akhe: Maaseya, Eliyezeri, Jaribi, naGedaliya.
Bonke bamemetela kutsi bazoshiya besifazane babo, ngobe bebengabi necala; nabo bonke babenikela ngalowo mkhwenyana wabo njengemnikelo wesono.
Lamadvodza aka-Imeri: Hanani naZebadia.
Lamadvodza laHarimu: Maaseya, neEliya, neShemaya, naJehiyeli, naUziya.
Lamadvodza laPashuri: Elioenai, Maaseya, Ishmaele, Nethaneli, Yozabadi, neElasa.
NaseLevini: Jozabade, neShimeyi, naKelayati, naPetahiya, naJuda, naEliyezeri.
Kulabo labangoma, nguEliyashib; kulabo labavala imnyango afihliwe, nguShalumu, neTelem, naUri.
Kulabo labaseSirayeli: kubo bonkhe bantfu base-Isiraheli, kwaba nguRamaya, neYisiya, naMalkiya, naMiyamina, naEleazari, naMalkiya, naBenaya.
Lamadvodza aka-Elam: Mattaniya, neZekariya, naJehiyeli, naAbdi, naJeremothi, naEliya.
Lamadvodza aseZathu: Elioenai, neEliashibi, naMatania, naJerimothi, naZabhadi, naAzisa.
Lamadvodza laBebayi: Johanani, Hanania, Zabbai naAt afilai.
Ngabo-Bani: Meshulama, Malluki, Adaya, Yashubi, Sheali, neJeremota.
Labo baphuma ePahati-Moabi: Adna, neKelali, naBenaya, naMaasihiya, naMatania, naBesaleleli, naBinui, naManase.
Lamadvodza laHarimi: Eliyezeri, ne-Ishiya, naMalkiya, naShemaya, naShimeoni,
Benjamini, Malluki, neShemariya.
Lamadvodza la-Hashumi: Matenai, neMatata, naZabadi, naElifeleti, naYeremai, naManase, naShimeyi.
Nasemadvodzana aBani:Mahadayi, neAmram, naUel,
Benaya, neBedaya, neKeluhi,
Vaniya, neMeremothi, neEliashib;
Mataniya, neMatanai, neYashu,
Bani, neBinui, neShimehi,
Shelemiya, naNathani, naAdaya,
Machnadebai, neShashai, neSarai,
Azareli, neShelemiya, neShemariya,
Shalumu, neAmariya, naJosefu.
Lamadvodza laNebo: Jeieli, naMatithiya, naZabadi, naZebina, naIdo, naJoyele, naBenaya.
Lamadoda lalaba bonkhe abenemadvodzakati lamanye amazwe, nabanye babenemadvodzana nemadvodzakati lalawo.
Neh: Lemibhalo yaNehemiya, umsa waHakaliya, kumnyaka wamashumi lamane wenyanga yeKislevu, lapho ngibe ngaseShushani, enhloko-dolobha.
Kwafika uHanani, lomunye wabazalwane bami, naye nabanye amadoda asuka eJudha; ngababuza ngebantfu baka-Israyeli labashiyisiwe, neJerusalema.
Batsi kuye: "Labo bantu labashiywe, labasele kulesifundazwe, baphila ekuphazameni nasekukhanyeni okukhulu; kanye nedonga leJerusalema lihleliwe, namasango ayo aqhutshwe ngemlilo."
"Nalapho ngikhuluma ngalolu daba, ngahlala khona, ngalingisa, ngalibalekela iminyaka leminingi, ngadla, ngathandaza kuNkulunkulu wasezulu.
Wathi: "Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wemazulu, ngikuphendule, wena uNkulunkulu lomkhulu newokuhleka, logcina inhlanganiso nalabo labamthandayo kanye nalabo abagcinela imiyalo yakhe.

Namuhla, ngiyakucela, lalela, uvule amehlo akho, ulalele luthandazo lwami lomkhonzi wakho, loluthandaza ebusweni bakho ekuseni nakusihlwa, ngebantfu baka-Israyeli, labakhonzi bakho; ngikhuluma ngebubi bethu, bantfu baka-Israyeli, labesikubusile wena; nami kanye nendlu yababa bam, sibulawe.
Sikhe sesivumile kakhulu kuwe; asizange sigcine imiyalo yakho, namasiko akho, nemithetho yakho, labewutjela umkhonzi wakho uMosi.
Khumbula, ngiyakucela, amazwi labewukhuluma kuMosi, umkhonzi wakho, watsi: Lakho-ke, uma ningenamtsetfo, ngitakwephulani phakathi kwebantfu.
kepha uma nibuyela kimi, nigcina imiyalo yami, nakuba baphambukile ekugcineni kwesibhakabhaka, ngitawubahlanganisa khona, ngiyawubabeka endaweni lapho ngiyikhethile kutsi lihlale khona igama lami.
Bangaba bakhonzi bakho nebantfu bakho, labewakhulula ngemandla akho amakhulu nesandla sakho esinamandla.

Namuhla, ngiyakucela, Nkosi yami, lalela umthandazo womkhonzi wakho, kanye nomthandazo wabakhonzi bakho labafuna ukuhlonipha igama lakho; ngikucele, vumelani kutsi ngifeze kahle ngalolusuku, nifike ninike ukumkani inhlonipho. Ngaleso sikhathi nganikela umvini kumkhonzi.
Ngomnyaka wa Nisani, eminyaka lemashumi lamakhulu lakumkani Artaxerxes, kwafakwa wayini emkhosini. Nami ngathatha iwayini, ngayinikela kuye; ngobe sengizange ngibe nebuhlungu phambi kwakhe.
Unkhosi yatsi kuye: "Ngubani na lobona ubuso bakho bubuhlungu? Awunaso sifo, kepha kubonakala sengathi kubuhlungu benhliziyo yakho." Nami ngasho kakhulu.
ngatsi kumkakhe: "Umkakhe uphile kuze kube sekupheleni! Ngabe ngingeke ngingabi nemilenze ebuhlungu, uma lomhlaba wemagugu lababami ungumhlambi wemahhashi, bese igate yawo ifunwa ngumlilo?"
Watsi kutsi: 'Ufuna yini?' Nami ngathandaza kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wemazulu, watsi:
ngatsi kunkhosi: "Kungekuhle kuwe, nkosi, noma nginekuthula nawe; thumelani kutsi ngifike eYuda, enhlokodolobha yalabo balimi bami, ukuze ngiyibuyele ngayo."
Watsi: "Kungakapheli yini uhambo lwakho, nalapho uyawubuyela khona?" Kube kulungile ebusweni benkhosi kutsi andise; ngatsi: "Kungakapheli yini uhambo lwakho, nalapho utawubuya khona?"
Ngiye ngatsi ukumkani: "Uma kungukulungile kunkhosi, ngicela imnike incwadi yabaphathi baleyo ndawo enyakatho-mpumalanga yeMfula i-Euphrates, kutsi bamivumele ngihambe ngekuthula kuze ngifike eYuda.

Nase nginike nencwadi ku-Asaphi, umphathi wesihlahla sikankhosi, kutsi anikeze imithi yekwakha iminyango yendlu yasebukhosini lebekwe endlwini yaSimakadze, kanye nasengcweti semgwaqweni wasemzini, nasendlini yami lapho ngiyahlala khona.' " 15Watsi ukumkani wanikela ngaleso sifiso sami, kabiwe ngesandla esihle saNkulunkulu wami esisenemi.
Ngiye ngafika kumagosa aseMfula i-Euphrates, ngabanikela ngemibhalo yenkhosi; ngobe inkhosi yayawuthumela nemkhosi kanye nalabo abahamba ngesikhephe nami.
Sanbalathi waseHoroni, kanye naTobiyasi, umphathi wemadvodzana a-Ammon, bakubona lokhu, bahlupheka kakhulu, ngobe kwafika umuntu kutsi abonise kubo-Israyeli.
Ngafika eJerusalema, ngahlala khona iminyaka lemibili.

Ngaphuma ngasebusuku, nami nalabambalwa lababili; ngobe sengizange ngicacise kulowo muntu kutsi yini leNkulunkulu wami abemise enhliziyweni yami kutsi ngiyenze ngeJerusalema. Ngabe nginesilwane esisodwa kuphela kanye nami, isilwane lesihamba ngaso.
Ngiphuma ngaleyo busuku ngeGate yeLwandle, ngiye efulethini le-Eshakeli, neGate yeTigodzi, ngibheka emasango aseJerusalema, ngobe abebiwe, negate zalo, ngobe abebiwe ngemlilo.
Ngaye ngaya eGeta yeFontaine neKing's Pool, kepha kwakungeke kube khona nendawo leyaneleyo kutsi isilwane sami sifike.
Nami ngaya efulethini ngalobusuku, nabona ledonga, ngabuyela emuva, ngafika ngendlela yeGate yeLwandle.

Abaholi bedolobha abengazange babone lapho ngifike khona, noma yini lengingayenza; ngobe ngabe sengingeke ngilitshele lamaJuda nalabaphatsimandla nalabo abakhulu nalabaphathi kanye nabo bonke labasebenza kulomsebenzi.
Nami ngatsi kubo: "Nibona buhlungu lapho sikhona khona, kutsi iJerusalema iyigugu, nemnyango wayo ufile ngemlilo; ningangeni, sibuye sisungule indlu yaseJerusalema, ukuze singabi nemfihlakalo.
Batsi: "Thina-ke sitawukwakha!" Bafike bakhuluma nabo, batsi: "Thina-ke sitawukwakha!" Bafike bamisa isandla sabo ekwenzeni lemsebenzi omuhle.
Batsi lapho Sanbalathi waseHoroni, neTobiyasi umphathi we-Ammon, naGishemi umArabha, bekubonile lokhu, batfumisana nathi, batsi: "Ngubani lowenza lokhu? Nifuna kutsi nigweme ukumkani yini?"
Ngibaphendvula ngitsi: "Simakadze Nkulunkulu wemazulu, yena utawutfumisa, nathi labakhonzi bakhe siyawusungula; kodvwa nine aninakho ingxenye, noma ilungelo, noma inkontileka eJerusalema.

Eliyashib, umsa wa-Eliyashibi, umLevi wasebukhosini, nalabapristi bakhe babuyela bekwakha iGate yeTingulube. Bayinikela kuSimakadze, batsi: "Le Gate lengcwele nguNkulunkulu!" Bangahlala khona kuze kube seTown of the Hundreds kanye neTown of Hananel.
Lamadvodza lasuka eJerikho abuye aphinde abe nesigaba sakhe; ngemuva kwawo, Zakur, umsa wa-Imri, walungisa ingxenye yakhe.
Isango lesinhlanzi lalihlelwe ngubana be-Hasenaa; babeka izingcezu zalo, bamisa iminyango yalo, nemingcingo yayo, namathumbu alo.
Meremothi, umsa waUriya, umsa waHakotsi, walungisa isigaba esisha; ngemuva kwakhe walungisa Meshulamu, umsa waBerekiya, umsa waMeshezabelu; ngemuva kwakhe walungisa Sadoki, umsa waBaana.
Lelinye icala lalihlanganisiwe ngulabo baseTekoa; kodvwa labaphathi babo bangeke babe nesibopho sokwenza lomsebenzi.
Isango lelikhulu lalihlanganisiwe nguYoyada, umsa waPaseya, naMeshulamu, umsa waBesodeya; bona babulale lisango, bamisa iminyango yayo, netingcotjo zayo, netigcotsi zayo.
Ngaphesheya kwabo balungisa Melatiya waseGibeboni, neYadoni waseMeronothi, nalabo baseGibeboni nabaseMizpa, kuze kube yindlu yomphathi welizwe laseMfula i-Efrayim.

Ngaphesheya kwabo walungisa Uziyele, umsa ka-Harhaya, lomunye webaholi begolide; ngaphesheya kwakhe walungisa Hananiya, lomunye wabakhiqizi bemifino. Babuye bakwakha ingqalelo yaseJerusalema kuze kube ngumgwaqo obanzi.
Ngaphesheya kwabo walungisa Refaya, umsa ka-Huri, umphathi wengxenye yendzawo yekubusa yaseJerusalema.
Ngaphesheya kwabo walungisa Jedayaya, umsa waHarumafa, ngaphesheya kwendlu yakhe; ngaphesheya kwawo walungisa Hatushi, umsa waHashabneya.
Malkiya, umsa waHarimi, neHashub, umsa waPahati-Moabi, balungisa icala elinye, kanye neTonge laMafu.
Ngaphesheya kwabo walungisa Shalumu, umsa kaHaloheshi, umphathi wengxenye yedolobha laseJerusalema, naye nemadvodzakati akhe.

Ngesango lelifu, Hanun nalabo baseZanoa balungisa; bakwakha, bamisa iminyango yayo, nemingcingo yayo, netingcotjo zalo, kanye nemamitha lamakhulu lamabili namashumi mahlanu, kuze kube ngeGate yeMfula.
Isango leMfudlana lalihlanganisiwe nguMalkiyahi, umsa waRekabu, umphathi wesifunda sase-Beth-hakeremi; wayakhela, wamisa iminyango yayo, nemingcingo yayo, namatilosi ayo.

Isango lemlilo lalihlanganisiwe nguShaluni, umsa ka-Kolhozehi, umphathi wesifunda saseMizpa; wakhela lifulegi lakhe, waligcobisa, wayimisa iminyango yayo, nezingcezu zayo, namahlombe ayo. Wahlanga udonga lwesibhakabhaka saSiloamu esigabeni somhlabatsini sikankhosi kuya emaphahleni aphansi aseMzini wakwaDavide.
Emva kwakhe uNehemiya, umsa wa-Azbukhi, umphathi wesishiyagalombili sesifunda sase-Beth-Tsuri, walungisa kuze kube kufike ecaleni lamagcobeni kaDavide, kanye nendlu yalabakhulu.
Emva kwakhe balungisa labaLevi, Rehumu unyana waBani; ngemuva kwakhe walungisa Hashabiyah, umphathi wesishiyagalombili sesifunda saseKehila, esigabeni sakhe.
Emva kwakhe, bazalwane babo labaLevi balungisa, Bavayi unyana waHenadadi, umphathi wengxenye yesifunda saseKehila.
Ngakwesokudla kwakhe, Ezere, umsa waJeshua, umvikeli we-Mizpa, walungisa icala elinye, ngaphesheya komfula, kuze kube yilapho kubekwe khona imiyalelo, ekhoneni lelingene.
Emva kwakhe uBaruhi, umsa waZabhai, wehlisa icala elinye, kusukela ekungeneni kwendlu yaEliyashibhi, umLevi omkhulu, kuze kube ngumnyango wayo.
Emva kwakhe walungisa Meremothi, umsa waUriya, umsa waHakotsi, isigaba esisodwa, kusukela emgwaqeni wendlu kaEliashibi kuya ekugcineni kwayo.
Ngasemuva kwakhe, labapristi bendawo lengaphansi kwendlu yabo balungisa.
Ngabo, Benjamini naHashubi balungisa ngaphesheya kwendlu yabo; ngemuva kwabo, Azariya, umsa waMaaseya, unyana waAnaniya, walungisa eduze kwendlu yakhe.
Emva kwakhe, Binnui, umsa waHenadadi, walungisa icala elinye, kusuka endluni ya-Azariya kuze kufike emgwaqeni nasenceleni.
Palal, umsa ka-Uzai, walungisa eduze kwendlu yasebukhosini ephakeme, kanye nesakhiwo esiphumayo esiseceleni kwendlu yenkhosi; ngemuva kwakhe wakulungisa Pedaya, umsa ka-Paroshi.
Nase-Nethinimi bahlala emfuleni i-Ofel, kuze kufike emphemeni wamanzi ngasempumalanga, kanye nenhloko lephumayo.
Emva kwawo, labahlali baseTekoya balungisa icala elinye, kusuka ecaleni letente lalikhulu elinamakhilomitha lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu liphuma emnyango weOfel.
Ngasentshonalanga yeGeta Yetingulube, abaLevi balungisa, lomunye nalowo ebhekene nendlu yakhe.
Ngabo walungisa Sadoki, umsa wa-Imeri, ngaphesheya kwendlu yakhe; ngemuva kwakhe walungisa Shemaya, umsa wa-Shekaniya, umphathi wesango lasenyakatho.

Emva kwakhe, uHananiya unyana waShelemiya neHanun unyana wesishiyagalolunye waZalaphu balungisa icala elinye; ngemuva kwabo, uMeshulamu unyana waBerekiya walungisa icala lelinye libhekene nendlu yakhe.
Emva kwakhe walungisa Malkiya, lomunye wabakhangisi begolide, kuze kube yindlu yabaseNethinimi neyebapheki, ecaleni kwesango lelingemuva, kuze kube yisakhiwo esiphakeme esisekhoneni.
Labahleli begolide kanye nalabahwebi balungisa isakhiwo phakathi kwegumbi lelingasentshonalanga neGate yeTingulube.
Kwatsi lapho Sanbalati ekubona kutsi sibuye sakwakha indlu, wagwema, waba nenkinga enkulu kakhulu, watsi: "Labo baHebheru abengabaphikisi.

Watsi: "LabaYuda labancane bangakwenza yini? Bacabanga kutsi bangawukwakha lodonga bobabili? Bangaba banikela ngesondlo? Bangaba batawusitimela kumnyaka munye? Bangaba batfusa ematshe afile emhlabatsini?"
UTobiyasi, umAmoni, wahlala ecaleni lakhe, watsi: "Nakuba ingulube ifike kuleyo ndlu labayenzayo, itawuyiphula ledonga labo lesitayela."
Ngitsi: "Thintela, Nkulunkulu wethu, ngobe sesihlanganisiwe; buyisela umsindo wabo phezu kwenhloko yabo; batfunywe ezweni lelingelinye, babe nguboshwa.
Musa kufihla inhlonipho yabo, ungawucimi lomonakalo wabo emehlweni akho; ngobe babulale labo labakhayo.
Sibuye sibuye sakwakha indlu, kuze kube kufike engxenyeni yayo; ngobe laba bantu basebenzela ngenhliziyo yabo yonke.
Batsi lapho Sanbalathi naTobiya, ne-Arabha, nemadvodzana aAmmon, nebantfu be-Ashdodi, bekubona kutsi kumiswa kwethempeli laseJerusalema kuhamba phambili, nekuvalwa kwemigoqo, baphoxeka kakhulu.
Labo bonke bahlela kuhlangana, kutsi bafike bahlasele eJerusalema, babe nenkinga.
Ngako-ke sathandaza kuNkulunkulu wethu, sabeka lamaphoyisa ekuseni nakusihlwa, kutsi aphindze ativikele.
Lamadodana eYuda akazange abonise, watsi: "Labo labasebenza nabo bahlupheka kakhulu, netinhlabamkhosi tikhulu kakhulu; singeke sikwazi ukwakha indlu."
Batsi: "Kungekuze babone noma babone kutsi sikhona, siyawufika kubo, sitawubabulala, sitawumisa lemisebenzi."
BaJuda labahlala eduze kwabo bafika, batsi: "Batawusihlasela ngaso sonke simo." Batsi: "Bayawusibulala!"
Nami ngabeka labantfu emaceleni emnyango, emaphandleni; ngababeka ngemindeni yabo, nabo babenesifuba sabo, nemilenze yabo, namatilosi abo.

Nase ngibona, ngaphuma, ngatsi kulabo abakhulu nalabaphathi kanye nebantfu labashiywe: "Ungabakhombi; khumbulani uSimakadze lomkhulu newokuhle, bese nilwela labazalwane benu, nabangani bakho, nasetinaneni zenu, namadzimate enu, nangetindlu zenu."
Batsi bafike lababi bethu, beva kutsi sifundile imibono yabo, ngobe Simakadze abewususa umqondo wabo; sabuyela emnyango sonke, singene kuwo wonke umsebenzi waso.

Ngaleso sikhathi, bese kuyawufika lomnyaka wasikhombisa, lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu ema-Amori asebenzela lendlu, nalabalishumi nasitfupha nalabalishumi nambili babenemikhumbi, nemkhosi, nemacwecwe, namabhande.
Nabo labakhayo isakhiwo, nalabo labafaka timpahla, basebenza ngesandla esisodwa, bese begcina imikhumbi ngesinye.
Nabo bonke labakhangisi, lomunye nalowo wabeka isandla sakhe esithendeni sawo, lapho besebenza khona; nome-ke lowo utfumisayo inkunzi wayehlala nami.
Nami ngatsi kulabo abakhulu, nebaholi, naleyo minye imindeni, kutsi: "Lemsebenzi ukhulu kakhulu, ubanzi kakhulu, futhi sihlala singesinye semgwaqeni.
Nalapho nikhuluma khona umsindo wemphimbo, fikeni nathi khona; Nkulunkulu wethu uyawukulwa nathi.
Siye saqhubeka sisebenza, nephesenti lelinye lamadoda ligcina tibhande, kusukela ngelilanga lesitsatfu kuya kulilanga lesisikhombisa.
Ngeleso sikhathi ngatsi kubantfu: "Lomuntfu kumele ahlale eJerusalema ngebusuku, yena nalowo losebenza naye; bangasivikela ngebusuku, basebenze ngelilanga.
Nami, nabazalwane bami, nabangani bami, nalabo labahamba nemkhosi, sihlala sigcina impahla yethu ngaso sonke isikhathi, ngisho nangemva kokuba siphuma sithole amanzi.
Lamadoda kanye nemadvodzakati abo afike ekhuluma ngesandla sakhe esikhulu ema-Ayuda,
Batsi: "Sinemadvodzana nemadvodzakati lamakhulu kakhulu; kufanele sidle, sihlale siphila."
Batsi nabo: "Sitawunikela ngemhlabatsi, netingcotjo, netindlu zethu, sifike sithole umnikelo wesono lapho kuphelela khona umfula."
Baye batsi: "Sifuna kukhokha imali, kutsi sikhokhele umkhonto wenkhosi ngemhlabatsi netingcotjo zethu.

Sifana nabo-Israyeli, nabantwana bethu bafana nabo-Israyeli. Natsi siyawuthengisa lamakhosikazi ethu nemadvodzakati ethu abe tikhonjiwe; nangetikhonjiwe naletinye tamadodana ethu; singeke senze lutho, ngobe emahlathi ethu netingcotfo tewayini letfu likhona kwabanye.
Nami ngatsi, lapho ngikhuluma khona, ngingabi nekuthula kakhulu.
Nakho, lapho sengicabanga ngayo, ngathi kulabo abakhulu kanye nalabaphathi, ngobe ngitsi kubo: "Nine nifuna umsebenti wabangani bami." Nakho, ngamemetela ibandla elikhulu kutsi likhulume nabo.

Nase ngitsi kubo: "Siye sibuye sathenga labazalwane bami labathengiswe ema-Israyeli, njengoba besikwazi; kodvwa nifuna kutsi nithengise nabangani benu, ukuze nabo bathengiswe nathi!" Bakhala, bangatholanga lokukhuluma.
Ngitsi: "Lento niyenzayo ayilungile; kufanele nihambe ngekuthula kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wethu, ukuze kungabikho lutho lokutfumisako kubo bonkhe bantfu lababi bami.
Nami, nabangani bami, nalabakhonjiswe ngami, sidlulisa kubantfu imali nekudla; hlalani sikhokhe inhlawulo!
Batsi: "Nibabuyisele namuhla imifula yabo, netingcotjo zabo, netingadi tabo te-olive, nemindeni yabo; nibuyeni nabo naleyo miphiko yemali, nemhluzi, newayini lelibomvu, nephethroli, lokwentayo kubo.
Batsi: "Siyawuyibuyisela, sitawucela lutho kubo; siyawukwenza njengoba ukhuluma." Nami ngabiza labaLevi, ngabakhipha emthethweni phambi kwabo, kutsi bakwenzela njalo.

Nami ngacisha imilenze yami, ngitsi: Lomuntu longeke agcine lesi siphakamiso, Nkulunkulu amcishe ngendlela lenjalo kusuka endlwini yakhe nasenhlalakahleni yakhe. Acishe acishe abe mnyama! Labo bonke baphendvula, batsi: "Amen!" Babonga uSimakadze. Lakho lakubo laba bantu bakwenze.

Ngaleso sikhathi lapho ngabekwa khona njengomphathi ezweni laYuda, kusukela kumnyaka weshumi nambili kuze kube ngumnyaka wamashumi mathathu namabili kankhosi Artaxerxes, iminyaka lengema-12, mina nebazalwane bami sasingadlanga lekudla lokuvunyelwa ngumphathi.

Nasebaphathi labazange bafike phambi kwami, baphindze basebentisa bantfu ngemandla amakhulu, bekhipha ekudlaneni kwabo newayini, kanye nesiliva lelikhulu, nalabo labasebenza nabo basebentisa bantfu ngemandla amakhulu; kodvwa mina angizange ngikwenze njalo, ngobe ngayeka Nkulunkulu.
Nami ngase ngisebenzela ngemandla emnyango; sisale sathenga mhlaba, ngobe bonke labangani bami bahlangana khona basebenze.
Nasembhedeni wami ngadla nebantfu labamakhulu lamashumi mahlanu, labaYuda nalabaphathi, kanye nabo bonkhe labo labafika kubo kusuka kulawo mazwe angaphandle.

Nami ngadla ngelilanga ingulube eyodwa, nemfuyo lelikhulu nesikhombisa, namanye amehlo emhlaba; nangebusuku beminyaka lengema-10 kwafika khona umnikelo lokhulu kakhulu wewayini. Lakudla lokuniketwa nguMengameli kwakungeke ngikufune, ngobe laba bantu babenesibopho esibi.
Khumbula kimi, Nkulunkulu wami, ngenhlonipho, yonke lekudla lokubi labengingayenzile kulabo bantu.

Batsi lapho Sanbalati, naTobiya, naGishemi, umArabhu, nabo bonkhe lababi bethu beva kutsi sengibuyele ngekwakha lodonga, kutsi angeke kube khona lutho lokudlwengula kulo; ngobe ngibe sengingakabeka iminyango emasango.
Sanbalathi naGishemi bathumela kuye, batsi: "Thina-ke sifike sihlangane nawe esinye sesive esiseNtsabeni ye-Ono." Baye bafuna kumbulala.
Nami ngathumela kubo, ngitsi: "Mine sengisebenza msebenzi omkhulu; angikwazi kutsi ngikhuphuke; yini lemisebenzi ingeke iphele uma ngiyishiya ngikhuphuke kuwe?"
Bangithumela ngaleso sinye siphakamiso sikhatsi lesinhlanu, ngaso sonke isikhathi ngibaphendule ngaloluhlobo lwemibuzo.
Ngemnyaka wasihlanu, Sanbalati wamthumela kuye umkhonzi wakhe, abe neletafula livulekile esandla sakhe, ngalendlela.
Wathi: "Kutsi kukhulunywa phakathi kwebantfu, Geshemi usho kutsi kuyiqiniso, ukuthi wena nalabaYuda nifuna ukushiyana; ngakho-ke ukwakha kabusha ledonga. Kutsi kuthiwa utawuba ngunkhosi yabo."
Nase ukhethe nabangane bakho labaprofeti, kutsi bakhulume nawe eJerusalema, besithi: 'Kukhona ukumkani eYuda.' Ngako-ke kuyawufika lobufakazi kubokumkani; khona-ke hlanganani, sikhulume ngalo.
Nami ngatsi kuye: "Kungeke kube khona lutho lokufana nalokho lokushoyo; wena ukhuluma ngengqondo yakho."

Batsi: "Kungeke kube khona msebenti, ngobe isandla sawo siyawucasuka" ngobe batsi: "Kungeke kube khona msebenzi, ngobe isandla sawo siyawucasuka." Ngako-ke ngathandaza ngitsi: "Nkulunkulu wami, ngenze isandla sami sinamandla!"

Ngiye endlini kaShemaya, unyana kaDelaya, unyana kaMehetabele; wahlala embhedeni wakhe. Wathi: "Sifike sihlangane endlwini yaNkulunkulu, ngaphakathi kwethempelini, sivale iminyango yethempelini; ngobe abantu bayawufika befuna kukubulala; lebusuku bazofika befuna kukubulala."
Nami ngatsi: Ingabe lowo muntfu lofana nami kumele ahambe? Ingabe lowo muntfu lofana nami kufanele afike ethempelini aze agcine impilo yakhe? Ngingeke ngifike!
Nami ngabona kutsi Nkulunkulu akazange amthumele, ngobe wakhuluma lombono lowo kimi, ngobe Tobia neSanbalati babemkhokhela.
Bemkhokhela kutsi amkhulise, angeke ngikwenze lokhu, ngingabi nebubi; ngobe bangeke baninikwe igama lelibi, bangeke baninikwe umvi.
Khumbula, Nkulunkulu wami, uTobiya neSanbalati, naNoadiya umprofeti, kanye nabo bonkhe labaprofeta, labafuna kutsi bangisikhulise.
Lodonga lwaqedwa ngemnyaka wamashumi lamabili nesihlanu wenyanga ye-Elul, lilanga lelishumi nambili nesihlanu.
Batsi bakubona bonke lababuphikisi bethu, bakhathazeka, nabo bonkhe bantfu labasemhlabatsini lethu, balahlekelwa ngumoya wabo; ngobe babone kutsi lomsebenzi wawucutshungulwe nguNkulunkulu wethu.
Ngaleso sikhathi, labakhulu baseYuda bathumela ku-Tobiya imibhalo leminingi, nemibhalo ka-Tobiya yafika kubo.
Baningi base-Yuda babeyawumsekela, ngobe waba ngumyeni waShekaniya, unyana ka-Araha; naYohanane, unyana wakhe, ubeyawushada nendvodzakati yaMeshulamu, unyana ka-Berekiya.
Bakhuluma nami ngezinto ezinhle azenzayo uTobiya, bakhuluma naye ngaleso sikhathi; naye uTobiya wathumela lamaphepha kutsi amkhulise.
Nalapho ingcweti yakhiwa khona, nalapho ngimise khona iminyango, nalapho bebekwa khona labagwebi, nelabo bakhulumayo, nelabaLevi.

Naye ngamisa eJerusalema uHanani, umngane wami, kanye noHananiya, umphathi wesitezi; ngobe uHananiya waba ngumntu lothembekile, wakholwa nguNkulunkulu, waphelelwa lithemba likhulu kunabo bonke bantfu.

ngobe ngitsi kubo: "Ungavulanga tisango taJerusalema kuze lilanga lifike lifule, bese behlala labagcina-tisango, bavule emasango, babulele emasango; bese nikhetha labaseJerusalema kutsi babe ngabahlengikazi, nibeke labanye emsebentini wabo, nabanye emakhaya abo.
Ledolobha lakungumhlabatsi, likhulu kakhulu, kepha labahlali bawo babencane kakhulu; kanye nemindeni yabo yayingeke ibe yenziwe.

Simakadze Nkulunkulu wami wamisa enhliziyweni yami, kutsi ngihlangane nalabakhulu, nebaholi, nebantfu, ngibabhalela ngemindeni yabo. Nalapho ngathola khona incwadi yemadvodzana kanye nemadvodzakati lakubo labazange bafike eJerusalema; lencwadi yabhalwa njalo:
Laba bayawubuyela eJerusalema naseYuda, kuwo wonke lamadolobha abo, labo labasuka esivumelwaneni saSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, kanye nenkhosi yaseBhabhiloni, lapho behlala khona.
