Bafike naboZerubabele, naJeshua, naNehemiya, naAzariya, naRamiya, naNahamani, naMordecai, naBilshani, naMisperethi, naBigwai, naNehumu, naBaana; le yinombolo yamadoda aseSirayeli:
Lamadvodza la-Paroshe, lamakhulu mahlanu, lamakhulu lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa.
Bamadvodzana aShefatiya bekungumakhulu matatu, lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu.
Lamadvodza la-Araha, amakhulu mane, lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu.
Lamadodana ePahati-Moabi, aJeshuwa naJowabe, lamakhulu mahlanu, emakhulu lasitfupha nemashumi lamabili nesikhombisa.
Lamadvodza la-Elam, alikhulu, elinamakhulu lamabili nemashumi mahlanu namane.
Lamadvodzana aZathu bekungumakhulu lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu.
Lamadvodzana aZakhai bekungumakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamane.
Lamadvodza la-Binui, amakhulu mane, lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu.
Lamadvodzana aBebayi belikhulu elinamahlanu lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa.
Lamadvodza la-Azgadi, lalikhulu, elinamakhulu mathathu, lamashumi lamabili nesitfupha.
Lamadvodza la-Adonikam, amakhulu mane, lamashumi lamane nesikhombisa.
Lamadodana eBigwai, lamakhulu mahlanu, lamashumi lamane nesikhombisa.
Lamadvodzana aAdin bekungumakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamane nasihlanu.
Lamadvodza la-Atere, asuka ku-Hizkiya, lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa namane.
Lamadodana aHashumi, lamakhulu matatu, lamashumi lamane nasitfupha.
Lamadodana aBezai, lamakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamane nasitfupha.
Lamadvodzana aHarifu bekungumakhulu lamabili nesikhombisa.
bantfu baseGibeoni, bamashumi lamane nesihlanu.
amadoda eBethlehem neNetofa, lamakhulu lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa nasitfupha.
Lamadodana eAnathothi, lamakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamane nasitfupha.
Lamadodana eBeth-Azmavethi, lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu.
Lamadoda eKirihati-Yearim, neKefira, naBeerothi, lamakhulu lamabili nesikhombisa, lamashumi mane nasitfupha nesihlanu.
Lamadoda eRama neGeba, lamakhulu mane, lamabili nahru.
Lamadodana eMikmasi, lamakhulu lamabili nemashumi mahlanu nasitfupha.
Lamadoda eBheteli na-Ai, lamakhulu lamabili nemashumi matatu.
Lamadodana eNebo lelinye, lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu.
Lamadvodzana a-Elam, labalikhulu elinamakhulu lasitfupha nesihlanu.
Lamadvodzana aHarimi bekungumakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamane.
Lamadodana eJerikho, lamakhulu matatu, lamashumi mane nasihlanu.
Abantu baka-Lodi, neHadidi, na-Ono, lamakhulu lamabili nesikhombisa, lamashumi mahlanu nelinye.
Abantu be-Sena, lamakhulu mahlanu, lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa.
BabeLevi: bantfu bakaJedaya, emndenini ka-Jeshua, bamakhulu lamane, lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu.
Labantwana ba-Imeri, labalikhulu elinamahlanu lamane.
Lamadodana aPashuri, lamakhulu lamabili nemashumi mane nasikhombisa.
Lamadvodza la-Harim, lamakhulu lamabili nesikhombisa.
LaLevi: bantfu baka-Yeshua, eKadmieli, emndenini waHodeva, labamashumi lasikhombisa namane.
Labangani ba-Asaphi, labazangeli, babemakhulu lamane nemashumi lamabili nesikhombisa.
Labaphathi bemnyango: bantfu baka-Shalumu, ne-Ateri, ne-Talmoni, ne-Akubi, ne-Hatita, ne-Shobai, lamakhulu lamashumi lasitfupha nesikhombisa.
Lamadoda aNethinimi: lamadvodzana aZiha, neHasupha, naTabaothi,
Keros, neSiya, nePadon,
Lebana, neHagaba, neSalmai,
Hanan, neGiddel, neGahar,
Reaya, neRezin, neNekoda,
Gazam, neUzza, nePaseah,
Besaya, neMeunim, nePushesim,
Bakbuki, neHakupha, neHarhuri,
Bazlithi, neMehida, neHarsha,
Barkosi, neSisera, neTema,
Neziya, neHatipha.
Lamadodana labangani bakaSolomoni: Amakhosikazi eSotai, neSoferethi, nePerida,
Jaala, Darkoni, Giddel,
Shefatiya, Hathili, Pokhereti-Hazebayim, naAmoni.
Bonke labaLevi bendlu yaSimakadze, kanye nemadvodzana aSolomoni,evayo, babemakhulu amathathu, lamashumi mahlanu namane nambili.
Bafike nabanye labavela eTelamela, neTela-Harsha, neKerubim, neAddoni, neImeri; kodvwa abazange baqinisekise kutsi bangabaSirayeli.
Labo babenemadvodzana aDelaya, eTobiya neNekoda, abemakhulu lamane, lamashumi mane nasitfupha nambili.
Labo baLevi: lamadvodzana aHobaya, bekuboHakosi, bekuboBarzilayi; barzilayi abeyawushada nendvodzakati yaBarzilayi waseGileyadi, wathatha igama lakhe.
Baye bafuna amagama abo emibhalweni yemindeni yabo, kodvwa bangawatholanga; ngakho-ke abavunyelwe ukuba basebenze njengemabhishobhi.
Wabaphendvula watsi: "Akufanele nidle lekudla lokungcwele kakhulu, kuze kufike kube khona umkhonzi lokhuluma nge-Urim ne-Thummim."
Lomndeni wonke, kanye nabo, waba ngumashumi lamane nambili lamakhulu lamabili nemakhulu matatu, namashumi lasikhombisa,
ngaphandle kwalabo labasebenza nabo, labangumakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamane nesikhombisa, kanye nalabakhonti babo, labangumakhulu mahlanu nemashumi lamane nesihlanu.
Banemahhashi lamakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamane nesihlanu, nemamu afihle lamakhulu mahlanu namakhulu mane.
tingulube tamakhulu lamane, lamashumi lasitfupha nesihlanu, nemakhosa lamakhulu lamabili nasikhombisa.

Batsi nabanye babaholi bemindeni yabo banikela ngemnikelo wekushiswa kwendlu. Umphathi wabanikela ebhokisini legolide, lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu ema-acre, namabhodlela lamashumi mahlanu, nemabhulukwe lamakhulu mane namashumi lasitfupha lamaLevi.
Labanye babaholi bemndeni banikela ngemali yekwakha lemalunga nemakhulu lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu emakilogramu egolide kanye namakhulu lasitfupha nesihlanu emakilogramu esiliva.
Labanye babantu babenikela ngegolide emashumi lamakhulu lamabili nesihlanu ema-shekeli, nesiliva lamaphesenti ayisishiyagalombili, kanye nemgqomo yamaLevi alishumi nelisikhombisa.

Bakhona labaLevi, nalabapristi, nalabo abagcina-mlilo, nalabazangeli, nebantfu, nalabo baseNethinimi, nabo bonkhe bantfu bakaSirayeli, bahlala emizini yabo; kuze kube ngumnyaka wesixhenxe bahlala emindenini yabo.

Bahlangana bonke bantfu, njengendoda eyodwa, esiteshini esivulekile esiseceleni kweGate yamanzi, batsi: "Ezra, umbhali, ufike athole incwadi yemtsetfo waMosesi, loNkulunkulu abewisela wona laSirayeli."
UEzra, umLevi, wakhipha mthetho ebusweni bebantfu, lamadoda nabesifazane, nalabo bonke labakwaziyo ukuqonda, ngemhla wokuqala wenyanga yesitsatfu.

Wabhala khona, ecaleni leliseceleni kwesango lamanzi, kusukela ngekusasa kuze kube ngubusuku; wabhalela emavikini lamadoda nabesifazane, nabo bonke labakwaziyo kulalela; nendlebe yalaba bantu bonke yaliba lukhulu ekufundeni incwadi yemtsetfo.

Ezra, umbhali, wahlala esitezi lesiphakeme sesihlahla, sakhiwa ngaleso sizathu; nakwesokudla kwakhe kwahlala Matitiya, neShema, naAnaya, naUriya, naHilkiya, naMaaseya; nakwesobunxele kwakhe kwahlala Pedaya, naMishayeli, naMalkiya, naHashumu, naHasbaddana, naZekariya, naMeshulam.
UEzra wavula incwadi ngamehlo labantfu bonke, ngobe wayehlala ephakeme kunabo; kodvwa lapho avule khona, bonkhe bantfu baphuma besuka.
UEzra wabonga uSimakadze, Nkulunkulu lomkhulu; nabo bonke bantfu baphakamisa isandla sabo, baphendula batsi: "Amen! Amen!" Batsi bahlangula, banikela kuNkulunkulu ngebuso babo emhlaba.

BaLevi, Jesuha, naBani, naSherebiya, naYamini, naAkubu, naShabhethai, naHodiya, naMaaseya, naKelita, naAzaria, naYozabadi, naHanani, naPelaya, bakhuluma kubo ngemtsetfo, ngobe labaLevi bebengase bahlale khona.
Babhalela incwadi yemtsetfo waNkulunkulu, bakhuluma ngaso, bachaza kutsi yini lokushoyo; ngobe labantfu babeqonde lokubhalwe kulo.

Nehemiya, umphathi, neEzra, umnikelo wesono, kanye naLevi, labafundisayo abantu, batsi kubo bonke: "Lemininingwane ingcwele kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu vo; ningabi nebuhlungu, ningalilili." Ngako-ke bonkhe bantfu babelilila lapho bekhuluma amazwi emtsetfo.

Nehemiya watsi kubo: "Hambani, nidle ukudla okuhle nekudla lokumnandi niphuze, nithumele kulabo labengalungiseleli lutho; ngobe lolusuku lungcwele kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu. Mna-ke ningabi nebuhlungu, ngoba ukuthula kweNkulunkulu ngumandla enu."
BaLevi batfumisa bonke bantfu, batsi: "Thintelani, ngobe lolusuku lungcwele; ningabi nebuhlungu."
Labantfu bonke bahamba badla, baphuza, bathumela nekudla, baphumula ngekuthula kakhulu; ngobe babeqonde lamazwi abevalelwe kubo.
Ngosuku lwesibili, labaholi bemindeni yebantfu bonke, nalabaLevi nalabaLevi, bahlangana ku-Ezra, umbhali wemtsetfo, kutsi bafunde amazwi emtsetfo.
Bafumanisa kutsi kubhalwe emthethweni, lapho uSimakadze awiselise khona ngesandla saMosesi, kutsi bantfu beSirayeli kumele bahlale emahhashini ngemnyaka losikhombisa.

Batsi: "Thumela emadolobheni abo kanye neJerusalema, nifike emifuleni, nithole tihlahla te-olive, netimfuyo te-olive, nemithi ye-mirteth, netimfuyo te-palm, nanoma iyiphi inhlamvu lemhlophe, ukuze nilungiselele imibhede, njengoba kubhalwe."

Baphuma ke abantu, bakhipha emaqabunga abo, bamenza lamahhashi abo, wababeka phezu kwendlu yabo, nasezindaweni zabo, nasezindaweni zendlu yaSimakadze, nasesiteji seGate yamanzi, nasesiteji seGate kaEfraim.
Nabo bonke lababuyayo bekuboshwa bakha tindlu, bahlala kuwo; ngobe bantfu baseSirayeli abazange benze njalo kusukela ngelilanga leJoshua unyana waNuni. Bajabulise kakhulu.

Wafunda ngemtsetfo waSimakadze ngosuku ngalunye, kusukela kusuku lokuqala kuya kusuku lwesithathu; bagcine lomnyakambo iminyaka lesikhombisa, kuze kube kusuku lwesihlanu kwabe sekuyingqungquthela engcwele, njengobe kubhalwe emthethweni.
Naleso sikhathi, ngemhla lesimashumi lamane nesihlanu walomnyaka, bahlangana bonkhe bantfu beSirayeli, bephuza, begqoka iingubo zamagebhe, bebeka umhlabathi ekhanda labo.
Lamadodana eSirayeli ahlukanise lamakhosikazi abo nalabo bangaphandle, wabeka phansi, wavuma kuhlukunyezeka kwawo kanye nebubi babo, kanye nebubi bobaba babo.

Bahlala khona lapho, balalela lokubhalwa encwadini yemtsetfo waSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wabo, lilanga lesihlanu; lilanga lesihlanu bekhuluma, bethandaza, benikela emkhondweni kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wabo.
Bahlala khona esitezi, Jesuha neBani naKadmiyeli naShebaniya naBuni naSherebiya naBani naKenani, labaLevi, bathandaza kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wabo ngezwi elikhulu.

Batsi Jesuwa, naKadmiyeli, naBani, naHashabneya, naSherebiya, naHodiya, naShebania, naPetahiya, labaLevi: "Thintwa nibulele uSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, lophilayo kuze kube sekupheleni; nibulele igama lakho lelihle, Simakadze, ngoba likhulu kunaso sonke isibhakabhaka sethu.

UNkulunkulu, wena kuphela lowenza izulu, nezulu lelikhulu, naleyo mihlaba yonke; nawe wakwenza umhlaba kanye nezinto zonke ezikhona kuwo, lwandle kanye nezinto zonke ezikhona kulo; wena uphilalisa zonke lezi zinto, nalo mkhosi wezulu uthandaza kuwe.
USimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho, lowo wakhetha uAbrama, waphuma e-Ur yaseBhabheli, watsi igama lakhe nguAbrahama.

Wabona ukuthi umphefumulo wakhe ulungile kuwe, wakwenza nesivumelwano naye, kutsi utawunikela ezweni lama-Kanana, nama-Heti, nama-Amori, nama-Perizi, nama-Jebuzi, nama-Girgashi, kutsi liniketwe bantfu bakhe. Ugcine amazwi akho, ngobe wena unguNkulunkulu longcwele, lothembekile.
Wabona kutsi labababutsi bethu bahlupheka ema-Egipta, walalela imvubelo yabo elwandle lwesiSundu.
Wabonisa izimpawu nemibono kuFaro, kubo bonkhe labakhonzi bakhe, nakubo bonke bantfu belizwe lakhe; ngobe wawazi kutsi babandlulule kubo, wabanika igama lakho, njengalolusuku lwamanje.
Wahlukanisa lwandle phambi kwabo, badlula emiphakathini yaso ngemhlabatsi; labebaphazamisa wabeka emajulweni, njengatihlathi emajungwini lamanzi.
Wabakhombisa indlela ngenhloko yemvula lilanga, nenhloko yemlilo ekuseni, kutsi babone indlela labahamba kuyo.
Ufike ukhuphuka emfuleni iSinayi, wakhuluma nabo kusuka esibhakabhakeni, wabanikela ngemtsetfo lolungile, nemithetho yeqiniso, nemiyalo kanye nemyalo ehlelekile.
Wabafundisa neSabhati yakho engcwele, wabeka kubo imiyalo, nemiyalo kanye nemtsetfo ngesandla seMosi, umkhonzi wakho.
Wabanikela ngekudla lokusuka emkhathini, lapho bekhala khona; wabakhipha amanzi emifuleni, lapho bekhala khona; wabaphendvula watsi: "Niya, niyigcine lemhlaba lowutsi utawuwunikela kubo.
Batsi: "Asekho uMoya Longcwele, kepha labababuleki bethu babekezela, bancenga isandla sabo, bangawuphula umyalo wakho.

Batsi: "Asikuvumeli kutsi balalele, bakhohlwa imicabango yakho leyentile kubo; baphikisa imilenze yabo, bakhetha umholi wabo ekuphazamiseni kwabo, ukuze babuye babuye bafike basebenzela ema-Egipta. Kodwa wena uNkulunkulu lowucela lokukhululwa, onekuthula, unenhlonipho, lobushelelezi ekukhanyeni, ogcwele ubulungisa, awubashiyeli.
Nalapho bakwenta khona inkunzi yegolide, bethi, Lowo nguSimakadze longuSomandla wakho, Nkulunkulu wenu, lowutfumisa e-Egipta; nalapho bakhuluma khona ngendzaba lebuhlungu.

kodvwa wena, ngekuthula kwakho lokukhulu, ungawashiya etifuleni; inhloko yemvula ayizange ihambe isuka kubo ngelilanga, yabakhombisa indlela yabo, nenhloko yomlilo yayingeke ihambe isuka kubo ngebusuku, ibuyise indlela yabo.
Wabanika umphefumulo wakho lolungile, wabafundisa; wabeka nabo i-manna yakho kutsi bayidle, wababunika amanzi lapho befuna khona.
Ubanikela ngekudla iminyaka lemashumi lamane emhlabatsini, kuze kube baphila; tigqoko tabo azigcotshwanga, nemilenze yabo ayigcobanga.
Wabanikela ngamandla emhlaba kanye nebantfu, wababunika imihlaba yaso sonke; bakhipha ilizwe laSihoni, ukumkani waseHeshboni, nelizwe laOgi, inkhosi yaseBashan.
Wabakhipha emhlabatsini, wabahlanganisa njengetinyenyela zezulu, wabeka kubo lemhlabatsi, watsi kubaba babo: "Niya kuyo niyibambe."
Baye baphuma, bafike behlala kulomhlaba; wena wabulala ema-Kanana, labahlala kulomhlaba, phambi kwabo, wabanikela kubo, nabo bonkhe bantfu balomhlaba, kutsi babe nabo ngendlela yabo.

Bathatha lamadolobha anemigodi, nemhlaba lomhlophe, bakhipha emakhaya agcwele izinto ezinhle, nebudzi obucwebezelayo, namavinina, nema-olive, nemfuyo leminingi; badla, baphuza, bakhululwa, bajabulela buhle bakho obukhulu.
Baye baphula umthetho wakho, bewushiya emuva kwabo; babebulala boprofeta bakho labakhuluma nabo kutsi babuyele kuwe; bakhulume nawe ngezinto ezinkulu kakhulu.

Wabanikela esihlalweni semagugu abo, labaphazamisa; kepha lapho becula kuwe ekukhanyeni kwenkinga yabo, wena wabalalela kusuka entabeni; ngamandla akho amakhulu, wababunika labo lababulalayo, lababulala emagugu awo.

Baye babuyela ekwenzeni lokubi emehlweni akho, wena utawubanikela kulabo labaphazamisayo babo, kutsi babe ngabaholi kwabo. Bekubuya bekhuluma kuwe, nawe wabalalela kusuka esibhakabhakeni, ubewakhulula ngemithandazo yakho lilanga nebusuku.
Wababutsa kutsi babuye kumthetho wakho, kodvwa bona baphikisa, bangawuphula umthetho wakho; baphuca imiyalo yakho, eyenza umuntu aphile uma uyigcina; babuyela emuva, bengeke bakhulume.
Ube uhlala nabo iminyaka lemikhulu, wakhuluma nabo ngemoya wakho ngesandla semaprofeti bakho; kodvwa bangakulalela; ngobe wabanikela kubo bonkhe bantfu bemhlaba.
Ngako-ke, ngenxa yetinhlekelele takho letikhulu, utawutsi ungabaphelisi, utawutishiya; ngobe wena uNkulunkulu ungumdali wekuthula netfu.

Namuhla, Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wethu, uNkulunkulu omkhulu, lonamandla, lowukhathazayo, logcina isivumelwano sakho nekuthula; khumbula kahle yonke lebuhlungu elingene kuthi, Succession of kings, chiefs, priests, prophets, fathers, and all your people, from the days of the kings of Assyria to this day.
Ube ulungile kulo lonke lokutsetfweni lwethu; wena ube ngumuntfu lothembekile, kodvwa nathi sakhe sesikubi.
Namakhosi ethu, nabaholi bethu, nalabaphatsimandla ethu, nababuphikisi bethu, nabobaba bethu, bangeke bagcine mthetho wakho; bangavumeli imiyalo yakho netibopho zakho.

Nasekuhlaleni kwabo, nasenhliziyweni yabo, nasekudlaleni kwawo wonke lamandla akho alungile, labewanikela kubo, kanye nelizwe lelikhulu nelinyenti labewabeka phambi kwabo, bangeke bakusebenzele, bangabuyeli ekuhambeni kwabo okubi.
Namuhla, bona, siyibantfu labakhonjiwe; kanye nemhlaba lowanikela kubobaba bethu, kutsi badla umnikelo wayo kanye nekudla kwalo, sabona sesikukhonjiwe.
Lemifino yayo leminingi ifike kumankhosi, labewabeka phezu kwethu ngenxa yesive sethu; nabo balawula ngemandla abo imisipha yethu nenyama yethu. Sisebuhlungu kakhulu.
Ngako-ke, ngenxa yalesi simo sonke, singenelela ngesivumelwano esiqinile, sasibhalela phansi; nabaholi bethu, namaLevi ethu, nalabaphatsimandla ethu babeka sandla sabo kuso.
Nalaba bantu babeka sandla kuleso simiso: uNehemiya, umsa waHakaliya, umphathi, na-Zedekiya,
Seraya, neAzariya, neYeremiya,
Pashuri, neAmariya, naMalkiya,
Hatushi, neShebaniya, naMaluku,
Harim, neMeremoti, neObadiya,
uDaniele, neGinithoni, naBaruhi,
Meshulamu, neAbiya, naMiyamimu,
Maasiha, neBilgai, neShemaia; laba bekungubo bonkhe bantfu.
LaLevi: Jesuha, umsa wa-Azaniya; Binnui, wase-Henadadi; Kadmiyeli;
nabangane babo labaLevi: Shebaniya, neHodiya, neKelita, nePelaya, naHanani,
Mika, neRehobohi, naHasabiya,
Zakur, neSherebiya, naShebaniya,
neHodiya, neBani, neBenini.
Labaholi bebantfu: Parosh, nePahat-Moab, neElam, neZattu, neBani,
Bunni, neAzgadi, neBebai,
Adonija, Bigwai, Adin,
Atere, neHezekiya, neAzur,
neHodiya, neHashumu, neBezai,
Harifi, neAnathothi, neNobai,
Magpiashe, Meshulam, Hezir,
Meshezabele, neTsadoki, neJaddua,
Pelatiya, Hanan, Anaya,
Hoshea, neHananiya, neHashub,
Haloheshi, nePilha, neShobheki,
Rehum, neHashabna, naMaaseya,
Ahia, Hanan, Anan,
Malluki, neHarim, neBaana.

Ukhipha ukuqonda kwabaholi bemhlaba, wabashiya bahamba ngetinyawo emasikweni lapho angeke kube khona indlela.
Bafuna indlela yabo emthunzini, ngaphandle kwekukhanya; uyawubashiya behamba njengebantfu labaphuza.
"Lamuhla, mehlo ami akubona konkhe loku, nendlebe yami ikhuluma, nayo ikhumbula.
Lento lowuyaziyo wena, nami ngiyibona; ngingabi phansi kuwe.
Nami ngifuna kutsi ngikhulume naNkulunkulu Omkhulu, ngifuna kutsi ngibuyele kuThixo ngecala lami.
Natsi niye, niyifihla ngebugebengu; ningaba dokotela lababi kakhulu.
Uma nje ungeke ukhululeke kakhulu, lokhu kungeke kube yinto ehlelekile kuwe kutsi uyenze.
Namuhla, lalelani kutsi ngikhuluma yini; landzelani kutsi ngisho yini.
Ingabe ukhuluma lutho lokubi kuNkulunkulu, ungasho yini kuye kutsi angeke abe?
Ingabe utawuhlala icala lakhe? Ingabe utawukhuluma ngecala lakhe?
Ungeke uphile kahle yini uma ekubona? Ingabe ungawukhohlisa kanjani, njengendlela uyawukhohlisa ngayo abantu?
Ungeke akusho lutho kuwe uma uhlala ucala ngetinyawo.
Ingabe ubukhulu bakhe bungakukhathaza, noma ngabe kutfutfuka kwakhe kungakugwaza?
Lemilomo yenu ifana netfufu, kanye namazwi enu afana nemhlabatsi.
Lala bese ngikhuluma; nome yini lengeke ifike kimi, iyabe ifike.
Ngabe ngingeke ngisibeke enhliziyweni yami engozini kanye nekuphila kwami ngesandla sam?
Nakuba angamibulala, ngobe sengingeke ngifune, ngaye ngitakhuluma ngendlela yami phambi kwakhe.
Lokho kungeke kumsindise, ngobe angeke kube khona lowo muntfu longenaNkulunkulu loyawufika phambi kwakhe.
Lingisani kahle kutsi ngikhuluma yini, bese lemazwi ami afika emandlebeni akho.
Ngitsi, sengilungiselele icala lami, ngiyazi kutsi ngizobe sengifanele.
Ingabe kukhona lowo longeke abe necala ngami? Uma kunjalo, ngitakhala, ngite.
UNkulunkulu, nikela nami ngezinto ezimbili kuphela, bese ngingeke ngikufihla:
Tsuse sandla sakho kusuka kum, uyeke kutsi ungithetse ngemanti akho.
Lapha khuluma nami, ngitawukuphendula; noma ngitakhuluma, wena uyawuphendula.
Ngubani nalowo muntfu longeke afike enkhosini yami, kodvwa abe nguSimakadze longuSomandla wami?
Yini naletifihlako buso bakho kum, ungenza ngibe ngumfowabo?
Ingabe ungeke utfole lilanga lelivutha ngemoya? Ingabe ungeke utfune isihlahla lesisha?
Ubhalela ngami ticala letibuhlungu, uphindze ungibeke kutsi ngikhokhe tindzaba letibi letibekiwe ngemnyaka wami loncane.
Ubeka tinyawo tami emgodini, ulandzela kuhamba kwami ngaso sonke sikhatsi; ubeka umgco lapho tinyawo tami tingeke zihambe khona.
Nami ngiyawufa njengento ephukile, njengetigqoko letidlalwe nguma.
Wonke lowo wazalwa nguwesifazane uphila isikhathi esincane kuphela, nekuphila kugcwele inkinga.
Sikhula sifana nembali, bese siphucuka; singena njengesithunzi, singahlalanga.
Ingabe ungeke ubeke mehlo akho kulowo lofana nami? Ingabe ungeke ungifake enkundleni kutsi ngigwenywe nguwe?
Nguwuphi lowo longeke aphume nento lengcwele kusuka kuleyo engeyona?
Utsi: "Lamandla ekuphila kwemuntu, wena utawuwamisa; wena utawumisa inani leminyaka yakhe, nawe utawumisa timiso letingeke ahambe ngazo.
Lapha, shiya kuye, uvumele aphumule, kuze aphele iminyaka yakhe njengemuntfu lokhokhelwa.
Kunethemba ngesihlahla; uma sicutshungulwa, sizokhula kabusha, netinsika letisha tiyawukhula.
Inhloko yayo ingase ikhule ibe mkhulu emhlabatsini, kanye nesihlahla sayo singase sife emhlabathini.
kepha ngephunga lelilanga liyawukhula, liphindze livule tindzawo letiphakeme njengesihlahla lesincane.
Kodwa uma umuntu efa, bese ebekwa phansi, bese ekhipha umphefumulo wakhe, khona-ke ukhona phi?
Njengamanzi aphuma emfuleni, bese umfula ujika, uphela,
Batsi: "Laba bantu bayalala, bangase basuseli; kuze kube lizulu liphelile, bangase baphumuli, bangase bakhutshwe embhedeni wabo.
Ngiyafuna kutsi ungifihla emhlabatsini, ungitfole kuze kuphelile umsindo wakho; ngingathanda kutsi ungibeke isikhathi sokuyikhumbula.
Uma umuntu efa, angaphila yini? Ngingeke ngilinde iminyaka yami yemsebenti wami, kuze kube kufike kutfunywa kwami.
Uyawukhuluma, ngitawukuphendula; uyawufuna lokwenziwa ngesandla sakho.
Lakho, wena utawubheka imiyalo yami, kodvwa awuzange ube nenkinga ngesono sami.
Ube ubeka icala lami ebhokisini, bese unciphisa umonakalo wami.
Ngako-ke, njengobe umfula uphuma, utfoleka, netintaba tisuka endaweni yawo,
njengobe amanzi abulala ematshe, kanye nemvula isusa mhlaba, njalo-ke wena ushiya umphefumulo wemuntu.
Uyawuwuphazamisa, utawuphuma; uyawushintsha buso bakhe, utawumushiya.
Nakuba labantwana bakhe bahlonishwa, yena awazi; nakuba bahlupheka, yena akakubona.
Ucabanga kuphela ngebuhlungu besikhumba sakhe, futhi uhlupheka kuphela ngenxa yakhe.
Elifazi waseTemani waphendula watsi:
"Ngabe umfundi utawuphendula ngemicabango leyimfishane, bese egcwele umoya lofudumele?
Ingabe ukhuluma ngemazwi angasebenzi, nemazwi angeke abe nenzuzo?
kodvwa niyawubulala nekuthula kweNkulunkulu, nitawuletsa abantu kutsi bangawuthandaza.
Lobubi bakho bufundisa umlomo wakho kutsi ukhulume yini; wena ukhetha kukhuluma njengemuntfu lokhazimu.
Umlomo wakho, hhayi lomi, utawukubulala; imilebe yakho ikhuluma nawe.
Ingabe wena ube ngumuntu wokuqala lozalwa, wakhiwa-ke ngaphambili kwetingcotfo?
Ingabe ukhuluma ngemihlangano yaNkulunkulu? Ingabe ucabanga kutsi wena kuphela lonomcabango?
Ucabanga yini kutsi singeketyne, noma ucabanga yini kutsi singeke sibone?
Batsi: "Sinebantfu labakhulu, labamnyama, labakhulu kunababa wakho."
Akufanele yini kutsi ukhululeke ngemazwi aNkulunkulu, nemazwi ekuthula akhuluma nawe?
Ngubani na lowo umphefumulo wakho utfumele kuwe? Ngubani na lomehlo akho aphikisayo,
kutsi ubeke buhlungu bakho kuNkulunkulu, uyewukhipha umlomo wakho ngemazwi lanjalo?
Ubani lomuntu, kutsi abe ngcwele? Ubani lowo wazalwa ngumkhwenyana, kutsi abe ngumuntfu lolungile kuSimakadze?
Beka, uNkulunkulu angeke athembeke kulabo abangcwele bakhe; kanye nezulu lingeke libe lihlanzekile emehlo akhe.
Ngabe angeke abe ngumuntu lobi, lobi kakhulu, lodla umonakalo njengobe amanzi!
Lingisa, ngitawukuchaza; ngiyakukhuluma ngezinto letingeke ngazibone,
letinye tincwadzi tekucala titsi "titfu" titsi "titfu", kanye nalelo livi,
Lelizwe lalike litfunyelwe bababo kuphela, ngobe angeke kube khona mhlali lophuma kwelinye lizwe ehlala nabo.
Lomuntfu lobi uhlupheka kuphila kwakhe lonke, kanye neminyaka yakhe leyawuhlala kuyo.
Tindlebe takhe tigcwele imvumi lebuhlungu. Kuze kube kubukeka sengathi kuphephile, lobulalayo utawumuhlasela.
Akholwa kutsi ungeke aphume emthunzini. Icwecwe likhona liyawumuletsa.
Uhamba efuna ukudla, watsi: 'Kuphi?' Wazi kutsi usuku lwesibhakabhaka luhle kakhulu.
Tinhlekelele nebuhlungu tiyawutfusa, titawumuhlasela njengenkhosi elungiselelwe kuhlasela.
Ngako-ke, uSimakadze watsi: "Ngubani na lowo longeke abe ngumuntfu waNkulunkulu?
Watsatsa sandla sakhe, watsi: "Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Amori, utsi:
Ubuso bakhe bucutshungulwa ngekudla, nemilenze yakhe ingumsoco.
Uyawuhlala emigwaqweni leyimisiwe, emindenini lapho angeke kube khona umuntu lohlala kuyo, emindenini yebantfu labafileyo.
Angeke ahlale ecebile, kanye nemali yakhe angeke ihlale, naleyo mpahla yakhe angeke ihlukaniswe emhlabeni.
Angeke avikeleke emnyama, mlilo utawudlidliza imbewu yakhe, nemoya wendlebe yaNkulunkulu uyawuwususa.
Angeke akhohlwe ngekuthembela kwakhe kuleyo nto engeyona lutho, ngobe ngeke afike abe nento lebalulekile.
Utawukhokhelwa lilanga lakhe, netinsika takhe tingeke tihlale tiluhlaza.
Angeke abe njengesihlahla semvini lesishaya mbewu yayo, nesihlahla sema-olive sishiya umhlobiso wayo.
Ibandla lalababi lingeke libe nabantwana, nemlilo utawudla indlu yalabo labathandela umshwalense.
Bacabanga buhlungu, bese bazala lokubi. Intliziyo yabo ihlala icabanga ububi."
UJobu waphendula watsi:
Watsi: "Ngibe ngikhuluma ngezinto eziningi letifana naleto, ngobe niyibantfu lababi kakhulu.
Ingabe kukhuluma kwakho kungakapheli? Yini ekusikhatsa, kutsi uhlala ukhuluma njalo?
Ngingeke ngikhulume ngendlela yakho, uma ngabe uhlala phandle, ngibe sengikhuluma kahle kuwe, ngitsi: "Nceda!"
Nami ngifuna kutsi nikhululeke ngemazwi ami, ngobe ngifuna kutsi nikhululeke ngemazwi am.
Nakuba ngikhuluma, buhlungu bami abupheli; Nakuba ngikhala, buyawuhlala nami.
UNkulunkulu, nguNkulunkulu wakho, ungeke ungiphazamise; wena utawumikhipha emndenini wami lonke.
Ungenza ngikhubeke, le buhlungu buye bube yisibonakaliso ngami; imilenze yami inciphisa, iyakhuluma ngami.
UNkulunkulu, ngemphiko yakhe, uncike ngami, wanquma ngami; watsi: "Lawo mazinyo akhe aphikisa ngami; umkhonzi wami unemehlo akhe emangalisa.
Bawuvula umlomo wabo, batfusa mehlo ami, baphazamisa imilenze yami; bonke bahlangana labani.
Nkulunkulu unginikela kubo bonkhe bantfu lababi, ungibeka emilenzeni yalabo labangalungile.
Nginekuthula, kodvwa yena watfusa. Wamitfwala emphinjeni yami, wanquma kutsi ngiphule; wamisa ngami njengento leyawuyibulala.
Labahlabani bakhe bami bahlala ngaseceleni kwami; angeke anikhombise ukuthula, kodvwa uyawutsisa emphilweni yami.
Uye wahlasela emasango ami, watsi: "Ngubani na loyawungibulala?"
Nginesikhumba sami lesinconywe ngetintambo, ngobe ngitsi: "Ngiye kutfusa kuthula kwami"
Lobuso bami bumnyama kakhulu, mehlo ami anesithunzi.
Lamandla ami angeke abe nebugebengu, ngobe mthandazo wami ungcwele.
Lemhlaba, ungawufihlanga gazi lami, ungeke uvumele lokushiwo kwami ngemtsetfo kutsi ku latsi.
Nasekumanje, umshushisi wami ukhona emhlabeni, nalowo lokhuluma ngami e ahlala emaphandleni.
Labangani bami bangisitsa, kepha mehlo ami aphuma emacwecwe kuNkulunkulu.
Ngifuna kutsi kube nemuntfu lokhuluma ngami kuNkulunkulu, njengobe umuntu ekhuluma ngemunye.
Ngeminyaka lembalwa nje, ngitahamba ngendlela lapho ngingeke ngibuye khona.
Umphefumulo wami uhluphekile, lilanga lami liphelile, neGibhithe lihlala limi.
Labaphazamisayo bami bahlala ngami, ngobe ngiyawuva kutsi bangisitsa.
LoNkulunkulu, ngiyakucela uvumele kutsi ungisize wena; ngubani longeke abeke sandla sami?
Uvule mehlo abo kutsi bangaboni, ngobe ungeke ubavumele baphumelele.
Uma umuntu ephikisane nabangani bakhe ngemali, bantfwana bakhe batawuhlupheka ngenxa yalo.
Nkulunkulu ungenza ngibe yinhlekelele ebantwini; Baphuca emhlane wami.
Imehlo ami amnyama ngebuhlungu, nemphilo yami yonke ilula njengesithunzi.
Labafanelekayo bahlupheka ngalolu hlobo, nalabo bangabi necala bahlupheka ngelowo longeke abe nguNkulunkulu.
kepha labo labalungile bahlala behamba ngendlela lefanele, kanye nalabo abanesandla lesisha bakhula babe namandla.
Niye nibuyeni, niphindeni, ngitsi: Angeke ngithole muntfu lowaziyo phakathi kwenu.
Kuphela lilanga lami, kuphelile imicabango yami, kanye nemibono yenhliziyo yam.
Bashintsha busuku bube mhlakani, bethi: "Ukukhanya kuyafika," nakuba kumnyama.
Uma ndlu yami ihlala emhlabatsini, noma uma sengibeka lebhedu lami emthunzini,
uma ngijenzelise mlilo kutsi uyise wami, nome umdlovukazi wakhe, noma inkemba yakhe, noma indvodzakati yami,
Kuphi khona themba lami? Nguwuphi lowo lotawungibona nginethemba?
Ingaba ithemba lami liyawuphuma nami kuya emasango aseSheol? Ingabe siyawuphuma kanye emhlabatsini?"
Waphendula Bildadi wase-Suha, watsi:
"Ngakanani utawuhlala ufuna magama? Khumbula ngaphambi, bese sikhuluma.
Yini lekwenta kutsi nitsi tilwane, yini lekwenza nitibone sengathi siyitfu?
Uyakha ubuso bakho ngemphiko yakho. Ingabe lemhlaba ungeke ushiyeke ungabi nalutho ngenxa yakho? Ingabe imifula iphindze ibuyele endaweni yayo ngenxa yakho?
Ukukhanya kwemuntfu lobi kuyawufiwa, nemlilo wakhe wemlilo utawutsi ungadli.
Ukukhanya kwetendlu yakhe kungeke kube mnyama, nelanga lakhe liyawufa.
Inyawo lakhe lelihle liyawutsi likhulu, imicabango yakhe itawumupha.
Inyawo lakhe lelinye liyawuwubeka emgodini, wahamba ngesandla sakhe sakhe kuye.
Umgodzi utawumugwaca ngetinyawo, umgodzi utawumubamba ngesandla.
Intambo ifihlakele emhlabatsini yakhe, kanye netfu libekwe ngendlela yakhe.
Ubuhlungu bumukhathisa ngaso sonke sikhatsi, bumuhlasela ngaso sonke simo.
Uphelelwa ngumandla ngendlala, nenkinga ikhona kuye lapho egwaca khona.
Isifo sidla sikhumba sakhe, umzabalazo wekufa udla imilenze yakhe nemisebe yakhe.
Waphuma ekuthula kwetente lakhe, wahamba waya kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wema-Amori.
Labanye bahlala etentini lakhe, nemlilo we-sulphur usakazeka phezu kwendlu yakhe.
Inhloko yakhe ikhutshwe phansi, netihlahla zakhe ziveliswa phezulu.
Angeke kubekho muntu emhlabeni loyawumkhumbula, noma ngubani emhlabatsini lowazi igama lakhe.
Waphuma ekukhanyani wafika emngcwabeni, wasuswa emhlabeni.
Angeke abe nemadvodzana kanye nemadvodzakati emiphakathini yakhe, kodvwa angeke kubekho namunye lohlala lapho.
Labanye labaphuma ngemuva kwakhe bahlupheka kakhulu, njengoba nalabo ababekhona ngaphambili bakhe bahlupheka.
Lokho kungenxa yetfu lelingaba khona emakhazeni lalabo ababusi, kanye netfu lelingaba khona emakhazeni lalabo labangazi.
UJobu waphendula watsi:
Ingabe kuze kube kuphi lapho ungeke ungikhonze khona, ungeke uninikele ponad amehlo akho?
Lakho kungenxa yakho, ngobe utfubile; kuze kube kungakabi nalinye livi lakho.
Nakuba kuyiqiniso kutsi sengikwenzele kahle, iphutha lami ngumsebenzi wami.
Uma nifuna kutsi nibonakale nihle kakhulu kunemi, bese nisebenzisa buhlungu bami njengebufakazi labanibulala,
kholwa kutsi Nkulunkulu ungithetse, wamifaka emgodini wakhe.
Ngitsi: "Nceda, ngiyabiwa!" kepha angeke kube khona lowo lokhuluma; ngitsi: "Nceda," kodvwa ngeke kube khona lowo olungisa.
Wayivala indlela yami, ngingeke ngiyihambe; wabeka lilanga emthunzini endlela yami.
Wayisusa inhlonipho yami, wayisusa inhloko yami yinye,
Umibulala ngaso sonke simo, kuze kube ngiphelile; watfusa ithemba lami njengesihlahla.
Umsindo wakhe utfubile kimi, Wamibona njengemunye walabo abamengameli bakhe.
Lamandla akhe ahlangana, bamisa izingcezu ngami, bamisa emasitela entanyeni yami.
Wamisa bazalwane bami kude nami; labaholi bebantfu labahamba nabo babuyela emuva.
Labangani bami baphuma, nalabo bahlala ndawonye nami balibala ngami.
Labangani bami, netibondza bami, bangenza kimi sengathi sengumkhwenyana; babheka kimi sengathi sengumhlali.
Ngitsi: "Lomkhonzi wami, akazange amphendule, ngisho nalapho ngimucela khona."
Umphefumulo wami utfusa indodana yami, nabangani bami batfusa.
Nasetincane tiyawungibona; lapho ngiphuma khona, bangisitsa.
Bami, bonke labo bahlala ndawonye nami, bami, labo ngibathandela, babuyela kum.
Ngiyisikhumba nemilenze yami kuphela, ngaphuma ngesikhumba semazinyo ami.
Bami, bami, bami, bami, ngobe sandla saNkulunkulu simile kimi.
Ngubani na lowo longeke afune kutsi ngibe nguNkulunkulu? Ingabe ungenawo umphefumulo wami lofanele?
Ngifuna kutsi magama ami abhalwe phansi, ngifuna kutsi abhalwe encwadini!
Ngingeke ngifune kutsi bacwecwe emadolobheni kuze kube sekupheleni ngesandla sensimbi bese begcwele lilanga!
Nami ngiyazi kutsi uphila lowo loyawungikhulula, kuze kube kuphele iminyaka yakhe, utawuhlala emhlabatsini.
Nakuba sikhumba sami sihleliwe, ngiyawubona Nkulunkulu ngenyama yami.
Nami ngitawumubona ngaseceleni kwami, ngiyawumubona ngemehlo ami, ngobe angeke abe ngumuntu longaphandle. Ngabe lilanga lenjalo inhliziyo yami ifuna!
Nakuba nitsi, Sifike sihambe ngemuva kwakhe, ngobe umfutho wenkinga ukhona kuye;
hlalani nalowo mkhosi, ngobe ubuhlungu buvela kulowo mkhosi, ukuze nibone kutsi kukhona lokuhlukunyezwa."
USofara waseNaama watsi:
"Imibono yami lebushelelezi yenza kutsi ngiphendule, ngobe sengibuhlungu kakhulu ngaphakathi.
Ngikujenjelwa, ngobe ngitsi: "Ndzabe" nguNkulunkulu, ngatsi: "Ndzabe" nguNkulunkulu.
Niyazi kahle kutsi kusukela kuleso sikhathi, kusukela lapho abantu babekwa khona emhlabeni,
Ukuthula kwebantfu lababi kungakapheli, nekukhululeka kwalabo labengakholwa nguNkulunkulu kuyawuhlala lilanga.
Nakuba inhlonipho yabo ifike emazulu, nakuba imilomo yabo ifinyelele emafu,
Bazophela njengenkemba yabo; labo labawaziyo baya kuphendvula, batsi: Kuphi nalabo?
Baphuma njengephupho, bangafunwanga; baphuma njengembono yebusuku, baqhutshwa ngaso.
Lamehlo abo atawubabona, kodvwa ayawubabona; nendlu yabo itawubabona kuze kube sekupheleni.
Labantwana babo bangeke babe nenkinga yekucela usizo kulabo abahluphekile. Bangeke babe nenkinga yokubuyiselwa kwemali labo abagcinile.
Lemisipha yabo yabe igcwele kutfutfuko lokuncane, kepha lokutfufuko luyawulala nabo emtweni.
Lobubi bumnandi emilonyeni yabo, bayawukufihla ngaphansi kwelimlomo babo.
Bawujabulela futsi bangeke bawuvumele uhambe. Bawugcina emlomoni wabo.
Lekudla kwabo kuyawuba buhlungu emlonyeni wabo, kuze kube sekuba ngumphimbo lomnyama ebusweni babo.
Badla impahla, bayawuyikhipha; Nkulunkulu utawubabuyisela emathunjini abo.
Bafuna ubisi lwetingulube. Tingulube letibulalako titawubabulala.
Bangeke bajabulele imifula, imifula ephuma ngeju kanye nejusi.
Baye baphindze babuyele kuleyo misebenzi yabo, kodvwa bangayidla. Baye balahlekelwa yinzuzo yebhizinisi labo.
Ngako-ke babulala labafayo, babashiya bengenalutho, bathatha tindlu labebengazisunguleli.
Kube kungabikho kutfuleka kwabo, bangeke bakwazi ukuvikela noma yini yezinto labebathanda.
Angeke kube khona lutho lokushiwo ngemuva kwekutidla kwabo, ngobe timfanelo tabo tingeke tihlale.
Nalapho bekhona khona, kuyawufika buhlungu kubo; nemandla lalomonakalo atawufika phezu kwabo.
Nalapho batfumile emathunjini abo, Nkulunkulu utawutsisa kubo umsindo wakhe, utawutsisa phezu kwabo imvula lapho bedla khona.
Angeke ahambe ngemikhumbi yensimbi, kepha lilanga lesiliva litawubabulala.
Bayawujenzisela emphinjeni yabo, bese baphuma emlonyeni wabo lilanga lelikhanyayo; tindlala tafika kubo.
Tindlu tabo tingeke tihlale lilanga, ngobe litfu lelingenawo umphefumulo litawutibulala, liyawudla yonke into etentini labo.
Sibhakabhaka sitawukhombisa inkohlakalo yabo, nemhlaba uyawuphuma kubo.
Indlu yabo iyawutfunywa ngumlilo, kanye nemanti aphumayo kulelo lilanga lebuhlungu.
Lokhojenye umsebenti waNkulunkulu kulabo lababi, kanye nalowo Nkulunkulu labewanikela kubo kutsi abe yingxenye yabo.
UJobu waphendula watsi:
"Lingisani kahle kutsi ngikhuluma yini, ngobe lokhu kuyawuba ngukukhululeka kwenu.
Kutsi ngikhuluma, khululekeni; bese lapho ngikhuluma khona, ningeke nihlale ningitsa.
Ngubani na longeke abe nekuthula? Ngubani na longeke abe netfu?
Lingisa mehlo akho kum, ukhululeke; kubeka isandla sakho emlomo wakho.
Uma ngicabanga ngale nto, ngitfuba kakhulu, nenyama yami ikhatsa.
Baphila kanjani lababi? Bakhula, bakhula, bese befika emandlani.
Labantwana babo bakhula bahlala nabo, bese bebona labangane babo.
Tindlu zabo tiphephile, Allah angeke abophe kubo.
Tingulube tabo tihlala tikhula, tingulube tabo tidzala futsi tingeke tilahle timbuti.
Bakhipha tincane tabo njengetfu letingcweti, nemadvodzana abo lidlalwa ngato.
Bakhuluma ngemiculo yema-tamburine ne-harp, badlala ngemisindo ye-flute.
Badla kuphila kwabo ngemali, bese baphuma emhlabatsini bekhululeka.
Bathi kuNkulunkulu, Sishiya; asifuni ukwazi indlela yakho.
Nguwuphi lowo Mtfubi, kutsi siyawumukhonza; yini lesizoyithola ngekuthandaza kuye?
Batsi: "Asekho esandlani sabo lokuphila kwabo, ngobe angeke ngibe nesibopho sokuba ngumholi webantfu lababi.
Ingabe lilanga lebantfu lababi liphuma lini? Ingabe kuyawufika kubo umonakalo? Ingabe uNkulunkulu utawubabulala ngemphiko yakhe?
Bangaphi emaphesenti labo aphindze abe njengetingulube letiboshwa ngumoya, noma njengobe tingulube letiboshwa ngumlilo?
Utsi: 'UNkulunkulu utawubavikela ekufeni kwabo.' UNkulunkulu uyawubabulala, ngobe bangeke bakwazi kukubona.
Lababone ngemehlo abo kuhlukunyezwa kwabo, baphuze buhlungu beNkulunkulu Omkhulu.
Ngubani longeke abe nenkinga ngekutfolwa kwemndeni wabo ngemuva kwekufa kwabo kanye nesikhathi sabo siphelile?
Ingabe umuntu angafundisa yini Nkulunkulu, ngobe yena aphindze abe ngumhlolojikelele welabo abasemazulu?
Lomuntu ufa lapho ahlala khona eqinile, ekhululeke kakhulu kanye nekuthula.
Umlomo wakhe utfolwa kahle, kanye nemilenze yakhe iqinile futhi inhle.
Lomunye ufa ngenhliziyo lebushelelezi, angeke abe nenhlanhla ngalento enhle.
Bobabili bahlala emhlabatsini, nalabo bobabili bacutshungulwa ngumaphiko.
Ngitsi, ngiyazi imicabango yenu, kanye nemibono yenu yekutsi ningalibulala.
Nithi, Kuphi indlu yemuntfu lomkhulu? Kuphi tindlu lapho lababi behlala khona?
Ungababuza yini labo labahamba ngetinyawo, ungava yini imicabango yabo?
Abantu lababi bagcinwa ngelilanga lebuhlungu, babuyiselwa ngelilanga lendlala.
Nguwuphi lowo lokhuluma kubo ngento yabo lebi? Nguwuphi lowo loyawubalalisa labo abakwenzayo?
Bafakwa ethempelini, nebantfu bagcina tigodzi tabanye.
Batsi: "Lemhlaba wefula uyawuba lula kubo; bonke batawuhamba ngemuva kwabo, njengendlela labazange bahambe ngayo.
Ngubani na lowungeke ungikhulise ngemazwi akho, ngobe impendulo yakho ayikho ngaphandle kwebubi!
Elifazi waseTemani waphendula watsi:
Ingabe umuntu angawusebentisa Nkulunkulu yini? Natsi nalowo lonixwabile, uyawusebentisa yena.
Ingabe lowo Mtfubi uyawukhululeka, uma wena ulungile? Ingabe uyaphumelela, uma kuphila kwakho kungakabi necala?
Ingabe, ngobe uyawumuhlonipha, utawukuphoxela nawe, nawe utawukufaka enkantolo?
Akunjalo, ngobe lokubi kwakho kukhulu kakhulu, nebubi bakho abuphelelanga.
Wathatha impahla yabangani bakho, wanikela ngayo ngaphandle kwecala; wabasusa emacwecwe abo, wabashiya bengeke bagqokwe.
Uphindze wanikela ngemanti kulabo labakhubazekile, kanye nekudla kulabo labagula.
Ube ngumuntfu lonamandla, ubenemhlaba, ube ngumholi webantfu labahlala khona.
Labesilisa nabesifazane utawubasusa bengenalutho, bese ubulala mandla lalabafazi.
Ngako-ke, letinye titfunywa tikhona ngaso sonke simo sakho, kanye nekuthula lokudlwengulako kutfumisa.
Ngako-ke kumnyama kakhulu, ungeke ubone, bese lilanga lemvula likugubuta.
UNkulunkulu angeke abe emhlabatsini? Bona kutsi lilanga liphakeme kakhulu!
Ngako-ke utsi: UNkulunkulu ungazi yini? Ingabe angagwema kutsi agweme lilanga?
Timvula letiqinile tiwufihla, ngobe angeke atibone emehlweni akhe lapho ehamba ngemhlabatsi wezulu.'
Ingabe uyawuhlala ngendlela yakudala, lapho lababi behamba ngayo?
Bacutshungulwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi sabo, isisekelo sabo sicutshungulwe ngumlilo.
Batsi kuNkulunkulu: "Lala, yini leyawukwenta Nkulunkulu Lomkhulu?"
LoNkulunkulu ugcwele tindlu tabo ngezinto letinene; Ngingeke ngivumeleke kutsi ngibe ngumholi walabo ababi.
Abantu labalungile babona kutyntwa kwabo, bakhululeka; kepha labo bangabi necala, bayabakhala,
"Labaphikisayo bethu bakhululwe, naleyo mpahla yabo eshiyekile imtfubi iyawuyidla."
Ngenani laNkulunkulu, nihlalene naye ngekuthula; khona-ke kuyawufika kwenu lokubi.
Lamukela mthetho emlonyeni wakhe, ugcine amazwi akhe enhliziyweni yakho.
Uma ubuyela kuNkulunkulu Omkhulu, utawubuyiselwa emuva; khipha lokubi emhlabatsini lakho.
Tsuse igolide lakho emhlabatsini, negolide lakho lelihle phakathi kwemifula.
UNkulunkulu Lomkhulu uyawuba golide wakho, nesiliva lakho lelihle.
Lakho kutawukuvusa ukhululeke kuNkulunkulu Lomkhulu, uphakamise ubuso bakho kuye Nkulunkulu.
Uyawuthandaza kuye, naye utawukuphendula; nawe utawunikela ngetinani zakho lakhe.
Nasiphi na sinqumo lesiniketwe, sitawuphumelela, nekukhanya kuyawukhanya endlela yakho.
Uma utsi: "Nciphisani" labo labaphansi, Nkulunkulu uyabakhulula labo abaphansi.
Uyawukhipha nalowo longeke abe necala; ngobe isandla sakho silungile, yena utawususwa."
UJobu waphendula watsi:
Nakho lilanga lenu libuhlungu kakhulu; isandla saNkulunkulu sinzima kimi, nakuba sengigula.
Ngingeke ngikwazi kutsi ngingawuthola phi, ngingeke ngifike lapho ehlala khona!
Ngingeke ngibeke icala lami phambi kwakhe, netfusa umlomo wami ngemibiko.
Ngingeke ngibone kutsi angabaphenduli yini, nome ngibone kutsi angabe ati yini kuye.
Angeke akhulume nami ngemandla akhe lamakhulu? Ngabe angeke amlalele?
Lakhona umuntu lothembekile ungeke akhulume naye, ummeli wami ungeke amvumele kutsi akhululeke kuze kube sekupheleni.
Uma ngiya enyakatho, angeke abe khona; noma ngabe ngiya emaphandleni, angamthola.
Uma esebenza ngasentshonalanga, ngingamubonanga; uma ebuyela entshonalanga, ngingamubonanga.
Kwakhona, yena ayazi indlela engithathayo; lapho efuna khona mina, nizophuma nisebunzini.
Inyawo lami lihlala lihamba ngendlela yakhe, ngiyigcina indlela yakhe, ngingabi nakwehla.
Angeke ngibeke phansi imiyalo yemilomo yakhe; ngiyayihlonipha imvumo yakhe kunekudla kwami lokuhlala khona.
ngobe yena kuphela uNkulunkulu, ngubani longeke akhululeke kuye? Uyakwenza lokudlalelayo.
Uyakwenza nami lokudla kwakhe, kanye nekudla kwakhe lokuningi lokufana nalo.
Ngako-ke nginetfutfu ebusweni bakhe; uma ngicabanga ngalo, ngingalokoti ngaye.
Nkulunkulu utfubile intliziyo yami, Lomkhuluwa utfubile inhliziyo yami.
Ngase ngibe sengikhululekanga ngemanti, Ngetimnyama letitfusa ibuso bami.
Ngubani na lowo Mtfubi longeke abeke tikhatsi temtsetfo? Ngubani na lowo umtatile, longeke abone lilanga lakhe?
Bakhona labahamba ngemigodi yemikhawulo kutsi baphuce mhlaba, baphuca tingulube bese babeka emafuleni abo.
Baphuma nedoli lelisifazane, bese bathatha inkomo yendvodzakati yakhe njengenhlawulo.
Bakhipha emahlwempu emgwaqeni, nabo bonkhe labafile emhlaba baphindze bafihla.
Kungenjalo nalabo batfutsi, labaphuma befuna ukudla, njengetingulube temhlabatsini; lemhlabatsini litawubanikela ngekudla labantwana babo.
Bahlangana nembewu emhlabatsini labanye, bese bevuna emavini lalabo ababi.
Bachitha busuku bemnyama, bengenatigqoko, bengenanto leyawubavikela ekujuleni.
Bakhuliswa ngemvula yemhlabatsi kanye nekuvutela ematshe ngoba bangeke babe nendlu.
Batsi: "Kunebantfu labakhipha labantwana emabeleni emama babo. Bathatha labantwana balabo abahlwempu njengenkhosa yemali yabo.
Batsi labafayo bahamba bemnyama, bangabi nemgqomo; beba netikhongo tekudla, kodvwa bafile.
Bafaka i-olive phakathi kwetindlu talabo abacebile, bafaka iwayini emabhodleleni ewayini, kepha bangabi nendlala.
Lamadoda enhloko-dolobha aphuca, nalabo abadlwengulayo baphuma becela usizo; kodvwa Nkulunkulu akaboni lutho lokubi.
Bakhona bantfu labaphikisako nekukhanya; bangawazi indlela yalo, noma bahlale emigwaqeni yayo.
Umdlavuza uphuma ekuseni, ubulala umtfubi nalowo lofunako; emveni kwebusuku uhlala njengemkhwenyana.
Umfana lohlala nenkosikazi yakhe, uma efika ekuseni, ucabanga kutsi: 'Akukho mntu loyawungibona.' Ngako-ke uvikela ibuso bakhe.
Ngelilanga lemnyama, babulala emakhaya; ngelilanga lemhlophe, bavala emakhaya abo. Bangeke babe nento yekwenza nekukhanya.
Kubojenze kubo bonke, ekuseni kuyawufana nebumnyama obukhulu; Bahlangana nalabo batfunywa ngubumnyama.
Bafike babe njengenkungu elwandle; ingxenye yabo yemhlaba iphelelwe, ngobe angeke kubekho lofika emavini abo.
Kutsi kushisa kanye nemvula lemnyama itfusa intaba-mlilo, njalo-ke lihlane litfusa labo lababi.
Emama abo ayawuwalibala; tingulube titawudla kubo, ngeke kubekho lowo loyawuwakhumbula. Ngako-ke lokubi kuphucuka njengesihlahla.
Basebenzisana nabesifazane labangenabantwana, baphindze basebentisa letinye tinyoni.
LoNkulunkulu ubeka phezulu lonamandla ngemandla akhe; nakuba abonakala eqinile, angeke abe nesiqiniseko sekuphila kwakhe.
Nkulunkulu utawubavumela bakhululeke, ngobe amehlo akhe abheke indlela yabo.
Bakhulula emaviki lambalwa, bese bephuma; baphansi, bese becutshungulwa njengabo bonkhe bantfu, bese becutshungulwa njengobe tingulube temhlabatsi.
Uma kungenjalo, yini lengeke ivumeleke kutsi ngibe ngumkhohlisi, nome kutsi amazwi ami abe lutho?
Waphendula Bildadi wase-Suha, watsi:
UNkulunkulu ulawula, nguNkulunkulu lowagcobayo; yena lowenza kuthula emazulu aphakeme.
Ingabe kukhona lokwenta linani lemikhosi yakhe? Ingabe kukhona lowo muntfu lokukhanya kwakhe kungeke kufike kuyo?
Ungaba kanjani lowo muntfu lolungile kuNkulunkulu? Ngabe lowo wazalwa ngumkhwenyana angaba njani longcwele?
Nakuba lilanga lingeke lijabulise, naletinye titukulwane tingeke zisihle emehlo akhe,
letinye tincwadzi tekucala titsi: "lomuntu, longeke abe ngumuntfu, ngobe angeke abe ngumuntu!"
UJobu waphendula watsi:
Ngubani na lowo longeke abe nemandla, wena uyawuwuvikela umlenze welowo ongeke abe nemkhono?
Ngubani na lowo muntfu longeke abe nenhlonipho? Ngubani na lowo muntfu longeke abe nenhlanhla!
Nguwuphi umphefumulo wakho lapho ukhuluma khona la mazwi?
Lamandla lalabo abafileyo, nalawo angaphansi kwamanzi, kanye nabo bonkhe labo labahlala khona, bayakhathaza.
Itfu livulekile phambi kwaNkulunkulu, nendzawo yekufa ayifuni kuvalwa.
Ufaka izulu laseNtshonalanga emhlabatsini, wamisa umhlaba kutsi ungabi nanto.
Ubeka amanzi emahlathini akhe, lamalahle angeke ahlukaniswe ngaphansi kwesisindo sawo.
Ufaka buso benyanga legcwele ngekubambisana kwemanti akhe kuyo.
Ubopha umgwaqo emhlabatsini lwamanzi, umkhawulo phakathi kwekukhanya nebumnyama.
Tikhonto tezulu tikhatsazeka, netinhlanga tatsi lilanga letfu, lapho akhuluma khona ngemandla akhe.
Ngemandla akhe wamisa lwandle, Ngendlela yakhe yabulala iRahabhi, itfu lelikhulu.
Ngemoya wakhe, izulu laliba mhlophe. Isandla sakhe satfusa lenyosi lehamba ngetinyawo.
Naleto yinye yezinto letincane kakhulu azenzayo. Sikhuluma naye nje ngetinhlamvu letincane. Uphi lowo longeke aqonde umsindo wemandla akhe?"
UJobu wakhuluma watsi:
Ngabe Nkulunkulu uphila, lowo longeke avumele kutsi ngibuyele esivumelwaneni, kanye noNkulunkulu Omkhulu, lowo longeke avumele kuphila kwami kubuhlungu,
kuze kufike kutfutfuko lwami, nemoya waNkulunkulu emphinjeni yami;
Lamehlo ami angeke akhulume lokubi, nelimlomo lami angeke akhulume lokubi.
Ngingeke ngikutshele kutsi ulungile, kuze kufike kumnyaka wami wokufa, ngeke ngiphele ngekusho kutsi ngiyaphila.
Ngitahlala ngiyigcina inhlonipho yami, ngingayeki ukuyishiya; inhliziyo yami ayizange imcamele kuze kube sengiphila.
Umfowabo wami abe ngumuntfu lobi; lowo umhlaselayo abe ngumuntfu lomfishane.
Lini themba lababi, lapho Nkulunkulu etawubasusa khona, bese ukhipha litfu labo?
Ingabe uNkulunkulu uyakulalela umsindo wabo, lapho kuyawufika khona buhlungu?
Ingabe bayakujabulela kuNkulunkulu Omkhulu? Ingabe bakhuluma kuThixo nsuku zonke?
Ngitakusifundisa ngemandla kaNkulunkulu, ngingakufihlanga umsebenzi Lomkhululi.
Niyawubona; yini-ke kutsi nikhuluma lutho lolungaba khona?
Lokho kungenxa yendlela Nkulunkulu abeyihlela ngayo kubo bonkhe bantfu lababi, kanye nento leyawutfunywa nguSimakadze, lowo Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli.
Batawuba nemadvodzana amakhulu, kepha isandla siyawubabulala; bantfwana babo bangadla kutsi bakhululeke.
Labo labahlala khona, ligciwane litawubabulala; nalabo labahlala nabo, bangabi nekuthula.
Baphindze bakhiphe igolide njengenhlabathi, netibondza njengemihlaba yemhlabatsi.
Kuze kube abantu labalungile bagqoka lemihlobiso, kanye nebantfu labangenacala bahlukanise isiliva.
Tindlu tabo tifana nebucwebe bekati, njengetindlu letibekwe ngumuntfu emhlabatsini.
Baphuma bafile, kepha kungeke kube lilanga lekucala; bese bevula imehlo abo, yonke into iphela.
Kutsi lilanga letfu lifike, lilanga letfu lifike, lilanga letfu lifika.
Umoya wasenyakatho utawuwasusa, bayawuphela; utawubasusa emhlabatsini lwabo.
Itfusa kubo ngaphandle kwemphiko njengoba befuna ukuphuma emandla ayo.
Itsatsa isandla sayo kubo kanye nekushayela kubo njengoba beshiya indawo yabo."
Kunemigodi lapho isiliva litholakala khona, kanye nezindawo lapho golide lihlanjululwa khona.
Lensimbi iphuma emhlabatsini, kanye nesiliva negolide iphuma ematsheni.
Ema-miners abeka kukhanya ekujuleni. Bafuna emadolobheni lasentshonalanga kutsi bathole titshe letifihlakele emjulweni.
Bafaka tigodzi emaphandleni lapho abantu bahlala khona, emadolobhaneni lapho angeke kubekho muntu lohamba khona.Babopha emaphandleni lapho abantu bahlala khona, bese behamba ngetintambo.
Ukudla lukhula kusuka ebusweni bemhlaba, kepha ngaphansi kwalo kushintshwa njengemlilo.
Ema-sapphires atholakala emahlathini ayo, negolide likhona emhlabathini wayo.
Akukho mhlambi wetingulube lowazi lendlela efihlakeleyo. Akukho mehlo e-falcon alibona.
Akukho silwane lesingenamsindvo lesemagremu lasengahamba ngaso, futsi angeke kube khona linyoni elalidlula ngalo.
Ema-miners ahlasele tihlathi letinzima kakhulu bese esuka emajikijolo emadolobheni.
Bavula imijovo ematsheni, bese mehlo abo abona yonke imfuyo yalo.
Bavala imifula, bese bakhipha izinto letifihlakeleko ekukhanyani.
Kutsi khona-ke, inhlonipho ingafunwa phi? Ingahlalaphi ingqondo?
Akukho muntfu lowaziyo, futsi angeke ifunwe emhlabani welabo baphilayo.
Lomhlabatsi utsi, Ayikho ngaphakathi kwami; lwandle lutsi, Alikho nami.
Angeke ithengiswe ngegolide lelihle, nentengo yayo angeke ikhokhwe ngesiliva.
Angeke ithengiswe ngegolide leOfiri, noma ngegolide lelihle, noma ngesiliva.
Igolide kanye nekristalu angeke ilinganiswe nayo. Angeke ithengiswe ngemihlobiso yegolide
I-coral kanye ne-jasper akufanele zicatshangelwe, kepha inzuzo yebuhlakani iphakeme kunegolide.
I-topaz yase-Ethiopia ayifana nayo, negolide lelihle angeke lithengiswe ngalo.
Kusuka kuphi khona ubuhlakani, nalapho kuhlala khona ukuqonda?
Ifihlakele emehloni laso sonke lesiphilako, kanye netingulube temhlaba.
Kubi nekufa kutsi: "Asikuva lutho ngaphandle kwezindaba letine."
UNkulunkulu kuphela lowazi indlela yayo, yena kuphela lowazi lapho ihlala khona.
Ubona kuze kube kufike ekugcineni kwemhlaba, kanye nezinto zonke ngaphansi kwesibhakabhaka.
Wabeka umoya ngemandla akhe, wamisa amanzi ngesimo sawo.
lapho abeka khona mthetho wemvula, nendlela yetfufu lelikhulu,
watsi: "UNkulunkulu ubona itfu, wakhuluma ngayo; wamisa, wayihlola.
Watsi kubo: "Bonani, ukukholwa kuNkulunkulu kuyindlela yebuhlakani, kanye nokungabi nebubi kuyingqondo."
UJobu wakhuluma watsi:
Ngubani nalowo muntfu longeke afune kubuyela emaviki ladlule, etikhatsini lapho Simakadze abengilalela khona?
lapho lilanga lakhe likhanyako phezu kwenhlavu yami, nangekukhanya kwayo ngihamba ngetinhlayiya!
Kube lilanga lelihle kakhulu lokuphila kwami, lapho ukuthula kweNkulunkulu kubhekelela khona indlu yami,
lapho lowo Mtfubi ehlala khona nami, nebantfu bami behamba ngami;
lapho indlela yami beyigcwele creme, netintaba taphuma ngazo emajikijolo e-olive.
Ngiye ngefika emnyango wedolobha, ngahlala esiteji lesivulekile,
Labesifazane labancane, lapho bakubona ngami, babuyela emuva, lamadoda amakhulu ahlala phansi.
Labaholi baphuma bekhuluma, babeka tindlebe tabo ngesandla sabo.
Lamazwi lalabo bantu abakhulu akazange akhululeke, ulwimi lwawo lufike kulomlomo wabo.
Wonke lowo umlalelayo ukhuluma ngemi, nalowo lowo umbonayo ungibonga;
ngobe ngiyawuvikela umtfubi lapho ekhala khona, nalowo mkhuluwa lapho angeke abe nemkhonto.
Bami, labafileyo, bangisibhalisela; nalabo abafayo, ngiyawubambisana nabo;
Ngibe nekuhle njengetigqoko tami, nekuthula kube ngumanti ami naletibhaka-bhaka tami.
Ngibe mehlo lalabo abamnyama, nemilenze yalabo labakhubazekile.
Ngibe ngubaba lomtfubi, ngakhipha icala lalabo bangaphandle ebantwini.
Ngincophelela tingulube tebantfu lababi, ngakhipha emphinjeni yabo lokudla kwabo.
Ngitsi: 'Ngizofa ekhaya lami, ngemuva kwekuphila iminyaka leminingi njengemifino yemanti.'
Inhloko yami iyawufika emanzini, bese lilanga lemvula lihlala emajikijolo ami.
Ngiyawujenzeliswe kahle, mandla ami angeke aphelelwe, njengentaka lengeke ikhululeke.'
Abantu balalela ngami, bahlala befuna impendulo yami.
Nalapho ngikhuluma khona, bangazange bakhulume lutho; Fedor limi lemazwi ami lafika emandlebeni abo.
Bamikele kimi, ngobe bamikele lilanga; baphuza amazwi ami njengemvula yebusika.
Nalapho bengenakukhululeka khona, ngabacosha, nemehlo ami ajabulile, ngabakhulisa.
Ngiye wakhetha indlela yabo, ngahlala nguNkulunkulu wabo; ngahlala njengenkhosi phakathi kwebantfu bakhe, njengalowo lowutfumisa lowo ufile.
Bami, namuhla bangisidlalela, labancane kunami, labebaba babo sengingeke ngibabeke kanye nebantfu bemihlambi.
Ingabe mandla abo angenza yini kuwe? Amandla awo ayephumile.
Bebafile ngendlala nenkinga, behamba ngebusuku emhlabatsini, emadolobheni angeke abe khona lutho.
Baphindze bakhipha titshalo letimhlophe kusuka emajikijolo bese bedla imvubelo yetimbali te-broom.

LoNkulunkulu ukhulu kakhulu, angeke siwuqonde; inombolo yeminyaka yakhe akukho longayibala.
Ufaka emacwecwe lamanzi aphuma emlilweni, wabeka emacwecwe lamanzi emvula.
Lemimoya ikhipha umhlwa, bese ugwaca kubo bonkhe bantfu ngemvula.
Nguwuphi lowo longeke aqonde kutsi ukhipha kanjani umfudlana, noma yini lephuma emgwaqeni wakhe?
Bona, uphindze uvule lilanga lakhe, lifike liwucwebezele mhlabatsi welwandle.
Ngako-ke ulawula ema-Israyeli, wabanikela ngekudla lokuningi.
Ugcwalisa isandla sakhe ngemandla emlilo bese ukhipha umyalo wakhe kutsi ahlasele intfo yakhe.
Umsindo wakhe ukhuluma ngekufika kwakhe; kanye nenyama ibona kutsi kuyawufika mlilo.
Ngeleso simo, imtfubi yami iphuma emphinjeni yayo.
Lingisani, lingisani umsindo welizwi lakhe, inkulumo lephuma emlonyeni wakhe.
Ukhipha umlilo wakhe emhlabatsini lonke, kuze kufike emaphesenti emhlaba.
Ngasemuva kwemlilo, kuvela umsindo; utfusa ngelizwi lakhe lelihle; angeke agweme umlilo lapho luphuma khona ijwi lakhe.
Umsindo waNkulunkulu uphuma ngendlela leyijabulile, wenza izinto ezinkulu letingeke tiqondwe.
Utsi ngekhephu, Wuka phansi emhlabeni; utsi ngemvula, Yidle, sithi nemvula, Yidle, sithi.
Uletsa wonke umuntu ekusebenzeni kwakhe, kutsi bonke labo abebambisene naye babone amandla akhe.
Tilwane tiphuma emahhashini lato bese tihlala emafuleni abo.
Imvula iphuma egumbini layo, nemlilo uvela kumoya wentshonalanga.
Umphefumulo waNkulunkulu ukhipha umkhentsi, bese lilanga letfu lelikhulu lihlabela.
Ubeka amanzi emahlathini aqinile, bese ukhipha umfucuza wakhe kuwo.
Bahamba khona lapho akusho khona kubo, bakwenza noma yini abekhuluma ngayo phezu kwemhlaba wonke.
Uthumela imifudlana kutsi agweme abantu, noma kutsi afafaze umhlaba wakhe, noma kutsi abonakalise inhlonipho yakhe.
Lingisa lokhu, Jobhi; hlala ucabange ngezinto letijabulile taNkulunkulu.
Ubona kanjani kutsi Allah ulawula imifudlana, bese ekhipha umfula?
Uyazijenyela yini emazulu, kanye netintfo letijabulisekayo talowo owaziyo zonke izinto?
Uphuma umfucuko emilenzeni yakho lapho lemhlaba ukhululeka ngaphansi kwemoya wempumalanga.
Ingabe ungamsiza ekuvuleni izulu, leliyiqinile njenge Mirror eyenziwe ngegolide?
Sitshele kutsi sitawukhuluma yini kuye, ngobe asikwazi ukukhuluma, ngobe sesingasemnyama.
Ingabe kutawutsi kutsi Prahlada ufuna kutsi ngikhulume? Ngabe kukhona lofuna kutsi atfolwe?
Akukho mntu longeke abheke kulilanga lapho likhanya kahle emhlabatsini ngemuva kwekuti umoya ususe timvula.
Ukukhanya kwegolide kusuka enyakatho, Nkulunkulu ufika ngemandla lamakhulu.
Singeke sifike kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, ngobe umkhulu ngemandla akhe. Ulungile, ulungile kakhulu, akabi nebubi.
Ngako-ke abantu bayawuhlonipha, ngobe angeke abe nenkinga nalabo labacabanga kutsi banekhono.
Simakadze watsi ku-Jobu kusuka emlilo, watsi:
Nguwuphi lowo, lobeka mnyama imicabango yami ngemazwi angeke abe nelwazi?
Lapha, lungiselela kutsi ube ngumuntfu; ngitakubuza, wena utawuphendula.
Ube khona phi lapho ngibeka khona isisekelo semhlaba? Sitshele, uma ucabanga.
Utsi: "Ngubani lowo lomemetele kutsi likhulu kangakanani? Nguwuphi lowo wamisa intambo yokulilinganisela?
Nguwuphi sisekelo sayo? Nguwuphi umkhonto wayo, nalapho kubekwe khona inhloko yayo,
lapho tinkanyezi takusihlwa tikhuluma ngalelinye, nalapho bonkhe bantfu labangcwele besaba khona?
Lowuvule lwandle ngeminyango, lapho luphuma khona emlonyeni wakhe,
lapho ngiyawubeka khona emafu njengetigqoko tayo, ngayifihla ngetintaba letimnyama,
lapho ngitawumisa khona imikhawulo yayo, nekubeka khona tintambo tayo kanye nemasango ayo,
watsi: Uyawufika lapha, kepha ungeke ufike ngaphezu kwalo; lapha kumele kube khona umfudlana wakho lomkhulu.
Ukhe wabeka kuphi emshadweni wakho umyalelo emini, noma wakhombisa ubusuku indawo yalo,
kutsi ifike ibe nemandla ekupheleni kwemhlaba, iphule kubo lababi kuwo?
Lemhlaba ubonakala njengetinhlayiya temhlabatsi, kanye nemehlo alo abonakala njengamaphiko emanti.
Ukukhanya kwabo lokubi kususwa kubo, nesandla sabo lesiphakamisayo kutsi bahlasele sibuswe.
Ufike kuphi emafuleni lasentshonalanga yelwandle, noma uhambe kuphi emhlabatsini lwesihlabathi?
Ingabe umngcele wekufa ukutsiwe kuwe? Ingabe wabona umngcele wemhlaba lomnyama kakhulu?
Ukholwa yini kutsi lemhlaba ubanzi? Nceda sithi, uma unelwazi ngalolu daba lonke.
Iyini indlela yendlu lekhanyayo, nalapho limnyama lihlala khona?
Ingaba utawubafaka lapho bahlala khona? Ingabe uyazi imizila yetindlu tabo?
Uyazi kahle, ngobe wazalwa ngaleso sikhathi, uye waphila iminyaka leminingi kakhulu.
Ufike yini emahhovisi lasentwasahlobo, noma ubone emahhovisi lasengcindezi,
lengingayigcina ngelilanga lebuhlungu, nelilanga lemphiko nalelivi?
Ingabe ikhona indlela lehamba khona lapho lilanga lisakazeka khona, noma lapho umoya wasempumalanga usakazeka khona emhlabeni?
Nguwuphi lowo lokhipha umfula wemanti, noma indlela yetfufu letfu,
kutsi abe nemvula emhlabatsini lapho kungekho muntu lohlala khona, emhlabatsini lapho angeke kubekho muntu kulo;
kutsi ubisi lemhlabatsi lomnyama kanye nemhlabatsi lomile, bese ukhipha lilanga letfu?
Ingabe imvula inebaba? Nguwuphi utata wetinhlayiya tefulawa yemvula?
Nguwuphi umlomo losuka lapho imvula yemvula iphuma khona? Nguwuphi lowo wadzala umlilo wemvula yasezulu
lapho amanzi ephindze abuye abe qinile njengemlilo, kanye nemhlabatsi welwandle lolubomvu uphuma khona?
Ingabe ungeke ukhonze iqembu lelilanga lelibizwa ngePleiades, noma uvule umlenze weOrion?
Ungakwazi yini kutsi ukhiphe emaqembu e星 ngemnyaka wabo, noma ukukhombisa i-Bear nemadvodzana ayo?
Uyazi yini imithetho yezulu? Ingabe uyawuyimisa ibe yinkhosi emhlabeni?
Ingabe ungeke unqume lilanga kutsi litfuse umfula wemanti?
Ingabe utawukhipha lilanga, lifike lihambe? Ingabe liyakutshela kutsi: 'Hla-ke sikhona'?
Nguwuphi lowo wabeka umcabango enhliziyweni? Nguwuphi lowo wabeka ukuqonda emlonyeni?
Nguwuphi lowo onekhono lokulibala lizulu? Nguwuphi lowo longeke abeke phansi emabhodlela lamanzi asemhlabatsini
lapho tinhlaba temhlaba tibuselwe khona, netinhlaba temhlaba tihamba khona?
Ingabe ungadla ukudla kwelelinyoni, noma ukhululeke umkhuhlane walelinyoni lencane
lapho bahlala khona emakhazeni abo, noma behlala emahlombe?
Nguwuphi lowo lonikela ngekudla ku-elephanti, lapho injabulo yayo iphuma khona kuNkulunkulu, ihamba ngayo ngaphandle kwekudla?
Ucabangani kutsi letinye tingulube tasemahlanjeni titawuzala yini? Ucabangani kutsi tindzawo letiphakeme temhlabatsine titawudzala yini?
Ingabe ubala emaviki kuze akhule? Ingabe uyazi kutsi lapho kuyawufika khona?
Baphuma, bazala emancane abo, nebuhlungu babo bekudla buphela.
Labantwana babo bakhulela emhlabatsini, baphuma, bangabuyelanga.
Nguwuphi loyawukhulula ingulube yemhlabatsi? Nguwuphi loyawususa tintambo zayo?
Nami ngayinikela emhlabatsini kutsi ibe yindawo yayo, nemhlabatsini wegolide njengendlu yalo.
Ikhala ngebugebengu bedolobha. Ingeke ilalele umshayeli wemoto eshaya.
Ihamba ngemifula yekudla kwayo, ifuna noma yini leluhlaza lokudla.
Ingabe ingulube yemhlaba iyakusebentisa? Ingabe iyahlala embhedeni wakho wekudla ngebusuku?
Ingabe ungayibopha ngentambo, uyawuyimisa emhlabatsini lakho? Ingabe iyakuphakamisa imilenze yakho ngemuva kwakho?
Ingabe uyawuhlala kuyo, ngobe inamandla kakhulu? Ingabe uyawushiya kuyo msebenzi wakho lonzima?
Ingabe ukholwa kuye kutsi utawuwufaka ummbila wakho, uyawuwuhlanganisa esiteji sakho?
I-ostriche ifafaza imilenze yayo ngekuthula, kepha imilebe yayo ayifana naleyo ye-stork ekunakekela tinyoni zayo.
Ifaka tingulube zayo emhlabatsini bese ivumela kutsi tifudume emahlathini.
Ikhohlwa kutsi inyawo lingabacindezela, noma kutsi silwane lesiphilako singababeka phansi.
Isebentisa bantfwana bayo ngebuhlungu, njengebangeke babe bayo; ayikhathazeki kutsi umsebenzi wayo ungabi nalutho,
ngobe Nkulunkulu akazange amnike ubuhlakani, noma ingxenye yekuqonda.
Kodwa-ke, lapho ikhipha tingulube tayo kutsi ihambe, ikhala ngekujaha kanye nalowo lohamba nalo.
Ingabe wena unikela ngemandla engulube? Ingabe wena uvikela ingcindezi yayo ngemilenze?
Ingabe uyawuyisa kutsi ihambe njengenkemba? Intsandvo yayo ibuhlungu.
Ihamba ngetinyawo emhlabatsini, ikhululeka ngesimo sayo. Iphuma ifuna ukuhlangana nemikhumbi.
Ikhala ngekukhathazeka, ingeke ikhululeke kunoma yini. Ingeke ihambe isuka esibhakabhakeni.
I-quiver yemikhumbi ihamba ngesandla sayo, kanye ne-javelin ne-spear ekhanya.
Ihamba ngemandla emhlaba, ingeke ikhululeke lapho ingoma yetromba iphuma khona.
Uma kuphucuka lilanga, liphuma litsi: 'Haha!' Lifuna ukulwa kusuka kude; lilalela umsindo webantfu labakhulu, nemphiko yekulwa.
Ingabe inhlekelele yakho yenza kutsi ingulube ihambe, ibe nemilenze yayo enyakatho?
Ingabe ngemtsetfo wakho i-eagle iyahamba, ibe nendlu yayo phezulu?
Ihlala emadolobheni kanye nalapho ihlala khona ngebusuku, phezulu kwetintaba lapho iphephile.
Kusuka khona ifuna ukudla kwayo, mehlo ayo ayawukubona kuze kube kude.
Tinyoni tayo tidla gazi; lapho kunetinyama, khona kukhona i-eagle."
Simakadze watsi kuJobu:
Angeke yini lowo lokhuluma naSimakadze agweme kuye? Lowutsatsa icala kuNkulunkulu aphendule kuye.
UJobu watsi kuSimakadze, watsi:
"Ngingeke ngikuphendule yini? Ngitawubeka isandla sami emlonyeni wami, ngobe sengingeke ngikuphendule.
Ngibe ngikhuluma kanye, kepha angeke ngiphendule; ngibe ngikhuluma kabili, kodwa ngeke ngiphinde ngikhulume.
Simakadze watsi ku-Jobu kusuka emlilo, watsi:
Watsi kuye: "Thintela kutsi ube ngumuntu; ngikubuza imibuzo, wena uyawuphendula.
Ingabe ucabanga kutsi sinqumo sami asilungile? Ingabe ungisola, ukuze ubone ukuthi ulungile?
Ingabe unesandla lesinamandla njengesoNkulunkulu? Ingabe umsindo wakho ungaba ngumlilo njengawo?
Hlala ugqoke kuthula nebuhle, ulale kuthula nebukhosi.
Lalela umsindo wakho, bheka kubo bonkhe labakhohlakeleyo, wabeka ngaphansi kwabo.
Thiba kubo bonkhe lababi, ubabubeke phansi; phula labo ababi lapho behlala khona.
Babulale bonke kanye emhlabatsini, bagweme emgodini wetfu.
Lakho-ke, ngitakusho kuwe kutsi isandla sakho sokudla singakusindisa.
"Thintsi uBehemothi, lowo ngiwutfumele njengobe ngiwutfumele wena; udla tingulube njengenkomo.
Lingisa kumandla ayo emadolo, nemandla emilenze yakhe, kanye nemandla entamo yakhe.
Umlenze wayo ufana nesihlahla se-cedar, imilenze yayo yinye nenye ifakwe kahle.
Ticubu tayo tifana netinhlavu tesiliva, imilendze yayo iphindze ibe njengemikhono yensimbi.
Likhulu kakhulu kuleyo silwane loNkulunkulu ayenze, ngobe lowo layenzayo kuphela longeke afike kuyo ngesandla.
Tigodzi titawutinikela ngekudla, lapho tonkhe timbuti tetfu tidla khona.
Ihlala ngaphansi kwesihlahla se-lotus, ifihlakala phakathi kwemifula emahhashini.
Isihlahla se-lotus sitawusifihla ngetihlahla taso, kanye netingcotjo letiselwandle titawusibamba.
Nakuba umfula utfusa, angeke akhathazeke; nakuba umfula iJordani utfusa kuze kufike emlonyeni wakhe, uyahlala ekhululekeni.
Ingabe kukhona lowo loyawuwubulala lapho ebona khona, noma loyawuwubeka emgodini wakhe, nome loyawuwubeka umkhonto emilonyeni yakhe?
Ingabe ungeke utsuse iLeviathan ngentambo, noma ubandlele ulwimi lwakhe ngentambo?
Ingaba utawubeka ntambo emlonyeni wayo, noma umgodzi emphinjeni yakhe?
Ingabe iyakucela ukuthula, ingabe ikhuluma nawe ngendlela lekahle?
Ingabe iyakwenza sivumelwano nawe, kutsi ibe ngumkhonzi wakho kuze kube sekupheleni?
Ingabe ungadlalwa ngayo njengetingulube? Ingabe ungayibeka emlenzeni wemadvodzakati akho? Ingabe ungayibeka emlenzeni wamadodana akho?
Ingabe batsatsa-ke, bangabahlukanisi-ke phakathi kwabo labathengisa?
Ingabe ungayigcwalisa sikhumba sayo ngetibhamu, noma inhlavu yayo ngetibhamu temanti?
Nciphisa isandla sakho kuyo kanye, bese ukhumbula umncintiswano. Ungeke uphinde ukwenze njalo!
Nakwesiphi na sifiso sokutibulala kungakasebenzi. Kuyibona kuphela kwenza umuntu ahlaselwe ngumoya.
Angeke kube nemuntfu loyawuyivusa; ngobe yini leyawuhlala ngaphambili kwami?
Nini labeminike lutho, kutsi ngibuyele nalo? Nakho konke lokusemhlabatsini ngukwami.
Angeke ngikhululeke ngemisipha yayo, nemandla ayo amakhulu, nemphini yakhe lehle.
Ningani longeke asuse ingubo yakhe, ninjani longeke afike kumehlo akhe lavulekile?
Nguwuphi lowo lotawuvula umlomo wayo? Ticumbu taso letinye titfusa kakhulu.
Ngasemva kwayo kunemigca yetibhakabhaka, letimisiwe kahle.
Lonke likhulu kakhulu kunelinye kutsi akukho umoya longeke ufike phakathi kwabo.
Bahlanganisana, bahamba kanye bese bangahlukaniswa nhlobo.
Uma iphuma, kukhanya kwaso kukhanya; mehlo ayo afana nekukhanya kwelilanga.
Kusuka emlonyeni wayo kuphuma lilanga lemlilo, kanye nemimoya yemoto.
Umphunga uphuma emphi Pra, njengemphunga losuka emgodini wemlilo lapho kushisa khona.
Iphunga lakhe libulala lilanga, nemlilo uphuma emlonyeni wakhe.
Inhlavu yayo inamandla kakhulu. Itfutfu ihamba phambili kwayo.
Imilenze yesikhumba sayo ihlangene kahle, iqinile futhi angeke ihleleke.
Intliziyo yayo iqinile njengelitfuba, iqinile njengelitfuba lelisephansi.
Nalapho iphuma khona, labakhulu bahlupheka kakhulu, babaleka ekungeneni kwayo.
Ngekhefu lelingcolisayo, lingeke libe nenkinga; noma lilanga, noma ingalo, noma umcibisholo.
Isebentisa insimbi njengenkhuni kanye negolide njengetindzawo.
Tigodzi tingeke zisivumele kutsi sihambe; ematshe laphuma esigabeni afana namatiko.
Icabanga kutsi tibhakabhaka tifana netfufu. Ikhala ngeso sesibhakabhaka lesiphuma kuyo.
Umlomo wayo ugcwele ticubu letincane njengeticubu tekudla lokudlwengula. Ishiya umfula emhlabatsini njengesibhakabhaka.
Uyamisa amanzi emhlabatsini abe ngumlilo, uyala lwandle kube ngumlilo wegolide.
Ishiya umkhondo lokhanyayo ngemuva kwayo. Ungeke ucabange kutsi lwandle olukhulu lunemilenze lemhlophe.
Ayikho into emhlabatsini lefana nayo; yakhiwa kutsi ingabi nenkinga.
Ibheka phansi yonke into leyentile, iyinkhosi yato tonkhe tive letiyentile."
UJobu watsi kuSimakadze, watsi:
"Ngiyazi kutsi ungakwenza noma yini. Akukho msebenti wakho longeke ugwenywe.
Utsi: 'Ngubani lowo lofihla imicabango yami ngemazwi angacaci?' Ngakhuluma ngezinto engizange ngiziqonde, ngakhuluma ngezinto lezingajabulisi kakhulu kutsi ngizibone.
Wathi, Lingisa, ngitakhuluma; ngiyakubuza, wena uyawuphendula.
Ngibe sengikhuluma ngaye, kepha manje ngikubone ngemehlo ami.
Lakho ngitsi: "Ngimkhonta nguNkulunkulu, ngobe sengikhuluma; ngabuyela ebubi bam, ngihlala ngetfufu netfufu.

Kwatsi lapho uSimakadze ekhuluma ngalowo mazwi kuJobu, watsi kuElifazi waseTemani: "Indlala yami ifike kuwe kanye nabangani bakho bobabili; ngobe ningazange nikhulume ngami ngendlela efanele, njengemkhonzi wami uJobu.

Ngako-ke, nithathe timbuti letisikhombisa kanye nemfuyo yengulube leyisishiyagalombili, ningaye kumkhonzi wami uJobhi, ninikeze iminikelo yekushiswa yenu. Umkhonzi wami uJobhi uya kuthandaza kuwe; ngobe ngitawulalela umkhonzi wami uJobhi, ngatsi angeke anibeke enhliziyweni yenu lokungalungile kwenu; ngobe ningakhuluma ngami kahle, njengemkhonzi wami uJobhi.
Wahamba ke Elifazi weTemani, neBiledadi waseShuhi, neSofari waseNaamathi, wakwenza njengobe Simakadze abewaphendvula watsi: "UNkulunkulu uyawulalela kuJobu.
Simakadze watsi kuJobu, ngemuva kwekutibulala kwakhe kubahlobo bakhe, kutsi abuye abe nekuthula; ngobe Simakadze wabanika uJobu lokuphindwe kabili kunalokho abenalo.

Bafika nabo bonke labazalwane bakhe, nalabo labafowabo, nalabo labazange bakhulume naye ngaphambilini, badla nekudla naye ekhaya lakhe, bamphikisa, bakhuluma naye ngesono sakhe ngaso sonke simo esibi loNkulunkulu abewubeka phezu kwakhe; nabo bonke babemnika umnikelo wesilivere, kanye nomnikelo wegolide.
USimakadze wabambisana naJobu ekupheleni kwemihla yakhe, ngaphezu kwaleyo yangaphambili; waba nengulube lama-14, neengubo lama-6, nenkunzi yengulube ema-1, nedume lamakhulu.
Waba nemadvodza lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa namakhulu lasitfupha.
Wayibiza igama lelikhulu ngeJemima, nelinye ngeKesiyah, nelinye ngeKerene-Haphuk.
Ngaso sonke lesizwe asikube khona lomunye umfazi lobukekayo njengalezingane taJobu; ubaba wabo wabanikela ngelifa phakathi nabazalwane babo.
Aye aphila ngemuva kwaleso, iminyaka lelikhulu nemashumi lamane, wabona izingane zakhe nezingane tabantwana bakhe, kuze kube ngumnyaka wesitsatfu wemndeni wakhe.
UJobhu wafa, eneminyaka leminingi ethulile, egcwele kuphila.
Ps: Kulungile lowo muntfu longeke ahambe ngendlela yebantfu lababi, nome angeke ahlale ngendlela yalabo abafileyo, noma angeke ahlale nelabaphazamisayo.
Uyawuthanda umthetho waSimakadze, utawuwucabanga ekuseni nasebusuku.
Ungeke abe njengesihlahla esisetshenzisiwe eduze kwemifula yamanzi, lesinikela ngekudla kwayo ngesikhathi saso, nephunga layo lingakabi lihleli; konke lokuyakhe kuyaphumelela.
Akufanele kube njalo kulabo lababi, ngobe bangaba njengetikhukhula letitfunywa ngumoya.
Ngako-ke lababi bangahlalanga lilanga lesinqumo, nalababusi bangaba nendlu phakathi kwalabo abalungile.
Simakadze ulalela indlela yalabo abalungile, kepha indlela yalababi ihamba ekufeni.
Ngubani na lowo lotfumisako ema-Israyeli? Ngubani na lowo latsatsa umyalo webantfu?
Lamakhosi emhlaba alungiselela ukulwa, nabaholi bahlanganisa imibono yabo kuSimakadze, noMlawuli wakhe loMkhishwe, besithi:
"Thintsi siphule tintambo tabo, netfusa tintambo tabo."
Lohlala ebukhosini bakhe emkhathini uyala; Simakadze uyawubaphazamisa.
Akhuluma nabo ngebuhlungu bakhe, abagcizelela kubo ngesimo sakhe.
Usho kutsi: "Ngitawubeka Mholi wami eSiyoni, emfuleni wami longcwele."
"Ngitakhuluma ngemtsetfo waSimakadze, lowo watsi kuye: 'Uye unyana wami; ngiwebulale ngalolusuku.'
Nifune, ngobe ngitakulethela ema-Israyeli kutsi abe ngumhlaba wakho, naleyo ndzawo lephakeme yemhlaba ibe yitfu.
Utawubaphula ngesandla sensimbi, utawubabulala njengetinduku temhlabatsini.
Namuhla-ke, ningabi nengqondo, nimakhosi; lalelani lesi sivi, nibaholi bemhlaba.
Banikelani kuSimakadze ngenhlonipho nekuthula, nijabulise ngekucosha.
Lala, nikhonze loMntwana, kutsi angeke agweme, nikhululwe enhliziyweni yenu; ngobe ugwemo lwakhe lungaba likhulu kakhulu. Kuhle kubo bonke labahamba kuye bafuna kuphephisa.
