Kusuka emlonyeni wakhe kwaphuma umphunga, kusuka emphinjeni yakhe kwaphuma umlomo lobulalayo, ībuta emacwecwe.
Wayisusa izulu, waphuma, nemanti amnyama abengaphansi kwenyawo lakhe.
Wahamba ngekerubi, wehla, wahamba ngetinyawo temoya.
Wabeka mnyama njengendawo yakhe yekufihla, netintaba-mlilo kanye nemfudlana yezulu yabe yitenti lakhe liyawushisa.
Kusuka ekukhanyaneni kwakhe, kwafika lilanga lakhe lelikhulu, kanye netingcumbu temlilo.
USimakadze wehla emhlabatsini, wakhipha umsindo lomkhulu kunabo bonke, netinhlabamkhosi kanye nemfudlana yemlilo.
Wayisusa imicibisholo yakhe, wabaphazamisa labagxeki bakhe; wayalela umlilo omkhulu, wabaphazamisa nabo.
Lamandla elwandle abonakala, isisekelo semhlaba sabonakaliswa, lapho ukhuluma khona, Simakadze, ngemoya wemphimbo yakho.
Waba nesandla sakhe esiphakeme, wancenga, wanciphisa ngasemanti lamakhulu.
Ungithetse emgodini wami lonamandla, nalabo labangiphazamisa, ngobe babemikhulu kakhulu kunemi.
Bemihlasela ngelilanga lenkinga yami, ngobe Simakadze abengivikela.
Wayemkhipha emhlabatsini, waphuma ngami, ngobe wayenekuthula nami.
Simakadze ungikhokhelile, ngobe sengisebenzele kahle; wangisabalalisa ngesandla sami esinempilo.
Ngigcine indlela yaSimakadze, ngingazange ngibe nebubi, ngase ngiye kuNkulunkulu wami.
Lamandla akhe onke abekwe phambi kwami, Ngami ngiyawusuka emiphumeleni yakhe.
Ngabe sengilungile phambi kwakhe, ngigcinele nguNkulunkulu kutsi angabi necala.
Ngako-ke Simakadze ungikhokhele, ngobe ngibe sengisebenzele kahle; ngobe isandla sami sihle emehlo akhe.
Kulabo abakholwayo, bonisa ukuthi uthembekile; kulabo labalungile, bonisa ukuthi ulungile; kulabo labangcwele, bonisa ukuthi ungcwele.
Kulabo labacophelela, ukhombisa kutsi ucocekile; kepha kulabo labaphikisayo, ubonisa ukuthi unengqondo.
Uyawusindisa abantu labancane, utawubasusa nalabo lamehlo abo aphakeme.
UNkulunkulu, wena ugcina lilanga lami likhanya; Nkulunkulu wami ungiguqula timnyama zami zibe kukhanya.
Ngesizo sakho, ngiyawuhlasela imindeni yebantfu; ngeNkulunkulu wami, ngitawuhamba ngaphesheya kwedonga.
Indlela yaNkulunkulu ilungile, nguNkulunkulu lowo usebentisa amazwi akhe ekuhleleni; yena ngusondza kubo bonke labahamba kuye.
Nguwuphi Nkulunkulu ngaphandle kweSimakadze? Nguwuphi lomtfubi ngaphandle kwaNkulunkulu wethu?
LoNkulunkulu uyawunika mandla ami, wamisa indlela yami kahle.
Uye wamisa tinyawo tami njengetinyawo tengulube, wamisa emhlabatsini lwami.
Usebentisa isandla sami emphilweni, ngobe sandla sami singeke sibeke tigodzi tesiliva.
Umingisise nendlundza yekubuyisana kwakho, isandla sakho sokudla siyawungisekela; ukunakekelwa kwakho kungenza ngikhulu.
Ufike uvule indlela yami kutsi ngihambe ngayo, ngobe tinyawo tami tingeke zivete.
Ngiye waphula lamacala ami, ngawafika; angibuyeli kuze kube ngiwuphelile lomhlaba.
Ngitawubabulala, ngobe bangeke babuye; bayawufa ngaphansi kwenyawo lami.
Ungisinika mandla ekulwa, wabeka emadolo ami labo labaphazamisayo mina.
Uyawubeka ema-Amori enhliziyweni yami, utawubasusa; ngiyawubulala labo labameteka.
Bacela, kodvwa angeke kubekho loyawubasindisa; bathandaza kuSimakadze, kepha akaphenduli.
Lami ngibacoce njengenhlayiya letfutwa ngumoya; lami ngibacubhulela njengobe lukhuni lwetindlela.
Ungithetse kusuka kubantfu labaphikisayo, ungenza ngibe ngumholi wamasiko; abantu abengabazange ngibabone bamisebentisa.
Batsi bakhuluma ngami, balalela; nalabasemazweni angaphandle bahamba ngaphambili kwami.
Lakwamanye amazwe ashaya umphefumulo wabo, bese baphuma bahlala emaphandleni abo.
UNkulunkulu uphila, livunywe itfu lami! Livunyiwe itfu lami! Livunywe litfu lokusindisa kwami!
Nguye Nkulunkulu lonika kutsi ngibuyele kulabo baholi bami, ubeka ema-Israyeli ngaphansi kwesandla sami.
Ungikhulula ekufeni kwami, ungithetse kulabo labaphazamisayo; ungikhipha ebantwini besive lesibi.
Lakho, Simakadze, ngiyawukubonga emehlweni ebantfu, ngitawulingisa igama lakho.
Lowunika umphathi wakhe lokukhulu lokusindisa, lowenza ukuthula kumkhonzi wakhe, kuDavide kanye nemadvodzana akhe kuze kube sekupheleni.
Umbhalo we-Psalme, waDavide. Tizulu tikhuluma ngekuthula kweNkulunkulu, nemhlaba ubonisa imisebenzi yesandla sakhe.
Bakhuluma lilanga ngelilanga, nebusuku nebusuku babelana ngelwazi.
Angeke kube khona ulwimi noma lokuchazwa lapho umsindo wabo ungasetjweni.
Kuye kwaphuma kumhlaba wonke umlayezo wabo, nemazwi abo kuya emaphesenti emhlaba; Nkulunkulu wabeka itente lelilanga emowyweni.
Lilanga liphuma njengemfana lophuma embhedeni wakhe, njengemfana lohamba ngemandla, ejabulile ekuhambeni kwakhe.
Iphuma ekugcineni kwemhlaba, ihamba kuze kukuphela kwalo. Akukho lutho lokungeke lufihlakale kumlilo wayo.
Lomthetho waSimakadze uphelele, uvuselela umoya; umyalelo waSimakadze uthembekile, wenza labangacabangi babe nengqondo.
Timiso taSimakadze tilungile, tijabulisa intliziyo; imiyalo yakhe ihlanzekile, yenza umbono ukhanya.
Lokwesaba Simakadze kulungile, kuyahlala kuze kube sekupheleni; imiyalo kaSimakadze yiqiniso, nayo yonke inene.
Bahle kakhulu kunalegolide, nakuleyo golide lengcwele; bamnandi kunejusi, banconywa kakhulu kunejusi lelisandza.
Bamiletsa umkhonzi wakho, banikela ngemnikelo lomkhulu kubo lababalalelayo.
Ngubani longeke abone iphutha lakhe? Lawulahla inkinga yami, ngobe ngingayibona.
Laletsa umkhonzi wakho kutsi angabi nebubi, ngobe ngiyakukhumbula. Laletsa kutsi angabi nebubi, ngobe ngiyakukhumbula. Laletsa kutsi angabi nebubi lokukhulu.
USimakadze, lomtfubi wami, nomsindisi wami, nguNkulunkulu wakho, lamazwi amlomo wami, nemibono yentliziyo yami, ahlale ekuhleni kwakho.
USimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, utawukuphendula ekufeni kwakho; igama leNkulunkulu waYakobi liyawukusivikela kuwe. Kuye kumphathi wemiculo, psalme yaDavide.
Utawukulethela kutfunywa kusuka ethempelini lakhe, uyawukusekela kusuka eSiyoni.
Akumbule tonkhe timnikelo takho, abe nekuthula kumnikelo wakho wekushiswa. (Sela)
Utawukunikela ngaso sonke sifiso senhliziyo yakho, utawukwenza kube lulawo lwakho lonke.
Natsi-ke, uma uphuma emphilweni yakho, siyawujabula; ngegama laSimakadze Nkulunkulu wethu, sitawuphakamisa imivi yethu. Simakadze akulethele konke lokuwucelayo.a.
Namuhla ngiyazi kutsi uSimakadze unciphisa lomkhonzi wakhe, wanquma kumphendula kusuka emazulu akhe angcwele ngemandla ekubuyiselweni kwesandla sakhe sokudla.
Batsi: "Labanye bahlala emabhokisini, nabanye bahlala emabhubesi; sihlala ngegama laSimakadze Nkulunkulu wethu."
Babekwa emadolo bese bagwaca, kodvwa siyawuvuka sihlale siqinile.
Simakadze, sivikele uMbuso, usiphendule kulelo langa litsi:
UNkulunkulu, ubukhosi buhle kakhulu ngenxa yemandla akho. Likhulu kangakanani lijabuliso lakhe, ngobe utawumusindisa! UNkulunkulu, ubukhosi buhle kakhulu ngenxa yemandla akho!
Utawumnika lokufunayo umphefumulo wakhe, ungeke ugweme kutsi afune lokho akushoko. (Sela)
Ufike umhlangabeze ngetipho letikhulu, wamisa enhloko yakhe inkunzi yegolide lemhlophe.
Wakucela kuphila, uyemnika, kuphila lokude kuze kube sekupheleni, kuze kube sekupheleni.
Uye watsi: "Lamandla akhe aphakeme kakhulu, ngobe utawumuvikela; utawumnika inhlonipho nebukhosi.
Utawumnika kuthula kuze kube sekupheleni, utawumugcwalisa ngekukhululeka kwakho, utawumunikela ngenhlanhla yakho.
Ubukhosi buhlala kuSimakadze, ngenxa yekuthula kweNkulunkulu Lophakeme, akukho lokumkhathaza.
Isandla sakho sitawuwathola bonke labasolwa bakho, isandla sakho sokudla siyawuwathola labo abakukhohlisa.
Uma ubonakala, utawubatfusa njengefu lemlilo; Simakadze utawubatfusa ngemphiko yakhe, umfula utawubatfusa.
Utawucisha labantwana babo emhlabani, nemadvodzana abo phakathi kwabantfu bonke.
Bafuna kukukhazamisa, bafuna kukukhazamisa, kepha bangawuphumelelanga.
Utawubashiya bahambe, lapho ubeka khona tigodzi takho emlonyeni wabo.
UNkulunkulu, ube mkhulu ngemandla akho; siyawuvuya, sitawubonga amandla akho.
Kulo mculo, kulelo livi. Lizwi lelitsi: "Ingulube yekusasa." Ipsalme yaDavide. 17UNkulunkulu wami, Nkulunkulu wami, kungani ungisishiya sengifile? Kungani ungasekho ngami kutsi ungisindise?
LoNkulunkulu wami, ngitsi ngelilanga, kodvwa wena awuphenduli; ngitsi ngebusuku, kepha angikhululeki.
Ngako-ke wena ungcwele, uhlala ebukhosini bakho, neSirayeli ikusibonga.
Babethu batfumelela kuwe; batfumelele wena, nawe wababukhulula.
Batsi: "Kukho wena, Nkulunkulu wethu!" Bekuphoxela kuwe, batfunywa; Bekuthembela kuwe, bangabi nenkinga.
"Nami, ngobe sengumdlovukazi, ngingeke ngibe ngumuntu; abantu bangisitsa, banikele kum.
Nalowo nalowo lokubona ngami, ukhuluma lutho ngami; batsa inhloko yabo, besithi:
Utsi: "Uyakholwa kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, Simakadze utawuwukhulula; Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli utawuwusindisa, ngobe uyawuthanda kuye."
Uye waphuma ngekuthula emphilweni yamama wami, Wabambisana nawe lapho ngibe ngumntwana enhliziyweni yamama wami.
Ngakho ngikubeke embhedeni wami; Nguwe Nkulunkulu wami kusukela ngaphuma enhliziyweni yayise.
Mna-ke, ungase uhambe kude nami; ngobe buhlungu buhlebile, kodvwa akukho lowo loyawungisiza.
Tingulube letinyenti timitfwele, Tingulube teBashan timitfwele.
Bawuvula umlomo wabo ngenhla yami, njengeliona lelingcolisa lidla lomunye.
Ngena njengemanti, nenyama yami yonke ihlukaniswe; Intliziyo yami ifana nemfudlana, ifafazekile entanyeni yami.
Intfusa yami icwebile njengengilazi, ulwimi lwami luhlelekile emphinjeni yami; umile ngasemhlabatsini wekufa.
Lamadodana esilwaneni amile ngami; ibandla lalababi lifike lemi; baphuca sandla sami nenyawo lami.
Ngingeke ngibala ticubu tami tonkhe, ngobe batsi: "Kunebantfu labahamba ngami, betingcolisa."
Bahlukanise ingubo yami kubo, bahlaba umklomelo ngento lengingayigqoka.
UNkulunkulu, ungeke uhambe kude nami; wena ungumandla ami, khawulela umkhonto wami.
Lingisa lilanga lemilomo yami, ligcine imphilo yami ekahle ekuhlaseleni kwecansi.
Ungithetse emlonyeni walelishona, ungithetse emahlanjeni engulube yemhlabatsini.
Ngitakhuluma ngegama lakho kulabo bazalwane bami, Ngitakubonga emehlweni emphakathini.
Niyawubonga Simakadze, ninethemba lakhe! Niwuhloniphe yena, bonkhe bantfu bakaYakobi! Niwube nekuthula naye, bonke bantfu bakaSirayeli!
Akazange abeke phansi imehlo akhe, angeke agweme ubuhlungu belowo ohluphekayo; akazange afihla buso bakhe kuye; walalela lapho ekhala khona kuye.
Ngiyakubonga wena phakathi kwebantfu abaningi; ngitawutinikela ngetibopho tami phambi kwalabo labamhloniphayo.
Banenkinga bayawudla bese bephuza; labo labafunayo uSimakadze bazomubonga. Intliziyo yenu iphile kuze kube sekupheleni!
Lamandla laso sonke semhlaba azokhumbula, aze abuye kuSimakadze; naleyo mindeni yebantfu iyakuhlangula phambi kwakho.
Ubukhosi bukhona kuSimakadze, yena ulawula ema-Israyeli.
Bayawudla nabo bonke labakhulu emhlaba, bayawuthandaza kubo; nalowo wonke lophuma emhlabathini uyawuhamba kuye, labo abangeke babe nekuphila.
Lomnyaka lolandelayo utawumukhonza, bakhuluma ngeSimakadze kubo bonkhe bantfu.
Bayawufika bekhuluma kulabo labazange bazalwa, kutsi yena usebenza ngendlela efanele, ngobe wakwenza.
Simakadze ngumelusi wami, ngako ngingeke ngiswele lutfo.
Uyangivumela kutsi ngilale ngiphumule emadlelweni laluhlata. Ungihola eceleni kwemanti lamile, lanekuthula.
Uvuselela umphefumulo wami. Ungihola etindleleni letilungile, kute libito lakhe lihlonishwe.
Noma ngingahamba esigodzini lesimnyama njengekufa, ngingeke ngesabe lokubi, ngobe unami. Tinduku takho temelusi tiyangiduduta.
Ungilungiselela litafula titsa tami tibukile. Utsela emafutsa enhloko yami kube luphawu lwekungemukela. Inkomishi yami igcwele ize ichitseke.
Ngiyaciniseka kutsi kuhle kwakho nelutsandvo lwakho lolungaguculi kutawuba nami onkhe emalanga ekuphila kwami. Futsi ngitawuhlala endlini yaSimakadze kuze kube phakadze.
Psalmeni yaDavide. Imhlaba uyawuSimakadze, naleyo yonke into ekhona kuwo; umhlaba kanye nabo bonke labahlala kuwo.
Wayisungula elwandle, wayibeka ngemandla emikhumbini.
Nguwuphi loyawufika emfuleni waSimakadze? Nguwuphi loyawuhlala endaweni yakhe engcwele?
Labo laba ngesandla sabo bahlanzekile, kanye nenhliziyo yabo ihlanzekile, nalabo abakhoni lokubi, nalabo abaphulanga imiyalo.
Baphindze batfunywe nguSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, watsi: "UNkulunkulu utawubalungisa.
Lokho kungenxa yebantfu labafuna kuye, labafuna ubuso bakho, Nkulunkulu waYakobi. (Sela)
Nciphisani inhlavu yenu, niminyango; vulani, niminyango yakudala, kutsi afike Ubukhosi bekuthula.
Nguwuphi loMbuso wasebukhosini, uSimakadze, lowo mkhulu nenamandla, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, lowo mkhulu emphilweni.
Nciphisani inhlavu yenu, niminyango; vulani, niminyango yakudala, kutsi afike Ubukhosi bekuthula.
Nguwuphi loMkwetfweli wekuthula? UNkulunkulu wema-Armagedoni, uMkwetfweli wekuthula! (Sela.)
WaDavide: "Simakadze, wena ngiwunikela umphefumulo wami kuwe.
Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wami, wena ngikwethemba kuwe; ngeke ngihloswe, kungabi nalowo umfomi wami loyawujabula ngami.
Wonke lowo utsite wena, angeke abe nenkinga; kepha labo labaphazamisa ngaphandle kwecala, bazobe benenkinga.
UNkulunkulu, kubonisani indlela yakho; fundisani imizila yakho.
Ubambisene nami ngeqiniso lakho, ufundise kimi; ngobe wena uNkulunkulu lowusindiso sam, ngikulindelela usuku lonke.
Khumbula, Simakadze, kutfumisa kwakho kanye nekuthula kwakho, lokube sekuyiminyaka lengemuva.
Musa kukhumbula kuhlukunyezeka kwami ngemnyaka wami wesifazane, noma lokubi engikwenzayo; khumbula mina ngenxa yekuthula kwakho, ngobe wena, Simakadze, ulungile.
UNkulunkulu ulungile, usebenza ngendlela efanele; ngobe ufundisa lababi indlela yabo.
Wabafundisa indlela yakhe, wabakhombisa indlela yakhe.
Zonke izindlela taSimakadze ngukuthula neqiniso kulabo labagcina inhlanganiso yakhe namasiko akhe.
UNkulunkulu, ngenxa yegama lakho, khulula umonakalo wami, ngobe ukhulu.
Ngabe yini lebantfu labakholwa kuSimakadze? Uyawuwafundisa indlela labekufanele bayikhethe.
Bayawuhlala bephila kahle, nemadvodzana abo labatawulithola lelilizwe.
USimakadze ungumhlobo walelabo labamuhloniphayo, uyawubakhombisa umnqophiso wakhe.
Amehlo ami abheke kuSimakadze njalo-ke, ngobe yena loyawukhipha tinyawo tami emgodini.
Yiba nami, ube nami, ngobe sengifile, ngihluphekile.
Ubuhlungu benhliziyo yami bukhula kakhulu; Landza ngasetinhlelweni tami.
Thiba kutfutfuko kwami, nebuhlungu bami, bese unciphisa zonke tisono tami.
Batsi: "Bonani kutsi baningi bobubi bami, baninikele kakhulu ngami.
Hamba, ugcine impilo yami, unciphise umphefumulo wami; ngize ngikhululeke, ngobe ngifike kuwe ngekuthula.
Lamandla ami kanye nebuhlakani bamvikele, ngobe ngikulindele.
UNkulunkulu, khulula iSirayeli kusuka kuwo wonke umonakalo wabo.
WaDavide. UNkulunkulu, hlulela ngami, ngobe sengihamba ngebulungisa, ngiyethemba kuSimakadze, ngaphandle kwekuphikisa.
Lingisa, Simakadze, lihlola; Libheka intfundza yami nemilenze yami.
Itfu lakho lelihle lihlala likhona phambi kwami, ngiphila ngeqiniso lakho.
Angeke ngihlale nalabo labakhohlakele, kodvwa angeke ngidle nebantfu labaphikisayo kutsi balungile.
Ngiyawugcoba umhlangano webantfu lababi, ngobe ngingeke ngihlale nalabo ababi.
Ngiyawuhlamba isandla sami, ngihlale sengilungile; ngobe ngisahamba ngaphesheya kwealtari yakho, Simakadze,
bakhuluma ngekubonga, bekhuluma ngezinto tonkhe letijabulile letiwenzile wena.
Ngiyayithanda indlu yakho, Simakadze, indawo lapho uhlala khona, nendzawo yebukhosi bakho.
Mna-ke, ungangisusa nami nalabo lababi, ungeke ube nempilo yami nalababulalayo,
labo imilomo yabo igcwele umsebenti wekukhangisa kanye nekudla.
Lami ngiphila kuphila lokunecala, usindise nami, ube nekuthula nami.
Inyawo lami lihlala emhlabatsini, Ngemihlangano emikhulu ngiyawubonga kuSimakadze.
UNkulunkulu ngukukhanya kwami, usindiso lwami. Ngawuhloniphi yini? UNkulunkulu yindlela yami yekuphila; ngawuhlonipha yini? Ngawuhloniphise yini?
Batsi: "Kunebantfu lababi labebaphikisa ngekudla kwami, kodvwa labo baphikisayo nalabo abaphikisayo baphucuka.
Nakuba umkhosi umile ngami, intliziyo yami ayingeke ikhathazeke; nakuba kulwa liphuma limi, ngiyawuhlala nginethemba.
Ngiyacela kuSimakadze into eyodwa, nento leyo ngiyifunayo: ukuthi ngihlale endlwini yaSimakadze zonke izinsuku zekuphila kwami, ukuze ngibone ubuhle benkhosi yami, nangemfune ethempelini lakhe.
Uyawungivikela emgwaqeni wakhe lapho kuyawufika khona umonakalo, uyangifihla etentini lakhe lengcwele; uyangibeka emadolobheni.
Ngaye ngiyawuphakamisa inhloko yami ngaphesheya kwalabo abamemi bami, labangibhekene nabo; ngitawunikela ngemnikelo wesono etentini lakhe, ngekubonga; ngiyawuvuya, ngiwubulele Simakadze.
Simakadze, lalela kimi lapho ngitsi khona ngendlebe yami; ukhululeke ngami, uphendule.
Utsi: "Thiba ubuso bami!" Intliziyo yami yatsi kuwe: "Simakadze, ngiyakubona ubuso bakho."
Mngewufihla buso bakho kum, ungeke unciphise umkhonzi wakho ngebuhlungu; wena ube ngusizo lwami; ungamitsi, ungamishiyeli, Nkulunkulu wekuthula kwami.
Nakuba ubaba wami nemama yami bemishiya, Simakadze uyawungigcina.
UNkulunkulu, mfundise indlela yakho, uphindze uncede ngendlela efanele, ngenxa yalabo labemiphikisa.
Mna-ke, ungeke ungifake emandlani lalabo baholi bami; ngobe labakhohlisi bayamile ngami, bese bephuza lokubi.
Lokho ngikukholwa, kutsi ngiyawubona kulungile kwaSimakadze, kuze kube ngiphila.
Landelani kuSimakadze, nibe nemandla, nibe namandla; hlalani kuSimakadze.
UDavide. Simakadze, ngiyakucela; mlilo wami, ungeke ungiphendule; uma ukhala, ngitawuba njengelabo labakhuphuka emgodini.
Lingisa imvumi yami, lapho ngicela khona, lapho ngitsi khona kuwe, lapho ngiphakamisa khona isandla sami esingcweleni sakho.
Mnganise nalabo ababi, nalabo labasebenza kabi, labakhuluma ngekuthula nabobandlululo babo, kepha engqondweni yabo kukhona lokubi.
Babuye bakhokhelwe ngendlela yabo, ngezinto zabo ezibi. Babuyiselwe emuva indlela yesandla sabo; bayakhokhiswa njengoba bekufanele.

Kutsi kutfutfuka kwemanti endzilweni yami, njengento leyimfishane kakhulu kutsi ngiyibambe.
Ticubu tami tiphuca, tigcwele buhlungu, ngobe ngingeke ngibe nengqondo.
Nginemile, nginemile kakhulu; ngihamba ngilingisa sikhatsi lesidze.
Intamo yami isuka ngebuhlungu. Lomhlaba wonke wami ufile.
Nginebuhlungu kakhulu, ngidlwengula kakhulu; ngingabi nendlala emlonyeni wami.
UNkulunkulu, wena uwazi yonke imithandazo yami; buhlungu bami abufihlakali kuwe.
Intliziyo yami ihlupheka, intfutfuko yami iphule, namehlo ami angeke abone.
Labangani nalabo labahamba nami bahlala phandle ngenxa yesifo sami, nemndeni wami uhlala phandle.
Labafuna kumbulala bamisa timphiko kimi; labo labafuna kungenami bakhuluma kutsi bangeke banciphise, bahlela lokubi lilanga lonke.
Nami ngase ngibe sengathi ngumdlavuza longeke akhulume, kanye nemuntfu longeke avule umlomo wakhe.
Ngingumfana nalowo longeke alalele, nome longeke abe nendlela yekuphendula.
Simakadze, ngiyakuthemba; wena utawuphendula, Nkulunkulu wami, Simakadze.
Ngitsi: "Ase bajabulise ngami, bangabi nebugebengu ngami, lapho inyawo lami lishaya."
Ngitawufa, buhlungu bami buhlala nami.
Ngitsi: "Ngiyethemba lokubi kwami, nginebuhlungu ngaleso sinqumo sami esibi.
Batsi: "Labaphikisi bami bangamandla, bangamakhulu kakhulu; baningi labo labamendza ngaphandle kwecala.
Bamikela kimi lokubi ngekuhle; bamicela kutsi ngibe nekuthula, ngobe sengifuna ukwenza lokuhle.
Simakadze, ungamitsi; Nkulunkulu wami, ungeke ube kude nami.
Lalela kutsi ungisize, Nkulunkulu lomsindisi wami.

Kuye-Jeduthuni, umbhali weBhayibheli: "Ngitsi: 'Ngiyawugcoba indlela yami yekuphila, ngobe ngingeke ngiphike ngelimlomo lwami; ngingawuvala umlomo wami, njengalo msoco, lapho abantu lababi bemile ngami.'
Nami ngakhala, ngatsi: "Angeke ngikhulume lutho, noma yini lelungile; kepha umkhuhlane wami wakhula.
Intliziyo yami yatfusa ngaphakathi kwami; lapho ngicabanga ngayo, mlilo watfusa. Ngako ngatsi:
"Simakadze, khombisa kutsi yini ekupheleni kwekuphila kwami, nezinsuku letiningi letikhona; bonisa ukuthi linyenti lelilanga lami.
Uye wamisa lilanga lami njengetinyawo letincane; Live lami lonke lifana nalutho phambi kwakho; Wonke umuntu ngumoya. (Sela)
"Lomuntu ngamunye uhamba njengesithunzi, uhamba ngento lengeke ifike; bahlanganisa imali, bengazi kutsi ngubani loyawuyithola.
Ngatsi, Simakadze, yini lengingakulindelela? Kukho kutsi ngikulinde.
Labalisa ngaso sonke isono sami, Labalisa ngaso sonke isono sami; Angeke lomuntfu lomkhohlakeleyo amcete.
Ngibe sengikhululekile, ngingavuleli umlomo wami; ngobe wena uyawukwenza lokhu.
Lala kutsi ungeke unciphise, ngobe lilanga lesandla sakho limisile.
Wena, lapho ubulala khona abantu ngenxa yebubi babo, udla impahla yabo njengenkungu; wonke umuntu ngumoya. (Sela)
UNkulunkulu, lalela umthandazo wami, landzela umsindo wami, ungabi nenkinga ngemilenze yami; ngobe sengumkhwenyana kuwe, nemhlali, njengabo bonkhe bantfu bami.
Lingisa mehlo akho ngaphandle kwami kutsi ngibe nekuthula emuva lapho ngiphuma khona.
Umbhali, psalme kaDavide. Ngiyethemba kuSimakadze; wabuyela kum, walalela ingcweti yami.
Wamimisa embhedeni lobuhlungu, wamile emlonyeni wami, wamisa iminyawo yami ematsheni, wamisa tinyawo zami emhlabatsini.
Wabeka emlonyeni wami ingoma entsha, ingoma yekubonga kuNkulunkulu wethu; labaningi bayakubona, bazamazama, bakholwa kuSimakadze.
Kuhle lowo muntfu lohlala ekholwa kuSimakadze, angeke abheke kubo labaphikisayo, nalabo abahamba ngebubi.
Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wami, nguNkulunkulu wakho lowenzako izinto letijabulisekayo kakhulu, kanye nemibono yakho eminingi. Akukho mntu ufana nawe; uma ngikhuluma ngazo zonke, angeke ngikwazi kuzibala.
Umnikelo wesono kanye nesondlo awufuni, uvule indlebe yami kutsi ngikhulume; mnikelo wekushiswa kanye nesondlo sesono awuwufuna.
Nami ngatsi: "Hla-ke, ngiyafika; kulo ncwadi libhalwe ngalo kutsi ngiyawufika."
Nginekuthula, Nkulunkulu wami, ngekwenza lokuhle kuwe; Lomthetho wakho uphakathi kwenhliziyo yami.
Ngitakhuluma ngekuthula kwakho kubantfu abaningi; wena, Simakadze, uwazi kutsi angiwuvuleli umlomo wami.
Ngingeke ngiyifihla inhlonipho yakho enhliziyweni yami; ngisakhuluma ngekuthula kwakho, nangekusindisa kwakho. Ngaligcina liqiniso lakho kanye nethando lwakho kulabo abaningi.
UNkulunkulu, ungawucingisi umphefumulo wakho ngami; Uthando lwakho kanye neqiniso lakho liyawungivikela njalo.
Kunebuhlungu lokuningi lokungibhekene nalo, angeke ngibabala; livi lami limiphele kakhulu, ngalibonanga; likhulu kunatinhloko yami; lilanga lemimoya yami liphindwe.
Ngiyabonga, Simakadze, usindise; Hlala, Nkulunkulu, ungisize.
Bahloniphe, babuyele emuva bonke labafunaākāsa kuphila kwami; baphoxeke labo labafunanga kumfishane nami.
Batsi: "Haha, haha!" Labaphikisa ngekukhaza kwabo labo labakhuluma nami.
Nabo bonke labakufunayo bajabulise, babuyele kuwe; Labathandekayo bokubuyisana kwakho bangatsi njalo: "UNkulunkulu ukhulu!"
Nami sengihluphekile, nginenkinga; Simakadze uyawungingakhumbula. UNkulunkulu wami, wena ungusizo lwami kanye nendlela yami yekubuyisana, ungenambitheki.
Kuye kumcweti, psalme kaDavide. Uphile umuntu lobhekana nalabo abahluphekayo; Simakadze utawumukhulula ezikhathini tebuhlungu.
Simakadze utawumuvikela, uyawugcina ephila; uya kuba ngumnikelo wesono ezweni; Nkulunkulu angeke amnike emlonyeni walabo abamfushane.
Simakadze utawumuvikela lapho egula khona, nalapho enhliziyweni yakhe, uyawuwuphilisa.
Ngitsi: "Simakadze, khululeka kum, uphilise, ngobe sengibusise kuwe."
Labaphikisi bami bakhuluma ngami ngebubi, besithi: "Ngabe uyafa yini, nome igama lakhe liyawulishwa?"
Nasekufike kuye lomunye wabo, ukhuluma ngezinto angeke azicabangele; wabeka engqondweni yakhe izindaba letibi, waphuma wakhuluma kubo bonke.
Labo bonkhe labangisa ngami, baphikisana ngemi; Bacabanga lilanga langabi.
Batsi: "Unesifo esibi kakhulu; uhlala embhedeni, angeke aphinde akhule."
Naye lowo mkhulumi wami, lowo ngiwuthembela kuye, loyawudla inhlanzeko yami, wabuyela kum.
kodvwa wena, Simakadze, ungithande, ungisindise, ngitawubabuyisela.
Ngiyazi kutsi ungithanda, ngobe umkhonzi wami angeke anikwe amandla ngami.
Uyawubambisana nami, ngobe sengilungile; uyangigcina nawe kuze kube sekupheleni.
Lambisani Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, kuze kube sekupheleni; Ameni naAmeni.
Kuye kumphathi wengoma, ipsalme yemadvodzana aKorha. Njengalowo lofuna imifula yamanzi, njalo-ke ngikuthanda wena, Nkulunkulu!
"Nginendlala kuNkulunkulu, Nkulunkulu lophilayo; kuphi lapho ngingeke ngifike khona ngibe phambi kwe benytte lantetfu?
Lamehlo ami abe ngukudla kwami lilanga nebusuku, ngobe batsi: Kuphi Nkulunkulu wakho?
Ngazikhumbula lezi zinto, ngitsi: Ngibe sengihamba nebantfu, ngabahambisa endlwini yaNkulunkulu, ngekushaya kwenhliziyo kanye nekubonga phakathi kwabaholi bemicimbi yekudla.
Ngubani na lowubuhlungu, nguNkulunkulu wami? Ngubani na lowubuhlungu enhliziyweni yami? Lindela kuNkulunkulu; ngiyawumubonga, ngobe ukhona nami kutsi ungisindise.
"ONkulunkulu wami, nginebuhlungu emilenzeni yami; ngakho-ke ngiyakukhumbula kusuka ezweni laseJordane, kusuka emaphandleni lasentshonalanga yeNtaba iHermon, kusuka emfuleni iMizar.
Lamandla emanti atsatsa lamandla emanti ngekugwazeka kwemifula yakho; Lamandla akho onke, kanye netintaba takho, amile phezu kwam.
USimakadze uthumela lilanga lekuthula kwakhe; ngebusuku nginengoma yakhe, luthandazo lwami kuNkulunkulu lophilayo.
Ngitsi kuNkulunkulu, lomtfubi wami: "Ngubani na lofuna kutsi ungikhohlwe? Ngubani na lofuna kutsi ngihambe ngiyolile, ngobe umkhonzi wami ungitfukula?"
Bami batfutsi kimi, benব্ کدလာaqqa ngeන්ටa scriptura yami. Bangibuza ahaake: " welisephi Nkulunkulu wakho?"
Ngubani na, wena lophilayo? Ngubani na lowo uhluphekile ngaphakathi kwami? Lindela kuNkulunkulu; ngiyakubonga yena, umsindisi wami, Nkulunkulu wam.
UNkulunkulu, khombisa kutsi sengilungile; lungisa icala lami ebantwini lababi; usindise kusuka kulabo labengakholwa, kanye nebantfu lababi.
UNkulunkulu, umtfubi wami, wena uyinikele yini? Ngubani na longeke ngihambe ngilingisa, ngobe lomfowabo ungiphazamisa?
Thumela ukukhanya kwakho kanye neqiniso lakho, lifike limi; lifike limi emfuleni wakho longcwele, endlu yakho.
Ngiya ku-Altari yaNkulunkulu, ku-God, ukuthula kwami; ngiyakubonga nge-harpa, Nkulunkulu, Nkulunkulu wami.
Ngubani na lowubuhlungu, nguNkulunkulu wami? Ngubani na lowubuhlungu emilenzeni yami? Lindela kuNkulunkulu; ngiyawukubonga yena, umsindisi wami, umkhonzi wami, Nkulunkulu wam.
Kuye kumsunguli wengoma, wabana beKora. Ipsalme yekuthula; Nkulunkulu, siyibonile ngetindlebe takho. Bami batsi: Sikhuluma ngalemisebenzi yakho emihlani yabo yakudala.
Wakhipha ema-Israyeli ngesandla sakho, wabeka bantfu bethu emhlabatsini; wabulala lamadolobha, wasakaza labababuphikisi bethu.
Bekungaba ngesandla sabo, besingaba ngemandla abo, besingaba ngemandla abo; isandla sakho sokudla, nemandla akho, nekukhanya kwebuso bakho, kwakuye kubo, ngobe wabathandela.
UNkulunkulu, wena uSimakadze longuSomandla wami, khipha umyalo wekubuyisana kwemndeni waYakobi.
Ngesandla sakho sitawutsisa umholi wethu emuva; ngemandla egama lakho siyawudlidliza labo labatfumisa.
Ngingeke ngikhululeke ngetinyawo tami, isandla sami singeke sindise.
Utawusivikela ekuhlaseleni kwethu, uyawuphazamisa labo labatfusa.
Siyawubonga kuNkulunkulu nsuku zonke, sitawubonga igama lakho kuze kube sekupheleni.
Ngako-ke namuhla utsi: "Usishiye, utfusa, ungaphumanga nabo bonkhe bantfu bami.
Utfule sifuba sethu phambi kwalabo batfutsi bethu; labo labatfusa nabo basidlandza.
Utfusa kutsi sidlalwe njengetingulube, utfusa kutsi sihlukaniswe emazweni lamanye.
Wabathengisa bantfu bakho ngemali lencane kakhulu, watsi: "Angeke ngikukhokhele lutho!"
Utitfumele kutsi sihlale sesihloniphekile kulabo labasenyakatho lethu, nalabasemaphandleni lasentshonalanga.
Utawutibeka sigubhu phakathi kwebantfu; batfusa inhloko yabo ngatsi sitsi.
Ngihlala lilanga lonke ngetinhlonipho, buso bami bufihliwe ngububi.
ngobe kutfunywa kwabo labaphazamisayo, ngobe kutfunywa lomfishane lofuna ukubulala.
Lento yonke ifike kuthi, kodvwa singeke sikukhohlwe, singeke sigweme umhlangano wakho.
Intliziyo lethu ayisehle, nenyawo lethu lingeke liyeke indlela yakho.
Nasewutfusa nathi, utsi: "Siye emhlabatsini lwema-jakali," utsi: "Usifihla ngemanti amnyama."
Sibe sesivumile igama laNkulunkulu wethu, sibeke isandla sethu emkhondweni wemuntfu lomnyama,
Ngabe uNkulunkulu akazange afunde, yena lowazi tifihlakalo taso sonke sinhliziyo?
Ngako-ke, ngenxa yakho, sidla lilanga nelilanga; sabekwa njengetingulube letifanele kuhlatjwa.
Yivule, Nkulunkulu, yini uhlala uphumule? Yivule, ungatsi usisishiye singeneso sikhatsi lesidze.
Kungani ufihla ibuso bakho, ulibala buhlungu bethu, kanye nendlela lesihlanganisiwe ngayo?
Siboshwe phansi emhlabatsini, tinyatfu tatsi setingcolisa phansi.
Yisuse, utfuse, uthumele ngaphandle ngenxa yekuthula kwakho.

Kulo mculo lohamba phambili, ku-"The Lilies", ipsalme yemadvodzana aKora. Yingoma lephuma emshadweni. Intliziyo yami iyigcwele amazwi amahle lapho ngikhuluma khona umlingiswa wami kumkakhe; lilimi lami libe njengepenini lombhali ocebile.
Uye ulungile kunabanye, imilomo yakho ikhuluma ngekuthula; ngobe Nkulunkulu wakubambisana nawe kuze kube sekupheleni.
Nciphisa isandla sakho, muntfu lonamandla, ugqoke ubuhle kanye nemandla akho.
Ngemandla akho, phuma uphumelele ngenxa yeqiniso, netinhlonipho kanye netemtsetfo; isandla sakho sokudla sikwenze izinto letijabulile.
Tigodzi takho tihle kakhulu, zidlula emlonyeni wababi benkhosi; lamazwe aphelelwa ngesandla sakho.
Ubukhosi bakho, Nkulunkulu, buhlala kuze kube sekupheleni; wena ulawula ngesandla sekuthula.
Uthanda lokulungile, ukhohlisa okubi; ngakho-ke, Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, usekukhethele wena kutsi ube ngumnikelo wesono kulabo abafana nawe.
Iphunga lemirha, ne-aloe, ne-cassia, liphuma emakhazeni akho amhlophe; umculo wemibhoshongo uyawukujabulisa.
Emabhishobhi enkhosini akhona phakathi kwamadodana akho; ngesandla sakho sokudla uhlala nkosikazi, egqoke igolide leOfiri.
Lingisa, ndvodzakati yami; khumbula lokhu, ubeke engqondweni kwakho. Lahla abantu bakho nemndeni wababa bakho.
Ubukhosi buyawujabula ngebuhle bakho; umhloniphe, ngobe yena nguSimakadze wakho.
Labahlali beTyre bayawufika nabo ngemnikelo, nalabakhulu batawufuna ukuthula nawe.
Inkosikazi ihlala ekamelweni lakhe, ibukeka inhle kakhulu. Injabulo yakhe yenziwe ngegolide.
Wafike wafika ekungeneni kwenkhosi, egqoke iingubo letimhlophe, nalabo besifazane labancane, labangane bakhe, labahamba ngemuva kwakhe.
Bahamba nabo ngekuphumula nekuthula, bafika endlu yasebukhosini.
Labantwana bakho bayawuhlala endaweni yababa bakho; wena utawubabeka bahlala emhlabeni wonke.
Ngitakwenza igama lakho liphawulwe emashumini lamakhulu kanye namakhulu lamashumi lasitfupha nesihlanu; letinye tizwe titawukubonga kuze kube sekupheleni.
Kulo mqondisi wemiculo, emadvodzana aKora, ngengoma ya-Alamothi. 11Nkulunkulu ngumhlaba wethu lophephile nemandla ethu; uhlala khona ekusizeni kuleso simo senkinga.
Ngako-ke singeke sikhathazeke, nakuba umhlaba utsi utfuba, nakuba imifula igwaca emidlweni yelwandle;
Nakuba amanzi ayo egwaca, nakuba atfusa, nakuba imifula iqhutshwa ngamanzi ayo, (Sela)
Kukhona umfula, imifula yakhe ijabulisa dolobha laNkulunkulu, indawo lengcwele, indlu yalowo Lophakeme.
Nkulunkulu uphakathi kwalo mtfubi, awusayi kugwa; Simakadze utawuwusiza ngelilanga lekucala.
Lamazwe ahlaba umxhwele, imimandla iphazanyiswa; Nkulunkulu ukhipha umsindo wakhe, umhlaba uphuma.
USimakadze longuSomandla ukhona nathi, Nkulunkulu wema-Jakobho ngumhlabatsi wethu. (Sela.)
Nifike, nibone loNkulunkulu awenzayo, nezinto letibi azenzayo emhlabeni.
Uletsa imibhikisho emhlabeni wonke, ubulala imphini, ubulala nemilenze, ubulala ngemlilo emacarriage.
Usho kutsi: "Cima, niqonde ukuthi ngiNkulunkulu; ngiyawuhlonishwa phakathi kwebantfu, ngiyawuhlonishwa emhlaba."
USimakadze longuSomandla ukhona nathi, Nkulunkulu wema-Jakobho ngumhlabatsi wethu. (Sela.)
Kuye kumphathi wengoma, psalme yabana-Kora. Lidlaleni isandla sam, nibantfu bonke; lidlaleni kuNkulunkulu ngekubonga!
Simakadze, Lomkhulu kakhulu, ungeke ukhululeke; yena nguSimakadze longuSomandla, utsi:
Wabeka ema-Israyeli ngaphansi kwesandla sethu, wabeka lamakhosi ngaphansi kwenyawo lethu.
Wakhetha lemhlaba wethu kutsi siwugcine, itfu lelihle laYakobi, lowo ayawuthanda.
Nkulunkulu ufike ngekusindza, Simakadze ufike nemsindo wembulelo.
Tsebentela kuNkulunkulu! Sebentela kuNkulunkulu! Sebentela kunkhosi yethu! Sebentela kunkhosi yethu!
UNkulunkulu nguSimakadze longuSomandla, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, utsi: Yite psalme kuye.
Nkulunkulu ulawula ema-Israyeli, Simakadze uhlala ebukhosini bakhe bongcwele.
Labaholi bebantfu bahlangana naboNkulunkulu wa-Abrahama; bonke abaphathi bemhlaba bayawuNkulunkulu, ngobe ungcwele kakhulu.
Ingoma, psalme yabana-Korha.ākāsa uSimakadze, nakuboshwa kakhulu emzini waNkulunkulu wethu, emfuleni wakhe longcwele.
Umfula iSiyone, uphakeme kakhulu, ubukeka kahle kakhulu, wukuthula kwemhlaba wonke; ufana nalapho kufike khona intaba yaseNtshonalanga, umjikelo wenkhosi enkulu.
Nkulunkulu uhlala emakhazeni ayo, wabonisa kutsi yena nguwo umkhumbi wayo.
Beka, bobukhosi bahlanganisana, baphuma nabo bahlala kuyo.
Batsi bakubona, bahlaba umxhwele kakhulu, balibala, baphuma.
Bafike batfunywa khona, bahlupheka njengemuntfu lokhulelwe.
Wababulala njengetinqanawa ta-Tarshishi, letibiwe ngumoya wasenyakatho.
Lokutsi sakusilalela, sesikubone lapha enhlokodolobha yaSimakadze longuSomandla, enhlokodolobha yeNkulunkulu wethu; Nkulunkulu uyawuyigcina ihlala kuze kube sekupheleni. (Sela.)
Nkulunkulu, ethempelini lakho sikhuluma ngekuthula kwakho.
ONkulunkulu, lokubonga kwakho kufike emaphesenti emhlaba, njengegama lakho; isandla sakho sokudla sigcwele buhle.
Lithende leSiyone lijabulise, Lamadolobha eYuda akhululeke, ngenxa yemtsetfo wakho longcwele.
Hambani ngeSiyoni, hambeni ngalendlela yakhe yonke, babantiseni tindlu zalo.
Landelani kahle tindlu tayo, nihambe ngetindlu tetfu letiqinile, kutsi nikhulume ngazo kulomnyaka lolandelayo.
LoNkulunkulu nguNkulunkulu wethu kuze kube sekupheleni, naye utawuba ngumqondisi wethu kuze kube sekupheleni.
Kuye kumbhali wengoma, psalme yalabo bantfu baka-Kora. Lilalelani leli, nibantfu bonke; lilalelani, bonke labahlala emhlaba,
kanye nebantfu labajwayelekile kanye nalabo ababalulekile, labakhulu kanye nalabancane.
Umlomo wami utawukhuluma ngemandla, Intliziyo yami iyawukhuluma ngekuqonda.
Ngiya kulalela lokushiwo nguNkulunkulu, ngisachaza incazelo yami ngidlale i-harpa.
Ngabe ngingekeáh composkilose lapho ku Eccisho lifika khona, lapho baholi bami be simbi, befuna ngami kutsi ngitsime?
Bakholwa kutfutfuko lwabo, bakhuluma ngetfufuko lwabo.
Angeke kube khona muntfu lokhokhela umphefumulo wabanye, ngobe angeke kube khona muntfu lokhokhela Nkulunkulu ngemuntu.
Intengo yekugcina kuphila iphakeme kakhulu. Akukho kukhokha kungakapheli
kutsi umuntu ahlale ephila kuze kube sekupheleni, kodvwa angeke abone mlilo.
Kubonakala kulowo nalowo, kutsi labo labacobile bafa; kepha nalabo lababi nalabakhohlakeleyo bafa, bashiya impahla yabo kubobanye.
Bacabanga kutsi tindlu tabo tiyawuhlala kuze kube sekupheleni, kutsi emakhaya abo atawuhlala kuze kube sekupheleni kweminyaka; babeka emadolobheni abo lamagama abo.
Kutsi muntfu, nakuba unetimfanelo takhe tonkhe, angeke ahlale; bafana nenyama lephilayo, labafa.
Lolu hlobo luyawuba khona kubo bonkhe labakholwa kuNkulunkulu, kanye nalabo labavumelana nemazwi abo. (Sela)

Bahamba njengetingulube, bafike eGibhithe. Ukufa kuyawuba ngumfuyi wabo; emaviki lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu labangcwele bazowalawula. 11Ticubu tabo titawufa emgwaqeni, kuze kube likhaya labo lelihle.
LoNkulunkulu uyawungisa ngasebukhosini bemhlaba, Uya kutsi angisithathe kuye. (Sela.)
Ungabi nenkinga, lapho umuntu ekhula emandlani, lapho imali yendlu yakhe ikhula.
Uma befa, bayawushiya nabo lutho; kanye naleyo mali yabo itawuhlala nabo.
Bebaphila, bacabanga kutsi bangcwele, bese bekubonga wena lapho ukwenza kahle kuwe.
Baye bahlangana nababa babo, laba ngaso sonke sikhatsi bangabona kukhanya.
Labantfu labanemali, kepha bangacabangi, bafana nesilwane lesifayo.
Zaburi ka-Asaphi. UNkulunkulu lowo Mkhulu, uSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakhe, ukhuluma; watsatsa umhlaba kusuka lapho lilanga liphuma khona kuya lapho lifika khona.
UNkulunkulu uphuma eSiyoni, emzini webuhle obuphelele.
Nkulunkulu wethu uyawufika, ngeke akhululeke; mlilo utawudla phambi kwakhe, nemvula enkulu itfusa ecaleni lakhe.
Ukhuluma emazulu asentshonalanga, kanye nemhlaba, kutsi abe ngummeli webantfu bakhe.
Usho kutsi: "Sihlanganiseni nami labangcwele bami, labo lababeke emthethweni wami ngemnikelo wesono.
Lizulu likhuluma ngekuthula kwakhe, ngobe uNkulunkulu nguye lowo logwema. (Sela)
Lingisa, bantu bami, ngitakhuluma; Yisrayeli, ngiyakubutsa: Ngiye Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho.
Angeke ngikugweme ngemithende yakho, neminikelo yakho yekushiswa ihlala ngaphambili kwami.
Ngingeke ngifune ingulube lesuka embhedeni wakho noma tingulube letivela emabhokisini akho.
Lawo laphilako emhlabatsini ayawungi, kanye nenyama lephilako emabhishi lamakhulu.
Ngazi zonke tingulube temhlabatsini, naletinye tintfo letiphilako temhlabatsini timi.
Nakuba nginendlala, ngingakutsi kuwe; ngobe umhlaba wonke uyawungiwo nami naleyo yonke into ekhona kuwo.
Ngidla yini inyama yetingulube, noma ngidla yini gazi lelibomvu?
Nceda utsatse kuNkulunkulu iminikelo yakho yekushiswa, ugcine imithandazo yakho kuLomkhulu.
Lalela kimi ngelilanga lenkinga yakho, ngobe ngitakukhulula, nawe utawungihlonipha.
Aye watsi kulowo lobi: Ukhuluma yini ngemtsetfo wami, ukhuluma kanjani ngenhlanganiso yami?
Lakho kutfutfuka kwami nikulibala, namazwi ami niwashiya emuva kwenu.
Uma ubona umkhwenyana, uhamba naye; uma uhlala nebantfu lababi emshadweni, uhamba nabo.
Umlomo wakho ushesha kutsi ukhulume lokubi, nelimlomo lakho likhuluma lutho.
Uhlala ukhuluma ngenkosi yakho, utsatsa umlingiswa wendodana yemama yakho.
Nawe wakwenza lezinto, kodvwa ngatsi sengikhala, ngobe ucabanga kutsi ngifana nawe; kepha manje ngingakucacisa, nami ngitakhuluma ngezinto letichazwako kuwe.
Think about this, you who forget God, or I will tear you to pieces and no one will ease you.
Wonke lowo unikela ngemnikelo wakhe wekudla, uyayihlonipha indlela yami. Nalowo lolandela indlela efanele, ngitawumukhombisa kutfunywa kwe-Allah."

UNkulunkulu, ngiyakubonga ngenhlonipho yakho; ngenxa yekhulu lakho lelimfishane lisuse imfihlakalo yami. 11Kuye kumbhali wengoma: Yipsalme yaDavide, lapho wafika khona uNathani umprofeti, ngemuva kokuba Davide ehlala neBatshebheba.
Lala yonke inkohliso yami, Lalisa lilanga lebubi bam.
ngobe ngiyazi kutsi ngiyenzile lokubi, nesono sami sikhona phambi kwami.
Ngincuphe kuwe, wena kuphela, ngakwenza lokubi emehlweni akho; ngobe ulungile lapho ukhuluma khona, ulungile lapho uhukumula khona.
Ngibe ngumbusi kusukela ngazalwa, ngibe ngumbusi kusukela emama ami amile ngemi.
Ufuna kukholwa kwami, ufundise inhlonipho kulapho kufihlakala khona inhliziyo yami.
Nciphisa ngale-isope, ngobe ngitawubi mhlophe; Nciphisa ngale-ysop, ngobe ngitawube mnyama kunasendzi.
Lalela kutsi ngivune kuthula nekuhleka, Lalela kutsi ticubu letiwetfunywe ngukho tijabulise.
Yihlise ubuso bakho ekufeni kwami, Yisuse yonke imfuyo yami.
Umphefumulo longcwele, Nkulunkulu, wakha ngaphakathi kwami; Nceda unciphise umphefumulo wakho weqiniso.
Ungeke ungisuse emehlweni akho, ungeke umtfubi wakho longcwele ungithathe.
Nceda ungisibuyele sijabuliso sekubuyisana kwakho, Nceda unciphise umphefumulo wami lophilako.
Lakho ngitawufundisa lababi indlela yakho, bese babuyela kuwe.
UNkulunkulu, nguNkulunkulu wekubuyisana kwami, ungisuse ekubeni necala lokudlwengula; khona-ke ulimi lwami luya kubonga ngemsebenti wakho lokuhle.
UNkulunkulu, vule imilomo yami, bese umlomo wami ukubonga.
Ungeke ukhululeke ngemnikelo, ngobe ngitawuwunikela; kanye neminikelo yekushiswa awufuni ukuyidla.
Lomnikelo wesono lofunako uNkulunkulu wumoya lobiwe; ngobe, Nkulunkulu, wena awuzange ubuyisele emuva umphefumulo lobiwe.
Uyawubambisana neZiyoni, utawuyilungisa; uyawukwakha imiganga yeJerusalema.
Lakho kutawukuthokozisa ngemnikelo wesono, neminikelo yekushiswa kanye nemnikelo wekushiswa; lakho kutawunikezwa ingulube emadini akho.

Umnikelo wekushiswa waDavide, lapho efika khona Doegi waseEdomu, watsi kuSawula: "Davidi ufike ekhaya la-Akhimeleki." Ngubani na wena lowo mtfubi lokhuluma ngebubi? Lothando lwaNkulunkulu luhlala usuku lonke.
Lilimi lakho lifuna ukulimala, lifana nesihlalo lesincanyana, licuca ngebubi.
Uyawuthanda lokubi kunekuhle, kanye nebugebengu kunekukhuluma iqiniso. (Sela.)
Uthanda amazwi abulalayo, wena ulimi lokukhohlisa.
Ngako-ke uNkulunkulu utawukwehla nawe kuze kube sekupheleni, utawukubamba, utakususa esitembeni sakho, utawukususa emhlabatsini lalabo baphilayo. (Sela)
Lamadoda alungile azokubona, abe nekuthula; nabo batawukucosha, batsi:
"Thintela lomuntu, lowo angeke abe nguNkulunkulu inhloko yakhe, kepha wakholwa ngemandla akhe amakhulu, waba namandla ekuphazamisekeni kwabanye."
Nami ngibe njengesihlahla sema-olive esikhulayo endlwini yaNkulunkulu; ngiyakholwa kukuthula kwakhe kuze kube sekupheleni.
Ngiyakubonga ngaso sonke isikhathi, kuze kube kungakapheli; ngitethemba igama lakho phambi kwalabangcwele bakho, ngobe lilungile.
Kulo mqondisi wemiculo, ku-Mahalathi, psalme yeDavide. Abantu labakhohlakeleyo batsi: "Akukho Nkulunkulu!" Baphambukile, bakwenza lokubi; akukho lowo lowenza lokuhle.
UNkulunkulu ubheka kusuka emazulu kuwo wonke lamadoda, kutsi abone ngabe kukhona lowaziyo, ngabe kukhona lofunayo uThixo.
Bonke babuyela emuva, bonke bahlupheka; akukho lokwenza kahle, angeke kube namunye.
Abakholwanga yini laba bantu bobubi, labadla bantfu bami njengekudla kwenyama, bengeke bafike kuNkulunkulu?
Kube khona lapho, batfunywa ngumlilo, bengeke babe nenkinga. LoNkulunkulu wasakaza ticubu talabo labaphikisayo nine; nibaphazamisa, ngobe uThixo wabakhohlisa.
Ngabe kuyawuphuma eSiyoni ukubuyisana kweSirayeli, lapho Nkulunkulu abuyelela khona lamakhosi akhe; uYakobi utawujabula, neSirayeli utawuvuya.

Kuye kumphathi wemiculo, lokudlalwa ngetintambo. Ipsalme yaDavide, lapho befika khona labaZephithi batsi kuSawula: "UDavidhi ufihlakele nathi." 11ONkulunkulu, ungisindise ngamandla egama lakho, uyengeza icala lami ngenkuthalo yakho;
UNkulunkulu, lalela umthandazo wami, Hlala kumazwi ami.
Labangaphandle baphuma bemihlasela, nalabo lababi bafuna kutsi bamisuse; ngobe bangeke bacabange ngeNkulunkulu. (Sela)
Ngako-ke, Nkulunkulu uyawungisiza; Simakadze nguwo lowo longisisa.
Labaphikisi bami babuyiselwe lokubi kwabo; Lawulahla, ngobe wena uthembekile.
Ngitakulethela mnikelo wesono, ngiyakubonga igama lakho, Simakadze, ngobe lilungile.
Ungithetse kusuka kuwo wonke umonakalo wami, ngabona kutsi labaholi bami bahlaselwa.
Kuye umqondisi wemiculo, kutsi acweliswe ngetintambo. Ipsalme yaDavide, ekhuluma ngesimo senhliziyo yakhe. 11UNkulunkulu, hlulisa umthandazo wami; ungagculisi lokushiwo ngukuthula kwami.
Lingisa ngitsi, uphendule ngami. Tinhlekelele tami tingisiza, ngobe sengigula kakhulu;
Ngabe ngitsi: 'Nginenkinga', ngenxa yesive semakhoboka ami, nangekuhlaselwa kwami ngulabo lababi; bangisingela ngebuhlungu babo, bamitfwala ngaso.
Intliziyo yami ihlupheka kakhulu, buhlungu bekufa bufike kum.
Ubuhlungu nebutfumbu bufike kimi, inselelo yami imile phezu kwami.
Ngitsi: "Ngabe sengingeke ngibe nemilenze lemifana neleyo yengulube, ngase ngihambe, ngihlale hlalakahle.
Ngingeke ngihambe kude, ngihlale emhlabatsini. (Sela)
Ngingeke ngihambe ngekushesha kutsi ngithole shelter kusuka emoya kanye nemvula.

Bahamba ekuseni nakusihlwa ngemiganga yayo; kubi nebuhlungu bukhona kulo.
Ubhubhiso lukhona ngaphakathi kwesitimela. Kuhlaselwa kanye nebugebengu akufanele kushiya imikhumbi yayo.
Kube umkhonto wangena ngami, ngingeke ngiwubeke; bese ngabe lowo longitjendza aphuma emphilweni yami, sengiyawufihla.
kepha wena, umuntu lofana nami, umshayeli wami kanye nomngane wami.
Sihlala siphila kuphila lokumnandi, sahamba kanye nebantfu endlwini yaNkulunkulu.
Mtfubi ufike emagugu ami, abuye emhlabatsini ngekuphila kwakhe; ngobe buhlungu buhlala emilonyeni yabo nemehlo abo.
Nami ngitsi kuNkulunkulu, Simakadze ungisindisa.
Ngesebusuku, nangekuhlwa, nasenhliziyweni yami ngitsi: "UNkulunkulu ukhuluma!"
Uyawumivikela emphilweni yami, ngobe nginebantfu abaningi labangihlasela.
UNkulunkulu, lowo ulawulayo kuze kube sekupheleni, uyawuva, utawubasusa. (Sela) Baye babuyela etindlela tabo, bangabi nekuthula kuSimakadze.
Umngane wami uhlasele labangani bakhe. Uphuca timali zakhe.
Amazwi akhe alula njengesibhakabhaka, kepha kulwa likhona emilenzeni yakhe; lamandla kakhulu kunamafutha, kepha afana nesibindi lesihleliwe.
Lalela kuSimakadze inkinga yakho, yena utawukuphatha; ngeke avumele labalungile baphazamise.
UNkulunkulu, wena utawubasusa lababi emgodini wokufa; lobulalayo nalowo okhohlisayo angeke abe nengxenye yeminyaka yakhe; kepha mina ngikubekela kuwe.

Kuye kumphathi wemiculo, ngengoma ye-"Silent Poe in Distant Lands." Lolu hlu lwaDavide lubhalwe lapho abaFilisti bewubulala eGathi. 11UNkulunkulu, ube nekuthula nami; ngobe abantu bafuna kutsi banciphise ngaso sonke sikhatsi.
Labaphikisi bami bafuna kutsi bangisidle lilanga lonke; Bakhulu kakhulu labo labahamba ngebugebengu labani.
Ngelilanga lengingalokoti, ngitawukuthemba wena.
Ngiyabonga kuNkulunkulu, ngobe utfumele; ngiyakholwa kuye, kodvwa ngingeke ngilobe. Kutsi yini labo bantu labancane bangenza kuwe?
Kuphela lilanga liphela babeka phansi amazwi ami, befuna kutsi bamidze.
Baphikisana, bese bafihla; Babheke lilanga lemikhumbi yami, befuna kutsi bamibulala.
Ingabe baphuma ngebubi babo? UNkulunkulu, cinisa ema-Israyeli emphilweni yakho.
Uhlala ulandzela kuhamba kwami, uphindze ubeke emacwecwe akho emlonyeni wami; awuzange uyibhale kanjani encwadini yakho?
Labaphikisayo bami bayawubuyela emuva ngelilanga lengingatsa; ngiyazi kutsi Nkulunkulu ukhona ngimi.
Ngiyabonga kuNkulunkulu, ngenxa yesive sakhe; ngiyabonga kuSimakadze, ngenxa yesive sakhe.
Nginethemba kuNkulunkulu, ngeke ngikhathazeke; yini lengeke umuntu ayinikele?
LoNkulunkulu, ngitawutigcina iminikelo yami leyimisiwe kuwe; ngiyakunikela ngenhlanhla.
Ungithetse kusuka ekufaneni, ugcine inyawo lami lingekho emthethweni, ukuze ngihambe noNkulunkulu ekukhanya kwekuphila.

Kulo mculo: "Ungeke ubhubhise." Lomuthi waDavide, lobhalwe lapho ephuma khona ku-Saule waya emfuleni. 14Laba ngukuthula nami, Nkulunkulu, laba ngukuthula nami; ngobe ngifika kuwe ngekubuyisana nawe. Ngizothola lokuphephile ngaphansi kwetinyawo zakho kuze kube ligugu lelisedlule.
Ngiye ngitsi kuNkulunkulu Lomkhulu, kuThixo lowenza yonke imicabango yakhe ngami.
: Seku, Nkulunkulu, uphindze wakhipha umtfundza wakhe kanye nenani lakhe lelikhulu, lamashumi lasitfupha namakhulu lasikhombisa.
Nami ngijijwe nguma-leons, ngahlala phakathi kwebantfu labafile ngemlilo, lamehlo abo anjengetibhakabhaka kanye nemilenze yabo, ulwimi lwabo lufana nesikhephe esicwebezelayo.
UNkulunkulu, uphakame phezu kwamehlo ezulu, Ubuhle bakho bube phezu kwemhlaba wonke.
Bamisa umgodzi kutsi babambe iminyawo yami; ngagubha ngebuhlungu. Bakha mlilo endlela yami, ngobe nabo baphuma kuyo. (Sela)
Intliziyo yami ilungile, Nkulunkulu, intliziyo yami ilungile; ngiyawuvuya, ngitawutingela.
Yivule, nhliziyo yami! Yivule, lute ne-harpa! Ngitawuyivule lilanga.
Ngiyawukubonga wena, Simakadze, phakathi kwebantfu; ngiya kukusimbisa wena phakathi kwamasiko.
Uthando lwakho lufike emazulu, neqiniso lakho lifike emhlabatsini.
UNkulunkulu, ube mkhulu kunaso sonke sihlabathi; ubuhle bakho bube ngaso sonke imhlaba.
Umculo we-"Don't Destroy", ingoma yaDavide. Nikhuluma yini lokulungile, nitsi: "Ngubani longeke agweme umsebenti wami?" Ngubani lowo longeke agweme umsebenzi wami?
Bami, nicabanga lokubi enhliziyweni yenu; imilomo yenu isakazelisa ukungcola emhlaba.
Lomuntfu lobi ukhohliwe kusukela kulelo langa lazalwa ngalo; kusuka emahlombe abo bahamba, bakhuluma lutho.
Ubuthi babo bufana nebubuthi benyoka, njengecobra leyivala imilomo yayo.
ngobe angeke alalele umculo wemuntfu lotsatsa lilanga, noma ngabe ulungile kangakanani.
UNkulunkulu, phula imilenze yabo emlonyeni wabo; uSimakadze, khipha tingulube talelo livo!
Bahambe njengemanti aphuma elwandle; lapho bekhipha khona imilenze yabo, bangabi namandla.
Babe njengetingulube letiphumako, tisuka lapho lihamba khona; njengalo mntwana lozalwa efile, angeke abone lilanga.
Kungakapheli kutsi imijovo yakho yekudla ibone umfutho wetinsika temlilo, Nkulunkulu utawuwususa, luhlaza kanye nemlilo.
Lamadoda alungile ayawuphumula, lapho ebona kutsi lomnyama uhluphekile; baya kuhlamba imilenze yabo emlonyeni wakhe.
Batsi: "Kukhona ngempela inhlawulo yalabo labalungile; kuneNkulunkulu loyawugwema umhlaba."

Umculo we-"Do Not Destroy", lobhalwe nguDavid, lapho uSaule ethumela khona abantu kutsi babheke indlu kaDavidi, ukuze a radolwe. UNkulunkulu wami, ungivikele ekuhlaseleni kwami. Ungigcine enhliziyweni yalabo labaphikisayo.
Landza ngisuka kulowo muntfu lowenza lokubi, Landza ngisuka kulabo lababulala.
Bona, bafuna kutsi banciphise kuphila kwami; labakhulu bahlangana labani, Simakadze, kepha hhayi ngenxa yesono sami, kodvwa hhayi ngenxa yesono sam.
Ngangizange ngikwenze lutho lokubi, kodvwa bafika bemihlasela. Yihla ningusizo lwami; bonani kutsi yini leyawuba khona!
USimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, uNkulunkulu waseSirayeli, phumula, ugweme tonkhe tive; ungabi nekuthula nalabo labaphazamisayo.
Babuyela ebusuku, begwaza njengetingulube, bahamba ngalenhloko yedolobha.
Batsi: "Lamazwi abo aphuma emlonyeni wabo; lamagama awo ayafana nesihlalo somlilo. Bathi, 'Ngubani loyawutilalela?'
Uye, Simakadze, uyawubakhohlisa; wena utawubaphazamisa bonke bantfu.
UNkulunkulu, wena ungumandla ami; ngiyakulalela, ngobe uSimakadze ngumhlabatsi wami.
Simakadze Nkulunkulu wami, uyawumihlangana nami ngekuthula kwakhe; Simakadze Nkulunkulu wami, ungivumela kutsi ngibone kuhlukunyezwa kwababi bami.
Musa kuwabulala, ngobe bami bangawalibala; shiya-ke ngemandla akho, utawubasusa, Simakadze, igolide lethu.
Indlebe yabo igcwele ububi, imilomo yabo ikhuluma lokubi; batfunywe ekuphambukeni kwabo, ngenxa yebugebengu kanye nebulukhuni babo.
Tsuse kubo ngemphiko yakho, Tsuse nabo kuze baphele; Nakho kuya emaphenyaneni emhlaba kumele abone kutsi uNkulunkulu ulawula kuYakobi. (Sela)
Babuye bafike ekuseni, begwaza njengetingulube, bese behamba ngalenhloko yedolobha.
Bahamba bafuna ukudla, bese begwaza lilanga lonke uma bengenakudla lokunyenti.
Nami ngitakhuluma ngemandla akho, ngasekufeni ngitakhuluma ngenhlonipho yakho. Ube ngumnyango wami lophakeme, nendawo yami yekuphumula lapho nginenkinga.
UNkulunkulu, umtfubi wami, ngiyakubonga kuwe; Nkulunkulu, inhloko yami lephakeme, uNkulunkulu, lowo mkhululisayo.

UDavide, lapho ehlasela khona iAram Naharaim, neAram Sobha; lapho abuyela khona uYowabhi, wabulala ema-Edomu lamakhulu lamabili namashumi mahlanu eGoli leNhlaba. Wena, Nkulunkulu, usasishiya, uyewuphuca umkhosi wethu; wena, lowo lokhazamisayo, usibuyisele emuva. LoNkulunkulu, usasishiya, usawuphuca umkhosi wethu; wena, lowo lokhazamisayo, usibuyisela emuva.
Uye waletsa umhlaba, uyawuwuvula; lungisa imijovo yayo, ngobe itsetseleka.
Utfumele lilanga lebuhlungu kubo bonkhe bantfu bakho; utfumele siphuzo sethu, satsi: "Sihlelekile!"
Nasekubeni wena uphakamisa inhloko yalabo labakuhloniphayo, Indzawo yekuhlangana, ngenxa yeqiniso lakho.
Sisindise ngesandla sakho sokudla, usiphendule, ukuze labathandekayo bakho baphile.
Simakadze ukhuluma kusuka ethempelini lakhe, watsi: "Ngiyakubambisa, ngiyawuhlukanisela iShekhemi, negwadi leSukoti ngiyayimisa.
Gileadi iyini yami, neManase uyini wami; Efrayimi ngusibhakabhaka sami, neYuda ngusihlalo sami.
Moabu ngumhlabatsi lwami lokuhlamba; ngitawutfusa isandla sami ku-Edomu, kutsi ibe yinye yami; ngiyawugwaza ngaseFilisti.
Niphi labo labangeke bamivumele ngifike enhlokodolobha? Niphi labo labangeke bamivumele ngifike eEdomu?
Utsi-ke, Nkulunkulu, ungenasishiya yini? Awusayiphumanga, Nkulunkulu, ngemikhosi yethu.
Sikhombise umsebenti wethu ekulwa nalowo muntfu, ngobe umkhonto wemuntu awufanele.
NgeNkulunkulu siyawuhlasela ngemandla, ngobe yena utawutsingela phansi bobubi bethu.
Kulo mqondisi wemiculo, lokudlalwa ngetintambo; nguDavide. UNkulunkulu, lalela ingcwengo yami, ulalele umthandazo wami!
Kusuka ekugcineni kwemhlaba ngita kuSimakadze, lapho intliziyo yami ihlupheka khona; hambisani nemlilo lophakeme kunemi.
Ube yindawo yami lephephile, inhloko yami eqinile ekuhlaseleni umkhonzi wami.
Ngabe ngihlala etenteni lakho kuze kube sekupheleni; Ngabe sengihlala ngaphansi kwemphimbo yakho. (Sela)
UNkulunkulu, wena uphendule imithandazo yami; wangisinika iminikelo yalabo labalibala igama lakho.
Ugcine iminyaka yenkhosi ihlale lengena, Neminyaka yakhe ihambe kuze kube kumnyaka lomusha.
Uyawuhlala ebukhosini bakhe phambi kwaNkulunkulu kuze kube sekupheleni; inhlonipho yakho neqiniso lakho litawumvikela.
Lakho ngitawukubonga igama lakho nsuku zonke, ngobe ngiyawugcina timiso tami lilanga nelilanga.
Kuye-Jeduthuni, umbhali weBhayibheli: "Nginekuthula kuNkulunkulu kuphela; Kusuka kuye kuyawufika lokusindisa kwami.
Uye kuphela lomtfubi wami, umsindisi wami; ngumhlabatsimi sam, ngobe angeke ngikhatshelwe.
Ingabe niyawuhlala kuphi kutsi nihlasele lomunye, niwubeke phansi njengedonga lelingcolisayo, noma njengesigwebo esibi?
Bafuna kutsi bagweme emandla akhe; bathanda kukhuluma lutho lokubi; ngemilomo yabo bashumayela, kepha enhliziyweni yabo balama. (Sela.)

Uyawulawula kusuka elwandle kuya elwandle, kusukela emfuleni i-Euphrates kuya emaphesenti emhlaba.
Lamakhosi esidlangalaleni ayawujikela phambi kwakhe, nalabo abawuphazamisayo bayawulibalisa umhlabathi.
Lamakhosi eTarshishi nemadolobha lasemafuleni ayawunikela kuye; lamakhosi aseShebha nalaba baseSeba bayakulethela sipho.
Bayawuwubuka kuye bantfu bonkhe, nebantfu bonke baya kulalela.
Uyawukhulula umtfubi lapho ekhala khona, nalowo mncane longeke abe nemkhonto wakhe.
Uyawuba nekuthula kulabo labafileyo, utawuvikela kuphila kwabo labahluphekile.
Utawubakhulula ekukhanyeni kanye nebugebengu, ngobe kuphila kwabo kubaluleke kuye.
Lenkhosi ihlale, ibe negolide laseShebha, ibe nguNkulunkulu wakhe, ibe ngumkhonzi wakhe, ibe ngumnikelo wakhe, ibe ngumnikelo wesono sakhe.

Kuyawuba khona umnikelo wekushiswa emhlabatsini lonke, uphindze ube mkhulu kakhulu emadolobheni aphezulu; nekudla kwalo kutawugcwala njengetihlahla ta-Lebanoni; nalabo abahlala emizini yabo bahlale behle njengamajikijolo ensimini.
Igama lakhe lihlale likhona kuze kube sekupheleni, kanye nemlando wakhe kuze kube sekupheleni kwelanga. Kuye kuboshwa ngaye tonkhe tindzawo letiphakeme, bayawutsi ungcwele.
Lambisani Simakadze Nkulunkulu wenu, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli; yena kuphela lowenza izinto ezimangalisayo.
Lambisani igama lakhe lelihle kuze kube sekupheleni; ligcwele umhlaba wonke bukhosi bakhe. Amen, amen!
Lolu lunye umnikelo wesono waDavide, umsa ka-Isaye.
Zaburi ka-Asaphi. LoNkulunkulu ulungile kuSirayeli, Kulabo labangcwele ngenhliziyo yabo.
Nami, ngase ngingcolisa tinyawo tami, ngase ngitsi ngidlwengula.
Nami ngase ngiba nenkinga nalabo labakhulu, lapho ngibona khona kutsi lababi baphila kahle.
Bangeke bahlangane lapho bafa khona. Imisipha yabo ikhululeke kakhulu nenamandla.
Bangeke bahlangane nezinkinga letikhona kubanye abantu.Bangeke bahlaselwe ngenkinga njengebantfu labanyenti.
Baphindze bagqoka inhlonipho njengobe yinye imilenze, bagqoka lokubi njengetibati.
Lamehlo abo aphuma emilenzeni yabo, nengqondo yabo igcwele intfo leyentile.
Bakhuluma ngekuphoxeka, batsatsa linye licala, bese bephazamisa abantu ngebugebengu babo.
Bakhuluma njengobe balawula izulu, ulwimi lwabo luhamba ngemhlaba wonke.
Ngako-ke abantu babuyela kubo, baphuza kunoma yini lekhuluma ngayo.
Batsi: "UNkulunkulu ungazi yini? Nguwuphi lowo Lophakeme lowazi lutho?"
Bona, lokhu kufana nalabo lababi: bahlala bekhululeka, nemali yabo ikhula njalo.
Kubonakala sengathi sengigcina intliziyo yami ihlanzekile ngaphandle kwesizathu, ngahlamba isandla sami ngitsi sengilungile ngaphandle kwesizathu.
Losuku lonke nginenkinga, lilanga ngalinye linikela ngemsebenti lomusha.
Ngibe ngitsi: 'Ngizokhuluma njalo', ngaba sengitawubulala abantwana bakho.
Ngiye ngazama kutsi ngiqonde lokhu, kepha kwakunzima kakhulu kimi.
kuze ngifike ethempelini laNkulunkulu, ngabona kutsi yini leyawuba khona kulabo lababi ekufeni kwabo.
Utawubabeka emhlabatsini lokudlidliza, utawubafaka emgodini wekufa.
Kuphi nalapho batfunywa khona, bese becutshungulwa ngemanti.
Bafana nephupho, liphuma lapho umuntu evuka khona; kodvwa wena, Nkulunkulu, uma uvuka, utawutisusa njengephupho.
Ngekube intliziyo yami ihluphekile, kanye nemcabango wami ubuhlungu,
Ngabe sengingeke ngicabange, ngabe sengingeke ngibone; ngabe sengifana nesilwane phambi kwakho.
Nami sengikhona nawe nsuku zonke; wena ungibamba ngesandla sami sekudla.
Ungeke ugcine ngihamba ngemtsetfo wakho, kodvwa emva kwalokho utawungifaka ebukhosini.
Ngine ngubani ezulu ngaphandle kwakho? Akukho lutho emhlabeni longingakufuna kakhulu kunakho.
Lenyama yami nenhliziyo yami ingeke ikhululeke, kepha uNkulunkulu ngumandla wenhliziyo yami; yena uyawuhlala nami kuze kube sekupheleni.
Bobabili labasekude nawe baphelelwe; wena uphelelwe bonke labo abakwephula mthetho wakho.
Nami, kulungile kutsi ngihlale ngisengcweleni kuNkulunkulu; ngobe sengibeke Simakadze Nkulunkulu wami njengendlu yami, ukuze ngikhulume ngawo wonke lamazwi akho.
UNkulunkulu, kungani usisishiya kuze kube sonke isikhathi? Kungani liphunga lelishwa lakho libe ngumlilo emagilebhisi emhlabatsini akho?
Khumbula abantu bakho labawuthengele ngaphambilini, nemindeni yabo labewubuyelele kuwe; khumbula intaba yaseSiyoni, lapho uhlala khona.
Hamba uhambe ngaleso sigubhu lesingaphelelanga, ubone kutfutfuka lokukhulu lokwenzelwe indawo yakho lengcwele.
Labaphikisayo bakho batfusa emhlabatsini lapho utawuhlangana khona nathi; babeka tiphakheji tabo njengemfihlakalo yekuthula.
Basebenza njengebantfu labahamba ngetintambo kutsi bagweme mhlabatsi.
Babulala yonke imihlambi yetingulube kanye nemihlambi yetingulube.
Batfusa indlu yakho lengcwele ibe yimhlaba, baphazamisa indawo lapho igama lakho lihlala khona.
Batsi: "Sitawubabulala bonke!" Bacubhulela phansi yonke indawo emhlaba, lapho kungcwele khona uNkulunkulu.
Asikho sibonakaliso setfu, asikho siprofeta setfu, natsi-ke nalowo nalowo lakhona lowazi kutsi kuze kube yini.
Ingabe kuze kube nini, Nkulunkulu, kutsi umkhonto wakho utfume kuwe? Ingabe umkhonto wakho utfume igama lakho kuze kuphele?
Ngubani na lo checa isandla sakho, isandla sakho sokudla? Tsuse icala lakho lisuka emlonyeni wakho, utawubabulala!
Kube Nkulunkulu uyawuba nguSimakadze longuSomandla, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, watsi:
Uhlukanise lwandle ngemandla akho, waphula inhloko yaleyo mihlambi lemikhulu yemanti elwandle.
Utsi: "Uye wabulala inhloko yeLevi-Athani, uyawuyinikela njengekudla kulabo labaphila emhlabatsini.
Wavula imifula nemifula, wamisa tindzawo letiphakeme letihamba njalo.
Uwo umhlwa, nawe ubusuku; wena lobeka lizulu nelilanga emakhazeni awo.
Utawubeka tonkhe timo temhlaba, uyawuhlela nebusika nalelihlwa.
Khumbula, Simakadze, kutsi umkhonto wakho utfubile wena, nebantfu lababi batfubile igama lakho.
Musa kunikela kuphila kwengulube yakho emidlalweni yenyama, ungalibali abantu bakho labahluphekayo kuze kube sekupheleni.
Khumbula inhlanganiso yakho, ngobe imihlaba lemnyama yemhlaba igcwele ukubulala.
Mna-ke, ungabi nenkinga, ngobe ngitsi kuwe: Labamnyama nalabo bahluphekayo bangakubonga igama lakho.
Thinda, Nkulunkulu, utfole icala lakho; khumbula kutsi abantu labakhohlakeleyo batfusa wena lilanga lonke.
Mna-ke, ungavumeli kutsi umsindo walabo bakhohlisi uhambe, ngobe umsindo walebo labaphikisayo uyakhula.
Kulo mculo, ku-"Do Not Destroy", ipsalme ya Asafu. Ingoma: "Sikubonga wena, Nkulunkulu! Sikubonga kuwe, ngobe ukhona; abantu bakhuluma ngezinto letimangalisako lowenzayo."
Nkulunkulu utsi: "Lesikhathi sami siyawufika, ngitawugwema lokubi.
Nakuba umhlaba nebantfu labahlala kuwo bahlaba umxhwele, ngiye lobeka tinhloko tabo. (Sela).
Ngitsi kulabo labakhulu: "Hambani nize," ngobe ngitsi kulowo lobi: "Ungagcini ngemandla akho.
Mna-ke, phakamisani tingulube zenu emazulu, mna-ke, khuluma ngalendlela lebuhlungu neyenhle.
Inhlonipho ayifikeli enyakatho noma enyakatho-ntshonalanga, noma emhlabatsini wasempumalanga.
ngobe Nkulunkulu uyawutsi, lowo lokhipha isinqumo, uyayinciphisa lesinye, uyikhuphula lesinye.
UNkulunkulu unegobolondo esandlani sakhe, ligcwele umnqumo wewayini elifihliwe ngemifino; utawulifafaza, nabo bonke lababi bemhlaba bazowudla kuze kube kuphele.
Nami ngiyawukhuluma ngaleso simo, ngisadlalela kuNkulunkulu waYakobi.
Simakadze utsi: "Ngitawuphula mandla lalabo bonke lababi, kepha mandla lalabo abalungile ayawuphakama.
Kuye kumsunguli wengoma, kutsi acweliswe ngemibhoshongo. Yipsalme yaAsaphe, livi; Nkulunkulu uvame kuphawulwa eYuda, igama lakhe likhulu eSirayeli.
Itente lakhe lihlala eSalem, nendlu yakhe ihlala eZiyone.
Akhe waphula khona imiyalelo yemlilo, nemilenze, nesibindi, nezixhobo zekulwa. (Sela)
Ukhanya ngekuthula, mkhulu kunalemifula egcwele lokudla lokubi.
Amaphoyisa lacophelela ahlaselwe. Ahlala embhedeni wekufa. Angeke kube namunye wamaphoyisa angaphakamisa isandla sakhe.
Ube ukhuluma kubo, Nkulunkulu waYakobi; lilanga letfu laliba nemilenze yaso, kanye nemiyalelo yawo.
UNkulunkulu, wena kuphela lokufanele utsalwe; ngubani longeke akhululeke ekukhanyeni kwakho lapho ungenawo umlomo?
Ufike usakhuluma emhlabatsini ngemtsetfo wakho; umhlaba utfubile, wakhululeka.
lapho ufike khona, Nkulunkulu, kutsi ugweme lokubi, ukuze usindise bonke labahluphekile emhlaba.
Nakuba buhlungu bebantfu bufike bukubonga wena, labo labaphila buhlungu bakho baphindze bagwenywe.
Uyawunikela ngetinani kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho, utawuzilungisa; tonkhe tinhlanga letingokwesobunxele tiyawunikela ngetinani kuye, lowo angeke agwenywe.
Uye ubulala inhlonipho yabaholi, namakhosi emhlaba ayawulibala kuye.
Kuye-Jeduthuni, umsunguli wengoma, psalme ya Asafu. Ngicela kuNkulunkulu, ngicela kuThixo, naye ungiphendulela.
Ngekuhlupheka kwami, ngiyethemba uSimakadze; ngaphakamisa isandla sami ngebusuku bonke, ngatsi: "Asekho lowo longeke angisikhulise."
Ngitsi: 'Nkulunkulu, ngite buhlungu; ngitsi: 'Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli!'" (Sela)
Ugcina mehlo ami angeke avuleke; nginebuhlungu kakhulu, ngobe sengingeke ngikhulume.
Ngicabanga ngelilanga lelikhulu, iminyaka eminingi yadlula.
Ngasebusuku ngisakhumbula tingoma tami, ngicabanga ngenhla, nemoya wami ubuza imibuzo:
Ingabe uSimakadze utawutishiya kuze kube sekupheleni? Ingabe angeke atithande kuze kube sekupheleni?
Ingabe inhlonipho yakhe yaphela, yini? Ingabe mtsetfo wakhe uphelile kungakapheli?
UNkulunkulu uyawulibala yini kutsi abe nekuthula? Ingabe umsindo wakhe uphindze ubeke phansi kukhulu kwakhe? (Sela)
Ngitsi: "Leli libuhlungu kakhulu, ngobe Lomkhulu angeke abe nesandla sakhe sokudla siyawusivikela."
Nami ngiyawukhumbula lokudlalwa nguSimakadze, nezinto letijabuliseko letiwenzile kusukela kuleso sikhathi.
Ngitakhuluma ngemsebenti wakho wonke, ngitawucabanga ngenhlekelele yakho.
Tindlela takho, Nkulunkulu, tingcwele; Nguwuphi Simakadze lomkhulu njengaNkulunkulu wethu?
Wena uNkulunkulu lowenza izinto letinene, ubonisa amandla akho emaNamani.
Ngesandla sakho esinamandla, wasindisa abantu bakho, indvodzakati yaYakobi naJosefa.
Lamanti akubona wena, Nkulunkulu, lamanti akubona nawe, akhatshulwa; itfu likhatshulwa.
Lemimoya yakhipha umhlwa, izulu lalimaza ngemlilo; imikhumbi yakho yaphuma ngaso sonke sikhatsi.
Inkulumo yakho yashaya ngemlilo, lilanga lakho lakhanya emhlabeni wonke; umhlaba ukhatshulwa, wajika.
Lendlela yakho yafika elwandle, nendlela yakho yafika emawotini amakhulu; kodvwa angeke kubekho lokubona inyawo lakho.
Uyawulandzela bantfu bakho njengetfu, ngesandla saMosese na-Aron.
Livi lami, livivi lebantfu bami! Livumile mtsetfo wami; Nciphisa lukhulu kumazwi ami.
Ngitakhuluma nawe ngemicabango, ngichaze tindzawo letifihlakeleko teminyaka lengemuva,
letitfunywa, netiboshwe, kanye naletitsiwe ngubaba bethu.
Singeke sizifihla ebantwini babo, sitawukhuluma kumnyaka lolandelayo ngekubonga kwaSimakadze, nemandla akhe, nezinto zakhe ezimangalisayo, azenzayo.
Wamisa umhlangano naYakobi, wabeka umthetho wakhe eSirayeli, watsi kubaba bethu kutsi bafundise izingane zabo,
kutsi lihlanga lelingemuva libe nalolwazi ngalo, nabantwana labazange bazalwa, bafike bakhuluma kubo bonkhe bantfu.
Bangeke babeke ithemba labo kuNkulunkulu, bangeke balibala lomsebenzi wakhe, bangeke bagcine imiyalo yakhe.
Bangeke babe njengebantfu babo bangaphambilini, labo baholi betfu kanye nalabo ababusi, lobuntu babo bungakabi nguNkulunkulu, nemoya yabo ingeke ibe ngumkhonto wakhe.
Amakhosi eEfremu angeke abe nekhono lokushaya ngesandla; babuyela emuva, babaleka lilanga lemphi.
Bangagcinanga sivumelwano saNkulunkulu, bangeke bahambe ngemtsetfo wakhe.
Bakhohlwa lokudla kwakhe, nemisebenzi yakhe emangalisayo, ayawukhombisa kubo.
Wakwenza imicabango emikhulu phambi kwababa babo, ezweni leMijiphu, emhlabatsini waseZoan.
Wahlukanisela lwandle, wabahambisa ngaso; wabeka amanzi ahlala njengemusango.
Wabahambisa ngemanti emvula ekuseni, nekukhanya kwemlilo busuku bonke.
Wamisa emahlathi emhlabatsini, wabanika amanzi lamakhulu kakhulu, njengawo asuka emfuleni.
Wakhipha imifula emfuleni, wabeka amanzi ephuma njengemifula.
Baye baqhubeka bewubusa kuye, bewuphula umthetho Lomkhulu emhlabatsini.
Baye batjela kutsi batfume Nkulunkulu, becela ukudla kwabo.
Bakhuluma ngeNkulunkulu, batsi: Ngabe uNkulunkulu angalungiselela yini itafula emhlabatsini?
Utsi, wabulala mlilo, waphuma amanzi, nemifula yagwadla; kodvwa utawutinikela yini ngekudla? Utawutinikela yini ngenyama kubantfu bakhe?"
USimakadze wehlule, watsi: "Kunemlilo losuka kuYakobi, nebuhlungu bakhe buphuma eSirayeli;
ngobe bangeke bakholwa kuNkulunkulu, bangeke bathembeke kuye kutsi abasindise.
Wabeka sandla sakhe emazulu asentshonalanga, wavula iminyango yemhlaba.
Wabakhipha nema-manna kutsi badle, wabanikela ngekudla lokusuka emkhathini.
Badla umnikelo wesono, wabathumela nekudla lokunyenti labangeke bafune.
Wakhipha umoya wempumalanga emhlabatsini, waphuma nemoya yasenyakatho ngemandla akhe.
Wababulala ngekudla njengetfufu, nangetingulube njengobe lilanga leliselwandle likhulu.
Wababulala emgwaqeni wabo, ngaso sonke sikhatsi etintfweni tabo.
Baye badla, batsi: "Sihle kakhulu!" Wabanikela ngekudla kwabo lokufuna.
Bafike baphuza, bengakapheki lokudla labafuna, raya emphinjeni yabo, watsi:
UNkulunkulu wehla emphilweni yabo, wabulala labakhulu babo, wababulala nalabancane ba-Israyeli.
Naphezu kwaleso simo, baqhubeka behlupheka, bengakholwa emisebenzini yakhe lemihle.
Wayisusa lilanga layo, bengenalo lokulibona, neminyaka yaso ngekukhathazaka.
Nalapho abulala khona labanye kubo, labanye bafuna kuye; babuyela emuva, bafuna Nkulunkulu ngemandla abo.
Bakhumbula kutsi uNkulunkulu ngumlilo wabo, Nkulunkulu Lophakeme uyawubakhulula.
Baye bakhuluma ngaye ngemilomo yabo, bakhuluma naye ngetindlebe tabo.
Intliziyo yabo yayingeke ihlale ilungile kuye, bangeke babe nekuthula emkhonweni wakhe.

Ngako-ke, akazange abonise buhlungu bakhe, wamisa umonakalo wabo, watsi: "Angeke ngibabhubhise." Akazange abeke phansi inhlonipho yakhe ngezikhathi eziningi, kodvwa akazange avumele itfu lakhe lihambe.
Wakhumbula kutsi bangaba bantu kuphela, iphunga lelimayelana nemoya, lidlula lisuka libuyela emuva.
Bangaphi emaphesenti labo labaye baphazamiseka naye emhlabatsini, bemkhulisa emgwaqeni!
Baye batsi: "UNkulunkulu utawutfunywa, kodvwa loMngcwele waSirayeli uyawuphucuka."
Baphindze bakhumbula sandla sakhe, kanye nelilanga labewasindisa emphinjeni wabo,
lapho abesenza khona imiqondiso yakhe eMijiphu, nezinto zakhe ezimangalisayo ezweni leSoan.
Washintsha imifula yabo ibe yigazi, bangeke baphuze emifuleni yabo.
Wathumela tingulube, zabadla nabo, netingcosana, zababulala nabo.
Wabanikela ngekudla kwabo emabhubesi, nemisebenzi yesandla sabo esigabeni setingcubu.
Wayibulala isihlahla sayo sewayini ngemlilo, nesihlahla sayo setinsika ngemvula.
Wabanikela ngenyama yabo emlilo, nemindeni yabo emlilweni wemlilo.
Wathumela kubo umsindo wakhe, nebuhlungu bakhe, nenhlonipho yakhe, nemfucuza yakhe; wakhipha ibandla labaholi lababulalayo.
Wamisa indlela yemphiko yakhe; akazange abonise kubulawa kwabo, wanikela kuphila kwabo ekufaneni.
Wabulala wonke umzali wesifazane eMijiphu, inhloko yemandla abo emgodini wa-Hami.
Wayikhipha imindeni yabo njengetingulube, wayabahamba ngemhlabatsini njengobe bundlovu.
Wabahambisa bephephile, bangeke bakhathazeke; kepha lwandle lalibalisa lababi babo.
Wababeka emgwaqeni wemhlaba wakhe longcwele, efulethini leliphakeme lesandla sakhe sokudla lalisithole.
Wakhipha ema-Israyeli ebusweni babo, wabanikela ngalelikhaya labo, wahlalalisa imindeni yaSirayeli emifuleni yabo.
Baye bacela, baba nenkinga noNkulunkulu Omkhulu, bangagcinanga mtsetfo wakhe.
Babuyela emuva, bakhohlisa njengobe babatfu babo; babuye babe njengesibhakabhaka esinconywayo.
Bemkhabelisa ngemihlobiso yabo yasemadolobheni, Bemkhabelisa ngenjabulo ngemifanekiso yabo yegolide.
ANkulunkulu wakhuluma, wagwema kakhulu, watsi: "ASimakadze uyawutsi: 'Ngaba nguNkulunkulu webantfu ba-Israyeli?'
Washiya itente lakhe eSilo, itenti lapho abehlala khona phakathi kwabanye.
Wayishiya ibhokisi lemandla akhe lithathwe, wanikela umkhonto wakhe emphinjeni.
Wabulala bantfu bakhe ngesandla sakhe, wagwema kakhulu abantu bakhe, watsi: "Lakho livi lami! Lakho livi lami!
Umlilo wabulala labangane babo, nalabo bancane babo babengenakulalela ingoma yabo.
Babengcwele babo babulawa ngesandla, nalabafayo babo bangabaphikisa.
USimakadze wehla embhedeni wakhe, njengobe umshayeli lophuma emlonyeni wakhe ngemuva kokudla uvini.
Wababulala bobubi bakhe, wabaphazamisa kuze kube sekupheleni.
Wayishiya indlu ka-Yusufu, akazange akhethe suku la-Efraim.
Wayikhetha inhlanga yaJuda, nemhlabatsi weSiyoni, lowo wayawuthanda.
Wakha indlu yakhe lengcwele njengobe lizulu liphakeme, njengemhlaba wabeka khona kuze kube sekupheleni.
Wakhetha uDavide, umkhonzi wakhe, wamkhipha emabhodleni etimbuti.
Wayemkhipha emhlambini wema-orenji, wayawuyisa kutsi abe ngumfuyi webantfu bakhe, uYakobi, nemadvodzana akhe a-Israyeliowy.
UDavide wabaphatha ngenhliziyo lelungile, wabeka sandla sakhe esihle kubo.
Psalmeni ya Asafu. ONkulunkulu, lamazwe asemhlaba afike ezweni lakho; baphazamisa indlu yakho lengcwele; babeka iJerusalema emgodini wemahhashi.
Banikela emacwecwe labangani bakho kutsi abe ngukudla kwetingulube, banikela emacwecwe labaholi bakho abangcwele emphinjeni yemhlaba.
Baphuza igazi labo njengemanti kuwo onkhe emadolobha laJerusalema, kodvwa angeke kubekho lowo loyawubafaka.
Batsi: "Labahlali bethu batfumisa, labahamba phambili batfumisa, labasenyakatho batfumisa, labasentshonalanga batfumisa.
Ingabe kuze kube nini, Simakadze, ungeke ugweme lilanga letfu? Ingabe umsindo wakho uyawushisa njengemlilo?
Lala buhlungu bakho kubo bonkhe bantfu labangeke bakubone, nalabo bukhosi labangeke bakhulume ngegama lakho.
Badla lamakhosi eJakobho, babulala mhlaba wabo.
Utsi: "Lakho, Simakadze Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, akufanele ubeke ebantwini bethu lokubi kwabobaba bami; lamandla akho azofika ngokushesha ethuneni lethu.
Sisebentisa, Nkulunkulu wekubuyisana kwethu, ngenxa yekuthula kwegama lakho; sisindise, ukhulule imibi yethu, ngenxa yekuthula kwegama lakho.
Ngubani na loyawutsi ema-Israyeli, Kuphi uNkulunkulu wabo? Sibone kutsi utawukhipha igazi labangani bakho ema-Israyeli,
Lingisa imvubelo yalabo ababoshwe; ngemandla akho amakhulu, usindise labo labatselelwe kubulawa.

KuNkulunkulu, iminyaka lelikhulu ifana nawe nelilanga ledlulele, njengemizuzu embalwa yebusuku.

Emini iphuma ikhula, kepha ngebusuku ikhulisa ibe yitfu.

Utawubeka kuhlukunyezeka kwethu phambi kwakho, nebugebengu bethu ekukhanyani kwemehlo akho.
Tisuku zethu zonke tidlula ngekukhapha kwakho, neminyaka yethu iphela ngento.

Uphi lowaziyo mandla ebuhlungu bakho? Kukhulu kutfutfuko kwakho, njengekutfutfuka kwakho.
Sifundise kutsi sibala lilanga lethu kahle, ukuze sibe nemphefumulo lohle.
Yibuyele kuthi, Simakadze, kuze kube yini? Lingisa labakhonzi bakho!
Sikhulise lilanga ngalinye ngethando lwakhe lokuthembekile, ukuze sihlale sikhuluma ngekukhululeka kanye nekuthula iminyaka leminingi.
Sijabulise nsuku letinyenti letitsiwe ngakho, kanye neminyaka lemikhulu esive siyibonile itfu.
Labakhonzi bakho babone umsebenzi wakho, nabantwana babo babone bukhosi bakho.
Ukuthula kweSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wethu, kube nathi; kwenze siphumelele umsebenzi wesandla sethu. Yebo, kwenze siphumelele umsebenzi wesandla sethu.
Lohlala ngaphansi kwendlu yeNkulunkulu Omkhulu, uyawuphumula ngaphansi kwesithunzi saSimakadze.
Ngitawuti kuSimakadze, "UNkulunkulu wami, umkhonto wami kanye nendlu yami, Nkulunkulu wami, lowo ngiwuhlala kuye."

Uyawukufihla ngemikhono yakhe, utawuhlala ngaphansi kweākāsi zakhe; inhlonipho yakhe ingeke ibe ngumkhumbi wakho noma umgodzi.
Ungeke ukhathazeke ngekukhatsazeka kwebusuku, noma ngesibhakabhaka esihamba lilanga;
noma umkhuhlane lohamba ngebusuku, noma inhlekelele lebulala emaviki lalishumi.
Lamakhulu layawufa ecaleni lakho, lamakhulu lalishumi esandla sakho sokudla, kepha wena angeke akufike.
Uyawubuka ngemehlo akho, utawubona kutsi lababi basebentiswa.
Ngako-ke, ngobe wabeka uSimakadze njengendlu yakho yekuthula, naNkulunkulu Omkhulu abe ngumhlaba wakho,
Akukho lokubi kutawufika kuwe, nakuphi nakuhlaselwa kuyawufike etiveni takho.
Utawuletsa ema-angels akhe kutsi akuvikele lapho uhamba khona.
Batawukuphakamisa ngesandla sabo, kutsi ungabi nenkinga yekutsi utfume inyawo lakho emtweni.
Utawuhamba phezu kwalelinyoni kanye nekhobra, utawudlidlisa linyoni lelikhulu kanye nenyoka.
