Ngitawutfumisa ngekuphila lokude, ngitawumukhombisa indlela lengingawusindisa ngayo."
Lipsalme, lingoma ngelilanga leSabhati. Kulungile kubonga uSimakadze, nekulalela igama lakho, Nkulunkulu lomkhuluwa,
Sikhuluma ngekuthula kwakho lilanga ngalinye, nekuthula kwakho lilanga ngalinye,
kanye nemculo we-albiro, ne-harpa, kanye nemsindo we-litara.
Uyawungijabulisa, Simakadze, ngezinto zakho; ngiyakujabulela umsebenzi wesandla sakho.
Likhulu kakhulu, Simakadze, lokudla kwakho! Kude kakhulu imicabango yakho.
Lomuntfu longeke abe nengqondo awazi lokhu, nalowo longeke aqonde loku.
Nakuba lababi bakhula njengamajikijolo, nakuba bonke lababi bekwenza kahle, bangacinywa kuze kube kuphele.
Ngako-ke wena, Simakadze, uphakeme kuze kube sekupheleni.
Labaphikisayo bakho, Simakadze, labaphikisayo bakho, baya kufa; bonke labaholi bobubi bahlukaniswa.
Ungigcinele amandla afana nengulube yemhlabatsini, Umitfwala ngemafutha lamasha.
Imehlo ami labona kutsi lababi bami bahlaselwa, nendlebe yami ikhuluma ngekufa kwalababi labaphazamisa.
Lamadoda alungile azokhula abe njengetimbali tetfu, aze akhule abe njengesedari yaseLebanoni.
Bafakwe endlwini yaSimakadze, batfunywa emafuleni aNkulunkulu wethu, bakhula bakhulu.
Nakuba bafile, baphindze babe nekudla lokunyenti. Bahlala bephilile nebumnyama,
Kuze babone kutsi Simakadze ulungile; yena ngumlilo wami, naye akukho lokubi kuye.
Simakadze ulawula, wagqokwa ngemandla; Nkulunkulu wagqokwa ngemandla. Imhlaba uqinile, awunakukhathanyiswa.
Inhloko yakho yabekwa ngaphambili, wena ukhona kusukela ngalesosikhathi.
Lilwandle, Simakadze, livuleka, lilanga lelwandle likhipha umsindo walo, lilanga lelwandle likhuphula imifula yayo.
UNkulunkulu wasephakeme unamandla kunawo wonke amanzi, mkhulu kunalawo magwaca elwandle ahlabayo.
Timiso takho tikhona; indlu yakho, Simakadze, igcwele ukuthula kuze kube sekupheleni.
UNkulunkulu, Simakadze, unguNkulunkulu lowo lobulalayo; Nkulunkulu lowo lobulalayo, khanya!
Yisuse, wena ummeli wemhlaba, ukhokhe kulabo labaphazamisayo lokubi kwabo.
UNkulunkulu, kuze kube nini lababi, kuze kube yini lababi bekhuluma?
Baphuma bekhuluma ngemandla, bonke bantfu lababi bafuna kukhunjulwa.
Babulala abantu bakho, Simakadze, babulala nabo bonkhe bantfu bakho.
Babulala emavi kanye nebantfu labaphumako, babulala nalabo labengababa.
Batsi: "Simakadze akakubonanga, Nkulunkulu wema-Yakobi akayiboni."
Nicabangeni, nibantfu lababi! Nibakhohlisi, kuphi nalapho nitawubona khona?
Lowenza indlebe, angeke akhulume yini? Lowenza limehlo, angeke abone yini?
Lowuphazamisa ema-Israyeli, angeke agweme yini? Lowufundisa abantu, uwazi zonke izinto.
Simakadze uwazi imicabango yebantfu, uyazi kutsi iphuma emphefumulweni.
Ungcwele lowo muntu lowutsatsa, Simakadze, lowufundisa ngemtsetfo wakho.
Utawumnika kuphumula ekubeni nelilanga lebuhlungu, kuze kube kufike kutfunywa kwegobho lokudlwengula lobi.
Simakadze angeke abeke phansi abantu bakhe, angeke abophe labo labahlala kuye.
Livi liyawubuyela ekuhleni, nalabo bonkhe labafaneleko emphefumulweni babo batawulilandela.
Nguwuphi lowo longeke ahlale ecaleni lami kulabo lababi? Nguwuphi lowo longeke ahambe ngesandla sami kulabo lababi?
Ngabe Simakadze angeke amkhonze, ngase ngibe sengifike enhliziyweni yebantfu.
Ngitsi: "Inyawo lami lidlale!" Lokuthula kwakho, Simakadze, kwangisekela.
Nginenkinga, kodvwa kutfumisa kwakho kwangikhulisa.
Ingabe baholi lababi bangaba bahlanganyeli bakho, labo labasebentisa umthetho kutsi baphikelele?
Bahlanganisana bahlasela abantu labalungile, bese babulala labo bangabi nacala.
Ngako-ke Simakadze uyawuba ngumnyango wami lophakeme, Nkulunkulu wami ube lisango lami lelihle.
Uyawubalalisa kubo isono sabo, utawubabulala ngenxa yebubi babo; Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wethu, uzowabulala.
Ngenani, sivulele kuSimakadze, sivulele lilanga letfu lokusindisa kwethu!
Sifike kuye ngekubonga, siwubulele ngemiculo.
Simakadze uNkulunkulu lomkhulu, umLwandle lomkhulu kunawo wonke lamakhosi.
Ngesandla sakhe sinezinto letiphakeme kakhulu emhlaba, netintaba-mlilo zinetfu lakhe.
Lilwandle liyawulo, ngobe uyawulile; isandla sakhe sakha lemhlabatsi.
Thumelani, sikhonze, siwubuke, Sibeke imilenze yethu phambi kuSimakadze lowenzalo.
UNkulunkulu wethu, kanye nebantfu bakhe, nangetingulube zakhe, natsi sinjalo. Namuhla-ke, ngabe niyawulalela lizwi lakhe!
Utsi: "Ungabi nenhliziyo lebuhlungu, njengaseMeriba, njengobe wakwenza ngalosuku lweMasa esiqhingini.
Kulapho batfu bemisebentisa khona, bemihlola, befuna kutsi ngikhululeke yini; ngobe babebona lokudla kwami.
Leminyaka lemashumi manhlanu ngibe nebuhlungu kuleso sizukulwane, ngobe ngatsi: Intliziyo yabo ihamba ngendlela ekhohlakeleyo; bangazi indlela yami.
Ngako-ke ngakhuluma ngecala lami, ngobe ngitsi: Angeke bafike ekuphileni kwami.
Hambani ngengoma entsha kuSimakadze, hambani nengoma kuSimakadze, umhlaba wonke!
Lingisani kuSimakadze, nivumile igama lakhe, nikhulume usuku ngalunye kutsi uyawusindisa.
Bakhuluma ema-Israyeli ngebukhosi bakhe, nabo bonkhe bantfu ngenhlekelele yakhe.
UNkulunkulu umkhulu, uyena ofanele kubonga kakhulu; angeke abe mkhulu kunawo wonke lamandla.
Bonke bonkulunkulu bebantfu bangama-idoli, kepha uSimakadze wakhe izulu.
Ubuhle nebunyenti bumi phezu kwakhe, umsebenti wakhe longcwele ugcwele mandla nekuhle.
Lambisani uSimakadze, mindeni yonke yebantfu; lambisani uSimakadze, ngenxa yebukhosi bakhe nemandla akhe.
Nceda, ninike uSimakadze kuthula lokufana negama lakhe; Ninikele iminikelo yenu, nifike emafuleni akhe.
Babusiseni kuSimakadze ngebucwebe bekungcwele bakhe; titse phambi kwakhe, umhlaba wonke.
Nitsi kubantfu: UNkulunkulu ulawula, mhlaba uqinile, awunakukhathazwa; yena uyawugwema abantu ngekuthula.
Lizulu lijabulise, imhlaba uphumule; lwandle nezinto zonke letikhona kulo licwebezele.
Lemifula nemhlabatsini kumele tijabulise, bese tonkhe tindzawo letiphakeme temhlabatsini kumele tijabulise.
Kunekuthula phambi kwaSimakadze, ngobe yena uyafika; yena uyafika kutsi agweme umhlaba. Uyawugwema umhlaba wonke ngeqiniso lakhe, nebantfu ngenhlonipho yakhe.
USimakadze ulawula, mhlaba kumele ujabulise, imifula lemikhulu kufanele ikhululeke.
Umfutho kanye nebumnyama bukhona kuye; isikhundla sakhe sibekwe ngemtsetfo nekuthula.
Ngumlilo lophuma phambi kwakhe, ubulala labanye batfumi bakhe ngaso sonke simo.
Umlilo wakhe ukhanya emhlabatsini lonke; umhlaba ubona, utfole.
Lemifula ifafazeka njengemoyi ebusweni beSimakadze, ebusweni benkhosi yemhlaba wonke.
Lizulu likhuluma kutsi unguNkulunkulu lowenzayo lokulungile, nebantfu bonke babona bukhosi bakhe.
Bahloniphe bonke labakhonta ema-idoli, nabo bonkhe labo bakhuluma ngezinto letingenalutho; niwubuke kuye, imimoya yonke!
LiSiyone lilalela, livutha; imijikelo yakaJuda ikhuluma ngemiyalo yakho, Simakadze.
UNkulunkulu, wena uphakeme kunaleyo yonke imhlaba; uphakeme kakhulu kunawo wonke lamasiko.
Labathandekayo baSimakadze, phula lokubi; yena ugcina inhliziyo yalabo abangcwele bakhe, ubakhulula emandlani lalababi.
Kulabo labalungile, kukhanya kuyawufika, kanye nekuthula kubo bonkhe labo bekufanele.
Lingisani kuSimakadze, nikwenta lokulungile; libonga igama lakhe elingcwele.
Yite psalme, niyiākāse ingoma entsha kuSimakadze, ngobe wakwenza izinto letinene; isandla sakhe sokudla nemilenze yakhe lengcwele basindisa.
USimakadze wabonisa ukuthula kwakhe, wakhombisa ema-Israyeli kutsi uyakwenza lokulungile.
Wakhumbula inhlonipho yakhe, nekukholwa kwakhe kuboSirayeli; zonke tiphenyane temhlaba zabona uNkulunkulu wethu, nabo bonkhe bantfu bakhe.
Lingisani kuSimakadze, yonke imhlaba; lingisane nengoma yekuphumula nekubonga.
Lalelani kuSimakadze nge-harpa, ne-harpa kanye nemsindo womculo.
Ngemibhoshongo, nangemsindo wemphimbo yengulube, nitshweleni ngekuthula phambi kwaSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Amoni.
Lelwandle ne tonkhe tive letikhona kulo, lemhlaba kanye nalowo wonke lohlala kuwo, kumele ahambe.
Nabatfole imifula, nabaphikelele emadolobheni, Nabakhulise nabo bonke.
Baze bacwebezela phambi kwaSimakadze, ngobe yena uyafika enkantolo yemhlaba; uyawukhipha isinqumo kumhlaba wonke ngeqiniso, nemindeni ngekuhle.
UNkulunkulu ulawula, namasiko akhatshulwa; wahlala ebukhosini bakhe phakathi kwekerubi; umhlaba ukhatshulwa.
UNkulunkulu umkhulu eSiyoni, uphakeme kunawo wonke lamazwe.
Bayawubonga igama lakho lelikhulu, nelihle kakhulu; Lingcwele!
USimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, unguNkulunkulu lonamandla, lowo lathandana nemtsetfo; wena wabeka mthetho, wehlisa isinqumo kanye nemvume kuYakobi.
Lambisani Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, nibuke embhedeni wakhe; yena ungcwele.
Musa na-Aron bebengabangcwele bakhe, neSamuele abengumnye walabo lababiza igama lakhe; bathandaza kuSimakadze, wabaphendulela.
Wakhuluma nabo emgodini wemvula; bagcine mthetho wakhe nemtsetfo wakhe labewanikela kubo.
Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, wabaphendule; ube nguNkulunkulu loyawubalungisa, nakuba ubenecala lokubi labo.
Nceba uSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wethu, nibuke emhlabatsini sakhe esingcwele; ngobe uSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wethu, ungcwele.
Psalmeni yekubonga. Lingisani kuSimakadze, umhlaba wonke!
Basebentisani Simakadze ngekuphumula, nifike kuye ngekulalela.
Kutsi: "UNkulunkulu unguNkulunkulu, yena lowenzayo, naye uyawuhlala kuwo; siyakuba bantu bakhe, tingulube takubo.
Ngeni emigwaqeni yakhe ngekubonga, nifike emafulethini akhe ninebucwebe; nimubule, nilubale igama lakhe.
UNkulunkulu ulungile, inhlonipho yakhe ihlala kuze kube sekupheleni; ubuqiniso bakhe buye kubo bonkhe labantfu.

"Ngiyakubona kutsi ngiphila ngendlela lelungile. Kuphi lapho uyawufika khona kum? Ngitahlala ekhaya lami ngenhliziyo yami ekahle,
Ngatsi: "Angeke ngibone lutho lokubi, ngobe ngiyawugcoba umsebenzi webantfu labakhohlakali; angeke ngibe nesibopho salowo."

Umthandazo wemuntfu lohluphekile, lokhatshulwa, lapho ekhipha khona buhlungu bakhe kuSimakadze. UNkulunkulu, lalela umnikelo wami, nafike umsindo wami kuwe.
Ungawufihlanga lobuso bakho kum, ngelilanga lenkinga yami; Nciphisa ndlebe yakho kuye; Niphendule ngokushesha lapho ngitsi khona.
Tisuku tami tihamba njengemlilo, nemithambo yami iphuma njengesibhakabhaka.

Ngihlala ngiyo, ngifana nengulube lephila yedwa efuleni.

Lowehlukanise lwandle lwesibhakabhaka, ngobe kutfutfuka kwakhe kuhlala kuze kube sekupheleni.
Wabeka Israele phakathi kwayo, ngobe lokuthula kwakhe kuhlala kuze kube sekupheleni.
Wabeka uFaro kanye nemkhosi wakhe emfuleni waseSirayeli; ngobe kukhulu kwakhe kuhlala kuze kube sekupheleni.
Wabahambisa bantfu bakhe emhlabatsini, ngobe kuthula kwakhe kuhlala kuze kube sekuseni.
Lowabulala bantfu labakhulu, ngobe kuthula kwakhe kuhlala kuze kube sekupheleni.
Wabulala bantfu labakhulu, ngobe kuthula kwakhe kuhlala kuze kube sekuseni.
Lowabulala uSihoni, ukumkani wema-Amori; ngobe kuthula kwakhe kuhlala kuze kube sekupheleni.
Lowabulala Og, inkhosi yaseBashan; ngobe kutfutfuka kwakhe kuhlala kuze kube sekupheleni.
Wabanikela ngemhlaba wabo njengelifa, ngobe lokuthula kwakhe kuhlala kuze kube sekupheleni.
Wayinikela kuSirayeli, mkhonzi wakhe; ngobe uthando lwakhe luhlala kuze kube sekupheleni.
Utsi: "Watsi: 'UNkulunkulu uhlala njalo, ngobe kukhulu kwakhe kuhlala kuze kube sekupheleni.
Watsi: "Uyawusikhulula ekuhlaselweni kwethu, ngobe kuthula kwakhe kuhlala kuze kube sekupheleni."
Lonika kudla kubo bonkhe labaphilayo, ngobe lokuthula kwakhe kuhlala kuze kube sekupheleni.
Uyawubonga Nkulunkulu wemazulu, ngobe kutfutfuka kwakhe kuhlala kuze kube sekupheleni.
Ngemifula yaseBabiloni, sahlala silele, sakhuluma lapho sakhumbula khona iZiyoni.
Sikhonta khona ema-harps ethu emidvonyeni yetinti.
Batsi: "Niyicwebezele ingoma yabo labo labatfusa, Niyicwebezele ingoma yekuthula labo labatfusa; Niyicwebezele ingoma yeSiyoni labo labatfusa.
Ngabe siyawukhuluma kanjani ingoma taSimakadze emhlaba wema-Arabhu?
LaseJerusalema, uma ngikulibala wena, isandla sami sekwesobunxele siphindze sikhohlwe ukudlala.
Lilimi lami licishe libe lihleli emlonyeni wami, uma sengingeke ngikukhumbula wena, uma sengingeke ngithande iJerusalema ngaphezu kwetfu.
Khumbula, Simakadze, lokudla kwabo bantfu be-Edomu kuleso sikhathi lapho bahlasela khona iJerusalema, betsi: "Khubulani, khubulani kuze kube yisisekelo saso!
"Uyawufa, wena umhlali waseBabiloni; uphile lowo lotawukukhokhela ngako konke lokwenta nathi."
Uphile lowo loyawutsisa labantwana bakho, wabeka ematsheni abo.
LoDavide, ngiyakubonga ngaso sonke sicupho sami; Ngitakusingisa kuSimakadze phambi kwaNkulunkulu.
Ngiyawubuka ngemehlo ami ethempelini lakho elingcwele, ngitawubonga igama lakho, ngenxa yekuthula kwakho, neqiniso lakho; ngobe ugcine igama lakho likhulu kunakho konke, namazwi akho.
Ngelilanga lemi, lapho ngitsi khona, ungiphendulile; wangisinika umphefumulo nemandla.
Kuyawukubonga wena, Simakadze, bonke bantfu basemhlaba, lapho bekhuluma khona amazwi akho.
Bakhuluma ngendlela yaSimakadze, ngobe ubuhle beNkulunkulu bukhulu kakhulu.
Ngako-ke Simakadze uphakeme kakhulu, wamukela labo baphansi; kepha awazi labasebukhali basekude.
Nakuba ngihamba ngetinhlekelele, wena ungivivinya. Utfusa isandla sakho kubuhlungu bomfishane bami; isandla sakho sokudla siyawungivikela.
UNkulunkulu uyawukwenza konke lokwenta kuye ngami. UNkulunkulu, inhlonipho yakho ihlala kuze kube sekupheleni; ungabi nenkinga ngemisebenzi yesandla sakho.
UNkulunkulu, wena ungibona, ungazi; nguNkulunkulu lokhuluma ngami. Umculo waDavide, ku-Eliya.
Utsi: "Lokuhlala kwami, nekuvuka kwami, wena uwazi; kanye nemibono yami, wena uyibona kusuka kude.
Ubona lapho ngihamba khona, nelapho ngihlala khona, nawe uwazi zonke izinto letingeke ngizenza.
Kungeke kube khona lutho emlonyeni wami, ngobe wena, Simakadze, uwazi.
Ungihlanganisa ngaseceleni kwami nasemandleni ami, umisa isandla sakho phezu kwami.
Lolwazi lwami lungaba likhulu kakhulu, lukhulu kakhulu kutsi ngiluqonde.
Ngiyaphi ngesuka emphefumulweni wakho? Ngahamba phi ngesuka ebusweni bakho?
Ngatsi ngiya ezulwini, wena ukhona khona; nangatsi ngihlala emhlabatsini, nawe ukhona khona.
Nakuba ngihamba ngetinyawo tasondza, nakuba sengihlala eningizimu yelwandle,
Nalapho-ke, isandla sakho siyawuncenga, nesandla sakho sokudla sitawungibamba.
Uma ngitsi: "Kungeke kube khona mnyama leyawungifihla, kanye nekukhanya lokuseceleni kwami kutawuba ngubusuku,"
Nasekumnyama akucaci kuwe, ngobe ubusuku bukhanya njengelilanga; nakumnyama kucaci kuwe njengekukhanya.
Uyawungilungisa, uyawungisisa emlonyeni wamama wami; Uyawungisa imisipha yami yonke.
Ngikubonga, Simakadze, ngobe nguNkulunkulu wezinto letijabulileākāsa kakhulu; nguNkulunkulu wezinto tijabulise kakhulu. Lokwakho ngikubona kahle.
Lenyama yami yayingeke ibe yifihlakele kuwe, lapho ngakhiwa khona ngekufihlakele, lapho ngicutshungulwa khona emhlabatsini.
Lamehlo akho angangibona ngaphambi kwekuzalwa kwami; lilanga lemi libhalwe encwadini yakho, kuze kube kufike linye lalelo.
UNkulunkulu, imicabango yakho inhle kakhulu kuye; Yimiphi lemikhulu!
Nakuba ngifuna kubala, bangaba makhulu kunamacwecwe emphini; kepha uma sengibuka, ngase ngikhona nawe.
LoNkulunkulu, ngase ngifune kutsi ubulalane nalababi; shiya nami, nibabulala!
Bakhuluma nawe ngezinto letibi, batsatsa igama lakho lilanga.
Simakadze, angeke yini ngibafune labo labakufunako wena? Angeke yini ngibafune labo labaphikisayo kuwe?
Ngibakhonta kakhulu; bayawube baholi bami.
Yibone intamo yami, Nkulunkulu, ubone umphefumulo wami; hlola ngami, ubone imicabango yami.
Bheka, ngabe kunendlela lebi engiyenzayo, uyenza ngihambe ngendlela yebudzala.
UNkulunkulu, lisabalalise ngami kulabo lababi, ugcine ngami kulabo lababi, Kulowo lohamba ngengoma, psalme kaDavide.
labaphikisa lokubi emiphefumulweni yabo, bese beqala kulwa ngaso sonke sikhatsi.
Lilimi lwabo lifana nelimtfubi, kanye namazwi abo afana nemkhuhlane wenyoka. (Sela).
Lingisa, Simakadze, ngasesandla semuntfu lobi; gcina-nemi kulowo muntfu lomfishane, lowo efuna kutsi ngiphambuke.
Labakhulu bamisa umgodzi wami, bamisa inkemba yami eduze kwendlela, bamisa imigodzi yami. (Sela)
Ngitsi kuSimakadze: "UNkulunkulu wami unguNkulunkulu wami." UNkulunkulu, lalela umsindo wami.
USimakadze, Nkulunkulu wami, umkhonzi wami loyawusindisa; wena uvikela inhloko yami lilanga lemphi.
UNkulunkulu, ungabi nesibopho kulabo lababi; ungeke ubavumele bafeze imicabango yabo lemibi, ukuze bangabi namandla. (Sela)
Labo bami bahlala ngaseceleni kwami, lihlavu labo litawugcotshwa ngubuhlungu bemilenze yabo.
Kufike kubo lilanga lemlilo, batfutwe emliloni, kulabo mhlabatsi lolubomvu, labangeke baphume khona.
Laba bakhuluma bugebengu ngabanye, bangabi nekuthula emhlabani; livi lelimfishane libe ngelabo lababusi.
Ngiyazi kutsi Simakadze utawukhipha isinqumo kulabo labahluphekayo, utawulungisa icala lalabo abafileyo.
Bayawubonga igama lakho labo labalungile, nalabo abathembekileyo bahlala phambi kwakho.
Psalmeni yaDavide. Simakadze, ngitsi kuwe: Hlala ungisindise; ngitsi kuwe: Yiva nami lapho ngikutsatsa khona.
Umthandazo wami ufike kuwe njengefutfume, nesandla sami lesiphakeme sibe semnikelo wesono.
UNkulunkulu, kubeka umgodzi emphinjeni yami, ugcine imnyango wemilomo yami.
Musa kutsi intliziyo yami ihambe kunoma yini lebi, ngibe ngumholi webantfu lababi, ngekwenza izinto letibi; ngingadli ukudla kwabo.

Kutsi uma muntfu lolungile engcolisa, kuyitfutfuko; uma engiletsa, kufana namafutha etindlebeni tami. Ngingeke ngiwubeke phansi, kepha ngiyawuthandaza ngalezinto letibi letisetshenzisiwe ngumuntu lobi.
Bayawuva amazwi ami, batawuzi kutsi lamazwi ami alungile, lapho abaphathi babo beboshwa emahlanjeni.
Batsi: "Imhlaba uphekwe, uhlukaniswe; ticubu tathu zisakazeka emaphethelweni eGibhithe."
Lamehlo ami abheke kuwe, Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wami; ngiya kuwe ngekuthula; ungabangele ngami.
Gcwalisa ngize ngingangeni emgodini labewumisa kimi, Emgodini walelabo labasebentisa lokubi.
Labakhohlakali bafike bahlaselwe ngemanti abo, kodvwa mina ngiyawuphuma sengiphephile.
Zaburi, lebhalwe nguDavide, lapho ehlala khona emgwaqeni. Umthandazo: Ngiyethemba kuSimakadze; ngicela ukuthula kuye.
Ngatsi: "Ngitawukhipha kuye umsindo wami, ngitawukhuluma kuye zonke tibuhlungu tami."
"Nasemoya wami ephazamisekile ngaphakathi kwami, wena usazi indlela yami; emgwaqeni lapho ngihamba khona, abantu bangisibeka itfu.
Ndzaba ngakwesokudla kwami, bese ubona; akukho namunye lokhuluma ngami; angeke kube khona lapho ngihlala khona; ngeke kube khona lowo lokhuluma ngami.
Ngikutsatsa, Simakadze, ngitsi: Uyindawo yami yekuphumula; wena uyawuba ngumnikelo wami ezweni lalabo baphilayo.
Lingisa lokushiwo nguSimakadze, utsi: "Lilalela lukhulu lwami, ngobe nginenkinga; lisabalalisela labo labaphazamisayo, ngobe banamandla kunami.
Landza ngiphuma emgodini wami, ngiyobonga igama lakho; bayawuhlangana nami labangcwele, ngobe ungigcinele kulungile.
Zaburi kaDavide. UNkulunkulu, lalela umthandazo wami; Hlala umsindo wami, ngobe wena unguNkulunkulu weqiniso, lowenza lokulungile.
Hamba, ugcine umkhonzi wakho engcupheni, ngobe angeke kube khona lophilayo lolungile emehlo akho.
Utsi: "Umdlavuza ungibulala, utfusa impilo yami emhlabatsini; ungenza ngihlale enhliziyweni lemnyama, njengelabo labafile kuleso sikhatsi.
Lomoya wami uhlala mkhulu ngaphakathi kwami, nenhliziyo yami igcwele umsindo.
Ngitsi: "Ngelilanga lekucala, ngacabanga ngemsebenti wakho wonke, ngacabanga ngemisebenzi yesandla sakho.
Ngitaphakamisa isandla sami kuwe, ngikufunela njengemhlaba lomnyama. (Sela)
Yite, Simakadze, ngiphendulākāse; umphefumulo wami uhluphekile; ungawufihla ubuso bakho kum, ngobe ngibe njengelabo labaphuma eGibhithe.
Laba, ngifike ngakulalela kutfumisa kwakho ngalolusuku lonke; ngobe sengikhombisile kuwe. Nceda ufundise indlela lokufanele ngiyihambe, kodvwa ngiyatinikela wena ngemoya wami.
UNkulunkulu, khulula ngasekufeni kwami; Ngiya kuwe ngiyawufihla.
Sifundisanise indlela yakho, ngobe wena uNkulunkulu wami; umphefumulo wakho longcwele ungihambisane nendlela ekahle.
UNkulunkulu, ngenxa yegama lakho, ugcine ngiphila; ngobe ungenawo umcabango lolungile, khiphani etinhlekweni.
Kunethando lwakho, khipha bobubi bami; Tsuse bonke labaphikisayo ngami, ngobe sengumkhonzi wakho.
WaDavide: Longcwele uSimakadze, lomtfubi wami, lowo lofundisa isandla sami kutsi sihambe emkhosini, nemilenze yami kutsi ibuye emidlaleni.
UNkulunkulu, umkhonzi wami, nesikhulu sami, nendlu yami lephakeme, nalowo longisasindisa; umsebenti wami, nome ngiwusebentisa kanjani?
Simakadze, yini naleyo ndoda, kutsi uyawubhekana nayo? Yini naleyo ndvodza, kutsi uyicabangele?
Umntu ufana nemoya, nelilanga lakhe lifana nesithunzi lesidlulayo.
Vumela izulu lakho, Simakadze, uyeke uhambe; cindezela imifula, ibe ngumlilo.
Thumela umlilo bese unquma umfowabo. Nciphisa imilenze yakho bese ubavumela bahambe.
Thinda isandla sakho kusuka phezulu, usindise, unciphise elwandle lokukhulu, emkhosini webantfu labangaphandle,
Labo imilomo yabo ikhuluma lutho, nesandla sabo sokudla sinikela ngemtsetfo.
LoNkulunkulu, ngitakusingisa ingoma entsha; ngiyakulalela ngetintambo letilishumi.
wena lonika ukuthula kumabukhosi, wena lokhipha umkhonzi wakho Davide ekufeni ngesandla.
Lawulahla, lalulahla emandlani emaphesheya, amehlo abo akhuluma ububi, nesandla sabo sasekudla sikhuluma lutho.
Lamadodana ethu ayawukhula abe njengetihlahla, nemadvodzakati ethu abe njengobe tinhloko leticwebezelayo endlunkulu.
Tindlu zethu tekudla tiyawutfunywa ngaso sonke sidakambiso, inkomo yethu itawukhula ibe ngamaphesenti lamakhulu, namaphesenti lamashumi lamakhulu, emasimini ethu.
Tingulube tathu tiyawutingela, umkhonzi wethu angeke afike esiteji sethu. Angeke kube nemuntu lothathwa njengemkhwenyana, kungabikho kugwazeka emabhishi ethu.
Kuhle kubo bonkhe bantfu labaphila ngalolu kuthula; kuhle kubo bonke bantfu labaNkulunkulu wabo nguSimakadze.
Ngitawukubonga wena, Nkulunkulu wami, Mlengikazi wami; ngiyawubonga igama lakho kuze kube sekupheleni, kuze kube sekupheleni.
Ngitakubonga ngalolusuku lonke, ngitawuhlonipha igama lakho kuze kube sekupheleni.
UNkulunkulu umkhulu, ufanele kubonga kakhulu; Angeke kube khona lowo lokwaziyo kutsi ukhulu kangakanani.
Babe bakhuluma ngemisebenzi yakho kubonyana babo, bakhuluma ngemandla akho anamandla.
Ngitakhuluma ngekuthula kwakho, nemisebenzi yakho emangalisayo.
Bayawukhuluma ngemandla akho, nami ngitawukhuluma ngenkhulumo yakho.
Bayawuvuya ngekuhle kwakho lokukhulu, bayawuvuya ngenhlonipho yakho yekwenza lokudla.
UNkulunkulu ulungile, ugcwele kutfutfuka, uhlala ephazamisekile, ukhulule ekubekezeleleni.
Simakadze ulungile kubo bonkhe bantfu, wanikela ngenhlonipho kuwo wonke lamake.
Kuyawukubonga wena, Simakadze, yonke lemisebenzi yakho; nabo bonkhe labangcwele bakho baya kubonga.
Bakhuluma ngekuthula kwebukhosi bakho, bashumayela ngemandla akho,
kutsi bakhulume ngemandla akho, nekuthula lokukhulu kwebukhosi bakho.

Ubukhosi bakho buhlala kuze kube sekupheleni, wena ulawula kuze kube sekupheleni kweminyaka; Simakadze ugcina zonke tincwadzi tekucala titsi "umsebenti wakhe" nguNkulunkulu lophilayo kanye nehovisi lakhe.
Simakadze usekela bonke labafayo, uphakamisa bonkhe labo labagcwala.
Labo bonke bakubona wena, nawe utawubanikela ngekudla kwabo kuleso sikhathi.
Uvula isandla sakho, unikela ngemandla kuwo wonke laphilayo.
UNkulunkulu ulungile kuwo onkhe emisebenzi yakhe, ungcwele kuwo tonkhe tive lakhe.
Simakadze ufikela kubo bonke labamwikelayo, kubo bonke labamwikelayo ngeqiniso.
Wabanikela labo labamhloniphayo, wava kuthula kwabo, wabasindisa.
UNkulunkulu ugcina labo labamthanda, kodvwa uyawubulala bonke labengalungile.
Lindlebe lami liyawubonga uSimakadze, nalowo wonke lophilayo abulethe igama lakhe elingcwele kuze kube sekupheleni.
Lingisa uSimakadze, lingisa uSimakadze, intfumo yami!
Ngiyawubonga kuSimakadze lilanga lemi, ngitawulalela kuNkulunkulu wami kuze kube ngukuphila kwami.
Mna-ke, ungase ubeke lithemba lakho kulabo labalawulayo, ebantwaneni kuphela labangeke batfume wena.
Liphunga labo liphuma kubo, babuyela emhlabatsini; ngalolusuku lonke lomsebenti wabo ungeke ube khona.
Kuhle kubo laba ngaNkulunkulu waYakobi loyawubasiza, labo lithemba lawo kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wabo.
Lowenza izulu nemhlaba, lwandle nezinto tonkhe letikhona kulo; uhlala ethembekile kuze kube sekupheleni.
Unikela ngemtsetfo kulabo lababiwe, nekudla kubo bonkhe labo labalahlekile; Simakadze ukhipha lababoshwe.
UNkulunkulu uvula amehlo lalabo abamnyama, uThixo uphakamisa labo lababi; nguNkulunkulu lowo othandana nalabalungile.
UNkulunkulu uhlala ecaleni labanye, ubhekana nalabo bahlala ngaphandle kwabazali babo kanye nebesifazane labafayo, kepha ubulala imicabango yalababi.
Nkulunkulu wakho, Siyoni, utawulawula kuze kube sekupheleni, kuze kube sekupheleni kweminyaka leminyenti. Lombisani Simakadze!
Kulungile kubonga Nkulunkulu wethu; kumnandi, kulungile kutsi simukeffa kuye.
Simakadze uyawukwakha kabusha iJerusalema, uyawubuyisela lamakhosikazi aseSirayeli atfutwe.
Ulapha labo lababiswe ngenhliziyo yabo, wabeka ticubu tabo.
Ubala tinyenyela, wazisa ngamagama abo lahlukene.
UNkulunkulu wethu umkhulu kakhulu, unamandla amakhulu; kuqonda kwakhe kungakapheli.
USimakadze uphakamisa lalabo abancane, kodvwa ubeka phansi lababi.
Hambani kuSimakadze ngekubonga, nidlale kuNkulunkulu wethu ngecansi.
Uye uvikela izulu ngemanti, ukhipha umhlwa emhlabeni, uphindze afake emhlabatsini kutsi bukhule.
Wabanikela ngekudla etinakeni, kanye nalabo bancane betingcuphi lapho bekhuluma khona.
Akazange akhululeke ngemandla engulube noma ngemandla emadolo lamuntfu.
UNkulunkulu uthanda labo labamhloniphayo, nalabo labakholwa kuthando lwakhe.
Lambisa uSimakadze, Yerusalemi; lambisa Nkulunkulu wakho, Siyoni!
Uyawuqinisa tintambo temnyango wakho, utawubambisa abantu bakho ekungeneni kwetemphi yakho.
Uyawukulethela kuthula emaphandleni akho, utawukutfumisa ngemifino ehle kakhulu.
Uthumela umyalo wakhe emhlabani, Lizwi lakhe lihamba ngekushesha.
Ukhipha intaba-mlilo njengelukhuni, ususa imvula yemvula njengenkungu.
Ukhipha tikhukhula njengetibhaka-bhaka; yini leyawumelana nemvula yakhe?
Uthumela imvumo yakhe, uyala; ukhipha umfutho wakhe, amanzi aphuma.
Wabonisa kuYakobi lizwi lakhe, imiyalo yakhe nemtsetfo wakhe kuSirayeli.
Akazange akwenze njalo ebantwini bakhe, Batsi-ke bangawazi mtsetfo wakhe. Lombisani uSimakadze!
Lingisani Simakadze, lingisani Nkulunkulu kusuka emazulu, lingisani kuye emhlabatsini.
Sibekele kuye, bonke ema-angeli akhe; sibekele yena, wonke umkhosi wakhe emhlabatsini.
Sibekele kuye, lilanga nelilanga; sibekele yena, nitinkhulungwane letikhanyayo.
Lambisani yena, nitizulu letiphakeme, namanzi lasentshonalanga.
Kuyawubonga igama laSimakadze, ngobe watsi, "Lawo akhiwa" nguNkulunkulu.
Wayibeka ngemandla kuze kube sekupheleni, wamisa mthetho longeke ushintshwe.
Lambisani uSimakadze kusuka emhlabatsini, nitilwane telwandle letikhulu, naletinye tilwandle,
lilanga, nemvula, netintaba, nemanti, nemandla emlilo, akwenza lokusho kwakhe;
emadolobheni kanye naleyo mhlabatsi, nemajikijolo ekudla kanye nesetindzaweni,
tilwane temhlaba kanye netintfo letiphilako, tinyama letincane kanye netingulube,
bukhosi bemhlaba, nebantfu bonke, nabaholi kanye nabo bonkhe labaholi bemhlaba,
labesifazane kanye nebantfu labancane, labakhulu kanye nabantwana.
Bafeze igama laSimakadze, ngobe igama lakhe kuphela likhulu; ubuhle bakhe bungaphezulu kwemhlaba kanye nezulu.
Uye wabambisana nabo bonkhe bantfu bakhe, abe ngumnikelo wekushiswa kubo bonke labangcwele bakhe, kubantfu bakaSirayeli, labo abasengqondweni yakhe.
Lingisani Simakadze, lingisizeni ingoma entsha kuSimakadze! Lisisaneni naye emcimbini webantfu bakhe abangcwele.
ISirayeli ijabulise ngelowo layawuyenza, nebantfu beSiyoni baphumule ngenhlanhla ngenxa yenkhosi yabo.
Bavelise igama lakhe nemdanso, bacwengeleke kuye ngemibhoshongo nencintiswano.
USimakadze uthanda abantu bakhe, wabeka lilanga lekuthula ebantwini babo.
Labangcwele bakhe bakhulume ngekuthula kwakhe, Bakhubeke embhedeni wabo.
Kuyawuba khona lokubonga kuNkulunkulu emlonyeni wabo, nesandla sabo sitawuba sesiliva lelibomvu,
kutsi agweme ema-Israyeli, abe nemtsetfo ngebantfu,
kutsi babambe bobukhosi babo ngemikhumbi, nebaholi babo ngetintambo tensimbi;
Uya kutsi aphumeze lokubhaliwe kubo, kutsi abe ngumnikelo wekushiswa kuwo wonke lakholwa kuye. Lokho kuyawubonga Simakadze!
Lombisani uSimakadze, lobongani uNkulunkulu ethempelini lakhe, lobongani kumandla akhe.
Sibekele kuye ngemandla akhe, sibekele yena ngebukhulu bakhe obukhulu.

Wonke lowo lothola umtfubi ngekukhokha inhlawulo lephakeme, utawuyikhipha kulowo lafuna kutsi abe nekuthula nalabo abafayo.
Uma kukhona longeke alalele mthetho, khona-ke umthandazo wakhe udlalwa nguNkulunkulu.
Lowo lobeka labakhulu endlela lebi, uyawufika emgodini wabo; kepha labo abalungile baphindze babe nekudla lokunekuthula.
Umtfubi ubona emehlo akhe kutsi unebwenge, kepha umtfubi onengqondo unenhlonipho.
Uma abantu labalungile bewina, kuvela kuphumula lokukhulu; kepha lapho lababi befika emandlani, abantu bafihla.
Lomuntfu lofihla isono sakhe angeke abe nenhlanhla, kepha lowo muntfu lokhuluma ngaso bese egwema kuyo, uzothola umviwa.
Uphile umuntu lohlala ekholwa kuNkulunkulu; kepha lowo uphindze agcine umphefumulo wakhe mkhulu, utawufika ebuhlungu.
Umholi lobi kulabo labancane, ufana nelilonte lelingcolisako, noma nengulube ephikisayo.
Umphathi lobulala bantfu bakhe awunakuqonda, kepha lowo okhohlisa inzuzo yakhe uhlala iminyaka lengemuva.
Lomuntfu lokhatshulwa ngumsebenti wekubulala, utawuhamba kuze aphele; akukho lowo loyawubasiza.
Lohamba ngendlela yakhe lelungile, uhlala ephephile; kepha lohamba ngendlela yakhe ekhohlakeleyo, uyawugwa.
Lowusebentisa mhlaba wakhe utawunekudla lokuningi, kepha lowulandzela iphupho lakhe utawunendlala.
Lomuntfu lothembekile uphindze abe nemandla, kepha lowo lohamba ngejubane angeke aphume ngaphandle kwemsebenti.
Akunakuhle kutsi ukhethe icala, ngobe kukhona labangeke bakwenze kahle ngenxa yesokudla.
Lomuntfu lokhazimule uhamba ngejubane kutsi abe mkhulu, kodvwa akawazi kutsi umfutho uyawufike.
Wonke lowo lokwenta lokubi kumunye, ekupheleni kwemsebenti wakhe, uphindze abe ngumhlonishwa kakhulu kunalowo lokhuluma ngekuhle.
Lowudlwengula ubaba wakhe noma umama wakhe, watsi: "Kulungile," angeke abe ngcono kunalowo obulala.
Umfana lophila ngemali uvusa umncintiswano, kepha lowo uyala kuSimakadze uyakwenza kahle.
Lotisebentisa isandla sakhe, ungeke ahambe; kepha lophila ngengqondo, utawuhlala.
Loninika umtfubi angeke abe nenkinga; kepha lowuvala mehlo akhe kulomtfubi, utawuba nesilamano esikhulu.
Uma bekhula lababi, abantu bafihla; kepha lapho lababi beboshwa khona, labalungile bakhulela.
Lomuntfu lohlala ephazamisekile ngemuva kokugcwaliswa ngezikhathi eziningi, utawufa lilanga letfu, futhi akukho lokungeke kuyawuwuvikela.
Uma labalungile bekwenza kahle, abantu baphumula; kepha lapho lababi belawula khona, bathola lilanga.
Umfana lothanda ubuhlakani ujabulisa ubaba wakhe, kepha umfana lohamba nebantfu labaphazamisayo unciphisa imfuyo yakhe.
Umphathi uvikela lizwe lakhe ngekuhle, kepha lowo lofuna umkhonto uyala.
Loba uhamba ngesandla sakhe, umisa umgodzi emilenzeni yakhe.
Abantu lababi bahlaselwa ngububi babo, kepha abantu labalungile bangaba nekuthula.
Labalungile bacabanga ngemtsetfo walabo abahluphekayo, kepha lababi bangacabangi ngawo.
Labaphazamisayo bakhulisa dolobha, kepha labacophelela baletsa umsindo.
Uma umfundi efaka umfoti emthethweni, umfoti utsatsa imvumo yakhe, wakhala, kwatsi angeke kube nekuthula.
Lababulala bakhohlisa abantu labathembekile, bese befuna kubulawa labo labakwenza kahle.
Longenangqondo ukhipha umsindo wakhe, kepha labacophelela bagcina kuthula.
Uma umphathi elalela lokubi, bonke labaphatsimandla bakhe bangabi nabubi.
Lolu hlobo lufana nalabo labaphazamisayo, ngobe Simakadze unikela ngekubona emilenzeni yabo bonkhe.
Uma uMbuso usabalalisa lomnyama ngekuthula, isikhundla sakhe siyawutsi sihlala njalo.
Ukunakekela kanye nekukhulisa kunika buhlakani, kepha umfana lohlala ehamba ngesandla sakhe, ushiya umnambitsi wakhe.
Nalapho lababi bekhula khona, nebubi bukhula; kepha labo balungile bangababona behla.
Laletsa izingane zakho, batawukunika kuthula; batawukuletha kutfutfuka.
Kulapho kungakabi khona mtsetfo, abantu baphuma emphilweni; kepha banekuthula labo labagcina mthetho.
Amazwi kuphela angeke alungise umkhonzi; Nakuba ucabanga, akawuphenduli.
Uma ubona umuntu ekhuluma ngekushesha kakhulu, umfana unethemba elikhulu kunalowo.
Uma utsatsa umkhonzi wakho kutsi abe ngumfana, ekupheleni kwakhe uyakubona sengathi ungumntwana wakho.
Umkhonto wetfu uvusa umncintiswano, nalowo lophikisayo uphindze akhulele ebubini.
Inhlonipho inciphisa umuntu, kepha umphefumulo lobushelelezi uthola kuthula.
Lowusebentisa lomdlavuza, ubulala nguNkulunkulu wakhe; baphelelwa livi, kodvwa bangati kutsi.
Lokwesaba umuntu kungenxa yetfu, kepha lowo lohlala enkhosini uyawuhlala.
Abantu abaningi bafuna ubuhle benkhosi, kepha inhlonipho yebantfu ivela kuSimakadze.
Lamadoda alungile ayawuphazamisa labo lababi, nalabo lababi bayaphazamisa labo abaphila ngendlela efanele.
Lemilomo ya-Agur, umsa wa-Jake, umlayezo lowawu ku-Ithiyeli, ku-Ithiyeli ne-Ukali, watsi:
"Ngiye mkhulu kunabo bonke abantu, ngingeke ngibe nengqondo yemuntu
Ngingeke ngifundile ubuhlakani, ngobe angifuni kufunda loMngcwele.

Nguwuphi lowo wenyuka emhlabatsini, waphuma khona? Nguwuphi lowo uhlanganisayo umoya emilenzeni yakhe? Nguwuphi lowo lobeka amanzi emlonyeni wakhe? Nguwuphi lowo obeka khona ekupheleni kwemhlaba? Yini igama lakhe, yini igama lomntwana wakhe? Nceda ukhulume nami uma uyazi!
Lonke ulwimi lwaNkulunkulu lulungile, waba ngutivikela labo labaphuma kuye.
Mfushaneni naSimakadze, Simakadze Nkulunkulu wenu, ngobe yena unguNkulunkulu wakho.
Lezinto ezimbili, Simakadze, ngikucela; ungamibi kutsi ngife.
Lalela phandle kusuka kum, lokubi kanye nebugebengu; ungeke ungivumele ngibe mncane noma ngingumtfutsi. Nceda umhlambi wami wekudla ngaso sonke sikhatsi.
Uma nginetfu, ngiyakushiya, ngitsi: Ubani uSimakadze? Nakuba sengincane, ngiyawudlwengula, ngobe nguNkulunkulu wami.
Mna-ke, ungeke ukhulume lutho lokubi ngemuntfu lomkhonto kuSimakadze wakhe, kutsi angakuphazamisa wena, nawe ube nenkinga.
Bakhona labo labalama baba babo, bangabambisani nabangani babo.
Bakhona bantfu labacabanga kutsi bahlanzekile, kepha bangabi nephunga lelihle lokudlidliza.
Bakhona abantu labafana nalowo, babheka phansi kubo bonkhe.
Bakhona labaphikisayo, nemilenze yabo injengesibhakabhaka, nemehlo abo afana nemcumbu; badla bobi emhlabani, nalabo abafayo emaphupheni.
Itsi: "Lenkukhu inezingane ezimbili, zithi: 'Nceda! Nceda!'" Kunezinto ezintathu letingeke tikhululeke; kunezinhlanu lezingati kutsi: "Kulungile!"
Nasekufaneni, nendvodza lengeke ikhulele; nemhlaba lapho amanzi angeke afike khona; nemlilo longakatsi: Kulungile!
Lomuntfu lotsatsa ubaba wakhe ngesandla sakhe, nome angeke avumele umkakhe kutsi akhulume naye, lamehlo akhe atawucutshungulwa tingulube letisuka emfuleni, nalabo batfutsi bazowadla.
Kunezinto letintsatfu letingeke ngiziqonde kahle, netisitfupha letingeke ngiziqonde:

njengendlela i-eagle ephila ngayo emkhathini, kanye nendlela i-snake ehamba ngayo emadolobheni, kanye nendlela inqanawa ehamba ngayo emanzini avulekile, kanye nendlela umfana ethanda ngayo indodana yakhe.
Leyindlela yendvodza leyenqaba. Idla, ifafaze umlomo wayo, itsi: "Angeke ngibe sengikwenze kahle."
Kunezinto letintsatfu letishaya umhlaba, kunezinto letinhlanu letingeke tihlale:
umkhonzi loyawuba ngunkhosi, nemuntfu lomtfubi lophila ngekudla,
umkakhe, longeke athandeki ngumuntu, abe ngumkakhe; kanye nendvodzakati yakhe, leyawuhlala endaweni yenkosikazi yakhe.
Kunezinto letintsatfu emhlaba letincane kepha tihle kakhulu:
I-Ants ingeke ibe nemandla, kepha igcina ukudla kwayo ngebusika.
Tingulube temhlabatsini tingeke zibe nemandla, kepha zenza tindlu tato ematshe.
Tingulube tingeke tinenkhosi, kodvwa tiyawuhamba tonkhe tive.
Ungeke ubambe lilanga ngesandla sakho, kepha likhona emahhovisini lamakhosi.
Kunezinto letintsatfu letihamba ngemandla, netisikhombisa tihamba nebuhlobo:
iLion, lenamandla kunawo onkhe emahhashi, longeke abuye kunoma yini,
umkhwenyana lohamba, nembudzi, nenkhosi kanye nemkhosi wayo emgwaqeni wakhe.
Uma ungenabo umcabango, noma uma ucabanga lokubi, beka isandla sakho emlonyeni wakho!
Kufana nekugcoba lemilenze kwenza i-butter kanye nekujika intamo kuyenza ibe nemfucuza, ukubamba umsindo kwenza timphiko.
Lemibhalo yaSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, ikhuluma kutsi:
"Mntwana wami, mkhuluwo wami, impendulo yemithandazo yami!
Ungeke uphuze amandla akho emabhishobhi, noma kubo lababulala bukhosi.
Lemuele, akulungile kutsi lamakhosi abe newayini lokudlela; akulungile kutsi labaphathi bafune ubisi.
Uma bedla, bangakhohlwa lokushoko kwemtsetfo, bese basusa malungelo lalabo labahluphekayo.
Ninike ubisi labo labafayo, newayini labo labaphazamiseka kakhulu.
Baphuze, bakhohlwe kungabikho kwabo, bangatsi baphindze bacabange ngebuhlungu babo.
Ukhuluma ngelabo labangeke bakhulume bobabili, uvikela malungelo labo bonkhe labangenakusebentisa.
Ukhuluma bese ukhipha isinqumo ngekuhle, uvikela malungelo lalabo labafile kanye nalabafunayo.
Ufuna yini indodana lekahle? Inhle kakhulu kunetigolide.
Umshado wakhe uyawuthembela kuye kakhulu. Unawo wonke ladingayo.
Wayekhuluma naye ngekuhle, angeke abe nenkinga naye lilanga lekuphila kwakhe.
Ifuna isikhumba kanye nelineni, isebenzela ngesandla sayo lesihle.
Ifana netintsambo temabhizinisi, ifaka ukudla kwayo kusuka kude.
Uphuma lapho kungakabi mnyama kutsi ahlinzeke ngekudla kwemndeni wakhe kanye netintfo tekudla letisebentisa.
Yabona mhlabatsi, yawuthenga; nemali yakhe yayitshala ivini lelinesihlahla.
Isebenza kahle kakhulu nemandla. Imikhono yayo inamandla kakhulu ekusebenzeni kwayo
Ubona kutsi ibhizinisi lakhe lihamba kahle, lilanga lakhe lihlala liphuma ngebusuku.
Ugcina ingubo ngesandla esisodwa bese ujika intambo ngesinye.
Ivulela sandla sayo kulabo labahluphekayo, ifikelisa imilenze yayo kubo bonkhe labo labafunako.
Angeke akhathazeke ngetinhlayiya kumndeni wakhe, ngoba bonke bagqoka tigqoko letimnyama tekushisa.
Iphindze isebentise tingwevu, igqoka ingubo yesiliva neyegolide.
Umshado wayo uhlonishwa emnyango wedolobha, lapho ehlala khona kanye nabaholi belizwe.
Ikhipha ingubo lemhlophe, iyayithengisa; inikela ngemikhono kulabo labahwebi.
Igqokwa ngemandla kanye nekuthula, ikhala ngaphandle kwekukhathazeka ngaleso simo.
Uma ikhuluma, imvumi yayo inenhlonipho; ifundisa ngekuthula.
Uhlala ebhekela konke lokutfolwa ekhaya lakhe, angeke abe nenkinga yekudla.
Labantwana bakhe baphuma, batsi: "Ungcwele!" Umkakhe naye uyawumubonga, watsi:
"Labesifazane abaningi bakwenza izinto tekuhle, kepha wena ungcono kunabo bonke."
Ubuhle bungakukhohlisa, ubuhle abuhlalanga; kodwa indodana leyihloniphayo Simakadze iyawubonga.
Nceda unciphise inzuzo yakhe, nemisebenzi yakhe ifike ibe ngumnikelo wayo emnyango.
